Maraykanka iyo xaalka Iran , Iranian Leader Press Office / Handout/Anadolu via Iyadoo doodaha ku saabsan jihada mustaqbalka ee siyaasadda Maraykanka ee ku wajahan Iran ay sii baahayaan, qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha ayaa sheegaya in maamulka Donald Trump uu qaadan karo hab la mid ah kii uu ku qaatay Venezuela – qaab ay dhaleeceeyayaashu ku tilmaamaan in uu diiradda saarayo isbeddel xaddidan oo ku yimaada madaxda sare ee qaab-dhismeedka awoodda halkii uu ka ahaan lahaa isbeddel buuxa oo ku yimaada nidaamka siyaasadeed. Walaacyadan, oo barbar socda dhaqdhaqaaqyada dibloomaasiyadeed ee cusub iyo wada-hadallada adag ee u dhexeeya Maraykanka iyo Israa'iil, ayaa mar kale keentay su'aalo ku saabsan saamaynta uu muuqaalkan noocaas ahi ku yeelan karo dadka Iran iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Horraantii sannadka -kii, tallaabo aan horay loo arag oo ka dhacday Venezuela, ciidamada militariga Maraykanka ayaa sameeyay hawlgal ballaadhan laakiin waqti gaaban socday, iyagoo soo xidhay Madaxweyne Nicolás Maduro oo ay keeneen Maraykanka – tallaabadan oo keentay falcelin ballaadhan oo caalami ah, saamaynteeduna siyaasadeed iyo amni waxay dhaaftay xuduudaha Laatiin Ameerika. Tallaabadan Maraykanka ayaa soo jiidatay dareenka falanqeeyayaal badan iyo shakhsiyaad siyaasadeed oo kale oo waddammadooda Maraykanka khilaaf siyaasiya kala dhexeeyo. Qaar ka mid ah mucaaradka Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah waxay ka walaacsan yihiin in waxa ka dhacay Venezuela loo arki karo qaab ama digniin maskaxda go'aan-qaatayaasha caalamiga ah iyo kuwa gobolka ee ku socota, suuragalna ka ah ee Iran – inkasta oo xaqiiqooyinka iyo qaab-dhismeedka labada waddan ay aad u kala duwan yihiin. Dhinacaas, maqaal dhawaan lagu daabacay wargeyska Jerusalem Post ee Israa'iil, Saeed Qasemejad iyo Navid Mohebbi ayaa ka digaya in ku celcelinta "qaabka Venezuela" ee Iran ay keeni karto cawaaqiib "masiibo ah" oo ku saabsan dadka Iran iyo amniga Israa'iil. Saeed Qasemejad waa lataliye sare oo ka tirsan Hay'adda Difaaca Dimuqraadiyadda (Foundation for Defense of Democracies), Navid Mohebbi-na waa cilmi-baare iyo falanqeeye; labadooduba waxay ka mid yihiin qorayaasha buug-yaraha "Muddada Degdegga ah". Buug-yarahan ayaa qeexaya hab-raac lagu maamulayo Iran muddada u dhaxaysa burburka Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah iyo samaynta nidaam siyaasadeed oo cusub muddo ilaa bilood ah oo kala-guur ah, iyadoo Amiir Reza Pahlavi loo qoondeeyay inuu noqdo hoggaamiyaha muddadaas. Waaya-aragnimada Venezuela – iyo waxa qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha ugu yeedhaan "qaabka Venezuela" – waa hab ay mudnaantiisu tahay in aanay daruuri ahayn burburka buuxa ee nidaamka siyaasadeed, balse abuurista awood cadaadis ah iyo ku qasbida awoodda talada haysa inay hoggaansanto. Qaabkan, madaxa sare ee awoodda ayaa la daciifiyaa ama la saaraa, laakiin qaybta iyo mishiinka dawladda ayaa inta badan aan la taabanayn. Dhaleeceeyayaashu waxay rumaysan yihiin in habkan oo kale uu halkii uu ka keeni lahaa "xorayn" uu keeno "dib-u-soo-nooleynta dhibaatadii oo waji cusub leh". Qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha ayaa hadallada mas'uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan dawladda Maraykanka – sida Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Marco Rubio – ku fasiray dhankaas, iyagoo soo jeedinaya in dawladda Maraykanku ay doorbidayso qaab la mid ah kan Iran. Mudane Rubio dhawaan wuxuu sheegay kulan ka dhacay Senatka Maraykanka oo ku saabsanaa beddelka suurtagalka ah ee Cali Khamenei, Hogaamiyaha Sare ee Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iran, isagoo sheegay inuu rajaynayo in la heli karo "shakhsiyaad ku jira qaab-dhismeedka jira kuwaas oo suurtogelin kara nooc ka mid ah kala-guurka". Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Qaar ka mid ah khubarada ayaa hadalladaas u fasiray inay macnaheedu tahay in Maraykanku uu ujeeddadiisu tahay isbeddel hab-dhaqan oo ku yimaada nidaamka halkii uu ka ahaan lahaa beddelka nidaamka. Sida uu qabo Saeed Qasemejad iyo Navid Mohebbi, ka saarista Cali Khamenei iyada oo aan la burburin qaab-dhismeedka Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah waxay la mid tahay in la iska indhatiro dalabyada bulshada ee doonaysa isbeddel aasaasi ah. Waxay sidoo kale ku doodayaan in xaaladdan ay Israa'iil ka dhigayso mid wajahaysa isla hanjabaadihii hore, kaliya hoggaamiye cusub ayaa imanay. Qorayaasha maqaalka ayaa rumaysan in "kala-guur muuqda" oo noocaas ah aanu joojinayn "mishiinka cadaadiska" mana burburin doono shabakadaha gobolka iyo kuwa militariga; waxa uu kaliya beddeli doonaa muuqaalka arrinta iyo ujeeddooyin dibloomaasiyadeed. Cabsida ugu weyn ee dhaleeceeyayaasha qaabka Venezuela waxay tahay in reer Galbeedku, si ay uga fogaadaan bannaan-bax awoodeed iyo xasillooni-darro muddo-gaaban, ay aqbali karaan muuqaal noocaas ah – mid uu qof ka mid ah shakhsiyaadka gudaha nidaamka uu gacanta ku dhigo halka dalabyada inta badan ee bulshada la iska indhatirayo. Walaacan waxa la soo qaadayaa xilli ay muuqato in mudaaharaadayaashii Iran ee sannadihii u dambeeyay ay ku nuuxnuuxsanayeen hal dalab oo guud: isbeddel aasaasi ah, maaha dib-u-habayn. Qaabkan gudaha, qorayaasha maqaalka Jerusalem Post waxay xoogga saarayaan doorka Reza Pahlavi oo ah shakhsi dhexdhexaad ah oo ka tirsan mucaaradka Iran – shakhsi ay ku tilmaamaan inuu ku guulaystay inuu sameeyo xidhiidh u dhexeeya hoggaanka siyaasadeed iyo saldhigga bulshada ee mudaaharaadayaasha, inkasta oo aanay dhammaan mucaaradka Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ku raacsanayn qiimayntan. Sida ay sheegayaan taageerayaasha Mr. Pahlavi, ayaa ku dooda in doorashadooda ay u arkaan in la iska indhatiraa ay la macno tahay in la iska indhatirayo rabitaanka qaranka. Qorayaasha maqaalka Jerusalem Post waxay sidoo kale qiimeeyaan in qaabka dawladda mustaqbalka ee Iran uu muhiim u tahay Israa'iil sidoo kale. Benjamin Netanyahu, Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Israa'iil, ayaa safarkiisii lixaad ee Maraykanka tan iyo sannadkii la soo dhaafay si uu ula kulmo Donald Trump ku jooga Washington, isaga oo yidhi: "Waxaan soo bandhigi doonaa mabaadi' gorgortan oo lala galayo Iran kuwaas oo aan keliya muhiim u ahayn Israa'iil balse qof kasta oo doonaya nabadda iyo amniga." Guud ahaan, doodda ku saabsan "qaabka Venezuela" waxay ka tarjumaysaa wax ka badan saadaasha qeexan; waxay ka tarjumaysaa walaacyada ku saabsan hababka suurtagalka ah ee quwadaha shisheeye ay u wejihi karaan Iran. Dhaleeceeyayaasha habkan ayaa ka digaya in diiradda la saaro isbeddel xaddidan oo keliya oo ku yimaadda madaxa sare ee qaab-dhismeedka awoodda, iyada oo aan wax laga qaban xaqiiqooyinka qotoda dheer ee hay'adaha, aysan kaliya ku guul darreysan doonin inay buuxiyaan dalabyada qayb weyn oo ka mid ah bulshada Iran, balse ay sidoo kale keeni karto cawaaqib aan la saadaalin karin oo ku saabsan xasilloonida gobolka iyo amniga jilayaasha muhiimka ah, oo ay ku jirto Israa'iil. © BBC. Wuxuuna qof walba uga mahad celiyay "naxariista iyo caafimaadka uu u rajeeyay". Afhayeen u hadlay ITV News ayaa yiri: "Waxaan daawadayaashii warkii xalay ugu mahadcelineynaa sida ay uga walaacsanaayeen xaaladda caafimaad ee Raage Omaar. "Kadib daawaynta isbitaalka, wuxuu hadda ku jiraa xaalad soo kabasho ah isaga oo gurigiisa ku sugan”. "Waxaan Raage u rajaynaynaa soo kabasho degdeg ah waxaanan rajaynaynaa inuu dib ugu soo laabto shaashada marka uu soo caafimaado." Maxay tahay sababta uu Turkiga u doonayo qarannimada Soomaaliya? Sanadkan oo dhan, Somaaliya iyo Itoobiya waxaa u dhaxeeyay xifaaltan, kaas oo salka ku haya heshiis ay jamhuuriyadda iskeed ugu dhawaaqday madax banaanida ee Somaaliland la siixatay Itoobiya. Turkiga ayaana dhaxdhaxaadin ahaan u soo galay. Balse maxaa Turkiga soo geliyay? Hagaag, sababta waa in Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya ay saaxiibbo ahaayeen sanado badan. Xaqiiqdii, Turkiga ayaaba goordhow oggolaaday in ay labo sano oo dheeraad ah ciidamadooda sii joogaan Somaaliya. Kaas oo qeyb ka ah waajibaad soo jireen ah, iyagoo ku kala yaalla labo qaaradood oo isku jira , oo kiilo mitir. Waxay saaxibtinimadooda bilaabatay -kii markaaso macluul ay soomaaliya ku dishay boqolaal kun oo qof, hay’adihiina ay iskaga baxeeen amni darro awgeed. Turkiga fursaddaas ayuu arkay tallabo ayuuna qaaday iyadoo waddamada kale ay iska indho tireen. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Madaxweyne Erdogan wuxuu noqday madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay ee aan Afrikaan ahayn ee booqda dalka sano kadib. Waxay taasi billow u noqotay iskaashi ka gudbay gargaarkii bini’adannimo. Marki ay diyaradda Turkish Airlanes caga dhigatay Muqdisho 2012kii, waxay dib ugu xirtay Somaaliya dunida kale. Turkiga ayaa muujiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay in Soomaaliya ay ka soo kabsato dhanka ganacsiga iyo dalxiiska. Shirkadaha Turkiga ayaa bilaabay inay maamulaan furaha kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha sida garoomada diyaaradaha iyo dekedaha, taaso xoojisay xiriirka dhaqaale iyo doorka Turkiga ee dib u dhiska Soomaaliya. Dr Elem Eyrice Tepeciklioğlu oo wax ka dhigta jaamacada University of Ankara oo aan ka wareysannay arrintan ayaa tiri: "kani waa hannaan nabad-dhisid oo dhammeystiran. Turkiga ayaana degdeg u noqday mid ka mid ah saaxiibbada ugu saameynta badan Soomaaliya,". Maanta, Turkiga, oo ah saaxiibka ugu weyn ee Nato, wuxuu si qoto dheer u maalgeliyay Soomaaliya. Bishii Febraayo, Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya waxay saxiixdeen heshiis taariikhi ah oo lagu xoojinayo difaaca ciidamada badda kaas oo ka hortagaya budhcad badeedda iyo khataraha amniga. , Soomaaliya waxay leedahay xeebta ugu dheer qaaradda Afrika, waana xuddunta isu socodka badaha caalamka. Tani waxay ku saabsanayd sugidda waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee ganacsiga, iyo xaqiijinta halka uu Turkiga ka taagan yahay qarannimada Soomaaliya. Hagaag… wuxuu ka helayaa sumcad calami ah iyo tan ugu muhiimsan ee ah ganacsiga. Runtiina waddamo kale ayaa isku haya si ay boos uga helaan waddanka. "Tan waxaa xoojiyay saraakiil dhowr oo soomaali ah: "eeg, Turkigu waa saaxiibkeenna, saaxiib la isku halleyn karo ayuu inoo yahay waana xubin Nato ka tirsan. "Faa’iido kale waa in Turkigu uu Soomaaliya joogay iyadoo inta badan dalalka, iyo NGO-yada ay ka baxeen dalka. Tani waa farriin cad oo dhaheysa in Soomaaliya ay u baahan tahay caawinaadeenna, annagoo ah xubno mas’uul ah oo beesha caalamka ka tirsan, waxaan u baahannahay inaan qeybteenna qaadanno iyo sidoo kale, mid muhiim ah… ganacsiga. "Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti xarumo istaraatiiji ah ayay ku leeyihiin gobolka Badda Cas. Qaabkan, [Turkigu] wuxuu hanan doonaa saaxiib ganacsi oo muhiim ah, sababtoo ah bilo yar kahor, Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya waxay saxiixeen heshiis baarid shidaal iyo gaas ah. Marka dalal badan waxay ka dambeeyaan [tan], inay heshiis kaa la mid ah la saxiixdaan Somalia," Ayay tiri Dr Elem. Imaaraadka Carabta [UAE] ayaa maamulaya dekedaha gobolka Geeska Afrika. "Gobolkan wuxuu ku yaallaa deriskooda dhow, keliyana ma daneynayaan qaar ka mid ah natiijooyinka dhaqaalaha. Xasiloonida iyo ammaanta gobolka ayaa saameyn ka badan oo toos ah ku leh ammaankooda sidoo kale," ayay intaa raacisay. Sidoo kale Ruushka ayaa ku soo biiray waddamada danaha ka leh Soomaaliya iyagoo cafiyay deyn gaareysay $ milyan, waddankana keenay , oo tan oo badar ah. Mascow uguma tal gelin in saaxiib kali ah sameysato, waxay dooneysay inay saameyn ku yeelato mustaqbalka gobolka. Sawirka, "Tani waa dabeecadda hannaanka caalamka. Dalalka ayaa tartama si ay u xejistaan danahooda qaranka iyo danahooda ganacsi sidoo kale. Balse uma maleynayo in Tukrigu uu halkaa u joogo inuu ka fiicnaado dalal gobolka ama ka baxsan, sababtoo ah iskaashigu keliya ma aha suurtogal balse waa qasab sababtoo ah xasiloonida gobolka waa muhiim." Ayay tiri Dr Elem. Iyadoo Turkiga uu sii xoojinaayo iskaashiga uu la leeyahay Soomaaliya saaxadda hadda wixii ka dambeeya waxay u baahan tahay awood isu dheelli-tiran in la helo si horay loogu socdo. © BBC. Khilaafka Aqalka Sare: ''Afar goor baan ka wada hadalnay waana isku fahmi weynay'' , RADIO MUGADHISHU Sanatar Mowliid Xuseen Guhaad oo ah Guddoomiye kuxigeenka -aad golaha Aqalka Sare ee Soomaliya ayaa ka soo horjeestay kulankii guddiga joogtada ee lagu qabtay aaladda Suumka. Kulankaasi ayaa laga soo saaray baaq ah in dowladda federaalka, dowlad goboleedyada iyo saamileyda siyaasadda ay isugu yimaadaan kulan degdeg ah kahor ka bishan Juun. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Aqalka Sare, Cabdi Xaashi Cabdillaahi ayaa kulan uu la qaatay guddiga joogtada ee golaha waxaa uu soo saaray qoraal uu ku sheegay in loo baahan yahay in la qabto shir ay isugu imaanayaan Madaxda Dowladda iyo Dowlad Goboleedyada kaas oo looga gol-leeyahay in looga arinsado hannaanka lagu gali doono Doorashooyinka Qaranka / si loo helo hab iyo hannaan lagu wad qanacsanyahay. Guddoomiye ku xigeenka ayaa sheegay in shirkaasi guddigu yeesheen aannu waafaqsaneyn xeer hoosaadka golahaasi. ''Waxaan ku diidanahay iyadoo ay Xamar ku sugan yihiin sanator oo buuxin kara booskaasi in xubno ka tirsan Guddiga Joogtada ah ee aqalka oo dalka ka maqan aaladda Zoom lagu raadiyo, iyadoo aysan jirin baahi keeni karta, waxayna arrintaasi baal marsantahay Xeer Hoosaadka Aqalka Sare'', ayuu yiri Gudomiye kuxigeenka. ''Xeer hoosaadkeena waxa uu dhigaya in guddomiyaha Golaha Aqalka Sare uu go'aamada muhiimka ah kala tashado ku xigeennadiisa, sidoo kale ku xigeenada la tashadaan guddoomiyaha laakin hadda taasi ma muuqato'' ''Guddoomiyaha ilaa afar jeer baan arrrintan ka wada hadalnay balse iskumaan fahmin, taasi ayaana sababtay inaan dalbano guddiga joogtada ah.'' ''Xalka haatan waxa uu ku jiraa in shacabka Soomaaliyeed si cadaalad ah loogu adeego iyadoo la ilaaninayo dastuurka iyo xeer hoosaadyada, gaar ahaan Aqalka Sare.'' Madaxweynaha Maamulka Hirshabeelle ee Soomaaliya ayaa soo dhaweeyay go'aankii guddiga joogtada ah ee Aqalka Sare ee Barlamaanka Federaalka. Sawirka, RADIO MUGADHISHU Horeyna maamullada Puntland iyo Jubaland iyo ururrada mucaaradka ayaa u soo dhaweeyay go'aanka guddiga joogata ah ee Aqalka Sare iyagoo ku tilmaamay tallaabo waqtigeeda lagu soo beegay. Dhanka kale Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa ugu baaqday dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya inay si deg deg ah shir ugu ula yeelato Madaxweynayaasha dowlad goboleedyada, si xal waara looga gaaro khilaafka hareeyay geeddi socodka siyaasadda Soomaaliya. Talooyinka muhiimka ah ee guurka ka hor , ullstein bild Marwo Ababa G/sillaase iyo Seygeeda Gabre Kiristos waxay isqabeen ama ay noolal wadaag ahaayeen sano. Dhawaanna waxay xuseen sanad guuradii 50aad ee guurkooda ka soo wareegtay iyada oo munaasabaddaasina ay ka soo qayb galeen carruur oo ay dhaleen iyo carruur oo ay carruurtooda sii dhaleen. Waxayna qoysaskaasi nus qarniga noolasha ku mideysnaa ay sheegayaan iney muddo intaa dhan ay wada noolaadaan ay ugu wacneed "Samir iyo Iisu dulqaadasho". "Labada qof ee isqaba ama wada nool midkood inuu khalad ka dhaca waa lagama maarmaan balse iney khaladka dhacay si deggan ay u xalliyaan ayaa u horseedaya iney noolal farxad leh ay ku noolaadaan" ayey tiri Marwo Ababa. Bariyahan dambana waxaa aad u badan qoysas wada nool oo aan aarimaha qoyskooda ka wada hadli karin, kuwa u wada nool carruurta iney wada korsadaan oo keli ah, ama aan kalsooni isku qabin. Haddaba isfaham la'aanta noocaasi marka uu sii ballaadho wuxuu horseedayaa qoysaski dhisnaa iney burburaan oo la kala tago. Tigist Waaltangus iyo Indaalki Asafa waxay muddo ka badan sano ay ka shaqeeyaan la talinta iyo xallinta khilaafaadka ka dhasha guurka iyaga oo ka wada tirsan urur arrimahan ka shaqeeya. Sawirka, Mar wax laga weydiiyey waxyaabaha guurka khatarta geliya ee burburka horseeda waxay sheegeen iney kow ka tahay aqoonta ay lammaanuhu u leeyihiin guurka iyo xiriirka jeceyl waxa ay kala yihiin. "Guurku wuxuu ka billaabmayaa qofka laftiisa" marka inta uusan qofku fiirin qofka uu noolasha la wadaagayo waa inuu marka hore isagu is fiiriyaa, ayey Tiri Khabiir Tigist. Dhibaatooyinka kale ee guurka iyo xiriirka jeceyl ee lamaanaha khatar gelin kara waxaa ka mid ah: Marwo Ababa waxay sheegtay Soddohdeed iyo Soddoggeed oo ay u aqbashay una soo dhaweeysay sida labadeyda waalid inuu qayb weyn ka qaatay iney guur farxad leh oo muddo dheer soo jira ay nasiib u yeelato. Ragga iyo dumarkaba marka ugu horreysa oo ay noolasha ku midoobaan waxay isku dayaan midba midka kale inuu isku dayo inuu iisu muujiyo sida malaa'igti oo kale oo qof wanaagsan uu iisu muujiyo balse xaalku dib ayuu ka xumaanayaa. "Dhibaatooyinka iyo dabeecadaha qarsoon ee dhabta ah oo uu qofku leeyahay oo dhan dib ayey ka soo baxayaan, maadaamaa inta la wada nool yahay noolasha wax badan oo wanaag ama xumaan ah lagala kulmayo" ayey tiri. "Dadka doonayo iney reer yagleelaan sida ay jeebkooda iyo akaawunka bangigooda u eegaan, waa iney dib u fiiriyaan aragtida qofka iyo waxa uu naftiisu ka aaminsan yahay" ayey tiri Tigist. Dhibaatooyinka ugu badan ee sii huriyay dhibka qoysaska ka dhex dhaca ayaa sida oo kale la sheegaa iney ugu wacan tahay ururro ama hay'ado arrimaha guurka bulshada kala taliyo oo aan jirin haddii ay jiraan ay awooddooda kooban tahay. Qoysaska isguursanaya inta aysan guurka guda gelin ka hor waa iney wada fariistaan oo si cad ay arrimahan u qorsheystaan: Haddii ay sidaa sameyn waayaan dhibaatooyinka guurka kaddib yimaaddo xallintooda qof ayey dusha ka fuuleysaa marka uu qofkaasi u dulqaadan waayana wuxuu u horseedaya inuu qoyska burburo. "Guurku sidiisaba waxaa lagu hagaa aqoon, karti iyo dulqaad" ayuu yiri Khabiir Indaalki. Haddaba aqoonta guur ee loo baahan yahay waa iney su'aalahan ka jawaabaan: Sawirka, Tigist WalteNigus and Endalk Facebook pages Dadki hore inta ay reer yagleelin ka hor waxay aqoonta guurka ka korosan jireen dadka ka waaweyn iyo waaliddiintooda iyaga oo weydiiyo guurka waxa uu yahay iyo maareynta uu u baahan yahay. Aqoonta ugu badan waxaa laga helaa: Sawirka, "Guurka ujeeddadiisu iney ka ballaadhan tahay in guri lagu wada noolaado ama ubad la dhalo oo keli cid labada qof ee isguursaneyso kala taliyana waa lo baahan yahay" ayey tiri Tigist.iwmwuuu k aballaadhan yahay Labada qof ee isguursaneysa oo dabeecadahooda rasmiga ah oo ay leeyihiin ilaaheyna uu ku abuuray aan kala qarsan oo iisu sheego waxay iyaduna gacan ka geysaneysaa qofka marka uu wax ku saabsan dabeecaddiisa kala kulmo qofka kale iney ku soo boodda ku noqoneyn maadaamaa uu horay ugu sheegay dabeecaddiisaasi. Waxayna khubaradu ku talinayaan labada qof inta ay isguursan ka hor iney iyagu maskax ahaan isa soo dhisaan iney wax walba ka wanaagsan tahay. Sawirka, Maxay yihiin dhibaatooyinka ugu waaweyn ee ay la kulmaan qoysaska? Tigist iyo Indaalki oo muddo sana ah arrimaha qoyska bulshada kala soo talinayey ayaa waxay sheegayaan muddadi ay howshan ku soo jireen dhibaatooyinka ugu badan ee ay qoysaska ula yimaaddaan ee ay xalliyeen waxa ay yihiin. "Labada qof ee sida dhabta ah iisu jecel jeceylkooda ay keydiyeen waxay la soo baxaan xilliga dhibka uu yimaaddo" ayey leeyihiin khubarada arrimaha guurka ku takhasusay. Sawirka, Labada qof ee isguursanaya waa iney lahaadaan hadaf mideysan, haddiise hadafkoodu uu marki horaba mideysneyn muddo marka la wada noolaado aragtida ayaa lagu kala duwananaanayaa taasoo ugu dambeynti khilaaf uu ka dhalan karo. Hadafkoodu ugu weyna waa iney ka dhigaan mar weliba iney dhisaan naftooda, dabeecadahooda, hab dhaqankooda iyo wax kasta oo wada noolaashahooda sii xoojin kara. Wax la dhisana waxaa ugu wanaagsan jeceylka ay lammaanaha iisu qabaan, maadaamaa jeceylku uusan marnaba duugoobin isla-markaana uu dhammaan, waxa ka soo hara oo dhan ay dhammaanayaan ayna isbeddelayaan. © BBC. Dawladda Kenya oo shaaca ka qaadday xaddiga qaadka ee maalin walba Soomaaliya loo dhoofiyo , The Daily Nation Kenya ayaa Soomaaliya u dhoofisa inta u dhaxaysa ilaa iyo tan oo qaad ah maalin kasta, sida uu xaqiijiyay wasiirka beeraha Mutahi Kagwe. Waxa uu meesha ka saaray wararka sheegaya in in ka badan tan ay dalka ka baxaan maalin kasta, isaga oo ku tilmaamay tirooyinkan kuwa "aad loo buunbuuniyay oo aanay jirin cadaymo la xaqiijiyey oo taageeraya." Wasiirku waxa uu u nisbeeyay kala duwanaanshaha xadiga dhoofinta la soo sheegay ee isbedbeddelka suuqa, farqiga awoodda xamuulka, iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa isbeddellada suuqyada. Kagwe ayaa u xaqiijiyay baarlamaanka in dowladdu ay is waafajisay diiwaannada dhoofinta ee guud ahaan Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA), KenTrade, iyo Hay'adda Dakhliga Kenya iyada oo la isugu keenay hal madal kombiyuutar oo midaysan. "Markii ugu horreysay, xogta dhoofinta qaadka waa mid shaqaynaysa ayadoo aan loo jeedin, la xaqiijin karo, oo dhammaan hay'adaha oo dhanna ay ku wada midaysan yihiin" ayuu yiri. Wargayska The Star ayaa qoray in sida laga soo xigtay AFA, Kenya ay Soomaaliya u dhoofisay in ka badan milyan oo kiilogaram oo qaad ah tan iyo bishii Luulyo , markii suuqa uu dib u furmay ka dib toban sano oo xayiraad ay ka saarnayd Yurub. Qaadku waa dalagga muhiimka ah ee Kenya, kaasoo ay beertaan ku dhawaad , beeraley ah ku dhawaad , eekar oo dhul ah, taas oo taageerta nolosha qoysas badan. Waxa uu waddanku soo saaraa qiyaastii , metrik tan sannadkii, oo lagu qiimeeyay bilyan oo shilinka Kenya ah, iyadoo - boqolkiiba gudaha laga isticmaalo. Soomaaliya ayaa weli ah meesha ugu badan ee loo dhoofiyo. Wargayska The Star oo warkan daabacay ayaa sheegaya in si loo xoojiyo sugnaanshaha xogta iyo ilaalinta dakhliga, Wasaaraddu ay soo saartay kontaroolo adag oo dhoofinta. Waxaa ka mid ah soo gudbinta sharci ahaan khasabka ah ee ruqsadda duullimaadyada hawada iyo warqadaha duulimaadka, kormeerka qasabka ah ee KEPHIS ee dhammaan shixnadaha, diyaarinta kormeerayaasha dalagyada AFA ee bakhaarada dhoofinta, iyo warbixin bille ah oo ay shirkadaha diyaaraduhu u gudbiyaan Maamulka Garoomada Kenya. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. "Waxaan dooneynaa inaan baabi'inno mala awaalka oo aan hubinno in kiilo kasta oo dalka ka baxaysa la diiwaan-geliyo" ayuu yiri Kagwe. Dawladda waxay sidoo kale sahaminaysaa wadooyin kale oo dhoofinta ah si loogu saldhigo dhoofinta qaadka loona yareeyo kharashaadka loojiistikada. Qorshayaashaas waxaa ka mid ah furitaanka goobo dheeraad ah oo laga dejiyo qaadka tagaya Soomaaliya, in la hawlgeliyo waddooyinka la mariyo qaadka la dhoofinayo ee waqooyiga Kenya, iyo in la bilaabo duullimaadyo xamuul oo toos ah oo ka yimaada Isiolo ilaa Jasiiradda Manda si loo yareeyo ciriiriga garoonka dayaaradaha JKIA. Si loo taageero beeralayda, Wasaaraddu waxay maalgelisay waraabka, dakhliyada ka soo xarooda suuqyada, ceelasha riigga ah, iyo biyo-xireennada dhulka ee guud ahaan gobollada Meru, Embu, iyo Tharaka Nithi. Iskaashatooyinka qaadka waxay heleen lacag dhan milyan oo Shilin. Laga soo bilaabo , dawladdu waxay soo aruurisay . milyan oo shilin oo canshuur ah taasoo ka soo xarootay qaadka, ayadoo dib loogu maalgalinayo cilmi baarista, ballaarinta suuqa iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha. "Dowladda waxaa si buuxda uga go'an in ay xirfad u yeelato silsiladda qiimaha qaadka iyo furitaanka suuqyo cusub oo ay beeralaydeennu u dhoofiyaan " ayuu yiri Kagwe. © BBC. Su'aalaha ku gadaaman cudurka Baabasiirka iyo sida loo daweyn karo , Baabasiirka waa cudur ku dhaca dad badan oo Soomaali ah, sababaha ugu weyn ee ka dhasha cudurkan waa isbaddallada dhanka cuntada iyo qaab nololeedka qofka. Cudurkan oo saameyn ku haya dunida oo dhan, tusaale ahaan boqolkiiba shacabka Hindiya waxay la daalaa dhacayaan baabasiirka, sida laga soo xigtay waaxda qaran ee diiwaanka arrimaha dawoooyinka. Dr. Vani Vijay oo ah khabiir ku takhasustay cudurka babaasiirka ayaa BBC-da uga jawaabtay su'aalaha ku gadaaman cudurkan. Marka ay bararaan xiddidada dhiigga ee u dhaw qofka halka uu ka saxaroodo, markaa waxaa cadaadis xad-dhaaf ah la saaraa qulqulka dhiigga ee xiddidadaas, bararka ayaa ku bilaabmaya halkaas, waxaana jira sababo badan oo keena bararka xididdada dhiigga. Xiddiddadan ayaa ah kuwa aad mashquul badan marka uu qofka saxaroonayo, waxaa laga yaabaa in qofka uu musqusha ku daaho, calool-istaag ayaa ka dhashaa arrintani, sidoo kale dadka qaar waxay isku arki karaan shuban joogto ah, miisaanka qofka oo korodho, qofka in uu iska yareeyo cabidda biyaha badan. Waa waxyaabo si xoojiyo baabasiirka, Dumarka waxay aad ugu nugul yihiin calool-istaagga iyo baabasiirka xilliga ay uurka leeyihiin. Sawirka, Cudurka baabasirka wuxuu ku dhacaa gudaha iyo dibaddahalka laga saxaroodo, qofka ay si daran u saameyso walaac xoogan ayuu kala kulmaa. Mararka qaar waxaa dhacda in dibadda uu u soo baxo, wuxuuna qofka dareemayaa cuncun iyo dhiig-bax. Dadka qaar uu ku dhaca cudurkan xiddidada dhiiga qaado ee goobta laga saxaroodo ayaa barara, waxaana laga yabaa in uu ku sameyso xijirowga dhiigga. Cudurkaan wuxuu ku dhici karaa qof kasta. Laakiin wuxuu ku badan yahay dadka da'doodu u dhexeyso ilaa . Dadka ay da'doodu u dhaxayso 's iyo 's ee la kulma calool-istaagga ayaa qarka u saaran in uu ku dhaco baabasiirka. Cudurkaan aad uguma badna caruurta, waana mid ka dhasha hab-nololeedka qofka gaar ahaan isbaddalka dhanka cunto cunista. Dadka uu ku dhacay baabasiirka waa inay isbaddal ku sameeyaan cuntooyinka gaar ahaan marka uu cudurka ku hor leeyahay. Qofka waa in uu iska ilaaliyaa burka iyo cuntooyinka lasoo warshadeeyay, waa in qofka uu raaca talooyinka caafimaad si xaaladdiisa uu uga war qabo. Qofka isaga ayaa iska daweyn kara baabasiirka gaar ahaan marka uu ku hor leeyahay, wuxuuna cuni karaa khudaarta iyo caleenta cagaaran. Sawirka, Haddii ay kasii darto xaaladda qof uu ku dhacay cudurka baabasiirka xitaa ka dib marka uu wax ka baddalo cuntooyinka iyo qaadashada daawooyinka uu dhakhtarka qoray, waa in la sameeyaa qaliin. Marka uu qofka ku hor leeyahay cudurka, waxaa qofka la siin karaa dawooyin iyo qofka uu isbaddal ku sameeyo cuntooyinka uu qaato. Laakiin mararka qaarkood, qalliin ayaa ah xalka kaliya ee lagu daweyn karo qof uu ku weynaado baabasiirka, Haddii baabasiirka aad qabto muddo dheer, way adkaanaysaa inaad saxarooto isla markaana aad kursi ku fadhiiso maalin kasta. Dhiigbaxa iyo sidoo kale buro hilib leh ee qaybta saxara mareenka ka sameysanto waa saameynta ka dhalata cudurkan, Xaaladdan oo kale, qofka waa in la marsiiyaa qalliin, markaa kadib waa in qofka uu la socdo cuntooyinka uu qaadanayo iyo hab nololeedkiisa. © BBC. Dhacdo -sano ka hor dhacday deegaanka Soomaalida oo qayb ka mida la xaliyey iyo hadal hayn ka dhalatay Waxay dhacdadani ka dhacday deegaan miyi ah oo hoos tagta degmada Qabri- bayax ee gobolka Faafan ee dowlad deegaanka Soomaalida sanadkii -dii. Arooryo hore iyadoo ay tahay ayaa geel ay lahaayeen qoyska reer Qodax oo ahaa reer guuraa miyigaas yaallay waxaa lagu war helay geela oo diday oo yaacay iyadoo markii dambe qayb ka mida geela la waayey. Baadi goob dheer ka dib waxaa la ogaaday in rag ay qayb ka mida geela dhaceen oo ay ula kaceen dhanka degmada Araarso oo ka tirsan gobolka Jarar. "Geelu isaga oo daaqaya ayuu diday, waxaa didiyey owr geela ku jiray ka dibna waxay kala talaabeen wadada jayga ahayd ee hadda noqotay laamiga ee degmada Araarso, nimanka geella dhacay aroor hore ayay dhaceen markii ay dhaceenna waxaa qaybsaday shan nin oo walaalo ah," ayuu BBC-da u sheegay Xasan Qodax oo aabihiis ka mid ahaa dadka geela la dhacay lahaa. Wuxuu intaa raaciyey in ergo aabihiis ku jiro oo uu geelu isugu jiray ay ku baxeen halkii geela loo kaxaystay si ay ragga dhacay ugu soo celiyaan basle ergadii ayuu sheegay inay wax ka duwan waxay doonayeen la kulmeen. "Geellu wuxuu ahaa -neef, geellaas isaga oo xerada ku jira oo ragii dhacay haystaan ayuu aabahay iyo raggii kale ee geelu ka dhaxeeyey soo arkeen basle raggii haystay inay qaalin ka mid soo kaxaystaan waa u soo diideen,"ayuu yiri Xasan. Ka sokow dhacdada geele qoyska Qodax lagu dhacay, waxaa labada dhinac horrey u dhex taallay geelal badan oo ay iska dhaceen, dhaca geeluna wuxuu deegaanadaas ka ahaa dhacdo ku badan. Ragga geela dhacay wuxuu Xasan Qodax aabihiisa ka soo gaaray inuu ka mid ahaa nin lagu magacaabi jiray Dayib Cabdi oo ahaa geel jire deegaanka degaanaaa. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Dhacdadaas waxay ahayd mid aan libdhin oo odoyadii ka kala tirsanaa raggii geela kala dhacay ay uga sheekeeyeen carruurtoodii sheekada ah in barigaas geel la kala dhacay. Nus qarni in ka badan ka dib, isla degmada Araarso ayaa sanadkan ka dhacday dhacdo ka duwan tii -dii ka dhacday. Qoyska Dayib Cabdi ayaa sano ka dib qoyska reer Qodax Xasan ku wareejiyey geel ay sheegeen inuu baadi dhac celin u yahay geelii barigaas ay ka dhaceen. Dayib Cabdi ayaa sagaal neef oo geela ka qaatay geelaas barigaas la dhacay oo halaad ka koobnaa basle rag kala duwan oo uu ka mid ahaa ay kala qayb sadeen sida dhinacydu u sheegeen BBC-da. Goob ay culimo iyo odoyaal dhaqan goob joog ka ahayeen oo ku taalla degmada Araarso ayaa qayb ka mid ah geela barigaas la dhacay lagula kala wareegay. Cabdillaahi Dayib Cabdi oo aabihiisa ka mid ahaa raggii barigaas geela dhacay ayaa shan neef oo ka mid sagaal neef oo qoyskiisa ku maqnaa ku wareejiyey Xasan Qodax Xaad oo abihiisa Qodax laga dhacay geelaas muddo nus qarni ka hor ah. Xasan Qodax Xaad oo la wareegay geela wakiilna ka ahaa qoyskiisa ayaa BBC-da u inuu ku faraxsan yahay in geelii aabihiisa laga dhacay loo soo celiyey. " -sanno ka dib waan ku faraxsanahay in geella oo ahaa - neef -tii neef ugu horeeyay aan la wareegay." ayuu intaas raaciyey Xasan Qodax. Afarta neef ee kale ee geela ah ee ka mid ahaa sagaalka ku maqan qoyska Dayib ayuu Xasan Qodax sheegay inay qoys ahaan ka cafiyeen. Isagoo ka hadlayey goobta geela uu kula waregay Xasan Qodax waxa uu sheegay in geella xiliga laga dhacay aabihiis ay ahayd wakhtii xoolaha la kala dhici jiray oo dadka xilligaas jaahilnimo u gaynaysay, dadkuna ay iska xalaashanayeen in xoolo booli ah ay dhacaan "Ninka geela soo dhacaa wuxuu ahaa nin ragganimo leh wakhtigaas". Ayuu yiri. Qodax wuxuu intaa raaciyey in dadka geela ka haystay ay isku deegaan ahayeen mudo dheer, ayna mar uun sugayeen in ay helaan dhaxalkii Aabahood. Cabdillaahi Dayib Cabdi oo ah ninka geela celiyey ayaa isna xusay in sababta ay tallaabadan u qaadeen ay tahay inuu celiyo xaqii bani'aadamka ee waalidkii ku maqnaa wixii tabartiisa ah. "Annaga qoys ahaan waan tashanay dadkii geellaas lahaa warasadii ka joogtay wan u yeernay tiradiisiina waan waydiinay waxay lahaayeen, geellu markii uu soo galay waa la qaybsaday wixii anaga aan helay waan u sheegnay waxaas baan idiin haynaaye naga gudooma ayaan ku niri, wixii kalana naga saamaxa ayaanu nidhi." ayuu yiri Cabdullaahi Dayib. Cabdullaahi Dayib waxa uu sheegay in xilligii geella la dhacay hooyadii iyo Aabihii aysan is guursanin "Anigan iminka hadlaya taariikhda saan ku hayno geellaas xiliguu reerka yimid hooyaday lama guursanin kuwa aniga iga waawayna mayna dhalanin". ayuu BBC-da u sheegay Cabdillaahi. Celinta geela ee qoyskiisu wareejiyeen ayuu Cabdillaahi sheegay inay uga dhigantahay xaq bini'aadam oo ay iska gudeen "Xooluhu waa xaq, xaqana waa la kala leeyahay nin walba wixiisa isagaa iskaleh waana xaq bini'aadam" ayuu yidhi Cabdullaahi Dayib oo ah nin geella celiyay. Dhacdadan ayaa noqotay mid hadal hayn ka dhalisa deegaanada degmada Araarso ee dowlad deegaanka in wali qaar ka mida bulshadu ay doonayaan inay dhayaan oo gudaan xoolo muddo qarniyo ku dhow ka hor kala dhaceen. Marka dib loo raaco taariikhda Soomaalida oo u badnayd xoolo dhaqato reer guuraa ah, xoolo kala dhicidu waxay ahayd wax ku suntay tariikhdoodaas hore walow ilaa waqtiyadan ay meelo kooban ka dhacdo dhulka Soomaalidu degto dhacdo la mid taas hore balse ay si weyn u yarraatay. Geelu wuxuu ahaa qarniyo ka hor ilaa maanta mid hanti xooleed u dhaafsan Soomaalida. Dhanka suugaanta Soomaalidana abwaanno badan ayaa ku amaanay geella, caadiyan geella wuxuu magac iyo muuno gaar ah ku dhex leeyahay bulshada Soomaalida oo xooluhu u yihiin laf-dhabarta nolashooda. © BBC. Fanaankii "caloosha hooyadii ku garaadsaday" oo maanta la aasayo Mulaxamiiste Xasan Sabriye Afrax (Xasan Gareed) wuxuu mid ka mid ahaa mulaxannada ugu cod samaynta fiicnaa laxamada, heeso badan oo uu sameeyeyna waa kuwa dhagaysigooda Soomaalidu ugu jeceshahay. Laakiin nolosha Gareed ayaa leh xiiso gooniya leh. Wuxuu ku dhashay Gobolka Galgaduuud ee bartamaha Soomaaliya ahaan deegaan u dhow Dhuuso mareeb. Xasan gareed wuxuu sheegay inuu ku dhashay bilood, sidaasna loogu biixiyey naynaasta (Garaad) oo loo bixin jiray dadka sidiisoo kale ah, kuwaas oo ku dhasha muddo ka badan tirsi qaadka uurka ee hooyada. “Anigu sagaal kuma dhalan,waxaan ku dhashay bilood, marka nin caloosha ku garaadsaday ayaa garaad loo bixiyaa ee la iskama bixiyo” ayuu yiri allah u naxariistee Xasan Gareed. "Aabahay wuxuu ii bixiyey magaca Xasan oo uu iigu wanqalay, laakiin hooyaday waxay ii bixisay garaad, markaas ka dib anigoo yar ayaan xamar tagay dadku ma aqoon magaca garaad ee reer Xamarkii ayaa u badalay Gareed" ayuu yiri. Burburkii ka dhacay Dalka Xasan meelna uguma bixin Muqdisho, wuxuuse tilmaamay in tabar u waayey inuu ka baxo. “Waxaan tawakalay ilaahay, meshii aan ku noolaa gurigaygii oo ku yaala xaafad la yiraahdo Xamar Bile oo Siinaay ku taala ayaan deganahay aniga iyo caruurtaydu xitaa Afgooye maanan gaarin” Markii dalku galay burburka, Xasan wax walba oo noloshiiisa ah waa is badaleen, wuxuuna galay nolol adag, Waraysi uu siiyey BBCda ayuu ku sheegay inuu soo maray maalmo aaad u adkaa. “ Meel la yiraahdo Bakaaraha oo suuq ganacsi ah ayaan u foof-tagi jiray kol aad garato qofaad taqaano, reer miyise baa yimid. Wixiise aan ka soo helo ayaan guriga keeni jiray, ha yaraadaan ama ha bataane.” Muddo ka dib wuxu sheegay in markii Muqdisho ay tagtay Dowladdii Madaxweyne Cabdilaahi Yuusuf hogaaminayey ilaa Dowladii Shiikh Shariif ay fanaaniintii joogtay markaa ay lacago u qoreen, mar konton marna boqol dollar ay ka heli jireen. Dabaqaayadii ayuu soo galay Fanka hase yeeshee wuxuu ahaa intii hore mid banaanka ku shaqeeya. Sanadkii ayuuse si rasmi ah ugu biiray fankii Soomaalida isagoo door muuqda ku lahaa kobaciisi. Codadka macaan ee ku saaray heeso badan ayaa Xasan ka dhigay inay laxamadiisa soo jiitaan abwaano badan oo miraha samayn jiray. Sanadkii ayuu sheegay inay isugu horeysay isaga iyo Xasan oo markaa xiiso u qabay inuu barto kabanka ama cuudka, gacanna uu ka siiyey dalabkisii. Maraykanka iyo Midowga Yurub oo ugu dambeyn gaaray heshiis , Mareykanka iyo Midowga Yurub ayaa gaaray heshiis ganacsi, kaas oo soo afjaray ismariwaagii muddo bilo ah u dhexeeyay labada dhinac ee dhaqaalaha ugu awoodda badan dunida. Ka dib wadaxaajood iyo go'aan dhex maray madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump iyo madaxweynaha Komishanka Yurub Ursula Von der Leyen oo ku sugnaa Scotland, labada dhinac waxay ku heshiiyeen in Mareykanku saaro canshuur dhan % dhammaan badeecadaha laga keeno Midowga Yurub. Taasi waxay ka dhigantahay kala bar heerkii hore ee canshuuraha oo gaaraysay % ee alaabta Midowga Yurub ugu tagta Maraykanka ee Trump uu horey ugu hanjabay inuu dhaqan gelinayo Jimcaha. Trump wuxuu sheegay in -ka dal ee xubnaha ka ah Midowga Yurub ay suuqyadooda u furi doonaan wax-soo-saarka Mareykanka, iyagoo xitaa boqolkiiba eber ka dhigay qaar ka mid ah canshuuraha badeecadaha la dhoofiyo. Von der Leyen ayaa iyaduna soo dhaweeyay heshiiska, iyadoo sheegtay inuu xasillooni u keeni doono labada xulafo, kuwaas oo marka la isku daro ka dhigan ku dhawaad saddex meelood meel ganacsiga caalamka. Trump wuxuu adeegsaday canshuuro si uu cadaadis ugu saaro saaxiibada ganacsi ee waaweyn ee Mareykanka, isaga oo isku dayaya inuu dib u habeeyo nidaamka dhaqaalaha caalamka isla markaana uu yareeyo khasaaraha ganacsi ee Mareykanka. Marka laga soo tago Midowga Yurub, Trump wuxuu sidoo kale heshiisyo canshuureed la gaaray waddamo ay ka mid yihiin Boqortooyada Ingiriiska, Japan, Indonesia, Filibiin iyo Vietnam. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, weli ma uusan gaarin yoolkiisii ahaa " heshiis maalmood gudahood." Heshiiska ayaa lagu dhawaaqay Axaddii kadib wadahadalo dhexmaray Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Trump iyo Von der Leyen oo ka dhacay South Ayrshire. Trump - oo booqasho shan maalmood ah ku jooga Scotland ayaa yiri ka dib kulankooda kooban "Waxaan gaarnay heshiis. Waa heshiis u wanaagsan qof walba." "Wuxuu inaga dhigi doonaa kuwo is fahamsan oo is kusoo dhawaada." Von der Leyen-na waxay heshiiska ku tilmaamtay "heshiis weyn" oo ay sheegtay in lagu gaaray "wadaxaajoodyo adag" kadib. Trump ayaa sheegay in Midowga Yurub uu ku kordhin doono maalgashigiisa Mareykanka $600bn oo ay ku jiraan qalabka militariga Mareykanka, ayna ku bixin doonaan bilyan oo tamarta ah. Maalgelintaas saddexda sano ee soo socota ee gaaska dabiiciga ah ee Maraykanka, saliidda iyo shidaalka nukliyeerka, ayey tiri Von der Leyen, waxay gacan ka geysan doontaa dhimista ku tiirsanaanta Yurub ee ilaha tamarta Ruushka. Alaabooyinka qaarkood lama saari doono wax canshuur ah, oo ay ku jiraan qaybaha diyaaraddaha, kiimikooyinka qaarkood iyo qaar ka mid ah wax soo saarka beeraha. Heshiis gaar ah oo ku saabsan semiconductors ayaa laga yaabaa in dhawaan lagu dhawaaqo. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Laakiin % tacriifaha Mareykanka ee Trump uu ku dhaqan-geliyay birta iyo aluminiumka adduunka ayaa sii jiri doonta, ayuu yiri. "Waxaan rabaa inaan u mahadceliyo Madaxweyne Trump shakhsi ahaan go'aankiisa gaarka ah iyo hoggaankiisa si uu u gaaro horumarkan," ayey tiri Von der Leyen. "Waa gorgortan adag, laakiin sidoo kale waa qof ku fiican heshiiska." Labada dhinacba waxay heshiiskan ku muujin karaan wax guul ah. Ganacsiga badeecooyinka u dhexeeya Midowga Yurub iyo Maraykanka ayaa dhan bilyan oo dollar sannadkii hore. Madaxda Yurub ayaa si taxadar leh u soo dhaweeyay heshiiska. Raiisel wasaaraha Irish, Taoiseach Micheál Martin, ayaa xusay xaqiiqda ah in canshuuraha ay wali ka sii badnaan doonaan sidii hore, taas oo ka dhigaysa ganacsiga "ka qaalisan oo aad u adag". Wadamada EU-da, Ireland ayaa ah tan ugu tiirsan Maraykanka oo ah suuqa dhoofinta. Hoggaamiyaha Jarmalka Friedrich Merz ayaa qoraa uu soo dhigay bartiita X, ee horrey loo oran jiray Twiter waxaay uu sheegay in khilaafka ganacsigu uu si adag u saameyn lahaa Jarmalka. "Xidhiidh ganacsi oo xasiloon oo la saadaalin karo oo leh helitaanka suuqa ayaa faa'iido u leh qof kasta oo ku nool labada dhinac ee Atlantic, ganacsiyada iyo macaamiisha si isku mid ah," ayuu intaas raaciyay. Ra'iisul wasaaraha Talyaaniga Giorgia Meloni ayaa soo dhoweysay heshiiska, balse waxay sheegtay inay u baahan tahay inay aragto faahfaahinta, sida ay ku warrantay wakaaladda wararka ee Talyaaniga ee Ansa. Guidance: User Generated and Social Media Content User generated content has become an essential part of BBC storytelling across the entire output. It plays a central role in most breaking news stories, but it is equally important in many other non-News output – including Children's. It can be still pictures, video or comment; it can be sent directly by users following specific calls to action or be found by searching for it on social media platforms and the wider web. Whatever content the BBC uses, regardless of how it is received, must adhere to the BBC Editorial Guidelines and standards. Content being widely shared or trending on social media may not necessarily make it appropriate for use; its editorial justification and purpose should be considered first. It should not be assumed that any user generated content – whether found on the web or received directly from the audience – is always what it claims to be. It may be fake, it may be genuine footage but of a different incident, it may be just part of the incident or taken from one perspective. In News, in particular, where UGC can play an important part in our output, the BBC must always authenticate any content before it is used. This might include anything from speaking to the individual who filmed the content to using a range of more sophisticated techniques such as geo-location and cross-referencing satellite imagery to interrogate the image itself. The more significant the image is, the more important it is to ensure it is authentic – although the responsibility for due accuracy remains regardless. Advice on verifying any UGC can be obtained from the UGC Hub. In a non-News environment, content producers might ask audience members to send in videos of themselves undertaking particular activities, or they might source similar content from the social web. Producers still have a responsibility to ensure the accuracy of that content before using it, but that might be ascertained in a simple conversation. Audiences should be provided with the relevant information to understand the events within their context, beyond the selective and narrow perspective which UGC may particularly offer. This may include details about the circumstances leading to the incident and its consequences. Nonetheless, BBC content producers should be open and honest about what they do not know or cannot corroborate. The Editorial Guidelines state: Care must be taken with content that may have been supplied by anyone with a vested interest, rather than a disinterested bystander. ( . . ) On highly controversial subjects, some views may be more likely than others to be expressed via UGC or be amplified on social media platforms. The existence of other views and their respective weights should be acknowledged and appropriately reflected. Where content producers ask audiences on social media to share their views or observations, they should be aware of the serendipitous nature of social media that means people may only come across the calls to action by chance. Where content producers are considering using significant content found on social media – such as video of a breaking news event – they should always seek to secure the consent of the owner of the material, even if a Fair Dealing use might be argued. The BBC would not normally pay for the use of such material, other than in exceptional circumstances but producers should be aware of copyright or other legal issues and take appropriate advice when necessary. The owner of the material, wherever and whenever it is used – should always be credited, unless to do so might put the contributor at risk. Any link to the source must be editorially justified, rather than merely being considered as a credit. (See guidance: Links and Feeds) Consent may not always be required to use material when there is a public interest in doing so. However, careful consideration should always be given to the wider editorial justification and the impact of using UGC on a BBC platform that is already being shared extensively on social media. Comment, tweets or posts to BBC channels or otherwise open spaces may be used without the explicit consent of the individual authors. That is particularly the case when individuals are taking part in a public debate or it is clear they understand and are participating in the open nature of social media. Similarly, it is reasonable to use appropriate pictures of individuals taken from their open social media profiles without explicit consent when it is in the public interest. However, potential distress to family and friends should be carefully considered when using pictures of individuals who have died. Even though content may have been posted to social media platforms that have a potential global audience of billions, it is still necessary to consider whether the use of the material respects the privacy of those featured. If the content is filmed openly in a public or even semi-public space then the presumption would generally be that it would be reasonable for the BBC to use. This may still be the case even where the subject is not aware they are being filmed provided there is a public interest. For example, it could be video of vehicle drivers using their mobile phones or other examples of anti-social or illegal behaviour. However, if the content features individuals who might otherwise have a legitimate expectation of privacy, for example if they are receiving medical treatment, or where they are in a private space or the content was clearly not intended for public consumption, respect for their privacy should be maintained - unless a public interest in bringing the material to the audience. It may be appropriate to consider anonymising individuals featured where there remains a public interest in using the material. Where the BBC has asked for contributions from audiences, content producers should act in accordance with data protection laws in handling personal information and take appropriate advice. The BBC should never encourage individuals to break the law or put themselves in danger. It should not normally use material sourced from social media where it is clear individuals have put themselves at unnecessary risk. It should be made clear that contributors should continue to act in the way they would normally do regardless of the fact that they may be creating content that the BBC might use. They should never be encouraged or even 'given permission' to undertake activities they would not normally undertake. This is particularly the case when working with contributors producing longer form personal view or eyewitness content. In breaking news stories, the BBC should be co-ordinated and considerate in approaching individuals on social media for both their consent to use their material and to request any further contribution to the BBC output. It maybe they are still caught up in the incident or dealing with the consequences of it. Children should not be routinely asked to act as newsgatherers for the BBC, but they may be asked to submit content for creative projects or competitions on CBBC or other appropriate outlets. Where children under have been asked to send content directly, the BBC should use its own uploader, where parents have already given permissions for their child to upload content and will notify them every time content is submitted. Where content submitted to the BBC features other children under parental consent must be sought. Where children or young people are featured in content found on social media that is being considered for use, the impact on them should be taken into account. Any online safeguarding concerns that are discovered, whether related to online grooming or child abuse images, must be referred to the Head of Safeguarding and Child Protection immediately. Sida malaayiin doollar oo deeq ah loogu xaday magaca Soomaaliya Madaxa fulinta Midowga Yurub ayaa si ku meel gaar ah u hakiyay dhaqaalihii la siin jiray Barnaamijka Cunnada Adduunka (WFP) ee Soomaaliya, sida ay wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters u sheegeen laba sarkaal oo sare oo ka tirsan Midowga Yurub, ka dib markii baaritaan ay sameysay Qaramada Midoobay lagu ogaaday xatooyo baahsan iyo in si aa naan munaasab aheyn loo isticmaalay gargaarkii looga tala galay in looga hortago macluusha Soomaaliya. Midowga Yurub ayaa in ka badan milyan oo doollar ku bixiyay howlgallada WFP ee Soomaaliya sannadkii hore, qayb ka mid ah deeqahaas oo ah in ka badan $ bilyan oo ay heshay, sida ay muujinayso xogta Qaramada Midoobay. Afhayeenka guddiga Midowga Yurub, Balazs Ujvari , ma xaqiijin mana beenin joojinta ku meel gaarka ah laakiin waxaa uu sheegay in ilaa iyo hadda aan la ogeysiin la-hawlgalayaasheeda Qaramada Midoobay saameynta dhaqaale ee mashaariicda uu maalgeliyo Midowga Yurub. Balazs Ujvari ayaa yiri "waxaan sii wadi doonaa inaan la soconno xaaladan, anaga oo raaci doono qaanuunka noo yaala ee la xiriira hufnaanta iyo musuqmaasuq la’aanta." Hay’adda WFP ayaan wali ka jawaabin codsiyo loo diray in wax looga weydiiyo arrimahaan. Mid ka mid ah saraakiisha sare ee Midowga Yurub ayaa sheegay in go’aankan la qaatay kadib markii baaritaankii Qaramada Midoobay lagu xaqiijiyay in mulkiilayaasha dhulka, maamulka deegaanada, xubno ka tirsan ciidamada ammaanka iyo shaqaalaha samafalka ee Soomaaliya ka howlgala ay dhamaantood ku lug lahaayeen xatooyada gargaarka loogu talagalay dadka nugul. Sarkaal kale oo magaciisa ka gaabsaday ayaa sheegay in gargaarka dib loo soo celin doono marka ay WFP buuxiso shuruudo hufnaanta, sida in la kala shaandheeyo la-hawlgalayaasheeda ku sugan gudaha Soomaaliya. Sarkaalka labaad oo sare oo ka tirsan Midowga Yurub ayaa sidaas xaqiijiyay. Ilo saddexaad, oo sidoo kale ka tirsan Midowga Yurub, ayaa sheegay in Guddigu "si firfircoon ula shaqeynayo WFP si loo xalliyo cilladaha nidaamka ka dhex jira" laakiin wuxuu sheegay in aan wax gargaar ah la joojin ilaa iyo hadda. Saddex bilood ka hor WFP iyo Hay’adda Maraykanka u qaabilsan Horumarinta Caalamiga ah (USAID) ayaa hakiyay cuntadii gargaarka ee ay siin jireen dalka Itoobiya si ay uga jawaabaan deeqaha baahsan ee la leexsado. Guddiga Midowga Yurub ayaa Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ugu deeqa milyan oo Yuuro oo u dhiganta . Milyan oo Doollar, iyadoo la sii marinayo hay’adda WFP, deeqahaasi ayaana qeyb ka ah hakin QM, sida uu sheegay mid ka mid ah saraakiisha sare ee Midowga Yurub. , Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Mareynkanka ayaa ilaa hadda ah deeq bixiyaha ugu weyn ee Soomaaliya. Sannadkii hore, waxay ku biirisay in ka badan $ . bilyan oo maalgelin ah oo ku baxday wax ka qabashada arimaha bini'aadantinimo ee ka jira Somaaliya. Afhayeenka USAID Jessica Jennings ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in Maraykanku uu ka shaqaynayo sidii loo darsi lahaa inta uu le'eg yahay gaargaarka la weecsaday, isla markaana ay horayba u qaadayeen tillaabooyin lagu ilaalinayo dadka u baahan gargaarkan iyo in la hubiyo in lacagta cashuur bixiyayaasha Mareykanka la gaarsiiyo dadka jilicsan ee Soomaaliya sidii loogu talagalay. Sarkaal ka tirsan hay’adda USAID oo magaciisa ka gaabsaday in la xigto ayaa sheegay in xaaladaha Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliya ay kala duwan yihiin, isla markaana USAID aysan qorsheynayn in ay hakiso gargaarka cuntada ee Soomaaliya ay siiso. Ilo ka tirsan Kongareeska Maraykanka ayaa sheegay in go’aanka lagu hakiyay gargaarka Itoobiya, uu qayb ahaan la xiriiro doorka gaarka ah ee dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ee ku aaddan qaybinta gargaarka cuntada, taas oo ku adkaatay deeq-bixiyeyaasha in ay fahmaan. Sawirka, Xafiiska Maareynta Masiibooyinka Soomaaliya oo isku dubarrida gurmadka bini’aadannimo ee dowladda ayaa war uu soo saaray ku sheegay in madaxda Soomaaliya ay ka go’an tahay in ay baaraan natiijada warbixinta Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo dhanka kale intaa ku daray in hababka gargaarka ee hadda jira ay u shaqeeyaan si ka baxsan nidaamka dowladda. “Weecinta gargaarka waxay wiiqaysaa waxtarka iyo hufnaanta hawlaha bani'aadamnimo, iyadoo meesha ka saaraysa kalsoonida ay shacabku ku qabaan dadaalladayada wadajirka ah. Natiijooyinka hordhaca ah ee warbixinta Qaramada Midoobay waxay muujinayaan daciifnimada nidaamka hadda jira ee gargaarka bini'aadantinimada, sidaas darteed, waa inaan ku dadaalnaa hab cusub oo hubinaya daahfurnaanta, yareynaya lakabyo badan oo qandaraas-hoosaad ah, oo dhisa lahaanshaha maxalliga iyo dawladda ee geeddi-socodka", ayuu yiri Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maareynta Masiibooyinka Soomaaliya (SODMA) Maxamuud Macallin. Xafiiska xoghayaha guud ee QM Antonio Guterres isla markiiba kama jawaabin codsiyo loo diray in faallooyin uu uga bixiyo arrimahan. Deeq-bixiyeyaasha caalamiga ayaa kordhiyay dhaqaalaha ay siiyaan Soomaaliya sannadkii hore iyadoo saraakiisha bini'aadannimadu ay ka digeen macaluul ku soo fool leh Soomaaliya oo ka dhalatay abaartii Geeska Afrika ee ugu xumayd muddo tobanaan sano ah. Tan iyo markii ay soo shaac baxday xatooyada gargaarka abaartii sanadkii -kii, hay'adaha bani'aadamnimada ayaa inta badan kaalmadoodii u beddelay qaab lacaga ah in ay u gaarsiyaan dadka nugul oo ay mas'uuliyiinta qaarkood ku sheegeen kuwo aan u nugulayn musuqmaasuqa. Diyaaradihii hakiyay duulimaadyada oo loo la'yahay meel la dhigo , Waxaa toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay la joojiyay qaar ka mid ah duulimaadyada caalamiga ka dib markii uu dunida ku faafay fayraska corona. Dalal badan oo caalamka ah ayaa sheegay in kiisas badan laga helay xanuunka corona oo markiisii hore ka dilaacay dalka shiinaha. Saameynta xanuunka ayaa keentay in dad badan aysan safrin, wadamo badanna ay joojiyeen duullimaadyadii caalamiga ahaa, taasoo keentay in inta badan shirkadaha diyaaradaha ay joojiyaan duulimaadayada, maadaama ay yaraadeen macaamiisha safreysa iyo dalalka la tagi karo. Wargeyska The Financial Times ayaa kusoo warramay in diyaarado gaaraya kun ay joojiyeen duulimaadyadii, taas oo ka dhigan in dhammaan diyaaradahaas ay u baahdeen meelo la dhigo, maadaama aysan hawada ku jirin. Diyaaradaha joojiyay duullimaadyada waxaa ka mid ah, Emirates, Delta, Qantas, Lufthansa iyo kuwa kale oo badan oo yareeyay safarada sida KQ, British Airway iyo kuwo kale. Sawirka, Diyaaradaha ayaa markii hore isku badeli jiray goobaha la dhigo diyaaradaha oo marka mid kuwo hawada ku jiraan, kuwa kale ayaa yaali jiray bakinnada eelaboorada ku dhex yaalla. Shirkadda Delta Airline ayaa sheegtay inay joojineyso boqolkiiba duulimaadyadii ay sameyn jirtay, waxayna intaa ku dartay in ay fariisinayaan lix boqol oo diyaaradood. Madaxa shirkadda Delta, Ed Bastian ayaa sheegay in sidoo kale ay ka fikirayaan in ay hawlgab ka dhigaan diyaaradaha duugga ah. Sidoo kale shirkadda diyaaradaha ee Qantas ayaa sheegtay in ay si ku meel gaar ah u hakineyso diyaaradood, haddana ay wadaan wadahadalo ku aadan sidii loo heli lahaa meel la dhigo diyaaradahaas. Madaxa shirkadda Qantas, Alan Joyce, oo la hadlay warbaahinta Mareykanka, ayaa sheegay in dedaallada kahortagga xanuunka corona ay keentay in ay aad hoos ugu dhacdo tirada dadka safra, taasina ay khasaaro ku keentay shirkadaha duulimaadyada. Sido kale shirkadda duulimaadyada ee dalka Jarmalka ee Lufthansa ayaa sheegtay in ay hakisay duulimaadyada ay ku tegi jirtay meela badan oo caalamka ah. Sawirka, Lauren O'Neil Mareykanka waxaa la soo wariyay in shirkadaha duulimaadayada qaar ay waayeen meel la dhigo diyaaradaha, waxaana ay ku qasbanaadeen in diyaaradaha loo weeciyo xarumo lagu tijaabiyo diyaaradaha cusub, saldhigyada milateri iyo goobo kale. Sidoo kale qaaradaha Yurub, Mareykanka iyo Aasiya waxaa la sheegay in qiimaha laga qaado goobaha la dhigo diyaaradaha ay sare u kacday, maadaama ay adag tahay in la helo goobo bannaan oo la dhigo diyaaradaha. Magaalada Copenhagen ee dalka Denmark waxaa la sheegay in ciriiriga ka jira goobaha la dhigo diyaaradaha ay gaartay heer aan la maleysan karin, waxaana maamulka garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaaladaas uu la yimid qorshe cusub. Labo ka mid ah halka ay diyaaradaha ku ordaan ee garoonka diyaaradaha ee Copenhagen ayaa la sheegay in laga dhigay meel la dhigo diyaaradaha, si loo heelo dhul dheeraad ah oo la dhigo diyaardaha joojiyay duulimaadyada. Maxaan ka naqaan kansarka ku dhacay ra'iisul wasaarihii hore ee Ingriiska, Soomaalidana dhibaatada ku haya , Raysal Wasaarihii hore UK, David Cameron, ayaa ka hadlay in kansarka qanjirada ee loo yaqaan (borostate kansar) laga daaweeyay. Inta badan kansarkan wuxuu ku dhacaa ragga da'adoodu weyn tahay. Sanadkasta waxaa laga helaa ku dhawaad , oo qof kuwaas oo isugu jira kuwa markaas uu ku dhacay iyo kuwa muddo la xanuunsanaa balse aan ogeyn. Kansarkan waxa uu ku dhacaa qanjir aan ka weyneyn xabad loos ah, kaas oo ku yaal kaadi haysta hoosteeda. Waxa uu qanjirkan dhinacyada kaga yaal tubada qaada kaadidada ee xubinta taranka geysa. Kansarka borostateetka waa unug u weynaada si aan la xakameyn karin, si tartiib-tartiib ah ayuuna ku koraa. Dadka qaar ma dareemaan ilaa uu soo rito xanuunka. Waxaa suuragal ah in sanado uusan laheyn wax astaamo ah oo lagu garto, dadka qaarkiina wax dhibaato ah ma arkaan. Qaar kale waxa uu noqdaa mid degdeg ku socda oo loo dhinto. Kansarkan oo goor hore la ogaado waa sida ugu fiican ee wax looga qaban karo, waxayna taasi keeneysaa in si guul leh loo daaweyo. Dowladda UK waxay sheegtaa in Kansarakan uu ku dhaco sideedii nin mid ka mid ah noloshooda. Sanadkiina waxaa laga helaa 55kun. Dadka u dhinta sanadkii waxaa lagu sheegaa in ay gaarayaan , oo qof sida ay sheegtay hay'adda cilmibaarista kansarka ee UK. Dr Cabdulqaadir wuxuu kaloo sheegay in kansarkan uu yahay kan ugu badan ee ku dhaca dadka waa weyn, marka la la fiiriyo UK waxaa u badan ayuu yiri dadka madow. Dr. Cabdulqaadir ayaa kula taliyay dadweynaha in lays baaro marka hore si goor hore wax looga qabato. "Marka la gaaro da'da iyo wixii ka sareeya waa in ay isbaaaraan, qofka haduu madow yahay waa in uu isbaaraa, waxaa lala xiriiriyaa in kansarkan uu ku dhaco dadka hilibka badan cuna inkastoo aysan aheyn arrin la xaqiiyay" Dr. Cabdulqaadir wuxuu kaloo sheegay in astaamaha lagu garto kansarkan ay dhici karto in ay noqdaan xanuuno kale balse waxaa muhiim ah in aad la tashato dhakhtarkaaga. Ma jirto baaris gaar ah oo lagu ogaado kansarkan. Dhakhaatiirta waxay ku ogaadaan marka ay fiiriyaan astaamo badan sida in ay dhiig kaa qaadaan iyo sidoo kale in cad laga soo jaro qanjirka oo baaris sheybaar loo diro. Dhakhaatiirta ayaa hadda ka fakaraya in baarista dhiigga lagu kordhiyo mid iskaanka loo yaqaan MRI la marsiiyo bukaanka taas oo la sheegay in xaalada ay kor u qaadi karto. Cilmibaarayaasha ayaa iyagana ka fakaraya in baarista lagu daro mid iskaan ah si looga faa'ideysto tiknolojiyada. Balse qaar ka mid ah khubarada caafimaadka ayaa ka shakisan waxtarka baarista iskaanka. Charlotte Leigh, oo ah kalkaaliso ku nool England, ayaa diyaar u ahayd inay shaqada ka baxdo maalin ka mid ah xagaagii . Balse diiqad ayay dareemeysay. Wax walba waxay ula muuqdeen kuwo aan sax ahayn. Caadi ahaan way murugsaneyd. Wax yar kadib, waxay go'aansatay inay is disho iyadoo aadday waddada tareenka ee West Yorkshire. Balse nasiib wanaag, waxay maalintaas la kulantay darawal fiican oo tareenka waday. Darawalka tareenka ayaa durba xaqiiqsaday in gabadhu ay dhibaato heysato, wuuna badbaadiyay nolosheeda. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. "Waxaan la daalaa-dhacayay arrimo caafimaadka maskaxda ah tan iyo markii aan da'yaraa. Maalintaas shan sano kahor waxay nolosha Charlotte u ahayd mid muhiim ah. Xusuusaheeda maalintaas aad uma fiicneyn. Balse waxyaabaha qaar aad ayay u xusuusataa. Waxay xusuusataa inay soo aadday dhanka tareenka, kadibna tareen kusoo wajahnaa dhankeeda uu gaabiyay kadibna istaagay. Maanta maalintaadu ma xumeyd?" Ayuu yiri. "Waxaan iri, 'Haa, taasi way xumeyd'. Wuxuu yiri dhibaato malaha. Aan wada fadhiisanno oo wada-hadalno ilaa xaalkaagu ka hagaagayo." Ayay hadalka raacisay. Waxa uu intaa ku daray in dabka uu saamayn ku yeeshay ganacsigii iyadoona dadka inta badan ay ka qaxeen goobaha ka agdhaw halka uu dabku ka kacay. Dhanka kale waxa uu sheegay in Soomaalida halkaas ka dhaw ay yihiin kuwo aad u yar sidaasna aysan u jirin cabsi badan oo ay qabaan. How to make Google put preferred sources up top when you search A new feature lets you choose which publishers – including the BBC – appear at the top of your search results. Here's how to use it. Whether seeking the day's headlines or a healthy recipe, turning to Google search inevitably yields almost too much information – and with the recent rollout of AI summaries, trusted sources can sometimes seem lost down the page. With their new Preferred Sources tool, Google has put some control back in users' hands. You can now personalise your Google settings to select the BBC and any other publication or news source you'd most want to see when you visit Google websites and apps. These are your Preferred Sources. Find out more, below. Preferred Sources are websites you select in your Google settings that Google will prioritise when showing news and content. When you add a site as a Preferred Source, Google is more likely to show you articles, videos and other updates from that site. Preferred Sources may appear in the Google Top Stories results on Google search. The most likely place you'll see your Preferred Sources will be in the "from your sources" section nested within Top Stories results, both in the desktop and mobile versions of Google search. When you personalise your Preferred Sources settings, you're making Google work smarter for you. Choosing the BBC as a Preferred Source means that you see news from your trusted source more frequently. The fastest way to add the BBC as a Preferred Source is to use this direct link and tick the box next to BBC.com. (If you're not logged in or you don't have a Google account, the link will first ask you to sign in or create an account before bringing you to the selection screen.) You can also set your Preferred Sources while searching: After you search for something on Google, you'll see "Top Stories" next to a starred card icon. Click that icon to add BBC.com as a Preferred Source, then reload the search to see new BBC results. This preference will now be applied to all future Google searches. Maxaan ka ognahay safarka la sheegay in Cirro uu ku tegayo Israa'iil? , Xafiiska Afhayeenka Madaxweynaha JSL; naqshadeynta: BBC. Warar sheegaya in Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Iskeed ugu Dhawaaqday Madaxbannaanida ee Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro uu u safray, ama uu isu diyaarinayo safar uu ku tago Israa'iil, ayaa si weyn ugu faafay baraha bulshada ilaa shalay, balse waxaa garab socda qodobbo muhiim ah oo aanan weli la xaqiijin. Asalka wararkan wuxuu dib ugu biya-shubanayaa wicitaan taleefan oo dhacay -dii Diseembar , kaas oo dhex maray Madaxweynaha Somaliland iyo Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Israa'iil Benjamin Netanyahu. Wicitaankaas, ayaa Netanyahu wuxuu u sheegay Madaxweyne Cirro in Israa'iil ay aqoonsatay Somaliland iyo inay tageerayaan xaqa ay uleeyihiin is-maamul madax banaan, isagoo ku tilmaamay tallaabadaas mid taariikhi ah. Wuxuu sidoo kale ku casuumay Madaxweyne Cirro inuu booqasho rasmi ah ku yimaado Israa'iil, isagoo sheegay inuu gaarsiin doono madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump rabitaanka Somaliland u qabto ku biirista heshiisyada Abraham Accords oo ujeeddadoodu tahay in la caadiyeeyo xiriirka Israa'iil iyo dalalka Carabta. Sawirka, Xafiiska Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Israa'iil Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa ku sheegay wicitaanka inuu aqbalay casuumaadda, diyaarna u yahay inuu Israa'iil booqdo "sida ugu dhaqsaha badan ee suurtagalka ah", isagoo tilmaamay in safarku dhici karo sannadkan . Saas oo jidha, jadwal rasmi ah ama war rasmi ah oo safarka la xiriira lama shaacin. Shalay -kii Janaayo , qoraal lagu daabacay barta X oo uu qoray akoon magaciisu yahay Rabbi Avi Hirsch ayaa ku andacooday inuu helay xog ah in Madaxweyne Cirro uu gaaray Israa'iil. Safarkaas oo uu ku tilmaamay mid taariikhi ah oo lagu doonayo in Somaliland si rasmi ah loogu daro heshiisyada Abraham Accords. Qoraalkaas ayaa si degdeg ah u faafay, isagoonan wehelin wax ilo rasmi ah oo xigasho noqon kara. Magaca "Rabbi Avi Hirsch" waa mid Cibraani ah. "Rabbi" waxaa loogu yeeraa wadaadka Yuhuudiga ah, halka "Avi" uu macnihiisu yahay "aabbahay". Akoonkaas X ee warka faafiyay ayaa imika la hakiyay. Ka hor inta aan la cinwaanka hawada laga saarin, dad badan ayaa shaki geliyay runnimadiisa, iyagoo ku tilmaamay akoon majaajilo ama marin-habaabin u eg. Akoonka ayaa isticmaalayay sawirka Sheekh Cabdi Hirsi, oo ah falanqeeye siyaasadeed oo caan ah, inkastoo aysan jirin wax caddeyn ah oo muujinaysa inuu wax xiriir ah la lahaa akoonka ama sheegashooyinkiisa. BBC-du ma aysan awoodin inay si madax bannaan u xaqiijiso cidda dhab ahaantii maamuleysay akoonkaas ama halka uu ka keenay macluumaadka uu baahiyay. Dhinaca kale, xogta isha-furan, ama sirta suuqa taalla ee OSINT loo yaqaano, ayaa tibaaxaysa dhaqdhaqaaq lala xiriirinayo diyaarad gaar ah. Sida xogtu sheegayso, diyaarad nooca Hawker 800XP ah, kuna diiwaangashan lambarka T7-NKS, ayaa shalay, -kii Janaayo ka duushay garoonka Ben Gurion ee Israa'iil una jiheysatay Hargeysa, iyadoo martay hawada Itoobiya isla markaana sameysay wareegyo hakad ah ka hor inta aysan si toos ah u galin hawada Hargeysa. Wax caddeyn ah oo si rasmi ah u muujinaysa cidda saarnayd diyaaradda ama ujeeddada duullimaadka lagu ma soo bandhigin goobaha warbaahinta. BBC-du na si madax-bannaan ilaa hadda uma xaqiijin karto liiska rakaabka saarnaa ama sababta diyaaradani u timi Hargeysa. Sawirka, AfriMEOSINT/X BBC-da ayaa la xiriirtay Somaliland si ay u hesho xaqiijin ku saabsan safarka la sheegay ee Madaxweyne Cirro iyo wararka ku saabsan diyaaradda. Waqtigii warbixintan la diyaarinayay, mas'uuliyiinta Somaliland kama aysan jawaabin wicitaankeenna. Ilaa iyo inta ay ka imaanayaan xaqiijin rasmi ah oo ka timaadda Somaliland ama Israa'iil, wararkani waxay uun ahaan doonaan war suuq oo aanan la xaqiijin karin. Ra'iisul Wasaaraha ayaa -kii December ku dhawaaqay in Somaliland ay si rasmi ah ugu aqoonsadeen dal madax-bannaan. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si xooggan uga hortimid aqoonsigaas, waxayna ku tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanideeda. Weriyaha Yurub ku nool ee ku hajabay inuu magangalyo ka codsan doono Soomaaliya , CARLOS HERRERA Dadka isticmaala baraha bulshada ee dalka Spain ayaa toddobaadkan weriye caan ka ah dalkaas soo xusuusiyay hadal uu sanado kahor yiri. Barnaamij soo jeediyaha' Herrera en COPE ' ee dalka Spain, Cralos Herreram ayaa bishii February ee sanadkii sheegay in marka uu eego xaaladda dowladda dalkaas ay taasi ku qasbeyso inuu magangalyo ka codsado Soomaaliya. “Xaaladda dalkan Afrikaanka ah ayaa aad uga wanaagsan keyga, marka la isu barbardhigo xeebihiisa, iyo waxa nagu sugaya Spain", isagoo markaas dhaliilayay dowladda raysal wasaare Pedro Sánchez. Xilligaas, inta badan dadka baraha bulshada isticmaala ayaa cambaareeyay hadalka weriyaha, kuwaasoo su’aal iska weydiiyay in Soomaaliya ay aqbasho "muhaajiriin" iyo inkale sida Herrera. Qaar kale ayaa ku boorriyay inuu diyaarad raaco "sida ugu dhaqsiyaha badan." Talaadadii lasoo dhaafay, kaddib doorashadii guud ee dalkaas, magacyada 'Carlos Herrera' iyo 'Soomaaliya' ayaa aad looga hadal hayay baraha bulshada Spain, iyadoo dadku ay weriyahan soo xusuusinayeen inuu ka dhabeeyo go’aankiisii ahaa inuu Soomaaliya ka codsado magangalyo. Dadka kale ayaa kula kaftamay in dalkan uu boos u haayo isaga. Macluumaadkan waxaa daabacay X. Waxaan dalbanayenaa fasaxaaga ka hor inta aan la furin, waxaa laga yaabaa inay isticmaalayaan cookies iyo farsamooyin kale. hadii aad u bahato akhri X xeerarka cokie iyo kan ku saabsan xogta gaarka ah ka hor inta aadan aqbalin. si aad u aragto xogta guji ‘aqbal oo soco’. Qaar kale, ayaa iyaguna la kaftamay weriyaha, waxayna u direen jadwalka duullimaadyada Soomaaliya, halka kuwo kalena ay dowladda ka codsadeen inay tikidka ka bixiso. Spain ayaa Axaddii la soo dhaafay gashay xaalad hubanti la’aan siyaasadeed kaddib markii aysan cidna guusha ku raacin doorashadii guud ee dalkaasi ka dhacday. Labada xisbi ee dalkaas midkoodna ma helin codadkii loogu talogalay inay dowlad ku dhisaan, taasoo laga yaabo inay sababto in codbixin kale la qabto dabayaaqada sanadkan. Natiijada ayaa muujineysa in codadku ay u kala qeybsameen xisbiga midig dhexe iyo bidix dhexe. Balse midkoodna, Xisbiga Hantiwadaagga ee Raysal Wasaare Pedro Sánchez iyo mucaaradka asal-raaca kuma guuleysan codad ku filan si ay keligood u maamulaan baarlamaanka dalkaas ee -ka kursi ka kooban. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Sida laga war hayo Soomaaliya way qaabishaa qaxooti iyo magangalyo doon ka yimid dalalka dibadda. Xog ururin ay sameysay barta Releifweb ee arrimaha bani’aadannamida ka hadasha, ayaa lagu sheegay in laga soo bilaabo January , ay Soomaaliya ku nool yihiin , qaxooti iyo dad magan-galyo doon ah. Iyadoo % qaxootigan iyo magangalyo doonkan ay ku nool yihiin gobollada galbeed ee dalka. Guurka Soomaalida iyo ajaanibtu miyuu ka batay sidii hore? , KALTUN BAANDEY Baryahan dambe waxaynu ku arkaynay baraha bulshada doodaha ku saabsan dadka soomaalida ah ee guursaday dadka ajaaniibta ah, gaar ahaan Soomaalida ku nool waddamada reer galbeedka oo sanadihii ugu dambeeyey ay sii bateen jaaliyadda Soomaaliyeed ee halkaasi ku nool. Waxaana doodahaa sii xoojiyey iydoo inta badan ay gabdho Soomaaliyeed kusoo bandhigeen lammaaneyaashooda oo ajaanib ah. Waxaa kaloo dhan kalena aynu ka daawannay isla baraha bulshada dhaliyaro wiilal Soomaali ah oo dalka Marooko u guur doonanaya. Haddaba su’aasha lays weydiinayanaa waxay tahay miyeey bateen Soomaalida ajaaniibta guursanaysaa mise baaha bulshada ayaa buunbuuniya? Dr Kaltun Baandey Rivers waa cilmi baadhe arrimaha bulshada ku takhasustay oo deggan Sheiffield UK, waxaanay is guursadeen nin Ingiriis ah muddo laga joogo sanno waxaanay noo sheegtay “Guurku waa wax laba qof oo is doortay is guursanayaan inaga Soomaali baa nahay udub dhaxaadka guurku waa diinteena Islaamka, markaa waligeedba Somaalida iyo ajaanibtu way is guursan jireen annaga intaannu is guursan ninkayga waxaa jiray Soomaali badan oo ajaanib ay is guursadeen, dalkan Ingiriiskana waxaa jira kumannaan Soomaali iyo caddaanku iska dhaleen oo raggii Soomaalida ahaa ee bad-mareenku ay dhaleen oo immika iyana carruurtoodii caruurro sii dhaleen, wax cusub maaha guurka ajaainbtu ee baraha bulshada ayaa aad u faafiyey," ayay tiri. Iyadoo sidaa tahay haddana waxaynu ognahay in muddo qarniyaal ah guursiga ajaanibta uusan ahayn wax ku cusub nolosha dadka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan marka laga eego dhanka isdhexgalka mujtamacyada dega xeebaha oo ka duwan kuwa deegaannada aan xeebaha lahayn ee u badan reer guuraaga. Sawirka, Inta badan doodaha baraha bulshada ee ku saabsan guurka ajaanibta ayaa ku jihaysnaa gabdhaha Soomaalida ee guursaday ama calmaday ragga ajaanibta ah, iyadoo qaar badanna ay si ulkaca usoo bandhigayeen muuqaallo ah iyaga iyo lammaanayashooda taasi oo doodaha iyo hadlhaynta cirka kusii shareertay, waatan mar kale Dr Kaltuun Baandey “maaha in gabadhaha uun diiradda la saaro oo raggana loo sacab tumo haweenka ajaaniibta ah guursada, taasi waxay keenaysaa in gabdhaha feedh duubtaan oo difaac galaan ama ay dadkoodii iyo dhaqankoodii ka cararaan, looma baahna taasi”. Waxaynu xasuusanaa dhowr jeer inay dareenka Soomaalida soo jiiteen aroosyo muran dheliyay sida kii ay ku aqal galeen Idriss Elba iyo Sabriina Dhoore. Idiris iyo Sabrina Dhoore ayuu arooskoodu ka dhacay Huteelka Mandarian Hotel oo ku yaalla dalka Marooko. Sideedaba ma hawal yara laba qof oo kala dhaqana iyo caadooyin ah ama aan isku diin ahayn oo guur dhex mara , inkastoo Soomaali badan oo reer gabeedka ku dhasahay aanay aragba meel dhul Soomaaliyeed ayahay oo halkaasi ku koreen haddana caqabadahu way jirayan sida ay sheegtay Dr Kaltun Baandey “Horta waxaa fiican in qofku marka hore dhaqankiisa wax ka yaqaano iyo caadooyinkiisa markaas ayaa qofkiikalena tixgalinayaa , caruurta aad dhashaana ay ku faanayaaninay Sooamli iyo dad kale iska dhaleen , waxaaa ku baaqaa marwalba in caruurtaiska dhalka ah ee Soomaalida ah ee calamo soomaali ah gacmaha u sudhan yahiin ynusoo dhaweeyno oo dhiiri galino wayo way inagu faanaan". Doodaha qaar in ay noqdaan hadal hayn weyn waxaa saamaxay baraha Bulshada oo ah meelo ay dadku ra'yigooda ku soo bandhigaan, laakin dhanka kale, waxaa yar ama meesha ka maqan tixgelinta dookha qofka, iyo in loo arko inuu isagu yahay qofka leh go'aanka noloshiisa.Haddaba iyadoo ay sii bateen Soomalida qurbahu iyo is dhexgalka soomaalida iyo ajaanibtu ayaa waxaa hubaal ah inuu sii badan doono guurka jaanibta iyo Soomaalidu. © BBC. Waa nooc mulawax ah oo aad u jilicsan oo laga jecel yahay Koonfurta Aasiya, isla markaana si weyn loogu cuno digaag lagu kariyey subag. Cunytada noocan ah waa mid ka mid ah cuntooyinka ugu caansan gobolkaas. Keliya digaag laguma cuno ee malawaxaas waxaa lala cunaa cuntooyin kale oo badan, wuxuuna ka mid yahay waxyaabaha lama huraanka u ah ee aan sinaba uga maqnaan karin miiska cuntada ee gobolka. Waxa lagu daraa alaabo kale oo dhadhan kala duwan u sameeya. Malaha sababtaas awgeed ayuu malawaxani caan uga noqday dunida oo dhan. Dhawaan ayaa nooc ka mid ah rootigan oo toon lagu daraywaxay caan ka noqotay kuwa ugu wanaagsan dunida. Marka la diyaarinayo waxa lagu daraa subag sixin ah oo lagu mariyo malawax diirran, kadibna lagu dul rusheeyo toon la jarjaray. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa laga yaabaa inay dad badan u noqoto arrin cusub in malawaxa oo meel kasta laga helo uu dadka qaarkiis u yahay cunnada ugu wanaasgan. Waxa la sheegayaa in cuntadani ay ka mid ahaan jirtay kuwa ugu qaalisan ee la siin jiray boqorradii muslimiinta. Haddaba, sidee ayuu malwaxani uga soo baxay jikadii boqortooyada una soo gaadhay miisaska caadiga ah ee dadweynaha caalamku ku cunteeyaan? Fadlan halkan riix oo ku soo biir janalka WhatsApp ee BBC Somali si aad u hesho wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee caalamka, iyo kuwa gobolka Taariikhda malawaxa waa mid xoogaa mugdi ah oo aan si buuxda u caddayn, balse khubaradu waxay aamminsan yihiin in mulawaxu asal ahaan ka soo jeedo taariikhdii Faaris ee qadiimiga ahayd, maadaama magaca "naan" oo la mid ah malawax uu ka yimid af-Faarisiga. Waqtiyadii hore, dadka Faarisiyiinta ah waxay ka samayn jireen roodhi iyaga oo isku daraya biyo iyo bur, kaddibna waxay ku dubi jireen dhagaxyo aad u kulul. Qarnigii 13aad ilaa 16aad, xilliyadii guulaha Islaamku ka gaadhay Hindiya, malawaxu wuxuu u gudbay Bariga Aasiya (Hindustan), sababtoo ah Muslimiintii guulaystay waxay la yimaadeen dhaqammadoodii cuntada. Sidoo kale, dadka ka yimid Aasiya Dhexe iyo Galbeed waxay wateen qalabyo waxa lagu foorneeyo. Niha Varmani, oo si dhow ula socota taariikhda Koonfurta Aasiya, waxay sheegtay in "malawaxu uu lahaa cunto-kariye gaar ah oo si joogto ah u soo saari jiray rootiga. Tusaale ahaan, nooc ka mid ah mulwaxaas wax auu lahaa lakabyo rooti khafiif ah, halka malawaxa qaarkooda ay ay ka samaysnaayeen rooti yar oo si fiican u nuugi jiray maraqa cuntada." Inkasta oo laga yaabo in ay kala duwan yihiin haddana, Soomaalida ayaa ka mid ah dadka aadka u jecel cuntadan malawaxa ah ee aadka u jilicdasan, islamarkaana waxa si weyn loogu cunaa subag ama malab. Waa mid ka mid ah cuntooyinka ugu caansan meelo badan oo ay Soomaalidu joogto. Keliya subag laguma cuno ee malawaxa waxaa lagu cunaa cuntooyin kale oo badan sida hilib, fuul ama shaah. Way adag tahay in laga waayo miisaska Soomaalida gaar ahaan xilliyada quraacda ama cashada. Waxa laga helaa guryaha, hoteellada iyo makhaayadaha, waxaana lagu diyaariyaa bur, caano, ukum iyo saliid ama subag, iyadoo lagu dubo digsi kulul. Maxay tahay qorraxda macmalka ah ee ay Japan sameeynayso? Dowladda Japan ayaa wadda qorshe ay ku hirgalinayso qorrax macmal ah, taas oo ay doonayso in ay isticmaasho. Saynisyahanno u dhashay dalkaasi ayaa hadda rajeynaya inay hammiga dowladdooda ay ka dhigaan mid xaqiiqo ah oo farsameeynaya qorraxada ayada oo la isticmaalaayo tiknolajiyadda. Mashruuca hirgalinta qorraxda macmalka ah ee Japan ayaa la daahfuray waxaana siynisyahannadu ay sheegeen in la isticmaali doono tamarta nukliyeerka oo ah tan ugu awoodda badan adduunka. In kasta oo mashruucaan uu yahay mid billow ah, haddana saynisyahannada qaar ayaa u arka in ay tahay xalka baahida tamarta mustaqbalka ee bani’aadamka. Saynisyahannada Japan ayaa shaaciyay in ay sameeynta qorraxdaan macmalka ah u adeegsan doonaan tamarta nukliyeerka oo lagu daray atamyo kale kuwaas oo lagu magacaabo (nuclear fusion) Waa qorshe ay khubarrada tiknoolajiyadda tamarta nukliyeerka muddo tobnaan sano ah baaritaanka ay ku wadeen, waxayna aaminsan yihiin inay noqon karto isha tamarta deegaanka. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay xaqiijiyeen inay ka gudbeen caqabad weyn oo arrintan ku saabsan taas oo ah in qorraxdu ay dhalinayaan ay noqon karto mid la isku hallayn karo. Waxaa kale oo khuburradu ay sheegeen in hannaanka lagu dhalinayo qorraxada macmalka loo isticmaali doono cunsur culus oo soo saara tamarta qaab iftiin iyo kulayl ah, iyada oo la jaanqaadaysa hababka gudaha qorraxda macmalka ah. Warshadda lagu sameyn doono qorraxda ayay saysinyahannadu tilmaameen in aysan ahayn mid khatar ah oo qarxi karta sida tii Fukushima, Japan ee oo kale. Hirgalinta mashruucaan waxaa gacan ka siinaya dowladda Japan isbahaysi ka kooban shaybaar oo reer Yurub ah kuwaas ka faa'iidi doona marka mashrruca uu mirodhal noqdo Dowladda Japan waxa ay ka mid tahay dalalka ugu horreeya dhanka tiknolojiyadda caalamka, waxaana horey ay u hiraglisay mashruucyo waaweyn oo ku saabsan nukliyeerka iyo tamarta oo ah mid si weyn ay ugu faa'iiidday. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Waxaa laga hirgalinayaa meel u dhow Machadka Qaranka ee Sayniska iyo Tiknoolajiyadda ee Japan (QST) oo ku yaal waqooyiga magaalada Tokyo. Hadii uu hirgalo waxaa uu noqonaya mid ka mid ah ilaha tamarta kaarboon-la'aanta ah iyo tamar 'nadiif' ah sida uu sheegay agaasimaha Machadka Qaranka ee Sayniska iyo Tiknoolajiyada ee Japan Sam Davis. Sam Davies oo la hadlay wakaaladda wararka Faransiiska ee AFP ayaa sheegay in sameynta qorraxdaan macmalka ay tahay natiijada iskaashiga u dhexeeya in ka badan oo saynisyahanno iyo injineerro ah iyo in ka badan shirkadood oo ka kala yimid Yurub iyo Japan oo dhan. Hirgalinta mashruucaan ayaa waxaa ku baxay dhismihiisa wejiga koobaad adduun lacaga ah oo dhan milyan oo Yuuro, taas oo ay bixin doonan Yurub iyo Japan. Farsamooyinka loo isticmaalo in sawirada lagu maamulo waa kuwo aad u casriyeysan, dabcan waxa aan galnay duni ka duwan tii hore marka ay noqoto habka casriga ah ee tiknoolojiyadda, waxa aan galnay xilligii been-abuurka la barbar dhigayay waaqiciga iyo waxa saxda ah ee jira. Iyada oo sawirka boqoradda Wales iyo carruurteeda lagala baxay wakaaladaha wararka ayaa waxaa laga walaacsanyahay sida "loo maareeyay", waxaana lasoo dhex dhigay baraha waliba si aan horay loo arag. Garaadka macmalka ah ayaa sidoo kale soo saari kara iftiin aan habooneyn iyo hoos aan markii hore jirin, laakiin sida cad, AI ayaa sameyn kara wejyo aad loo rumeysan karo xitaa marka loo eego aadanaha. , PRINCE OF WALES Habka kale ee xaqiiqo helidda waa in la raadiyo sifooyin ay adagtahay in mararka qaar la helo. Gobolada qaarkood sida Punjab iyo Madhya Pradesh jabaatiga ayaa la doortaa. Hadaba khubaradu ma aysan eegin oo kaliya bariiska ama jabaatiga. Hadii aad dooneysi bariis ama jabaati in aad ka dhigato cashadaada waxay ku xiran tahay waxyaabo badan. Waxay sidoo kale ku xiran tahay nooca bariis ama jabaati aad cuneysid. Bariiska iyo jabaatiga labaduba waxaa ku jira karbohaydareyt. Waxaa sida guud la rumeysan yahay in karbohaydareytka ku jira rootiga ama jabaatiga uu ka yar yahay kan bariiska taas ayaa ka dhigeysaa mid caafimaad ahaan ka wanaagsan. Nazneen Hussain waxa ay ku nooshahay magaalada Mumbai, waxayna ku takhasustay nafaqada cuntada. Waxa Nazneen leedahay hadii aad cuntid Jabaati laga sameeyay burka adag ama faybar waa fiican tahay, balse hadi aad cuneysid jabaati laga sameeyay burka caadiga karbohaydareytka ku jira waxa uu la mid yahay kan briiska. Sidaa darteed in la cuno jabaatiga noocaas oo kale ah waxa uu keenayaa in degdeg uu u kordho heerka sokorta dhiigga. Waxay kaloo sheegtay Nazneen in caafimaad ahaan uusan fiicneyn bariiska cad ee qolofka laga qaaday. Waxaa ka wanaagsan ayey leedahay bariiska aan la warshadeyn ee aan laga qaadin qolofka. Sawirka, Marka la eego faybarka, dhakhaatiirta ama khubarada nafaqada waxay kula taliyaan dadka in ay cunaan bariiska baroownka ah ama midka aan qolofka laga qaadin. Arrimaha kale ee lagu taliyay waxaa ka mid ah in bariiska lagu cuno khudaarta. Waxayna sheegeen in bariiska sidaas loo cuno uu caafimaad ahaan fiican yahay. Kuwa khudaarta cuno waxa kaliya ee jabaatiga ku dari karaan waa khudaar. Sawirka, Mala Manral waxay leedahay, "qofkasta waxa uu u baahan yahay kolori, waxayna taas ku xiran tahay dhaqdhaqaaqa aad sameyso iyo da'adaada.
