Dadka Hinduga iyo Sikha dalka Hindiya oo wax ka dhisaya masaajid Dadka haysta diimaha kala duwan ee Hindiya waxaa mararka qaar dhexmara rabshado, kuwaas oo sannadihii tagay isu badalay qalalaaso culus. Balse waxaa arrin la taaban karo noqotay sida ay isugu xiranyihiin dadka ku nool hal tuulo ku taalla Waqooyiga Hindiya. Iyadoo fuundi Nazim "Raja" Khan uu ka shaqeynayo dhismaha Mandarka Shiva ee tuulo ku taalla Punjab, waxaa ku soo dhacday fikrad kale. Waa nin Muslim ah oo ka shaqeynaya dhismaha, isagoo aan haysan masaajid dhow oo uu ku cibaadeysto. "Ma haysan meel aan ku oogno namaz (oo micneheedu yahay Salaadda)," ayuu yiri ninka -jirka ah. "Qaraabadeena uma fiicneyn marka ay na soo booqdaan". Waxaa tuulada Moom ku nool illaa oo qof oo Muslimiin ah, waxayna ku taallaa Waqooyiga Hindiya. Balse waa dad aad sabool u ah oo aan awoodin in ay helaan dhul laga dhiso masaajid. Inta badan Muslimiinta tuullada Moom waa muruqmaal waxayna qabtaan shaqooyiinka gacanta sida dhismaha, halka Hinduga oo gaaraya illaa iyo Shikhska oo ka badan , ay yihiin dad dhaqaale haysta oo ladan. Ka dib markii la dhammeeyay dhismaha Macbadka, Raja wuxuu qaaday tallaabo aan horey loo arag. Horraantii sannadkan, wuxuu u tagay maamulka Macbadka wuxuuna ku yiri: "Adinka Hinduga ah waxaad dhowaan heleysaan mandar. Waxaad haysateen mid hore. Laakiin annaga Muslimiinta mahaysano masaajid aan ku tukano, mana haysano lacag aan dhul ku iibsano. Meel yar oo dhulkiina ka mid ah mana siin kartaan?" Isbuuc ka dib, wuxuu ka helay jawaab. Maamulka Macbadka waxay go'aansadeen in ay Muslimiinta siiyaan dhul banaan oo ku dheggan Mandarka oo gaarayay sq ft ( sq m). "Waa farxad," ayuu yiri Raja. "Hadda maba heli karo erey aan ku qeexo sida aan ugu mahadcelinayo." Purshottam Lal, oo ah dhaqtar, kana tirsan guddiga maamula mandarka ayaa sheegay "Wuxuu ahaa dalab la taaban karo. Waxay ahayd cadaallad daro in Muslimka aysan haysan Masaajid iyadoo aan wadaageyno farxadda iyo murugada". Laba bilood ka hor, Raja iyo dhowr fuundi oo kale iyo shaqeele ayaa si farxad ku dheehan tahay u billaabay dhismaha Masaajid. Bulshada Sikh waxay gacan ka geysteen dhanka dhaqaalaha lagu dhisayo Masaajidka, taas oo ay "uga deyanayaan gidaarka Gurdwara". Waxayna tuulada noqotay Tusaalaha dhifka ah ee muujinaya wadajirka ka dhexeeya seddaxda diimood ee Hindiya ee iskula nool hal meel. Aalaaba waxaa dhacdo in dadka laga badan yahay ay sheegtaan in dhibaato loo geystay laakiin kuwa tuulada Moom way ka dhuwan yihiin.

Taariikhda madaalihii hobolladii Waaberi Cumar Shoolli Waxaa xalay magaalada Muqdisho ku geeriyooday alle ha u naxariistee fanankii waynaa ee Cumar Cabdulle (Cumar Shoolli). Cumar Shooli ayaa muddooyiinkii ugu dambeeyay ku xanuunsanaa magaalada Muqdisho waxaa uuna u geeriyooday sida dadka ku dhaw-dhaw ay shegeen cudurka Macaanka ama Sokorta. Fanankii waynaa ee Cumar Cabdulle (Cumar Shooli) ayaa sida la sheegay ku dhashay degmada afgooye ee gobolka shabeellaha Hoose, waxaana da'diisa lagu sheegay dhowr iyo sideetan. Waxaa uu fanka ku soo biiray sida uu ku sheegay wareysiyadii uu horey u bixiyay in ka badan sano ka hor. Shooli ayaa fanka kaga soo biiray dhanka ciidamada oo waxaa uu ka mid ahaa militarigii Soomaaliya sida uu ku sheegay wareysiyadii hore ee uu bixiyay. Fanaanka waxaa uu qaaday heeso badan oo ay ka mid ahaayeen heesta la dabaalo Caashaqa iyo heesta aroosyada ee aadka loo jecelyahay ee Ladnaan ku waara. Cumar Cabdule (Shooli) ayaa waxaa uu ka mid ahaa kooxdii qaranka ee Waabari. Cumar ayaa waxaa uu fanaaniinta kale kaga duwanaa in uu ciyaari jiray kaalimo kala duwan sida qaadida heesaha, tumidda muusiga iyo waliba jilliinka. Mar la waydiiyay Cumar Shooli sababta loogu bixiyay ma daalaha waabari ayuu sheegay in uu ahaa nin howla badan isku qabta taasi oo dad badan ka yaabisay ka dib na magaca loo bixiyay. "Waxaan qaban jiray shaqo saddex qof u baahnayd ayaan kaligey qaban jiray," ayuu yiri cumar Shooli. Cumar Shooli ayaa alle ha u naxariistee sheegay in mararka qaar ay dhici jirtay in hal habeen uu ka qeyb galo dhowr barnaamij taasi oo xitaa dadka shaki galisay in dhowr cumar Shooli ay jiraan. "Magaalada Marka ayaa waxaan ka soo dhigayaa Ruwaayad waan ka soo tagayaa waxaan imaanayaa Jubba Gitaar ayaan ka tumayaa waan heesayaa , subaxiina waxaan fadhiyaa barnaamijikii Kadis, dadku waxay is yiraahdeen markaa waa Shooliyaal badan ma aha Shooligii aan arki jirnay,", ayuu yiri shooli. Magaca Madaalaha Waabari ayuu sheegay in uu u bixiyay alle ha u naxariistee Wariye Cabdalle Nuuradiin. Alle ha u naxariisteen fanaanka Cumar Cabdulle waxaa uu lahaa naanesyo badan. Waxaa ka mid ah magaca inta badan dadka Somaalida ay u yaqaanaan ee Shooli oo ah magac yaraantiisii ay asxaabtiisa u bixiyeen. Mar wax laga waydiiyay magaca Cumar shooli ayaa waxaa uu ku jawaabay:"Waxaan ku fiicnaa dabaasha, xeebta Liido waxaan ahaa ninka koowaad haddii aan waayo ama labaad waxaan ahaa saddaxaad marka waxaa jira Kalluun afdhuuban oo dabaasha ku fiican marka Shooli meeshaas ayay ka timid," ayuu yiri.

Sida khuuradu u dhibaateyn karto guurkaaga iyo xalka looga bogsan karo . Khuurada ayaa wax u dhinta maskaxda iyo jirka qofka ag jiifta qof khuurinaya. Sidoo kale guurka ayay burburisaa. “Waxaan qosol ka sameeyaa khuurada ninkeyga aniga oo kula kaftama qoyskeyga iyo saaxiibadeey. Laakin xaqiiqada ayaa ah inaan aad u dhibanahay,” Sidaas waxaa tiri Arunika Selvam oo ah jir u dhalatay Singapore oo xaas u ah nin qaba. “Muddo afar sano ah waxaan dhinac jiifay odeygayga oo si aan loo dulqaadan Karin u khuuriya, aniga oo ku walwalsan sida uu u xanaaqi doono hadii aan u shego dhibka aan ku qabo,” ayay tiri hooyadaan haysata labada caruurta ah. Khuurada ninkeeda ayaa waxay xalaad xun galisay xiriirka labadooda ka dhaxeeya, iyada oo sidoo kale hoos u dhigtay Tayada hurdada ee seygeeda, in kasta oo ay is leedahay waad iskala noolaan kartaa khuuradaan. “Wuxuu bilaabay inuu soo tooso habeenkii. Si wanaagsana habeenkii uma seexdo sidaas daraadeed subaxii jawigiisu ma fiicnaado,” ayay u sheegtay BBC da. Isaga kalishiis ma ahan cidda habeenkii ay hurdo la’aantu ku dhacdo. Iyada ayaa sidoo kale habeenkii aan si wanaagsan u seexan maadaama uu seygeedu aad u khuuriyo. Waxay sheegtay in ay ku adkaato in shaqadeeda ay caadi u gudato maadama hurdada habeenkii ay aad ugu adkaatay. Inkasta oo khuuradu ay tahay dhibaato ka dhex jirta dadka is qaba ayaan hadana si wayn looga doodin dhibaatada ka dhalata. Khubarada ka faalooda xiriirada caafimaadka qaba ayaa sheegaya in saameynta xu nee ka dhalata khuurada ee saameysa xiriirka ay tahay mid aad u sareysa oo ay la kulmayaan labada qof ee wada nool, sidaas daraadedna ay tahay in laga wada hadl arrintaan si furana looga dodo. Khuurada ayaa waxaa la xiriiriyaa xaalad caafimaad oo ah in qofka ay xiranto sanqaroorku markii uu jiifto. Xaalad xirmashada sanqaroorka ah ayaa la sheegay in ay bilaabato markii qofka ay neeftu hora yuga soo bixiso kadibna ay mar kale bilaabato socoshada neefta. Xaaladdaan ayaa waxaa sababa ayaa la sheegay in ay sababto kadib markii ay dabcaan sidoo kalana ay qafiif noqdaan darbiyada neefmareenka, taas oo waxyeelo u gaysata nidaamka caadig ah ee neefsadasha, sababtana in oksajiintu ku yaraato. Dr. Ramamurthy Sathyamurthy, oo ku taqasusay neefmareenka macalin na ka ah jaamacadda Cook University Hospital ee tuaalla dalka Ingiriiska, ayaa sheegay in xaaladda xiran sanqaroorka ay ka sii darto markii muddo la joogaba. Sida uu sheegay dhaqtarku, xaalad caafimaad ayaa dhibaato taban oo ku keenta caafimaadka qofka khuuriya iyo sidoo kale xaalad caafimaad oo maskaxiyan iyo jir ahaanba ah oo ku timaada lamaanaha qodka khuuriya. Caalamadaha lagu garto in aad leedahay khuuradaan ay sababto xaaladda caafimaad ayaa waxa la sheegay in ay ka mid yihiin joojinta iyo dib u bilaabista neefsashada iyo soo kicitaanka dagdaga ah iyada oo neeftu kugu dhagan tahay. Madax xanuunka malainkii ah, daal badan, in aad waxba diiradda saari waydo, hilmaanka badan iyo jawiga oo kugu xumaada ayaa ka mid ah waxyaabaha sidoo kale la sheegay inaad ku garan karto. Mid ka mid ah waxyaabaha loogahortagi karo khuurada iyo xaaladda caafimaad ee sababta ayaa ah in aad badasho qaabka aad u nooshahay. Inaad cayilka iska rido, joojinta cabista sigaarka iyo waxyaalaha lamidka ah iyo joojinta isticmaalka aalkolada ayaa ka mid noqon kara waxyaabaha xalka noqon kara. Balse dadka qaar oo isticmaala mashiin sanka la gashto xilliga ay jiifanayaan oo loogu talagalay in uu nefta socod siiyo ayaa laga yaaba in uu lagama maar,aan noqdo mararka qaar. Mashiinkaan ayaa mararka qaar noqoda mid wata afsaab la galiyo sank aiyo afkaba waxa uuna ka hortagaa neef qabatoonka xilliga jiifka. Daraasad: 'Dawooyinka ay qaatan ragga ee uurka dumarka looga hortaggo waxay soo hoyiyeen guul' Baahida loo qabo kaniiniyada ka hortagga uurka ay ragga qaatan ee aan xiriirka la laheyn hormoonka ayaa laga yaabaa inay soo hooyaan guulo isla markaana horseedaan suurtagalnimada ah inay ka hortaggaan in shahwada ay ku dhex dabbaalato gudaha ilmo galeenka hooyada. Daraasado lagu sameeyay jiir ayaa tilmaamaya in kaniiniga uu xakamaynayo shahwada ugu yaraan dhowr saacadood - si looga hortago in ay gaarto ugxanta. Waxaa la qorsheeyay in baaritaanno iyo tijaabooyin badan lagu sameeyo arrintan, waxaa dawadan la siin doonaa bakeylaha ka hor inta aan lasoo gaarsiin banii'aadanka. Wuxuu qorshaha yahay in baaritaan buuxo lagu ogaado arrintani si loo ogaado waxtarka dawooyinka ragga ka hor istaaga inay wax uureeyaan. Fikradda ayaa ah in ragga ay qaadan karaan kaniiniga saacad ka hor galmada. Si ka duwan kaniiniga ay dumarka qaataan ee ka hortagga uurka, kan ragga kuma lug yeesho wax hormoonno ah. Saynisyahanada waxay sheegeen in tani ay tahay mid ka mid ah faa'iidooyinka kaniiniga oo ay baarayaan - meesha kama saari doono maadada testosterone isla markaana wax saameyn ah kuma yeelan doono yareynta hormoonka ragga. Taa baddalkeeda, "Dabbaasha ay sameyso shahwada" waxay weecisaa inta badan unugyada astaanta ah ee beegsada borotiinka ee loo yaqaanno adenyl cyclase ama sAC, kaniinigan loogu talagalay inay qaataan ragga si aysan wax u uureyn wuxuu xanibayaa maadada SAC. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Daraasad hore oo lagu sameeyay jiirarka, oo ay maalgaliyeen machadyada caafimaadka ee Mareykanka taasoo lagu daabacay joornaalka Nature Communications, hal xabbo oo daawadan ah, oo lagu magacaabo TDI- , ayaa xannibtay dabbaasha shahwada xilliga iyo ka dib galmada. Saameynta dawadan waxay socotay ilaa saddex saacadood. Ilaa saacadoodna, waxay u muuqatay mid gebi ahaanba jirka kasii baaba'ayso. Mid ka mid ah saynisyahannadaas, oo lagu magacaabo Dr. Melanie Balbach oo ka socota machadka Weill Cornell Medicine oo ku yaalla magaalada New York, ayaa sheegtay in kaniinigan si fudud loogu adeegsan karo ka hortagga uurka. Haddii ugu dambeyntii uu kaniinigan wax tar u noqdo banii'aadanka, ragga waxay qaadan karaan mar kasta, waxay go'aan ka gaari karaan xilligga ay wax dhali karaan. Khuburrada waxay ka digeen in dawadan aysan ka hortagin cudurrada lagu kala qaado galmada. Professor Allan Pacey, oo ah barafasoor ku takhasusay cudurada ku dhaca ragga oo ka tirsan Jaamacadda Sheffield, ayaa sheegay: "Waxaa jirta baahi weyn oo loo qabo in la helo kanini ay ragga qaataan oo wax ku ool ah, oo macquul ah, in kasta oo sanadihii lasoo dhaafay la sameeyay baaritaanno dhowr ah oo ku aaddan arrintani, hadana mana jirto daawo lagu guuleystay oo suuqa laga heli karo". "Habka halkan lagu sharraxay, ayaa ah in enzyme-ka muhiimka ah ee shahwada laga saaro, waa fikrad gebi ahaanba cusub. Laakiin Xaqiiqda ah in ay wax ka qaban karto, oo dib loo rogi karo, si dhakhso ah waa mid aad u xiiso badan. "Haddii tijaabooyinkaas lagu sameeyay jiirka si lamid ah loogu sameeyo banii'aadanka lana ogaado waxtarkeeda, waxay dawada noqon kartaa in ragga ay u isticmaalaan inay kaga hortaggaan uurka, waana guul in muddo ah la raadinayay".
Waxaad seegtay wicitaan ka yimid ‎چوہدری‎.

Faransiiska oo ka cabanaya qaadacaadda ay ku sameeyeen qaar ka mid ah dalalka Carabta Dowladda Faransiiska ayaa dalalka Bariga dhexe ugu baaqday inay ka hortagaan dukaamadda iyo ganacsiyada qaadacay alaabaha dalkaas, kadib markii uu Madaxweyne Emmanuel Macron difaacay in la baahiyo sawir lagu tilmaamay Nebi Maxamed NNKH. Wasaaradda arimaha dibedda ee Faransiiska ayaa sheegtay in baaqyada lagu qaadacayo alaabta Faransiiska lagu saleeyay go'aanno runta ka fog, oo ay dabada ka riixayaan dad xagjir ah oo kooban. Alaabaha Faransiiska ayaa laga saaray dukaamo ku yaal Kuawait, Urdun iyo Qatar, halka dibedbaxyo kooban oo Faransiiska ka dhan ah ay ka dhaceen Liibiya, Gaza iyo waqooyiga Suuriya. Fal celintan ayaa waxay salka ku haysaa faallooyin uu bixiyay Mr Macron ka dib dilkii loo geystay macalin Faransiis ah oo sawir gacmeedyo uu muujiyay Nebi Muxamed NNKH, tusay ardaydii fasalka ku jirtay. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in macallinka, oo lagu magacaabo Samuel Paty, "loo dilay sababta oo ah Islaamiyiintu waxay rabaan mustaqbalkeenna", laakiin Faransiisku "kama quusan doono sawir gacmeedyada". Sawiradda Nabi Muxamed NNKH waxay muslimiinta u horseedi kartaa ciqaab culus sababtoo Islaamka wuxuu si cad u mamnuucayaa sawirrada Nabi Muxammad iyo Allaah SW. Laakiin cilmaaniyadda dalka Faransiiska ayaa waxay udub dhexaad u tahay aqoonsiga qaranka Faransiiska. Faransiiska ayaa sheegay in xakamaynta xorriyatul qowlka si loo ilaaliyo dareenka koox gaar ah, ay wiiqayso midnimada dalka. Axadii, Mr Macron wuxuu laba jibaaray difaacidda qiimaha Faransiiska waxa uuna qoraal uu soo dhigay bartiisa Twitterka ku yiri: "Isma dhiibeyno, waligeen." Macluumaadkan waxaa daabacay X. Waxaan dalbanayenaa fasaxaaga ka hor inta aan la furin, waxaa laga yaabaa inay isticmaalayaan cookies iyo farsamooyin kale. hadii aad u bahato akhri X xeerarka cokie iyo kan ku saabsan xogta gaarka ah ka hor inta aadan aqbalin. si aad u aragto xogta guji ‘aqbal oo soco’. Hoggaamiyeyaasha siyaasadeed ee Turkiga iyo Pakistan ayaa ku gacan seyray Mr Macron, iyagoo ku eedeeyay inuusan ixtiraamin "xorriyadda caqiidada" iyo inuu takooray malaayiinta Muslimiinta ah ee ku nool Faransiiska. Axadii, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan ayaa sheegay in Mr Macron uu u baahan yahay "baaritaan dhanka Maskaxda ah. Hadalka Erdogan ayaa horseeday in Faransiiska ay dib ugu yeeraan safiirkooda u fadhiya Turkiga. Qaar ka mid ah goobaha laga dukaameysto ee dalalka Urdun, Qatar iyo Kuwait ayaa ilaa Axaddii laga xayuubiyay alaabtii Faransiiska. Tusaale ahaan timaha macmalka ee lagu sameeyo Faransiiska iyo waxyaabaha la isku qurxiyo. Dalka Kuwait, ururka ganacsiga ee alaabta tafaariiqda ayaa amar ku bixiyay in la qaadaco badeecadaha Faransiiska. Wasaaradda arimaha dibedda ee Faransiiska ayaa sheegtay in baaqyada lagu qaadacayo alaabta Faransiiska lagu saleeyay go'aanno runta ka fog, oo ay dabada ka riixayaan dad xagjir ah oo kooban. Waxaa sidoo kale baraha bulshada dhex-wareegayay baaqyo dhanka online-ka ah oo dalalka Carabta lagu boorrinayo iney iyagana qaadacaan alaabaha Faransiiska.

Soomaaliya ma ka mid tahay dalalka aan looga baahneyn dal-ku-galka Kenya Ka dib markii uu ku dhawaaqay Madaxweyne William Ruto in Kenya ay joojin doonto shuruudihii dal kugalka ee dadka booqanaya Kenya, dhammaan dadka soo gelaya ayaa hadda u baahan doona in ay dalbadaan oggolaanshaha safarka Elektaroonigga ah ee loo soo gaabiyo (ETA) si loo aqoonsado marka ay soo galayaan. ETA-da Kenya waa nidaam otomaatik ah kaas oo go'aaminaya in qofku uu soo geli karo ama soo booqan karo Kenya. Tilmaamo dhowr ah oo ku xusan gudaha bogga ETA, ayaa dhammaan booqdayaasha, oo ay ku jiraan carruurta waxa ay u baahan doonaan arrimahan sida ay sheegtay dawladda Kenya, kuwaasoo inta badan ay kala mid tahay dalalka dunida: Baasaboor shaqaynaya ugu yaraan lix bilood kadib taariikhda la qorsheeyay in ay Kenya ku yimaadaan oo leh ugu yaraan hal bog oo bannaan. Sawirka nooca baasaboorka. Macluumaadka xiriirka sida (cinwaanka emailka ama lambarka taleefanka), faahfaahinta la xiriirta waxa uu daaran yahay safarka, iyo xaqiijinta halka aad ku degi lahayd iyo waxyaabo kale. Waxaa intaa dheer in booqdayaasha qaarkood sidoo kale looga baahan doono in ay caddeeyaan dhaqaale gacan ku qabsi ah oo ay haystaan iyo sidoo kale tikidka laabashada. Baasaboor Diblomaasi ah ayaa looga baahan doonaa dadka u socda safarrada dibloomaasiyadeed iyo warqad rasmi ah oo ka yimid waddankii ay ka yimaadeen. Soo booqdayaasha ayaa lagula taliyay inay soo gudbiyaan codsiyada ugu yaraan maalmood ka hor safarka si wakhti ku filan loogu hubiyo oggolaanshaha. Waxaa xusid mudan in dhammaan dowladaha Bulshada Bariga Afrika ee (EAC) laga reebay barnaamijkan ETA. Hase yeeshee Soomaaliya oo dhawaan ku biirtay ururkan ayaan ka muuqan liiska loo qorsheeyay in ay ka maqnaadaan qorshahan dal-ku-galka, iyadoo u muuqataa in dadka ku soo safraya baasaboorka Soomaaliga looga baahan doono in ay maraan habkan ETA. “Muwaadiniinta Waddamada Iskaashiga Bariga Afrika, Dalalkaas waxaa ka mid ah Burundi, Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, iyo Uganda, ayaa laga reebay barnaamijkan muddo bilood ah”, ayaa lagu xusay bayaanka. Mid ka mid ah shirkadaha ka howlgala arrimaha safarrada ee Soomaaliya ayaan wax ka weydiinnay sida arrintan ay u saameyn karto soomaalida ka soo safreysa Soomaaliya ee doonaya in ay usoo gudbaan Kenya. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. “Barnaamijkan cusub ee ay soo kordhisay dowladda Kenya ee loo yaqaanno ETA, waxa uu gebi ahaanba wax ka beddelay qaabkii safarka ee Kenya lagu tegi jiray, ma saameynayo bulshada bariga Afrika oo Soomaaliya ay dhawaan ku biirtay, laakiin Soomaaliya wuu saameynayaa”, sidaas waxaa yiri Abuukar Dhaqane oo ah milkiilaha shirkadda Dhaqane travel agency oo ka shaqaysa dhoofka la isaga kala goosho Soomaaliya iyo Kenya. “Soomaalida ku soo safraya baasaboorka Soomaaliga ah, waxay u baahan doonaan in ay codsadaan fiisaha ama dal-ku-galka, waana isla sidii hore waxba lagama beddelin” ayuu yiri. Dhaqane ayaa sidoo kale yiri, “Soomaaliya iyo dalal kale sida Afghanistan, Pakistan, iyo Yemen, si gaar ah ayaa loola socdaa baasaboorradooda marka hadda in baasaboorka Soomaaliga ah lagu tago Kenya bilaa fiisa wey adkaan doontaa”. “Soomaaliya waxa ay u baahan tahay in baasaboorka laga bedelo si la mid ah dalalka kale ee bulshada bariga Africa ay ku mideysan yihiin, ka dib ayey ka mid noqon kartaa dalalkaas aan looga baahneyn codsiga dalkugalka” ayuu sii raaciyay Dhaqane. Madaweyne Ruto oo u ololeeya ganacsiga xorta ah ee Afrika ayaa marar badan ka codsaday wadamada Afrika in ay meesha ka saaraan shuruudaha dal ku galka. Tani ayuu Ruto sheegay in ay taageeri doonto aas-aaska aagga Ganacsiga Xorta ah ee Qaaradda Afrika ee loo soo gaabiyo (AfCFTA) kaas oo doonaya in uu abuuro suuq aan xuduud lahayn oo loogu talagalay ganacsiga iyo ganacsatada Afrika. Saraakiisha socdaalka ayaa dhowaan shaaciyay in qaybtii ugu horreysay ee ajaanib ah isla markaana aan dal-ku-gal soo qaadan ay ka degeen Kenya. Xoghayaha guud ee waaxda socdaalka Julius Bitok ayaa sheegay in dadka kasoo dagay garoonka caalamiga ah ee Jomo Kenyatta ay yimaadeen iyagoo isticmaalaya oggolaanshaha safarka ee ETA. Waxa uu sheegay in in ka badan , oo codsi oo dhinaca ETA-da ah la qabtay, iyadoo , la ansixiyay ilaa iyo haatan. Dalka Kenya waxaa ku nool Soomaali badan oo qaarna ay deegaan ahaan u deggan yihiin, qaar kalena meherado ganacsi iyo shaqooyin kala duwan ku haystaan, waana dalka ay Soomaalida ugu badan ee qurbaha ku nool deggan yihiin marka lagu daro kuwa ku jira xeryaha qaxootiga.

Diyaaradaha Tansaaniya ee ku duula shidaalka mootada . Garoonka yar ee Mazimbu ee ku yaalla Morogoro, waxaan goobjoog u ahaa dhacdo dad badan ay ula ekaan lahayd sheeko xariir. Halkaan, koox ka kooban dhalinyaro Tanzaniyaan ah ayaa qaaday tallaabo weyn oo horumar ah, iyaga oo dhisaya diyaarad yar oo ay gacmahooda ku sameeyeen — waana tallaabo weyn oo loo qaaday xilli cusub oo duulimaadyo ah oo Afrika ka bilaabanaya. Markii aan galay garaashkooda yar, waxaan durba maqlay dhawaqa mishiinnada goynaya biraha, dhalinyaro adkaynaya boolal, iyo kuwo kale oo si taxaddar leh u cabbiraya baalasha diyaaradda. Waxaan is iri, "Halkaan waa aduun kale," — waana meel aanan ka filayn bartamaha Morogoro. Halkaan, waxay ku sameynayaan diyaaradaha yar-yar ee Sky Leader iyo Sky Leader oo ah kuwo hal matoor ku shaqeeya oo labo qof qaadi kara. Waxay gaari karaan xawaare dhan kiiloo-mitir saacaddii, waxayna mari karaan masaafo dhan , kiiloo-mitiriyagoo isticmaalaya hal taangi shidaal ah, iyadoo ay u baahan yihiin keliya litir oo baensiin caadi ah. Waxa ugu yaabka badan ayaa ah in diyaaradahaan ay ku degi karaan jidad aad u gaaban oo dhererkoodu yahay mitir — xitaa haddii uu yahay meel cows leh. Paul Ihuya, oo ah wiilka dhalinyarada ah ee ugu horreeyay ee bilaabay mashruucan, ayaa iiga warramay isagoo wajigiisa laga dareemayo farxad iyo xamaasad: "Farxaddii aan dareemay maalintii aan arkay diyaaraddii aan gacmahayga ku sameeyay oo si nabad ah u duushay... ma jiro eray aan ku cabbiro." Su'aasha dad badan is weydiiyaan waa: "Diyaaradahaani ma yihiin kuwo si dhab ah ammaankoodu u suganyahay?" Injineer Lilian Jackson, oo ah farsamayaqaan tayo hubin ah, waxay adkaynaysaa in wax walba loo maray habraacyada caalamiga ah. "Diyaaraddu waa waxa kaliya ee boqolkiiba boqol lagu kalsoonaan karo marka la eego amniga, sidaas darteed waxaan hubinaa in diyaaradaha aanu samaynay yihiin kuwo leh tayo la isku halleyn karo si loo sugo badbaadada loogana hortago shilalka," ayay tiri Lilian. Markii ugu horreysay ee aan raacay diyaaradahan waxaan dareemay cabsi weyn. Gudaha diyaaradda waxaa yaalla kuraas raaxo leh, meel lugaha lagu fidsado, iyo saqafka kore oo galaas ah oo furmaya si aad si cad u aragto cirka. Waxaan fadhiyey anigoo daawanaya duuliyaha Engelbert Sengati oo diyaar garoobaya duulimaad uu igu wareejin doona cirka Morogoro. Wuxuu i siiyey wacyigelintii badbaadada ee caadiga ahayd. Markii ugu horreysay ee aan duulnay, kuna jirnay hawada nus saac, jirkeyga oo dhan wuu gariiray. Ma ahayn wax sahlan. Laakiin markii waqti aan soconay , waxaan arkay in aysan jirin wax farqi weyn ah oo u dhexeeya diyaaradahaan iyo diyaaradaha yaryar ee aan horay u raacay. Waa mid degan, ammaan ah, oo fulisa amar kasta oo uu duuliyuhu bixiyo. Markii aan degay ayaan mar labaad raacay. Markan waxaan is arkay anigoo aad u xiiseynaya… waxaan bilaabay inaan sawiro qaato, duuliyaha la sheekeysto, su'aalo badanna weydiiyo. Wuxuu ii xaqiijiyey in diyaaradahaani ay mareen qiimeyn rasmi ah oo ay ansixiyeen hay'adaha ku shaqada leh, sidoo kalena ay leeyihiin shahaadooyin tayo iyo badbaado. Markaas ayaan si buuxda uga gudbay cabsidii. Waxa ii haray kaliya waa hal dareen oo weyn — waddaniyad. Waxaan iri: "Wooo… tani waa diyaarad Tanzaniyaan ah. Waxaa sameeyey dhalinyaradeena reer Tanzania. Waxaa lagu sameeyey Afrika." Runtii, waxaa I qaaday dareen farxadeed— anoo ku faanaya inaan ahay Tanzaniyaan, xitaa intaa ka sii badan, sharaf aan ku faano inaan Afrikaan ahay. Dadka caadiga ah ee shacabka ah, riyadan weli waa mid la yaab leh. John oo deggan magaalada Tanga ayaa yiri: "Wax yar ayaan la yaabay markii aan maqlay in Tanzaniyiintu ay diyaarad gacmahooda ku sameeyeen. Markii hore ma aan rumaysan. Waxaan moodayay in qalabkii diyaaradda la keenay oo kaliya la isugu xidhay. Laakiin markii aan daawaday muuqaalkii, waan rumaystay — waxaanan arkay in hadda aan halkii saxda ahayd gaarnay." Laakiin weli waxaa jira dad aaney ka dhaadhicin. Safi Ruda oo ka timid magaalada Dar es Salaam ayaa si la yaab leh u tiri: "Tanzaniyiintu diyaarado ma sameyaan? Diyaaradahaas cirka sare u duula? Maya, taas ma rumaysan karo." Hadalladan waxaad ka dareemaysaa sida uu safarku yahay. Waa sheeko ay ka buuxaan yaab, shaki, laakiin sidoo kale rajo cusub iyo qab. Dhallinyaradan, oo aan kaliya tababar gudaha dalkooda ku qaadan balse fursad u helay inay muddo kooban u safraan dalka Czech Republic si ay uga bartaan farsamada gacanta ee dhismaha diyaaradaha, ayaa durba dhisay diyaaradood, shan ka mid ahna si buuxda ayay u shaqeeyaan. Waxay sheegayaan in haddii ay heli lahaayeen dhammaan qalabkii iyo agabkii loo baahnaa, ay diyaar u ahaan lahaayeen inay hal diyaarad sameeyaan bil kasta, iyaga oo adeegsanaya shirkaddooda yar ee la yiraahdo Airplanes Africa. Paul Ihuya ayaa sharraxaya hammigooda mustaqbalka: "Waxaan rabnaa inaan meel dheer gaarno. Ma rabno oo kaliya in nala yaqaan in diyaarado yar yar dhisno. Hadafkeennu waa inaan dhisno diyaarado rakaab oo waaweyn, si aan u muujinno in Tanzania ay noqon karto xarunta diyaaradaha ee Afrika." Iyadoo adduunka intiisa badani maanta ka hadlayo doorka dhallinyarada iyo hal-abuurka ee Afrika, sheekada Mazimbu waxay iftiiminaysaa suurtagalnimada haddii fursad la helo in wax badan la smaeyn karo. Runtii, Mazimbu oo ku taal gobolka Morogoro, waxaad oran kartaa waa halka ay riyooyinka -kan dhallinyaro ahi cirka ku bexeen. Tani ma aha oo keliya sheeko diyaaradeed — waa sheekada jiil cusub oo aaminsan in wax walba suurta gal yihiin. Waa aqoon cusub oo cirka la xiriirta oo dhalatay, xilli safarkii riyooyinkuna uu weli bilow yahay.

Yaan ka garanay cashadii Cirro kula kulmay wiilka Trump iyo madaxweynaha Israa'iil? . Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) ayaa kulan casho-sharaf oo gaar ah kula yeeshay madaxweynaha Israel Isaac Herzog, is-arag ka dhacay magaalada Davos, oo uu ka socdo shirweynaha Dhaqaalaha Adduunka (WEF). Madaxweyne Herzog ayaa sheegay inuu soo dhoweynayo dhismaha xidhiidh diblomaasiyadeed oo u dhexeeya labada dhinac, isla markaana uu rajeynayo in la xoojiyo iskaashiga labada dal si ay uga faa'iidaystaan labada shacab. Qoraal uu ku daabacay Facebook-ga, Madaxweyne Cirro wuxuu sheegay in cashada ay ka soo qayb-galeen siyaasiyiin culus iyo hoggaamiyeyaal ganacsi oo caalami ah, kuwaas oo uu ka mid yahay Eric Trump, wiilka madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump. Eric Trump ayaa ka hor cashada ka qayb-galay kulan kale oo gaar ah oo ay martigelisay isla madasha Davos Lodge, kaas oo cinwaankiisu ahaa Isbeddellada Caalamiga ah iyo Fursadaha Suuqyada Horumaray. Inkasta oo uusan ahayn mas'uul dowladeed, Eric Trump waa Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Fulinta ee ururka qoyska Trump, isla markaana madaxweynaha Mareykanka waxyaabo badan kala taliya. Liiska buuxa ee martida si rasmi ah looma shaacin. Kulanku wuxuu ahaa mid martiqaad kaliya lagu galayay, oo qabanqaabiyeyaasha ayaa dad gaar ah casuumayay kuwaas oo aysan shaacin. Laakiin BBC Somali ayaa gaarkeeda u fiirisay sawirrada uu Madaxweyne Cirro la wadaagay bulshada, waxaana ka aqoonsanay magacyo waaweyn oo cashada joogay, anagoo kaashaynaa, xogta khadka ku jirta, aaladaha aqoonsi wajiyeedka iyo keydka munaasabada oo qeyb kamid ah martidu cinwaanadooda gaarka ah soo galiyeen. Mas'uuliyiinta ugu sarreeya ee aanu xaqiijinay waxaa ka mid ahaa Nir Barkat, Wasiirka Dhaqaalaha iyo Warshadaha ee Israel. Waa xubin ka tirsan golaha wasiirrada, horeyna u soo noqday duqa magaalada Qudus, isaga oo door muhiim ah ka ciyaara diblomaasiyadda dhaqaale ee Israel iyo xiriirka ay la leedahay maalgashadayaasha caalamiga ah. Waxaa sidoo kale cashada joogay hoggaamiyeyaal ganacsi oo caalami ah. Margarita Louis-Dreyfus, Guddoomiyaha shirkadda Louis Dreyfus Group, ayaa ka mid ahayd dadka goobta joogay. Shirkaddeedu waa mid ka mid ah kuwa ugu waaweyn ganacsiga badeecadaha caalamka, iyadoo ka shaqaysa beeraha, tamarta iyo gaadiidka caalamiga ah. Luděk Sekyra, oo ah maalqabeen Czech ah kuna lug leh hantida maguurtada ah, kaabayaasha iyo samafalka, ayaa sidoo kale aanu ka aqoonsanay sawirrada. Waa shakhsiyad si weyn looga yaqaan suuqyada maalgashiga Yurub. Sidoo kale waxaa goobta lagu arkay Evangelos Marinakis, oo ah maalqabeen Giriig ah kuna xeel dheer maraakiibta iyo gaadiidka tamarta,sidoo kalena ah mulkiilaha naadiga horyaalka Ingiriiska ka ciyaara ee Nottingham Forest. Iyo John S. Koudounis, Madaxweynaha iyo Agaasimaha Guud ee shirkadda maalgashiga Maraykanka ee Calamos Investments. Dadka kale ee laga aqoonsaday sawirrada waxaa ka mid ahaa Rainer Schorr, oo ah aasaasaha iyo guddoomiyaha shirkadda hantida maguurtada ah ee Standard Land SA; iyo Nadav Sarfir, oo ah masuul ka tirsan waaxda tiknoolajiyadda iyo hal-abuurka ee Israel. Cashadan waxay ka mid ahayd barnaamij ballaaran oo ay martigelisay Greek House Davos, taas oo ay hoggaaminayso Eirini Vantaraki. Vantaraki ayaa Greek House ku qeexday madal diiradda saarta kulammo gaar ah oo albaabadu u xiran yihiin, iyada oo sheegtay in Davos ay ka guurayso doodaha fagaareyaasha una wareegayso kulammo gaar ah oo ay isugu yimaadaan awoodda siyaasadeed, raasamaalka iyo danaha istiraatiijiga ah. Maadaama cashadu ahayd mid gaar ah oo martiqaad ku kooban, suurtagal ma aha in la xaqiijiyo dhammaan dadkii ka soo qayb-galay ama faahfaahinta waxa laga wada hadlay. Waxa la hubo ayaa ah in cashadu ay isu keentay mas'uuliyiin sare oo Israeli ah, shaqsiyaad si dhow ula xiriira awoodda siyaasadeed ee Maraykanka, iyo maalqabeenno caalami ah, dhammaantoodna ku kulmay jawi si gaar ah loo habeeyay oo ku dhisnaa qarsoodi iyo taxaddar. In kulankan ay joogto Somaliland, oo aan weli aqoonsi caalami ah helin, marka laga reebo kii Israa'iil, waxay muujinaysaa muhiimadda diblomaasiyadeed ee israa'iil u leedahay Somaliland, xilli ay isku arkayaan xitaa meelo ka baxsan kulamada rasmiga ah ee Davos ka socda.

BBC-da oo fashilisay madaxa ka ganacsiga galmada ee Dubai Digniin: Waxa ku jira qoraalka waxyaabo naxdin leh iyo sharraxaadyo sawirro leh oo ficillo galmo ah Baadhitaan ay samaysay BBC ayaa lagu ogaaday nin maamulayay shabakad galmo oo ka dhex shaqaynaysay xaafadaha ugu quruxda badan Dubai, isla markaana ka faa'iidaysanayey haween dhibban. Charles Mwesigwa, oo sheegay in uu yahay darawal hore oo bas ku wadi jiray London ayaa u sheegay weriyahayaga qarsoon in uu haween keeni karo xaflad galmo oo qiimihedu ka bilaabanayso $ , (£ ), isaga oo intaas ku daray in qaar badan ay samayn karaan "badi wax kasta" oo macaamiishoodu ka doonayaan. Warar xan ah oo ku saabsan xafladaha galmada ee Imaaradka Carabta ayaa soo soo jiitamayay sannado badan. Weedha #Dubaiportapotty ayaa la sheegay in in ka badan milyan oo jeer laga daawaday TikTok. Waxa halkaas ku jira sheekooyin mala-awaal ah oo ku saabsan haween lagu eedeeyay in ay yihiin kuwo lacag ka sameeya galmada. Garaadka macmalka (AI) oo ka badiyay ardayda sida caadiga u qora imtixaanada iyo curisyada Imtixaano jamacadeed oo laga qaaday arday aan jirin iyadoo la adeegsanayo garaadka macmalka ayaa la ogaaday in ay ka wanaagsanaadeen kuwa saxda u galay imtixaanka. Sidoo kale waxaa la ogaaday in aysan soo qaban aaladaha kale ee lagu hubiyo in mashiin uu qoray qoraalka sidaasina waxaa lagu ogaaday cilmi baaris kooban oo la sameeyay. Cilmi baarayaal ka tirsan Jaamacadda Reading ee UK ayaa sameeyay arday oo aan jirin, waxayna adeegsadeen garaadka macmalka ee ChatGPT, kaas oo ay ku sameeyeen jawaabaha su’aalaha imtixaanka arday jaamacadeed oo dhiganeysay psychology, ama cilmu nafsiga. Waxay sheegeen in ardayda isticmaashay garaadka macmalka natiijadooda ay ka sarreeyeen celceliska kuwa sida saxda u galay imtixaanka. Sagaashan boqolkiiba qoraalada AI lagu sameeyay uma suuragalin in ay ogaadaan kuwa saxayay imtixaanka. , Urbe university Daraasad lagu dabaacay wargeyska Plos One ayaa lagu sheegay in lix boqolkiiba in la qabto ay tahay wax yar. “Arintan waa mid welwel leh maadaama qoraalada garaadka macmalka lagu sameeyay ay helayaan darajooyin ka badan kuwa ardayda ay caadi u qoreen”. Ardayda haddii ay isticmaalaan AI waxay heli karaan darajo ka sarreysa marka ay sida caadiga ah wax u qoraan. Prof. Peter Scarfe iyo Prof Etienne Roesch oo daraasaddan horkacayay ayaa sheegay in waxa ay ogaadeen ay digniin u tahay aqoonyahanada adduunka oo dhan. Dr Scarfe waxa uu sheegay in jaamacado badan ay ka guureen habkii caadiga ah ee imtixaanada loo gali jiray si qiimeynta u noqoto mid loo dhan yahay. “Kuma noqoneyno imtixaanadii gacanta lagu qorayay balse adduunka waxa loo baahan yahay in ay la jaanqaadaan garaadka macmalka”. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Cilmi baarista marka hore waxaa la sameeyay in itixmaanada iyo cursiyada beenta ah aan loo sheegin kuwa saxayay habka itixmaanka lagu soo sameeyay. Ardayda gacan ku sameyska aheyd ee garaadka macmalka ayaa ka badiyay kuwa sida saxda ah u sameeyay imtixaanka iyo curisyada. Qoraallada waxay ahaayeen sanadaha hore ee jaamacadaha. Garaadka macamalka ah waxa ay awoodiisa yaraatay marka la gaaray sanadka saddexaad. Dadka caadiga ah ayaa taas ku fiicnaaday. AI marka ay timaado garaadka iyo fakarka waa meelaha aysan ku wanaagsaneyn oo ay ku guuldareystay. Aqoonyahannada waxay walaac ka muujiyeen saameynta ay AI ku leedahay waxbarashada. Horaantii sanadkan wargeyska The Guardian waxa uu sheegay in cilmi baaris lagu ogaaday in badi ardayda shahaadada koowaad jaamacadda ku jirta in ay isticmaaleen barnaamijiyada garaadka macmalka si ay kaalmo ugu helaan curisyada ay qorayaan. Shan boqolkiiba ayaa qirtay in ay isticmaaleen qoraalada AI lagu sameeyay oo aan waxba laga beddelin markii ay gudbinayeen qoraalkooda. Taa ka sokow, garaadka macmalka wuxuu iminka shaqaalaha ka caawiyaa shaqooyinkooda, ayadoo meelaha qaar la bilaabay in AI uu maamule u noqdo shaqaale bani'aadmi ah. Maamulaha AI wuxuu caawinayey shaqaalaha shirkadda Student marketing agency oo ah goob ay ka shaqeeyaan ardayda jaamacadaha si ay u siiyaan taageero suuqgeyn ganacsiyada yaryar, kuwaas oo saacado ladifan ka soo shaqeeya meelo fog fog, wuxuuna gacan ka siiyaa sida ay u dejisan lahaayeen jadwalkooda oo ay u qorsheyn lahaayeen culeyska shaqadooda goor hore. Aaladdan waxay hubisaa ilaalinta wakhtiga, waxay u dirtaa xasuusinta kama dambays ah iyo fariimaha joogtada ah, waxayna diiwaangelisaa wakhtiga lagu qaatay macaamiil kala duwan, si tan dambe si sax ah loogu dallici karo qaansheegashada. AI waxa kale oo ay soo jeedinaysaa talooyinka lagu hagaajinayo ereyada qoraalka qoran, waxay diyaar u yihiin inay ka jawaabaan su'aalaha la xiriira shaqada, waxayna aaladdan si toos ah u cusbooneysiisaa qof kasta horumarkiisa.

Sidaas oo kale Bareceona waxay la timid magacyo caan ah sida Ronaldinho oo Brazil ah, Samuel Eto'o oo Cameroon ka soo jeeda, Thierry Henry oo Faransiis ah, iyo Yaya Touré oo Ivory Coast ah Labada xiddig ee shiday El-Clásico isla markaana kaalinta kowaad ka galay tartamada kubbada cagta aduunka ayaa kala ahaa Cristiano Ronaldo oo Portugal u dhashay iyo Lionel Messi oo Argentina u dhashay, kuwaas oo ku kala guulaystay abaal marinta Ballon d'Or wakhtigoodii Real Madrid iyo Barcelona., taasoo ka qayb qaadatay ballaarinta xiisaha caalamiga ah ee lagu daawado labada koox. Ciyaartoyda kale ee sidoo kale ee shiday iyagu waxaa ka mid ahaa Xavi Hernandez, Andres Iniesta, Gerard Pique, Sergio Ramos, Lukas Modric, iyo Karim Benzema. Ciyaartii El Clásico ee ugu daawashada badnayd ayaa la rumeysan yahay inay dhacday -kii Abriil, , iyadoo laga baahiyay in ka badan wadan iyada oo ay adeegsadeen in ka badan idaacado caalami ah oo xuquuqda ka haysta Horyaalka Kubadda Cagta Spain (La Liga), taasoo gaartay qiyaastii milyan oo qof. Labada kooxood ayaa ciyaaray kulan oo El Clasico tartamada oo dhan ah tan iyo markii la aasaasay horyaalka La Liga, iyadoo Real Madrid ay badisay ka mid ah, Barcelona , iyo barbaro. Guushii ugu weyneyd ee taariikhda El Clásico waa guushii Real Madrid ay - kaga badisay Barcelona bishii June , , magaalada Madrid. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, natiijadii ciyaartan ayaa weli ah mid muran siyaasadeed oo aad u weyni ka taagan tahay, iyadoo lagu eedeeyay faragalin siyaasadeed kaligii taliyihii Francisco Franco oo xilligaasi xukumayay Spain, kaddib markii uu afgambi milateri ku qaaday dowladdii bidixda ee la doortay, si uu u xaqiijiyo in ciyaartu ay sidaas ku dhammaato. Si aan u diiwaan geliyo wixii dhacay maalintaas, qoraaga British-ka ah ee Sid Lowe ayaa ka wareystay Fernando Argilla, oo ahaa ciyaaryahankii ugu dambeeyay ee nool ee ka qaybqaata ciyaarta, buug uu daabacay . Argilla ayaa u sheegay inuu ciyaarta ka daawaday kursiga keydka, maadaama uu ahaa goolhayaha Barcelona ee bedelka ku soo galay. Waxa uu intaa ku daray inuu xasuusto sarkaal ka tirsan dawladda oo booqday qolka labiska ka hor ciyaarta: "Nin booliis ah, gaashaanle, ma aqaano, laga yaabee inay ka tirsan yihiin Ilaalada Madaniga ah." Hadda El Clásico, waxaa mar kale xiiso u yeellay xiddiga kooxda Real Madrid kaga soo biiray Paris Saint-Germain Kylian Mbappé iyo mar la raga kooxda Barcelona ka soo baxay Lamine Yamal. Labadooda Lamine Yamal iyo Kylian Mbappé, ayaa iska horyimid siddeed jeer oo laba ka mid ah ay yihiin Qaramada.

Fayraska korona: 'Waan ku qasbannahay in aan daawano bukaanka oo dhimanaya maalin walaba' Waxa jiro "dhibaato sii kordhaya" oo ah ogsajiin la'aan ba'an oo ka jirta dalalka aadka saboolka u ah, oo keenaysa dhimasho laga baaqsan karo, ayey ka digeen wakaaladaha caafimaadka iyo xirafadleyaashu. khubaradu waxay sheegeen in dalalka dakhligoodu hooseeyo ay aad u saameysay ogsijiin la'aanta, sababtuna tahay in goobaha asaasiga ah ee soo saara ogsajiinta oo aanba jirin iyo in aanay helin tallaalka cudurka ama wax koobani ka gaadhay iyada oo tirada dadka uu ku dhacaya ay sii kordhayso. Every Breath Counts, oo ah urur ay ku bahoobeen dad u ololeeyaha caafmaadka oo heer caalami ah, oo doonaya in la hagaajiyo wax soo saarka ogsajiinta dalalka dakhilooda uu hooseeyo, ayaa sheegay in ka mid ah dalalkaas ay haatan haysato ogsajiin yaraan, badankooduna waxay ku yaallaan Afrika. Jesssica Winn oo ka sitran Save the Children ayaa tidhi: "baahida ogsajiinta ee dalalka aad bay u badan tahay degdegna way tahay. waxa jira duruuf ka sii daraysa". Ma jirto xog rasmi ah oo la hayo oo muujinaysa korodhka dhimashada laga hortagi karo. Laakiin daraasad lagu baahiyey bishii hore, wargeyska Lancet, ayaa lagu sheegaysa in dad ka badan kala badh bukaannada uu Covid ku dhacay ay ku dhintay isbitaal oo ku yaal dal oo Afrikaan ah, aanan la siin ogsajiin. BBC-da ayaa la hadashay qaar ka mid ah dadka ku nool wadamadaa dakhligooda uu hooseeyo ee ay saamaysay ogsajiin yaraanta la sheegay. , Dr. Jama Mahamud Dr Jaamac Cabdi Maxamuud, wuxu yidhi isaga iyo kooxdiisa isbitaalka guud ee Qardho in culays badani haysto. "Waxaanu aragnay inta u dhaxaysa shan ilaa toban bukaan oo Covid uu ku dhacay oo u dhammaanaya ogsajiin la'aan, maalin walba, waana arrin xanuun badan," ayuuyiri. "Kuwaasi waxay noqon lahaayeen dhimasho laga hortagi karo haddii aanu haysan lahayn ogsajiin nagu filan". Sida ay sheegtay hay'ada Caafimaadka adduunka ee WHO, illaa in ay Soomaaliya ugu dhinteen Coronavirus, illaa -kii June. Waxaana dalka oo dhan laga soo sheegay , xaaladood oo cudurkan ah. Xirfadleyaasha caafimaadka ayaa sheegay in tiradu ka badan tahay intaa, sababtoo ah, ma jiro qaab haboon oo lagu diiwaan geliyo geerida ka dhacda tuulooyinka. "Bukaannada Covid badankooda waxay ku dhintaan wadada, inta lagu sii waday isbitaallada u jira boqollaalka kiiloomitir. Sababta oo ah isbitaalada yaryari ma hayaan ogsajiin," ayuu yidhi Dr Joseph Sriki oo ah sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan hay'adda Save the Children oo Muqdisho ku sugan. "Dadka jooga meelaha qaar sida Somaliland iyo Puntland, waxay u dhimanayaan ogsajiin la'aan, in kasta oo tirada dhimashada ay hoos u dhacday marka la barbardhigo bishii February iyo March. Xilligaas waxaa Soomaaliya ka jiray mawjada labaad," ayay tidhi Dr Ubax Faarax Axmed, oo ah agaasimaha waaxda caafimaadka qoyska ee wasaarada caafimaadka federaalka. "Isbitaallada dowlada ay maamusho ma lahan wershad ogsajiin. Waxaa jiro saddex isbitaal oo gaar ah oo ku yaal magaalo madaxda Muqdisho oo leh qalabkan. Balse anigoo taakulo ka heleynay hay'adaha gargaarka qaarkood, waxaanu dhawaan isbitalada dawlada qaarkood ka dhisi doonaa goobo ogsajiin laga helo". Sawirka, Deepak Chapagain Tikaram Chapagain oo ah saajin hawl gab oo militariga ka tirsanaan jiray, oo ku nool degmada galbeedka Nepal ee Kailali, ayaa laga helay Covid May. heerka ogsajiinta ee jidhkiisa ayaa hoos ugu dhacday, waxayna hoos u dhacday %, markii dalka ay mawjado labadaad ee Covid- ah ay ka bilowdeen, halkii ugu saraysay ay maraysay. Heerka caadiga ah ee ogsajiinta waa inta u dhaxaysa % ilaa % marka lagu cabiro qalabka pulse oximeter. "Waxaanu u qaadnay sadex isbitaal oo gaara, laakiin midna ogsajiin ma hayn," ayuu yidhi walaalkii Prem Chapagain. "Waxaanu haddana tagnay isbtaal dawladeed oo berendaha la jiifiyey madaama ay sariirha wada buuxeen". Si ogsajiin loo helo qoyska iyo saaxiibadu in ay safaf dhaahdeer u galeen goobta laga buuxiyo haama ayay noqotay. "Walaalkay waxaa dhibayay neef la'aan oo wuxuu u baahnaa ogsajiin badan. Waxaanu ka fikirnay in aan u qaadno Kathmandu, laakiin waxaanu ogayn in ay ka jirto ogsajiin yaraan badani. "Walaalkay wuxuu yidhi 'kama halayno ogsajiin meel dhibaato ka jirto, markaa ma jirto sabab aan u sii raadinaaba. Aan iska dhintee i daa'. sida dhagaxa ayuu u adkaa. ma rumaysan karo inuu dhintay." "Ogsajiin la'aanta waa dhibaato weyn oo keentay dhimasho badan, ka dib markii ay billowdeen mowjadihii labaad," ayuu yidhi Dr Samir Adhikari oo ah xarunta hawlaha degdega ah ee caafimaad ee wax ka qabashada covid. Sawirka, Estefania Rejala Markii uu hoos u dhacday heerka neefsiga ee Rejala, May, ninkaas oo sano jir ahaa qoyskiisa waxay bilaabeen in ay ogsajiin u raadiyaan. "Qalabka neefta meelna waan uga heli waynay," ayay tidhi walaashii Estefanie Rejala. "Waxaan isku daynay laba isbitaal laakiin midkooda in la dhigo wuu diiday. "Heerka ogsajiintiisu waxay hoos ugu dhacday % iyo %, laakiin qof buka uma eekayn bukaan badan oo ku jiray goobta sugitaanka isbitaal kasta. Dadka dhimashada qarka u saaran uun baa la ogolaa in la dhigo". Subaxii xigay, waxaa sii xumaatay xaaladdii Rejala isagoo ku jiray isbitaal ku yaal magaalo madaxda Paraguay oo loo qaaday. "Xanuunka hayey ayaa dhibayey oo wuu qaylinayey. Dhakhaatiirta ayaa baryey in ay u helaan ogsajiin oo ay dhigaan qolka daryeelka dadka liita, laakiin waxay ii sheegeen in aanay waxba qaban karin". Waxoogaa yar ka dib ayuu Rejala dhacay oo uu dhintay. In kasta oo sheekooyinkaas la sheegay, haddana xukuumadda Paraguay waxay sheegtay in aanay dhibaato jirin. "Baahida qalabka neefta waxay kor u kacday %. Wax soo saarka dalka gudihiisuna wuu kaafiyaa illaa %, inta kalena waanu soo dejinsanaa", ayuu yidhi agaasima guud ee wasaarada caafimaadka, Dr Derlis Leon. Wuu beeniyey in bukaan dhinta gaar ahaan neef la'aan. Tirada la xaqiijiyey dadka uu ku dhacay Covid- ee Paraguay ilaa June waxay ahayd , oo qof, waxaana dhintay in kala badh ka badan, labadii bilood ee la soo dhaafay. Khubarada caafimaadku waxay sheegeen in dalal badan oo dakhiligooda uu hooseeyo in aanay haysanin wershadaha soo saara ogsajiinta ganacsiga ah ka yareyn kara culayska isbitaalada. "Dhibaadata taagani waxay ahayd barta aan la arkayn ee ka dahsoon beesha caafimaadka caalamka," ayuu yidhi Leith Greensdale, oo ka tirsan Every Breath Counts. Wakaaladaha Maaliyada dunida sida Global Fund, ayaa sheegay in ay haatan dardar galinayaan sidii ay u maalgelin lahaayeen in ay qalabka neefta helaan dalalka dakhilijoogda uu hooseeyo.

Muxuu yahay xanuunka ka dillaacay Uganda ee sababay inay mamnuucdo hilibka? Waaxda xayawaannada ee Uganda ayaa la sheegay inay caasimadda Kampala ka mamnuuceen iibka hilibka, tallaabadan oo qeyb ka ah xayiraado wax looga qabanayo xanuunka kudka oo ka dillaacay halkaas, kaasoo saameynaya xayawaannada. "Kala gudbinta lo’da, ariga, idaha, doofaarka iyo manaafacaadka hilibkooda, iyadoo la marsiinayo Kampala amaba gudaheeda, waa mamnuuc ilaa amar dambe," ayaa lagu yiri qoraal ka soo baxay Wasaaradda Beeraha, Xoolaha iyo Kalluumeysiga. "Suuqyada xoolaha, meelaha lagu gowraco, oo ay ku jiraan halka hilibka lagu iibiyo, iyo meelaha lagu soo bandhigo xoolaha ee guud ahaan degmada ayaa degdeg loo xiray." Warqaddan ayaa ku asteysan March balse waxay waaxaha Kampala heleen shalay oo Khamiis ah, sida lagu sheegay warar uu daabacay wargeyska gaarka loo leeyahay ee Daily Monitor. Sarkaal maamulka magaalada ka tirsan ayaa wargeyska u sheegay inay la shaqeyn doonaan hay’adaha kale si ay u hirgeliyaan tallaabooyinka karatiinka, balse warbaahinta gudaha ayaa sheegaya in dukaamada magaalada ee hilibka lagu iibiyo ay weli shaqeynayaan. Xanuunkan oo aad u faafa kuna dhaca afka iyo cagaha ayaa sababa qandho iyo nabro biyo wata oo xanuun badan oo gudaha afka kasoo baxa, xoolahana way u dhiman karaan. Xanuunkan kudka ayaa ah mid aad u faafa oo ay sababto bakteeriyo, wuxuuna ku dhacaa xoolaha balse wuu u gudbi karaa bani'aadamka. Sida laga soo xigtay Waaxda Xakameynta Cudurrada iyo Kahortagga, kudku waa cudur halis ah oo aad u faafa, waxaana sababta bakteeriyada Bacillus anthracis. Wuxuu xoolaha usoo raacaa ciidda, isaga oo saameeya xoolaha la dhaqdo iyo waliba duurjoogta. Xanuunkan kudka ayay dadka iyo xoolaha uu ku dhacaba u jirradaan. Muxuu yahay macmacaanka dhimashada madow ee adduunka laga hadal hayo? , Underrated Hijabi Nacnaca loo yaqaanno ‘dhimashada madow’ ayaa hadal heyn weyn ka dhex dhaliyay baraha bulshada ee caalamka iyadoo lagu tilmaamay mac macaankii ugu dhanaanaa abid isla markaana lagu sameeyay waxyaabo xooggan oo la xiriira aashito. Sheekada nuxurka leh ee ku duugan nacnacan ayaa ah in uu qof kasta doonayo inuu tijaabiyo dhadhan ahaan iyo ur ahaan intaba, adduunka oo dhan goobaha ganacsiga ayaa laga baadi goobayaa iyadoo tiradii ugu badneyn ay iibsadeen maalmo gudeheed. Nacnacan oo midab ahaan madow isla markaana leh dhibco cad cad oo u eg sonkorta ayaa ka sameysan waxyaabo aad u dhanaan iyo aashito saami ahaan xooggan, dadka tijaabiyay ee muuqaallada kusoo bandhigay tijaabadooda ayaa markiiba soo tufayay iyagoo u muuqday in ay awoodi waayeen in ay afka kusii hayaan. Waxaa ku qoran digniino muujinaya in cid kasta ay istcimaali karin, waxaa kamida carruurta ay da’doodu ka yartahay siddeedda sano in aan loo oggoleyn. Ku dhawaad labaatan ilbiriqsi ayey dadku ku dareemi karaan dhadhanka saxda ah ee nacnaca, muddadaasi gaaban kadib waxaa la’isku raacay in qofku uusan xamili karin in uu afka kusii hayo. Digniin ku taalla warqadda kore ee nacnaca ayaa sidoo kale in cunista xad-dhaafka ah ee waqti gaaban gudaheed ay keeni karto saameyn qofku uu ku yeesho in ay dabeecadda qofka beddeli karto ama caloosha ay kicin karto. Mid kamida dadkii sameeyay tijaabada isla markaana muuqaalkeeda uu yeeshay saameynta ugu badan ayaa ah gabadh Soomaaliyeed oo muuqaalkeedu uu noqday ka nugu hadal heynta badan adduunka lana xiriirira nacnaca ‘dhimashada madow’. Gabadhan oo mageceeda saxda ah aan kusoo gelin baraha bulshada ayaa sameysay tijaabo cajiib ah isla markaana dad badan cabsi gelisay. Waxa dhinaca TikTok-gga ay ku leedahay taageerayaal gaaraya illaa milyan oo iyada raacsan iyo kun oo dhinaca Instagram-ka ah. Waxa ay kusoo gashaa magaca Underrated Hijabi, waxa ayna ku nooshahay UK. Muuqaalka ay soo duubtay ee tijaabada nacnaca ayaa waxaa daawaday in ka badan milyan oo ruux. "Weligay ma isku dayin wax ka dhanaan badan nacnacan," iyada oo dalbatay in la shaacin mageceeda dhabta ah ayey sidaasi u sheegtay warbaahinta the post. Xilliga ay afka gelisay nacnaca ayey uga falcelisay si adag oo dadka qaar i arkeen ka badbadin, halka kuwa kale u arkeen mid nadin leh. Sawirka, ReuBekah Vidz Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Balse dhanaanka iyo aashatada saa’idka ah ee macmacaanka dhimashada madow ayaa sababi kara falcelinta gabadhaan ay sameysay oo kale, kaas oo ayisku garaacday kursiga gaarig ay saarneed, halkaas oo ay si joogto ah ugu duubto muuqaalladeeda tijaabooyinka ee ay duubto. Waxaan isku dayay 'nacnac adduunka ugu dhanaan' oo loo yaqaan 'dhimashada madow' waan ooyay oo dadku waxay igu yiraahdeen waxaad u ekeyd in ay wax kale ku haystaan” ayey sii raacisay. Waxay ku billowday digniin iyo in cabsi ay ka qabto nacnacan, iyadoo ka digtay in macmacaanka 'cabsida' ah uusan ahayn inuu isku dayo qof 'kayar siddeed jir', ka hor intaysan si taxadar leh mid ka mid ah afka u gelin. Macmacaankan loo yaqaanno dhimashada Madow ee Mega Sours waxa uu qiimo ahaan ku kacayaa £ . halkii bac oo 200g ah. Dad badan oo isugu jira Soomaali iyo ajaanib ayaa sameeyay tijaabada nacnacan, walow aaney ka bixin fal celin ku sida sida gabadhaan, balse waxa ay dhammaantood qireen in nacnacan uu yahay mid aad u dhanaan una kulul waqti badanna aan afka lagu heyn karin.

Guidance: Racist Language (including Racial Slurs and Racist/Ethnic Abuse) Warning: this guidance contains language which may cause offence. Racist language by its very nature is offensive, derogatory, and hurtful. Its effect will depend on the choice of words, the speaker and the context. Different words cause different degrees of offence in different communities as well as in different parts of the world. Ofcom research in showed[ ] that discriminatory language is of concern to audiences. Racist language, like other strong language, is most likely to cause offence when used gratuitously, in a discriminatory way, and without clear editorial purpose. The use of racist language must be editorially justified, and signposted, to ensure it meets audience expectations, wherever it appears. Meeting audience expectations does not preclude causing offence, but there must be exceptional editorial reasons to use the strongest racist terms. Although this guidance is about racist language, the same principles apply to racist gestures. An updated list of racist language in the UK is available from the Ofcom research Public attitudes towards offensive language on TV and radio: Quick Reference Guide.[ ] For the purpose of this guidance, all words classified as "strong" will be covered by this guidance. All words in Ofcom's "strong" category for racist language will be a mandatory reference (to the relevant Divisional Director or their named delegate. The words which require a mandatory reference are: ching chong; chinky; coon; darky; gippo; golliwog; golly; half-caste; jungle bunny; kike; negro; nigger; nig-nog; paki; pikey; raghead; sambo; spade; spic; uncle tom; wog; yid. Ofcom's research states that: Audiences told us that, although they want broadcasters to give careful consideration to when and how offensive language is used on TV and radio, they stressed the important role it can play in broadcasting. When it comes to issues around race, the report states: Viewers and listeners said they expect broadcasters to take the utmost care to carefully contextualise the strongest forms of discriminatory language to ensure that audiences are protected. At the BBC, the guidance since has been that using the strongest racist language even where the intention might be to expose or condemn discrimination is not in itself sufficient editorial justification. Justification for the use of strong[ ] racist language requires that there must be a specific editorial reason why it should be used, for instance, where it might make a difference to audience understanding, or for particular reasons of clarity, or where a contributor is talking about their own personal experience, or where a term might be seen to have been "reclaimed", or in history programmes, or comedy, drama, arts or music, especially with regard to freedom of expression. The editorial justification test carries a presumption that such language will not normally be used unless, for exceptional editorial reasons, there is a judgement – at Divisional Director (or their named delegate) level – that it should be used because of the specific context. Any re-use in another context (for instance at a different time or on a different channel or on On Demand services) would require a new and separate consideration of the editorial justification. This also applies to cut-downs for social media purposes. (See Editorial Guidelines Section – Harm and Offence . . - . . ) When re-using archive content – written and broadcast – reflecting standards of the day is no longer, in itself, sufficient justification. Editorial judgement needs to be applied, including looking at purpose and context – and if the language is deemed to be gratuitous, it should be removed. (See Editorial Guidelines Section – Use of BBC Content after Publication or Broadcast . . ) The Ofcom Broadcasting Code does not permit certain offensive swear words and their derivatives to be used before the TV watershed, 9pm. Ofcom has not placed the same restriction on the use of strong racist language though it makes clear it is unacceptable to many without clear and strong contextual justification. At the BBC, the use of strong racist language should never be gratuitous or used simply for effect. It requires serious editorial purpose. Strong racist language should only be used on television before the watershed if there is clear and strong contextual justification and provided this has been signed off by the Divisional Director or their named delegate. The watershed does not exist for Radio and Online/Digital. In Radio, considerations such as the likely audience, the remit and audience expectations of the station, the type of output played, and the person presenting the programme are all key considerations when deciding whether to play such language. For online/digital it is important that audiences have control over what they see and are alerted to any content they may find offensive. Considerations include: does the word have to be used in its entirety, is there another way of conveying what has happened, what is the editorial justification and, especially in the case of cut down versions for social media, is there sufficient context? The Divisional Director or their named delegate must be made aware of and agree its use. The following questions can help determine whether content will be within the expectations of the audience: The pre-meditated use of racist language will always be signposted whether on TV, radio or online/digital. It is important that audiences are not taken by surprise and have sufficient warning to avoid the offence that would be caused if they so wish. It is preferable to decide whether racist language should or should not be used and to avoid bleeping/dipping. But there may be circumstances in which that is not possible, eg. in some acquisitions. When bleeping/dipping is used it must be done so as to completely disguise the words used. Care should be taken the bleeped/dipped words are not made obvious by visible mouth movements or by captions only partly redacted. As with all strong language it is important that presenters/reporters apologise speedily for the unexpected and unjustifiable use of racist language in live output: this language should usually be removed before being published on BBC iPlayer and BBC Sounds. If the use is judged to be justified by the context eg. when a contributor is talking about their own experience, the apology should make it clear that we are not directing blame on to the contributor for using it but recognising the offence that may be caused to some. In much output there will be a straightforward choice between using racist language and not doing so. Abbreviations may be used on occasion, for example, "the N-word" and "the P-word". But it is important to remember that Ofcom's research has shown that audiences do not always understand abbreviations, especially in relation to the P-word. Where they are understood, the offence caused may not be much mitigated. So use of abbreviations, which in any case might be editorially inappropriate in some output, should not necessarily be regarded as a safe alternative to the use of the words themselves. Dr Siciid Axmed: Dhakhtarkii bukaankiisa ku badbaadiyey dhiigiisa , Dr. Sa'id Ahimad "Dhiigedu aad ayuu u hooseeyay, way miyir doorsoomi rabtay," ayuu yiri Siciid Axmed. Baraha bulshada ayaa aad loogu amaanayaa dhaqtar haween oo ku deeqay dhiig si uu u badbaadiyo haweeney xaaladeeda caafimaad ay liidato ka dib markii dhiig bax xoogan uu ku dhacay. Dhaqtarkaan oo lagu magacaabo Saciid Ahmed, Madaxa Caafimaadka ee Isbitaalka Guud ee Kamisee oo ku yaalla dalka Itoobiya. "Hooyadaan jirka ah ayaa timid xaruntayada abbaare : subaxnimo. Markii ay timid, waxay bilowday matag," ayuu yiri dhaqtarku. Kadib markii dhakhaatiirta isbitaalka guud ee Kamisees ay siiyeen haweeneyda uurka leh antibiyootig, si nabad ah ayay ku umushay, waxaaba ay dhashay gabar yar. Hase yeeshee, markii ay dhakhaatiirtu ka saareen mandheerta, waxay bilowday dhiig bax aan kala joogsi lahayn. "Dhammaan dhakhaatiirta, oo uu ku jiro dhakhtarka takhasuskaan leh, waxay daba socdeen sababta dhiiggu uu u joogsan waayay," ayuu yiri, isagoo raaciyay in dhiig-baxa joogtada ah ay ogaadeen in uu sababay dillaac ku yimaadda ilmo-galeenka xilligii dhalmada. Howlwadeenada caafimaadka ee isbitaalka ayaa siiyay haweeneyda daawooyin lagu joojinayo dhiiga, waxaana ay qaadeen tillaabooyin kala duwan balse dhiiga hooyada ayaa joogsan waayey. "Heerka dhiigaageedu aad buu u hooseeyay. Waxay ku hdawayd in ay miyir doorsanto" ayuu yiri Saciid isaga oo sheegay in hooyadan lagu waday in loo gudbiyo magaalada Dase ee dalka Itoobiya, balse waqtigu u saamixi waayay. "Cisbitaalka Dasee Referral Hospital waxa uu u jiraa - KM, kooxda khubarada ah waxay go'aan ku gaareen in aanay suurtogal ahayn in loo diro, isla markaana si degdeg ah qaliin loogu sameeyo." Ayuu hadalkiisa raaciyay. Xirfadlayaasha caafimaadka ee cusbitaalka, oo helay ogolaanshaha qoyska si ay u fuliyaan qaliinka, ayaa la kulmay caqabad kale. Sawirka, Dr. Sa'id Ahimad Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Dhiig bax ku yimid darteed, waxay u baahatay hooyadaan dhiig gaaraya . ilaa liitar si qaliin loogu sameeyo. "Waxaan ka codsanay dhammaan hay'adaha noo dhow inay na siiyaan dhiigga nooceeda ah, balse waa la waayay wax dhiig ah, dwaanu harjadnay". "Gabadha umushay iyo qoyskeedu isku dhiig ma ahayn. Sidoo kale xaalad dhiig looga qaado karo xitaa jirkoodu kuma jirin. Sidaas daraadeed dhaqtar Saciid ayaa go'aansaday in uu ku deeqo dhiigiisa maadaama ay isku dhiig ahaayeen gabadha. "Nooca dhiigaygu wuxuu la mid ahaa kan hooyada, nooca dhiigayagu waa O+, ma haysan doorasho aan ka ahayn inaan dhiigayga si toos ah ugu deeqo ka dib markaan tixgelinno faa'iidooyinka iyo dhibaatooyinka," ayuu yiri. Dhaqtarku waxa uu sheegay in baaritaanno ay ka mid yihiin HIV, Cagaarshowga B iyo C, waraabowga iyo baarista dhiigga guud la sameeyey ka hor inta aanay dhiiggiisa ku deeqin si degdeg ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dhiigii lagu deeqay kuma filnaan oo mid ka mid ah shaqaalaha qaybta shaybaarka ee isbitaalka oo lagu magacaabo Mahammad Cabdu iyo laba qof oo kale ayaa ku deeqay dhiig kale, waxaana la sameeyay tijaabo. "Inkasta oo ay ku badbaadday dhiig ku deeqid iyo qalliin, haddana xaaladeeda ma fiicnayn, waxaana ula cararnay qaybta daryeelka degdegga ah (ICU)," ayuu yiri. Kadib saacado lagu hayay qaybta daryeelka degdega ah, caafimaadka hooyada dhashay ayaa bilaabay inay soo hagaago. Maalin ka dib, waxaa laga saaray qeybta daryeelka degdega ah waxaana la dhigay qeybta hooyada. Isla markiiba way bogsatay oo waxay aaday gurigeeda iyada iyo ilmaheeda, sida uu sheegay dhaqtarku. Dhaqtarka oo wax laga waydiiyay sida uu u arko badbaadinta nolosha hooyada , waxa uu yiri, "Aqoonyahan caafimaad ahaan, arrimahan oo kale maaha kuwo cusub, marar badan ayay dhacdaa. Sidoo kale waxa uu sheegay in go'aankan uu qaatay uu yahay mid tusaale u noqonaya dadka kale ee ku jira xaaladaha adag. Hooyada ayaa haatan ku jirta xaalad wanaagsan. "Aad bay u qurux badan tahay marka ay soo toosto daweynta ka dib oo ay daawato ilmaheeda oo ku jira gacmaheeda. Shaqaalaha isbitaalkuna ay ku wada faraxsan yihiin," ayuu yiri.

Maxay tahay abaal-marinta uu helay "Boqorka Bollywood-ka" muxuuse muddooyinkan dambe ku maqnaa? Xiddigga Bollywood-ka Shah Rukh Khan ayaa taageerayaashiisa u sheegay "inay fiican tahay inuu dib usoo laabto" kadib markii uu ku guuleystay abaal-marinta jilaaga ugu wanaagsan oo ay guddoonsiiyeen Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Abaal-marinnada Filimada ee Hindiya. Khan ayaa ula jeeday dib ugu soo laabashadiisii aflaanta sanadkii kadib markii uu saaxada ka maqnaa muddo afar sano ah. "Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan xoogaa farxad ah ka helayo dadweynaha sanadkan sababtoo ah mar kale ayaan shaqeeyay kadib muddo dheer," ayuu u sheegay dadweyne ku sugnaa munaasabadda oo ka dhacday magaalada Abu Dhabi. Khan, oo magac caan ah ka ah Hindiya, wuuxu sidoo kale ka mid yahay xiddigaha ugu caansan dalkaas iyadoo ay ku xiran yihiin malaayiin taageerayaal ah oo dalka iyo dibadda oo Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay kala jooga. Keliya kuma guuleysan abaal-marinta oo uu ku muteystay doorka jilliinkiisa filimka Jawan balse wuxuu sidoo kale munaasabad weyn ku qabtay caasimadda Imaaraatka Carabta, oo ah magaalo ay ku nool yihiin bulsho badan oo Hindi ah. Waxaa lagu soo dhoweeyay bulleer, xafladda oo dhanna waxaa hareeyay taageero loo muujinayay. "Waan jeclahay abaal-marinnada, waxaan u oommanahay abaal-marinnada," ayuu yiri. "Waxaan keliya rabay inaan idiin sheego inay fiican tahay inaan dib usoo laabto." Soo laabashada Khan ee shaashadaha waaweyn ayaa ahayd guusha ugu weyn ee sanadkii hore uu gaaray Bollywood. Wuxuu sidoo kale wax ka jilay filimka sirdoonka ee Pathaan. Doorarkan ayuu ku matalayay geesi, iyadoo -jirkan muddo ka badan sano oo uu xirfadda jilaanimada ku jiray si weyn loogu yaqaannay jilidda doorarka jilicsan ee dhanka jaceylka. Soo laabashadiisa ayaa imaaneysa kadib caqabado badan oo soo wajahay dhanka noloshiisa iyo xirfaddiisaba. Waxaa ka mid ah xiridda wiilkiisa Aryan Khan oo lagu heystay eedeymo ah inuu daroogo isticmaalayay - eedeymahaas ayaa markii dambe meesha laga saaray, sidoo kalena tiro filimaan ah ayaan noqon sidii laga rabay. Balse fasaxa uu ka qaatay shaashadaha uma muuqato inay saameysay caannimadiisa. Jilaagan oo ah mid farxaan ah, ayaa waxaa aalaaba lagu tilmaamaa astaanta ugu muhiimsan ee dhaqanka Bollywood, iyadoo malaayiin taageerayaal ah ay ku tilmaamaan Boqor Khan ama Boqorka Bollywood. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Xiddigaha kale ee Bollywood ayaa sidoo kale ka qeybgalay xafladda oo dhacday Sabtidii, waxaana ka mid ah Rani Mukerji, Anil Kapoor iyo Bobby Deol. Mukerji ayaa ku guuleysatay aktaradda ugu wanaagsan ee filimka Mrs Chatterjee vs Norway halka Vidhu Vinod Chopra ayaa ku guuleystay agaasimaha ugu wanaagsan ee filimka 12th Fail. Dhanka kale, filimka Animal ee Sandeep Reddy Vanga ayaa helay lix abaal-marin waxaana ka mid ah sawirka ugu wanaagsan, iyo jilaaga ugu fiican ee dadka caawiya ee Anil Kapoor. Shirkadda Bollywood ee qabsatay ganacsiga wax soo saarka aflaanta ee Hindiya, ayaa sanad walba soo saarta boqollaal filin waxaana ku xiran dad badan oo Hindi ah oo dalka iyo dibadda kala jooga. Balse sida shirkad walba oo dunida kale ah, waxay la kulmeysay guul iyo guul-darro tan iyo markii xanuunka safmarka ah ee coronavirus uu saameeyay shaneemooyinka muddo bilooyin ah taasoo dad badan u horseedday inay baraha online-ka wax ka daawadaan. Sanadkan gaar ahaan xaalka waa ku adkaa. Marka loo barbardhigo sanadkii , oo soo laabashada "Boqor Khan" ay gacan ka geysatay in xaalka shirkadda uu soo hagaago. Waa markii saddexaad ee Abu Dhabi ay munaasabaddan martigeliso, oo in ka badan saddex sano la qabanayo. Karan Johar ayaa xafladda la qabtay Khan. Filim-sameeyaha caanka ah ayaa sidoo kale abaal-marin ah gaar ah la siiyay taasoo lagu xusayay -ka sano ee xirfadda filimada uu ku jiray.

Yaan ka garanay cashadii Cirro kula kulmay wiilka Trump iyo madaxweynaha Israa'iil? . Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) ayaa kulan casho-sharaf oo gaar ah kula yeeshay madaxweynaha Israel Isaac Herzog, is-arag ka dhacay magaalada Davos, oo uu ka socdo shirweynaha Dhaqaalaha Adduunka (WEF). Madaxweyne Herzog ayaa sheegay inuu soo dhoweynayo dhismaha xidhiidh diblomaasiyadeed oo u dhexeeya labada dhinac, isla markaana uu rajeynayo in la xoojiyo iskaashiga labada dal si ay uga faa'iidaystaan labada shacab. Qoraal uu ku daabacay Facebook-ga, Madaxweyne Cirro wuxuu sheegay in cashada ay ka soo qayb-galeen siyaasiyiin culus iyo hoggaamiyeyaal ganacsi oo caalami ah, kuwaas oo uu ka mid yahay Eric Trump, wiilka madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump. Eric Trump ayaa ka hor cashada ka qayb-galay kulan kale oo gaar ah oo ay martigelisay isla madasha Davos Lodge, kaas oo cinwaankiisu ahaa Isbeddellada Caalamiga ah iyo Fursadaha Suuqyada Horumaray. Inkasta oo uusan ahayn mas'uul dowladeed, Eric Trump waa Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Fulinta ee ururka qoyska Trump, isla markaana madaxweynaha Mareykanka waxyaabo badan kala taliya. Liiska buuxa ee martida si rasmi ah looma shaacin. Kulanku wuxuu ahaa mid martiqaad kaliya lagu galayay, oo qabanqaabiyeyaasha ayaa dad gaar ah casuumayay kuwaas oo aysan shaacin. Laakiin BBC Somali ayaa gaarkeeda u fiirisay sawirrada uu Madaxweyne Cirro la wadaagay bulshada, waxaana ka aqoonsanay magacyo waaweyn oo cashada joogay, anagoo kaashaynaa, xogta khadka ku jirta, aaladaha aqoonsi wajiyeedka iyo keydka munaasabada oo qeyb kamid ah martidu cinwaanadooda gaarka ah soo galiyeen. Mas'uuliyiinta ugu sarreeya ee aanu xaqiijinay waxaa ka mid ahaa Nir Barkat, Wasiirka Dhaqaalaha iyo Warshadaha ee Israel. Waa xubin ka tirsan golaha wasiirrada, horeyna u soo noqday duqa magaalada Qudus, isaga oo door muhiim ah ka ciyaara diblomaasiyadda dhaqaale ee Israel iyo xiriirka ay la leedahay maalgashadayaasha caalamiga ah. Waxaa sidoo kale cashada joogay hoggaamiyeyaal ganacsi oo caalami ah. Margarita Louis-Dreyfus, Guddoomiyaha shirkadda Louis Dreyfus Group, ayaa ka mid ahayd dadka goobta joogay. Shirkaddeedu waa mid ka mid ah kuwa ugu waaweyn ganacsiga badeecadaha caalamka, iyadoo ka shaqaysa beeraha, tamarta iyo gaadiidka caalamiga ah. Luděk Sekyra, oo ah maalqabeen Czech ah kuna lug leh hantida maguurtada ah, kaabayaasha iyo samafalka, ayaa sidoo kale aanu ka aqoonsanay sawirrada. Waa shakhsiyad si weyn looga yaqaan suuqyada maalgashiga Yurub. Sidoo kale waxaa goobta lagu arkay Evangelos Marinakis, oo ah maalqabeen Giriig ah kuna xeel dheer maraakiibta iyo gaadiidka tamarta,sidoo kalena ah mulkiilaha naadiga horyaalka Ingiriiska ka ciyaara ee Nottingham Forest. Iyo John S. Koudounis, Madaxweynaha iyo Agaasimaha Guud ee shirkadda maalgashiga Maraykanka ee Calamos Investments. Dadka kale ee laga aqoonsaday sawirrada waxaa ka mid ahaa Rainer Schorr, oo ah aasaasaha iyo guddoomiyaha shirkadda hantida maguurtada ah ee Standard Land SA; iyo Nadav Sarfir, oo ah masuul ka tirsan waaxda tiknoolajiyadda iyo hal-abuurka ee Israel. Cashadan waxay ka mid ahayd barnaamij ballaaran oo ay martigelisay Greek House Davos, taas oo ay hoggaaminayso Eirini Vantaraki. Vantaraki ayaa Greek House ku qeexday madal diiradda saarta kulammo gaar ah oo albaabadu u xiran yihiin, iyada oo sheegtay in Davos ay ka guurayso doodaha fagaareyaasha una wareegayso kulammo gaar ah oo ay isugu yimaadaan awoodda siyaasadeed, raasamaalka iyo danaha istiraatiijiga ah. Maadaama cashadu ahayd mid gaar ah oo martiqaad ku kooban, suurtagal ma aha in la xaqiijiyo dhammaan dadkii ka soo qayb-galay ama faahfaahinta waxa laga wada hadlay. Waxa la hubo ayaa ah in cashadu ay isu keentay mas'uuliyiin sare oo Israeli ah, shaqsiyaad si dhow ula xiriira awoodda siyaasadeed ee Maraykanka, iyo maalqabeenno caalami ah, dhammaantoodna ku kulmay jawi si gaar ah loo habeeyay oo ku dhisnaa qarsoodi iyo taxaddar. In kulankan ay joogto Somaliland, oo aan weli aqoonsi caalami ah helin, marka laga reebo kii Israa'iil, waxay muujinaysaa muhiimadda diblomaasiyadeed ee israa'iil u leedahay Somaliland, xilli ay isku arkayaan xitaa meelo ka baxsan kulamada rasmiga ah ee Davos ka socda.

Vanuatu: Maxaa ka dhigay mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu farxadda badan dunida? , Chris Morgan/BBC Mid ka mid ah meelaha dhulka ugu farxadda badan ayaa ku taal badhtamaha badda Baasifigga, waa Vanuatu. Dalkan saddex geesoodka ah ee ay ku dhex yaallaan, ku dhawaad -ka jasiiradood, ee u dhaw una jira wax gaadha ,000km bariga Australia, ayaa ka mid ah afarta dal ee ugu farxadda bada dunida. Sidoo kalena dalalka ka baxsan America waa dalka ugu farxadda badan, marka loo eego sida ay tebisay wakaaladda Happy Planet Index. Kala sarrayntan ayaa lagu kala helaa, fiicnaanta dalkaasi leeyahay, rejada nolosha laga qabo, iyo heerka sinnaanshaha oo ay ku jiraan sidda ummaddaasi degaankeeda iyo wax soosaarkooda u ilaashadeen. Dadka naftooda jecel waa "kuwo argagaxa balse farxad ku nool" Farxad la'aantay ka cabanaysay fasaq la'aan baa loogu daray Maxaa dalkan yar ka farxiyey? Tan iyo markii ay xornimadooda ka qaateen Faransiiska iyo ingiriiska sannadkii , guud ahaanba dhulka Vanuatu waxaa iska lahaaa oo haystay dadka dalkani u dhashay, lagamana iibinnin cid shisheeya ah marna. Sannadkii , cilmibaadhis ay sameeyeen Waaxda Xisaabaadka ee Vanuatu oo loo soo gaabiyo (VNSO) ayaa tilmaamaysay dadka haysta dhul ay leeyihiin, in ay ka farxad badan yihiin kuwa aan haysan. Maantana, qiyaastii seddex meelood meel dadka dalkaasi , ah ee deggan kuna nool meelaha baadiyaha ah, iyo dadka jasiiradaha ku nool badankooduba waxay leeyihiin dhul ay ku noolaan karaan kuna tabcan karaa cuntadooda. Cilmbaadhis taa la mid ah ayaa Iyana caddaysay, in doofaarka, khudaarta noocyadeeda kala duwan oo uu ka mid yahay Kava (Nooca caleenta cagaaran ah oo mararka qaar loo cuno si uu u yareeyo shakiga iyo welwelka) ay degaankaasi ka buuxaan iyagoo aan wax lacag ah ahayn. Waxa kale ee dadka jasiiraddan deggan farxaddooda u sababta ah ayaa ah 'xidhiidhka qotada dheer ee ka dhaxeeya dhaqankooda, quruxda dabeecadda iyo deegaanka kala duwan ee ku xeeran'. Vanuatu, oo ah magaca dalkan waxa uu la micne yahay 'Dhulkayagii Dhabta ahaa'. Sidoo kale -ka luuqadood ee lagaga hadlo degaankan ayaa ka dhigaya inoo sidoo kale yahay, dalalka ugu luuqad yahansan dunida. Afafkan asliga ah ee ay ku hadlaan %, dadka u dhashay dalkani ayaa sidoo kale faham xooggan waxa ay la leeyihiin, xayawaanka, dhirta, daaqa, dhulka iyo guud ahaanba deegaanka iyo taariikhdiisa. Inkasta oo uu hadda dalkani waajahayo caqabado waaweyn. Kuwaas oo lagu qeexo inay dab kor saran yihiin. Vanuatu, waxaa loo tixgeliyaa mid ka mid ah dalalka ugu fudud ee ay ka dhici karaan masiibooyin dabeeci ahi, iyadoo sannadihii la soo dhaafayna ay jasiiradahaas ku xoogganayaan dhul go' iyo isbeddelka cimillada ee dhanka badda. Taas oo ka dhigaysa in degaankaas loo aqoonsado halka ugu khatarta badan dunida, marka laga eego dhanka masiibooyinka sida laga soo xigtay sannadkii -kii, Qaramada Midoobay. Sanadkii , Duufaantii Pam ayaa ku dhufatay jasiiraddan, iyada oo sababtay khasaare aad u weyn oo , oo qof ay hoy la'aanka dhigtay. Laakiin in kasta oo burburka intaa leegi dhacay, dadka deegaankan ayaa si dhakhso leh u bilaabay dib-u-dhiska tuulooyinka, iyaga oo muujinaya adkeysi iyo awooddooda waxqabsi inta ay leegtahay.

Viagra: Barnaamijka BBC maka caawin karaa ragga inay ka hadlaan tabaryarida ragannimada? Waa ruwaayadda BBC ee uu soo saaraha ka yahay Russell T Davies taasoo ku saabsan waxa yar ee laga ogyahay tijaabadii kaniiniga kordhiya awoodda ragga ee Viagra oo la rajeynayo inay ragga ka caawiso inay ka hadlaan awood-yarida ragannimada. Men Up waxaa dhiirrigelinaya ragga "geesiyaasha ah" ee tijaabiyay kaniiniga noqday Viagra xilli in laga hadlo arrimaha tabardarrida ragga ay ahayd mid ceeb ah si xitaa ka daran sida ay maanta tahay. Dhaqaatiirta iyo ka qeyb qaatayaasha Men Up ayaa rajeynaya in barnaamijkan uu ragga ka caawiyo soo afjaridda ceebeynta arrintan. Khubarrada ayaa sheegaya in wacyigelinta ragannimada ay u baahan tahay hormuud sida ay Davina McCall uga caawisay haweenka ka hadalka caado go’a. Awood-yarida ragannimada ayaa saameyn karta kala bar ragga ay da’doodu ka weyn tahay , sida ay sheegtay waaxda caafimaadka bulshada UK ee NHS. Balse ragga ayaa looga digayaa in xaaladdan laga yaabo inay calaamad u tahay dhibaatooyin caafimaad oo qoto dheer, ayna tahay inay sida ugu dhaqsiyaha badan dhaqtar u arkaan. "Rag ahaan, gaar ahaan kuma wanaagsanin ka hadalka dareemaheenna iyo arrimaha noocan ah," ayuu yiri xiddigga Men Up iyo Game of Thrones Iwan Rheon. "Waxaa jira in in badan xoogga la saarayo caafimaadka maskaxda ee ragga waana muhiim dhabtii in sheekadan hadda la sheego." Men Up waa ruwaayad ay BBC-du bilaabeyso waxaana qeyb ka ah ilaa shan nin oo caadi ah oo ka qeyb qaadanaya tijaabada daawo cusub oo awoodda ragannimada ah. "Waxay ahayd geesinnimo saa’id ah oo ay raggan muujiyeen inay diyaar ugu yihiin tijaabadan oo kale," ayuu yiri jilaaga Dunkirk Aneurin Barnard, oo qeyb ka ah Men Up. "Gaar ahaan bulshada dhexdeeda xilligan oo ka hadalka awood-yarida ragannimada ay tahay mid aan suurtogal ahayn. "Balse waxay dhammaantood raadinayaan inay helaan wax ay lumiyeen – taasi waa waxa awoodda leh. "Waa dad caadi ah oo isku dayaya inay dib u hantaan ragannimadooda, kalsoonidooda." Inkastoo xitaa tabar-darrida ragannimada ay tahay xaalad ku badan ragga waaweyn, bukaannada ayaa ka cago jiida inay ka hadlaan dhibaatooyinkooda – xitaa marka ay la joogaan khubarrada caafimaadka – taasina waxay saameyneysaa caafimaadka. , BBC / QUAY STREET PRODUCTIONS / TOM JACKSON Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Marka maaddaama in ka badan kala bar ragga ka weyn -ka sano laga yaabo inay saameyso awood-yarida ragannimada, dhaqaatiirta ayaa kusoo biiray jilaayada Men Up waxayna ragga ku boorriyeen inaysan ka xishoon iyagoo eegaya faa’iidada ay u leedahay caafimaadkooda – iyo xiriirradooda. "Aad ayay ragga ugu adag tahay inay xaqiiqsadaan inaysan ka dhigneyn inaadan rag ahayn haddii aad qabto awood-yarida ragannimada," ayuu yiri khabiir sare oo caafimaadka ragga ah Dr Jeff Foster. "Waxaa jiri kara sababo caafimaad oo dhab ah maaddaama % kiisaska ay leeyihiin sababo dabiici ah, sida xanuunka macaanka, xanuunka wadnaha amaba hoormoonka testosterone oo yar. Taasina waxay meesha ka saareysaa fekradda ku jirta maskaxdaada. "Ma aha keliya iibsashada Viagra sidaasina xaalku ku hagaagato, taasi waxay la tacaaleysaa calaamadda ee waxba kama qabaneyso waxa sababay. "Raggu waa inay xubintooda taranka u adeegsadaan sida cabbirka caafimaadkooda haddii aysan shaqeyneyn, waxaad u baahan tahay inaad u tagto dhaqtar aadna ku tiraahdo waxaa i heysata dhibaato caafimaad." Sawirka, DR JEFF FOSTER Dr Foster ayaa xarun la tacaasha tabaryarida ragannimada ku leh Royal Leamington Spa, Warwickshire, celcelis ahaanna, bukaannadiisa , -ka gaaraya ee xaaladdan qaba ayaa waxay ku qaadataa saddex sano inay isaga rakaan. "Tabaryarida ragannimada iyo arrimaha la xiriira galmada ee ragga waa wax aad looga xishoodo gudaha UK," ayuu intaa raaciyay Dr Foster, oo xubin ka ah Bahda Britain ee Caafimaadka Galmada. "Haddii aad qabi lahayd inta badan xaaladaha cafimaadka, maadan sugi lahayn saddex sano kahor inta aadan u tagin dhaqtar. Haddii aad iska deyso, xiriirrada ayay dhib ku tahay iyo khatarta ah inaad qabi karto xaalado caafimaad oo khatar ah ayaa kasii dareysa."
