Cilmibaaris: Maxaa carruurta Nairobi ku dhasha ugu wacan in caqligoodu ragaaso? Cilmibaaris cusub oo ay wadajir u sameeyeen saynisyahanno kala socda Kenya iyo Mareykanka, ayaa lagu ogaadey in carruurta ku dhalata magaalada Nairobi ay u badan tahay in ay ku dhashaan garaadyari. Warbxinta cilmibaaristan oo todobaadkii hore lagu daabacay warsidaha caanka ah ee ka faallooda arrimaha fayadhowrka deegaanka ee la yiraa Environmental Health Perspectives Journal ayaa daaha ka rogtey khatarta ku gedaaman dadweynaha ku nool caasimadda Nairobi, gaar ahaan haweenka uurka leh oo halis ugu jira kiimiko la yiraahdo LEAD oo ku badan guryaha la dego iyo ilo biyoodka. Kiimikadan oo ah bir sumeysan ayaa badanaa laga helaa rinjiga guryaha la mariyo ama agabka aqallada lagu dhalaaliyo, taas oo sida la sheegay ay warshaduhu ku daraan qiyaas ka badan inta la oggol yahay, si uu rinjigu ciyow u qallalo. Waana halkaas halka inta badan carruurta korriinshaha garaadkooda la dersay ay eersadeen, sida ku xusan daraasadda. Cilmibaaristan oo ay iska kaashadeen khuburro ka kala socda Jaamacadaha Nairobi iyo Washington oo ku kala yaalla Kenya iyo Mareykanka ayaa lagu sheegay in ilmaha uurka ku jira iyo kuwa naaska nuugaya ay halis ugu jiraan calaannimo dhanka maskaxda ah. Cilmibaarista oo si qoto dheer loogu kuurgalay sida ilmuhu ku qaadaan kiimikadan maskaxda ragaadisa ayaa tibaaxday in hooyada uurka leh ama irmaan ay kiimikada Lead toos ugu gudbin karto ilmaha uurka jiifa, gaar ahaan marka ay qaadato cunto iyo cabitaan sumeysan. Suntan oo raacda aalaaba qulqulka dhiigga ayaa waxay si fudud ugu gudubtaa ilmaha uurka jiifa, iyadoo sii mareysa xuddunta. Sidoo kale waxay raaci kartaa caanaha naaska sidaasna waxay ugu gudbi kartaa cunug kasta oo jaqa caanaha hooyada sumeysan. Kumannaan carruur reer Nairobi ah ayaa dhasha iyagoo horay ula dersey kiimiko ragaadisa korriinsha garaadkooda, sida lagu ogaadey baaritaan lagu sameeyey haween ku dhalay isbitaalka Pumwani ee ku yaal degmada Kamakunji ee ay ka tirsan tahay xaafadda Eastleigh ee inta badan Soomaalidu degto. Hooyooyinkan dhiiggooda uu baaray sheybaarka dowladda Kenya ayaa lagu arkay raadka birta Lead-ka oo heerkoodu sarreeyo, taas oo xaadir ku ah dhiigga hooyada iyo xuddunta cunugga. Baaritaankan lagu sameeyey haweenka ayaa muujinaya haweenka ka soojeeda degmooyinka isku-raranta ah ee nadaafadooddu hooseyso inay aad ugu nugul yihiin kiimikada Lead-ka oo si fudud ugu gudbi karta ilamaha ay uurka ku siaan ama ay nuujinayaan. Dhallaanka ku sumooba kiimikada Lead ayaa ka dhaxli kara dhibaato caafimaad darro iyo cillad aan laga soo waaqsan oo saameeya ilmaha uurka jiifa. Waxaana cilladaha ugu badan ee lagu arko ciyaalkaas ka mid ah xaaladda loo yaqaan Maskax Ragaaska Waara (Permanent Mental Retardation) oo ah in maskaxda cunuggu aysan u korin sidii la rabay. Sida ku cad tusmada fayadhowrka walxaha khatarta leh ee Ururka Caafimadka Adduunka (WHO), ilmaha uurka ku jira waa kuwa ugu nugul in ay ku sumoobaan kiimikada ka soo gorota jirka hooyada, ka dibna qayb ka noqda ubadka ku dhex abuurmaya. Khuburrada baaritaanka sameysay ayaa xoogga saaray xaafadaha Dandora iyo Kariobangi, halkaas oo haween ka yimid ay ku umuleen Isbitaalka Pumwani, dabadeedna dhiigag looga qaaday si loo baaro. Isku soo wad duuboo, marka la isku eego daruufaha nadaafadeed ee xaafadaha warbixinta lagu xusay iyo tan xaafadaha Soomaalidu degto, sida Eastleigh waa kuwo aad isugu dhow.

Qaar ka mid ah faa'iidooyinka iyo dhibaatooyinka teknoolajiyada 5G ee ay keeneen shirkadaha isgaarsiinta Soomaaliya Shirkadda Hurmuud ayaa daahfurtay isgaarsiinta casriga ah ee jiilka Shanaad oo loo yaqaan 5G, waxaa kasii horeeyay oo billowgii sannadkan isla 5G daahfurtay shirkadda kale ee Somtel. Waxaa suurta gal ah in aad isweydiiso muxuu soo kordhinayaa 5G, mase leeyahay dhibaatooyin? Qormadan ayaan kusoo bandhigaynaa qaar ka mid ah Faa’iidooyinka iyo dhibaatooyinka teknoolajidan casriga ah ee jiilka Shanaad (5G). Mid ka mid ah faa'iidooyinka 5G ee ugu caansan waa xawaarihiisa. Isgaarsiinta 5G ayaa la filayaa inay ku shaqayso awood dhan ilaa Giga baayt ilbiriqsigiiba, taas oo ilaa jeer ka dhakhso badan noocii ka horeeyay ee 4G LTE. Taasi waxay la macno tahay inaad ku soo dejisan karto filin HD ah oo buuxa ilbiriqsiyo gudahood marka aad isticmaalayso 5G, taas oo 4G ku qaadata dhowr daqiiqo. Xawaarahan la kordhiyey kaliya ma wanaajinayo u hawl yaraynta isticmaalaha ee codsiyada xogta sida baahinta fiidiyowga iyo ciyaaraha laakiin sidoo kale waxay furi doontaa fursadaha cusub ee codsiyada sida teknoolajida loo yaqaan VR. 5G waxa loogu talagalay in uu ka tayo wanaagsanaado 4G. wuxuu isticmaalaa tignoolajiyad horumarsan sida goynta shabakadda, taas oo u oggolaanaysa hawl-wadeennada in ay abuuraan shabakado badan oo muuqaal ah oo ku dhex jira hal shabakad oo 5G ah. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in agabka isgaarsiinta loo qoondayn karo si hufan, iyadoo la hubinayo in isticmaale kastaa uu helayo heerka adeegga uu u baahan yahay. 5G waxay leedahay awood aad uga weyn midda 4G. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in ay awood u leedahay in ay xamili karto qalabyo badan, laga bilaabo casriga iyo tablets ilaa aaladaha internetka ku shaqeeya iyo dareemayaasha, iyaga oo aan hoos u dhigin. Tani waxay si gaar ah muhiim ugu noqon doontaa magaalooyinka iyo munaasabadaha waaweyn halkaas oo dad badani isku dayayaan inay isku mar ku xidhmaan shabakada. Waxaa nagu hareereysan shucaac elektromagnetic ah had iyo jeer - laga bilaabo telefishinada iyo signalada raadiyaha, iyo sidoo kale noocyo kala duwan oo teknooloji ah, oo ay ku jiraan taleefannada gacanta, iyo ilaha dabiiciga ah sida ilayska qorraxda. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. 5G waxay isticmaashaa mowjado soo noqnoqda oo ka sarreeya jiilalkii ka horeeyay ee mobilada, taas oo u oggolaanaysa aalado badan in ay ku xirmaan internetka isku mar iyo xawaare dheereeya. Saamaynta caafimaad ee ka iman karta 5G waa mawduuc dood joogto ahi ka taagan tahay. Khubarada qaar ayaa walaac ka muujiyay saameynta mowjadaha raadiyaha ee soo noqnoqda ee 5G ay ku leeyihiin caafimaadka aadanaha. Sannadkii -kii Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) ayaa sheegay in "wax saameyn caafimaad darro ah aan la ogaanin taas oo uu sababo isticmaalka taleefanka gacantu". Si kastaba ha ahaatee, WHO oo ay weheliso Hay'adda Caalamiga ah ee Cilmi-baarista Kansarka (IARC) waxay ku tilmaantay dhammaan shucaaca soo noqnoqda ee raadiyaha (oo signalka isgaarsiinta ee mobaylada ay qayb ka yihiin) in ay “kansar sababi karaan”. Waxaa loogu daray liiska kansarka sababi kara "waxaa jira caddaymo ku soo gunaanadaya in soo-gaadhista jirka ee shucaacu ay bini'aadamka kansar ku sababi karto ". Carqaladeynta suurtagalka ah ee hawlaha duulimaadka Waxaa jiray walaac laga muujiyay suurtagalnimada in signalada ay dirayaan qalabka ku shaqeeya 5G ay farageliyaan altimeterka raadiyaha ee diyaaradaha, kuwaas oo cabbira inta ay diyaaraddu dhulka ka sarayso. Arrintu waxay soo ifbaxday sababtoo ah xargaha soo noqnoqda, baaxadda . GHz, ee loo isticmaalo 5G waxay ku dhowdahay tan ay adeegsadaan altimeter radio, kuwaas oo adeegsada . ilaa . GHz band. Bishii Janaayo , dhowr diyaaradood oo caalami ah ayaa ku qasbanaaday inay hakiyaan duullimaadyada Mareykanka iyadoo 5G la geeyay garoomo badan oo dalka ah. Iyadoo hawl wadeenada isgaadhsiinta iyo soosaarayaasha qalabka 5G ay sheegaan in khatarta faragalintu ay yar tahay, FAA waxay sii waddaa inay kormeerto oo ay soo saarto tilmaamo marka macluumaad badan la helo. Teknoolajiyad kasta oo caalamka kusoo biirta, waa wax iska caadi ah in laga muujiyo walaacyo ku aaddan in ay bini’adanka wax u dhimi karaan, kuwanina waa qaar ka mid ah waxyaabaha laga dooday in ay uu 5G keeno.

Waxaanse dib u eegaynaa taariikha kulankan gaar ah ee aadka loo jecelyahay. -kii Maajo, , kooxda FC Barcelona — oo la aasaasay laba sano iyo bar ka hor — ayaa markii ugu horreysay tagtay caasimadda Madrid, si ay kulan ula ciyaarto koox maxalli ah oo cusub oo la aasaasay laba bilood ka hor, FC Madrid. Maalintaas cidna ma ogeyn in ciyaartaas ay noqon doonto bilowgii waxa markii dambe isu beddelay xafiiltankii ugu weynaa taariikhda kubadda cagta adduunka. Kooxda Catalonia, tani waxay u ahayd kaliya ciyaar "caadi ah oo fudud" oo ka tirsan tartanka, iyaga oo ku socda dhinaca finalkii aan laga maarmi karin ee ay la ciyaari lahaayeen Athletic Bilbao, oo markaas loo tixgelin jiray kooxda kubadda cagta ee ugu fiican Spain. Booqashadan waxay timid xilli semi-final-ka Koobka Coronation Cup, kaasoo lagu qabtay si loogu dabaaldego Boqor Alfonso XIII kadib markii uu gaaray da'da lix iyo toban jirka, oo markaas loo aqoonsanaa "da'da qaangaarka," isla markaana si rasmi ah u qabtay waajibaadkiisii boqornimo ee Boqortooyada Spain. Tartankan wuxuu ahaa tartankii kubadda cagta ee ugu horreeyay ee ay ka qeyb galaan kooxo ka kala yimid guud ahaan Spain. FC Barcelona waxaa aasaasay -kii koox dhalinyaro ajnabi ah oo deggan magaalada, taasoo ka dhalatay caannimada kubadda cagta iyo ciyaaraha kale ee Ingiriiska ee guud ahaan Yurub. Kahor kulanka ay la ciyaareysay Madrid, Barcelona waxay laheyd labo sano oo waayo aragnimo ah oo kubada cagta ah iyadoo ka qeybqaadatay Copa Macaya, tartan u dhexeeyay naadiyada Catalan oo socday ilaa . Kooxda kubadda cagta ee Madrid waxaa aasaasay injineerka Isbaanishka ah Julián Palacios, oo loo aqoonsaday madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay ee Real Madrid xilligaas ay weli ahayd koox aan rasmi ahayn intii u dhaxaysay iyo . Lixdii Maarso, , Palacios wuxuu xilalkii u wareejiyay Juan Padrós, ninka si rasmi ah u aasaasay naadiga. Markii Clásico-dii ugu horreeyay ee labada koox dhexmartay ay dhacday, kooxda Catalonia waxaaa u ciyaarayey laba ciyaartoy oo Swiss ah, hal ciyaartoy oo Jarmal ah, iyo saddex ciyaartoy Ingiriis ah, halka Madrid — oo markii dambe noqotay Real Madrid sanadkii , uu ciyaaray hal ciyaartoy oo ajaanib ah. Kooxda Madrid ayaa sidoo kale lahayd khibrad tartan oo xadidan, iyagoo dhawr kulan oo saaxiibtinimo la ciyaartay kooxaha kale ee caasimadda. Ciyaartoyga ajaanibka ah ee kaliya ee Los Blancos — kuwaas oo tan iyo maanta xirta dharka cad — Arthur Johnson, ayaa dhaliyay goolka ugu horreeya ee ciyaarta, isaga oo noqday ciyaartoygii ugu horreeyay ee taariikhda El Clásico gool ka dhaliya. Laakiin ciyaartu waxay ku dhamaatay Barcelona oo ku guuleysatay - . Guushan awgeed, kooxda Catalonia waxay u soo baxday finalka tartanka, halkaas oo ay la ciyaari lahaayeen kooxda Basque-ka ah, Athletic Bilbao, oo ugu dambeyn ku guuleystay horyaalka. Tartankani sidoo kale wuxuu calaamadeeyay koobka ugu horreysay ee waxa hadda loo yaqaan Copa del Rey. Isku dhacyadii u dhexeeyay dhammaan kooxaha Isbaanishka ayaa sii socday sannadihii xigay. Intii u dhaxaysay ilaa , Madrid iyo Barcelona waxay kulmeen toddobo jeer, iyadoo Barcelona ku guuleysatay shan kulan, halka labo kulan ay ku dhamaadeen barbaro. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, "khilaafkii" dhabta ahaa ee u dhexeeyay labada kooxood ee Real Madrid iyo Barcelona wuxuu bilaabmay markii ugu horreysay ee muran garsoor uu ka dhashay kulankoodii sideedaad. Labada kooxood ayaa ku ballansanaa inay ku kulmaan is arag oo labada guri ah oo laba lug ah. Barcelona ayaa lugtii hore gurigeeda ku badisay laba iyo hal bishii Maarso sanadkii -kii halka Real Madrid iyaduna lugta labaad ku badisay todobaad ka dib, - . Maadaama qaabka tartanka waqtigaas uusan ku salaysnayn farqiga goolasha, ciyaar dheeri ah ayaa loo qorsheeyay -kii Abriil, taasoo noqotay mid ka mid ah khilaafaadyadii ugu da'da weynaa ee labada naadi loo diiwaangeliyay. Garoonka Campo de O'Donnell ee Madrid ayaa loo xushay inuu martigeliyo ciyaarta, waxaana garsoore loo magacaabay José Ángel Berraondo, oo ahaa ciyaaryahan hore oo Real Madrid ah. Intii ay ciyaartu socotay Berraundo waxa uu saddex rigoore u dhigay kooxdiisii hore ee Madrid,waxana uu u diiday gool ay la timid Barcelona. Goolhayaha Barcelona ayaa labo rigoore ka badbaadiyay, laakiin ciyaaryahankii Santiago Bernabéu oo markii dambe loogu magac daray garoonka Real Madrid ayaa dhaliyay goolkii seddexaad daqiiqadii 118aad. wuxuuna ciyaarta ka dhigay - . Madrid ayaa u soo baxday finalka ay la ciyaari lahayd Athletic Bilbao, kaasoo lagu qabtay garoonka Barcelona, halkaasoo qaar ka mid ah taageerayaasha ay wateen boorar cambaareynaya garsoorka Berraondo. Kooxda Madrid ayaa finalka ku guuldarreysatay iyadoo kulankaasi ku dhamaaday - , waxaana qaar ka mid ah taariikhyahannada kubadda cagta Isbaanishka ee xilligaas sheegay in ciyaartoyda Madrid lagu tuuray dhagaxyo iyagoo ka baxay garoonka. Horyaalka Isbaanishka ee aan maanta u naqaano La Liga ayaa la aasaasay sanadkii , waxaana kulamada u dhexeeya labada koox noqdeen kuwo joogto ah. Sanadihii -meeyadii iyo -meeyadii, Real Madrid waxay xoojisay booskeeda xooggan, iyadoo ku guuleysatay shantii koob ee ugu horeysay ee Yurub ee isku xigta, laga soo bilaabo , iyadoo ay ugu mahadcelineyso ciyaartoydii loo tixgeliyey halyeeyo sida Alfredo Di Stéfano oo Argentine-Isbaanish ahaa iyo Ferenc Puskás, oo Hungarian ahaa. Xafiiltanka u dhexeeya Real Madrid iyo Barcelona ayaa sidoo kale bilaabay inuu qaato wajiyo cusub, iyadoo xidiga u dashay Holland Johan Cruyff uu hogaaminayay kooxda Catalonia bartamihii -meeyadii, halka ciyaaryahanka Jarmalka Paul Breitner uu ku jiray safka Real Madrid, oo ay garab joogeen ciyaaryahanada Spanishka ahaa Spain Vicente del Bosque iyo Goyo Benito. Sanadihii xigay, labada koox waxay sii wateen inay safafkooda ku soo kala daraan xidigaha ka soo jeeda dalalka kale ee Yurub iyo wadamada Latin America sida Argentina iyo Brazil. Real Madrid waxay soo maratay waqtigii loo yaqaanay "Galacticos" oo ahayd intii u dhaxaysay sanadihii iyo , xilligaasoo ay kooxda ay ku soo biireeen xidigo waaweyn oo ka yimid dibadda Spain, oo ay ku jiraan Luis Figo oo ka yimid Portugal, Zinedine Zidane oo Faransiis ah, Ronaldo oo Brazil ah, iyo David Beckham oo Ingiriis ah. Sidaas oo kale Bareceona waxay la timid magacyo caan ah sida Ronaldinho oo Brazil ah, Samuel Eto'o oo Cameroon ka soo jeeda, Thierry Henry oo Faransiis ah, iyo Yaya Touré oo Ivory Coast ah Labada xiddig ee shiday El-Clásico isla markaana kaalinta kowaad ka galay tartamada kubbada cagta aduunka ayaa kala ahaa Cristiano Ronaldo oo Portugal u dhashay iyo Lionel Messi oo Argentina u dhashay, kuwaas oo ku kala guulaystay abaal marinta Ballon d'Or wakhtigoodii Real Madrid iyo Barcelona., taasoo ka qayb qaadatay ballaarinta xiisaha caalamiga ah ee lagu daawado labada koox. Ciyaartoyda kale ee sidoo kale ee shiday iyagu waxaa ka mid ahaa Xavi Hernandez, Andres Iniesta, Gerard Pique, Sergio Ramos, Lukas Modric, iyo Karim Benzema. Ciyaartii El Clásico ee ugu daawashada badnayd ayaa la rumeysan yahay inay dhacday -kii Abriil, , iyadoo laga baahiyay in ka badan wadan iyada oo ay adeegsadeen in ka badan idaacado caalami ah oo xuquuqda ka haysta Horyaalka Kubadda Cagta Spain (La Liga), taasoo gaartay qiyaastii milyan oo qof. Labada kooxood ayaa ciyaaray kulan oo El Clasico tartamada oo dhan ah tan iyo markii la aasaasay horyaalka La Liga, iyadoo Real Madrid ay badisay ka mid ah, Barcelona , iyo barbaro. Guushii ugu weyneyd ee taariikhda El Clásico waa guushii Real Madrid ay - kaga badisay Barcelona bishii June , , magaalada Madrid. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, natiijadii ciyaartan ayaa weli ah mid muran siyaasadeed oo aad u weyni ka taagan tahay, iyadoo lagu eedeeyay faragalin siyaasadeed kaligii taliyihii Francisco Franco oo xilligaasi xukumayay Spain, kaddib markii uu afgambi milateri ku qaaday dowladdii bidixda ee la doortay, si uu u xaqiijiyo in ciyaartu ay sidaas ku dhammaato. Si aan u diiwaan geliyo wixii dhacay maalintaas, qoraaga British-ka ah ee Sid Lowe ayaa ka wareystay Fernando Argilla, oo ahaa ciyaaryahankii ugu dambeeyay ee nool ee ka qaybqaata ciyaarta, buug uu daabacay . Argilla ayaa u sheegay inuu ciyaarta ka daawaday kursiga keydka, maadaama uu ahaa goolhayaha Barcelona ee bedelka ku soo galay. Waxa uu intaa ku daray inuu xasuusto sarkaal ka tirsan dawladda oo booqday qolka labiska ka hor ciyaarta: "Nin booliis ah, gaashaanle, ma aqaano, laga yaabee inay ka tirsan yihiin Ilaalada Madaniga ah." Hadda El Clásico, waxaa mar kale xiiso u yeellay xiddiga kooxda Real Madrid kaga soo biiray Paris Saint-Germain Kylian Mbappé iyo mar la raga kooxda Barcelona ka soo baxay Lamine Yamal. Labadooda Lamine Yamal iyo Kylian Mbappé, ayaa iska horyimid siddeed jeer oo laba ka mid ah ay yihiin Qaramada.

Cunto laga helo guryaha Soomaalida oo ay isticmaali jireen boqorrada oo kaliya Waa nooc mulawax ah oo aad u jilicsan oo laga jecel yahay Koonfurta Aasiya, isla markaana si weyn loogu cuno digaag lagu kariyey subag. Cunytada noocan ah waa mid ka mid ah cuntooyinka ugu caansan gobolkaas. Keliya digaag laguma cuno ee malawaxaas waxaa lala cunaa cuntooyin kale oo badan, wuxuuna ka mid yahay waxyaabaha lama huraanka u ah ee aan sinaba uga maqnaan karin miiska cuntada ee gobolka. Waxa lagu daraa alaabo kale oo dhadhan kala duwan u sameeya. Malaha sababtaas awgeed ayuu malawaxani caan uga noqday dunida oo dhan. Dhawaan ayaa nooc ka mid ah rootigan oo toon lagu daraywaxay caan ka noqotay kuwa ugu wanaagsan dunida. Marka la diyaarinayo waxa lagu daraa subag sixin ah oo lagu mariyo malawax diirran, kadibna lagu dul rusheeyo toon la jarjaray. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa laga yaabaa inay dad badan u noqoto arrin cusub in malawaxa oo meel kasta laga helo uu dadka qaarkiis u yahay cunnada ugu wanaasgan. Waxa la sheegayaa in cuntadani ay ka mid ahaan jirtay kuwa ugu qaalisan ee la siin jiray boqorradii muslimiinta. Haddaba, sidee ayuu malwaxani uga soo baxay jikadii boqortooyada una soo gaadhay miisaska caadiga ah ee dadweynaha caalamku ku cunteeyaan? Fadlan halkan riix oo ku soo biir janalka WhatsApp ee BBC Somali si aad u hesho wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee caalamka, iyo kuwa gobolka Taariikhda malawaxa waa mid xoogaa mugdi ah oo aan si buuxda u caddayn, balse khubaradu waxay aamminsan yihiin in mulawaxu asal ahaan ka soo jeedo taariikhdii Faaris ee qadiimiga ahayd, maadaama magaca "naan" oo la mid ah malawax uu ka yimid af-Faarisiga. Waqtiyadii hore, dadka Faarisiyiinta ah waxay ka samayn jireen roodhi iyaga oo isku daraya biyo iyo bur, kaddibna waxay ku dubi jireen dhagaxyo aad u kulul. Qarnigii 13aad ilaa 16aad, xilliyadii guulaha Islaamku ka gaadhay Hindiya, malawaxu wuxuu u gudbay Bariga Aasiya (Hindustan), sababtoo ah Muslimiintii guulaystay waxay la yimaadeen dhaqammadoodii cuntada. Sidoo kale, dadka ka yimid Aasiya Dhexe iyo Galbeed waxay wateen qalabyo waxa lagu foorneeyo. , The Cleveland Museum of Art, Andrew R. and Martha Holden Jennings Fund Niha Varmani, oo si dhow ula socota taariikhda Koonfurta Aasiya, waxay sheegtay in "malawaxu uu lahaa cunto-kariye gaar ah oo si joogto ah u soo saari jiray rootiga. Tusaale ahaan, nooc ka mid ah mulwaxaas wax auu lahaa lakabyo rooti khafiif ah, halka malawaxa qaarkooda ay ay ka samaysnaayeen rooti yar oo si fiican u nuugi jiray maraqa cuntada." Inkasta oo laga yaabo in ay kala duwan yihiin haddana, Soomaalida ayaa ka mid ah dadka aadka u jecel cuntadan malawaxa ah ee aadka u jilicdasan, islamarkaana waxa si weyn loogu cunaa subag ama malab. Waa mid ka mid ah cuntooyinka ugu caansan meelo badan oo ay Soomaalidu joogto. Keliya subag laguma cuno ee malawaxa waxaa lagu cunaa cuntooyin kale oo badan sida hilib, fuul ama shaah. Way adag tahay in laga waayo miisaska Soomaalida gaar ahaan xilliyada quraacda ama cashada. Waxa laga helaa guryaha, hoteellada iyo makhaayadaha, waxaana lagu diyaariyaa bur, caano, ukum iyo saliid ama subag, iyadoo lagu dubo digsi kulul. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa laga yaabaa in ay dad badan u noqoto arrin cusub in malawaxa maanta qof walba heli karo ay hore u ahaan jirtay cunto si gaar ah loogu sameeyo guryaha iyo munaasabadaha qaarkood. Haddaba, sidee ayay malawax-du uga soo baxday jikada dhaqanka una noqotay cunto maalinle ah oo miis walba taalla?

Maxay da’yartu haatan ugu laabanayaan telefoonnadii hore? Telefoonnada casriga ah ayaa kuu sheegi kara qiyaasta waqtiga aad ku bixiso isticmaalka telefoonkaaga maalin walba. Waxay sababi kartaa inaad xaqiiqsan weyso, aaladdii loogu talogalay inay kuu noqoto qeyb teknolojiyadda ka tirsan oo waxtar leh inay noqoto wax aad la qabsato ood ka maarmi weydo. “Baraha bulshada waxaa lagu dhisay FOMO (cabsida inaad ka maqnaato), marka waxaan dareemay inaan ka bixi karin,” ayuu Luke Martin, oo jir ah kana soo jeeda Canada, u sheegay BBC. “Degdeg ayaan u helay Instagram xaalkuna wuu ka sii darayay.” Sida lagu xusay daraasad ay sameysay Harvard University, isticmaalka baraha bulshada ayaa shidda isla qeybta maskaxda ee sidoo kale shaqeysa marka la isticmaalayo daroogo la qabsi leh. Tan ayaa dhalisay walaacyo ku saabsan dhaqamada isticmaalka telefoonnada ee dhalinyarada. Gudaha UK, baaritaan ay sameysay Ofcom ayaa ku qiyaaseysa in ilaa rubuc ka mid ah carruurta da’doodu tahay shan ilaa toddoba ay haatan leeyihiin telefoon casri ah oo u gaar ah. Daraasadaha qaar ayaa isla xiriirinaya isticmaalka baraha bulshada iyo saameyn taban ah oo caafimaadka maskaxda ah – gaar ahaanna carruurta. Dadka qaar ee u ololeeya yareynta isticmaalka telefoonnada casriga ah ayaa doonaya in la xaddido da’da. Qaar kale, sida Luke, ayaa dooranaya inay telefoonnadooda uga guuraan kuwo fudud. Telefoonkiisa cusub wuxuu keliya leeyahay qeybaha farriimaha, wicitaanka, khariidadda, iyo aalado kale oo yar oo xaddidan. “Isticmaalka telefoonka ee saaxiibbadey waxaan u maleynayaa waa sida afar ilaa shan saacadood, taasina waa inta aan aniguba sameyn jiray kahor inta aan helin kan,” ayuu yiri. “Haatan isticmaalkeygu waa daqiiqo maalinrii taasoo runtii fiican sababtoo ah waxaan keliya isticmaalaa marka aan u baahdo.” Waaliddiinta ayaa sidoo kale u weecanaya telefoonnadan qaddiimiga ah, keliya maaha carruurtoda dartood, balse si ay uga caawiyaan waqti la qaadashada qoysaskooda. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Lizzy Broughton, oo heysata wiil shan jir ah, ayaa dhowaan iibsatay telefoon nooca Nokia ah. “Waxay iga caawisay inaan isbeddel ku sameeyo caadooyinkeyga gaarka ah, waqti aad uga fiicna kii hore ayaan u hayaa wiilkeyga,” ayay tiri. Waxay sheegtay in marka la gaaro inuu telefoon yeesho, ay isla keeda oo kale u doori doonto. “Uma muuqayo sida fekradda ugu fiican inaad ku billowdo telefoon casri ah,” ayay tiri. “Waa sida inaan soo wareejineyno adduunka, sida inaan isku dayeyno fahamka sida loo sameeyo taas.” Iibka telefoonnadii hore ayaa kordhay Waqooyiga Ameerika. Dumbwireless oo ku yaalla Los Angeles, milkiilayaasha dukaamadaaas Daisy Krigbaum iyo Will Stults ayaa u adeega macaamiisha doonaya qalab teknolojiyaddiisu hooseyso. “Waxaa noo yimaada waaliddiin badan oo doonaya inay telefoonkii ugu horreeyay u iibiyaan ilmahooda, mana doonayaan inay internet-ka ku mashquulaan,” ayuu yiri Balse in la iska daayo telefoonka casriga ah waa ka adag tahay sida loo maleynayo. Mr Stults ayaa sheegay in iskuullada qaar ayaa ardayda ka doonayaan inay heystaan app-yada qaar. Waana adag tahay in la sameeyo marka ay carruurtu arkaan saaxiibbadood oo la siiyay telefoonno casri ah oo qaali ah, ayay tiri Ms Broughton. “Waxay dhabtii u baahnaan doontaa koox waaliddiin ah oo dhihi kara, sidan si ka duwan ma u sameyn karnaa?” ayay tiri. Wiilkan yar ee u dhashay Canada ee Luke ayaa sheegaya inuu sii heysan doono telefoonkiisa cusub, taasoo aad la yaab ku noqotay saaxiibbadiis. “Waxay moodaan in wax lala yaabo ay tahay balse anigu saacaddan waxaan taaganahay waxba maaha sababtoo ah aad ayuu ii caawiyay telefoonkan,” ayuu yiri. “Dhabtii waxay haatan gebi ahaanba i geysay meel wanaagsan.” Ayuu yiri isagoo kala jeeday isticmaalka telefoonka qaddiimiga ah ee haatan uu wato.

Muxuu yahay furaha la waayay xalay ee sababay in reer Baladweyne ay biyo ku dhex baryaan? . Magaalooyin katirsan Soomaaliya, saacadihii lasoo dhaafay waxaa ka da’ayay roobab xooggan, iyadoo meelaha qaar ay ku yeesheen saameyn sababtay in laga qaxo xaafadaha xilli habeennimo ah. Magaalada Beledweyne ee caasimadda gobolka Hiiraan, ayaa kamida meelaha ay roobabku qaxa ka dhaliyeen iyadoo dad badan ay daadad soo rogmaday guryaha ugusoo galeen. Xaafadaha Kooshin iyo Xaawo taako ayaa kamida meelaha laga barakacay xilli dambe oo xalay ah, kadib roob da’yay in kabadan saacadood. Dadka degan Xaafadaha Kooshin iyo Xaawa taako, gaar ahaan laamaha Kutiimbo iyo Dhagax jibis ayaa Xalay saqdii dhaxe mar qura kusoo toosay guryaha oo ay u dhex ceegagaan biyo aad u fara badan, waxaana dadkaasi gurmad biyaha looga samatabixiyay u sameeyay dhalinyarada magaalada Baledweyne. Mid kamida kanaallada loogu talagalay in ay biyaha daadadkan oo kale ah ka baxaan ayaa xirnaa, iyadoo dad qaar ay sheegayaan in la waayay qofkii furaha hayay hase yeeshee markii dambe lagu guuleystay in lafuro. “Intii ay daadadku socdeen oo aan ku guda jirnay samatabixinta, waxa aan maqlanay in uu xiranyahay kanaalkii loogu tala galay in ay ka baxaan biyahan reeraha ku rogmaday, waxaa la waayay qofkii furaha hayay," ayuu yiri Macoow oo kamid ah dhallinyaro saqdhexe u kacay inay garab siiyeen qoysaska biyhu qaadeen. Kanaalka biya xireenka kiliga Dhagax jebis oo loogu tala galay biyaha soo rogmada iney wabiga ku xareeyaan ayuu ahaa kan xiran sida ay noo sheegeen dadkii aan waeysay. Maadaama uu ahaa roobku mid xooggan albaabka kanaalkuna uusan markiiba wada gudbin Karin biyaha xowliga ah ayayna sababta ku sheegeen loogu baahday in kanaalka la furo. Waxaan isku daynay inaan la xiriirno ninkii hayay furaha kanaalka, balse nooma aysan suuragalin. Daadadkaan ayaa imaanay xilliya dhawaan ay dawladda Soomaaliya ka digtay duufaano iyo dabaylo laga yaabo inay waxyeello xoog leh sababaan, balse cidina ma xaqiijin karto in roobabkii xalay ay yihiin kuwii laga digayay. Macoow Maxmed Dhicisoow oo ka mid ahaa dadkii xalay gacanta ka geystay samata bixinta dadka ay daadadku guryaha ugu galeen, ayaa sheegay in roobab ilaa shalay ka da'ayay magaalada ay sababeen in saqdii dhexe ay dadad soo rogmadaan. "Waxaa nasoo gaartay qaylo dhaan, anaga oo badan oo dhallinyarada magaalada ah ayaa ku baxnay, waxaa noo suuragashay in dad badan oo guryo ku go’doonsanaa aan soo saarno," ayuu BBC da u sheegay. Waxaa jira khasaare ka dhashay daadadka, kadib markii badan ay awoodi waayaan in ay bad-baadiyaan xoolihii ugu guryaha xirnaa, halkaana ay uga cararaan. Sahro Maxamed Xasan, waa hooyo dhowr carruur ah heysata, waxa ay kamid eheed dadkii xalay ka barakacay daadadka, ee xalay biyuhu ugu soo galeen guriga. “Anagoo jiifna ayan ku kacnay qaylo dhaan, saacaddu waxa ay ahayd qiyaastii, toddobo saac - dii saqda dhexe," ayay tiri Sahro. "waa soo barakacnay, waxaa ilmaha ilasoo qaaday wiil yar oo marti noo ahaa iyo dhallinyaro, waxa hadda aan joognaa meel duur ah oo magaalada dusheeda ah halkaas aayn salliyo iska dhiganay”. Qoyska Sahro iyo kuwa kale ayaa ku sugan haatan duleedka magaalada iyaga oo wajahaya qorax iyo dandarro nololeed. “Waxa aan qorsheynayaa in aan raadiyo baco aan halkaan ku xirano si hadii uu roob kale imaado aan uga galno oo aan hoy uga dhiganno, ilaa saakay dadkale ayaa soo barakacayay, marka halkaan ayaan joogi doonnaa ilaa uu xaalku si, isku bedelo, ayey sii raacisay”. Viagra: Barnaamijka BBC maka caawin karaa ragga inay ka hadlaan tabaryarida ragannimada? Waa ruwaayadda BBC ee uu soo saaraha ka yahay Russell T Davies taasoo ku saabsan waxa yar ee laga ogyahay tijaabadii kaniiniga kordhiya awoodda ragga ee Viagra oo la rajeynayo inay ragga ka caawiso inay ka hadlaan awood-yarida ragannimada. Men Up waxaa dhiirrigelinaya ragga "geesiyaasha ah" ee tijaabiyay kaniiniga noqday Viagra xilli in laga hadlo arrimaha tabardarrida ragga ay ahayd mid ceeb ah si xitaa ka daran sida ay maanta tahay. Dhaqaatiirta iyo ka qeyb qaatayaasha Men Up ayaa rajeynaya in barnaamijkan uu ragga ka caawiyo soo afjaridda ceebeynta arrintan. Khubarrada ayaa sheegaya in wacyigelinta ragannimada ay u baahan tahay hormuud sida ay Davina McCall uga caawisay haweenka ka hadalka caado go’a. Awood-yarida ragannimada ayaa saameyn karta kala bar ragga ay da’doodu ka weyn tahay , sida ay sheegtay waaxda caafimaadka bulshada UK ee NHS. Balse ragga ayaa looga digayaa in xaaladdan laga yaabo inay calaamad u tahay dhibaatooyin caafimaad oo qoto dheer, ayna tahay inay sida ugu dhaqsiyaha badan dhaqtar u arkaan. "Rag ahaan, gaar ahaan kuma wanaagsanin ka hadalka dareemaheenna iyo arrimaha noocan ah," ayuu yiri xiddigga Men Up iyo Game of Thrones Iwan Rheon. "Waxaa jira in in badan xoogga la saarayo caafimaadka maskaxda ee ragga waana muhiim dhabtii in sheekadan hadda la sheego." Men Up waa ruwaayad ay BBC-du bilaabeyso waxaana qeyb ka ah ilaa shan nin oo caadi ah oo ka qeyb qaadanaya tijaabada daawo cusub oo awoodda ragannimada ah. "Waxay ahayd geesinnimo saa’id ah oo ay raggan muujiyeen inay diyaar ugu yihiin tijaabadan oo kale," ayuu yiri jilaaga Dunkirk Aneurin Barnard, oo qeyb ka ah Men Up. "Gaar ahaan bulshada dhexdeeda xilligan oo ka hadalka awood-yarida ragannimada ay tahay mid aan suurtogal ahayn. "Balse waxay dhammaantood raadinayaan inay helaan wax ay lumiyeen – taasi waa waxa awoodda leh. "Waa dad caadi ah oo isku dayaya inay dib u hantaan ragannimadooda, kalsoonidooda." Inkastoo xitaa tabar-darrida ragannimada ay tahay xaalad ku badan ragga waaweyn, bukaannada ayaa ka cago jiida inay ka hadlaan dhibaatooyinkooda – xitaa marka ay la joogaan khubarrada caafimaadka – taasina waxay saameyneysaa caafimaadka. , BBC / QUAY STREET PRODUCTIONS / TOM JACKSON Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Marka maaddaama in ka badan kala bar ragga ka weyn -ka sano laga yaabo inay saameyso awood-yarida ragannimada, dhaqaatiirta ayaa kusoo biiray jilaayada Men Up waxayna ragga ku boorriyeen inaysan ka xishoon iyagoo eegaya faa’iidada ay u leedahay caafimaadkooda – iyo xiriirradooda. "Aad ayay ragga ugu adag tahay inay xaqiiqsadaan inaysan ka dhigneyn inaadan rag ahayn haddii aad qabto awood-yarida ragannimada," ayuu yiri khabiir sare oo caafimaadka ragga ah Dr Jeff Foster. "Waxaa jiri kara sababo caafimaad oo dhab ah maaddaama % kiisaska ay leeyihiin sababo dabiici ah, sida xanuunka macaanka, xanuunka wadnaha amaba hoormoonka testosterone oo yar. Sawirka, DR JEFF FOSTER Dr Foster ayaa xarun la tacaasha tabaryarida ragannimada ku leh Royal Leamington Spa, Warwickshire, celcelis ahaanna, bukaannadiisa , -ka gaaraya ee xaaladdan qaba ayaa waxay ku qaadataa saddex sano inay isaga rakaan. "Tabaryarida ragannimada iyo arrimaha la xiriira galmada ee ragga waa wax aad looga xishoodo gudaha UK," ayuu intaa raaciyay Dr Foster, oo xubin ka ah Bahda Britain ee Caafimaadka Galmada. "Haddii aad qabi lahayd inta badan xaaladaha cafimaadka, maadan sugi lahayn saddex sano kahor inta aadan u tagin dhaqtar. Sawirka, BBC/QUAY STREET PRODUCTIONS/TOM JACKSON Inta badan ragga ayay mararka qaar lasoo gudboonaataa tabar-darri tanna waxaa caadi ahaan sababa isku buuq, daal, cabid badan oo aalkolo ah amaba saameyn ka dhalatay daawooyinka qaar – mana aha wax laga walwalo. Haddii xaaladdan ay soo laalaabato, waxaa laga yaabaa inay ka dhalatay xaaladaha sida dhiig-karka amaba kolostarool sare, sokorowga, isku buuqa amaba walbahaarka iyo dhibaatooyin hoormoonka ah. Muxuu yahay xanuunka cusub ee laga baqayo in sida Corona uu dunida ku faafo? Hoggaamiyeyaasha caafimaadka warshadaha ayaa ku sugan magaalada Davos ee dalka Switzerland iyagoo ka wada xaajoonayay muhiimadda qorsheynta xanuun kale oo safmar ah oo dillaaca, waana kan loogu yeero "Cudurka X". Balse muxuu yahay xanuunkan cusub ee safmarka ah annaguna diyaar ma u nahay? Bishii November , Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka ayaa isu keenay in ka badan oo saynisyahanno ah si ay ugu kuurgalaan caddeymaha in ka badan bakteeriyo oo sababi kara inay xanuunno dillaacaan. Ururka ayaa daah-furay hannaan calami ah oo lagu cusbooneysiinayo liiska fayrasyada sababi kara inay dillaacaan cudurro iyo xanuunno safmar ah, si loo jiheeyo maalgashiga dunida, baaritaanka iyo horumarinta, gaar ahaanna tallaallada, baaritaannada iyo daaweynta. Eray-bixinta “Cudurka X” ayaa loo adeegsaday in loogu yeero xanuunka aan la aqoon ee sababi kara inuu dunida aad ugu faafo. Ma ahan cudur gaar ah, balse waa eray-bixin loo adeegsanayo baaritaanka, u kuurgelidda iyo u diyaargarowga si loo ogaado wuxuu yahay loogana falceliyo. Waa magac ku meel gaar ah oo loo adeegsanayo in lagu ogaado xanuun mustaqbalka dillaaci kara oo sababi kara inuu dunida ku faafo, loogumana talogelin in magacan loo adeegsado cudur gaar ah. Madaxa hay’adda Ammaanka Caafimaadka ee UK Jenny Harris ayaa sheegtay in sababta eraygan loo adeegsaday ay tahay in saynisyahannadu "aysan aqoon waxa xiga ee sababi kara xanuun faafa", iyadoo xarafka X-na uu u dhigan yahay sida aan la aqoon ee uu cudurka noqon doono, iyo baahida loo qabo in loogu diyaar garoobo oo laga feejignaado. Dadaalladan ayaa ka dhigan qaab garwaaqsasho ah oo sheegaya in mar walba ay jirayaan suurtogalnimada cudurro cusub oo leh dabeecado aan la qiyaasi karin. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. “Iyadoo bani’aadannimadu ay Meesha ka saareyso xannibaadda u dhaxeysa aadmiga iyo nooleyaasha kale iyadoo loo marayo suuqyada xayawaanka iyo xaalufinta, waxana u baahannahay u kuurgelidda oo lasii wado, darsidda, iyo hagaajinta amniga deegaanka ee guud ahaan dunida,” ayay intaa raacisay. Erayga "Cudurka X" ayaa aad loogu hadal hayay baraha bulshada, gaar ahaan dalka Mareykanka. Dadka isticmaalaha baraha bulshada ayaa ka digay in u diyaar-garowga xanuunkan aan la aqoon ay u dhigmi doonto tallaabooyin la mid ah xayiraadaha intii uu socsay safmarka Covid- ." Tallaabooyinkan ayaa aad looga cambaareeyay gudaha Mareykanka iyo Yurub, iyadoo dadka qaar ay aaminsna yihiin in safmarkii Corona uu yahay wax lasoo abaabulay. Monica Crowley, oo maamulkii Trump u qaabilsaneyd arrimaha maaliyadda iyo bulshada, ayaa qoraal ay soo dhigtay barta X ku sheegtay in “caabuqa cusub uu hoggaamiyeyaasha caalamka u oggolaan doono hirgelinta xayiraado guud, xannibaadda xorriyatul-qowlka, uuna burburiyo xorriyado badan.” "Marka cadowgaaga ay kuu sheegaan waxa ay qorsheynayaan, rumeyso una diyaar garow," ayay intaas raacisay. Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka ayaa cudur u yaqaanna fayraska Nipah, cudurka henipavirus, xummadda Rift Valley, iyo fayraska Zika. WHO ayaa ahmiyad siisay baaritaanka iyo horumarinta marka la eego sida ay degdegga u yihiin dhammaan xanuunnadaan, iyadoo la doonayo in baaritaan qoto-dheer lagu sameeyo goor horena loo diyaargaroobo. Bare sare Andrew Pollard, Madaxa Kooxda Tallaalka Oxford, ayaa warbaahinta Sky News u sheegay inay u badan tahay in mustaqbalka ay dillaacaan xanuunno safmar ah sababo la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada. Wuxuu intaa ku daray, "Dabcan waa suurtogal in la go’aansado xilliga ay tan dhaceyso, balse xaaladaha aan horteenna ku aragno ayaa laga yaabaa inay suurtogelin karaan." Wuxuu sharraxaad ka bixiyay sababta xanuunno badan oo safmar ah looga yaabo inay dillaacaan mustaqbalka isgaoo yiri: “Waan ognahay in isbeddelka cimilada uu sababayo bakteeriyo iyo fayrasyo cusub inay deegaankeenna ka dillaacaan. Waxaa sidoo kale jirta deegaameyn. Iyadoo bani’aadamku ay aad ugu guurayaan meelaha xayawaannada, waxaan kordhineynaa khatarta inay tan dhacdo.” Wuxuu sheegay sidaan aragnay Covid- , ay dadka aadka u badan horseedaan xanuunno safmar ah: “Haatan ilaa bilyan oo qof ayaan dunidan ku saarannahay. Ilaa -ka sano ee soo socda waxaan ka badnaan doonnaa bilyan.” Ayuu yiri.

Suurogal ma tahay in go'aanadii ka soo baxay shirkii wadatashiga qaran hirgalaan iyadoo Puntland ay qaadacday? , BARAHA BULSHADA Maamulka Puntland ayaa si wayn uga soo horjeestay go'aanadii xalay ka soo baxay shirkii wadatashiga qaran ee Muqdisho lagu soo gabagabeeyay. Madaxwaynaha maamul goboleedka Puntland Saciid Cabdulahi Deni oo maanta khudbad jeedinayay ayaa sheegay in Puntland aysan qeyb ka ahayn go'aanadaasi. Mr Deni ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in go'aanadii ka soo baxay shirkii wadatashiga qaran uusan Puntland quseyn. "Waxaa aad ii dhibeysa marin habaabinta hoggaanka dalka ka socota, waxaan rabaa halkan inaan ka caddeeyo waxyaabaha golaha wadatashiga qaranka ka socda wax Puntland ay qeyb ama raalli ka tahay ma aha " ayuu yir Deni. Go'aanadii shirka ka soo baxay ayuu madaxwayne Deni ku tilmaamay kuwa ay dhowr qof gaareen oo aysan Puntland quseyn. Dhowr qof go'aano ay soo saareen oo aan runtii ka turjumeyn bulshada dareenkeeda, waxaa weeye waqtiga umbey sii dileysaa, waxaan rajeynayaa in uu caqligu taliyo. Waaxaa uu madaxwayne Deni ugu baaqay hay'adaha dowladda ee kala duwan inay isu yimaadaan islamarkana go'aano laga soo saro. "Waxan u baahanahay golayaasha dowladda hogaaminaya in madallo noocan oo kale ah isu yimaadan laga wada qeyb galiyo dhammaan dadka oo war cad laga soo saaro," ayuu ku nuuxnuuxsaday." Sawirka, Puntland State House Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Madaxwaynha Puntland ayaa farta ku fiiqay in loo baahan yahay in laga dhabeeyo midnimada iyo wadajirka dalka taasi oo ah wax mar walba laga hadlo. "Dalka Soomaaliyeed runtii waan ku celcelinaa midnimadu waa muqadas, wadajirku waa sidan laakiin shaqo ku wajahan arrintaasi oo ah sidii dadka la isugu soo dhaweyn lahaa aad uma muuqato, bal ee waxaa muuqata dadka Soomaaliyeed sidii loo kala irdheyn lahaa ayaa aad u muuqaneysa," ayuu intaa ku daray. Madaxwayne Deni ayaa xusay in maamulkiisu uu ka shaqeyn doono sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa midnimada Puntland islamarkana looga shaqeyn lahaa danta guud ee dalka. "Puntland waxaa Alle haddii uu idmo ballan u ah, ninkii tiisa daryeelaa tu kale ku daree la yiriyee in midnimada iyo wadajirka Puntland la adkeeyo oo hadafka kowaad noqdo, sidii caadada u ahayd dowladda Puntland baadigoobka dowladda Soomaaliyeed inaysan ka daalin," ayuu yiri madaxwayne Deni. Hadalka madaxwaynaha Puntland ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli xalay magaalada Muqdisho lagu soo gebagabeeyay shirka wadatashiga qaran. Warmurtiyeedkii xalay ka soo baxay shirka ayaa lagu sheegay in intii u shirka socday la faaqiday arrimo badan oo ay ka mdi yihiin amniga, siyaasadda iyo shuruucda dalka. Waxaa sidoo kale sida warmurtiyeedka lagu xusay ay golaha wadatashiga qaranka bogaadiyeen ansaxinta baarlamaanka federaalka ay ansixiyeen afar cutub oo dastuurka ka mid ah. Intii uu shirka socday waxaa sidoo kale warbixinno laga dhageystay hogaamiyaha maamulka kumeelgaarka ee Khaatuma oo ka warbixiyay xaaladda deegaanadaasi. Shirkan kama qeyb galin maamulka Puntland oo muddooyiinkii u dambeeyay uu khilaaf kala dhaxeeyay dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Sawirka, VILLA SOMALIA Khubarada qaar ayaa ka digaya in uu hirgali waayo qodobada laga soo saaray shirka wadatashiga qaran. Waxaa ku xusan warmurtiyeedka shalay soo baxay in la dardargaliyo dhaqangalinta heshiisyadii hore ay madashu u gaareen. Maxamed Mukhtaar Ibraahim oo ka faalooda arrimaha siyaasadda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in warmurtiyeedka sida ka muuqta aan la hirgalin waxyaabihii horey loogu heshiiyay. "Go'aanka laftirkiisa ka soo baxay markaad aragto qodob waxaa ku jira dhahaya waa in la meelmariyo go'aanadii horey loo gaaray ama heshiisyadii horey loo gaaray taas micnaheedu waxay tahay inay jiraan heshiisyo horey loo gaaray oo aan fulin," ayuu yiri Mr Mukhtaar. Mr Mukhtaar ayaa intaa ku daray in loo baahan yahay in madaxda ay badiyaan kulamadooda si xal looga gaaro arrimo badan oo wali taagan lana fuliyo waxyaabaha lagu heshiiyay. "Waxaa ugu muhiimsan waxay tahay in kulankooda ay badiyaan midda labaad in wixii lagu heshiiyay la meelmariyo," ayuu intaa ku daray. Waxaa uu intaa ku daray in ay muhiim tahay in Puntland la raadiyo si ay go'aanada qeyb uga noqdaan. "Waa in laga shaqeeyaa sidii Puntland qeyb kaga noqon lahayd go'aamada masiiriga ah ee dalka looga gaarayo arrimahaasi ayaa u muhiimsan"

Lix arrimood oo naadir ah oo ku saabsan Wabarka beesha Dagoodiye , Aden Ducaale Wabarka beesha Dagoodiye, Wabar Cabdile Wabar Cabdi oo maalma kahor si aad ah loogu soo dhaweeyay Kenya ayaa la kulmayay qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada oo ay ka mid yihiin siyaasiyiinta iyo odayaasha dhaqanka. Boqorka oo soo dhaweyntiisa iyo hab maamuuska ay u muuqdeen kuwo ka duwan boqorada iyo ugaasyada kale ee Soomaalida. Waxaan halkan idiinkugu soo gudbineynaa lixsiyaabood oo uu kaga duwan yahay odayaal dhaqameedyada Soomaalida. Wabarka beesha Dagoodiye wuxuu la kulmay madaxweynaha Kenya, Uhuru Kenyatta oo sheegay: "Waxaan u baahan nahay in aan wada noolaano inagoo walaalo ah oo xushmeyneyno dhammaan bulshooyiinka gobolka." Wabar Cabdile wuxuu hoggaamiye dhaqameed u yahay dhamaan beesha uu ka dhashay ee ku kala nool bariga Afrika iyo kuwa ku nool qeybaha kale ee dunida, Wuxuuna mas'uul ka yahay hawlaha beesha. "Wuxuu mideeyaa dhammaan reerkaas meel walba oo ay dunida ka joogaan, wuxuu leeyahay wakiilo isaga uu u wakiisho xalinta dhibaatooyinka ka taagan deegaanada reerka uu dego, kuwaas oo u fariista garta deegannaada fogfog ee uusan gaari karin wabarka", ayuu yiri afhayeenka Wabarka, Macallin Cumar Macallin Bisin. Arrinta waxaa loo arkaa in ay ka duwan tahay qaabka ay qaar ka mid ah beelaha kale ee Soomaalida u sameystaan oday dhaqameedyada iyo sida ay u howlgalaan. Waxay beel walba meesha ay deggan tahay ku sameysataa oday dhaqameed hadba ka taliya danaha reerkaas iyo halka ay degan yihiin, waxaana mararka qaar la arkaa dad isku beel ah oo ku kala nool deegaanno kala duwan in ay yeeshaan odayaal dhaqameedyo badan oo aan isla howlgalin, sida ay qabaan dadka khubarada ku ah arrimaha dhaqanka Soomaalida. Sawirka, Aden Ducaale Afhayeenkiisa ayaa sidoo kale BBC-da u sheegay in Wabarka uu leeyahay gole guurti oo la shaqeeya, kuwaas oo u soo gudbiya waxyaabaha ay tahay in uu go'aan ka gaaro. Marka ay timaado go'aan gaarista arrimaha beeshiisa, wuxuu sheegay in Wabar Cabdile uu yahay qofka ugu dambeeya ee go'aankaas gaari kara. Wuxu intaa ku daray in inkastoo odayaasha dhaqanka marka hore loo gudbiyo arrintan oo ay soo jeediyaan talada ay u arkaan in ay tahay macquul, haddana wixii uu Wabarka ku qanci waaya, wuxuu xaq u leeyahay in uu gaaro go'aan aanan laga daba hadli karin, wax racfaan ahna aanan laga qaadan karin. Waa naadir in qaar ka mid ah beelaha Soomaalida lagu arko oday dhaqameed beeshiisa u gaara go'aanka kama dambeysta, oo waxaa inta badan la arkaa in odayaasha ay ku dhaqaqaan tala loo dhan yahay. Inta badan odayaasha dhaqanka ee Soomaalida waa kuwa marka ay hadlayaan aad loo dhageysto, wakhti badan la siiyo, aadna ugu dheeraada hadalka. Wabar Cabdile Wabar Cabdi waxay dadka ehelka la ah ay shegeen in uusan ahayn qof hadal badan oo uusan ahayn qof khudbad jeediya ama aad ugu hadla xafladaha iyo shirarka. Taas bedelkeeda, wuu ka duceeyaa goobaha la isugu yimaado ee munaasabadaha ay ka dhacayaan. Wuxuu leeyahay afhayeen u hadla oo warbaahinta iyo meelaha hadalka looga baahan yahay ka hadla, kaas oo ay BBC-da la hadashay. Tusaale ahaan, markii ay BBC Somali ay isku dayday in ay wareysi la yeelato Wabarka, waxaa naloo sheegay in uusan hadlin oo uu leeyahay afhayeen wixii hadalna loo wakiishay. Sawirka, Madaxtooyada Kenya Wabar Cabdille Wabar Cabdi, waxyaabaha kale ee uu kaga duwan yahay boqorada ama salaadiinta kale ee Soomaalida waxaa ka mid ah in uu leeyahay lataliyeyaal isaga u gaar ah oo kalataliye arrimaha isku dhacyada qoysaska, bulshada iyo wixii la mid ah. "Wuxuu leeyahay lataliye oo kala taliya arrimaha beesha, waxaana dadkaas laga soo kala xulay jilibyada reerka, kuwaas oo sidoo kale leh guddoomiye, guddoomiye ku xigeen iyo xoghaye, balse go'aanka ugu dambeeya isaga ayaa iskaleh", ayuu raaciyay afhayeenka Wabar, Macallin Cumar oo hadda ka mid ah wafdiga Wabarka ee ku sugan dalka Kenya. Lataliyeyaasha -ka ayaa isugu jira aqoonyahano, culimo, odayaal dhaqameed, ganacsato iyo xoola dhaqato, waxaana tiradooda lagu saleeyay hadba sida ay reerka uu ka dhashay ay u kala badan yihiin. Inkastoo sida afhayeenka Wabarka uu sheegay uu leeyahay xoolo nool, oo uu xoolihiisa raacdo, haddana beeshiisa ayaa marwalba la garab taagan xoolo joogta ah, hanti ahaanna uu u leeyahay guri, babuur, lix boqol oo neef oo geel ah, ari gaaray kun neef iyo saddex boqol oo neef oo lo' ah, sida uu sheegay afhayeenka. Way dhacdaa mararka qaar in beelaha soomaalida ay taageero dhaqaalo siiyaan odayaasha dhaqanka, balse way adag tahay in la arko beel Soomaali ah oo dhaqaale joogta ah la garab taagan oday dhaqameedka. Caafimaadkiisa, noolashiisa iyo waxyaabaha asaasiga ah ee Wabarka uu u baahan yahay, waxaa damaanad qaaday tolka uu ka dhashay, kuwaas oo sannad walba siiya xoolo nool, lacag iyo baabuur. Sawirka, Madaxtooyada Kenya Sannadihii la soo dhaafay, odayaal badan oo Soomaaliyeed ayaa aad ugu dhex milmay siyaasadda, taas oo dadka qaar ay aaminsan yihiin in ay ka duwan tahay waxyaabihii dhaqanka ahaa ee lagu yaqiinay odayaasha dhaqanka ee Soomaalida. Wabar Cabdile, waxaa la sheegay in uusan marnaba faragelin hawlaha siyaasadeed ee beesha uu ka dhashay ama beelaha kale, taas oo ka duwan waxyaabaha sanadahan dambe looga bartay qaar ka mid ah odayaasha dhaqanka. "Wabarka siyaasad wax shaqo kuma lahan, sababtoo ah siyaasadda way iska caddahay oo hal dhinac ayaad la safaneysaa, isaguna ma doonayo in xurmada, karaamada iyo wanaagga ay ummadda u hayaan uu lumiyo, wana taas sababta uusan usoo faragashanin arrimaha siyaasadda". Sidaas waxaa BBC-da u sheegay Afhayeenka Wabarka Sidoo kale safiirka Soomaaliya ee dalka Kenya, Maxamed Axmed Nuur Tarsan oo ka hadlay xafladda lagu soo dhaweynayay Wabar Cabdile ayaa sheegay in odayaasha dhaqanka ee Soomaaliya ay waxbadan ka baraan karaan Wabarka beesha Dagoodiye.

Guidance: User Generated and Social Media Content User generated content has become an essential part of BBC storytelling across the entire output. It plays a central role in most breaking news stories, but it is equally important in many other non-News output – including Children's. It can be still pictures, video or comment; it can be sent directly by users following specific calls to action or be found by searching for it on social media platforms and the wider web. Whatever content the BBC uses, regardless of how it is received, must adhere to the BBC Editorial Guidelines and standards. Content being widely shared or trending on social media may not necessarily make it appropriate for use; its editorial justification and purpose should be considered first. It should not be assumed that any user generated content – whether found on the web or received directly from the audience – is always what it claims to be. It may be fake, it may be genuine footage but of a different incident, it may be just part of the incident or taken from one perspective. In News, in particular, where UGC can play an important part in our output, the BBC must always authenticate any content before it is used. This might include anything from speaking to the individual who filmed the content to using a range of more sophisticated techniques such as geo-location and cross-referencing satellite imagery to interrogate the image itself. The more significant the image is, the more important it is to ensure it is authentic – although the responsibility for due accuracy remains regardless. Advice on verifying any UGC can be obtained from the UGC Hub. In a non-News environment, content producers might ask audience members to send in videos of themselves undertaking particular activities, or they might source similar content from the social web. Producers still have a responsibility to ensure the accuracy of that content before using it, but that might be ascertained in a simple conversation. Audiences should be provided with the relevant information to understand the events within their context, beyond the selective and narrow perspective which UGC may particularly offer. This may include details about the circumstances leading to the incident and its consequences. Nonetheless, BBC content producers should be open and honest about what they do not know or cannot corroborate. The Editorial Guidelines state: Care must be taken with content that may have been supplied by anyone with a vested interest, rather than a disinterested bystander. ( . . ) On highly controversial subjects, some views may be more likely than others to be expressed via UGC or be amplified on social media platforms. The existence of other views and their respective weights should be acknowledged and appropriately reflected. Where content producers ask audiences on social media to share their views or observations, they should be aware of the serendipitous nature of social media that means people may only come across the calls to action by chance. Where content producers are considering using significant content found on social media – such as video of a breaking news event – they should always seek to secure the consent of the owner of the material, even if a Fair Dealing use might be argued. The BBC would not normally pay for the use of such material, other than in exceptional circumstances but producers should be aware of copyright or other legal issues and take appropriate advice when necessary. The owner of the material, wherever and whenever it is used – should always be credited, unless to do so might put the contributor at risk. Any link to the source must be editorially justified, rather than merely being considered as a credit. (See guidance: Links and Feeds) Consent may not always be required to use material when there is a public interest in doing so. However, careful consideration should always be given to the wider editorial justification and the impact of using UGC on a BBC platform that is already being shared extensively on social media. Comment, tweets or posts to BBC channels or otherwise open spaces may be used without the explicit consent of the individual authors. That is particularly the case when individuals are taking part in a public debate or it is clear they understand and are participating in the open nature of social media. Similarly, it is reasonable to use appropriate pictures of individuals taken from their open social media profiles without explicit consent when it is in the public interest. However, potential distress to family and friends should be carefully considered when using pictures of individuals who have died. Even though content may have been posted to social media platforms that have a potential global audience of billions, it is still necessary to consider whether the use of the material respects the privacy of those featured. If the content is filmed openly in a public or even semi-public space then the presumption would generally be that it would be reasonable for the BBC to use. This may still be the case even where the subject is not aware they are being filmed provided there is a public interest. For example, it could be video of vehicle drivers using their mobile phones or other examples of anti-social or illegal behaviour. However, if the content features individuals who might otherwise have a legitimate expectation of privacy, for example if they are receiving medical treatment, or where they are in a private space or the content was clearly not intended for public consumption, respect for their privacy should be maintained - unless a public interest in bringing the material to the audience. It may be appropriate to consider anonymising individuals featured where there remains a public interest in using the material. Where the BBC has asked for contributions from audiences, content producers should act in accordance with data protection laws in handling personal information and take appropriate advice. The BBC should never encourage individuals to break the law or put themselves in danger. It should not normally use material sourced from social media where it is clear individuals have put themselves at unnecessary risk. It should be made clear that contributors should continue to act in the way they would normally do regardless of the fact that they may be creating content that the BBC might use. They should never be encouraged or even 'given permission' to undertake activities they would not normally undertake. This is particularly the case when working with contributors producing longer form personal view or eyewitness content. In breaking news stories, the BBC should be co-ordinated and considerate in approaching individuals on social media for both their consent to use their material and to request any further contribution to the BBC output. It maybe they are still caught up in the incident or dealing with the consequences of it. Children should not be routinely asked to act as newsgatherers for the BBC, but they may be asked to submit content for creative projects or competitions on CBBC or other appropriate outlets. Where children under have been asked to send content directly, the BBC should use its own uploader, where parents have already given permissions for their child to upload content and will notify them every time content is submitted. Where content submitted to the BBC features other children under parental consent must be sought. Where children or young people are featured in content found on social media that is being considered for use, the impact on them should be taken into account. Any online safeguarding concerns that are discovered, whether related to online grooming or child abuse images, must be referred to the Head of Safeguarding and Child Protection immediately.
