DeepSeek: Barnaamijka Shiinaha ee dunidu hadal hayso Barnaamijka lagu sheekeysto ee garaadka macmalka ahi ka shaqeysiiyo ee chatbot oo ay soo saartay shirkadda Shiinaha laga leeyahay ee DeepSeek ayaa durba noqotay app-ka lacag la'aanta ah ee loogu soo degsasho badan yahay Apple store, kadib markii lagu sii daayay suuqa Mareykanka bishan Janaayo. Caannimada degdegga ah ee app-kan, iyo sidoo kale qiimeyaasha hooseeya ee la soo sheegay ee DeepSeek marka la barbardhigo kuwa shirkadaha garaadka macmalka ah ee Mareykanka daggan, waxay ku ridday suuqyada maaliyada hubanti la'aan badan. Dhaqaaleyahanka Silicon Valley ee lagu magacaabo Marc Andressen ayaa u hambalyeeyay DeepSeek maadaama ay tahay buu yiri "mid ka mid ah guulaha ugu cajiibsan" garaadka macmalka ah. Shirkaddu waxay sheegeysaa in moodalladeeda garaadka macmalka ah ee AI ay la siman yihiin moodallada hormuudka ah ee shaqadaan ee gudaha Mareykanka – sida ChatGPT – ayadoo lagu hagaajiyay qeyb un ka mid ah qiimihii ay ku kaceen. Cilmibaareyaal ka dambeeyay app-ka ayaa sheegay in lagu bixiyay $6m (£ .8m) samaynta, taasoo aad uga yar balaayiinta ay bixiyeen shirkadaha garaadka macmalka ah ee Mareykanka. DeepSeek waa shirkad ka shaqeysa garaadka macmalka ah oo laga leeyahay Shiinaha oo laga aasaasay gudaha Hangzhou, taasi oo ah mid ka mid ah caasimadaha koofurta bari ee dalka Shiinaha. Shirkadda ayaa la daah furay Luulyo , laakiin app-keeda caawinta ee caanka ah ee garaadka macmalka ah laguma sii deyn gudaha Mareykanka wixii ka horreeyay 10kii Janaayo, marka loo eego Sensor Tower oo ah raadeerka app-ka. Liang Wenfeng ayaa qeyb ahaan maalgashay DeepSeek asagoo isticmaalay qarash maalgaliyeyaal laga soo kala uruurshay lacagtaasi oo uu sidoo kale daahfuray. Ninkaasi oo jir ah, ahna qof ka soo qalin jebiyay injineerinka korontada, ayaa sida la soo tebiyay sameeyay keydka qalabka chips-ka ee elektaroonigga ah ee kaararka u eg ee Nvidia A100 chips, oo haatan la mamnuucay in loo dhoofsho Shiinaha. Khubaro ayaa aaminsan in soo uruurintaa – oo lagu qiyaasay ilaa , – ay horseeday daahfurka DeepSeek, ayadoo lagu darayo chips-kaas kuwo ka qiime jaban, oo ka yara taya hooseeya oo wali lasoo dejin karo. Mr Liang ayaa dhawaan lagu arkay shir u dhexeeyay khubarada shaqadaasi qaabilsan iyo raisulwasaaraha Shiinaha Li Qiang. App-kaas ayaa laga soo degsan karaa Apple App Store iyo internetka gaar ahaan mareegta shirkadaas. Adeegga oo bilaash ama lacag la'aan ah ayaa durba noqday waxa ugu badan ee lagala soo dego Apple store, inkastoo ay jiraan warbixino ku saabsan dad inay diiwaan gashadaan ay ku adag tahay. Sidoo kale wuxuu noqday barnaamij app ah oo aad iyo aad looga helay loona ammaanay gudaha Mareykanka kaasi oo ku jira Apple app store. DeepSeek waxay caan ku noqotay kaalmadeeda xooggan ee garaadka macmalka ah ee AI oo u shaqeysa sida ChatGPT. Marka loo eego sharraxaadeeda kujirta App Store, waxaa loogu tala galay "ka jawaabitaanka su'aalaha iyo sare u qaaditaanka waxtarka nolosha". Fikrado ay ka soo dhiibteen isticmaaleyaasha oo buundooyin siiyay app-ka ayaa sheegay "in qoraalka uu siiyo app-ku caanimo intii hore ka badan". Laakiin chatbot ayaa jaray ama u gooyay oo aanan ka jawaabin hal su'aal oo dhanka siyaasada ku saabsan oo xasaasi ah. Markii BBC ay su'aashay app-ka waxa ka dhacay Tiananmen Square Juunyo , DeepSeek ayaa ku jawaabtay: "Waan ka xumahay, oo anigu kama jawaabi karo su'aashaas. Waxaan ahay cawimaad dhanka garaadka macmalka ah oo bixisa jawaabo cawimad badan oo aan dhibaato lahayn." Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. DeepSeek waxaa la soo sheegay inay ku samaysay qeyb un ka mid ah qiimaha ay shirkadaha Mareykanka ee tartanku kala dhexeeyo ay ku sameeyeen barnaamijyada kaa la mid ah – boqolaal milyan oo doollarka Mareykanka ah ayaa farqiga u dhexeeyaahi yahay – taasi oo keentay su'aalo ku saabsan mustaqbalka awoodda garaadka macmalka ah ee Mareykanka. Kharashaadka hooseeya sida suurtagalka ah ee shirkadda ayaa qasay suuqyada maaliyadda 27kii Jan, taasi oo horseeday miisaanka culus ee teknoolojiyada Nasdaq inuu hoos u dhaco in ka badan boqolkiiba iibin ballaaran oo ay ku lug lahaayeen dadka sameeya chips-ka iyo xarumo internet oo ku kala yaala daafaha caalamka. Nvidia, oo ah shirkad fadhigeedu yahay Mareykanka oo sameysa chips-yada awooda badan ee maamula garaadka macmalka ah, ayaa u muuqata in ay gaartay khasaarihii ugu darnaa. Waxay lumisay ku dhawaad $ oo bilyan qiimaha suuqa Isniintii – taasoo ah hoos u dhaca hal maalin ee ugu weyn ee shirkad kasta taariikhda Mareykanka - iyadoo qiimaha saamiyadeedu uu hoos u dhacay % intii lagu jiray maalinta. Nvidia waxay ahayd shirkadda ugu qiimaha badan adduunka, marka lagu qiyaaso suuq-geynta, laakiin waxay ku dhacday kaalinta saddexaad ka dib Apple iyo Microsoft Isniintii markii qiimaha suuqeedu hoos ugu dhacay $ . tiriliyoon halkii uu ka ahaa $ . tiriliyoon, Forbes sida ay soo tebisay. DeepSeek waxay isticmaashaa chips korontada yara gudbiya oo ka yara taya hooseeya kuwa ay soo saartay Nvidia. Guusha ay gaartay waxay hoos u dhigtay aaminaada ah in miisaaniyadaha waaweyn iyo chips-yada heerka sare gaarsiisan ay un yihiin siyaabaha kaliya ee lagu hormarinayo garaadka macmalka ah, waana rajo abuurtay hubanti la'aan weyn oo ku saabsan baahida iyo mustaqbalka chip-waxqabad sare leh.

Waa kee dalka kaalinta 1aad ka galay "farxadda dunida" muxuuse ku mutaystay Finland ayaa noqotay sannadkii 8aad oo xiriir ah dalka ugu horreeya ee dadkiisu ay dunida ugu farxadda badan yihiin, ayadoo khubaradu ay taa la xiriirinayaan ayadoo dadka dalkaas ay ka helaan dabeecadda, iyo hanaanka cayrta oo ah mid aad u fiican. Waxay ka hormartay dalalka kale ee seddexda ah ee la isku yiraahdo Nordic, sida lagu xusay warbixin ay Qaramada Midoobay taageeraysay oo ku saabsan farxadda dunida, halka Costa Rica iyo Mexico ee qaaradda Latin America ay soo galeen markii ugu horreysay 10ka dal ee ugu horreeya. UK iyo Maraykanka waxay hoos ugu dheceen kaalimaha iyo , ayadoo Maraykanku gaaray heerkii ugu hooseeyey abid. Daraasaddan ayaa sidoo kale lagu ogaaday in dadka ajnabiga ah ay ka naxariis badan yihiin laba-laab marka la eego fikradda ay dadku ka haystaan. Halbeegga lagu qiyaasay ayaa ah in si ula kac ah loo lumiyey boorsada yar ee lacagta lagu qaato, si loo eego inta xabbo ee inta la helo dib loo soo celiyo, ayadoo la barbar dhigayo tirada dadka rajada ka qaba inay helaan. Tirada boorsooyinkaas ee la soo celiyey ayaa laba goor ka badan sidii ay dadka iyo daraasadduba sii saadaaliyeen, ayadoo caddaymo laga soo uruuriyey dunida oo dhan lagu ogaaday si ka duwan sidii hore in rumaysashada naxariista dadka kale ay aad ugu xiran tahay farxadda. Warbixinta farxadda dunida ee 13aad ayaa la shaaciyey ayadoo la xusayo maalinta caalamiga ah ee Qaramada midoobay ay u astaysay farxadda, taasoo kaalimo kala gelisa dalalka caalamka ayadoo dadka la weydiinayo inay qiimeeyaan noloshooda. Finland waxay keentay . dhibcood ayadoo dhibacaha ugu badan ay yihiin , waxaana kaalinta 2aad gashay Denmark. Khubarada waxay sheegayaan in dalalka Costa Rica iyo Mexico marka la eego lala xiriirinayo isku xirnaanshaha adag ee qoysaska. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Daraasadda oo ay daabacday Jaamacadda Oxford ayaa dadka lagu weydiistay inay noloshooda kala geliyaan kaalimaha – , ayadoo ay tahay tan ugu liidata, halka ay tahay nolosha ugu fiican. 10ka dal ee ugu hoorreeya ayaa noqday. Warbixinta farxadda dunida ee waxaa kaloo lagu ogaaday: Hoos u dhac ku yimid farxadda iyo kalsoonida bulshada ee Maraykanka iyo qaybo Yurub ka tirsan, taasoo muujinaysa sare u kaca iyo jihada kala qaybsanaanta siyaasadeed. Cuntada oo la wada cuno ayaa aad loola xiriiriyey niyad wanaagga caalamka. Baaxadda qoysaska ayaa lala xiriiriyey farxadda, ayadoo ama qof oo wada nool ay yihiin kuwo ku nool heerka ugu sarreeya farxadda, gaar ahaan Mexico iyo Yurub. Jeffrey D Sachs oo ah guddoomiyaha UN sustainable development solution network ayaa sheegay in waxyaabaha ay warbixinta soo bandhigtay ay mar kale xaqiijimnayaan "in farxaddu ay xididdo ku leedahay kalsoonida, naxariista iyo isku xirka bulshada". "Innaga ayey naga falantaa ka bulsho ahaan in aan u fasiranno xaqiiqdaas na hortaalla ficillo taban, ayadoo taa ay keenayso in la kobciyo nabadda, ilbaxnimada, iyo wanaagga mujtamacyada dunida" ayuu yiri. Qaamuuska Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy oo micnaynaya waxa ay farxadi tahay ayaa leh waxaa jira laba fikradood oo farxadeed. Mid ayaa ereyga si la mid ah u isticmaala wanaagga ama ladnaanta ama kobcinta, waxaana laga yaabaa in loo isticmaalo erey cilmu nafsi ah oo keliya iyo qeexitaan la mid ah "niyad-jab" ama "dejin."

Ilaa heer intee ayaad jirdhis sameyn kartaa adoo soomman? Inaad joogteyso jimicsiga caadiga ah inta lagu guda jiro Ramadaanka ma ahan wax fudud, gaar ahaanna marka la eego hurdada iyo cabidda biyaha oo nagu yar. Si kastaba, inaad waqti u hesho jimicsiga inta lagu jiro bishan barakeysan keliya kaama dhigeyso qof caafimaadkiisu sarreeyo, balse waxay xitaa sidoo kale sare u qaadi kartaa tamartaada, caawinta dheef-shiidka iyo maskaxdaada oo si fiican u shaqeysa. Muddadan -ka maalmood ah ayaa laga yaabaa in jimicsigu uu caqabad kugu noqdo, aadna ku fekerto inaad joojiso hadafkaaga jirdhiska, balse waxay khubarrada jimicsiga kuu hayaan talooyin kaa caawin kara inaad isku waddo labadaba. Inaad maalintii oo dhan waxba cunin, waxna aadan cabin ayaa laga yaabaa inay jirka ku keento tabaryari. Dadka qaar ayaa jimicsiga u sameeya sidoodii hore, amaba si xad-dhaaf ah taasoo laga yaabo inay saameyn caafimaad ku yeelato. Marka jimicsiga lagu sameeyo jiimka laga hadlayo, dadka ayaa leh hadafyo kala duwan. "Dadka qaar waxay doonayaan inay miisaanka iska dhimaan, halka qaar kalena ay jirdhis doonayaan iyo inay murqahooda dhisaan," ayuu yiri Cabaas Cali oo ah macallin jiim iyo khabiir jirdhiska ah oo ku nool magaalada Nairobi ee dalka Kenya. Wuxuu kula talinayaa dadka doonaya inay miisaanka dhimaan, in inta lagu guda jiro Ramadaanka ay tahay xilliga ugu wanaagsan. "Cunnada waa waxa ugu muhiimsan ee qofku miisaanku ku dhimi karo. Waa in qofku helaa cunno isku dheelli-tiran oo nafaqadu ku badan tahay, ayna ku yar tahay karbohaydaraytka." Dadka jirdhiska doonaya ayuu sidoo kale Cabaas sheegay inay ku dadaali karaan joogteynta jirdhiskooda. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Macallin Cabaas ayaa sheegay in maaddaama qofka marka uu soomman yahay uusan jirkiisu tabar lahayn, ay jiraan waqtiyo uu u beddelan karo jirdhiska. "Qofka xilliga uu afuran yahay sida habeenkii ayaa fiican inuu jirdhis sameeyo. Haddii qofku miisaanka iska dhimayana way ku adag tahay sidoo kale isagoo soomman inuu jimicsi sameeyo, waxaa ku habboon xilliyada 9pm wixii ka dambeeyo, isagoo isticmaalaya tamartii uu ku afuray," ayuu yiri. Wuxuu sheegay in qofka buuran ee doonaya inuu jirdhis sameeyo ay u fiican tahay inuu jimicsi sameeyo xilliga ka horreeya afurka. "Waxaa u fiican xilliga galab gaabkii ama labada saac ee ugu dambeysa. Sababtoo ah qofka maanta dhan wuu soomman yahay, cuntadii jirkiisa u jirtay way ka soo dhammaatay waxa keliya ee tamar ahaan uu u isticmaali karana waa baruurta jirka ku jirta," ayuu yiri Cabaas. Qaabkaas marka uu qofku sameeyo, ayuu sheegay inay u fududaaneyso inuu miisaanka dhimo. Si taas ka duwan, qofka caatada ah ee miisaan isku daraya amaba jirka dhisaya, ayuu kula taliyay inay jimcisiga sameeyaan marka ay afuran yihiin. Waxaa jira khaladaad ay dadka qaar ee jiimka dhigta sameeyaan inta lagu guda jiro Ramadaanka. Waxaa khaladaadkaas ka mid ah in dadku aysan qorsheyn jadlwalkooda, ayna taasi saameyso murqahooda, maaddaama iyagoo soomman ay ku qasbayaan jirka inuu isticmaalo tamar xad-dhaaf ah. Cabaas ayaa ku talinaya in qofku uusan qasbin jirkiisa, ee hadba sida uu hadafkiisu yahay u qorsheeyo xilliyada uu jimicsiga sameynayo. Sidoo kale, dadka qaar ayaa gebi ahaanba joojiya Ramadaanka inay jimicsi sameeyaan, taasoo sida uu sheegay sababta inay murquhu dabcaan amaba uu qofku cayilo.

Maxay yihiin caqabadaha ay wajihi doonto Soomaaliya hadday deyn hor leh qaadato Soomaalida ayaa si balaaran u soo dhaweysay in dalka muddo dheer ka dib laga cafiyo dayntii lagu lahaa taas oo ay dalal iyo haya’ado ku lahaayeen, balse waxaa jira walaac dadka qaar iyo dhaqaalayahanada Soomaalidu ka muujinayaan caqabado ku gedaaman haddii dowladdu soo qaadato dayn hor leh. Waxaa jira shuruudo qayb ahaan ku xirnaa dayn cafinta oo falanqeeyayaasha dhaqaaluhu sheegeen in laga dul qaaday Soomaali oo ay ugu weynayd midaynta canshuuraha dalka oo dhan, taasoo ilaa hadda aan gudaha dalka ka hirgalin. Dr Aweys Cabdilaahi Cali oo ah dhaqaalyahan kana tirsan machadka Heritage Soomaaliya ayaa BBC-da u sheegay inay jiraan waxyaabo muhiimad leh oo u baahan inay ka heshiiyaan Dowlada dhexe iyo maamul goboleeyada kuwaasoo mudnaan u leh dalka. Wuxuu xusay in qaadasho deyn cusub ee dalka ay sii kordhin karto caqabadaha haysta Soomaaliya haddii dhinacyada aysan mar kasta ahayn kuwa ka heshiis ah. Aweys wuxuu si gaara u xusay in hadda Soomaaliya ay qaadan karto dayn taas oo ka heli karaan haya’adaha dhaqaalaha ee dunida sida IMF,Bangiga adduunka iyo dowladaha saaxiibka la ah,maadaama laga cafiyey deyntii lagu lahaa dalka oo dhamayd . bilyan oo dollar. , Dr Aweys wuxuu sheegay inay haboon tahay in dowladdu ay diiradda saarto sidii loo xoojin lahaa wax soo saarka dakhliga gudaha iyo midaynta canshuurada si loo kordhiyo lacagaha dowladda ka soo galaya gudaha dalka. Taas oo inteeda badan ku xiran heshiis siyaasadeed oo laga gaaro hanaanka midaynta canshuuraha dalka si dhaqaalaha dalku u noqdo mid leh qiyaasaad lagu jaangooyo oo gudaha ah. “Sida cad ma muuqato canshuur midaysan oo ka dhaxaysa dalka, waana tan ay fiicnaan lahayd in dowladu xoogga saarto si dhaqaalaha dalku u noqdo mid soo hagaaga, laakiin waxaad moodaa hadda inay xoogga saarayso dowladdu deyn qaadasho, taasna ma saacidayso dhaqaalaha dalka ee gudaha” ayuu yiri Dr: Aweys. Odoros miisaaniyadeedka sanadkan ee dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa % ah taageero dhaqaale oo ay ka sugayso dibadda halka dakhliga gudaha ee dalku uu yahay mid hooseeya. Dekadaha Bosaaso, Kismaayo, Berbera iyo Garacad oo dhawaan la dhameeyey ayaa intaba aysan canshuur ka qaadin dowladda Federalka hanaankaas oo wali aan hirgalin balse hore uga mid ahaa qoddobadii ku xirnaa dayn cafinta. Shirarka wadatashiyada Qaran ayaan heshiisyo midaysan lagu gaarin sidii looga heshiin lahaa canshuuraha laga qaado dalka oo dhan. Taas oo wali jirta haddii dowladdu dayn qaadato iyadoo aan la qeexin halka loo isticmaalayo, sababta loo qaadanayo iyo waxa looga faa’iidaysanayo ayaa ah mid keeni karta walbahaar sida uu BBC-da u sheegay dhaqaalahayan Dr Cali Ciise. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Dhaqaalayahan Dr Aweys Cabdilaahi Cali ayaa muujiyey walaac uu ka qabo haddii dalka uu qaato dayn hor leh ka dib cafintii tii hore. Wuxuu sheegay khilaafaadka ugu weyn ee ka jira dalka inay sal u yihiin arrimaha qaybsiga khayraadka iyo dhaqaalaha kuwaasoo aan laga heshiinna ay xaalada ugu sii dari doonto. “Waxaad ogtahay in caqabadda iyo khilaaf weyn oo gaarsiisan in xitaa wadashaqaynta yaraato ama go’do ay ay dhaliyaan dhaqaalaha yabooha ah ee haya’daha caalamku siiyaan Soomaaliya, marka hadii deyn ka miisaan weyn dhaqaale ahaan la soo qaado waa dareemi kartaa in ay abuuri karto khilaafaad cusub oo dalka wax yeeli kara” ayuu yiri Dr Aweys. Gudoomiyihi hore ee golaha dhaqaalaha Qaranka Dr Cali Ciise Cabdi ayaa BBC-da u sheegay inay mudan tahay in la qaabeeyo hanaanka maaliyada ee dalka oo laga dhigo kuwo ka fog eex, iyo musuq si loogu kalsooni qabo in la dhiso dhaqaale dalka ka saari kara mushkilaadka uu ku jiro. Maamulka Puntland ayaa hore ugu digtay dayn la soo qaado taas oo ay muujiyeen inay caqabad ku tahay Soomaaliya hadii aan la isla ogolayn sida BBC-da uu u sheegay wasiirka maaliyadda Puntland Maxamed Cabdiraxmaan Dhabancad. Sida uu BBC-da u sheegay Maxamed Aadan Ibraahim (Fargeeti) oo ahaa wasiirka maaliyada ee Soomaaliya xiligii heshiiska dayn cafinta dalku la galay haya’adda IMF isaguna saxiixay sanadkii -kii ayaa xusay inay haboon tahay in la xoojiyo dhowr qodob si looga faa’iidaysto waxa ka ratimaya daynta dalka laga cafiyey. ‘’Welwelka ugu weyn wuxuu noqon karaa in daynta la soo qaadanayo si qaldan loo isticmaalo waayo haya’adihii la xisaabtami lahaa sida hanti dhowrka, Garsoorka iyo Barlamaanka aysan gaarsiisanayn aniga ahaan sidii loo baahnaa iyo meshii loo baahnaa, waxaana loo baahan yahay in hay’adaha u lahaan lahayeen awoodo kala madax banaan ayna wax ku diidi karaan, waxna ku ogolaan karaan”ayuu yiri Fargeeti. Wuxuu intaa ku daray in dayn qaadashada aysan hadda bilaabanin oo Soomaaliya -kii soo qaadatay lacag dhan milyan oo dollar taas oo ahayd tii ugu horeysay markii ay gaadhay wajigii kowaad ee ahaa gunaanadka oo ay la gashay haya’adda lacagta aduunka ee IMF-ta. Dr Aweys ayaa la qaba wasiir Fargeeti walaaca la xiriira sida lagacaha dowladu qaatado ay ugu aamin noqon karaan in la musuq maasuqo ama an loo adeegsan jihooyinkii lagu talagalay. Haya’adaha Garsoorka oo aan xooganayn ayaa iyana ka mid ah caqabadaha hufnaanshaha maaliyadeed ee dalka taas oo ku sii daraysa caqabadaha laga muujinayo haddii dowladda dhexe ay qaadato dayn sida uu tilmaamay Dr Aweys. ‘’Haddii qof lagu eedeeyo inuu musuq gaysto waa inay jiraan hay’ado garsoor oo kalsooni lagu qabo oo awood macno leh ,dad xirafooda leh ay joogaan oo ka jawaabi kari hadii aysan jirin waxaa runtii khatar ah weyn ayey keni karaan” ayuu intaas ku daray Dr: Aweys. Sida uu BBC-da u sheegay Dr Cali Ciise Cabdi kuna cad sida uu xusay jaantusyada caalamiga ee dalka marka uu dayn qaato iyo waxaa loo adeegsado taas oo ku xiran hadba baahiyada dalku u qaatay daynta ayaa wuxuu yiri “Dayn marka dal qaato waxaa uu adeegsadaa tiirar dhowr ah sida hormarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha dalka sida dekadaha, beeraha, warshadaha iyo jidadka si daynta la qaatay celinteeda loogu helo ilo dhaqaale oo lagu bixiyo laakiin hadii loo adeegsado bixinta mushaarka ciidamada ama shaqaalaha taasi ma noqonayso mid sidii la rabay loo qorsheeyey” ayuu yiri Dr Cali. Dr Cali Ciise oo muddo afar sano ah soo hogaamiyey golaha dhaqaalaha Qaranka ayaa sheegay in qaadasho dayn ay ka weyn tahay in la hagaagjiyo hanaankii iyo haya’adihii shaqadaas qaban lahaa iyo sida loo isticmaali karayo daynta. “Haddii dayn cusub la qadanayo, waa in la og yahay daynkaasi meesha uu galayo, waxaa uu soo saarayo sida uu Soomaaliya uga saarayo faqariga, waxbarasho la'aanta, caafimaadka iyo arimaha muhimka ah balse dayn danbe oo la qaato oo ku salaysan sida hadda ay ku luntay lacagihii yabooha ahaa iyo kuwii gargaarka loogu talagalay halkii ay mareen ayaa u baahan in lays waydiiyo intaan qaadan” ayuu yiri Dr Cali Ciise. Dr Cali wuxuu u sheegay BBC-da in la kobciyo dhaqaalaha dalka lana awoodsiiyo haya’adaha dhaqaalaha “Dayntu waa mid mar kasta kaaga baahan inaad bixiso waayo waa mid aad qaadatay, marka haddii aysan jirin Ilo dhaqaale iyo dakhli gudaha ah, oo dalka uu gudi waayo daynta la qaato wali waa caqabad iska cad oo muuqata in dayn hor leh la qaato” ayuu yiri Dr: Aweys. Soomaaliya ayaa heerka ugu liita ka gashay dalalka uu dilooday musuq maasuqa caalanka warbixintii ay sii daysay haya’adda transparency International. Dowlada dhexe iyo maamulada dalka ayaa hore dhowr jeer isugu maandhaafay hanaanka loo qaybsanayo yabooha dhaqaale ee ay bixiyaan dalalka saaxiibka la ah iyo hay’adaha lacagaha ee aduunka “Caqabadda ugu weyn ee hadda dalka haysta waa sidii loo qaybsan lahaa khayraadka iyo dhaqaalaha waa mid ka mid ah waxa salka u ah mushkiladaha haysta dalka marka daynta la soo qaadanayo, waxay ka mid noqonaysaa khayraadka dalka soo galaya haddaan laga heshiina waxay sii durkin kartaa mushkiladda” ayuu yiri Dr Aweys. Dr Cali Ciise oo ah dhaqaalahayan ka shaqeeyey dalal badan oo Afrika ayaa qaba in dowladda Soomaaliya looga baahan yahay in la helo guddi madaxbanaan oo dusha ka ilaaliya dhaqaalaha dalka iyo haddii dayn la soo qaadanayo si looga fogaado in ay ku dhacaan gacmo aan loogu talagalin. Wuxuu intaa ku daray inaysan jirin lacago isaga qulquli doona Soomaaliya oo dayn ah balse ay ku xirnaan doonaan sharuudo badan oo u baahan in la maro oo mid walbana waqti qaadanayso Wasiirkii hore ee maaliyada Soomaaliya Maxamed Aadan Ibraahim (Fargeeti) ayaa xusay in dhanka kale faa’iido weyn laga helayo in daymo la helo si dalka looga saaro xaaladaha cakiran ee u baahan dhaqaale lagu hormariyo Sanadkii ayey Soomaaliya saxiixday heshiiska deyn cafinta la gashay hay’adda IMF,taas oo cafinteedu qaadatay dhowr sano.

Wasiir Estonia u dhashay oo "ku jees-jeesay" ra'iisul wasaaraha Finland Madaxweynaha dalka Estonia ayaa raalligelin bixiysay ka dib markii wasiirka arrimaha gudaha ee dalkaas uu ra'iisul wasaaraha Finland ku tilmaamay "sida gabar tukaan iibisa". Madaxweyne Kersti Kaljulaid wuxuu sheegay in "ceeb ay ku tahay " hadalka Mart Helme, oo sano jir ah, kaas oo hoggaamiye ka ah xisbiga mididgta fog ee caanka ah ee Ekre. Ra'iisul wasaaraha Finland, Sanna Marin, oo sano jir ah, waa ra'iisul wasaaraha ugu da'da yar caalamka. Waxay hoggaamisaa isbeheysiga Bidix-Dhexe, oo madaxdiisa oo dhan ay yihiin dumar, waxayna ahayd xidig soo baxeysay sannadihii ugu dambeeyay. Mr Helme wuxuu hadalkiisaa muranka dhaliyay ka sheegay barnaamij ka baxa idaacadda xisbigiisa. "Hadda waan aragnaa sida gabar tukaan iibisa ay ku noqotay ra'iisul wasaare iyo sida dad jidadka ka qeylin jiray iyo kuwo aan waxbaran sida ay golaha wasiirada ugu soo biirayaan," ayuu yiri. Ms Marin waxay ka hadashay in ay ka soo jeeddo qoys sabool ahaa. Waxay ahayd kaaliye iibgeyn ka shaqeysa, ka dib ayey jaamacad ku biirtay, waxayna soo gashay xirfadda siyaasadda. Waxay ahayd qofkii ugu horreeyay qoyskeeda ee dugsiga sare ka baxa, ka dibna jaamacad dhigta. Iyadoo hadalka wasiirkaas uga jawaabeysay Twitter-ka waxay Ms Marin sheegtay inay "si xad dhaaf ah ugu faaneyso Finland". "Dalkan, canugga ka soo jeeda qoyska saboolka ah ayaa waxbaran kara, noloshana guulo badan ka gaari kara. Qofka ka shaqeeya tukaan ayaa noqon kara ra'iisul wasaare," ayey ku tiri qoraalkeeda. Mr Helme wuxuu sheegay in hadalkiisa si xun loo fahmay, wuxuuna raalligelin usoo diray Ms Marin. Wuxuu sheegay in uu doonayay inuu muujiyo "sida uu u ogyahay in ay macquul tahay in nolosha meel hoose laga soo billaabo lana gaari karo meesha ugu sareysa ee siyaasadda". "Haddii qof uu si xun u fahmay... marka hubaashii waxaan ka bixinayaa raalligelin ku socota ra'iisul wasaaraha Finland," ayuu hadalka ku daray. War qoraal ah oo ay soo saartay madaxweynaha, Estonia, Kaljulaid waxay ku sheegtay in ay wacday dhiggeeda Finland, Sauli Niinistö, ayna weydiisatay in raalligelinta la garsiiyo Ms Marin iyo dowladdeeda. "Waxaan sidoo kale u muujiyay weji-gabaxa aan ka dareemay arrimahaas oo dhan," ayey tiri. Axsaabta mucaaradka ee dalkaas Estonia ayaa Mr Helme ugu baaqay in uu is casilo, ama in ra'iisul wasaare Jüri Ratas uu shaqada ka ceyriyo. Xisbiga uu wasiirkaas ka tirsan yahay ee Ekre wuxuu isbeheysiga dowladda ku biiray bishii May, ka dib markii uu ku guuleystay . % boqolkiiba oo ka mid ahaa codadkii laga dhiibtay dooorashadii dalkaas ka dhacday. Xisbiga wuxuu ballan qaaday in uu difaacayo dadka asalka u ah Estonia. Mr Helme wuxuu caan ku yahay hadalladiisa aan gabashada lahayn iyo dhaqamadiisa muranka sababa.

Isticmaalka Telefoonka: Maxaad u "argagaxdaa" marka mobile-ka lagaa qaado? Ku dhowaad afar-meelood, meel ka mid ah dhallinyarada caalamka waxay ku tiirsan yihiin telefoonada casriga ah, taas oo noqotay wax ay qabatimaan, sida lagu ogaaday cilmi baaris ay sameeyeen dhaqaatiir ku taqasustay cilmu-nafsiga. Cilmi barista oo uu hoggaminayay machadka King's College ee London, waxaa lagu sheegay in dabeecadaha qabatinka leh ay sababeen in dhallinta ay "argagaxaan" marka laga qaado mobile-ka. Sidoo kale, da'yartan naftooda kama xakameyn karaan waqtiga ay ku bixiyaan isticmaalka telefoonka casriga ah. Dhaqaatiirta waxay ka digayaan in qabatinka noocaas ah uu yeelan karo "cawaaqib aad u xun" oo ah in uu dhibaato u geysan karo caafimaadka maskaxda. Cilmi baarista waxaa lagu eegay warbixin oo lagu baaray caafimaadka , oo dhallinyaro ah. Waxaa la baaray "dhibaatada ka dhalata isticmaalka telfoonnada casriga ah". Waxaa la helay in boqolkiiba % uu keeno isbedel dabeecadeed oo si joogto ah u soo noqnoqda - waxaa ka mid ah, walwal la xiriira in mar uun telefoonka laga qaado oo ay isticmaali waayaan ama akhrinta farriimaha ay shaqeyn waayaan - kuwaas oo dhibaato ku ah waxyaabihii kale ee dhallintan ay qaban lahaayeen. Dhaqanka noocaas ah wuxuu xiriir la lahaan karaa dhibaatooyiin kale ee caafimaad, sida warbixinta lagu sheegay. Waxaa ka mid ah, walbahaar, murugo, hurdo la'aan iyo damiinnimo. "Telefoonnada casriga ah, waa in la iska daayo, lana fahmo dhibaatada uu isticmaalkoodu leeyahay," waxaa sidaa sheegay mid ka mid ah dadka qoray warbixinta, Nicola Kalk, oo ka tirsan qeybta Barashada Cilmu-nafsiga ee King's College, London. "Weli makala cadda in telefoonka uu yahay dhibaatada ama barnaamijyada lagu shubo ee dadku isticmaalaan," ayuu hadalka ku daray Dr Kalk. "Sikastaba, waxaa loo baahan yahay wacyigelin dadweyne oo la xiriirta telefoonnada casriga ah iyo wixii gudahooda ku jiro iyo isticmaalka carruurta iyo dhallinyarada. Waalidiintu waa in ay ka warhayaan wakhtiga ay carruurtooda ku bixinayaan isticmaalka mobile-lada." Samantha Sohn oo wax ka qortay warbixinta cilmi-baarista waxay sheegtay in qabatinka "uu yeelan karo cawaaqib aad u xun oo caafimaadka maskaxda ah iyo sida ay maalin kasta u falgasho maskaxda. Waxaana loo baahan yahay baaritaan dheeraad ah in lagu sameeyo dhibaatada adeegsiga telefoonnada". Balse, Amy Orben, oo ah baare caafimaad oo ka tirsan jaamacadda Cambridge, waxay ka digtay in la maleysto in xiriir caadi ah uu ka dhexeeyo dhibaatada telefoonnada casriga ah iyo walbahaarka. "Waxaa horey loo caddeeyay in saameynta telefoonnada casriga ah, aysan ahayn hal dhinac oo keli ah, balse in sida ay tahay niyadda qofka ay keeni karto isticmaalka badan ee mobile-ka," ayey tiri Dr Orben.

Iran dhaqaale ahaan maka faa’iidaysatay heshiiskii Nuyuukleerka? Heshiiskii Nuyuukleerka ee la saxiixay sanadkii -kii , ayna wada galeen dowladda Iran iyo dal oo kala ah Maraykanka, Shiinaha, Ruushka, Britain, France iyo Germany ayaa horseeday in la qaado cunaqabatayntii dhaqaale ee saarnay Iran. Iran waxa ay heshiiska ku badalatay in ay xakamayso horumarinta barnaamijkeeda Nuyuukleerka. Balse madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump ayaa si joogto ah ugu hanjabaya in uu ka laaban doono heshiiskaas, islamarkaasna go'aan ka gaari doono -ka bishan May in uu dib usoo celiyo cunaqabatayntii dhaqaalaha ee saarnayd Iran. Iyada oo taariikhdaas ay aad usoo dhawaanayso ayaa barnaamijka Xaqiiqo Raadin ee BBC-da waxa uu u kuurgalauaa waxyaabaha ay Iran ka faa'iiday heshiiskan. Dhaqaalaha Iran waxa uu galay qalalaase ka hor heshiiska Nuyuukleerka, balse sanduuqa lacagta adduunka waxa uu sheegay in dhaqaalaha Iran uu kordhay boqolkiiba . % sanad kadib heshiiska. IMF waxa ay qiyaasaysaa in sanad kasta dhaqaalaha Iran uu kordhayo % boqolkiiba. Kororkii sanadkii hore ee aadka ahaa waxaa lagu micneeyay in ay ugu wacnayd qiimaha shidaalka oo kordhay. Cunaqabatayntii saarnayd ayaa waxa ay Iran ku qasabtay in ay kala bar dhinto dhoofkii shidaalka ka hor intii aanan heshiiska la galin. Tusaale sanadkii -kii Iran waxa ay dhoofin jirtay . milyan barmiil maalinkii, maantana waxa ay dhoofisaa . milyan barmiil maalin kasta. Shidaalka ka sokoow Iran waxa ay dhoofisaa badeeco kale sida nooc looska ka mid ah oo lagu magacaabo Pistachio, wuxuuna dhoofkaas soo xareeyay lacag gaaraysa $ bilyan doolar. Sida ay sheegtay wasaarada maaliyadda Iran, looska oo kaliya waxa uu sanadkii dhoofkiisa gaaray $ . bilyan oo doolar, taasna waxa ay aad uga badantahay sanadkii hore intii uu dhoofka gaarayay. Dhibka kaliya ee wax soo saarkan gaaray ayaa ah abaarta, ee ma ahan cunaqabataynta. Ganacsiga ka dhaxeeya Iran iyo Yurub aad ayuu u kordhay tan iyo intii cunaqabataynta la qaaday, balse Shiinaha, Kuuriyada Koonfureed iyo Turkiga ayaa ah kuwa ugu waaweyn ee dhoofsada badeecada Iran. Sanadkii -kii lacagta Riyaalka ee Iran ayaa lumiyay sadex meelood labo meel oo ka mid ah qiimaheedii, sababtuna waxa ay ahayd cunaqabataynta iyo maamul xumo gudaha ah ee xaga suuqa lacagaha. Cuqanataynta waxa ay xakamaysay galaangalka ay Iran u lahayd nidaamka bunuukta adduunka. Madaxweynaha Iran ayaa heshiiskii Nuyuukleeka kadib balanqaaday in aanan dib loo arki doonin sicirka sarifka oo sare u kaca saacad kasta. Balse markii madaxweynaha Maraykanka Trump uu diiday in uu heshiiska ogolaado ayay lacagta markale hoos u dhac biloowday. Kala bar ayuu qiimaha lacagta hoos u dhacay sanadkii hore, taas oo dadka dalkaas ku qasabtay in ay iibsadaan lacag adag oo shisheeye iyaga oo ka baqaya in lacagta Iran ay hoos usii dhacdo. Waxaa kale oo dhacday in dad badan ay hantidooda kala baxeen Iran, waxaana la qiyaasay in illaa iyo $ bilyan oo doolar laga saaray dalkaas. Wixii markaas ka dambeeyay dowladda Iran ayaa talaabo ka qaaday dukaamada sarifka lacagaha qalaad, waxaana la mamnuucay in ay iibiyaan lacaga qalaad, waxaana lasoo rogay sharci ah in qofka uusan haysan karin lacag ka badan $ kun oo lacagta doolarka Maraykanka ah.

Maxay tahay maaddada ku jirta bariiska ee laga digayo inay kansar sababto? Bariiska ayaa ah cuntada ugu muhiimsan ee ay isticmaalaan balaayiin qof oo dunida ku nool, dadka qaarkiisna ay u isticmaalaan xitaa si ka badan qamadiga iyo galleyda, balse cilmi baaris cusub ayaa daaha ka qaaday in qiyaasta maaddada halista ah ee Arsenic ee bariiska ku jirta ay kordhi karto isbedelka cimilada darteed. Haddii aad u itsicmaasho bariiska nooca Biryani ama Pulao oo aad cuntid bariis ugu yaraan laba ama saddex jeer usbuucii, markaa maqaalkani adiga ayuu kugu saabsan yahay. Saynis yahano ayaa daaha ka qaaday daraasad cusub oo ku saabsan bariiska: Marka qiiqa kaarboonka iyo heerkulka caalamku kor u kaco, sidoo kale waxaa laga yaabaa in ay kor u kacaan qadarka walxaha arsenic ee bariiska ku jira. Ku jhiritaanka maaddada arsenic ee bariiska ayaa muddo dheer dhibaato ahayd, waxaana laga helaa ku dhawaad dhammaan noocyada bariiska. Arsenic waxay si dabiici ah ugu dhalataa ciidda iyo biyaha waxayna noqon kartaa sun. Inkasta oo xaddiga maadada arsenic ee ku jira bariiska laga yaabo inuu aad uga hooseeyo ama xitaa marar badan ka sarreeyo xadka ay dejiyeen hay'adaha sharcigu, xitaa xaddi aad u yar oo arsenic ah oo ku jira shay cunto ama biyaha la cabbo ah waxay keeni kartaa cuduro kale, oo ay ku jiraan kansarka iyo macaanka. Cilmi-baarayaasha adduunka ayaa ku hawlan sidii ay u yarayn lahaayeen xadiga arsenic-ka ee bariiska ku jira, laakiin waxa kale oo jira habab badan oo bariiska loo kariyo kuwaas oo meesha ka saaraya maaddadan waxyeelada leh. Laakiin daraasad cusub oo la sameeyay ayaa daaha ka qaaday in dhibaatadani ay sii weynaan karto isbeddelka cimilada awgeed. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay koriyeen nooc oo bariis ah afar goobood oo kala duwan oo Shiinaha ah muddo sano ah. Waxay ogaadeen in kororka heerarka kaarboon laba ogsaydh iyo heer kulka jawiga ay sidoo kale kordhiyeen xaddiga maaddada arsenic ee bariiska. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay ku qiyaaseen in kororka heerka arsenic ee bariiska uu keeni karo kororka kiisaska cudurka kansarka ilaa milyan gudaha dalka Shiinaha oo keliya. Inkasta oo cilmi-baarayaashu ay diiradda saareen goobo ku yaal Shiinaha oo ay ku tijaabiyeen, haddana waxay sheegeen in saamaynta noocan oo kale ah ay sidoo kale u badan tahay in lagu arko bariiska laga beero Yurub iyo Maraykanka sababtoo ah maaddada arsenic ee aan dabiiciga ahayn ayaa ku badan bariiska laga beero adduunka oo dhan. Tani waxay sidoo kale ka dhigan tahay in arsenic ay ku jirto biyaha dhulka hoostiisa gobollo badan. Tusaale ahaan, . milyan oo qof oo ku nool Maraykanka ayaa caba biyo leh heerar halis ah oo maadada arsenic ah, halka qiyaastii milyan oo qof oo adduunka ah ay cabbaan biyo leh heerar arsenic ah oo ka sarreeya tilmaamaha WHO ay ku talisay. Biyaha la cabo ka sokow, isha ugu weyn ee arsenic ee adduunka oo dhan waa bariiska. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Welwelka khubarada caafimaadka ayaa ah, marka cilmi-baarisyo badan lagu sameeyo arsenic, waxa sii badanaya waxyeelada ay u leedahay dadka. "Dib-u-eegis cusub oo ay samayeen Maamulka Ilaalinta Deegaanka ee Maraykanka (EPA) ayaa muujisay in arsenic ay aad uga awood badan tahay inay keento kansarka si ka badan sidii horey loo rumaysnaa," ayuu yiri Kevin Nechman, oo ah barfasoor wax ka dhiga jaamcadda Caafimaadka Dadweynaha ee Johns Hopkins Bloomberg. Hadda waxa jira caddayn ah in arsenic ay kordhiso khatarta kansarka maqaarka oo keliya laakiin sidoo kale kansarka sambabada iyo kaadi heysta. Kansarka ka sokow, arsenic waxa kale oo ay kordhisaa halista cudurrada wadnaha iyo macaanka. Qaadashada badan ee maaddada arsenic ee haweenka uurka leh waxay sidoo kale kordhisaa halista dhimashada dhallaanka, iyo sidoo kale khatarta ah in ilmuhu ku dhashaan miisaan yar. Khataruhu waa ay ku kala duwantahay dadka. Tusaale ahaan, dib u eegista EPA waxay ogaatay in soo-gaarista maalinlaha ah ee . micrograms ee maaddada arsenic ay tahay halkii kiilogaraam oo miisaan ah, ama . micrograms oo arsenic ah maalintiiba qofka -kg ah, waxay kordhisaa khatarta kansarka kaadi heysta qiyaastii boqolkiiba saddex iyo khatarta cudurka macaanka boqolkiiba hal. Haddaba ka sokow dhimista qiiqa kaarboonka iyo sare u kaca heerkulka, maxaa kale oo la samayn karnaa si aan uga fogaano khatarta arsenic? "Kaliya ma joojin karno cunista bariiska," ayuu yiri Professor Nechman. "Suurtagalna ma aha." "Intaa waxaa dheer, bariiska waa cunto aad muhiim ugu ah dadka saboolka ah, sababtoo ah qaarkood waxay ka helaan bariiska dhammaan kalooriinta, laakiin waxa aan u baahanahay in aan sameyno wax ka duwan sidii aan wax uga qaban lahayn dhibaatadan. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay sidoo kale sameynayaan tijaabooyin ku saabsan heerarka biyaha iyo hababka isticmaalka ee loo baahan yahay in lagu beero bariiska. Tusaale ahaan, halkii si joogto ah looga waraabin lahaa beerta bariiska, habka biyaha qayb ahaan loo waraabiyo, ka dibna mark aay biyuu ka dhamaadaan oo ay engagto in dib loo waraabiyo ayaa la isticmaalaa. Habkani wuxuu sida muuqata hoos u dhigayaa heerka arsenic laakiin wuxuu kordhiyaa maaddada cadmium, taas oo ah khatar aad u weyn. Maaddada Cadmium waxay saameyn xun ku leedahay jirka bini'aadamka waxayna sababi kartaa kansarka naasaha, sambabada, iyo keliyaha, iyo sidoo kale cilladaha ku yimnaada beerka. Cilmi-baarayaashu waxay sheegeen in sidoo kale ay jirto xiisaha taranka noocyada bariiska ee nuugaya maaddada arsenic ee aan organic-ga ahayn. Maadaama noocyada bariiska qaarkood ay uruursadaan arsenic yar, waxaa sidoo kale jira xiiso loo qabo beeristooda. Xalka kale ayaa noqon karaa in lagu daro waxyaabo bacrimin ah biyaha, taas oo nuugi karta arsenic. Hab kale ayaa noqon kara in lagu daro noocyada bacriminta qaarkood beerashada bariiska. Hal waddo ayaa noqon karta in bariiska lagu beero biyaha roobka, ama meel ay ku yar tahay maadada arsenic ee biyaha. Bariiska ka yimaada Bariga Afrika oo lagu beero biyaha roobka ayaa si gaar ah ay ugu yartahay maaddada arsenic, halka bariiska laga keeno Maraykanka, Bartamaha iyo Koonfurta Ameerika, Koonfur Bari Aasiya, Yurub iyo Australia uu leeyahay heerar sare oo arsenic ah. Maamulka Cuntada iyo Dawooyinka ee Maraykanka ayaan hadda la socon xaddiga arsenic ee bariiska ku jira, balse waxa ay u dejisay . mg halkii kiilo oo bariis ah carruurta. Sannadka , Midowga Yurub ayaa xaddiday . mg halkii kiilo ee arsenic ee bariiska ah, halka Shiinuhu uu soo jeediyay xad la mid ah. Laakin talooyinkani ma tixgelin in bulshooyinka qaar ay cunaan bariiska aad uga badan kuwa kale. Haddii aad rabto in aad cunto bariis oo aad sidoo kalena dooneysid in aad iska ilaaliso maaddada arsenic si shakhsi ah, waxa aad samayn kartaa adiga oo beddela habka aad u kariso bariiska. Hay'adda kormeerka Cunnada ee UK waxa ay ku talisaa in bariiska la dhaqo ka hor inta aan la karin, ka dibna lix jeer la karkariyo biyaha la isticmaalo marka la karinayo bariiska. Cilmi-baarayaal ka tirsan jaamacadda Sheffield ee dalka Ingiriiska ayaa sidoo kale dhawaan daah furay hab lagu karsado bariiska kaas oo % ka saari kara maaddada arsenic bariiska bunniga ah iyo % bariiska cad. Waxay ku taliyeen in bariiska lagu dhaqo biyo hore loo karkariyey shan daqiiqo ka dibna laga daadiyo, ka dibna lagu daro biyo cusub bariiska laguna kariyo kulayl yar ilaa uu ka gursado dhammaan biyaha. Bariiska laga keeno Maraykanka, Yurub, iyo Koonfur Bari Aasiya waxaa ku jira arsenic aad u badan, halka bariiska Bariga Aasiya ay ku jiraan wax ka yar.

Guidance: Duty of Care We owe due care to our contributors or potential contributors as well as to our sources, who may be caused harm or distress as a result of their contribution. Due care is the level of care that is appropriate to the individual and particular circumstances. We must judge this taking into account the editorial content, the nature and degree of the individual's involvement and their public position, along with other relevant factors such as safety risks or whether the individual is vulnerable. (See Section Fairness . . ) The term contributor covers a wide range of people taking part in content under very different circumstances, from those taking part in any news coverage to contestants in any talent search. They have very different needs. example, a contributor to a vox pop will not require as much information as an individual who has agreed to take part in a constructed reality programme to be filmed over a period of months. This guidance is not intended to apply to individuals who appear in our news coverage when they are caught up in current events. There may be occasions when it is unnecessary or impractical to inform the contributor of potential risks, for example in the production of many news and current affairs programmes and other programmes where it is warranted in the public interest not to do so. In other News & Current Affairs content then the risks to the welfare of the contributors can be assessed through discussion or a formal risk assessment. In longer form content, or content where a high level of duty of care is necessary, such as an investigation that deals with vulnerable people having to talk about difficult experiences, then best practice after assessing the risks and discussing them with the contributor could include keeping a welfare log; offering an assessment and potentially support from a psychologist or psychiatrist; checking in just before and just after publication; and offering guidance around social media where appropriate. We should consider whether a contributor might be regarded as being at risk of significant harm as a result of taking part in BBC content for reasons including (but not limited to) the following: We should conduct a 'contributor due care' risk assessment to identify any risk of significant harm to the contributor/contestant , unless it is justified in the public interest not to do so. A risk assessment, if required, should be considered at the earliest stage in the production process. Carrying out a risk assessment can be a useful way to determine what level of care is 'due' in each case and which specialists, if any, are required at each stage of the production. Ofcom has produced an example of a 'Risk Matrix' that can be used as a tool for supplementing this guidance identifying, assessing and managing potential risks to contributors in content. In a case where there are immediate and clear concerns in relation to significant harm to the contributor themselves or a third party, it may be necessary to direct them to the emergency services, or arrange it on their behalf, preferably with their consent. Editorial Policy and BBC Safety, Security and Resilience may be consulted. Even when a person gives informed consent to contribute, we should consider whether it is in the best interests of that person to take part. In some cases we should also consider the impact and wider implications for those around them such as close family. Any potential benefits of participation should also be considered alongside the risks. With contributors who are already vulnerable we should normally establish with the professionals responsible for their medical care as well as any day-to-day carers that vulnerable contributors are medically fit and psychologically robust enough to take part in production. It is sometimes advisable to ask for a statement of health from their GP or consultant. Where this is not possible, for example, in some cases internationally, it can be helpful to consult with appropriate organisations, such as health services, NGOs or other agencies, working in country and with an area of expertise relating to the contributor, in order to make a judgement about the risks to an individual, including medically or psychologically, if we involved them in our output. There is additional guidance in relation to contributors and charitable appeals. (See guidance: Charitable Appeals) We should consider the psychological impact for all contributors even though they may not appear to have pre-existing vulnerabilities. It can sometimes be advisable to engage a mental health professional to carry out a psychologically assessment as part of the pre-production process. This can be especially useful with constructed and immersive content or other types of content in which contributors, some of whom may be vulnerable, will be recorded outside of their normal living environment or face challenges of a new kind. (See guidance: Talent Searches and Contestants) In Factual & News and Current Affairs content, psychological assessments may be required on a case by case basis, depending on the vulnerability of the contributor and the sensitivity of the subject matter that will be discussed. The resulting psych reports will be discussed by the commissioner, production team and editorial policy adviser. Discussions about the level of support needed will be held, taking into account the contributor's support network and circumstances. Advice from external organisations such as those dealing with trauma, or rape survivors may be consulted about interview techniques, especially if the presenter is unused to talking to people who may be vulnerable. These assessments should be carried out by appropriately registered and qualified health professionals, for example psychologists or psychiatrists, who if possible also understand how the media works, have experience of working with specific genres or types of contributors and understand the potential impact on contributors. They should be contracted with a clear commitment to provide advice which is in the best interests of contributors irrespective of whom they are contracted to. They can advise both the content-makers and the individual about the impact – if any – of taking part on their personal welfare and condition. In content in which contributors are placed outside of their normal living environment or face challenges of a new kind consideration should also be given to the possible impact on their ability to return to their day to day lives following their involvement with the BBC. Editorial Policy can provide information on the suitability of any mental health specialist. Other independent expert advice may be sought from appropriately qualified specialists where it may be required at different stages of the production. It is important to manage the expectations of contributors, some of whom may be viewing the opportunity to take part in BBC content as providing a life changing opportunity. It is important that they understand that this may not be the case so any decision by them to take part is not down solely to this expectation. Doing due diligence on a contributor by looking at their social media and any news articles about them, in conjunction with something like a self-declaration form, or a criminal records check (where appropriate) can help ensure that if any focus is put on anything contained in these when content is published, the contributor can withstand these issues being raised. The safety of the contributor should also be considered. Would their life be in danger or would they be at risk of additional violence, for example within their community? Seek advice from BBC Safety Advisors (for in-house productions). BBC Safety can also advise on potential risks to BBC staff. Independent companies should seek advice from suitably trained professionals. There may be personal events or behaviours which it might not be in a contributor's best interests to reveal to a wider public but which may be integral to telling a true and accurate story about their experience, and which might therefore make it difficult or sometimes impossible to feature a particular contributor. Even after seeking professional advice, it remains the producer's and BBC's responsibility to choose whether to go ahead with a particular contributor. If the decision is taken to proceed it should be established what further safeguards, support and resources are required to manage or mitigate risk of significant harm and to ensure responsible inclusion. Any decision about a single contributor should take into account the obligations this will put on the production as a whole when taking into account all contributors. If a decision is made to not go any further forward in the process with a contributor then it is important that they are stood down as soon as possible, and in a manner that doesn't make them feel that they have 'failed' in some way. These are editorial decisions that are often made because of a number of factors. It is good practice for the production team in conjunction with BBC Commissioning and Editorial Policy, to establish written protocols to set out the agreed procedures to assess and mitigate the risk of significant harm to contributors. These should be shared amongst the production team to ensure that everyone understands what to do and when to escalate issues Where risks to a contributor have been identified in relation to their contribution to BBC content, they should be provided with relevant information about those risks and any steps that will be taken to manage them. The information should be given clearly at the earliest stage of the production process in a way that is understandable to the contributor, with further information given during the production process, particularly where the risks may change significantly as the production evolves. However, there may be occasions when it is unnecessary or impractical to inform the contributor of potential risks, for example in the production of many news and current affairs content and other content where it is warranted in the public interest not to do so. It is helpful to keep written records of discussions with contributors before recording, in addition to informed consent in writing. It may also be helpful for contributors to be provided with information on any areas of questioning, in writing, where practical. Records are useful because complaints about unjust or unfair treatment may occur after production teams have disbanded. Vulnerable contributors need all the information given to contributors generally as part of the consent procedure. When communicating with contributors/contestants who are vulnerable and have specific needs, it is important to use the methods that are the most suitable for communication with them. These may include, for example, using verbal recorded consent methods. The BBC is committed to being inclusive and accessible to all and supporting reasonable adjustments, such as access requirements, across productions. Help may be obtained from the BBC Creative Diversity team who can give advice on how to support diverse and inclusive practices, such as the use of access co-ordinators. (See Section Fairness: . . – . . or guidance: Informed Consent) The BBC has a large footprint and even experienced social media users, such as influencers, may not expect the reaction they could get following a BBC broadcast or publication. Discussions should take place with contributors as part of the informed consent process, highlighting the pitfalls and advising them how to reduce risks on social platforms. Production staff may sometimes require appropriate training or guidance in order to deal sensitively and practically with contributors. Productions should be tailored to suit the likely needs of vulnerable contributors. In some formats a senior member of the production team will be designated as the welfare producer to oversee duty of care provisions and protocols. They can check in with every participant on a regular basis and escalate issues. The welfare producer's sole task is to ensure the welfare of those taking part. That means they are separate from any editorial concerns or pressures, and won't use any info to build story lines. They are expected to be senior enough for editorial team to listen to. In other genres a single member of the production team may lead on welfare as the single point of contact. A 'point person' may also be identified by the contributor, who is the nominated adult, usually a close family friend or member of the immediate family. They can be contacted if necessary throughout the production, with the contributor's consent. There may be circumstances when it is appropriate for contributors to have direct access to specialists without having to request this through the production team. For example, if a contributor wants to raise concerns or questions directly with a specialist, we should consider how best to facilitate this in an easy and timely manner, while making sure that any information necessary to allow the production to fulfil their due care obligations is passed on. The BBC who has the ultimate editorial responsibility should also be informed. Continuing support may also be needed from a mental health expert at 'pinch points' or set times such as after a sensitive interview or after an elimination in a competitive format. Regular updates should be provided to the wider team of any welfare concerns. It may be useful for contributors to receive direct advice from BBC experts such as InfoSec or the Press office. In competitive or constructed formats that might be in the form of a meeting with all contributors and all the relevant experts, who can give briefings around issues such as what to expect, how to keep social media accounts secure, and how to deal with social media, press enquiries and being in the spotlight. In making short-form content for social media from content that originated as long form, we should take care to make sure that we aren't putting one person's story in a position where it is judged more harshly because it is the sole story being told. We should also consider NOT publishing content to social if we think the contributor is particularly vulnerable to comment. We should ensure that the full and appropriate context is included in any cut down and we should keep a particular watch on comments, and potentially consider if comments should be turned off. There are similar considerations when putting forward contributors forward to be involved in press interviews. Aftercare is important. Any aftercare needs to be proportionate to the ongoing risks identified and have clear boundaries and time frames. We should be flexible to the type of support a contributor might reasonably require or request and remain responsive to a contributor's needs for an appropriate time after the programme has been broadcast. At the outset the need for aftercare for vulnerable contributors and for all contributors when the nature of the programme means they'll be put in highly pressurised or exposed situations should be discussed. An agreed plan should be drawn up with an outline of how aftercare will be delivered and for what period of time it should be available. It should be signed off by production and commissioning, who may consult Editorial Policy. This aftercare plan may need to be adjusted if any contributor develops a vulnerability during the production. A psychological assessment or conversation may be advisable post-production. It may also be necessary to limit the period of time that content could be repeated for. However, the contributor and their families should be made aware that third party websites may reproduce the content without our knowledge or consent. The aftercare plan should usually include details of a phased withdrawal at a suitable point. In some cases this needs to be done in liaison with external agencies/services that can offer ongoing and more tailored help and support. Ramla Cali: 'Markii aan Soomaaliya ka baxay waa lay hilmaamay' . Feedhyahannada caanka ah ee Soomaaliyeed ayaa muuqaal ay ku baahisay barteeda Tiktok ku sheegtay in ay Dowladda Maraykanka u diiday dalku gal ay kaga qayb gali lahayd barnaamij si toos ah looga daawan doono Netflix oo ay kasoo qaybgalayaan feedhyahanno caan ah. Ciyaarta ugu culus ayayna dhex mari doontaa feedhyahankii caanka ahaa ee hore ee labada jeer ku guuleystay biladda feedhka culus Anthony Joshue oo sanno jir reer Biritan ah iyo Youtuberka isku beddelay feedhyahanka Jake Paul. Ciyaartan ayaana ka dhici doonta golaha ciyaaraha ee Kaseya oo ku taala Miami. Ciyaarta oo si toos ah looga daawan doono Netflix, wuxuu dhici doonaa 19ka December, waxaana uu ka koobnaan doonaa siddeed wareeg, midkiiba saddex daqiiqo. Ramla, oo muuqaal ay duubtay ku hadlaysay, waxay sheegtay in booqashadeedii dhowaan ee Soomaaliya ay sabab u noqotay in laga hor istaago ka qaybgalka tartan lagu waday inuu qabsoomo December . Waxay codsatay Madaxweyneha Soomaaliya, Wasiirka Dhalinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha, iyo mas'uuliyiin kale oo dowladda ka tirsan inay fuliyaan ballanqaadkoodii ahaa in loo soo saaro baasaboorka diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya. Ramla waxay sheegtay in loo ballanqaaday in ay helayso Baasaboorka Soomaaliga ah ee diblumaasiga si'ay u booqato dalka Maraykanka ugana qayb gasho ciyaartaas. "Wasiiryaalka markii aan u socday Soomaaliya ayaan u sheegay, balan ay iga qaadeen Baasaboorka diblumaatiga in ay i siiyaan si ay iigu fududaato Ameerika si'aan u galo" ayay Ramla ku tiri muuqaalkii ay soo galisay barteeda "Madaxweynka, wasiiryaalka uyukoo dhan way iga ballanqaadeen, wali waa sugooyaa. Wali wax ma iisoo dhicin, hadda ma dheeli kari december -ka", ayay sheegtay iyada oo hadalkeeda sii wadata. Ramla Cali oo ah gabadh taariikh ka samaynaysa dhanka feedhka, Soomaliyana ku metalaysay ciyaaro badan oo feedhka ah ayaa noqotay haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee ka soo jeedda Soomaaliya ee u tartanta ciyaaraha feerka ee Olimbikada. Sanadkii ayay aheyd markii Ramla ay ku guuleystayb tartanka feerka, waxay noqontay gabadhii ugu horreysay ee Muslim ah ee ku guuleystay feer dalka Britain. Wixii ka dambeeyay guushaas waxay go'aansatay in Soomaaliya ay ku matasho tartanka Olimbikada gaar ahaan feerka. , waxay ka noqotay Xulka Haweenka Dunida ee shabakada Times, waxay heshiis la gashay shirkada MVP (Most Valuable Promotions) oo ah Hay'ad taageerta ciyaaryahannada feedhka waa shirkad uu dhismaheedu qayb ka yahay feedhyahanka caanka ah ee Jake Paul oo ciyaar aad loo sugayo isna ku leh Miami. "Ramla waa quwad isbeddeleed oo dunida ah, una isticmaalaysa masraxyadeeda in ay ku baaba'iso caqadaha dhiirigelinaysana habla dunida" ayay qoraal ku dheheen markii ay heshiiska la galeen. Ramla waxay sheegtay in ay u aaday Soomaaliya si ay u aragto dalkeeda iyo dadkeeda, waxse ay sheegtay in ay dareemayso niyad jab ka dib siday sheegtay ballankii loo qaaday oo looga baxay darteed. "Aniga waxaa rabay beledkeyga in aan arko, dadkeyga arko. Balankii layga qaaday markii aan Soomaaliya ka baxay waa lay hilmaamay", ayay ku sheegtay muuqaalka ay soo duubtay. "Hadda waxaan dareemaya Soomaali in niyadda la iiga jabiyay" ayay tiri iyada oo wajigooda murugo ka muuqato. Muuqaalka ay soo dhigtay barteeda waxaa ku jiray qayb ay ku sheegtay isu-dawaheedii barnaamijkan kaas oo sheegaya in uusan hubin si fiiso loogu heli karo. "Waxaan rabaa in aan farriintan si toos ah kuugusoo diro, waa in aan kaa saaro munaasabadda dhacaysa -ka December ee Netflix, ma jirto hubanti aan fiiso kuugu heli karo" ayuu muuqaalka ku sheegay maamulaha Ramla. "Wax walba oo aad samayn karto si aad u xaliso mustaqbalka waa wax weyn" ayuuna kusoo gunaanaday fariintiisa. Waxaan xidhiidh la samaynay dowladda Soomaaliya gaar ahaan wasaaradeeda ciyaaraha waxuuna wasiirku sheegay in arrinta Ramla sheegtay ayna waxba ka jirin. "Arrintaasi arrin wax ka jiraan ma aha, cid baasaboor diblumaasi u balanqaaday in ay Ramla u samaysana ma jirto, laakiin Ramla waa ciyaaryahanad Soomaaliyeed magaca Soomaaliyana mar soo meteshay," wasiirka Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha Soomaaliya Maxamed Cabdiqadir Gurey ayaa sidaas u sheegay BBC. Wasiirku waxuu qiray in booqashadeedii ay Mudisho ku timid Ramla ku codsatay baasaboor balse nooca ay u awoodeen ay tahay kan shaqaalaha. "Markay booqashada dhammaysatayna waxay codsatay baasaboor, waana u sheegnay in ciyaartooyada iyo dadka ka shaqeynaya arrimaha adeegga qaranka in ay leeyahiin baasaboor nooca shaqaalaha maalinkay codsatayna aan u dalabnay" ayuu hadalka sii raaciyay. Waxa uu sheegay in baasaboorka diblumaatiga aya leeyihiin diblumaasiyiinta iyo cidii kale ee uu madaxweynaha u garanayo oo kaliya.

Laakiin ma ogtahay in koobka ku jira gacanta Messi uusan ahayn midkii saxda ahaa? balse uu yahay mid dahab yar oo kali ah lagu dhejiyay. Koobkii la nashqadeeyay sanadkii - islamarkna sanadkii lagu qabtay Mexico ayna ku guuleysteen Brazil ay kooxdaasi geeyeen dalkooda . Koobkan ayaa horay looga xaday carwo ku taalla magaalada London, balse waxaa markii dambe helay ey lagu magacaabo ‘Pickles’ xilli isaga iyo milkiilihiisa ay lugeynayeen meel ku taalla koonfurta London. Kadib -dii, koobka ayaa mar kale la xaday markii la dhigay magaalada Rio de Janeiro ee caasimadda Brazil, iyadoo ay qaadday kooxdii ku guuleysatay. Koobkaasi la xaday dib dambe indha looma saarin oo lama soo helin. Sanadkii 1970kii FIFA waxay qabatay tartan koob cusub kaas oo nashqado la soo gudbiyay. Sawir-qaade Talyaani ah oo lagu magacaabo Silvio Gazzaniga ayaa ku guuleystay tartanka nashqadan. Koobkan la nashqadeeyay waxaa lagu soo bandhigay koobkii adduunka ee -kii, kaas oo ay marti galiyeen Jarmalka galbeed. Hadaba maxay tahay muhiimadda gaarka ah ee uu leeyahay koobka aduunka ee FIFA ? Waxaa laga sameeyay dahab -carat ah, koobkan dhirirkiisu waa -inji waxa uu culeyskiisu ka yar yahay lix kiilo. Maxaa Messi loo siin waayay koobka dhabta ah? Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Koobkani waxa uu leeyahay meel u gaar ah taariikhda ciyaaraha adduunka. Sida laga soo xigtay FIFA, dad aad u yar ayaa loo oggol yahay inay taabtaan koobka, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa ku guuleysta iyo madaxwayneyaasha dowladaha. Koobkan dahabka ah ayaa waxaa la guddoonsiiyaa kooxda ku guuleysatay tartanka koobka, balse waxaa gacanta ku sii haynaya FIFA. Sida uu dhigayo sharciga FIFA, koobka dhabta ahi waxa uu baaqi ku sii ahaanayaa FIFA oo sii yaalaya, laakiin kooxda ku guulaysata ayaa si ku meel gaar ah loo siiyaa. Koobkii asalka ahaa ka dib waxaa uu la yaallayaa oo gacanta ku haynaysa FIFA. Sanadkii , FIFA waxay go'aansatay inaysan mar dambe abaal-marinta koobka dhabta ah siinin kooxda ku guulaysata Markii hore waxaa loo oggolaa kooxda tartanka koobka ku guuleysata in koobka dahabka ah qudhiisa ay qaataan oo ay dalkooda ugu soo dabaaldagaan ka dibna ay FIFA, dib ugu soo celiyaaan. Balse tan iyo kooxda koobka ku guuleysatay waxaa koobka lagu siinayaa oo kali ah goobta xafladda lagu abaalmarinayo ka dibna waxaa dib loogu celinayaa gacanta FIFA. Mark ay xafladda dhammaato ayaa waxaa kooxda koobka ku guuleysatay la siinayaa koob kale oo u ek midka saxda ah, balse aan ahayn kii asalka ahaa ee ay ku guuleysteen. Sida laga soo xigtay FIFA, koobka ay helaan kooxda ku guulaysata ayaan ahayn mid gabi ahaanba ka samaysan dahab, balse waxaa lagu aslay biyo dahab. Waxaa koobka ku dhajisan sanadka koobka adduunka, dalka martigelinaya iyo magaca kooxda ku guulaysata. Abaalmarinta lacageed ee Koobka Adduunka Sida ay FIFA sheegtay, kooxda koobka sanadkan ku guuleysatay ayaa waxaa la sinayaa lacag dhan milyan oo doollar, halka Faransiiska oo kaalinta labaad soo galay ay helayaan milyan oo doollar. Lacagta abaalmarinta ayaa waxaa laga bixinayaa sanduuqa FIFA oo sanadkan ciyaaraha adduunka ugu talagashay lacag dhan of $ milyan oo doollar. Faransiiska markii ay koobka adduunka ku guuleysteen , FIFA waxay siisay $ milyan. Xilligaas waxaa lacagtii ay FIFA ugu talagashay koobka adduunka ay ahayd oo milyan oo doollar.

Waxay guursatay darawalkii tareenka ee ka badbaadiyay inay is disho , Charlotte and Dave Lay Isku buuqa nolosha, caqabado badan iyo dhibaatooyinka caafimaadka maskaxda ayaa ah wax aad looga walaaco. Dhanka kale dadka qaarkood cidna makala hadlaan dhibaatooyinkooda mana u furaan maskaxdooda. Mararka qaarkood shaki awgii iyo cadaadiska bulshada kasoo gaaraya ayay isaga aamusaan, dad badan kama hadlaan dareenkooda taasna noloshooda burburisaa. Balse sheekada Dave iyo Charlotte ayaa bulshadoo dhan duruus u ah. Waa markii ay isku dayday inay is disho iyo haatan oo ay nolol qurxoon ku nooashay... (Digniin: Warbixintan waxaa ku jira waxyaabo la xiriira is dilid iyo xanuunka maskaxda.) Charlotte Leigh, oo ah kalkaaliso ku nool England, ayaa diyaar u ahayd inay shaqada ka baxdo maalin ka mid ah xagaagii . Balse diiqad ayay dareemeysay. Wax walba waxay ula muuqdeen kuwo aan sax ahayn. Caadi ahaan way murugsaneyd. Wax yar kadib, waxay go'aansatay inay is disho iyadoo aadday waddada tareenka ee West Yorkshire. Balse nasiib wanaag, waxay maalintaas la kulantay darawal fiican oo tareenka waday. Darawalka tareenka ayaa durba xaqiiqsaday in gabadhu ay dhibaato heysato, wuuna badbaadiyay nolosheeda. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. "Waxaan la daalaa-dhacayay arrimo caafimaadka maskaxda ah tan iyo markii aan da'yaraa. Caafimaadka maskaxdeyda ayaa wixii intaa ka dambeeyay ahaa mid aan xasilooneyn. Mararka qaar waan fiicanahay, mararka qaarna ma ficneyn," ayay tiri Charlotte oo jir ah. Maalintaas shan sano kahor waxay nolosha Charlotte u ahayd mid muhiim ah. Xusuusaheeda maalintaas aad uma fiicneyn. Balse waxyaabaha qaar aad ayay u xusuusataa. Waxay xusuusataa inay soo aadday dhanka tareenka, kadibna tareen kusoo wajahnaa dhankeeda uu gaabiyay kadibna istaagay. Dhacdadan ayaa ka dhacday waddada tareenka meel u dhow Crossflatsmeel u dhow Bradford. "Waxaan xusuustaa inaan arkay nin tareenka kasoo degay. Waan ka baqay markaan arkay asagoo soo degaya, waxaan moodayay inuu igu dhufan doono tareenka," ayay tiri Charlotte. "Ninka ayaa ii yimid wuxuuna yiri, Hello, magaceyga waa Dave. Maanta maalintaadu ma xumeyd?" Ayuu yiri. "Waxaan iri, 'Haa, taasi way xumeyd'. Wuxuu yiri dhibaato malaha. Aan wada fadhiisanno oo wada-hadalno ilaa xaalkaagu ka hagaagayo." Ayay hadalka raacisay. Dave wuxuu u shaqeeyaa Northern, shirkad tareen oo fadhigeedu yahay England. Shirkadda ayaa inta badan ka howl-gasha isu socodka tareennada ee waqooyiga Ingiriiska. Intaa kadib Dave iyo Charlotte waxay wada hadlayeen ilaa nus saac. Kadib markii ay la hadashay Dave, xoogaa way degtay. Dabcan, weli cadaadis ayay dareemeysay. Dhacdadaas kadib, Charlotte ayaa billowday raadinta ninka badbaadiyay nolosheeda, kaasoo aad ugu naxariistay. Waxay ku dhibtootay inay war ka hesho ninkaasi. Waxay ka baadi-goobtay Facebook iyadoo codsi u dirtay dadka. Waxay ku fekertay in qof ka shaqeeya shirkadda Northern Railway laga yaabo inuu ninkaasi kusoo xiro iyada. "Haddii laga yaabee uusan dooneyn inuu ila hadlo, taas waan fahmi karaa. Balse waxaan keliya doonayay inaan ninka fiican uga mahad celiyo inuu waqti ila qaatay, uu aad iigu naxariistay uuna i tusay bani'aadannimo," ayay tiri Charlotte. Codsigeeda way ku guuleysatay. Mid ka mid ah dadka la shaqeeya Dave ayaa codsiga Charlotte ku arkay Facebook. Wuxuu namnbarka Dave siiyay Charlotte. Charlotte ayaa kadib farriin u dirtay Dave. Dave haatan waa jir. Kadib markii uu farriin ka helay Charlotte, wuu ku farxay. Wuxuu nafis ku dareemay inay bad qabto. Dave ayaa sheegay inuusan hore weligii fursad ugu helin la hadalka qof dhibaato ay heysatay. "Waxaan doonayay inaan ogaado inay bad qabto. Waxaan la xiriiray booliiska si ana u ogaado xaalkeeda iyo wixii intaa kadib dhacay. Waxaan keliya doonayay inay bad qabto," ayuu yiri Dave. Labo bilood kadib way kulmeen iyagoo kafeey isla cabay wixii intaa kadib dhacayna taariikh bey ahayd. Labadooda ayaa is guursaday sanadkii . Charlotte waxay xilligaas lahayd uur toddobaad ah. Charlotte ayaa sheegtay in dadka la harjada nolosha ay dhib ku qabaan inay dadka kale la hadlaan, ayna caawinaad weydiistaan. Aalaaba ma hadlaan amaba caawinaad ma weydiistaan. Marka, waxaan soo jeedinayaa in dadka agtooda jooga ay su'aalo weydiiyaan iyo caawinaad.

Safarkaygii Baariis - Magaaladii aan ka helay aniga oo aan tegin . Waa sheeko gaaban oo weriyaha BBC-da ee Cabdiraxmaan Cali Dhimbiil, kaga warramayo, booqashadiisii ugu horraysay ee caasimadda dalka Faransiiska ee Baariis. Waa beri hore iyo magaaladii Burco ahayd, gaar ahaan xaafadda Plaza. Sees danbe oo cidlo ah ayaan fadhinnaa annaga oo badan. Yaasiin, oo naga yar weynaa ayaa noo sheekaynaya. Magaalada Baariis iyo nolosha ka jirta ayuu ka warramayaa. Nolol raaxo leh ama u muuqatay kolkaas ayuu nooga warramayaa. Waddooyinka is dhaafsan iyo baararka aan jabaqda miyuusiggu ka demin, barbaarta caweysyadaas ku ciyaaraysa iyo xaalad indhasarcaad ah ayuu noo tilmaamayaa. Magaalo waxan 'tumashada' Burco looga yaqaan Muqdishana 'baashaalka' ay dadkeedu ku fooggan yihiin oo aan shaqo kale la hayn ayuu noo sawirayaa. Dabcan, sheeko xiiso leh iyo magaalo xiiso leh ayay nala ahayd. Waa mar kale iyo Waadamagoo, tuulo Burco bari ka xigta oo ah magaaladii aan ku dhashay. Kolkan se fasax ayaan ku booqday intaan Burco ka tegay. Nin dhallinyaro ah oo qurbaha ka yimi ayaa magaalada markaas joogay. Ninkaasi, si yara duwanayd kolkaas ayuu u soconayaa, si baad mooddaa in uu gacmaha u soo horraysiinayo marka uu soconayo; sidii wax meel ka dusaya ayuu garbaha ka soconayaa oo marba mid soo horraysiinaya. Waa socod xarrago, sina ugu muuqda qof yara wareersan. Laba aan ag fadhiyey ayaa kolkaa iskawaraysanaya, waa laba nin oo reer tuulihii halkan ah. Mid baa leh, 'Waar hebel, ninkani sidan uu u soconayaa waa maxay?' Kii kale ayaa yidhi jawaab aan kolkaas la yaabay. Kulahaa: "Magaalo Baariis la dhaho ayuu ka yimi, oo cidhiidhi ah, maadaama dadku ku badan yihiin, oo qofku kolka uu soconayo ee waddo marayo waxa uu ka qasban yahay in laba qof oo garabka isku haya uu ka dhex duso, cidhiidhi awgii; kolkaa magaaladaas baa qaabkaa looga socdaayoo wixii baa caado ka noqotay oo waa kaa socodkii qof laba qof ka dhex dusaya uun uu ka noqday!" Cajiib! Waa mar kale iyo Baariis. Magaalo yaab leh. Ka kaalay, waa . Waxaan joogaa Nayroobi, ma ihi ninkii odayga aha ee berigii, wax baa ii yar baxay, Baariis xogo kale oo badan ayaan ka maqlay. Iska daaba e, hadda asxaab ayaaban ku leeyahay. Kuma lihi uun, qaarkood iyagoo Baariis jooga ayayba igala soo dhex hadlaan. Markan Khaalid oo transit ku ahaa ayaaba u danbeeyey. Maanta se waa Julaay. Safar baan ahay, oo Talyaaniga ayaan u socdaa. Magaalo Florence la yidhaahdo ayaa waxbarasho kooban u tegayaa. Fiisihii Yurubna waan haystaa, weliba nooca Shanghai ee dhawr dal oo kala duwan oo Yurub ah lagu soo mari karo. Magaaladii Baariis ahayd ee sheekadeedu igu badnayd ayaa si gaar ah iigu taagan. Waxaan is leeyahay ma adiga oo Yurub tegay oo aan Baariis soo marin ayaad soo noqon! Waxaan is leeyahay, si ka duwan dardaarankii Hadraawi, "Baariis adoon tegin / ama Boon ka sheekayn," miyaad laaban doontaa! Waa Maya. Tigidh ayaaban jartay Talyaaniga ah, markaan se halkaas tago, soo noqodkayga waxaan ka dhigtay in aan ka soo bixi doono Baariis! Magaaladii igu badbadatay. Alle mahaddii safar dheer ka dib nabad tegay Talyaaniga—Florence, caasimadda Gobolka Tuscany, magaalo dalxiis oo caan ah, si gaar ah farshaxanka iyo aasaarteeda qadiimka ah loogu majeerto. Waa sheeko kale iyo maalin kale e, Pisa oo isla gobolkaas ah ayaan uga gudbay markii aan dhammaystay waxbarashadii koobnayd ee aan halkaa u tegay. Pisa asxaab hore oo reer Burco ah ayaa Jaamacad ka wada, si gaar ah Xudayfi ayaan ku booqday. Maalmo yar oo aan magaaladaas joogay, waxaa la gaadhay toddobaadkii u danbeeyey safarkayga, waa toddobaadkii qorshuhu ahaa in aan Talyaaniga kala dhammaanno oo magaaladii tigidhkayga bixitaanka Yurub ka go'naa aan iska xaadirayo. Waa Halkii Nebi Sulaymaan iyo malaggii nafta e, qofka Pisa igu arka ee ogaa 'back-gaygu' in uu Baariis yahay, wuu yaabi lahaa! Waa subax, waxaan raacayaa diyaaradda gudaha u kala safarta ee caanka ah, Ryanair, waa nooc diyaaradeed aan aad u weynayn oo qiime jaban Yurub dhexdeeda loogu kala goosho. Wax kale kuma garatide, waa bajaajta duusha ee u kala baxda Yurub. Tii ayaan saaranahay, Baariis baanan u socdaa! Baariis! Magaaladii Baariis ahayd ayaan dhex joogaa. Markaas uun ayaan diyaaraddii ka soo degay. Tareenka ka taga garoonka diyaaradaha ee Paris Beauvais Tillé Airport ee magaalada aada ayaan goostay. Dhexda ayuu na geeyey; halkaas ayaa bas lagaga sii wareegayaa oo qofba dhankuu magaalada uga socday u raacayaa. Baskii ayaan haddana tigidh u goostay. Nasiibdarro, mid baa si ii tabaabusheeyey Afrikaan ahaa oo bas halkan iska taagan i saaray, shandaddii aan watayna xagga hoose ee baska ii geliyey. Kolkaan xoogaa fadhiyey ayaan shakiyey oo is idhi, bal meesha uu sii marayo hubi. Waddo aan magaceeda hayo iyo goobtii aan u socday ayaan damcay in aan mid debadda taagnaa weydiiyo, waan soo degay si aan uga waraysto. Markii aan dhulka sidaa u taabtayba baskii wuu iska dhaqaaqay. Shandaddaydii baa saaran. Aniguna dhulkaan taaganahay. Markiiba kii baan ku qayliyey 'waar shandaddaydii, waar shandaddaydii'. Isna markiiba baskii buu ka daba qayliyey, xoogaa baannu baskii oo yara dhaqaaqay eryannay. Meel hore istaag oo shandaddaydii ii soo deji. Weliba, ka hor, inta aanay ii soo dejin, si buu kii darawalka ahaa u shakiyoo, shandaddii aan sheegtay ayuu rakaabkii baska weydiiyey in cid kale ay leedahay, markii cidi sheegan waydayna i sii, oo kala soo tegay. Meel dhexe ayaan ku yar nastay illeen xoogaa baan bas eryadee! Minidkaas ayaan hoosta ka idhi, 'Alleylehe waa Baariis dhexdeeda oo aan bas shandad igala tegay eryanayo!' Xaaladdaas si dadban ayaan u gartay waxaan Baariis maalmaha aan joogo kaga tashanayo, ugu yaraan in wixii is eryadka la odhan jirey ka jiro gartay. Istaankii basaska ayaan ku soo noqday. Intaanan baskii kale fuulin, ayayba igu dhalatay in la ii qaatay tagsi toos ii geeya halkan rabo. Moobilkayga ayaan la soo baxay oo adeegga Bolt ee tagaasida oo caalami ah, Kiiniyana aan ku isticmaali jirey, ayaan is idhi bal eeg in uu halkan ka shaqayanayo. Wuuba shaqeeyey! Tagsi ayaanan halkii ka dalbaday. Koongaliis halkan ka tagsiileeya ayuu noqday oo bartii aan u socday i gee. Xaafadda La Chapelle oo Soomaalidu ku badan tahay, oo meel aan tilmaan ka haystay ku taallay ayaan imi; nin reer Burco ah oo xer asxaab ahi igu soo xidhay baa meherad ku haysta oo itaalka cunto soomaalina ugu eero ayaan is leeyahay. Markaan tagsigii sidaa uga soo degay, bartii cinwaankeeda aan hayey ayaan hore u yar arki waayey. Mid Soomaali oo meel halkana kursi ku fadhiya ayaan aniga oo shandaddaydii jiidanaya ku idhi, 'Walaal meeshii Hebel meeday?' Intaanan Baariis iman ka hor ayaan asxaab aan Faransiiska ku ogaa la hadlay. Sacad, oo dugsigii Shiikh Ibraahim aannu isku galaas ahayn, saaxiib aannu isku kursi ahaan jirnayna ahaa ayaan wacay, habeenkaan berri oo kale imanayey. Ii sheeg in magaalo kale oo fog uu ku nool yahay. Nin kale oo aan meesha ku ogaa isna ii sheeg in uu magaalo kale joogo. Ragguna, inaan xilli danbe u soo sheegay oo hadday sii ogaan lahayeen meesha igu soo booqan lahaayeen iigu cudurdaarte. Nimanka Faransiis aan Baariis ka deggannayni maxay la maqan yihiin, may Ballidhiigtoodii iyo Qoryaaladoodii iska degaan kollayba hadday tuulo degayaan ayaan ku xifaaleeyey. "Afrika caasimadaha laga degaa" ayaa igu yar qafilnayd. Raggu se halkan waa dhul isku midoo, qofba halka uu nolosheeda iyo jaanisyadeeda ka helo ayuu iska degaa, oo safarkuna sidaa uma cusla, tuulada Yurub ku taallaana caasimad Afrika waxba uma oga. Laftayda se asxaab bariidin bay iga ahayde, sidaa uma wewersani oo nin wax u baxsan yihiin baan isu arkaa oo khariiradda, cinwaanka, iyo adeegga Google in ay i caawin doonaan ayaan ku kalsoonahay. Weliba, nin Baariis si gaar ah iyada u kala yaqaan ayaaban isu haystaa. Waayo, sheekooyinkii Yaasiin-Buur, iyo sida Baariis looga socdo oo aan Wadaamagoo beri hore ku maqlayba way ii fadhiyaan. Xataa waddooyinka, oo taxanihii Emily in Paris aan ku daawadayna wax badan waan ka dhex arkay. Kolkaa, aniga iyo Baariis in aannu isku sirannahay ilama aha. (Aniga ayaaba dareemaya in aan ku dhex jiro taxane kale oo Dhimbiil In Paris ah). Haddaba, kolkii aan inankii Soomaaliga ahaa ee meesha taagnaa ku idhi ""Meheraddii Hebel meeday?" inta uu sidaa ii eegay oo gartay in aan hadda soo galay ayuu si kaftan ka muuqday iigu yidhi: "Ma calaa duul baa, oo halkaas baad toos GPS-ka ku soo xidhatay?" Inta uu dhoolacaddeeyey. Markiiba intaan halka uu u socdo gartay, ayaan si cadho ka yar muuqato u idhi: "Haa! Ee meeday?" Suu i yidhi: "Waa taa" inta uu dareemay in weedhu i yara gaadhay. Daalkii safarkaa lahaaye, in ninkaa odayga ahi si ilbaxnimo ah iila kaftamay dareemay. Meeshii aan u socday helay. Waaba goor duhuree qado ka cunay meeshii, weliba cunto Soomaali aanan maalmahanba arag cunay. Cunta kale maahee, hilib baan ka helay; sidii nin Burco jooga oo hudheelkii Badhabadha ama Beder hilib ka dalbanaya ayaan Baariis uga dhex qadeeyey, maalinkii koowaadba. Toddobaad ayaan joogay magaaladii, nin oday ah oo Cabdillaahi Axmed la yidhaahdo oo xertaydii ahna iska dhex helnay xaafaddii Soomaalida, oo magaaladii ii shid. Booqday birtii caanka ahayd Eiffel Tower, miyuusamkii Musée du Louvre, dhismaha Notre-Dame Cathedral iyo meelo kale oo xiiso gaar ah lahaa. Waddooyinkii magaaladana hadba dhan u raacay, magaaladiina meelihii ii qorshaysnaa wada tegay. Safarkaygii Baariisna, allaylehe, ku raaxaystay. Ruqiyo Bulle: Gabadha Soomaalida ah ee ku guuleysatay abaalmarinta sare ee BBC-dau bixiso Ruqiyo Bulle oo ah gabar Soomaali Kenya wariye ah ayaa ku guulaysatay abaalmarinta BBC-da ee la yiraahdo Komla Dumor Award, ee sanadka -ta. Gabadhan oo sano jir ah una shaqaysa warbaahinta Nation Media Group, ayaa soo bandhigta sheekooyin xiiso leh ayaa noqotay qofkii sagaal oo ku guulaysta abaalmarintan. Ruqiyo, ayaa sidoo kale saamayn weyn barta TikTok oo ay dad badan ku xiran yhiin ayna ku soo bandhigot mawaadiic la xiira nolosha saxafiga. Abaalmarinta ayaa loogu magac daray oo loo hibeeyey Dumor, wariyihi iyo tabiyihii BBC-da ee reer Ghana kaas oo si kadis ah u geeriyooday sanadkii -kii isagoo sano jir ah. Wuxuu shaqo adag galiyey inuu soo gudbiyo sheekooyin xiiso leh oo ku saabsab Afrika oo adduunka u soo bandhigo isagoo u tabiyey si kalsooni leh xeeldheer iyo dhanka ganacasi. Garsoorayaasha waxay aad ula dhaceen adkaysiga iyo kartida ay u leedahay Ruqiyo maaraynta sheekooyina caqabado lahaa, iyadoo diiradda saaraysa inay matasho kuwa an codka lahayn sida awooda leh iyo tabinteeda heerka sare ah. “Ku guuleysiga abaal-marintan waxay ii tahay macno weyn aniga. Suxufi ahaan, waxaad had iyo jeer ku dedaalaysaa inaad samayso waxa ugu fiican, iyadoon loo eegayn aqoonsigaaga, sidaa darteed in lagugu aqoonsado masraxa caalamiga ah ee Abaalmarinta Komla Dumor Award si cajiib ah ayay u ansaxaysaa,” ayey tiri Ruqiyo Buulle oo sannadkii hore ka soo muuqday liiska ka qof ee ugu saamaynta badan Muslimiinta Kenya. "Waxaan rajeynayaa in abaal-marintan ay dhiirigeliso gabdhaha da'da yar ee aniga oo kale ah, kuwaas oo xirta xijaabka kana soo jeeda beela laga tirada badan yahay, inay ku riyoodaan wax weyn oo ay gaaraan hadafkooda."intaas raacisay Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Waxay intaa ku dartay iyadoo la hadlaysay BBC-da Ruqiyo inay toddobaadyo sugaysay helid jawaabtan farxada leh in loo sheego inay ku guulaysatay abaalmarintan. Waxay intaa ku dartay inay jeclayd saxaafada ayna xooga saarto samaynta sheekooyinka ku saabasan in cod u noqoto dadka an la maqlin oo ay bannaanka u soo saarto. Wariyahan Kenyanka aha ayaa waqti saddex bilood ah la shaqayn doonta qaybta wararka ee BBC-da sida Telefishinka, Raadyaha iyo Onlinke xarunta London. Waxay sidoo kale heli doontaa tababar iyadoo la shaqayn doonta wariya Waxa ay sidoo kale heli doontaa tababaro waxaa kale hagi doona wariyaasha sare sare BBC-da Tarik Kafala, oo ah ku-simaha agaasimaha BBC World Service, ayaa sheegay inuu aad ugu faraxsan yahay in abaalmarinta Komla Dumor ay kobcisay xirfadda suxufiyiin badan oo qaaradda ah. “Dadkii hore ee abaal-marintan helay waxa ay wax weyn ku soo kordhiyeen saxaafadda adeegga bulshada sidaa darteed aad ayaan ugu faraxsanahay in aan soo dhawayno Ruqiya Bulle oo ku guulaysatay sannadkan,” ayuu yiri Qorshayaasha kale waxaa ka mida in Ruqiyo, u safri doonto dal ku yaalla Qaarada si ay tabiso sheekooyin kuwaas oo loo baahin doono dhagaystayaasha BBC-da ee Caalamka. Guulaystayaashii hore ee biladan horrey u helay waxaa ka mida wariyaasha kala ah Paa Kwesi Asare, Dingindaba Jonah Buyoya, Victoria Rubadiri, Solomon Serwanjja, Waihiga Mwaura, Amina Yuguda, Didi Akinyelure iyo Nancy Kacungira. Abaalmarinta Komla Dumor waa abaal-marin saxaafadeed oo ay BBC-du billowday sannadkii -kii iyadoo lagu sharfayo dhaxalka uu ka tagay saxafiga reer Ghana ee Komla Dumor oo u soo shaqeeyay BBC World News, ahaana daadihiyaha ugu weyn ee barnaamijkeeda Focus on Africa. Komla, waxa uu si hagar la'aan ah uga shaqeeyay in uu dunida u soo bandhigo sheekooyin aad u xiiso badan oo ku saabsan Afrika. Abaalmarintani loogu magac daray Komla Dumor, ayaa weriyeyaasha da’ yarta ah ee qaaradda Afrika siina fursad ay ku helaan xirfad muhiim ah, iyo waaya aragnimo muddo saddex bilood ah oo London ay BBC-du ku siin doono fursad tababar goobta shaqada ah. Biladan waxaa helay wariyaal ku nool qaarada kuwaas oo sidoo kale BBC-da la sameeyeyey sheekooyin xiisa lahaa oo ay ka sameeyeen qaarada.
