Guidance: Investigations The term 'Investigation' can be applied to many types of journalistic content, designed to shed light on matters of public interest. All sorts of content may include elements of investigation. However, this guidance is confined to larger-scale investigations that scrutinise an individual, groups of individuals, a business or other organisations to reveal serious crime, serious anti-social behaviour or wrongdoing, or other such matters of significant public interest. They may also contain a significant element of undercover work (and usually ongoing use of secret recording) central to the evidence-gathering - particularly where an individual may be sent undercover to work within or otherwise infiltrate that organisation. The Editorial Guidelines contain many principles and practices relevant to investigations; the guidance here is some of the best practice learned from a variety of such investigations over the years. Other guidance notes – such as those relating to Secret Recording and Right of Reply – include relevant information too, and it is advisable to discuss all investigations with Editorial Policy throughout the process. Where possible, investigations should normally be published or broadcast when ready rather than held for scheduling purposes or as part of a series. Any exceptions should be agreed beforehand so the risks of the content sitting on the shelf can be properly assessed on a case-by-case basis. The Editorial Guidelines require that any proposal to undertake an investigation into serious crime or serious anti-social behaviour must be referred to a senior editorial figure or, for independents, to the commissioning editor. Editorial Policy and Programme Legal Advice must also be consulted. It can often be helpful to produce a detailed outline laying out the aims of the investigation, the existing evidence and the parameters of the inquiry. (See Editorial Guidelines Section Crime and Anti-Social Behaviour: . . – . . ) It will normally be necessary to hold a start-up discussion with key members of the production team, undercover operatives, a senior editorial figure and Editorial Policy, Programme Legal Advice and BBC Safety, in order to consider the risks and management of the investigation. These discussions should be held at the earliest possible stage and may even be required before a firm commitment is made to production of a programme. Any proposal to send someone to work as an undercover operative on an investigation must be referred to Editorial Policy and Programme Legal Advice. (See Editorial Guidelines Section Privacy : Secret Recording . . – . . and Secret Recording for Investigations including Undercover Investigations . . – . . ) Before any undercover work begins, appropriate members of the production team should be aware of all relevant Editorial Guidelines and guidance, practices to be followed when using secret filming equipment, how to carry out filming in such a way that the footage and its evidential value can be verified by the production team, the contemporaneous note-taking and record keeping required, and legal and safety considerations. Particular attention should be given to any measures that may be necessary to ensure filmed material can be validated and the resulting investigation can withstand the closest scrutiny. This is even more important when using an undercover operative working in the field alone. (See below: Authentication of Material) Appropriate security measures should be used to prevent confidential information or personal data, as defined by UK data protection legislation, from being accidentally or deliberately compromised. This may include data encryption processes and password protection. It is recommended that personal or confidential data is stored on a BBC approved Cloud service such as Dropbox, particularly if it contains restricted or sensitive personal information. If that is not practicable because, for example, information needs to be accessed off-premises or needs to be backed up, then an encrypted portable storage device may be used (but only for as long as is necessary). Most data, including all personal data, held on a portable storage device must be encrypted in compliance with the BBC Acceptable Use Policy, and the BBC Records Management Corporate Policy and kept secure at all times. Some data, such as editorially sensitive data or children's personal data, must be given an additional layer of security and be pre-encrypted (ie with password protection) before being uploaded to Cloud services or portable storage. Contact Information Security for more advice. For information about what protection is needed for different types of data see advice on Gateway. See guidance on how to encrypt files or portable storage devices for Windows and Mac. The BBC is legally required to report personal data breaches to the Information Commissioner's Office within hours of becoming aware of the incident. Any secret recording proposals must be conducted in accordance with the Editorial Guidelines andapproved using the established procedures. The cover story or any invitations to targets designed to encourage them to talk should be carefully thought through, avoiding any unjustifiable entrapment. Advice is available from Editorial Policy and Programme Legal Advice. (See Editorial Guidelines Section Privacy: Secret Recording . . – . . ) (See guidance: Secret Recording) A daily diary should usually kept by the production team, detailing all contacts with the subject of the investigation whether filmed or not. When making ongoing use of secret recording, secretly recorded material needs to be logged and kept secure and preferably copied, with originals kept in secure storage. Such logs usually contain a brief summary of what is on the material and who filmed it. It is also helpful if the base team review the material and keep a log that is reviewed by the undercover team on return. (See below: Authentication of Material) The use of any material recorded by a third party, whether gathered openly or covertly, must be in accordance with the Editorial Guidelines. (See Editorial Guidelines Section Accuracy: . . – . . and Section Privacy: . . and . . ) Any proposed payment to contributors must be in line with the Editorial Guidelines. (See Editorial Guidelines Section Crime and Anti-Social Behaviour: . . – . . and . . – . . ) If the parameters of the investigation shift significantly during production, this should be confirmed and agreed with the senior editorial figure and discussed as required with Editorial Policy. It may be necessary to go through some of the initial procedures again to ensure the refocused investigation still has the necessary prima facie evidence and public interest. All proposals to send an undercover operative to work in a business or organisation must be conducted in accordance with the Editorial Guidelines. (See Editorial Guidelines Section Privacy: . . – . . and Section Crime and Anti-Social Behaviour . . – . . ) The Editorial Guidelines require that Editorial Policy is consulted over job applications, which includes the use of a CV. This should normally contain as much accurate information as possible, and the amount of false information kept to a minimum. Should the application be successful, an entirely fictitious past and persona creates extra pressures in what is already a uniquely demanding situation, and could jeopardise the investigation. When someone is working undercover, another member of the production team is normally based nearby in order to provide back-up or other assistance and support (including debriefs and help with record keeping). (See below: Authentication of Material) Normally the secret recording will only commence when the operative has gained evidence of or witnessed the behaviour and practices they are seeking to capture. There may be certain occasions where recording can begin immediately, but the parameters for this will need to have been agreed in advance. Operatives should usually keep a daily diary noting the details and context of what was filmed and why. (See above: Record Keeping, and below: Authentication of Material) Undercover operatives are in place to gather evidence and record the story, not to create the story. If a manager in the business or organisation under investigation (or someone else in a position of authority) gives instructions to our undercover operative do something that departs from rules, regulations or best practice, it may be appropriate to follow those instructions where this is important evidence showing how an organisation operates and manages their staff. However, care must be taken to assess the possible implications or consequences of an undercover reporter following such instructions. For example, could it have significant negative consequences for innocent members of the public or could it be argued convincingly that the operative should have questioned the instructions or simply refused to comply? Where operatives could face such dilemmas, it is important to think through possible scenarios before going undercover and draw up protocols on how to proceed. At all times, the requirements of the investigation should be balanced with responsibilities to the public and others. The public interest in BBC journalism should not be outweighed by public concern about any harm that may have been caused by the methods used. Operatives whose true identity is discovered and are directly challenged as to whether they are filming should normally respond truthfully, without going into detail or engaging in protracted discussions. It is usually advisable to then leave as quickly as possible, remaining calm and non-confrontational, making clear that the programme's Editor will deal with the matter. Investigations may often include evidence from whistleblowers. While corroborating their story, it is important to consider any ulterior motives they might have, particularly if they no longer work for the organisation or company concerned and their claims could be discredited by the manner of their dismissal. Consideration should also be given to what steps, if any, a whistleblower has given to resolving their concerns within the relevant organisation and whether or not it is appropriate for them to take any such steps before the BBC acts. Where whistleblowers still work for an organisation under investigation and their identity needs to be protected, care must be taken not to identify them in any notes or other material that could be seen by third parties (particularly if that material could later be called upon as evidence in a court case or complaint). Whistleblowers should not normally receive any payment or other inducement for their involvement. The Editorial Guidelines state that 'content makers should normally undertake all the tasks associated with investigative journalism themselves'. Any proposal to use a private investigator must be conducted in accordance with the Editorial Guidelines. (See Editorial Guidelines Section Privacy: . . ) (See guidance: Use of Private Investigators) A successful investigation is likely to lead to detailed examination of the content makers' work (including all rushes and recorded material) – particularly when it uncovers wrongdoing that leads to prosecution or may have a commercial impact on the subject of the investigation. Those under investigation, or their representatives, will often seek to undermine the programme's integrity by looking for weaknesses in its evidence or investigative process, or questioning the good faith of those who gathered the evidence. Production teams should bear this in mind at all stages of the investigation and be confident that all material used, supporting evidence (including records and notes) and the processes followed are properly preserved and can withstand the closest scrutiny. Withstanding such scrutiny will often depend on the ability of the production team to demonstrate the authenticity of any evidence supporting the allegations contained in the eventual content. The Editorial Guidelines state that "Where appropriate to the output, content makers should validate the authenticity of documentary evidence and digital material". The Editor of an investigative programme has overall responsibility for ensuring that all evidential material to be broadcast meets the standards necessary to achieve due accuracy. (See Editorial Guidelines Section : Accuracy: . . ) Each allegation contained in BBC content should be considered in isolation. The weight or quantity of evidence obtained throughout the investigation may not be, on its own, sufficient to overcome any doubts raised about the accuracy of an individual allegation or piece of evidence. The need to validate the authenticity of filmed or recorded evidence should be considered at the outset of an investigation - for example in a start-up meeting with key members of the production team including any undercover operatives or others working 'in the field'. Consideration should be given to gathering supporting material where possible. This may include consistent and unbroken time-coding of rushes, video diaries, and written records or notes of the events that have been witnessed by the team's undercover operatives. (See above: Start-Up Considerations and Editorial Guidelines Section : Accuracy: . . ) Accurate and reliable note-taking is an essential and prime journalistic craft; it can also be crucial to protecting the reputation of an investigative programme, its production team and the BBC. If filmed evidence is later disputed by those under investigation, records and notes documenting what has been captured on camera, how it was filmed and any relevant surrounding events can be an important tool for validating the filming. These notes should normally be made as contemporaneously as operationally possible. It is advisable to give early consideration to what notes will be required, who will make them and how they will be made. This also applies to recorded audio evidence. (See above: Start-Up Considerations and Editorial Guidelines Section Accuracy: . . ) In addition, it is advisable to keep a detailed and contemporaneous diary of all other dealings with the subject of the investigation, outside of those that have been secretly recorded. Remember that all records and notes may become relevant to a prosecution, other legal action or complaint to a broadcast regulator that follows an investigation. It is usually recommended for an undercover operative to be supported in the field by a member of the programme team. This team member can offer production and safety support, as well as assistance with keeping records that validate any filmed material and corroborate the claims of the finished programme. Where it is not possible for the operative to be supported in the field, the Editor (along with the production team) must subject the filmed or recorded material to the closest possible scrutiny, review the available supporting material and question the operative, in order to consider where any inconsistencies may lie and satisfy themselves as to the circumstances in which evidence was obtained, its significance and ability to withstand the scrutiny that can follow a successful investigation. Throughout the editing process, it is important to ensure the finished content reflects the evidence fairly and accurately, taking account the context in which any secretly recorded incidents took place. Achieving this may be aided by keeping detailed notes of what is on all secretly recorded material, including a list of who has been filmed, with the producer reviewing all of the material before editing begins. Apparently damning events should not be lifted out of context. A transcription of the full surrounding material can help to avoid this. Where a secretly recorded target has been encouraged to talk by an undercover operative, this should be made clear in the programme. When dealing with a large amount of secretly recorded material, where only a small proportion can appear in the finished programme, it is important that the editing process does not distort the overall meaning or significance of the secretly recorded material as a whole. In some circumstances it can be helpful to have a senior editorial figure (an Executive or someone with appropriate editorial expertise agreed by a senior manager) acting as a 'second chair', reviewing the thesis of the programme, the allegations to be made and the editing process in the context of all relevant rushes. When the allegations to be made in the film have been identified, the right of reply process should be followed in accordance with the Editorial Guidelines. Atooreyaashii dhintay iyagoo jilaya filimadoodii ugu dambeeyay , Hindustan Times Jilayaal isugu jira rag iyo dumar oo ka tirsanaa shirkadda filimada Hindiga ee Bollywood-ka ayaa geeriyooday iyagoo bartanka uga jira shaqada filimo ay soo wadeen ama aan wali lasii deynin filimadii ugu dambeeyay ee ay soo jileen. Marka ay atooreyaasha ama atariishooyinka dhintaan, taageerayaashooda ayaa aad ula murugooda geeridooda. Laakiin dhammaanteen waxaan mar walba xasuusnaannaa jilayaasha bandhigyada wanaagsan sameyn jiray, horayna aan uga heli jirnay habka ay noo madadaaliyaan. Hase yeeshee mararka qaar waxaa dhacda in jilayaasha qaarkood aysan nasiib u yeelanin inay goob joog ka noqdaan natiijada ka soo baxeysa shaqadii ugu dambeysay ee ay qabteen. Qormadan waxaan kusoo qaadaneynaa liiska jilayaashaii geeriyooday iyagoo aan daawanin filimadoodii ugu dmabeeyay. Sushant Singh Rajput wuxuu geeriyooday -kii bishii June ee sannadkan -ka. Jilaagan, oo ka mid ahaa atooreyaasha ugu caansan ee sannadihii dambe soo baxay, ayaa isdilay. Soo saareyaasha filimkiisii ugu dambeeyay, ee lagu magacaaby Dil Bechara, ayaa go'aansaday inay kasoo soo daayaan shirkadda OTT. Filimkan, oo si weyn loo sugayo ayaa -ka bishan July la shaacin doonaa, qof walbana waxaa xilligaas u suurtageleysa inuu daawado. Balse Sushant dabcan nasiib uma uusan yeelanin inuu ku raaxeysto bandhiggiisii ugu dambeeyay. Rishi Kapoor wuxuu geeriyooday -kii bishii April ee sanadkan. Dhimashadiisa waxay timid wax yar ka hor inta aan dunida badabkeed la galinin xayiraadda looga hortagayo cudurka safmarka ah ee Covid- . Jilaagan wuxuu xilliga uu dhimanayay jilayay filim lagu magacaabo Sharmaji Namkeen, kaasoo ay la sameyneysay atariishada caanka ah ee la yiraahdo Juhi Chawla. Wax yar ayaa uga dhimanaa dhammeystirka duubitaanka, laakiin soo saareyaasha ayaa go'aansaday inay filimka gabagabeeyaan Rishi la'aantiis, ayna sii daayaan. Waxay sidoo kale go'aansadeen inay filimkaas ka daaraan tiyaatarradooda, si ay atooraha rugcaddaaga ah ugu maamuusaan. Juhi Chawla ayaa dabayaaqadii sanadkii lasoo dhaafay barteeda twittwrka soo dhigtay sawirro iyo qoraal ay ugu duceyneyso inuu filimkaas guuleysto. Macluumaadkan waxaa daabacay X. Waxaan dalbanayenaa fasaxaaga ka hor inta aan la furin, waxaa laga yaabaa inay isticmaalayaan cookies iyo farsamooyin kale. hadii aad u bahato akhri X xeerarka cokie iyo kan ku saabsan xogta gaarka ah ka hor inta aadan aqbalin. si aad u aragto xogta guji ‘aqbal oo soco’. Rishi Kapoor wuxuu shaleemooyinka filimada lagu daawado qabsaday sanadkii -kii, markaasoo uu doorkiisii ugu horreeyay oo hoggaamin ah uu ka qaatay filim ka hadlayay qiso jacayl oo dhalinyaro dhex martay. Laakiin markii ugu horreysay Rishi Kapoor wuxuu jilista filimada kasoo muuqday isagoo carruur ah sanadkii -kii, wuxuuna ka qeyb qaatay filimkii uu aabihiis Raj Kapoor jilayay ee Mera Naam Joker. Kapoor wuxuu filim laga dabadhacay oo jacayl ahaa la sameeyay atariishada lagu magacaabo Neetu Singh. Lamaahanan ayaa jacaylkooda aan ku ekeynin jilitaan kaliya, waxayna is guursadeen sanadkii -kii. Wiilkooda Ranbir Kapoor, wuxuu hadda ka mid yahay jilayaasha ugu caansan shirkadda Bollywood-ka, taageerada weynna heysta. Sawirka, NBCUniversal -kii bishii April ee sanadkan -ka ayuu Irrfan Khan u geeriyooday nooc dhif ah oo ka mid ah cudurka kansarka, isagoo jir ahaa. Jilaagan waxaa dunida oo dhan laga bartay markii uu kasoo muuqday, xirfad cajiib ahna kusoo bandhigay filimkii lagu magacaabay Slumdog Millionaire. Khan wuxuu caan ku ahaa jilliinkiisa aan caadiga ahayn iyo fahamka, iyadoo dad badan ay u garanayaan mid ka mid ah jilaayada ugu xirfadda fiicnaa Hindiya. Inkastoo uu filimo badan soo jilay, dad badan waxay u maleeyaan in filimkiisii ugu dambeeyay uu ahaa Angrezi Medium. Om Puri, oo wadne xanuun u geeriyooday, waxaa filimadiisii loogu jeclaa ka mid ah: Ardh Satya, Sadgati, Paar iyo the satirical Jaane Bhi Do Yaaro. Sawirka, Hindustan Times Shammi Kapoor wuxuu -kii bishii August ee sanadkii -kii u geeriyooday kalli xanuun. Kapoor waxaa si weyn loogu yaqaannay habkii cajiibka ahaa ee uu bandhigyadiisa u sameyn jiray iyo qoob ka ciyaarkiisii. Atoorahan rugcaddaaga ah wuxuu dhintay isagoo jir ah, base xilligii uu dhalinyarada ahaa ayuu heer wanaagsan soo gaarsiiyay filimada Bollywood-ka. Filimkiisii ugu dambeeyay wuxuu ahaa Rockstar, oo la sii daayay bishii November ee sanadkii -kii, markaasoo ahayd dhimashadiisii kaddib. Atooraha da'da yar ee Ranbir Kapoor ayaa kala qeyb qaatay filimkaas, dad badanna waxay aad ugu faraxsanaayeen inuu yeeshay nasiibka uu filim kula jilay nin magac weyn ku lahaa bollywood-ka muddo tobannaan sano ah.

Saalax ma qaadi doonaa koobka AFCON ayadoo Morocco ay isha ku hayso sharaf ay dalkeeda u soo jiiddo Kadib dood adag oo ku saabsan helitaanka ciyaartoyga iyo waqtiga tartankan ayaa waxay diiraddu u wareegtay garoonka iyadoo mar kale bartamaha xilli ciyaareedyada yurub uu ka furmi doono dalka Morocco koobka qaramada Afrika. Marka la eego, labada qodob ee ugu muhiimsan ee ka horreeya finalka , ayaa ah in xulka martigelinaya tartankan uu sii dheeraysan karo rikoorka adduunka ee guul oo xiriir ah, isla markaana uu qaadi karo koob labaad, iyo haddii Mohamed Salah uu ugu dambeyntii koobka la qaadi doono Masar. Mustaqbalka -sano jirkaan u cayaara Liverpool waxa uu ahaa mid qabsaday ciwaannada tan iyo markii uu sheegay -dii Disembar in kooxda ay "ku soo tuureen baska hoostiisa". Ka dib markii uu ka soo laabtay kursiga keydka ee Anfield Sabtidii hore, Salah wuxuu hadda diiradda saari doonaa isku daygiisii shanaad ee uu ku hanan karo abaalmarinta ugu weyn qaaradda - gaar ahaan ka dib laba guuldarro oo hore oo uu ka soo gaaray finalka. Fadlan halkan riix oo ku soo biir janalka WhatsApp ee BBC Somali si aad u hesho wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee caalamka, iyo kuwa gobolka Laakin in xooga la saaro laba mawduuc kaliya cadaalad uma samaynayso, tartan gaar ah oo lagu gartana lama saadaalin karo. Ivory Coast ayaa guulo cajiib ah garoonkeeda ku gaartay bishii February ee sanadkii hore, shaqada ka cayriyeen tababarahoodii intii lagu jiray wareega Group-yada, halka Senegal qaab ciyaareedka fiican ay ku soo bandhigtay guushii ay ka gaareen England bishii June. Dhanka kale, Nigeria waxay hiigsaneysaa inay gaarto guul ka wanaagsan finalka -ka, laakiin kooxaha kale ee culus sida Cameroon ayaa u muuqda, marka dibadda laga fiiriyo, inay ku jiraan xaalad jahawareer leh - iyadoo labada dal ay raadinayaan inay isa saxaan ka dib markii ay seegeen Koobka Adduunka ee Fifa. Iyadoo toddobo guuleyste oo kala duwan ay ka heleen siddeedii koob ee la soo dhaafay, Morocco waxaa hubaal ah inay noqon doonto daawasho soo jiidasho leh. "Aad bay u adag tahay in lagu guuleysto Koobka Qaramada Afrika, dadku aad bay noo jecel yihiin, laakiin haddii aad ku guulaysato weligood kuma ilaawi doonaan," Sofyan Amrabat oo khadka dhexe uga ciyaara Morocco ayaa u sheegay BBC World Service.

Masar iyo Soomaaliya oo ka wada hadlay arrimo muhiim ah oo ay Badda Cas ka mid tahay Madasha Dooxa ayaa dhawaan lagu qabtay dalka Masar. Shirka ayaa la qabtay iyadoo la adeegsanayo hal-ku-dhigga "Raadinta Istaraatiijiyad Habaysan oo Lagu Joogtaynayo Isbeddelka". Mid ka mid ah diiradda shirku wuxuu ahaa xal wax ku ool ah oo loo helo xiisadda Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar Badr Abdelatty ayaa sheegay in dhibaatooyinka maanta ka taagan Soomaaliya ay u baahan yihiin taageero caalami ah oo isku dubaridan. "Waxaa jira kuwo isku dayaya in ay gobolka [Soomaaliya] ka dhigaan meel lagu tartamo," ayuu yiri Badr Abdelatty. Tallaabadan oo kale ayaa khatar gelinaysa midnimada Soomaaliya, waxayna degganaansho la'aan ka dhigaysaa gobolka Badda Cas, ayuu yiri. Inkastoo aysan magacaabin kuwaas, haddana dhawaanahan waddamada waaweyn sida Mareykanka, Ruushka iyo Shiinaha ayaa kordhiyay dhaqdhaqaaqyadooda Geeska Afrika iyo dadaalladooda ku aaddan inay ku guulaystaan diblomaasiyadda. Mareykanka iyo Shiinaha ayaa magacaabay ergaygii ugu horreeyay ee gaar ah ee Geeska Afrika. Sidoo kale, xiisadda ka taagan gobolka ayaa sii kordheysa. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Badr Abdelatty ayaa sheegay in diblomaasiyadda Masar ee ku aaddan Soomaaliya ay tahay mid lagu xaqiijinayo midnimada xudduudaha Soomaaliya, laguna hor istaagayo go'aannada dhinac kaliya ah ee gobolka laga qaato. Somaliland waxay sheegtay inay ka go'day Soomaaliya sano ka hor. Inkastoo aan la aqoonsanayn, haddana way is-maamushaa. Masar waxay dhinac joogtay Soomaaliya markii Somaliland ay oggolaatay inay deked badeed siiso Itoobiya horraantii sanadkan. Soomaaliya, Eritrea iyo Masar ayaa iyaguna kala saxiixday heshiisyo militari iyo kuwo kale oo ka soo horjeeda heshiiska Itoobiya. Masar ma rabto in Itoobiya ay yeelato deked badeed. Tan tilmaanta u ah ayaa ah is-afgaradka labada dhinac ee ka soo baxay shirkii Aswan ee u dambeeyay, kaasoo dhigayay in maamulka Badda Cas uu quseeyo oo keliya waddamada xudduudahoodu ay gaaraan badda. Sida uu sheegay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar, Masar waxay Soomaaliya siisay barnaamijyo tababar oo kala duwan, taageero ay siisay hay'adaha rayidka iyo amniga iyo fursado waxbarasho si ay Soomaaliya uga dhigto dal xooggan oo deggan. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Masar ay qayb hormuud ka ahayd howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee nabad-ilaalinta Soomaaliya, ee AUSSOM. Wuxuu sheegay in howlgalkiisu yahay soo celinta nabadda Soomaaliya balse ay jirto miisaaniyad la'aan lagu taageerayo ciidamada amniga Soomaaliya inta lagu jiro xilligan kala guurka ah. Badr Abdelatty ayaa sheegay in uu wadahadallo la yeeshay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayadoo ay ka wada qeyb galeen shirka Dooxa. Masar iyo Soomaaliya ayaa ka wada hadlay sidii ay u garab istaagi lahaayeen Soomaaliya si loo ilaaliyo xasiloonida gobolka Badda Cas, sida uu qoray wargeyska Al-Ahram ee kasoo baxa Masar. Nabadda Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas ayaa fure u ah horumarka gobolka, ayuu yiri, isaga oo intaas ku daray in uu sii wadi doono taageerada uu siiyo Soomaaliya si tan loo xaqiijiyo. Shirka ayaa waxaa ka soo qeyb galay Ergayga Gaarka ah ee Mareykanka u qaabilsan Suuriya Tom Barak, Wakiilka Gaarka ah ee Midowga Yurub u qaabilsan Koonfur Afrika Annette Weber, Xoghayihii hore ee Qaramada Midoobay Ban Ki-moon iyo Borge Brende oo ka socday Madasha Dhaqaalaha Adduunka. Diiradda ugu weyn ee wadahadallada ayaa ah sidii nabad waarta looga gaari lahaa Koonfur Afrika, horumarinta ballaarinta iyo gargaarka bini'aadantinimo. Horaan, markii Midowga Yurub ay ka qeyb gashay shirkii Aswan oo uu heshiis goonni ah la saxiixday Masar, waxay soo saartay bayaan ka caraysiiyay Itoobiya oo ku saabsan biya-xireenka Niil. Itoobiya ayaa cambaareysay. Masar ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay garab istaagtay qof kasta oo dhibaato kala dhexeysa Itoobiya tan iyo markii Itoobiya ay isku khilaafeen biya-xireenka. Dhowaan ayay Masar ka jawaabtay codsigii -ka sano ahaa ee ay u jeedinaysay Itoobiya inay heshiis ka gaaraan biya-xireenka. "Ma jiro shirqool aad ka waddaan Geeska Afrika oo aniga i jilba-dhigi doona," ayay tiri Itoobiya. Masar ayaa ku eedaysay Itoobiya inay diidday inay wadahadal yeeshaan oo sidoo kalena ay raacdo go'aannadeeda. Itoobiya, si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxay sheegtay inaysan u hoggaansami doonin, sababtoo ah heshiisyadii xilligii gumeysiga ee lagu saxiixay isticmaalka Niil kuma jirin dhammaan, mana aysan ixtiraamin danahooda qaran. Masar, si kastaba ha ahaatee, tan ma rabto. Sidii la isku raacay, waxay rabtaa inay go'aan madax-bannaan ka gaarto isticmaalka Niil intii lagu jiray xilligii gumeysiga. Itoobiya waxay bixisaa in ka badan % biyaha. Masar wax kaalin ah kuma laha Niil. Balse Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale sheegatay inay doonayso is-maamul. Sidaa darteed, Masar, oo ciidamo u dirtay si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga Soomaaliya, ayaa xoojisay xulafadeeda Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea.

Liibaan Cabdi: "Waan caawinayaa Soomaaliya intii aan u ciyaari lahaa" Wiil dhallinyaro ah oo ku dhashay Soomaaliya, laguna magacaabo Liibaan Cabdi ayaa ku riyoon jiray inuu u ciyaaro xulka qaranka Norway, laakiin hadda wuxuu rajeynayaa iney soo hagaageyso xaaladda waddankii uu ku dhashay sidaas awgeedna uu u ciyaari kari lahaa. Ciyaartoygan jirka ah ayaa xirfaddiisa ciyaartoynimo ku billlaabay kooxda ka dhisan dalka Ingiriiska ee Sheffield United, isagoo ay isku koox ahaan jireen xiddigaha koobka adduunka ee Kyle Walker iyo Harry Maguire. Wuxuu sidoo kale ka soo ciyaaray kooxo ka kala dhisan dalalka Hungary, Turkiga, Portugal, Norway iyo Sacuudiga. Wuxuu helay dhalashada dalka Norway maadaama uu ahaa cunug yar oo qoyskiisa ay ka soo qexeen Soomaaliya, fursad ayuuna u heystay inuu labada dhinacba qaran ahaan ugu ciyaaro. jirkaan ayaa waxaa muddo ka badan sano soo dalbaneysay Soomaaliya isaguna wuxuu jeclaa inuu u ciyaaro Norway. "Dabcan waa dalab - Soomaaliya wali waxay qeyb muhiim ah ka tahay qofka aan ahay. Laakiin ma aha wax aan iska sameyn karo ilaa uu meeshaas ka dhaco isbaddal weyn," sidaas ayuu ku yiri barnaamijka ciyaaraha ee BBC-da. "Wali waa meel cabsi leh oo aan lagu ciyaari karin, waxaan ka walwali lahaa dadka isku dayaya iney igu qasbaan sameynta waxyaabo anaan raalli ka ahayn. Waxaan diiday inaan noqdo ciyaaryahan loo adeegsado borabogaadada. Musuqmaasuqa xitaa wuu jiraa. Muxuu Ozil isaga casilay xulka qaranka Jarmalka? Sidee ugu habboon oo qof sooman u samayn karaa jirdhis iyo jimicsi? "Markii ugu horreysay ee ay isoo waceen masuuliyiinta xiriirka kubadda cagta Soomaaliya (SFF) waxaan u ciyaarayay kooxda da'da yar ee Norway, runta markaan ka hadlana xilligaas mustaqbalkeyga waxaan uga jeeday qaranka Norway. "Ma aanan dareemeynin inaan ka go'ay Soomaaliya, runtii sidaas liddigeeda ayeyba ahayd. "Waxaan ku fikirayay inaan ku biiro koox Soomaaliya ka weyn oo aan u ciyaaro Norway, taasina ay hor seedeyso magac weyn iyo inaan awood u yeesho sidii aan gacan uga geysan lahaa dib u dhiska Soomaalia oo ah wax qabad ka weyn in loo ciyaaro." Qodobbada uu ka hadlay ayaa ah kuwo uu gar u leeyahay. Soomaaliya ciyaaro caalami ah kama aysan qeyb galin muddo bilood ah, waqti xaadirkanna waxay meesha ugu hooseysa uga jirtaa qiimeynta kooxaha ciyaaraha ee FIFA, iyadoo ay booska -aad iskula jiraan dalalka Eritrea iyo Tonga. Cabdi waxaa ka go'an inuusan dayicin waddankii uu ku dhashay, wuxuuna helay waddooyin kale oo uu gacan uga geysan karo horumarka kubadda cagta ee Soomaaliya. "Waxaan sameeyay xoogaa yar oo dhaqaale uruurin ah waxaana diray xoogaa qalabka kubadda cagta ah - waxaana arrimahaas kala shaqeeyaa hay'adaha aan dowliga ahayn ee NGO-yada iyo ururrada samafalka, sidaas darteedna taas waxay ahayd waddo fiican oo aan ku caawin karo. "Dabcan waan jeclaan lahaa inaan u ciyaaro Soomaaliya maalin maalmaha ka mid ah waana ogahay iney taas wax fiican ka soo bixi karaan. Laakiin nasiib darro waddanku wali ma uusan gaarin heerkaas".

Intee le'eg yahay kaydka shidaalka ee Venezuela Saacado kadib markii milatariga Maraykanku ay xireen Madaxweynaha Venezuela Nicolás Maduro, Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa ballan qaaday in uu ka faa'iidaysan doono kaydka shidaalka ee dalkaas Koonfurta Ameerika ku yaalla. "Waxaan ka codsan doonnaa shirkadaha waaweyn ee shidaalka Maraykanka, kuwa ugu waaweyn dunida, in ay isku diyaariyaan inay maalgelin balaayiin doolar ku sameeyaan, si ay u dayactiraan kaabayaasha aadka u burburay kaabayaasha shidaalka iyo inay bilaabaan soo saarista dakhliga dalka," ayuu Trump ka yiri shir jaraa'id oo maalintaas uu qabtay Hadallada Trump waxay ku soo beegmayaan xilli suuqa shidaalka caalamku uu wajahayo dalab badan, qiimaha shidaalku waa mid hooseeya marka la eego, sida ay tahay saadaasha muddada-dheer iyo baahida shidaalku ay sii noqoneyso mid aan caddayn maaddaama dunidu u wareegayso baabuurta ku shaqeeya koronto. Shidaalka Venezuela ayaa lagu qiyaasaa ku dhowaad bilyan oo fuusto, waxa ayna ka dhigan tahay in ay haysato kaydka shidaalka ee ugu badan dunida inta la xaqiijiyay, taas oo noqoneysa "qiyaastii % wadarta guud ee shidaalka caalamka," sida uu sheegay Gideon Long, oo ah wariye ka tirsan BBC Money and Work. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa ku jirta kaalinta labaad iyadoo leh . bilyan oo foosto, waxaana ku xiga Iiraan oo leh . bilyan oo foosto iyo Ciraaq oo leh bilyan oo foosto, sida ay sheegtay Ururka Dalalka Dhoofiya Shidaalka (OPEC). Afartan dal marka la isu geeyo, waxay ka kooban yihiin in ka badan kala bar kaydka shidaalka adduunka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wax-soo-saarka hadda ee Venezuela waa mid aad u yar marka loo eego kaydkeeda. Bishii Nofeembar, dalka ayaa soo saaray qiyaastii , foosto maalintii, sida ku cad warbixintii ugu dambeysay ee suuqa shidaalka ee Hay'adda Caalamiga ah ee Tamarta (IEA). Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay wax ka yar saddex meelood meel wax-soo-saarkii ay lahayd toban sano ka hor, iyo wax ka yar % isticmaalka shidaalka caalamka. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Marka la barbar dhigo, Maraykanka wuxuu soo saaraa qiyaastii milyan oo foosto maalintii, sida ay sheegtay Hay'adda Macluumaadka Tamarta ee Maraykanka (EIA). Kaydka Venezuela badankiisu waxa uu ka kooban yahay waxa loogu yeero saliidda adag ee aasidka leh, kaas oo ka adag in la nadiifiyo marka loo eego shidaalka khafiifka ah, balse inta badan loo adeegsado samaynta naaftada iyo daamurka. "Dhibaatada ugu wayn ee loo tiiriyo hoos u dhaca shidaalka Venezeuela ayaa inay warshadaha ugu ee uu dalkau leeyahay ina ay ku yaallaan Dhanka Bari ee dalka, waxaana lala xiriiriyaa inuu yahay gobolkaas gobol aan la awoodin in la gaaro, intiisa bandanna ay ku hareereesan yihiin kaymo, waana waxa adkeenaya in lasoo saaro shidaalkaas", ayuu yiri Mr. Long. "waa saliid aad cayriin u ah oo aad u culus. Waa ay badan tahay saliidda halkaas taalla, balse tayadeedu maaha mid fiican, waxa ay u baahan tahay sifeeyn iyo hagaajin badan, dhanka kale meelo kooban oo aad u yar ayaa awood u leh in ay hagaajiyaan", ayuu raaciyey isaga oo sheegay in qaar ka mid ah warshadahan sifeynta ay ku yaallaan Texas. Nooc kasta oo saliid ah marka la gubayo waxa uu saameeyaa isbeddelka cimilada, balse gubista saliidda cayriinka ah ee Venezuela wa tan ugu daran ee ka qeyb-qaadato wasaqowga hawada iyo cimilada sii kululaaneysa ee dunida ay khubaradu sheegaan. Wax-soo-saarku waxa uu si weyn ayuu hoos ugu dhacay tan iyo horraantii , xilligii oo uu waddanka hogaaminayey madaxweynihii hore Hugo Chávez oo ahaa madaxweynihii ka horreeyay macallinkii Maduro , kadib xukuumaddii Maduro sheegeen in ay adkeeyeen, gacantana ay ku hayaan shirkadda shidaalka qaranka ee PDVSA, taas oo sababtay in shaqaalihii ugu khibradda badnaa in ay dalka iskaga tagaan Cunaqabataynta Maraykanka, oo markii ugu horreysay la saaray intii uu xilka hayay madaxweynihii hore Barack Obama sababo la xiriira eedeymo ku saabsan xadgudubyo xuquuqda aadanaha ah, ayaa sidoo kale ka xayuubisay dalka maalgelin badan iyo agab beddel ah oo uu u baahnaa. "Caqabadda dhabta ah ee ay wajahayaan waxay ku jirtaa kaabeyaashooda," ayuu yiri Callum Macpherson, madaxa qaybta badeecooyinka ee Investec, oo ah bangi iyo shirkad ka shaqeeya maareynta hantida caalamiga ah oo Anglo iyo Koonfur Afrika ku yaala. "Inta badan waddooyinkii sahayda iyo kaabeyaasha adkaa waa la dhacay, waa la kala furfuray, waana la iibiyey," ayuu raaciyay. Badi waxaa ka shaqeeya qaar ka mid ah shirkadaha shidaalka ee reer Galbeedka Venezuela, si gaar ah waxaa la xusi karaa shirkadda Chevron oo ah shirkadda keliya ee Maraykan ah ee dalka joogta. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, hawlahooda ayaa si weyn hoos ugu dhacay tan iyo markii Maraykanku ballaariyay cunaqabata uu saaray dalkaas, isla markaana bartilmaameedsaday goobaha dhoofinta shidaalka, si loo xaddido dhaqaalaha uu helayo Maduro. Sannadkii , Chevron waxa ay heshay oggolaansho (ruqsad) uu siiyay madaxweynihii hore Joe Biden si ay uga sii shaqayn karto shidaal qodista inkastoo ay saameyn ku yeelatay cunaqabataynta. Shirkadda, oo hadda bixisa qiyaastii shan meelood meel wax-soo-saarka shidaalka Venezuela, ayaa sheegtay inay diiradda saarayso badbaadada shaqaalaheeda isla markaana ay u hoggaansanto "dhammaan sharciyada iyo xeerarka khuseeya." Intii lagu jiray shirkiisa jaraa'id, Madaxweyne Donald Trump waxa sheegay in Maraykanku uu dhisay warshadaha shidaalka Venezuela, balse nidaamka dalkaas ah uu "ka xaday." "Waxaan dhisnay warshadaha shidaalka Venezuela annagoo ka faa'iidaysanay kartida, iyo aqoonta Maraykanka, balse nidaamka hantiwadaagga ah ayaa naga xaday intii ay jireen xukuumadihii hore," ayuu yiri. "Waxay ku xadeen xoog. Tani waxay ahayd mid ka mid ah xatooyadii ugu waaweynaa ee hantida Maraykanka ee taariikhda dalkeenna," ayuu raaciyay. Hadallada Trump waxay tixraacayaan go'aanno ay qaateen dowladihii hore ee Venezuela oo ku saabsanaa qamarameynta shidaal qodista dalkaasi. Sida uu qabo sharciga caalamiga ah, Venezuela waxa ay leedahay madax-bannaani buuxda oo ay u leedahay kaydkeeda shidaalka, taas oo Maraykanka u ogolaanayn wax xaquuq ah inuu ku leeyahay shidaalka Venezeuela. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, shirkadaha shisheeye waxay dalban karaan magdhow haddii hantidooda ay ku xadgudubto dowladda ka jirta dalka ay ka hawl galayaan. Homayoun Falakshahi, oo ah falanqeeye sare Kpler, a data platform, ayaa sheegay in caqabadaha ugu waaweyn ee hortaagan shirkadaha doonaya inay ka faa'iideystaan kaydka Venezuela ay yihiin kuwo sharci iyo siyaasadeed. Wareysi uu siiyay BBC, ayuu ku sheegay in shirkaduhu u baahan doonaan heshiis ay la galaan dowladda, taas oo aan suuragal noqon doonin ilaa uu xilka ka dago Maduro oo la helo hoggaan cusub. Markaas kadib, shirkaduhu waxa ay galin doonaan balaayiin doolar, wax ay ku xiran tahay xasilloonida dowladda mustaqbalka iman doonta, ayuu raaciyay. Shirkadaha doonaya inay ka faa'iideystaan qorshaha Trump waa inay marka hore saxiixaan qandaraasyo ay la galaan dowladda cusub ka hor inta aysan kordhin maalgashigooda kaabeyaasha maamulka Venezuela. Dadka falanqeeya arrimahaan ayaa ka digaya, si dib loogu soo celiyo heerarkii wax-soo-saarka ee hore ee Venezuela in ay ku bixi doonto tobaannaan bilyan doolar, isla markaana laga ayaabo in ay qaadato tobaneeyo sano. Neil Shearing, oo ah madaxa dhaqaalaha ee Capital Economics, ayaa sheegay in qorshayaasha Trump ay saameyn kooban ku yeelan doonaan sahayda iyo qiimaha shidaalka caalamka. "Waxaa jira caqabado aad u waaweyn oo ay tahay in laga gudbo, in la dhameeyana waqti dheer ayey qaadaneysaa," ayuu yiri, isagoo xusay in qiimaha shidaalka ee aan la filayn inuu si weyn isu beddelo. Shearing wuxuu intaas ku daray in shirkaduhu aysan maalgashan doonin ilaa ay jirto dolwad la isku hallayn karo, isla markaana mashaariicdu aysan miro dhalin doonin "sanado badan." "Dhibaatadu had iyo jeer waxay ahayd maalgashi la'aan muddo tobannaan sano ah, maamul-xumo, iyo kharash aad u sarreeya oo ku baxa soo saarista shidaalka," ayuu yiri. Xitaa haddii Venezuela ay ku laabato booskeedii hore ee ahaa inay soo saaro maalintii qiyaastii saddex milyan oo foosto, wali kama mid noqon doonto tobanka waddan ee ugu wax-soo saarka badan dunida", ayuu hadalkiisa ku daray Shearing. Madaxweynihii hore ee shirkadda BP John Browne ayaa BBC u sheegay in dib-u-soo-nooleynta warshadaha shidaalka Venezuela ay tahay "mashruuc aad u fog oo muddo dheer qaadan doonta." "Dadku waxay hoos ka eegayaan waqtiga loo baahan yahay in waxyaabaha qaar la fuliyo, guud ahaan diyaarinta isku dabo-ridka ilaha wax-soo saarka, gaar ahaan kan qalabka iyo kan aadanaha, waxa uu qaataa waqti dheer," ayuu yiri. Inkasta oo qaybo ka mid ah ilaha wax-soo saarku ay si dhaqse ah usoo kaban karaan, haddana marka hore hoos u dhici karaa sababo la xiriira dib-u-habaynta waaxda, " ayuu raaciyay. Mr. Browne ayaa hadalkiisa ku daray in shirkaduhu doonayaan in ay dhaqaale sameeyaan oo ay wax ku darsadaan ganacsiga caalamka, sababtoo ah "mar walba waa wanaagsan tahay in ganacsi lagu yeesho meelo kala duwan oo dunida ah."

Muxuu Sheekh Cali Wajiis ka yiri inuu fatwooday 'duulaan dowladda dhexe ku qaado Puntland'? Wasiirka Warfaafinta Puntland Maxamuud Caydiid Dirir, oo warbaahinta kula hadlay Garoowe ayaa sheegay in Puntland “ lagu soo qaaday duullaan diimeed “ isagoo eedeyn u jeediyey Sheekh Cali Wajiis oo ku sheegay in uu “ fadwooday in lagu duulo Puntland lana soo qabto madaxweynahooda” Laakiin sheekh Cali Wajiis oo BBCda la hadlay ayaa sheegay inuusan isagu ka hadlayn wax ku saabsan Puntland ee kaliya uu sharaxay nidaamka dowladdeed ee dalka iyo ay isaga la tahay aragtidiisa. “Waa nasiib darro, in masuul hadal beena oo raad lahayn u qasdo oo waliba dad ugu khudbeeyo," ayuu yiri Cali wajiis oo iska fogeynaya eedda uu u jeediyay wasiirka. "Anigu waxaan sharxayey federalka iyo qaynuunka qaabkuu u kala maareeyo dowladda dhexe iyo dowlad goboleedyada, anigu hadafkaygu ma ahayn Puntland” ayuu hadalkiisa sii raaciyay. Sheekh Cali wajiis oo dhawaan wareysi siiyay mid kamid ah warbaahinada maxalliga ah ee Soomaaliya, ayaa sheegay "In dawladda dhexe ee Soomaaliya ay xaq u leedahay in soo qabato madaxweynayaasha dawlad goboleedyada hadii ay ka hor yimaadaan". Balse isagu waxa uu ku adkeystay in inuusan fatwoon in lagu duulo Puntland sida uu ku eedeyey wasiirka Puntland. Dhanka kale wasiir Caydid ayaa si la mida Sheekh Cali Wajiisa eedeyn u jeediyey Sheekh Maxamed Cabdi Umal, hase yeeshee xiriir BBCdu la samaysay Sheekha ayaan noo suura galin inuu ka soo jawaabo. , PUNTLAND STATE HOUSE Ka dib wax ka baddelkii dastuurka ee ay meel mariyeen labada aqal ee barlamaanka Soomaaliya uuna saxiixay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud waxaa la bilowday khilaaf xooggan oo ka dhex oogmay dhinacyada Puntland ayaa ku dhawaaqday go’aan siyaasi ah oo ay gaareen golaheeda wasiirrada balse u madlan yihiin golaheeda wakiillada kaas oo ah in ay kalsoonidii ay kala laabteen haya’addaha dowladda federalka ee Soomaaliya, ka dib markii shalay ay barlamaanka labada aqal ee Soomaaliya meel mariyeen wax ka baddelka dastuurka. Sawirka, VILLA SOMALIA Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Khilaafka labada dhinac u dhaxeeya ayaa soo taagnaa in muddo ahba. Puntland oo lagu naaneyso "Hooyada Federaalka" ayaa waxaa jiray arrimo dhowr ah oo ay hore isugu khilaafeen dowladda federaalka. Haddaba aan eegno dhowr arrimood oo go'aankan uu saameynayo. Soomaaliya ayaa ah dal wali ku tiirsan kabid dhaqaale oo ay ka helaan caalamka gaar ahaan dalalka caawiya kaas ka mida halbowlayasha dhaqaalaha dalka. Puntland ayaa ka mid ah maamullada hela saamiga dhaqaale ee ay dowladda dhexe ka hesho caalamka gaar ahaan kuwa dalalka taageera iyo haya’adaha dhaqaalaha ee Bangiga Adduunka iyo IMF. Sida uu BBC-da u sheegay Maxamed Mukhtaar oo ka faallooda arrimaha Soomaaliya, inkasta oo xiriirkoodu xumaa labada dhinac haddana ay Puntland lumin karto fursaddaas, maaddaama ay gabi ahaanba hadda jartay xiriirkii dowlada federalka. Puntland ayaa sidoo la xasuustaa inaysan kaalin weyn ku lahayd heerkii dayn cafinta muddooyinkii danbe laga soo bilaabo muddo xilledkii Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo. Madaxda Puntland ayaa hore u sheegay inaysan helin kaalmadii beesha caalamku siiyeen Soomaaliya qaybtii ay ku lahaayeen sida uu BBC-da horaan u sheegay wasiirkii hore ee maaliyada Puntland Maxamed Cabdiraxmaan Dhabancad. Tani waa qodob kale oo muhiim u ah Puntland, marka la eego kaalinta ay ku leedahay deeqaha waxbarasho ee Soomaaliya ka hesho dalalka ka taageera waxbarashada. Inkasta oo Puntland iyo dowladda federalka isugu maandhaafeen xal u helidda arrintaas, oo ayba dowladda dhexe hakisay deeqaha waxbarasho ee Puntland ka heli jirtay dowlada federalka xilligii dowladdii madaxweyne Farmaajo, haddana tani waa caqabad ay mar kale la kulmi karaan ardayda deegaanadasi sida uu BBCda u sheegay Maxamed Mukhtaar. Khilaafka Puntland iyo dowladda federalka kaliya ma saamayn dhanka siyaasadda oo kaleiya, basle waxaa kale oo saamayn togan uu ku yeeshay arrimaha bulshada. Puntland ayaa sanadkii labaad oo xiriir ah aan ka qayb galin ciyaaraha maamul-goboleedyada dalka oo ka dhacay Muqdisho, sababo ay ku tilmaameen inay kala heshiin dowladda dhexe hannaankaas sida uu horaan BBC u sheegay wasiirka dhalinyarada iyo ciyaaraha ee Puntland, Cabdiraxmaan Caydiid.

Uganda oo billowday tijaabada tallaalka xanuun uu ka walaacsan yahay dal Soomaaliya deris la ah Dalka Uganda ayaa bilaabay tijaabada tallaalka cudurka Ebola gaar ahaanna nooca Suudaan, kadib markii uu dib u dillaacay mar kale. Ma jiro tallaal ansax ah oo loogu tala galay nooca Suudaan ee Ebola. Arrinkaasi ayaa ka dambeeyay kadib markii cudurku ka dillaacay dalkaas hal qofna uu dilay labo kalena ay qaadeen. Bukaankii ugu horreeyay oo ah nin jir ahaa oo kalkaaliye caafimaad ahaa ayaa toddobaadkii hore geeriyooday. Isniintii, qofkii ugu horreeyay ee tijaabada ka qeyb qaatay oo haatan karantiil ku jira ayaa helay kuuro tallaalka ah ama lagu muday. Tallaalka ayaa waxaa soo saaray mashruuca dadaalka tallaalka AIDS ee caalamiga ah oo ah urur aan faa'iido-doon ahayn. Hal tallaal yaa jira hadda. Si kastaba há ahaatee, nooca Zaire ayaa ku badnaa DR Congo. Dhowaan, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Kenya ayaa digniin dadweyne soo saartay kaddib markii cudurka Ebola nooca loo yaqaaan (Sudan Ebola Virus Disease) laga xaqiijiyay dalka deriska la ah ee Uganda. Sida ay qortay Hay'adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) fayraskaan Suudaan waxuu lamid yahay lana bah yahay fayraska Ebola, waana xanuun darran oo cadadka dadka uu ku dhaco dhimashoodoodu badantahay qiyaastiina gaadhayso sida ay sheegtay hay'addu % Illaa % marka la eego safmareenadiisii hore. Waxayna sidoo kale Hay'adda Caafimaadku Adduunku xustay in maqnaanshaha dawadiisa iyo hababkiisa ka hortag ay keenayso saamayn ba'an uu yeelan karo xanuunkani. Xoghayaha Guud ee Caafimaadka Dadweynaha dalka Kenya, Mary Muthoni, ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in dowladda ay ka go'an tahay badbaadinta muwaadiniinta maaddaama xadka Kenya iyo Uganda uu yahay mid furan. Waxay xustay in la xoojin doono kormeerka dhammaan goobaha laga soo galo dalka. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Calaamadaha caabuqa Ebola waxaa ka mid ah qandho, daal, murqo xanuun, madax-xanuun, cune xanuun, oo ay ku xigaan matag, shuban, finan, iyo dhiig-bax gudaha iyo dibadda ah. Waxa lagu kala qaadaa marka la taabto dareere iyo unugyo jireed oo buka. Cudurka Ebola ee Sudan ayaa ah mid aad u daran, wuxuuna dilaa ugu yaraan % dadka uu ku dhaco cudurko, sida ay sheegtay hay'adda caafimaadka adduunka ee WHO. Uganda waxaa hadda ka dilaacay cudurka markii lixaad. Ilaa ka mid ah dad ay istaabteen dhibbaneyaasha ayaa la tallaali doonaa wejigan soo-bandhigidda ah ee ay si wadajir ah u fulinayaan mas'uuliyiinta Uganda iyo WHO, sida ay hay'adda Qaramada Midoobay ku sheegtay bayaan Isniintii. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Uganda ayaa xaqiijisay qof inay jiraan kuwaasi oo ay is taabteen dadka la xaqiijiyay inay cudurka qaadeen. WHO ayaa la kaashanaysa wasaaradda caafimaadka Uganda, machadka cilmi-baarista fayraska Uganda, iyo Machadka Sambabka ee Jaamacadda Makerere si ay tijaabadan u fuliyaan. Arrinkan ayaa ah astaanta guul weyn oo ah dhanka waxqabadka degdegga ah waxaa uuna muujinayaa awoodda iskaashiga ee loogu tala galay sugnaanta caafimaadka ee caalamiga ah, sida ay sheegtay agaasimaha Afrika ee WHO. Matshidiso Moeti ayaa intaasi ku dartay in haddii la xaqiijiyo inuu waxtar leeyahay tallaalku uu sii xoojin doono tallaabooyinka looga badbaadinaayo bulshooyinka dillaacitaanka cudurka mustaqbalka. In nooca Sudan ee fayrasku dillaacay ayaa horay looga xaqiijiyay gudaha Uganda September wuxuuna dilay in ka badan qof. Waxaase shaaca laga qaaday Janaayo . Inkastoo Uganda ay heli kartay isla tallaalka tijaabada ah ee haatan la hadal hayo waqtigaas, tijaabooyinka ayaanan la samayn kareyn inta safmarku uusan dhammaan ka hor. Dabayaaqadii toddobaadka, kuurooyinkii ugu horreeyay oo dhan , oo ah tallaalka tijaabada ah iyo daawooyin ayaa la keenay xarunta Uganda ee Kampala. Hay'adaha caafimaad iyo kooxaha cilmi-baarista ayaa u shaqeeyay si degdeg ah ayagoo cilmibaareyaasha la wargaliyay, ayadoo la diyaariyay tas'hiilaadka lana dejiyay borotakoollo daraasadeed.

Isbaddalka cimilada adduunka sidee buu u saameeyay Afrika? Qaaradda Afrika ayaa qaaradaha kale ee caalamka uga nugul isbadalka cimilada ee haatan laga dareemayo adduunka. Sida ay sheegayaan khubarada cilmi Sayniska, arrintaasi ayaa loo aaneynayaa afar arrimood oo ay ka mid yihii: Cimilada qaaradda Afrika ayaa ah mid aad u kala geddisan oo aan hal dhinac laga eegi karin. Lamadegaanka Saxara ayaa ah lamadegaanka ugu ballaaran caalamka isla markaana ugu kulul caalamka. Bilihii Juun iyo Luuliyo ee sanadkan sii dhammaanaya ayaa Afrika waxaa hareeyay cirboor (dabeylo xoogan oo boor iyo qashin wata oo hawada qabsada) kuwaa oo aan lagu arag adduunka intiisa kale balse la rumeysan yahay in cirboorkaasi uu saameyn ku leeyahay cimilada adduunka waloow aan la garan karin saameyntaasi iyo waxa ay tahay. Laga soo billaabo waxaa aad u soo yaraanayay roobabka ka da'a qaaradda Afrika, gaar ahaanna waddamada ku yaal saxaraha, arrintaa oo markii dambe sababtay macalluul galaafatay nolasha boqolaal kun oo qof isla markaana ay ku barakeceen malaayiin qof oo kale. Marka laga soo tago gobolkaasi, wali lama arag abaar sidaa u daba dheeraata dunida inteeda kale. Dhanka koonfurta qaaradda, waxaa soo baxaya in roobabku ay daaheen iyo in marka ay roobabkaasi da'aan ay noqdaan kuwo aad u yar. Isbadalkaasi ayaa la saadaalinayaa in uu ka sii dari doono tobanaanka sano ee soo socda. Heerkulka gobolkaasi ayaa la filayaa in uu ilaa shan digrii ama ka badan uu sii sara kaco, gaar ahaanna qaybo ka mid ah Namibia, Botswana iyo Zambia oo haatanba kuleyl ba'an laga dareemayo. Dhanka kale, waddamada Kenya iyo Tanzania waxaa in badan xilligooga ka soo daahay roobabka guga. Markii ay billowdaannaa waxa ay noqdaan kuwo ka aad u yar. Bartamaha Afrika waxa uu ka mid yahay saddexda gobol ee adduunka ee caanka ku ah roobabka wata Onkodka, waxaana ku yaal keymaha ugu weyn qaaradda oo dhan. Isbaddalkaasi cimilada Afrika ayaa horseeday duufaannada Idai iyo Kenneth ishii Maarso ku dhuftay waddamada Mozambique, Zimbabwe iyo Malawi. Duufaanta Kenneth ayaa qaaday wado aan laga filayn oo waxa ay martay qeybo ka mid ah dalka Tanzania. Horumar badan ayaa hadda laga sameeyay saadaasha hawada balse dhibaatadu wali waa mid taagan. Gobol kastaa oo Afrika ka tirsan waxa uu leeyahay cimilo u gaar ah, taa oo dhibaato ku noqonayso saadaalinta iyo in la sii ogaado waxa soo socda. Waxaa mararka qaar dhacaya in roobabku ay xilli yar da'aan balse ay sababaan dhibaato aad u badan ama in ayba noqdaan kuwa yar oo abaaro ay xigaan.

Waa maxay xaaladda lagu dhasho ee wadna furanka? Dhaqtarka Soomaaliga ah ee fuliya qalliinkaas oo BBC-da la hadlay , Dhaqtar, Cabdinafic Wadnuhu waa mid ka mida xubnaha ugu muhiimsan jirka bini’aadanka ee qabta shaqo la’aanteed uusan qofku noolaan karin. Si la mida xubnaha kale ee jirka waxaa jira xanuuno ku dhaca wadnaha. Xanuunada ku dhaca waxay u qaybsamaan kuwa lagu dhasho iyo kuwa ku dhaca qofka isaga oo weyn hase yeeshee sida ay muujisay cilmi baaris ay sameeyeen dhaqaatiir ka tirsan Isbitaalka Erdogan sanadkii -kii ayaa muujisay in bukaanada carurta ah ee booqday qaybta wadnaha ee Isbitaalka kuwaasoo qabay cabasho la xariirta wadnaha boqolkiiba lixdan qabeen xanuunada wadna furanka ama wadne daloolka. Markii ugu horeyeysay taariikhda Soomaaliya ayaa dhowaan yeelatay xarun lagu fuliyo qaliimada wadna furanka iyo dawayntooda gaarka ah taas oo howl gashay bishii Maarso ee sanadkan. Dr. Cabdinaafic Maxamuud Xuseen, ayaa sheegay inuu yahay dhaqtarkii ugu horeeyay ee Soomaaliya ka suurta galiyay qalliimada wadnaha furan isaga iyo koox isugu jirta dhaqaatiir iyo kalkaaliyaal sare oo ka kala yimid turkiga iyo wadanka gudihiisa. Xaruntaan ayaa ku guulaysatay fulinta qaliimadii ugu horeyey ee wadnaha ee lagu sameeyey bukaano qabay xanuuno kala duwan oo dhanka wadnaha ah. Waxaa uu BBC-da u sheegay in in hirgalinta xaruntan ay waxbadan ka tari doonto heerka daweynta xanuunada ku dhaca wadnaha maadaama uusan dalku horey u lahayn xaruntan oo kale ah. Dhaqtar Cabdinaafic, wuxuu tilmaamay in ilaa furitaanka wajiga kowaad ee howlgalkooda ay fuliyeen ilaa toddobo qaliin oo wadnaha ah, kaas oo lagu sameeyey bukaanno qabay xanuunno wadnaha la xiriira. Sida uu BBCda u sheegay Dr.Cabdinafic Maxamuud Xuseen, oo ah Maamulaha waaxda qaliimada furan ee Isbitaalka Erdogan oo hore loo oran jiray ‘Digfeer’, in xanuunada wadnaha ee caruurtu ku dhashaan ay ka mid yihiin daloolka wadnaha, xiddidada waawayn ee wadnaha ee isku furma ama qaybaha kale ee wadnaha oo qaab dhismeedkeedu cilad ku timaado. ‘‘Wadne furanka ama daloolka wadnuhu waa xanuun inta badan carruurtu ku dhashaan, kaas oo ah in Ilmuhu dhasho isagoo wadnihiisa qaab dhismeedkiisa uusan caadi ahayn, kaas oo keenaya in shaqadii wadnaha ku timaado culays ama dhibaato” ayuu yiri Dr. Cabdinafic. Wuxuu tilmaamay in heerka wadne furanka ee carruurta qaar ku dhashaan ay kala duwan yihiin kaas oo ay ku xirantahay nooca daloolka ee wadnaha qabo ‘‘ Waxay ku xiran tahay heerka daloolka wadnaha ee Ilmuhu ku dhasho, heerka dawada ee uu bukaankaasi u baahan yahay” Sawirka, Dr. Cabdinaafic Waxaa jira calaamo kala duwan oo lagu arki karo Ilmaha ku dhasha wadne furanka marka uu dhashaba taas oo muujinaysa in uu xanuunkaas ka qabo wadnaha sida uu BBCda u sheegay Dr Cabdinafic. Dr. Cabdinafic, wuxuu sheegay in loo baahan yahay in marka calamaadaas lagu arko Ilmaha isla marka uu dhasho ama ilaa qayb ahaan uu soo gaaro da’da ila afar sano jir ay muhiin tahay in lala xiriirsiiyo dhaqaatiirta ku shaqada leh wadnaha. ‘‘Waxaa suura gal ah in bukaano loo samayn karo dawayn xilliga ku haboon ee wadne furanka, laakiin waxaa mararka qaar uu gaari karaa heer aan waxba laga qaban karin,marka xilli kasta waxaa fiican in waqti hore la geeyo dabiib bukaanka si loola tacaalo” ayuu BBCda u sheegay Dr.Cabdinafic. Waxaa xusid mudan sida dhaqtarku sheegay in ilmuhu uu qabi karo wadne furan marka uu dhasho balse uu xanuunka qabi karo ilaa inta uu da’a weyn gaari kara taas oo ku xiran heerka xanuunka. Sawirka, Dr. Cabdinaafic Tan iyo markii la furay xarunta qaliinka wadnaha ee Isbitaalka Erdogan ee Muqdisho Bishii Maarso, bukaan da’adiisu ahayd sano jir lab ah, ayaa lagu samaeeyey qaliin furan oo wadnaha ah. Sida uu BBCda u sheegay Dr. Cabdinaafic. ‘‘Waxaa Isbitaalka yimi nin dhalinyaro ah oo an markiisii hore u imaan xanuun la xiriira wadnaha balse baaritaano lagu sameeyey ka dib ayaa la ogaaday in wadnihiisu daloolo cabir gaarsiisan 4cm oo wareeg ah sidaasna loogu sameeyey qaliin lagu sameeyey wadnihiisa, waana lagu guulaysaty qaliinkaas” ayuu yiri dhaqtar Cabdinafic. ‘‘Bukaano kale oo gaaraya lix ayaa sidoo kale qaliimo wadnaha loo sameeyey” ayuu intaas raaciyey. Sawirka, Dr. Cabdinaafic Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Madaxa Xarunta Qaliimada furan ee Isbitaalka Ex-Digfeer ee Muqdisho, Dr Cabdinaafic, ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in bukaanka qaba xaaladdan ay heerkiisa daweyntu kala duwanaan karto. ‘‘Mararka qaar waxaa suura gal ah in daloolka wadnaha uu bukaanka iskiis u xirmo isagoo an wax dawo ah madaama laga yaabo in daloolki yaraa markiisii hore, marar waxaa ku filan dawo la siiyo, marna waxaa la adeegsan Qalabka ‘Angiographic Intervention’, kaas oo ah tubo lagu gaaro wadnaha si halkaas loogu xiro duleelka. Laakiin marka waxaa loo baahdaa in la sameeyo qaliin furan oo ah in laabta la dilaacsho bukaanka dabadeedba la daweeyo wadne furanka” ayuu yiri Dr. Cabdinafic. Soomaaliya oo ah dal dowladdnimadiisu soo kabanayso ayaa hadda heerkiisa caafimaadku gaaray in Muqdisho laga furo qayb ka mida Isbitaalka Erdogan oo qaliimada wadnaha lagu sameeyo balse nooca qalabka iyo dadka aqoonta u leh ayaa ku yar dalka. Dr. Cabdinafic, oo ah dhaqtarkii ugu horeeyey ee qaliin wadnaha ku sameeyey gudaha Soomaaliya ayaa xusay in qalabka oo qaali ah iyo qubarada loo baahanyahay oo helideedu adagtahay darteed muddadaas dalka dib ugu dhigtay in la helo xarumo qaliim wadnaha fulisa.

Muxuu yahay geedka Soomaaliya aan looga faa'iideysanin ee dunida muhiimka ka ah? Dacarta Cas waxaa laga helaa meelo badan oo ka mid ah Soomaaliya, hase yeeshee khubarada dhinaca seyniska waxay aaminsan yihiin inuu yahay geed dhif ah oo ay adag tahay in la helo. Horaantii sanadkii lasoo dhaafay, Dr. Mary Barkworth oo baratay Cilmiga Botony, kana ka tirsan Jaamacada Utah State University USA, ayaa geedkan oo afka qalaad lagu yiraahdo "Asphodelaceae" ka heshay Somaliland. Markii ugu horreysay waxay ku aragtay madxafka Jaamacadda Hargeysa. Maqaal ay ku daabacday wargeyska PUBFACTS, ee soo bandhiga xogaha seyniska, ayey ku sharraxday in geedkaas uu ka duwan yahay dhirta dacarta ee laga helo caalamka intiisa kale. Dr Barkworth ayaa diiwaanka ku gashay in loo aqoonsan yahay inay garatay geedkaas dhif iyo naadirka ah. Barfasoor Yaxye Sheekh Caamir, oo ah aqoonyahan ku takhasusay cilmiga dhaqaalaha, ayaa sheegay khubarada reer galbeedka ay mar walba magacooda ku qoraan helitaanka waxyaabo caadi ka ah bulshada Soomaalida dhankooda, si fiicanna ay muddo dheer usii yaqaanneen. "Waa la yaab in la yiraahdo 'Qofkii ugu horeeyay ee helay', soo annagu iyaga ka hor ma aqoon, oo waalidiinteenu uma isticmaali jirin Daawo ahaan." ayuu yidhi Yaxye Caamir oo la hadlay BBC-da. Wuxuu qoraal dheer oo uu kaga hadlayay sida uu geedkan muhiim uga yahay caalamka iyo sida aan Soomaaliya looga faa'iideysanin ku shaaciyay boggiisa Facebook. Dhanka kale, Barfasoor Yaxye ayaa Soomaalida ku dhiirrigaliyay inay dhaqaale ahaan iyo dawo ahaanba uga faa'iideystaan geedkan. "Dhaqan ahaan waxaan ugu soo isticmaali jirnay daawo ahaan, laakiin hadda waxaa kale oo looga faa'iideysan karaa in la warshadeeyo oo cabitaan ahaan laga dhigto. Wuxuu geedkan u roon yahay kansarka naaska ku dhaca iyo cudurrada wadnaha. Annagu waxyaabo badan uma isticmaalo, sababtoo ah ma garaneyno, waxaa kaliya oo aan u isticmaalnaa maqaarka kore." Ayuu yidhi. Sida uu Yaxye sheegayo, waxyaabaha ugu badan oo loo adeegsado dhacaanka dacarta waxaa ka mid ah in lagu qallajiyo ama lagu baabi'iyo nabarrada kasoo baxa maqaarka, in xoolaha laga mariyo cadhada, dadka indhaha caadka ka saarmo oo looga dhicbiyo iyo in digaagga loogu daro biyaha. Dhawaan ayey ahayd markii khubaro Soomaali ah ay ka fal celiyeen war kasoo baxay seynisyahanno reer Galbeed ah oo sheegay inay Jabuuti ka heleen xayawaan dhif ah oo aan la arkin muddo sano ah. Noolahaas, oo loo yaqaanno Walo San-dheer ayaase si caadi ah u joogay inta badan dhulka Soomaalida. Inta badan arrimaha ku saabsan waxyaabaha laga helo Soomaaliya ee aan laga warqabi caalami ahaan ayaa loo aaneeyaa in muddadii uu dalka burbursanaa aan la diiwaan galinin macluumaad badan oo ku saabsan xayawaanka iyo dhirtaba. Cilmi Baareyaal ayaa ogaaday in Dacar Cas oo laga helo Jamhuuriyadda iskeed ugu dhawaaqda madaxbannaanida ee Somaliland ay tahay mid aan lagu arag dunida inteeda kale, sida uu BBC-da horay ugu sheegay Axmed Ibraahim Cawaale oo madax ka ah xarun ka shaqaysa daryeelka iyo badbaadinta dhirta oo layiraahdo Candle Light. "Dacartan ayaa noqonaysa middii -aad ee dhulka Soomaalida laga helo, inta la ogyahay" ayuu intaas ku daray Axmed." Maadaama oo aynan dacartu ku cusbayn dadka Soomaalida ah sidee lagu ogaaday in ay tahay nooc gooni ah ayay BBC-du waydiisay Axmed. Cilmi baareyaasha ayaa sheegay in ay iskood baaritaan u sameeyeen ka dibna la kaashadeen xarun caalami ah oo lagu aruuriyo dhirta adduunka oo dhan. Markii ugu horreysay ee fikradda baadhitaanka ay imaaneysay, Axmed oo safar ah ayay soo jiidatay qaabka ay u samaysan tahay dacarta sannadkii . "Waxaa markiiba isoo jiitay in ay tahay dacar si baahsan u fidda oo isku qabsata, dhinac ilaa mitir ayay gaarraysay, dhinaca kalana mitir". Markii uu u kuurgalay waxaa ku dhalatay in uusan halkaa ka hadhin, sannadkii xigay ee ayuuna billaabay cilmibaarasta Dacarta Cas. "Dacartu waxay ku kala duwan tahay ubaxa iyo qaabka ay u samaysan yihiin, qodxaha yaryar ee dacarta intay isu jiraan, waxyaabahaas iyo baaritaanno kale ayaa lagu kala saaraa" ayuu yiri Axmed oo BBC-da la hadlay.

Si dhab ah ayaan tababarka u qaataa balse Ramadaanka ayaa ka muhiimsan Tababarka orodka dheer ee Maradoonka aad ayuu u adag yahay. Adigoo sooman in aad u diyaargarowdo tartanka ciyaartoyda ugu fiican adduunka ee masaafadiisu tahay . mayl waa wax aad u adag. Mahamed Mahamed waxa uu ka mid yahay jiilka oradyahanada Britain ee masaafada dheer orda, kuwaas oo ku sii dhawaanaya rikoodhkii uu dhigay Mohamed Farah ee oradka maradoonka. Oradyahanka jirka ah ee isu diyaarinaya orodka maradoonka ee London sanadkan ayaa hadana sooman. Wuxuu tababarka dhameeyaa xilli dambe, wuxuuna isku wadaa soonka iyo orodka. Mahamed, oo kaalinta afraad kaga jira liiska orodyahannada ugu fiican UK ayaa iska indhatiray talooyin loo soo jeediyay oo ah in uu dib u dhigo soonkiisa inta uu tababarka ku jiro si uu u jabiyo rikoorka labada saacadood, toddoba daqiiqo iyo shan ilbiriqsi ah. "Dadka qaar waxay u maleeyaan in aanan soomin marka aan tababarka ku jiro," ayuu Mahamed ku yiri wakaaladda wararka ee PA. "Gaar ahaan hadda, waxaan galayaa tartan, waxay u haystaan in aan diiradda saarayo tababarka oo mar dambe aan dib ka soomayo. "Laakiin waan la qabsaday. Waxay noqotay jadwalkayga caadiga ah. Waan uga mahadcelinayaa taladaas, balse anigu waxaan sii wadaa dhammaan soonka iyo orodaka." Mahamed waxa uu deggen yahay magaalada Ifrane ee Buuraha Atlas ee Morocco, wuxuuna isu diyaarinaya tartanka dhacaya bisha soo socota ee Abriil. Goobta uu joogo waxay u ogolaaneysaa in uu si badqab ah ugu tababarto iftiinka garoonka habeenkii, isaga oo la jira Muslimiin kale oo sooman bisha barakeysan ee Ramadaan. Maadama aan maalintii biyo la cabeyb, cunto la cuneyn waxay tababarka ka dhigeen habeenkii. Maalmaha qaar, jadwalkiisa tababarka wuxuu gaaraa saacadaha hore ee subaxda. Waxa uu bilaabaa kulankiisa koowaad qiyaastii -ta galabnimo, kaddibna wuu afuraa oo masaajidka tagaa ka hor inta uusan dhammayn kulankiisa labaad. Markuu si ku filan u cunteeyo, Mahamed wuxuu seexdaa hal ama laba saacadood, kaddibna wuu soo toosaa qiyaastii -ta subaxnimo si uu mar kale wax u cuno, ka hor inta uusan sariirta ku noqon si uu markaas kaddib hurdo ugu sii darsado. Mahamed waxa uu sheegay in wax yar ay adag tahay. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. "Shaqadayda si sax ah ayaan u sameeyaa, laakiin Ramadaanka waa kan ugu muhiimsan. Waxa uu iga caawiyaa in aan diiradda saaro. Waxa uu iga dhigayaa in aan fahmo cidda aan ahay iyo waxa aan samayn karo." Mahamed waxa uu ka mid yahay afar orodyahan oo Britan u dhashay oo wali firfircoon kuwaas oo ka qeybgala orodka dheer ee maradoonka. Mahamed waxa uu ku orday wax ka yar saac iyo daqiiqo, isaga oo ay weheliyaan Alex Yee, Emile Cairess iyo Philip Sesemann, waxaana lagu tilmaamay "jiil cusub". Kaddib markii uu kaalinta afraad ka galay Marathon-kii London ee la qabtay sanadkii -kii, Mahamed waxa uu doonayay in uu dhigo rikoodh cusub maradoonka London ah ka hor inta uusan u tartamin billad Tartanka Qaaradda Yurub ee ka dhacaya magaalada Birmingham. Sida Mo Farah, sheekada Mahamed waxay wax badan u dhow tahay tan Mo Farah. Ka hor inta isaga iyo qoyskiisa aysan u soo guurin UK sanadkii -kii, waxa uu ku noolaa Itoobiya. "Waxaan daawan jiray Mo iyo Jess Ennis anigoo ka fakaraya in sidoo kale aan sameeyo" ayuu yiri Mahamed. Wuxuu kaloo uu sheegay in markasta uu la kumo Mo Farah ay taladiisu aheyd "Dhageyso tababarayaasha, diiraddana saar waxa aad qabaneyso".

Guidance: User Generated and Social Media Content User generated content has become an essential part of BBC storytelling across the entire output. It plays a central role in most breaking news stories, but it is equally important in many other non-News output – including Children's. It can be still pictures, video or comment; it can be sent directly by users following specific calls to action or be found by searching for it on social media platforms and the wider web. Whatever content the BBC uses, regardless of how it is received, must adhere to the BBC Editorial Guidelines and standards. Content being widely shared or trending on social media may not necessarily make it appropriate for use; its editorial justification and purpose should be considered first. It should not be assumed that any user generated content – whether found on the web or received directly from the audience – is always what it claims to be. It may be fake, it may be genuine footage but of a different incident, it may be just part of the incident or taken from one perspective. In News, in particular, where UGC can play an important part in our output, the BBC must always authenticate any content before it is used. This might include anything from speaking to the individual who filmed the content to using a range of more sophisticated techniques such as geo-location and cross-referencing satellite imagery to interrogate the image itself. The more significant the image is, the more important it is to ensure it is authentic – although the responsibility for due accuracy remains regardless. Advice on verifying any UGC can be obtained from the UGC Hub. In a non-News environment, content producers might ask audience members to send in videos of themselves undertaking particular activities, or they might source similar content from the social web. Producers still have a responsibility to ensure the accuracy of that content before using it, but that might be ascertained in a simple conversation. Audiences should be provided with the relevant information to understand the events within their context, beyond the selective and narrow perspective which UGC may particularly offer. This may include details about the circumstances leading to the incident and its consequences. Nonetheless, BBC content producers should be open and honest about what they do not know or cannot corroborate. The Editorial Guidelines state: Care must be taken with content that may have been supplied by anyone with a vested interest, rather than a disinterested bystander. ( . . ) On highly controversial subjects, some views may be more likely than others to be expressed via UGC or be amplified on social media platforms. The existence of other views and their respective weights should be acknowledged and appropriately reflected. Where content producers ask audiences on social media to share their views or observations, they should be aware of the serendipitous nature of social media that means people may only come across the calls to action by chance. Where content producers are considering using significant content found on social media – such as video of a breaking news event – they should always seek to secure the consent of the owner of the material, even if a Fair Dealing use might be argued. The BBC would not normally pay for the use of such material, other than in exceptional circumstances but producers should be aware of copyright or other legal issues and take appropriate advice when necessary. The owner of the material, wherever and whenever it is used – should always be credited, unless to do so might put the contributor at risk. Any link to the source must be editorially justified, rather than merely being considered as a credit. (See guidance: Links and Feeds) Consent may not always be required to use material when there is a public interest in doing so. However, careful consideration should always be given to the wider editorial justification and the impact of using UGC on a BBC platform that is already being shared extensively on social media. Comment, tweets or posts to BBC channels or otherwise open spaces may be used without the explicit consent of the individual authors. That is particularly the case when individuals are taking part in a public debate or it is clear they understand and are participating in the open nature of social media. Similarly, it is reasonable to use appropriate pictures of individuals taken from their open social media profiles without explicit consent when it is in the public interest. However, potential distress to family and friends should be carefully considered when using pictures of individuals who have died. Even though content may have been posted to social media platforms that have a potential global audience of billions, it is still necessary to consider whether the use of the material respects the privacy of those featured. If the content is filmed openly in a public or even semi-public space then the presumption would generally be that it would be reasonable for the BBC to use. This may still be the case even where the subject is not aware they are being filmed provided there is a public interest. For example, it could be video of vehicle drivers using their mobile phones or other examples of anti-social or illegal behaviour. However, if the content features individuals who might otherwise have a legitimate expectation of privacy, for example if they are receiving medical treatment, or where they are in a private space or the content was clearly not intended for public consumption, respect for their privacy should be maintained - unless a public interest in bringing the material to the audience. It may be appropriate to consider anonymising individuals featured where there remains a public interest in using the material. Where the BBC has asked for contributions from audiences, content producers should act in accordance with data protection laws in handling personal information and take appropriate advice. The BBC should never encourage individuals to break the law or put themselves in danger. It should not normally use material sourced from social media where it is clear individuals have put themselves at unnecessary risk. It should be made clear that contributors should continue to act in the way they would normally do regardless of the fact that they may be creating content that the BBC might use. They should never be encouraged or even 'given permission' to undertake activities they would not normally undertake. This is particularly the case when working with contributors producing longer form personal view or eyewitness content. In breaking news stories, the BBC should be co-ordinated and considerate in approaching individuals on social media for both their consent to use their material and to request any further contribution to the BBC output. It maybe they are still caught up in the incident or dealing with the consequences of it. Children should not be routinely asked to act as newsgatherers for the BBC, but they may be asked to submit content for creative projects or competitions on CBBC or other appropriate outlets. Where children under have been asked to send content directly, the BBC should use its own uploader, where parents have already given permissions for their child to upload content and will notify them every time content is submitted. Where content submitted to the BBC features other children under parental consent must be sought. Where children or young people are featured in content found on social media that is being considered for use, the impact on them should be taken into account. Any online safeguarding concerns that are discovered, whether related to online grooming or child abuse images, must be referred to the Head of Safeguarding and Child Protection immediately. Waddooyinka Nairobi oo webiyo isku beddelay iyo dhimasho ka dhalatay Waddooyinku waxay isu beddeleen wabiyo ku yaalla caasimadda Kenya ee Nairobi, iyadoo mas’uul sare uu sheegay in fatahaadda “ay gaartay heer aad u daran. Roobab mahiigaan ah oo maalmahan ka da’ayey Kenya ayaa dhaliyey khasaaro kala duwan. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan qof ay naftooda ku waayeen in ka badan , oo qofna lagu qasbay in ay guryahooda ka barakacaan roobabka iyo daadadka. Edwin Sifuna, oo kormeera Ismaamulka Nairobi, ayaa soo bandhigay muuqaal muujinaya xaafad dhan oo daad qaaday, kuwaas oo qaar ka mida ay muujiyaan dadka oo ku goddoonsan saqafyada kore ee guryahooda. “Xaaladda Nairobi waxay gaartay heer aad u daran, maamulka gobolka dadaal kasta oo uu sameeyay si cad ayaa looga awood roonaaday, waxaan u baahanahay in la abaabulo dhammaan gurmadka qaran si loo badbaadiyo nolosha,” ayuu yiri intaas raaciyey. Boqollaal kale oo ku sugan Nairobi iyo deegaannada u dhow dhow ayaa xayiray daadadka ka dib roobab xoogay oo ka da’aya magaalada. Warbaahinta maxalliga ah ayaa sheegtay in dadka deggan xaafadda isku raranta ah ee Mathare ay ku qasbanaadeen inay seexdaan saqafyada guryaha habeenkii. , AFP via Daadadka soo rogmaday ayaa wadsooyinka qaar ka dhigay kuwo biyo ay qariyeen, taas oo keentay in isku socodka guud ahaan Kenya uu hakad galo. Kelvin Mwangi, oo ah darawal wada gawaarida Uberka oo ka shaqeeya Nairobi ayaa u sheegay wakaalada wararka ee AFP in xaalada magaaladu gashay mid dhaqdhaqaadu joogsaday oo inta badana wadooyinkii daad qaaday. Wiil shan sano jir ah oo daadadku ay go’doomiyeen ayaa diyaarad helicopter ah oo boolisku adeegsadeen looga soo badbaadiyey deegaanka Yatta ee koonfurta Nairobi Talaadadii. Magaalo digada lo'da ka sameysa shidaal loo isticmaali karo gawaarida Magaalo ku taal dalka Japan ayaa ka dhigeysa digada lo'da shidaal nadiif ah oo mustaqbalka loo isticmaalo gawaarida. Magaalada Hokaido waa jasiirad ku taal waqooyiga Japan. Markaad tagto waxaad dareemeysaa urka digada lo'ada. Magaalada waxay caan ku tahay caanaha lo'ada. Jasiiradan waa tan labaad ee ugu weyn Japan, waxaana ku nool lo' ka badan malyan oo soo saara kala bar caanaha iyo subaga dalka. Magaalada waxay digada lo'da ka dhigeysaa maaddada hydrogen. Marka la gubo qiiq hawada wasakheeya ma sii deyso taas ayaa ka dhigeysa shidaal aan hawada wasakheyn. Rajo ayaa laga qabaa in ay noqoto shidaal rasmi ah. Inta badan qaabka loo sameeyo hydrogen-ta maanta waa mid aan u fiicneyn hawada oo qaali ah balse habka ay magaaladan u sameyneyso ayaa ah mid qiimahiisu jaban yahay oo joogto loo heli karo. "Mashruuca lagu sameynayo howlahan waa mid ku cusub magaaladan" ayuu yiri Maiko Abe oo ka tirsan shirkadda Air Water oo ka mid ah shirkadaha ka shaqeeyanaya howlahan. BBC-da ayaa booqatay magaalada si ay uga sameyso barnaamij. Mashruuca waxaa sanadkii -kii bilaabay wasaaradda deegaanka. Ujeedka ayaa ahaa in waxyaabaha ka yimaada xoolaha laga dhigo hydrogen. Digada iyo kaadida lo'da ayaa marka hore la soo ururinayaa kaddibna waxaa lagu darayaa walxo kala saara. Warshadda lagu sameynayo howlahan waxay hadda awood u leedahay in ay soo saarto hydrogen ka badan liiter kaas oo buuxin karaa ilaa iyo gaari maalintii sida uu sheegay Abe. Sidoo kale warshadda waxay shidaal siin kartaa gawaarida waaweyn iyo cagafyada. Qalabka beeraha way adag tahay intoo badan in ay batari ku shaqeeyaan shaqada ay qabtaan darteed. Baabuurta ku shaqeysa hydrogen-ta waxaa loo isticmaalaa beeraha si loo yareeyo wasaqowga hadwada. Hydrogen-ta laga sameeyo waxyaabaha ka yimaada xoolaha ayaa la ururinayaa si marka dambe koronto ay u siiyaan xarumaha magaalada ku yaal. Hydrogen-ta ma ahan mid sahlan. Waxay u baahan tahay in lagu keydiyo haamaha gaaska oo cadaadiskoodu sareeyo, waxaana suuragal ah in ay dilaacaan ama ay ku timaado cilado kale. Waxayna u baahan yihiin haamahaas in loo maareeyo si taxadar leh. Hydrogen-ta qaababka loo keydin karo waxaa ka mid ah in hab dareero ah loo keydo oo heerkulka ka hooseeyo C, taasina waxay u baahan tahay kaabayaal dheeri ah. Tamarta hydrogen-ta waxay sadddex laab ka badan tahay tan batroolka marka ay badan tahay. In digada iyo kaadida xoolaha lagu daro maaddada methane si hydrogen loo sameeyo ma ahan wax guud, balse ugu dambeyn waa loo adeegsan karaa in lagu sameeyo hydrogen. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Abe wuxuu sheegay in mashruucan uu yahay mid shaqeynya maadama karboonka ka dhalanaya uu yahay mid ka yimaada cowska ay lo'ada cuntay. Caqabadaha kale ee jira waxaa ka mid ah qiimaha hydrogen-ta ku baxaya marka la barbardhigo shidaal kale iyo dalabkeeda oo hooseeya ayaa ka dhigeysa in sameynteeda ay tahay mid dhib badan. In la dhiirogeliyo geliyo gawaarida ku shaqeysa hydrogen-ta iyo in la kabo qarashka ku baxaya si loola simo shidaalka kale ayaa ah waxyaabo loo baahan yahay. Kaalimo laga qaato shidaalka hydrogen-ta ayaa laga sameeyay magaalooyinka jasiirada. Dalka Japan waxa uu hurmuud ka yahay shidaalka hydrogen-ta adduunka, waxa uuna ku maalgeliyay farsamo casri ah balse hada waxaa ka jaban farsamada gawaarida batariga ku shaqeysa. Waxyaabaha kale ee adduunka ka jira waxaa ka mid ah in meelo badan oo caalamka ah aad loo daneynayo in digada iyo kaadida xoolaha laga sameeyo maaddada hydrogen. Dhinaca kale, injineero ka tirsan jaamacada Illinois Chicago ee dalka Mareykanka ayaa dhawaan soo saaray habkale oo lagu sameyn karo hydrogen. Waxay isticmaaleen digada xoolaha iyo qashin kale. Hindisahan waxaa lagu bilaabay iskaashi dhexmray jaamacadaha Kyushu iyo Fukuoka balse hadda waxaa ku soo biiray shirkado waa weyn sida Toyota. "Saxarada dadka waa mid joogto loo heli karo marka in laga faa'ideysto oo laga soo saaro tamar waxtar leh lagana dhigo hydrogen waxay na gaarsiineysaa tamar gudaha ka timaado oo gudahana laga isticmaalo" ayuu yiri Miyaoka Saldhiga Fukuoka ee bulaacadaha ka sameeya shidaalka hydrogen-ta waxa uu shaqeynaya ilaa iyo -kii. Dhowr dal oo adduunkana waxay isticmaalaan habkan. Wadamo ay ka mid yihiin Jarmalka, Hindiya iyo Mareykanka ayaa wasaqda bulaacadaha ka sameeya hydrogen. Dhowr shirkadood oo kuwa biyaha UK ayaa wada mashaariic ceynkan oo kale ah si loo sameeyo hydrogen.
