Go'aanka arooska: Talooyinka muhiimka ah ee guurka ka hor . Marwo Ababa G/sillaase iyo Seygeeda Gabre Kiristos waxay isqabeen ama ay noolal wadaag ahaayeen sano. Dhawaanna waxay xuseen sanad guuradii 50aad ee guurkooda ka soo wareegtay iyada oo munaasabaddaasina ay ka soo qayb galeen carruur oo ay dhaleen iyo carruur oo ay carruurtooda sii dhaleen. Waxayna qoysaskaasi nus qarniga noolasha ku mideysnaa ay sheegayaan iney muddo intaa dhan ay wada noolaadaan ay ugu wacneed "Samir iyo Iisu dulqaadasho". "Labada qof ee isqaba ama wada nool midkood inuu khalad ka dhaca waa lagama maarmaan balse iney khaladka dhacay si deggan ay u xalliyaan ayaa u horseedaya iney noolal farxad leh ay ku noolaadaan" ayey tiri Marwo Ababa. Bariyahan dambana waxaa aad u badan qoysas wada nool oo aan aarimaha qoyskooda ka wada hadli karin, kuwa u wada nool carruurta iney wada korsadaan oo keli ah, ama aan kalsooni isku qabin. Haddaba isfaham la'aanta noocaasi marka uu sii ballaadho wuxuu horseedayaa qoysaski dhisnaa iney burburaan oo la kala tago. Tigist Waaltangus iyo Indaalki Asafa waxay muddo ka badan sano ay ka shaqeeyaan la talinta iyo xallinta khilaafaadka ka dhasha guurka iyaga oo ka wada tirsan urur arrimahan ka shaqeeya. Mar wax laga weydiiyey waxyaabaha guurka khatarta geliya ee burburka horseeda waxay sheegeen iney kow ka tahay aqoonta ay lammaanuhu u leeyihiin guurka iyo xiriirka jeceyl waxa ay kala yihiin. "Guurku wuxuu ka billaabmayaa qofka laftiisa" marka inta uusan qofku fiirin qofka uu noolasha la wadaagayo waa inuu marka hore isagu is fiiriyaa, ayey Tiri Khabiir Tigist. Dhibaatooyinka kale ee guurka iyo xiriirka jeceyl ee lamaanaha khatar gelin kara waxaa ka mid ah: Marwo Ababa waxay sheegtay Soddohdeed iyo Soddoggeed oo ay u aqbashay una soo dhaweeysay sida labadeyda waalid inuu qayb weyn ka qaatay iney guur farxad leh oo muddo dheer soo jira ay nasiib u yeelato. Ragga iyo dumarkaba marka ugu horreysa oo ay noolasha ku midoobaan waxay isku dayaan midba midka kale inuu isku dayo inuu iisu muujiyo sida malaa'igti oo kale oo qof wanaagsan uu iisu muujiyo balse xaalku dib ayuu ka xumaanayaa. "Dhibaatooyinka iyo dabeecadaha qarsoon ee dhabta ah oo uu qofku leeyahay oo dhan dib ayey ka soo baxayaan, maadaamaa inta la wada nool yahay noolasha wax badan oo wanaag ama xumaan ah lagala kulmayo" ayey tiri. "Dadka doonayo iney reer yagleelaan sida ay jeebkooda iyo akaawunka bangigooda u eegaan, waa iney dib u fiiriyaan aragtida qofka iyo waxa uu naftiisu ka aaminsan yahay" ayey tiri Tigist. Dhibaatooyinka ugu badan ee sii huriyay dhibka qoysaska ka dhex dhaca ayaa sida oo kale la sheegaa iney ugu wacan tahay ururro ama hay'ado arrimaha guurka bulshada kala taliyo oo aan jirin haddii ay jiraan ay awooddooda kooban tahay. Qoysaska isguursanaya inta aysan guurka guda gelin ka hor waa iney wada fariistaan oo si cad ay arrimahan u qorsheystaan: Haddii ay sidaa sameyn waayaan dhibaatooyinka guurka kaddib yimaaddo xallintooda qof ayey dusha ka fuuleysaa marka uu qofkaasi u dulqaadan waayana wuxuu u horseedaya inuu qoyska burburo. "Guurku sidiisaba waxaa lagu hagaa aqoon, karti iyo dulqaad" ayuu yiri Khabiir Indaalki. Haddaba aqoonta guur ee loo baahan yahay waa iney su'aalahan ka jawaabaan: Dadki hore inta ay reer yagleelin ka hor waxay aqoonta guurka ka korosan jireen dadka ka waaweyn iyo waaliddiintooda iyaga oo weydiiyo guurka waxa uu yahay iyo maareynta uu u baahan yahay. Aqoonta ugu badan waxaa laga helaa: "Guurka ujeeddadiisu iney ka ballaadhan tahay in guri lagu wada noolaado ama ubad la dhalo oo keli cid labada qof ee isguursaneyso kala taliyana waa lo baahan yahay" ayey tiri Tigist.iwmwuuu k aballaadhan yahay Labada qof ee isguursaneysa oo dabeecadahooda rasmiga ah oo ay leeyihiin ilaaheyna uu ku abuuray aan kala qarsan oo iisu sheego waxay iyaduna gacan ka geysaneysaa qofka marka uu wax ku saabsan dabeecaddiisa kala kulmo qofka kale iney ku soo boodda ku noqoneyn maadaamaa uu horay ugu sheegay dabeecaddiisaasi. Waxayna khubaradu ku talinayaan labada qof inta ay isguursan ka hor iney iyagu maskax ahaan isa soo dhisaan iney wax walba ka wanaagsan tahay. Maxay yihiin dhibaatooyinka ugu waaweyn ee ay la kulmaan qoysaska? Tigist iyo Indaalki oo muddo sana ah arrimaha qoyska bulshada kala soo talinayey ayaa waxay sheegayaan muddadi ay howshan ku soo jireen dhibaatooyinka ugu badan ee ay qoysaska ula yimaaddaan ee ay xalliyeen waxa ay yihiin. "Labada qof ee sida dhabta ah iisu jecel jeceylkooda ay keydiyeen waxay la soo baxaan xilliga dhibka uu yimaaddo" ayey leeyihiin khubarada arrimaha guurka ku takhasusay. Labada qof ee isguursanaya waa iney lahaadaan hadaf mideysan, haddiise hadafkoodu uu marki horaba mideysneyn muddo marka la wada noolaado aragtida ayaa lagu kala duwananaanayaa taasoo ugu dambeynti khilaaf uu ka dhalan karo. Hadafkoodu ugu weyna waa iney ka dhigaan mar weliba iney dhisaan naftooda, dabeecadahooda, hab dhaqankooda iyo wax kasta oo wada noolaashahooda sii xoojin kara. Wax la dhisana waxaa ugu wanaagsan jeceylka ay lammaanaha iisu qabaan, maadaamaa jeceylku uusan marnaba duugoobin isla-markaana uu dhammaan, waxa ka soo hara oo dhan ay dhammaanayaan ayna isbeddelayaan.

Buurnidu ma waxa ay u baahan tahay qeexitaan cusub? Waxaa jira khatar ah in dad aad u badan lagu sheego cayilnaan ama buurnaan iyada oo loo baahan yahay "qeexid sax ah" oo "faahfaahsan", sida lagu sheegay warbixin ay soo saareen khubaro caalami ah. Dhakhaatiirta ayaa la faray inay tixgeliyaan guud ahaan caafimaadka bukaanka leh dufanka xad-dhaafka ah, halkii ay ku koobnaan lahaayeen cabirka miisaanka jidhka (BMI), ayay warbixintu sheegtay. Kuwa qaba cudurrada daba-dheeraada ee ka dhashay miisaankooda waa in loo aqoonsado "buurnaan caafimaad ahaan lagu xaqiijiyay" - laakiin kuwa aan qabin wax dhibaato caafimaad ah waa in loo aqoonsado "Buurnaan aan caafimaad ahaan loo xaqiijin". In ka badan hal bilyan oo qof ayaa la qiyaasayaa inay la nool yihiin cayil caalamka oo dhn, halka dawooyinka miisaanka lagu dhimo ee dhakhtarradu qoraan aad loo dalbado. Warbixinta, oo lagu daabacay joornaalka The Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology, waxaa taageeray in ka badan khabiir oo caafimaad oo caalamka ah. "Buurnaantu waa mid soo badanaysa," ayuu yidhi Prof Francesco Rubino oo ka socda King's College London, oo madax u ahaa kooxda daraasaddan. "Qaar baa qaba oo haddana si caadi ah ulu noolaada, kuwaas oo wax dhib ah ku qabin" Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. "Kuwa kale uma socon karaan si wanaagsan, uma neefsan karaan si caadi ah, ama waxay ku fadhiyan kursi curyaanimo iyagoo la ildaran dhibaatooyin caafimaad oo waaweyn." Warbixintu waxay ku baaqaysaa in dib loo qeexo buurnaanta si loo kala saaro bukaannada qaba cudurka iyo kuwa weli caafimaad qaba laakiin halis ugu jira in ay mustaqbalka cudur ku dhacaan. "Waxaan dareemayaa inaan nasiib leeyahay inaan helo cirbadaha miisaanka dhima" – laakiin ma awoodi karaa NHS in qof walba la siiyo? Sidee ayay u shaqeeyaan dawooyinka miisaanka dhima ee sida Mounjaro iyo Wegovy? Hadda, wadamo badan, buurnaanta waxaa lagu qeexaa in BMI-gu ka badan yahay - taas oo ah cabbir lagu qiyaaso dufanka jidhka iyada oo lagu saleynayo dhererka iyo miisaanka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, BMI-gu waxba kama sheego guud ahaan caafimaadka bukaanka, ayay warbixintu leedahay, mana kala saari karto murqaha iyo baruurta jidhka, mana tixgeliyaan dufanka khatarta badan ee ku wareegsan uurkujirta iyo xubnaha muhiimka ah. Khubaradu waxay ku doodayaan in la hirgeliyo qaab cusub oo diiradda saaraya calaamadaha buurnaanta ee saameeya xubnaha jirka - sida cudurrada wadnaha, neefsashada oo dhib ku noqota, macaanka nooca , ama xanuunka kala-goysyada - iyo saameyntooda waxyeellada leh ee nolosha maalinlaha ah. Tani waxay tilmaamaysaa in buurnaantu ay noqotay cudur caafimaad ahaan u baahan dawooyin. Dadka qaba "buurnaanta ka-hor caafimaad" waa in halkii laga siin lahaa dawooyin iyo qalliino, loo bandhigaa talo ku saabsan dhimista miisaanka, la-talin iyo kormeer si loo yareeyo halista caafimaad ee soo kordhaysa. Waxa kale oo ay noqon kartaa in daawayn loo baahan yahay.

Saacaddan murugadu taagan tahay, waxaan tacsi u dirayaa qoyskiisa, asxaabtiisa iyo taageerayaashiisa aan la tirin karin. Om Shanti" ayuu yiri. Maxay tahay dawada loo helay madax xanuunka loo yaqaanno Migraine ama Goon-jabka? Kiniinnada nooca loo yaqaanno Atogepant, kuwaas oo dhowaan caan ku noqday hababka daawaynta iyo ka hortagga madax xanuunka maygariinka oo ay soomaalidu u taqaanno Goon-jabka, ayaa laga hirgeliyay Adeegyada Caafimaadka Qaranka (NHS) ee gudaha Ingiriiska. Daawadii ugu horreysay ee afka laga qaato ee loo isticmaalo daawaynta iyo ka hortagga madax xanuunka daba-dheeraada iyo xanuunka Goon-jabka ayaa la filayaa in dhawaan la siiyo bukaannada. Khubarrada caafimaadku waxay sheegeen in ku dhawaad kun oo qof oo gudaha dalkaasi ku nool ay ka faa'iidaysan karaan habkan cusub ee daawaynta. Xanuunka loo yaqaanno Goon-jabka waxa uu la soo baxaa madax xanuun aad u daran waxana uu qofka ku adkayn karaa in uu sameeyo hawl maalmeedka inta lagu jiro xilliga shaqada. Mid ka mid ah toddobadii qof ee adduunka oo dhan ayaa qaba xanuunka Migraine-ka ama Goon-jabka. Xilliyada xanuunka ee la dareemo wax ka yar maalmood bishii waxaa loo yaqaannaa migraine episodic. Xilliyada xanuunka ee soconaya in ka badan maalmood bishiiba waxaa Iyana lagu qeexay madax xanuunka Migraine-ka. Daawada cusub waxaa lagula talinayaa kuwa aan dhibaato ku qabin dawooyinka kale ama aan la siin karin cirbadda. NICE (National Institute for Health and Care Excellence), oo ah hay'ad ilaalisa daweynta kana howlgasha England, ayaa ku talisay in dawada, oo la ogaaday ay wax ku ool u leedahay dadka waaweyn qaarkood inta lagu jiro xilliga tijaabada, iyo in loo isticmaalo Adeegyada Caafimaadka Qaranka. Madax xanuunka Goon0jabka waxa caadiyan lagu tilmaamaa inuu yahay xanuun ku dhaca dhinaca madaxa wuxuuna socon karaa dhawr maalmood. Calaamadaha kale ee la dareemo waxaa kamid ah daal, dareenka iftiinka iyo dhawaaqa hadalka oo ku dhiba. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Lama oga inta qof ee la ildaran xanuunka Migraine-ka, laakiin marka loo eego NHS-ta, waxaa gudaha UK ku nool ku dhawaad milyan oo qof oo qaba xanuunkan Goon-jabka. Dumarku waxay aad ugu nugul yihiin Goon-jabka marka loo eego ragga. Daawooyinka nooca loo yaqaanno Atogepant waxay bixin karaan daaweyn ka hortag ah oo loogu talagalay xanuunka Goon-jabka dabadheeraada iyo madax xanuunka isna loo yaqaanno episodic. Inkasta oo xarumaha caafimaad qaarkood ay u arkaan horumarka daawadan "tallaabo wanaagsan", waxay sidoo kale hoosta ka xariiqeen in dad badan ay ku adag tahay helitaanka daawooyinka cusub. Sababaha tani waa iyadoo daawadu aysan si fiican u garaneynin dhakhaatiirta iyo in ay jiraan liisaska sugitaanka ee dheer ee helitaanka dhakhaatiirta takhasuska leh. Daawooyinka loo yaqaan "Gepant" kooxda ayaa la tijaabiyay dhowr sano laakiin weli lama gelin isticmaalka baahsan. Atogepant waa mid ka mid ah. Sida laga soo xigtay cilmi-baaris, kiimikaad maskaxda ku jirta oo la yiraahdo calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) waxay door ka ciyaartaa xanuunka iyo dareenka iftiinka labadaba. Atogepant, oo ah nooc cusub oo dawooyinka lidka ku ah CGRP, ayaa si gaar ah loogu talagalay daawaynta Goon-jabka. Waxa kale oo la xusay in dawooyinka jiilka cusub ay leeyihiin waxyeellooyin ka yar hababkii daawaynta ee hore. Rimegepant, oo la mid ah atogepant, ayaa sidoo kale la siiyay bukaannada qaar ee England iyo Scotland. Deborah Sloan oo ka socota Brighton ayaa ka mid ah kuwa qaatay dawadan. Iyadoo khibradeeda u sharraxaysa BBC-da, Sloan waxay sheegtay in ka dib markii ay la il darnayd xanuunka Migraine-ka ee daba dheeraaday muddo sano ah, nolosheeda ayaa ku soo noqotay caadi iyada oo ay uga mahadcelinayso dawooyinka. Deborah Sloan waxa ku kacay xanuunka Goon-jabka qiyaastii maalmood bishii waxana ay shaqada ka tagtay laba jeer caafimaadkeeda awgeed.

Women cops forging ties for life with the sex trafficking victims they rescue Several years have passed since Cristina and her team, an elite unit of Spanish police detectives, rescued "Victoria" from a sex trafficking ring. When they found her, Victoria's life was hanging by a thread - for three years, she had suffered such an extreme level of physical and emotional abuse that she barely felt human. It was the hope of seeing her children again that helped her survive. The police investigation has now ended, but the relationship with Cristina and the rest of the team hasn't. They have continued to play a substantive role in her life - from something as powerful as reuniting her with her children after years apart, to something smaller but no less meaningful: surprising her with a cake on her birthday. It is an autumn afternoon and Victoria [not her real name] gets emotional as soon as she sees Cristina and her colleagues arrive with their present in her local park. She is smiling and glad to celebrate another year with them, but Victoria, in her 40s, says the past was "tough". Her childhood in her native Colombia was brutal. Her father disappeared on his way to work one morning in , leaving no trace. Her mother remarried another man who Victoria says raped her younger sister. As the eldest child, she was keen to get a job in order to rescue her siblings from hardship. When a friend introduced her to a woman who offered her a cleaning job in Spain, Victoria thought she had finally struck lucky. But what awaited her in Europe was another kind of misery. She was immediately forced into prostitution. "I worked hours a day," she says. "I had to sleep with my make-up on and you always had to be [only] in your underwear, ready for any customer who would arrive." We can't give details of her rescue, because as a protected witness we need to conceal her identity, but Victoria says she will never forget that sunny morning when she first saw the detectives and ran towards them. "I looked at them, hugged them and cried," she recalls. "They offered to take me to a safe place, where I could be free without fear." Victoria says she was so traumatised by the gang's continual surveillance that she was even asking for permission to sleep. Since then, in partnership with other organisations, Cristina and her team have helped Victoria access psychological support, as well as advice on how to find a job and progress her studies. More significantly, they also worked for months to help ensure the safety of her children. The gang that lured Victoria to Spain had threatened to hurt them back home in Colombia if she ever dared to escape or alert the authorities. They were highly organised and unlikely to be bluffing - the traffickers had texted her children directly in the past and knew where they lived and which school they went to. Cristina and others in the Central Operative Unit - a specialised division of Spain's Guardia Civil that prosecutes the most serious forms of organised crime - worked alongside women's organisations and human rights lawyers for months to legalise Victoria's situation in Spain so that they could bring her family over to join her. The team follows a victim-focused approach, through which women are offered long-term support to help them settle into a stable and safe environment after they have been rescued. The team says it sometimes get teased by other units for sounding more like a "charity" than an elite team of criminal investigators, but Cristina is a passionate advocate for what they do. "We believe in a social and humanitarian process that can restore hope in victims' lives, so they can truly recover and live passionately again." While women make up fewer than % of Guardia Civil's officers across the board, they make up % of Cristina's squad. The head of the unit, Felix Duran, explains their recruitment is a "priority". He believes that sex trafficking victims, particularly teenage girls, feel more comfortable giving details to a female officer. Approximately , trafficking victims are detected across the world every year, the United Nations' Office on Crime and Drugs (UNODC) estimates. Its latest global report on human trafficking, published on Wednesday, says there has been a % rise in the detection of victims compared with the pre-pandemic period, as "more children are exploited and forced labour cases spike". The report finds that women and girls continue to account for the majority of victims detected worldwide, who are mostly trafficked for the purpose of sexual exploitation. Spain is both a country of exploitation and a transit hub for thousands of victims trafficked into Europe. Victoria and the other victims were concealed inside an apartment, surrounded by other flats. Victoria felt she was being abused in plain sight - she believes that the cries for help, the beatings, and the constant flow of men coming in and out of the property, would have made it obvious. "The neighbours; the postman; everyone knew. They could have killed me and nobody would have asked any questions," she recalls. After the lockdowns during the Covid- pandemic, human trafficking for sexual exploitation went further underground, the Guardia Civil told the BBC. It says that, while many women are still exploited in public venues, such as bars or on the streets, most documented victims are now concealed in private apartments supplied by traffickers, making it harder for police forces to detect them. Ilias Chatzis, chief of the UNODC Human Trafficking and Migrant Smuggling Section, says the high involvement of organised crime groups means human trafficking is now increasingly intertwined with other illegal activities, such as drug trafficking or cybercrime. "A large number of victims remain undetected because sometimes authorities will prosecute the trafficker for some lesser offence, but not for the trafficking crime, so the victim itself would not be recognised as a trafficking victim," he told the BBC. For Victoria, she is grateful that her own experience was recognised by the police, and wants to use it to raise the visibility of those victims still waiting to be rescued. "They gave me another chance not only to live, but to heal and hug my children again." She asked the BBC to be referred to as "Victoria" because it means "victory" in Spanish. "I go out on the street and I breathe, and I say, 'my God, thank you, I'm alive'. I feel free and that's the best feeling." Cristina says she marvels at Victoria's resilience. "She is an example of how you can survive and overcome such an ordeal", explains Cristina. "I often think: 'My goodness, there's so much inner power, such bravery in you.'" Shaqooyinka ay halista ku hayso teknooloojiyadda Waxaa jiraa shaqooyin qaar oo ka ciribtirmi doono dunida maadama ay soo ifbaxayaan aalado casri ah oo qaban karaa shaqooyinkaas xilli dunida ay ku tallaabsatay horumar weyn oo dhanka horumarinta shaqooyinka iyo waxsoo saarkaba. Hadda iska jir shaqooyinka qaar ee qarka u saaran in la waayo sanadaha soo socda. Darawalnimada ayaa kamid ah shaqooyinka meesha ka bixi karo xilli waaxyaha gaadiidka adduunka la casriyeeyay taas oo wax ka baddali karto dhammaan sida loo howlgeliyo. Waxaa jiraa malaayiin qof oo ku tiirsan shaqada darawalnimada oo ka cabsi qaba in arrintani ay saameyso mustaqbalka. Sida laga soo xigtay xarunta Goldman Sachs , dad lagu qiyaasay malyan oo ku nool Mareykanka ayaa halis ugu jiraa inay waayaan shaqooyinkooda maadama ay soo korodhay teknooloojiyada casriga ah ee lagu kaxeeyo baabuurta. Isbaddallada lagu saameeyo gaadiidka adduunka ayaa sii ballaaranayaa, -ta sano ee soo socota waxaa yaraan doonaa shaqooyinka darawalnimada. Haatan waxaa dunida la wareegay qalabka teknooloojiyadda oo ganacsigii iyo suuqyada qabsaday, xitaa dowldaha qaar waxay bilaabeen xoojinta xirfadaha la xiriira teknooljiyadda. Dowladda Jarmalka waxay bilowday inay taageerto mashruucan isla markaana waxay daneysay qorshaha ku aadan baabuurta sida iskood ah isku kaxeynayo. Waxay sheegtay in meesha lagu gaaro in baabuur lagu qiyaasay milyan ay geli doonaa waddooyinka dalkaas kuwaas si iskood ah isku kaxeyn doono. Waa arrin wareerkeeda leh maadama bukaanada ay ku tiirsan yihiin dhakhaatiirta. Kadib saameynta ka dhalatay safmarka Karoona wuxuu isbaddallo ku yimid waaxyaha caafimaada adduunka, waxaana la xaqiijiyay in xitaa dhakhaatiirta ay ku adkaatay inay ogadaan cudurrada qaar taa baddalkeedana lagu ogaado teknooloojiyadda. Waxaana shaqadan halis gelinayaa qalabka casriga ah ee caafimaadka qaabilsan sida adeegsiga adeeg la yiraahdo 'telemedicine' oo horseedi karo in dhakhtarka uu xaaladda la socdo adiga oo jooga meel fog. Waxay tani dhalin kartaa in laga maarmi karo dhakhaatiir fara badan maadama la adeegsanayo qalab casri ah. Kadib saameynta Karoona, shaqaalaha caafimaadka waxay safka kaga jireen la tacaalidda bukaanada uu ku dhacay Covid- sidaa darteed qaarkood waxay halis u galeen in uu ku dhaco cudurka, tani waxay horseedi kartaa in uu hoos u dhac uu ku yimaado tirada shaqaalaha caafimaadka ee adduunka. Dadka waxay haatan isaga tageen maalmihii buugaagta lagu soo akhrin jiray maktabadaha iyo cilmo baarista lagu soo sameyn jiray, wax kasta waxaa baddalay dunida casriga ah. Haatan waxaa dunida ka howlgalaa maktabado casri ah. Xitaa baryahan dambe waxaa buugaagta laga heli karaa internetka oo qofka dhaalacan karo isaga oo gurigiisa joogo. Lacag intee leeg ayaa ku baxaysa haweenaydii ugu horraysay ee dayaxa u safraysa? Teknolojiyad cusub oo dhalinyarada ka caawineysa qorshaha guurka Maalmihii hore waxaa jiri jiray qof lacagaha ka uruuriyay xarumaha ganacsiga iyo goobaha kaleba isaga oo kuu soo celinayo baaqikaaga. Dunida casriga ah waxay horseeday in dadka intooda badan aysan adeegsanin lacagaha caddaanka ah. Waxaa soo ifbaxay adeegyo casri ah oo lacagaha lagu xawisho ama lagala baxo. Bangiyo badan oo adduunka ku yaalla, waxay haatan yareynayaan shaqaalaha maadama adeegyadaha lacagaha lagu sameeyo adeegyada casriga ah ama Digital-ka. Mustaqbalka waxaa dhici kartaa in bangiyada qaar ay iska xiraan xarumahooda maadama adeegyada ay ku fulin doonaan Online-ka. Dunida waxaa haatan si weyn loo maalgelinayaa ganacsiga Online-ka maadama adeegyada la xiriira lacagaha laisku marsiin karo halkaas.

Dawladda Soomaaliya oo si quursi leh uga jawaab celisay hadallada Trump Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa ka falcelisay hadalada kasoo baxaayay maalmihii la soo dhaafay Madaxweynaha dalka Maraykanka Donald Trump. Ra'iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamse Cabdi Barre oo ka hadlaayay munaasabad ka dhacaysay magaalada Muqdisho ayay gabadh kamida ah dadkii kasoo qaybgalay munaasabadda weydiisay waxa uusan wax uga dhihin hadalada Trump. Gabadha oo lagu magacaabo Hibo Sooyaal ayaa weydiisay Ra'iisul wasaaraha "Ilmo adeeradaaba waad u jawaabtee, Donald Trump; maxaadan ugu jawaabin?" Ra'iisul wasaaraha ayaa isaga oo qoslaya ku bilaabay "Waa su'aal fiican". "Madaxweynaha Maraykanku, Soomaaliya kaliya ma ahee wadamo badan ayuu af-xumeeyay runtii" ayuu Ra'iisul wasaarahu yidhi isaga oo ka jawaabaya su'aasha ay gabadhu weydiisay. "Dad badan buu wax ka sheegay, Nigeria ayuu wax ka sheegay, South Africa ayuu sidoo kale wax ka sheegay; marka mararka qaarkood; waxyaabo la yidhaahdo Salaaman ku dhaafa." Isaga oo hadalka sii wata. Waxuu xusay Ra'iisulwasaaraha Soomaaliya in aysan ahayn hadalka Trump wax ah in la weyneeyo ayna tahay in meesheeda looga tago. "In aan arrin ka dhigno oo aan micno u yeelno; waxaa ka dhibyar, in aan iska dhaafno" ayuu ku soo gabagabeeyay Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuusan doonayn muhaajiriinta Soomaaliyeed ee ku sugan Maraykanka, isaga oo u sheegay weriyeyaasha in ay "dib ugu noqdaan halka ay ka yimaadeen" isla markaana "dalka ay ka yimaaddeen aanu wanaagsanayn sabab jirta darteed." "Runtaan kuu sheegayaa, ma rabo gudaha dalkayaga in ay sii joogaan," ayuu yidhi intii lagu jiray kulan golihiisa wasiirrada Talaadadii. Trump wuxuu sidoo kale yidhi Maraykanku wuxuu "jid qaldan ku dhici doonaa haddii aan sii wadno in aan qashin soo qaadanno dalkayaga." Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya Cali Balcad, ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay barta X wuxuu u dhignaa sidaan:"Dadka qaarkood waxaa aad ugu fududaatay inay Soomaaliya u adeegsadaan marmarsiiyo ama inay ku qariyaan guuldarradooda. Sheekadan ma aha oo keliya mid been ah, balse waa aflagaado loo geystay adkeysigeenna iyo naf-hurnimadeenna. Waa inaan midnimo muujinaa, ilaalinaa karaamadeenna, una muujinnaa caalamka inaanan ahayn wax uu qof doonayo oo sida uu rabo u adeegsado". Hadallada Trump ayaa yimid iyadoo la soo sheegayay in hay'adaha socdaalka ay qorshaynayaan hawl fulin balaadhan oo ka dhan ah muhaajiriinta, taas oo ka dhici doonta gobolka Minnesota oo Soomaalidu ku badan tahay. Mas'uuliyiinta gobolka ayaa cambaareeyay qorshahaas, iyaga oo ku dooday in ay si aan caddaalad ahayn ugu dhici karto muwaadiniin Maraykan ah oo laga yaabo in muuqaalkoodu u ekaado dad ka yimid Geeska Afrika. Wuxuu sidoo kale yidhi: "Soomaaliya, oo aan si fiican u ahayn dal, waad ogtihiin, waxba ma laha, waxba, wax kasta oo jira ma leh. Way iska ordayaan iyaga oo is dilaya. Mana jiro nidaam." Markaas ayuu u jeestay dhaleeceynta Wakiil Ilhaan Cumar, oo ka tirsan Dimuqraadiyiinta, isla markaana ah gabadhii ugu horreysay ee Soomaali-Maraykan ah ee loo doorto Kongareeska, taas oo ay marar badan isku dhaceen madaxweynaha Maraykanka. "Had iyo jeer waan daawadaa iyada," ayuu sheegay Trump, isaga oo ku daray in Cumar ay "cid walba neceb tahay. Waxaanan u malaynayaa inay tahay qof aan waxba qaban karin (aan karti u lahayn)." ayuu ku yiri Trump. Qoraal kooban oo ay ku daabacday barta X ayay Ilhaan Cumar sidatan ugu jawaabtay Donald Trump. "Ku mashquuliddiisu aniga waxay noqotay mid cabsi leh," ayay Omar ku jawaabtay qoraal baraha bulshada ah. "Waxaan rajaynayaa inuu helo caawinaadda uu sida daran ugu baahan yahay." Hay'adda Socdaalka iyo Kastamyada Mareykanka (ICE) ayuu amray maamulka Trump in ay bartilmaameedsato muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee aan sharciyada haysan ee ku nool magaalooyinka Mataanaha ah, sida uu sheegay qof arrimaha qorshaynta ku dhow oo u warramay CBS News, oo ah la-hawlgalaha BBC ee Maraykanka, Talaadadii. Boqolaal qof ayaa la filayaa in la beegsado marka hawlgalku billowdo toddobaadkan, sida uu sheegay mas'uulkaas. Wargeyska The New York Times ayaa markii ugu horraysay soo tebiyay hawlgalka. Afhayeen u hadashay Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha oo ay ICE hoos timaaddo ayaa diidday inay ka hadasho hawlgallada qorshaysan, waxayna beenisay in dad lagu beegsan doono sababo la xidhiidha jinsiyaddooda. "Maalin kasta, ICE waxay fulisaa sharciyada dalka oo dhan," ayay tidhi Kaaliyaha Xoghayaha Tricia McLaughlin. "Waxa qof ka dhiga bartilmaameedka ICE ma aha jinsiyaddiisa ama qowmiyaddiisa, balse waa xaqiiqda ah inuu dalka si sharci-darro ah ku joogo," ayay tiri. Shir jaraa'id oo uu qabtay, duqa magaalada Minneapolis Jacob Frey, ayaa sheegay in hawlgal ay ICE fuliso uu "ka dhigan yahay in hab-raaca sharciyadu la meelmarin doonin." Sida ay sheegeen hoggaamiyeyaasha maxalliga ah, waxaa halkaas ku nool ku dhowaad , oo qof oo asal ahaan ka soo jeeda Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo intooda badan ah muwaadiniin Maraykan ah.

Muxuu yahay heshiiska caalamiga ah ee laga gaaray biyaha Webiga Niil ee Masar iyo Suudaan ka hor yimaadeen? Heshiis caalami ah oo ku saabsan maareynta biyaha webiga Niil ayaa dhaqan galay inkastoo si xooggan ay uga soo horjeedaan dalalka Masar iyo Suudaan. Ka dib in ka badan toban sano oo wadaxaajood ah, heshiiska Iskaashiga Gobolka Webiga Niil ayaa loogu talagalay in lagu xalliyo khilaafaadka taariikhiga ah si loo hubiyo in dalalkan kor iyo hoosba ay ka faa'iideysan karaan biyaha Niil. Kheyraadkan ayaa marar badan noqday xudunta khilaaf gobolka, gaar ahaan ka dib markii Itoobiya dhistay biyo xireenka oo ay doonayso in ay ka dhaliso koronto.. Heshiisku wuxuu ujeedkiisu yahay in la hubiyo in dhammaan toban dal oo ku jira dooxada Niil ay haystaan qaab sharciyeed oo maamula isticmaalka webiga. Laakiin labo dal ma saxiixan. Masar ayaa muddo dheer ku adkeysanaysay inay raacdo heshiisyadii iyo ee xaqiijinayay inay iyada iyo Suudaan heli doonaan qiyaas cayiman oo biyo ah sanad walba. Masar sidoo kale waxay awood u leedahay inay diiddo mashaariic kasta oo ku saabsan webiga Niil ee dalalka aan soo xusnay. Itoobiya waxay dhistay biyo xireenkeeda ballaaran si ay koronto ugu sameysato. Khilaafkan wuxuu qayb ka yahay khilaaf siyaasadeed oo halis ah oo ka dhaxeeya Soomaaliya, Ereteriya iyo Masar oo dhinac ah, iyo Itoobiya oo iayaduna ku sii adkaysanaysa tallaabooyin dalalkaan ka caraysiiyay. Muranka waxaa udub-dhexaad u ah qorshaha lagu buuxinayo biyo-xireenka iyadoo Masar ay ka baqayso in mashruucu uu Itoobiya u suurto-gelin doono inay maamusho biyaha webiga ugu dheer Afrika. Xarumaha korontada laga dhaliyo biyaha uma baahna biyo, balse sida degdegga ah ee ay Itoobiya u buuxineyso keydka biyo-xireenka ayaa saameyn doonaya hab u socoshada biyaha webiga. Buuxinta keydka biyo-xireenka, oo lagu wado in qaadkiisu uu noqdo bilyan kiyuubik mitir, waxaa yaraanaya saameynta heerka qulqulka webiga ay arrintaasi ku yeelanayso. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Itoobiya ayaa dooneysay in dhismaha biyo-xireenka ay ku soo afjarto lix sano gudahood sida ay sheegtay sanadkii -kii. Wasiirka Biyaha Itoobiya Seleshi Bekele ayaa bishii September ee sanadkii -kii sheegay in dalkiisu uu qorsheynayo inuu dedejiyo arrinta ku saabsan biyo-xireenka. Balse Masar ayaa soo jeedisay xilligaas in xilli dheer ay qaadato buuxinta biyo-xireenka - si aysan hoos ugu dhicin biyaha webiga, gaar ahaanna marka ay socoto wejiga hore ee buuxinta. Wadahadallo u dhaxeeyay Masar, Suudaan iyo Itoobiya oo ku saabsanaa biyo-xireenka ayaa miro-dhali waayay in ka badan afar sano - Mareykanka ayaana soo fara geliyay oo isku dayay inuu dhexdhexaadiyo hase-yeeshee kuma guulaysan in xal laga gaaro Kaddib wadahadllo dhacay -kii, Mr Seleshi ayaa Masar ku eedeeyay inaysan dooneyn in heshiis la gaaro. "Uma maleynayo markii ay Masaaridu halkan yimaadeen inay u yimaadeen in heshiis la gaaro," Mr Seleshi ayaa sidaasi u sheegay BBC-da. "Waxay haddana la yimaadeen qorshe cusub oo buuxinta biyo-xireenka ah. Waqtiga ay doonayaan inay qaadato buuxinta biyo-xireenka waa ilaa sano. "Tani maaha mid la aqbali karo," ayuu yiri. Wasiirka Biyaha Masar Mohamed Abdel Aty, ayaa isagana sheegay in labada dhinac ay xoogaa is-afgarasho ah gaareen. Khilaafka arrintaas ka dhashay oo weli taagan ayaa keenay in dhawaan ay Masar ka qayb ka noqoto iskaashi saddex geesood ah oo looga dhawaaqay magaalada Asmara ee caasimadda Ereteriya kaas oo u dhaxeeya madaxweynah Ereteriya Isaias Afwerki, Cabdul Fitaax- asiisi madaxweynaha iyo Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud madaxweynaha Soomaaliya. Iskaashigaan ayaa ah mid ka dhan ah oo Itoobiya ay u aragto inuu khatar ku yahay, waxaana dadka falanqeeya arrimaha gobolka ay sheegayaan in xiisadda gobolka oo awalba maraysa meel adag ay sare u sii kici karto.

Soomaali ku nool Los Angeles oo BBC uga warramay sida uu u saameeyay dabka ka holcaya halkaas , Xuseen Buulow Khubarrada saadaasha hawada ee California, dalka Mareykanka ayaa ka digaya in dabeylo xooggan oo sii hurin kara dabka Los Angeles ay mar kale halkaasi ku wajahan yihiin toddobaadkan, xilli shaqaalaha dab-damiska ay isku dayayaan inay demiyaan ilaa saddex dab oo halkaasi ka holcaya. Saraakiisha ayaa ka digay in kadib dabeylaha oo labadii maalin ee lasoo dhaafay degganaa, ay xoogeysan karaan gaar ahaanna waxaa laga baqayaa dabeylaha qallalan ee Santa Ana inay sii socdaan ilaa Arbacada. Dabkan ayaa saameeyay nolosha dadka halkaasi ku nool, waxaana ka mid ah Soomaali ganacsi ku leh xaafad ka tirsan magaalada. Xuseen Maxamuud Buulow oo maqaayad ku leh magaalada Ingliwood ee koonfurta Los Angeles, ayaa BBC-da uga warbixiyay guud ahaan saamaynta dabka. Sawirka, Xuseen Buulow "Musiibadu waxay ku dhacday meel nolol kala duwan ay ka socotay oo dhismeyaal nooc kasta ah leh, haatan lama aqoonsan karo sida ay u kala dhisnaayeen, waa musiibo wayn," ayuu yiri Xuseen Buulow. Waxa uu intaa ku daray in dabka uu saamayn ku yeeshay ganacsigii iyadoona dadka inta badan ay ka qaxeen goobaha ka agdhaw halka uu dabku ka kacay. Dhanka kale waxa uu sheegay in Soomaalida halkaas ka dhaw ay yihiin kuwo aad u yar sidaasna aysan u jirin cabsi badan oo ay qabaan. "Dadka Soomaalida ah ee la shaqeeya shirkadaha filimaanta ama dad qaar ee ganacsi leh ayaa goobta ka dhawaa balse waa tiro aad u yar," ayuu raaciyay. Waxa uu xusay in waxa ugu daran ee ay ka cabsi qabaan ay tahay dhanka caafimaadka, iyadoo ay soo gaareen khashinka iyo danbasta ka soo baxaya gubashada. Tan ayaa sidoo kale sababtay in dadku aysan bannaanada iyo maqaayadaha isugu imaan taasoo saamayn ku yeelatay ganacsiga. Baaraha caafimaadka ee degmada LA ayaa cusboonaysiiyay tirada dhimashada Axaddii waxa ayna gaartay ilaa , halka saraakiishu ay sheegeen goor sii horaysay ugu yaraan kale inay wali maqan yihiin. Ilaa ka mid ah dadka dhintay ayaa laga helay aagga dab damiska ee Eaton, halka siddeed kalena laga helay aagga Palisades. Saddex kamid ah gaadiidka dab damiska ayaa ku gubtay agagaarka Los Angeles. Dabka ugu weyn waa Palisades, kaas oo hadda gubay in ka badan , eekar oo % ka kooban. Ka hor duufaanta dabaysha, xoogaa horumar ah ayaa laga sameeyay joojinta fiditaanka dabka ee Palisades iyo Eaton, kuwaas oo haatan ka gubanaya darafyada magaalada. Dab demiska maxalliga ah ayaa waxaa caawinaya shaqaale ka socda siddeed gobol oo kale, iyo sidoo kale Canada iyo Mexico, kuwaas oo qayb ka ah howlgalka. Dabka Eaton waa kan labaad ee ugu weyn wuxuuna ku gubay in ka badan , eekar. Waxa ku jira % Dabka Hurst ayaa isna gaaray eekar, waxaana lagu dhawaaday in si buuxda loo xakameeyo. Dabkaan ka kacay LA ayaa saamayntiisu waxa ay dhalisay khasaare aad u badan waana kii ugu kharashka badnaa taariikhda Maraykanka. Axaddii, saadaasha gaarka ah ee Accuweather ayaa kordhisay qiyaasta horudhaca ah ee khasaaraha maaliyadeed ee dabka waxaana lagu sheegay inuu gaarsiisanyahay inta u dhaxaysa $250bn-$275bn. In kasta oo shaqaaluhu ay ku guulaysteen xakamaynta dabka ugu weyn, mas'uuliyiintu waxay ka digeen dabaysha la filayo inay ku soo wajahantahay aagga uu dabku ka dhacay taas oo horseedi karta "xaalad masiibo ah", iyada oo dhammaan gobolka LA lagu soo rogay digniinno la xiriira dabka.

Ajnabiga Af-Soomaaliga bara dadka Soomaalida ah , Faysal Maxamed Muxumed Jaamacadda Gothenburg, ee dalka Sweden ayaa waxaa ay baaritaan qoto dheer ku sameysaa afka-Soomaaliga, waxaana ay ka sameeyaan qoraal cilmi ah. Jaamacadda ayaa macalimiin u dhashay dalkaas waxay baraan arday Soomaali ka mid tahay luuqadda Soomaaliga. Jaamacadda ayaa haysa qoraal Soomaali ah oo la qoray muddo aad u fog, waxaana Soomaaligu ka mid yahay luuqadaha Afrika ee Jaamacaddu ku sameyso baaritaannada cilmiyeeysan ee ujeedkoodu yahay in loo yeesho faham mug leh oo dib ugu laabanaya bilowgii afka. Faysal Maxamed Muxumed oo ah Arday dhigta Jaamacadda Gothenburg ee dalka Sweden ahna bare Luuqadda Soomaaliga ah, ayaa sheegay in af-Soomaaliga loo baaro habka uu u dhisanyahay iyadoo loo maray nidaam lagu eegyo qoraalkiisa iyo sida erayadu ay isku raacayaan. Wuxuu tusaale u soo qaatay Faysal, kalmadda waa "Lala socday". Waxaa uu yiri: Labo la' baa ku jirta naxwo ahaan markii la fiiriyo. La'da mid waa magac u yaal oo waa qofkii wax la socday, midna waa horyaalle, waxay dhisaysaa oraahda,". Ujeedka arrintaan Jaamacaddu ka leedahay ayaa Faysal ku sheegay in howshaan ay tahay mid aan hadda bilaaban oo muddo soo soctay, isla markaana afaf badan oo Afrika ah lagu sameeyo si wax looga ogaado taariikhdooda dhabta ah ee dhinacyada qoraalka, dhaqanka iyo dhismahaba. Sawirka, Faysal Maxamed Muxumed Waxaan shaki ku jirin in tani ay kugu noqonayso layaab, balse ma ahan in Macallimiintu ay qofka Soomaaliga ah barayaan afka ku hadalkiisa, waxay barayaan oo fahamsiinayaan cilmiyan sida uu u dhisanyahay is-raaca erayada iyo marxaladihii uu soo maray Afka Soomaaligu, oo ay ku sameeyeen baaritaanno lagu aruurinayo arrimahaas oo dhan. "Way yar adagtahay in qofku uu fahmo in la dhaho qof ajanabi ah ayaa qof Soomaali ah baraya luuqaddii Soomaaliga, laakiin qofkaan wuxuu ku barayaa qaab-naxweedkii iyo qaabka uu afku u dhisanyahay," ayuu yiri aqoonyahay Faysal Maxamed Muxumed. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. BBC-da ayaa Faysal waydiisay ma qof ajanabi ah ayaa Soomaalida baraya luuqadoodii, waxaana uu ku jawaabay, "haa Macallinka ajanabiga ah ee Swedish-ka ah ayaa baraya,". Faysal isaga ayaa ka mid ah dadka Soomaalida ah ee ajaanibtu Af-Soomaaliga u baraan qaabka cilmiyeysan ee dhuux-taabadka ah. Waxaana u intaa raaciyay in Macallimiintaasi ay xitaa saxeen qoraallo ka soo baxay xaruumo dowladeed oo ay ka saxeen erayo waxna lagu daray waxna laga tagay. "Waxaana jirta qoraallo badan oo macallin Swedish ah uu saxay oo ka soo baxay dowladda dhexe ee Soomaaliya iyo qaar ka tirsan maamul goboleedyada oo qaladaad badan ku jiro warqadihiina waan hayaa," ayuu yiri Faysal. BBC-da ayaa Faysal mar kale waydiisay sida arrintaas ay suurta gal ku tahay, wuxuuna ku jawaabay: In aan afka ku hadlo kama dhigna in aan afka aqaanno, afka in qaab cilmiyeysan oo seynis ah loo baaro iyo in aan afka ku hadlo labo ayay kala yihiin,". "Dadka Soomaalida ah badankood afka way ku hadlaan, laakiin kan kale waa mid Iskuul gooni ah loo aado oo la barto," ayuu raaciyay. Waxaa intaa dheer in Jaamacaddu hayso qoraal Af-Soomaali ah oo muddo fog ka hor la qoray kaas oo tilmaamaya in afka Soomaaligu uu fac weynyahay, waxaana qoraalladaas oo ay sidoo kale hayaan qaar ka mid ah aqoonyahannada Soomaaliyeed qayb ka qaatay qoraalkooda sida xoguhu tilmaamayaan dad ajaanib ah. Khuburada afafka ayaa qaba in afaf badan oo ay ku hadlaan dalal dunida ka tirsan ay u hormari la'yihiin. Waxaa qaarkood ay ku sheegeen "in maskixiyan loo qaraareeyay dhadhanka iyo muhiimadda ay leeyihiin in cilmiyan loo barto loona horumariyo afafka. Arrintaas dadka qaar ayaa u tiirinaya gumeystayaashii si gaar ah dalalka Afrika oo intooda badan luuqado kale ku lamaaniyay afafkooda. "Caqabadda kobac la'aanta waa mid haysata dalalkii la gumeystay oo dhan, gaarahaan Afrika, waxaana weeye caqabadda ugu weyn in loo qaabeeyay, si afkiisa loogu tiirsanaado," ayuu yiri Faysal.

Ruqiyo Bulle: Gabadha Soomaalida ah ee ku guuleysatay abaalmarinta sare ee BBC-dau bixiso Ruqiyo Bulle oo ah gabar Soomaali Kenya wariye ah ayaa ku guulaysatay abaalmarinta BBC-da ee la yiraahdo Komla Dumor Award, ee sanadka -ta. Gabadhan oo sano jir ah una shaqaysa warbaahinta Nation Media Group, ayaa soo bandhigta sheekooyin xiiso leh ayaa noqotay qofkii sagaal oo ku guulaysta abaalmarintan. Ruqiyo, ayaa sidoo kale saamayn weyn barta TikTok oo ay dad badan ku xiran yhiin ayna ku soo bandhigot mawaadiic la xiira nolosha saxafiga. Abaalmarinta ayaa loogu magac daray oo loo hibeeyey Dumor, wariyihi iyo tabiyihii BBC-da ee reer Ghana kaas oo si kadis ah u geeriyooday sanadkii -kii isagoo sano jir ah. Wuxuu shaqo adag galiyey inuu soo gudbiyo sheekooyin xiiso leh oo ku saabsab Afrika oo adduunka u soo bandhigo isagoo u tabiyey si kalsooni leh xeeldheer iyo dhanka ganacasi. Garsoorayaasha waxay aad ula dhaceen adkaysiga iyo kartida ay u leedahay Ruqiyo maaraynta sheekooyina caqabado lahaa, iyadoo diiradda saaraysa inay matasho kuwa an codka lahayn sida awooda leh iyo tabinteeda heerka sare ah. “Ku guuleysiga abaal-marintan waxay ii tahay macno weyn aniga. Suxufi ahaan, waxaad had iyo jeer ku dedaalaysaa inaad samayso waxa ugu fiican, iyadoon loo eegayn aqoonsigaaga, sidaa darteed in lagugu aqoonsado masraxa caalamiga ah ee Abaalmarinta Komla Dumor Award si cajiib ah ayay u ansaxaysaa,” ayey tiri Ruqiyo Buulle oo sannadkii hore ka soo muuqday liiska ka qof ee ugu saamaynta badan Muslimiinta Kenya. "Waxaan rajeynayaa in abaal-marintan ay dhiirigeliso gabdhaha da'da yar ee aniga oo kale ah, kuwaas oo xirta xijaabka kana soo jeeda beela laga tirada badan yahay, inay ku riyoodaan wax weyn oo ay gaaraan hadafkooda."intaas raacisay Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Waxay intaa ku dartay iyadoo la hadlaysay BBC-da Ruqiyo inay toddobaadyo sugaysay helid jawaabtan farxada leh in loo sheego inay ku guulaysatay abaalmarintan. Waxay intaa ku dartay inay jeclayd saxaafada ayna xooga saarto samaynta sheekooyinka ku saabasan in cod u noqoto dadka an la maqlin oo ay bannaanka u soo saarto. Wariyahan Kenyanka aha ayaa waqti saddex bilood ah la shaqayn doonta qaybta wararka ee BBC-da sida Telefishinka, Raadyaha iyo Onlinke xarunta London. Waxay sidoo kale heli doontaa tababar iyadoo la shaqayn doonta wariya Waxa ay sidoo kale heli doontaa tababaro waxaa kale hagi doona wariyaasha sare sare BBC-da Tarik Kafala, oo ah ku-simaha agaasimaha BBC World Service, ayaa sheegay inuu aad ugu faraxsan yahay in abaalmarinta Komla Dumor ay kobcisay xirfadda suxufiyiin badan oo qaaradda ah. “Dadkii hore ee abaal-marintan helay waxa ay wax weyn ku soo kordhiyeen saxaafadda adeegga bulshada sidaa darteed aad ayaan ugu faraxsanahay in aan soo dhawayno Ruqiya Bulle oo ku guulaysatay sannadkan,” ayuu yiri Qorshayaasha kale waxaa ka mida in Ruqiyo, u safri doonto dal ku yaalla Qaarada si ay tabiso sheekooyin kuwaas oo loo baahin doono dhagaystayaasha BBC-da ee Caalamka. Guulaystayaashii hore ee biladan horrey u helay waxaa ka mida wariyaasha kala ah Paa Kwesi Asare, Dingindaba Jonah Buyoya, Victoria Rubadiri, Solomon Serwanjja, Waihiga Mwaura, Amina Yuguda, Didi Akinyelure iyo Nancy Kacungira. Abaalmarinta Komla Dumor waa abaal-marin saxaafadeed oo ay BBC-du billowday sannadkii -kii iyadoo lagu sharfayo dhaxalka uu ka tagay saxafiga reer Ghana ee Komla Dumor oo u soo shaqeeyay BBC World News, ahaana daadihiyaha ugu weyn ee barnaamijkeeda Focus on Africa. Komla, waxa uu si hagar la'aan ah uga shaqeeyay in uu dunida u soo bandhigo sheekooyin aad u xiiso badan oo ku saabsan Afrika. Abaalmarintani loogu magac daray Komla Dumor, ayaa weriyeyaasha da’ yarta ah ee qaaradda Afrika siina fursad ay ku helaan xirfad muhiim ah, iyo waaya aragnimo muddo saddex bilood ah oo London ay BBC-du ku siin doono fursad tababar goobta shaqada ah. Biladan waxaa helay wariyaal ku nool qaarada kuwaas oo sidoo kale BBC-da la sameeyeyey sheekooyin xiisa lahaa oo ay ka sameeyeen qaarada.

Maxay tahay sababta la isugu khilaafay"dawada kordhisa dareenka dumarka" Dumarka Mareykanka ayaa hadda loo diyaariyay qaabka kordhinta rabitaanka ka dib markii loo sameeyay "dawo sare u qaadeysa dareenkooda". Warkan ka soo baxay Maamulka Cuntada iyo Dawada Mareykanka (FDA), oo ah guddiga ugu sareeya arrimaha caafimaadka bulshada, ayaa ansixiyay Vyleesi. Markii hore waxaa loo arkayay guul laga gaaray dhanka xoojinta dareenka dumarka oo caafimaad leh. Balse Isbuucyo ka dib, waxaa soo baxaya dood adag oo la xiriirta xaaladda dawada marka uu dareenka aad u bato ayna adkaato inuu caadi kusoo noqdo qofka. Dawada waxaa loo yaqaanaa bremelanotide, waxayna ku asteysan tahay magaca ah Vyleesi marka la iibsanayo. Waxaa si isku mid ah u isticmaali kara gabdhaha iyo haweenka da'da ah - kuwaas oo aan lagu arkin astaamaha muujinya in caadada ay ku dhici rabto ama ay ku dhacday - iyo kuwa ay dhibaatada ka haysato dhanka rabitaanka galmada ee loo yaqaano (HSDD). Dhaqaatiirta waxay arrintan ku qeexeen in qof dumar ah ay si joogto ah u diido la seexashada ninkeeda. Waxaa lagu qiyaasaa in boqolkiiba illaa ee dumarka weli ku jira da'da dhalmada in ay dhibaato noocaas ah haysato. Waa markii labaad oo dhaqaatiirtu isku deyaan in ay soo saaraan "Viagra dumarka isticmaali karaan". Khilaaf iyo muran ayaana ka dhashay in FDA ay aqbasho dawadaas iyadoo dhaqaatiirta qaar ay shaki ka muujiyeen waxtarkeeda. Waxay sheegeen in halis caafimaad ay la kulmayaan dumarka isticmaala dawada? Haddaba, bremelanotide maxay soo kordhisaa? Maxayna yihiin dhibaatooyiinka caafimaad ee ka dhalan kara? Vyleesi - Waxaa la sameeyay iyadoo la adeegsanayo teknolojiyadda Palatin, waxaana la fasaxay in dawo ahaan loo adeegsado - Waxay ka sameysan tahay cirbad uu qofka isku duri karo. Ujeedada waxay tahay in dumarka laga yareeyo xanaaqa badan, ayna yeeshaan dareen raaxo. Waxay xakameyneysaa heerarka waxyaabaha maskaxda ka soo baxa sida: Joogteynta qalbi rabitaan leh iyo ka saaridda waxyaabaha keena xanaaqa. Dawadan waxay la tartameysaa Addyi - waa mid horey loo soo saaray oo ah kaniin la qaato maalin kasta taas oo ay ansixisay FDA, sannadkii 2015kii. Go'aankaas xitaa wuxuu dhaliyay muran iyadoo khubarada ay sheegeen in Addyi aysan "lahayn waxtar" ayna halis ka dhalan karto. Sida lagu xusay cilmi-baaris la sameeyay -kii, dhibatada HSDD waxa la kulma mid ka mid ah 10kii dumar ee Mareykanka ku nool, badankoodana weligood ma aysan raadsan dawo. "Kuwa badan oo ka mid ah dumarkaas waxay la aamuseen dhibaatada haysata, taas micneheedu wuxuu yahay in dawadan aysan suuq haysan," sida uu sheegay William Heiden, Agaasimada Fulinta ee Amag Pharmaceuticals. Balse khubarada warshadeynta waxay qiyaasayaan in dhaqaalaha ka soo xarooda Vyleesi sannadkii uu gaari doono $ Bilyan oo dollar. Amag Pharmaceuticals waxay sheegeen in saameynta ka dhalata dawan, ee la ogaaday xilligii tijaabada, ay ka mid tahay lalabo qabatay boqolkiiba % dumarkii isticmalay. Waxaa kaloo ka mid ah dareen aan dhammaan iyo madax-xanuun. FDA waxay dawada cusub ku amaantay "in dumarka ay u tahay bedelka dawo kale" oo la xiriirta HSDD. "Waxaa jiro dumar, oo aan la ogeyn sababta ay u yaraatay rabitaankooda galmo, taas oo sababi karta walbahaar," ayey tiri FDA. Balse waxay qirtay in aysan kala cadeyn in Vyleesi ay ku shaqeyneyso maskaxda si ay u kordhiso rabitaanka iyo hakinta walwalka. Qaar ka mid ah ururada u dooda caafimaadka dumarka waxay sheegayaan in FDA aysan u baahan baaritaan dheeraad ah oo la xiriira saameynta caafimaadka muddada fog ee Vyleesi. "Warka wanaagsan wuxuu yahay in (Vyleesi) aan loo baahneyn in la isticmaalo maalin kasta sida Addyi," sida ay Diana Zuckerman, madaxweynaha xarunta baaritaanka cafimaad, u sheegtay Washington Post. "Warka xunna wuxuu yahay in bulshada aysan ku kalsooneyn dawada sababtoo ah ma ogin dhibaatada caafimaad ee ka dhalan karta mustaqbalka," Ayey hadalka ku dartay Zuckerman. Tijaabada caafimaad ee Vyleesi waxay socotay isbuuc, waxaana ka qeybgalay , oo ah dumar ay dhibaato ka haysatay rabitaan nin. Bukaanada ugu badan waxay dawada isticmaaleen laba illaa seddax jeer bishii, mana aysan ka badsan hal mar isbuucii.

Adigoo qashin xaaqa haddaad lacag badan hesho weli qashin-xaaqid ma wadi lahayd? , ARUN CHANDRABOSE Bishii Juun ee la soo dhaafay, haween oo ah shaqaale nadiifiya dhulka oo deggan gobolka Kerala ee koonfurta Hindiya ayaa bilaabay inay aruuriyaan lacag ay ku iibsadaan tigidh bakhtiyaa nasiib ah. Hase yeeshee nasiib wanaag toddobaadkii hore ayay farxadda weyn la soo deristay kadib markii ay ogaadeen inay ku guuleysteen bakhtiyaa nasiibka oo dhan milyan oo Rupees, oo u dhiganta . milyan oo doolarka Mareykanka ah. Inkasta oo ay noloshooda is badashay haddana maalintii xigtay ayaa waxaa la arkay iyagoo sidii caadiga ahayd shaqadoodii nadaafadda u sii wata. Haweenkan ayaa qayb ka ah koox uruurisa qashinka laga soo daadiyo guryaha magaalada Parabanangadi ee degmada Malappuram ee gobolka Kerala. Caadi ahaan waxa ay maalintii ka helaan shaqada qashin uruurinta ilaa rubi taas oo ay ka bixiyaan qaraashaadka qoysaskooda ay ku biilaan, mararka qaarkoodna qayb ka mid ah lacagtaas waxay ka helaan iibinta qashinka ay dib u habeynta ku sameeyaan shirkadaha maxaliga ah. Haweenkan ayaa ka sheekeynaya xaaladdooda dhaqaale ee adag, iyo in dhaqaalaha ay helaan uusan ku filneyn inuu daboolo kharashaadka ay u baahan yihiin. Inta badan haweenkan ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in ay lacago amaahdaan si ay ugu suurta gasho in ay caruurtooda waxbarshada uga bixiyaan oo sidoo kalana ay ku daboolaan baahiyahooda kale. Bakhtiyaa-nasiibka sharci-darro ayuu ka yahay gobollo badan oo Hindiya ku yaalla, laakiin dowladda gobolka Kerala lafteedu waxay waddaa barnaamij bakhtiyaa nasiib ah oo aad loo jecel yahay, bakhtiyaa-nasiibka ay maamulaan shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay waa ka mamnuuc gobolka. Sawirka, ARUN CHANDRABOSE Bishii hore, kooxdu waxay go'aansatay inay iibsadaan tigidh Rupees ah kaas oo loogu talagalay bakhtiyaa nasiibka weyn ee la yirahdo Monsoon. Abaalmarinadan waaweyn ama faa'iidada badan waxaa lagu bixiyaa munaasabado gaar ah sida ciidaha. Kotimalu, oo jir ah, ayaa sheegtay inay aad uga murugootay markii saaxiibadeed, Radha, ay billowday inay lacag u ururiso tigidada, sababtoo ah ma haysan lacag ku filan oo ay ku bixiso qaybteeda qiimaha tigidhada bakhtiyaa nasiibka. Chiromanil Baby (xubin kale oo kooxda ka tirsan) ayaa BBC-da u sheegtay inay haysatay rupees, ayna iyadoo rabta inay bixiso lacagta ay Kutimulu ka codsatay inay qaar amaahiso lacagta sidaa darteed Chiromanil iyo Kutimalu wuxuu qofkiiba bixiyey . Rupee si aysan uga harin saaxibadood oo ay u iibsadaan tikidka bakhtiyaa nasiibka halka sagaal kale uu qofkiiba bixiyay rupees. Sawirka, ARUN CHANDRABOSE Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. "Waxaan ku heshiinay inaan heli doono saami siman haddii aan wax ku guuleysano...laakin dhab ahaantii ma aanan fileyn inaan ku guuleysaneyno lacag aad u badan!" ayay yiri Kotimalo. Haweenka ayaa ogaaday in ay ku guuleysteen bakhtiya nasiibka maalin kadib markii mid ka mid ah ay ninkeeda ka codsatay inuu hubiyo natiijada. Radha ayaa tiri, "Tani waa markii afaraad oo aan iibsano tigid bakhtiya nasiib ah gaar ahaan kan lacagta badan lagu helo laakiin markaan afaraad ayuu nasiibka ina caawiyay!" Shiromanil Bibi, oo jir ah, ayaa sheegtay in ay ku adag tahay in ay rumaysato in kooxdu ay ku guuleysatay bakhtiyaa-nasiibka. "Hore nasiibkan uma helin," ayay raacisay. Gurigeeda waxaa qaaday daadad ba'an oo ku dhuftay Kerala . Waxay hadda qorsheyneysaa inay dhisato guri cusub sidoo kalana ay iska bixiso deymaha lagu leeyahay. Dumarka kale ee kooxda ku jira waxay leeyihiin qisooyin la mid ah kuwa Chiromaniel. Ki Bindu, oo jir ah, ayaa ninkeeda ku weyday kal hore xanuun dhanka kelyaha ah. Qoyska ayaa awoodi waayey inay iibsadaan kelyo lagu badbaadiyo. "Ninkaygu wuxuu tigidada bakhtiyaa-nasiibka ku iibsan jiray lacagtii uu ku bixin lahaa sifeynta kelyihiisa. Wuxuu nooga tagay dhismo aan dhammaanayn, kaas oo ay burburiyeen daadadku, hadda waa inaan dhammeeyaa dhismihiisa," ayay tiri Ki Bindu. Ki Bindu waxa ay doonaysaa in lacagta ay saami ahaan u hesho ay sidoo kale ku bixiso waxbarashada gabadheeda -jirka ah, si ay mustaqbalka shaqo fiican u hesho.

Maxaad ka taqaan kaydka raadadkii qaddiimiga ahaa ee Soomaalida? Xarunta Dhaqanka ee Hargeysa, waa goob dhaqan oo qabata hawlo badan oo ay ka mid yihiin ururinta, meelaynta iyo kaydinta aasaartii qaddiimiga ahayd. Goobtaas waxa yaalla oo la isugu keenay kutub hore oo la qoray qarniyo hore, sidoo kale waxaa yaalla sawirro taariikhi ah oo ku mid yahay, Masjidu Qiblatayn oo Saylac ku yaal kana mid ah dhismayaasha qadiimiga ah ee Somaliland ku yaal. Mar ay BBC-du weydiisey Maxamed Axmed Dalmar oo ah oo dhaqan yaqaan, shiikh iyo suxufiba ah kuna sugnaa markii aannu booqannay goobtaasi, waxa masjidkaas magucu ugu baxay, waxa uu yidhi: 'Horta kolley taariikhdaasi baadhis badan bay u baahan tahay, waxay se tilmaamaysaa taariiikhda islaamka wakhtigii aan jasiirad carab aan la soo dhaafin, Nebigu NNKH intii aan la hijroon ee uu Maka joogay, marka uu tukanayo waxay qibladiisu ahayd Quddus oo looma tukan jirin Maka. Markaa waxaa jira masjid ku yaalla Maddiina agagaarkeeda oo la yidhaahdo Qiblatayn, oo iyadoo lagu tukanyo oo loo jeedo Quddus ayay aayadi soo degtay oo xaggii Quddus oo waqooyi ahayd laga jeestay oo koonfur oo ay markaa Maki ka xigtay loo jeestay, sidaana Masjidkii labaqiblo lahaa loogu bixiyey, kan se ma hubo oo taariikh bay u baahan tahay. Waa suure in yadoo xaggaa loo tukado ay soo gaadhay in Maka ay sax tahay, iyo in ay tahay muujinta taariikhaas si loo xasuusnaado' Magaalada taariikhiga ah ee Taleex ayaa ka muuqata iyana goobaha sawirrada lagu kaydiyey, gaar ahaan taariikhdii Daraawiishta iyo halgankii Sayid Maxamed Cabdulle Xasan. 'Sida magaalada Taleex loo dhisi karo, iyadoo taariikhdeeda aan la baabbiinayn' ayay BBC-du weydiisay isla Dalmar waxa uuna ku jawaabay: 'Waxaa weeyaan haddii dib u dhis lagu sameeyo khibrad badan bay u baahan tahay, laakiin habka iyo caynka ay tahay anan laga duwanayn oo qaabka ay tahay la raacayo iyadoo aan la duminayn, illeen taariikhdii way isbeddelaysaaye waxay u baahan tahay dib usoo celin wax la yidhaahdo' xarunta dhaqanka ee Hargeysa, sida uu sheegay Siciid Jaamac Xuseen, waxaa la aasaasay xilli aan dhawayn iyadoo rabta oo isuxilqaantay qaybta iyada la gudboon ee ku saabsan afka, suugaanta iyo dhaqanka. Yoolkeeduna waa sidii ummaddu burburka gaadhay uga kabmi lahayd, ee loo soo noolayn lahaa 'soo jireenkii' waxayna soo uruurisaa wax kasta oo jiri jirey, iyadoo sidoo kale bandhigyo wacyigelin ah iyo kuwo dood isweydaarsi ah u qabata dhallinyarta magaalada Hargeysa.

Shirkadaha ka faala qaadaya shaqaalaha ayaa laga rabaa iyaga inay bixiyaan $ milyan oo doolar, ayna u sii dheer tahay khimado kale. Khidmadaha dheeraadka ee dowlada ayaa laga yaabaa in la qaado iyada oo ku xiran xaaladaha codsi kasta, ayaa lagu sheegay mareegta. Shakhsiyaadka ayaa sidoo kale laga doonayaa inay bixiyaan khidmad aan la soo celinayn oo $ , oo doolar ah kahor inta aan la eegin kiiska codsadaha. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Qorshaha Kaarka dahabka ayaa wajahaya dhaleecayn tan iyo markii la shaaciyay bishii Febraayo, iyada oo qaar kamid ah Dimuqraadiyiintu sheegayaan inuu si aan cadaalad ahayn u taageeri doono shakhsiyaadka hodonka ah. Markii uu horaysay oo Trump soo bandhigo qorshahan ayu uku tilmaamay in fiisooyinkan la mid yihiin kaararka cagaaran, kuwaas oo u oggolaanaya muhaajiriinta dakhliga kala duwan inay ku noolaadaan kana shaqaystaan Maraykanka si abadi ah. dadka haysta kaarka cagaaran ayaa dhalashada Maraykanka hela shano ka dib marka ay u qalmaan kaarkaasi. Maraykanku waxa uu sidoo kale hakiyay codsiyada socdaalka ee dadka ka imaanaya dal, oo intooda badan ku yaala Afrika iyo Bariga dhexe, kuwaasi oo wajahay mamnuucista safarka ee madaxweynaha. Go'aankan ayaa sababay cabsi ka dhex abuurmatay ardayda caalamiga ah ee Maraykanka iyo shirkadaha tiknaloojiyada. Maxey dowladda Jarmalka u go'aansatay inay sanad kasta tababarto imaam? , Wasaaradda arrimaha gudaha Jarmalka ayaa ku dhawaaqday in si tartiib tartiib ah loo joojin doono imaamyada looga soo diri jiray dalka Turkiga ee ka howlgalayay masaajidda dalkaas. Bayaan uu soo saaray ururka arrimaha diinta Islaamka ee Turkiga ayaa lagu yiri, “Waan ka warqabnaa baahida loo qabo isbeddelkan”. Qoraalka ay soo saartay wasaaradda arrimaha gudaha Jarmalka ayaa lagu sheegay in heshiiska imaamyada lagu tababarayo ay la galeen Wasaaradda Diinta iyo Awqaafta iyo ururka arrimaha diinta Islaamka ee Turkiga kadib wada xaajood dheer . Heshiisku wuxuu dhigayaa in imaam loo tababaro dalka Jarmalka sanad walba, imaamyadan oo lagu soo tababaray barnaamijka tababarka wadajirka ah ayaa loogu talagalay inay beddelaan imaamyadii laga soo diray Turkiga. Sidoo kale qoraalka ka soo baxay wasaaradda arrimaha gudaha ayaa lagu sheegay in la sameyn doono iskaashi ka dhaxeeya Kuliyadda Islaamiga ah ee Jarmalka oo la aas aasay -kii iyo Jaamacadda Osnabrück ee Turkiga . Iimaamyada ayaa marka ay tababarka dhammeystaan waxaa si tartiib tartiib ah ah ay u baddali doonaan kuwa dalka Turkiga. Ururka DİTİB, oo xaruntiisu tahay magaalada Cologne, ee dalka Jarmalka, waa mid ka mid ah ururrada Muslimiinta ee ugu waaweyn Jarmalka oo maamula ku dhowaad oo masaajid, oo ay ka howgalaan in ka badan imaam oo ka shaqeeya masaajiddan. Wasiirka arrimaha gudaha ee Jarmalka Nancy Feaser ayaa sheegtay in tababarrada imaamyada dalka Jarmalka ee baddalay kuwii laga keeni jiray Turkiga ay tahy “mid muhiim u ah is dhex galka” jaaliyadaha Muslimiinta ee Jarmalka. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Arrinta imaamyada Jarmalka looga soo diray Turkiga ayaa mararka qaar xiisad ka dhex dhalisay Berlin iyo Ankara, taasoo ay ugu wacan tahay dacaayad siyaasadeed iyo eedeymo basaasnimo oo labada dal ay isdhaafsadaan. Taasi waa in la dilo qof maalin kasta, sida ay warbixintu sheegtay, dhammaan qaybaha adduunkana ayay saamaysay. Sannadkii -kii, ilaa , oo haween iyo gabdho ah ayaa waxaa dilay qof aad u dhow ama xubno qoysaskooda ka tirsan, ayay tiri warbixintu. Dilalkan ayaa ka dhigan % dhammaan dilalka ula kaca ah ee haweenka iyo gabdhaha adduunka oo dhan loo geysto. Warbixinta - oo la sii daayay si loogu xuso maalinta caalamiga ah ee ciribtirka xadgudubyada ka dhanka ah haweenka, -ka November - ayaa iftiimisay xaqiiqo naxdin leh, Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay: in gurigu uu yahay meesha ugu badan ee lagu dilo haweenka. Dilalka guryaha ka dhaca oo afka qalaad lagu yiraahdo Femicides sidoo kale waxaa lagu sameeyaa meel ka baxsan guriga, laakiin cadadka xogta kuwaas ayaa weli xaddidan, ayay tiri. "Dilalka guryaha ka dhaca meel goonni ah kama dhacaan. Waxay inta badan ka billowdaan rabshado isdaba joog ah oo ka bilaaban kara xakamaynta dabeecadaha, hanjabaadaha iyo dhibaataynta oo ay ku jiraan internet-ka," Sarah Hendriks, oo ah agaasimaha qaybta siyaasadda haweenka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sidaa tiri. Dhanka kale, iyadoo lagu gudo jiro toddobaadka ka hortagga tacdiyada ku saleysan jinsiga, ayaa haddana waxaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ku soo badanayay Soomaaliya xad-gudubayada ka dhanka ah haweenka. Tacaddiyadii ugu dambeeyay ayaa ahaa, sida muuqata kuwo lagu beegsanayay gabdhaha yaryarka ah oo qaarkood aan qaan gaarin. Arrimahaan ayaa waxaa walaac ka muujiyay bulshada iyo hay'adaha u dooda xuquuqda aadanaha gaar ahaan kuwa dumarka taageera. Sida qoraal bakhtiyaa-nasiib ah ka dib uu ugu dhammaaday farxad waligeed ah . Donovan Shears, wuxuu fariin qoraala u diray number si bakhtiyaa-nasiib ah sanadkii -dii balse taasi waxay beddeshay noloshiisa. Wuxuu helay telephonkiisii ugu horreeyey markuu jiray da'ada siddeed iyo tobban jir markaas oo u ogaaday fariimo dirida. Wuxuu ku nasiib saday number wuxuuna u diray fariin isagoo leh "hello" taas oo xaaskiisii mustaqbalka Kirsty ay dib ugu soo qortay "hi" "Waqtigaas keli ah wuxuu horseeday in ka badan sano oo jacayl, qosol, iyo iskaashi ah," ayay tiri. Dhowr fariimood oo uu u diray numbaro aanu garayn, wuxuu ka dirayey isagoo jooga Coventry pub, halkaas oo uu ka shaqaynayey habeenkaas, Kirsty oo ku sugnayn Cleethorpes, ayaa ahayd qofka kaliya ee hal mar u soo jawaabtay. Afar sano ka dib, lamaanaha ayaa isku guursaday Scotland, halka ay ka soo jeedo Kirsty. Hadda waxay haystaan laba caruura oo da'doodu kala tahay lix iyo sagal sano jir. Kirsty, waxa ay sheegtay in ay uga jawaabtay fariinta Donovan iyada oo u malaynaysa in uu yahay qof ay garanaysay, balse nambarkiisa aanay ku kaydsan telefoonkeeda. Iyagoo la hadlayey BBC CWR, waxay soo xasuusteen sidii ay markii ugu horreysay ugu kulmeen xarunta tareenada ee magaalada Coventry iyo siday u markii ugu horreysay u yeesheen haasaawahoodii goob lagu caweeyo oo markaas caanka ahayd, Colosseum, oo hadda loo yaqaan The Kasbah. Donovan ayaa yiri "Waxaan bilaabay inay si bakhtiyaa-nasiib ah fariimo u diro. Anigoo tusaya saaxiibaday. "Waxaan soo qaaday afarta number oo ugu horreysa si la mid ah sidaydii ka dibna saddexda number ee ugu dembaysa sibakhtiyaa-nasiib ah. waxay ahayd ilaa shan ama lix number oo kala duwan, ka dibna kuma firkin wax kale," Kristy ayaa Iyana tiri "Waxaan fariimo isu diri jirnay maalinta oo dhan ka dibna waxay noqotay mid aad iyo aadu badan ka dibna waxaan go'aansanay in aan taleefoon isku dirno" "Waxaan isku diri jirnay fariimo si badan, telefoonkayga kharashkiisu wuxuu ka badnaa gani bishii. Waxay u malaynayaa intaasi ay ahay markii aan go'aansaday inaan is wacno"ayuu hadalkiisa sii raaciyey Donovan. "Dareenku wuxuu bilaabay inuu horumaro, waxayna lahayd lahjad Scottish ah oo aad u qurux badan, taasoo sidoo kale i soo jiidatay." Labada lamaane ayaa ugu dambeyntii kulmay ilaa lix bilood ka dib markii Donovan uu diray qoraalkii ugu horreeyay. "Waxaan ku iri gabar walaashey ah, waa inaan aado oo aan la kulmo ninkan, waxayna u egtahay, 'Wuxuu noqon karaa qof kasta', waxaanan ku iri, 'Haa, waan ogahay', laakiin waxaan ahaa runtii sano jiro an marnaba ka fekerin wax ku saabsan caawaaqibka," ayey tiri Kirsty. "Kaliya waxaan fuulay tareen oo waxaan imid Coventry." Donovan,wuxuu sheegay inuu ka cabsi qabay inuu talaabada koowaad qaado, laakiin Kirsty aad ayey ugu kalsooni badnayd. "Inta kale waa taariikh" ayuu yiri "Waxaan xasuustaa markii an ka soo laabtay habeenkeenii koowaad ee bannaanka, kaliya waa is laab galinay, waxay ahayd wax mujiso oo kale ah" "Waa haweeney cajiib ah, aad ayay u caqli badan tahay, si fiican ayaan isu naqaannaa, waa saaxiibkayga ugu fiican iyo sidoo kale xaaskayga." In ka badan sano laga bilaabo maalintoodii weynayd, labada qof ayaa ka qayb qaadan doona cusboonaysiinta nidarka ee Coventry Cathedral ee Maalinta Jacaylka, oo ay soo qabanqaabisay BBC CWR. Donovan, wuxuu sheegay inay rajeynayaan inay u dabaaldegaan maalintaas qoys ahaan. "Waxaan wilkeyga u soo qaaday Suud le'eg shalay, dhab ahaantiina wuuu jeclaaday,ka dibna gabadhayda, waxay leedahay, 'Waxaan rabaa inaan arko hooyaday oo labisan', ma sugi karto," ayuu raaciyay.

Maxay dadka Koonfur Afrika taageero u siin waayeen xisbiga u soo halgamay xorriyaddooda? Natiijada doorashada ee Koonfur Afrika ayaa lagu dhawaaqay, iyadoo Xisbigii uu mar hogaamin jirey Nelson Mandela ee ANC uu lumiyey aqlabiyaddii Baarlamaanka dalkaa oo uu ka helay kursi marka la eego tirada guud ee kuraasta loo tartamayey oo dhan oo kursi. Waa natiijadii doorasho ee ugu xumayd xisbiga ANC, tan iyo markii uu dhamaaday midab-takoorka muddo haatan sano laga joogo, inkastoo uu ilaa hadda haysto kuraasta ugu badan. Madaxweyne Cyril Ramaphosa ayaa inkastoo xisbigiisa ANC uu lumiyay aqlabiyadda baarlamaanka, haddana wuxuu natiijada ka soo baxaday doorashada ku tilmaamay mid guul u ah dimuqraadiyadda Koonfur Afrika. Natiijada doorashadan waxay soo afjartay sano oo ay hogaaminta siyaasada ee Koonfur afkika kali ku ahaayeen xisbiga ANC, codbixiyaasha Koonfur afrika oo wajahayey caqabado baahiyada asaasigaa ee nolosha a, koronta iyo biyaha ayaa jiha kale u leexiyey dalka qubac qarni ka badan.tani waa waa cusub oo u baryey koonfur afrika. Xisbiga ANC ayaana helay kursi oo ka mida oo uu ka kooban yahay barlamaanka dalkaasi iyagoo lumiyey aqlabiyada barlmaanka markii ugu horeysay tan iyo xiliigii midab takoorka ee Koonfur afrika. Natiijada ayaa ifisay in hoos u dhac weyn ku yimi taageeradii xisbiga ANC halka xisbiyo ugub ihi ay yesheen taageer badan iyo tiro xoogan oo barlamaanka ah. Gudiga madaxa banaan doorashada waxay natiijada ku tilmaamneed in doorashada sanadkan ay ahayd mid an hore loo arag. Madaxweyne Cyril Ramaphosa ayaa ku tilmaamay natiijada doorashada Koonfur Afrika mid guul u ah dimuqraadiyadda, inkastoo xisbigiisu markii ugu horreysay lumiyay aqlabiyadda. “Waxaan u xaqiijinayaa dadka reer Koonfur Afrika in aan farriintooda maqalnay, islamarkaana aan dareennay, walwalkooa iyo walaacooda. Lixdii sane e la dhaafay, ANC waxay ku hawlaneyd dib u habeyn.” Geeddi-socodkasina weli ma dhammaan, natiijada doorashaduna wuxuu na tusaysaa baahida loo qabo in aan hawshaas dardargelino.” Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. “Dadkeennu waxay ka filayaan xisbiyada oo dhan in ay u wada shaqeeyaan si waafaqsan dastuurka, islamarkaana wixii jira lagu xalliyo si nabadoon oo ku saleysan dastuurka iyo sharciga. Xisbiga MK ayaa sheegay in kaliya ay la shaqeyn doonaan isbaheysiga ANC haddii madaxweyne Cyril Ramaphosa uu xilka ka dago. Xoghayaha Guud ee ANC, Fikile Mbalula, ayaa sheegay in dalabkan uu yahay mid aan su'aal leh . Isagoo ka hadlayay shir jaraa’id, Mr Mbalula ayaa sheegay in xisbigu ay tahay inuu dib u eego istiraatijiyaddiisa ka dib natiijada doorashada. Iyadoo ANC ay ku guuleysatay inta badan cododkii la bixiyey, haddana natiijadu waxay muujineysaa hoos ku dhac ku yimid taagfeerada xisbiga marka laga shidaal qaato doorashooyinkii hore. Waxaa jira arrimo badan oo loo aaneynayo hoos u dhaca ku yimid taageerada xisbiga, ku was oo farriin cad u diraya ANC. Haddaba maxay guuldarradan soo foodsaartay uga dhigan tahay xisbiga ANC muxuuse u baahan yahay si uu u sii hayo caynaanka dalka? “Sababta koowaad ayay dadka qaar ee reer Koonfur Afrika waxay leeyihiin dhaqaalaha waddankeena waxaa gacanta ku dhigay ajaanib oo xisbiga ANC wuxuu oggolaaday inay dad badan yimaadaan, qodobka labaad ayaa ah dhulka taas oo la xiriirta dib u soo celinta dhulkii caddaanka la wareegeen xilligii gumeysiga marka dadka madowga waxay rabeen in haddii caddaankaasi ay diyaar u yihiin inay dowladda ka iibsato dhulka, tan saddexaad ayaa ah in dhaqaalihii yaraa ee ay dowladda ANC hoggaamiso gacanta u haysay ay ku tagri-faleen rag ka mid xisbiga taas oo ay dadku sheegeen in dhibaatadii dhaqaalaha uga sii dartay”, ayuu Cabdiqaadir Axmed Siciid oo muddo dheer daganaa dalkaasi ku yiri wereysi uu siiyay BBC-da.

Maxaad ka taqaannaa cuntooyinka ay khubarada caafimaadka ku talinayan inaan si joogta loo isticmaalin? , Abdurahman Haji Adow Khubarada takhasuskoodu yahay cuntooyinka waxay sheegayaan noocyada kala duwan ee cuntooyinka oo aan isticmaalno iney isugu jiraan kuwa waxtar aad u weyn noo leh iyo kuwa waxyeello dhanka caafimaadka noo keeni kara. Waxaana inta badan sameynta caafimaad ee cuntooyinkaasi u geystaan jirkeenna ay ku xiran tahay habka aan u bisleyno, xaddiga aan cuntadaasi ka qaadanno, xilliga aan isticmaalno iyo waxyaabaha kale ee cuntooyinkaasi marka la sameynayo lagu daro. Waxaana marag ma doonta ah sida ay khubaradu sheegayaan iney jiraan cuntooyin badan oo khatar caafimaad oo aad u weyn aan ka dhaxli karo oo dadkuna iyaga oo aan ogeen ay si joogta ah u isticmalaan.
