Haweenka si joogto ah ayaa loogu tilmaamaa erayo sida "shisheeye xun", iyo "dumar foolxun". Waxaan ku guuleysanay inaan raadraacno mid ka mid ah kaamiradaha qarsoon ee ku yaalay qol hudheel oo ku yaal Zhengzhou, bartamaha Shiinaha, annagoo isku keenay tilmaamo kala duwan oo ka yimid macaamiisha, isticmaaleyaasha baraha bulshada, iyo cilmi-baaristeena. Cilmi-baarayaal ku sugan goobta ayaa awooday inay galaan qolka, waxayna heleen kaamirada — muraayaddeedu u jeedday sariirta — oo ku qarsoon unugga hawo-mareenka ee derbiga, isla markaana ku xiran korontada dhismaha. Qalab lagu ogaado kaamiradaha qarsoon, oo si weyn online looga iibiyo iyadoo lagu tilmaamo "inuu yahay shay lagama maarmaan u ah martida hudheelka," ma aysan siin wax digniin ah in lagu duubayo. Kooxdu waxay damisay kaamiradii qarsoodiga ahayd, eraygana si dhakhso ah ayaa looga faafiyay Telegram. "Zhonghua [magaca kaamirada] waa la joojiyay!" ayuu qoraal ku qoray mid ka mid ah xubnaha kanaalka weyn ee AKA maamulayo. "Waa wax laga xumaado; qolkaa wuxuu lahaa tayada codka ugu fiican!" ayaa AKA kaga jawaabay chat-ka. Laakiin cabashooyinkii waxay isu beddeleen dabaaldeg markii, saacado gudahood, AKA uu soo geliyay in kaamirada beddelka ah ee hudheel kale la hawlgaliyay. "Tani waa xawaaraha… [barnaamijkeena baahinta tooska ah]," ayaa AKA ugu sheegay macaamiishiisa. "Waa wax lala yaabo, sax?" Intii lagu guda jiray baaritaankeenna ‑bilood ah, waxaan aqoonsannay ku dhawaad toban wakiil oo la mid ah AKA. Isdhaafsiga ay la lahaayeen macaamiisha ayaa si cad u muujinayay in ay u shaqeynayeen kuwo kale oo ka sarreeya silsiladda , kuwaas oo ay ugu yeeri jireen "mulkiilayaasha kaamirada." Sida faallooyinka wakiilada ay muujinayeen, dadkaas ayaa diyaariya rakibidda kaamiradaha qarsoon iyo maareynta barnaamijyada baahinta tooska ah. Intii aan si toos ah ula sheekaysannay AKA, si khalad ah ayuu noo soo wadaagay sawirka shaashadda fariin uu ka helay qof uu sheegay inuu yahay "mulkiile kaamirada," oo leh magaca profile-ka "Brother Chun." AKA si dhakhso ah ayuu fariinta u tirtiray, wuxuuna diiday inuu ka hadlo, laakiin waxaan awooday inaan si toos ah ula xiriirno "Brother Chun." In kasta oo caddeynteenna ay muujinayso inuu uu siiyay AKA website-ka baahinta tooska ah, Brother Chun wuxuu ku dooday inuu ahaa wakiil kale oo iibka, inkastoo uu u muuqday inuu qirayo in silsiladda ay ka ballaaran tahay dadka la midka ah isaga. Waxaa cad in lacag fara badan lagu kasban karo. Iyada oo lagu saleynayo xubinnimada kanaalka iyo lacagaha macaamiisha, BBC waxay qiyaastay in AKA kaligiis uu helay ugu yaraan , Yuan oo u dhiganta $ , , tan iyo bishii april ee la soo dhaafay. Dakhliga sannadlaha celceliska ah ee Shiinaha sanadkii hore wuxuu ahaa , Yuan ($ , , £ , ), sida laga soo xigtay Xafiiska Tirakoobka ee Shiinaha. Eric iyo Emily weli way la niyad jabsan yihiin wixii dhacay. Mar walba waxay xirtaan koofiyado markay dadweynaha dhex oogaan si aan loo aqoonsan, waxayna isku dayaan inay ka fogaadaan hudheelada. Eric wuxuu sheegay inuusan hadda u adeegsan kanaalada Telegram si uu u daawado filimada qaawan, laakiin weli mararka qaar wuu hubiyaa — isagoo ka baqaya in muuqaalka dib u soo muuqdo.

Maxaa u roon dhabar xanuunka?: Sida ay soo jeedisay Hay’adda Caafimaadka Aduunka ee WHO Dhabar-xanuunka, gaar ahaan xanuunka qaybta hoose ee dhabarka, waa mid ka mid ah dhibaatooyinka caafimaad ee la yaabka leh sababtuna waxay tahay tirada badan ee dadka qaba xanuunkan iyo sida aadka ah ee uu u saameeyo nolol maalmeedkeenna. Haddi aysan weli ku qabsan dhibaatada dhabar xanuunku, waxa suurtogal ah in aad la kulmi doonto maalin uun. Si aad fikrad ugasii haysato, Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) wuxuu xaqiijiyey in xanuunka dhabarka qaybtiisa hoose uu yahay sababta ugu weyn ee curyaamisa isla markaana shaqada joogtada ah iyo nashaadyada firaaqada ee dadka aduunka. Sannadkii , ku dhawaad 13kii qofba mid ka mid ah oo qiyaastii ah (in ka badan milyan oo qof) guud ahaanb caalamka ayaa la kulmay dhibaatadan ugu yaraan hal mar, taasoo ka dhigan koror % ah marka loo eego 1990kii. Ururku wuxuu tilmaamay in dhibaatadan caafimaad ay saameyn iyo kharash badan ku leedahay qofka iyo guud ahaan bulshada , sidaas darteedna la bilaabay December tilmaanta ugu horreysa ee lagu hagayo daaweynta xanuunka dhabarka hoose ee daba-dheeraada (marka xanuunku uu socdo in ka badan saddex bilood oo xiriir ah). Dukumeentiga waxaa saxiixay dhowr khabiir oo ka kala socda adduunka, kuwaas oo qiimeeyay caddaymaha sayniska ee la heli karo si loo go'aamiyo waxa dhabta ah ee u roon- iyo waxa ka soo horjeeda - marka la daaweynayo dhibaatadan. Marka la eego dhaqamada ay khubaradu ku taliyaan, waxa ay isugu jiraan daryeel guud iyo mid joogto ah, sida barnaamijyada waxbarashada, kulamo lala yeesho dhaqaatiirta cilmi-nafsiga iyo jimicsi, daawaynta gaarka ah si loo gaaro daryeel degdeg ah, sida dawooyinka fudud ee ka hortagga bararka iyo in qofka loo daliigo dhabarka. Marka loo eego tilmaamaha WHO, daawaynta xanuunka dhabarka hoose ee loo hayo caddeyn wanaagsan oo lagu kalsoonaan karo oo ay faa’iidooyinku ka weynyihiin dhibaatada waa: Tilmaamaha WHO ayaa sidoo kale sheegaysa daawaynta aycilmi-baarayaashu u arkaan kuwo aan fiicneyn, kuwaas oo ah kuwo aa loogu tala galin xanuunka dhabarka hoose ee guud ahaan, sababtoo ah khatarta ayaa ka weyn faa'iidooyinka: Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Liiska WHO waxa kale oo uu iftiimiyay noocyada daawaynta kuwaas oo aanay jirin cadaymo cilmiyeed oo ku filan si loo ogaado in ay shaqeeyaan iyo in kale. Sida laga soo xigtay qorayaasha dukumeentigu, waa lagama maarmaan in la sugo cilmi-baaris cusub si loo ogaado wax badan oo ku saabsan fursadahan ka hor inta aan lagu darin liiska daaweynta. Liiskaan waxaa ka mid ah: Daaweynta dabeecadda falcelinta (nooc teraabiyada cilminafsiga ah) Daaweynta garaadka (nooc teraabiyada cilminafsiga) Dhaqannada dhimista welwelka iyo walbahaarka Daawooyinka nooca Benzodiazepine Daryeelka ku saleysan xashiishadda Nooca daryeelka jirka la mariyo ee ku salaysan arnica ( Solidago chilensis ) Sinjibiisha (Zingiber officinale)/Daawo dhireed daliigista jirka ee ku salaysan ubaxa cad ( Lilium candidum ) Xakamaynta miisaanka jidhka iyada oo loo marayo waxqabadyo aan dawooyin ahayn Tilmaamaha, waxaa kaliya lagu tilmaamay wax aan dhibaato lahayn hal nooc oo kaliya, kaas oo ah isticmaalka qalabka caawiya dhaqdhaqaaqa dadka qaba xanuunka dhabarka.

Guidance: User Generated and Social Media Content User generated content has become an essential part of BBC storytelling across the entire output. It plays a central role in most breaking news stories, but it is equally important in many other non-News output – including Children's. It can be still pictures, video or comment; it can be sent directly by users following specific calls to action or be found by searching for it on social media platforms and the wider web. Whatever content the BBC uses, regardless of how it is received, must adhere to the BBC Editorial Guidelines and standards. Content being widely shared or trending on social media may not necessarily make it appropriate for use; its editorial justification and purpose should be considered first. It should not be assumed that any user generated content – whether found on the web or received directly from the audience – is always what it claims to be. It may be fake, it may be genuine footage but of a different incident, it may be just part of the incident or taken from one perspective. In News, in particular, where UGC can play an important part in our output, the BBC must always authenticate any content before it is used. This might include anything from speaking to the individual who filmed the content to using a range of more sophisticated techniques such as geo-location and cross-referencing satellite imagery to interrogate the image itself. The more significant the image is, the more important it is to ensure it is authentic – although the responsibility for due accuracy remains regardless. Advice on verifying any UGC can be obtained from the UGC Hub. In a non-News environment, content producers might ask audience members to send in videos of themselves undertaking particular activities, or they might source similar content from the social web. Producers still have a responsibility to ensure the accuracy of that content before using it, but that might be ascertained in a simple conversation. Audiences should be provided with the relevant information to understand the events within their context, beyond the selective and narrow perspective which UGC may particularly offer. This may include details about the circumstances leading to the incident and its consequences. Nonetheless, BBC content producers should be open and honest about what they do not know or cannot corroborate. The Editorial Guidelines state: Care must be taken with content that may have been supplied by anyone with a vested interest, rather than a disinterested bystander. ( . . ) On highly controversial subjects, some views may be more likely than others to be expressed via UGC or be amplified on social media platforms. The existence of other views and their respective weights should be acknowledged and appropriately reflected. Where content producers ask audiences on social media to share their views or observations, they should be aware of the serendipitous nature of social media that means people may only come across the calls to action by chance. Where content producers are considering using significant content found on social media – such as video of a breaking news event – they should always seek to secure the consent of the owner of the material, even if a Fair Dealing use might be argued. The BBC would not normally pay for the use of such material, other than in exceptional circumstances but producers should be aware of copyright or other legal issues and take appropriate advice when necessary. The owner of the material, wherever and whenever it is used – should always be credited, unless to do so might put the contributor at risk. Any link to the source must be editorially justified, rather than merely being considered as a credit. (See guidance: Links and Feeds) Consent may not always be required to use material when there is a public interest in doing so. However, careful consideration should always be given to the wider editorial justification and the impact of using UGC on a BBC platform that is already being shared extensively on social media. Comment, tweets or posts to BBC channels or otherwise open spaces may be used without the explicit consent of the individual authors. That is particularly the case when individuals are taking part in a public debate or it is clear they understand and are participating in the open nature of social media. Similarly, it is reasonable to use appropriate pictures of individuals taken from their open social media profiles without explicit consent when it is in the public interest. However, potential distress to family and friends should be carefully considered when using pictures of individuals who have died. Even though content may have been posted to social media platforms that have a potential global audience of billions, it is still necessary to consider whether the use of the material respects the privacy of those featured. If the content is filmed openly in a public or even semi-public space then the presumption would generally be that it would be reasonable for the BBC to use. This may still be the case even where the subject is not aware they are being filmed provided there is a public interest. For example, it could be video of vehicle drivers using their mobile phones or other examples of anti-social or illegal behaviour. However, if the content features individuals who might otherwise have a legitimate expectation of privacy, for example if they are receiving medical treatment, or where they are in a private space or the content was clearly not intended for public consumption, respect for their privacy should be maintained - unless a public interest in bringing the material to the audience. It may be appropriate to consider anonymising individuals featured where there remains a public interest in using the material. Where the BBC has asked for contributions from audiences, content producers should act in accordance with data protection laws in handling personal information and take appropriate advice. The BBC should never encourage individuals to break the law or put themselves in danger. It should not normally use material sourced from social media where it is clear individuals have put themselves at unnecessary risk. It should be made clear that contributors should continue to act in the way they would normally do regardless of the fact that they may be creating content that the BBC might use. They should never be encouraged or even 'given permission' to undertake activities they would not normally undertake. This is particularly the case when working with contributors producing longer form personal view or eyewitness content. In breaking news stories, the BBC should be co-ordinated and considerate in approaching individuals on social media for both their consent to use their material and to request any further contribution to the BBC output. It maybe they are still caught up in the incident or dealing with the consequences of it. Children should not be routinely asked to act as newsgatherers for the BBC, but they may be asked to submit content for creative projects or competitions on CBBC or other appropriate outlets. Where children under have been asked to send content directly, the BBC should use its own uploader, where parents have already given permissions for their child to upload content and will notify them every time content is submitted. Where content submitted to the BBC features other children under parental consent must be sought. Where children or young people are featured in content found on social media that is being considered for use, the impact on them should be taken into account. Any online safeguarding concerns that are discovered, whether related to online grooming or child abuse images, must be referred to the Head of Safeguarding and Child Protection immediately. Maxay helayaan xulka ku guuleysta koobka Afrika ? , Senegal Presidency Dowladda Senegal ayaa abaal-marin lacageed iyo mid dhul gudoonsiisay cayaartooyda xulka qaranka ee dalkaasi u soo hoyiyay koobka qaranada qaaradda Afrika. Munaasabad ka dhacday xarunta madaxtooyada ayaa ciyaaryahan kasta waxaa la gudoonsiiyay abaal-marin lacageed oo dhan in ka badan , oo dollar . Waxaa sidoo kale ciyaartooyda dhul laga siiyay caasimadda Dakar iyo deegaanka Dianiyadiyo oo daris la ah caasimadda. Madaxweyne Mackie Sal waxa uu kooxdaasi guddoonsiiyey abaal-marintii ugu sarraysay ee uu dalku bixiyo. Madaxweynaha ayaa mar sii horeysay uga mahadceliyey kooxda sharafta ay dalka u soo hoyiyeen iyo in ay noqdeen horyaalka Afrika. Waxaa uu sidoo kale madaxwaynaha ammaanay tababaraha xulka qaranka Senegal Aliou Cissé. Tababaraha Senegal, Aliou Cissé, waxay guul u tahay isku daygii saddexaad ee finalka Koobka Qaramada Midoobay. -jirkan ayaa kabtanka u ahaa kooxda Teranga Lions markii ay ku dhameysteen kaalinta labaad sanadkii -dii, wuxuuna xilligaa uu qasaariyey rigoore tuuristii Cameroon waxa uuna kursiga keydka ku jiray -kii. Waxa uu guusha u hibeeyey asxaabtiisa ka hor intii aanu shirkiisa jaraa'id qaban ciyaarta ka dib oo ay kooxdiisu joojin dabbaaldegga. Xulka Senegal ayaa rigoorayaal - uga adkaaday xulka Masar, iyagoo noqday markii ugu horreysay taariikhda hantay koobka Afrika. Sawirka, ANADOLU AGENCY Dadka ree Senegal ayaa farxad iyo reynreyn ku soo dhaweeyay kooxda markii ay dalka dib ugu soo laabteen iyga oo sida koobka kubadda cagta ee Afrika. Waxaa dalkaasi iyo guud ahaan caalamkaba si aad ah looga hadal hayaa laacibka wayn ee reer Senegal Sadio Mane Xiddiggan wuxuu shabaqa uu ku hubsaday rigooraha guusha u horseeday dalkiisa uu ka dhaliyey Masar, isaga oo qaybti hore ee ciyaarta laga diiday rigoore iyada oo marki dambana ay ciyaarti Axadda oo wakhti dheeri ah lagu daray ay ku dhammaatay - . Dalka Senegal ee Galbeedka Afrika ku yaalla waxay ku guul darreysteen laba koob oo kubadda cagta ah, iyada oo seddex sano ka hor ay Algeria isku soo hareen ugu dambeyntina - looga guuleystay. Qiimaha lacageed ee la siinayo kooxda ku guuleysata koobka Afrika Qiimaha lacageed ee la siinayo kooxda dalka ku guleysta koobka kubadda cagta ee qaranada qaaradda Afrika ayaa sii kordhayay sanad-ba sanadka ka dambeeya. Sanadkan dalka Senegaal oo koobka ku guuleystay waxa ay helayaan lacag dhan milyan oo doolar. Kooxdii ay ciyaartii kama dambeysta ahaa wada dheeleen ee Masar ayaan qudhooda qadi doonin oo waxaa ay helayaan abaalmarin lacageed oo dhan . milyan oo doolar. Sidoo kale labadii kooxood ee soo gaaray nus-dhamaadka oo kala ahaa Burkina Faso iyo Cameroon ayaa waxaa ay helayaan . milyan midkiiba. Kooxihii soo gaaray rubac dhamaadka tartanka koobka qaramada qaaradda Afrika oo kala ahaa Gambia, Tunisia, Morocco and Equatorial Guinea ayaa waxaa ay helayaan abaal-marin lacageed oo dhan . milyan oo doolar.

Abdulrazak Gurnah: Ninka ku guulaystay abaalmarinta caalamiga ah dalkiisa se aan laga aqoon Cabdulrazak Gurnah oo ku dhashay Zanzibar ayaa noqday qoraaga loogu hadal heynta badan yahay caalamka ka dib markii uu sannadkan ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Nobel Prize ee suugaanta, balse wax badan kama garanayaan shacabka ku nool dalka uu ka soo jeedo ee Tanzania. Abaalmarinta qoraaga sano jirka ah ayaa lagu tilmaamay inay tahay mid horumarinaysa qoraalka Afrika, balse buugaagta Gurnah lagama heli karo goobaha lagu iibiyo buugaagta ee ku yaalla bariga Afrika. "Haddii aad sawirkiisa halkan ku muujiso, dadka waxay arki doonaan markii ugu horreysay," ayuu yidhi Ally Saleh, oo ah qoraa iyo gabayaa ka yimid Zanzibar, jasiiradda uu Gurnah ku koray oo markii dambe lagu daray Tansaaniya. "Aad ayey u yaryihiin dadka Tansaaniya ee wax ka og shaqadiisa." In kasta oo buugaagta Gurnah ay ugu horrayn suuq ka heli jireen UK, halkaas oo uu ku noolaa -kii sano ee la soo dhaafay, -ka sheeko ee uu sameeyay ayaa falanqeeyay arrimo iyo mawduucyo khuseeya dadka reer Zanzibar, oo ay si fiican ugu dheregsan yihiin. Wuxuu sahminayaa saamayntii uu gumaysiga ku yeeshay aqoonsiga Afrikada Bari, iyo waayaha qaxootiga, marka lagu khasbo in ay meelo kale guryo u raadsadaan. Gurnah laftiisa waxa uu ka tagay gurigiisa isaga oo jira sano jir ahaa - wuxuuna ka cararayay qalalaasihii iyo rabshadihii ka dhashay kacaankii -kii ee afgambiyay madaxdii sarsare ee Carabta ee Zanzibar. Ka dib Zanzibar waxay la midowday dhulweynihii lagu magacaabi jiray Tanganyika si ay u dhisto Tansaaniya. Qoraaga waxa uu xidhiidh adag la leeyahay jasiiradda, taas oo dhextaal u ah sheekooyiinkiisa qaar badan oo ka mid ah. "Waa muhiim in Tansaaniyaanka ay akhriyaan shaqada Abdulrazak. Waxa uu shaacinayaa wax badan oo ka mid ah xaqiiqooyinka Tansaaniya ee gudaha iyo dibaddaba," ayuu yidhi Mkuki Bgoya, maamulaha daabacayaasha Tansaaniya Mkuki na Nyota. "Inta badan haddaanu nahay dadka Bariga Afrika, waxaan adduunka ku aragnaa indhaha dadka kale, laakiin Gurnah, sidoo kale waxaan ka dhex arki karnaa nafteenna." Tan iyo markii lagu dhawaaqay abaalmarinta, bishii Oktoobar, qaar ka mid ah dadka Tansaaniya waxay la yaaban yihiin sida qoraa Gurnah oo kale aanu shacbiyad uga haysan gurigiisa. Waxa kale oo ay dhalisay doodo ku saabsan dhaqanka wax-akhris ee dalka oo sii yaraanaya. TPH Bookshop, oo ah shirkad ay howl-wadaag yihiin Mkuki na Nyota, oo ku taal magaalada ugu weyn Tansaaniya ee Dar es Salaam, ayaa ahayd mid ka mid ah dukaamada buugaagta ee dalka ku yaal ee kaydiya wax soo saarka Gurnah laga helo. "Waxaan aragnay farqi weyn oo dhanka daabacaadda ah ee Tansaaniya, taas oo diiradda saaraysa oo keliya buugaagta waxbarashada. "Si aan taas wax uga qabanno waxaan bilownay soo saarista iyo iibinta sheekooyinka, gabayada iyo suugaanta kale. Gaar ahaan buugaagta ay qoreen Tansaaniyaanka," ayuu yiri Mr Bgoya. "Riwaayadaha Gurnah waxay qaadatay waqti dheer in la iibiyo, markaa dib umaanu soo celin." Illaa iyo hadda, qoraallada Gurnah laguma darin manhajka suugaanta dalka ee iskuullada, inkastoo ay ku jiraan qoraayo kale oo Sawaaxili iyo Afrikaan ah. "Waxa uu sumcaddiisa ka sameeyay meel ka baxsan Zanzibar, wuxuuna ka maqnaa dalkiisa tan iyo ," ayuu yidhi Mr Jussa. "Sidaa darteed waxa kaliya ee yaqaannay koox yar oo akhristayaasha aadka u jecel ee akhrista suugaanta Zanzibar." Mid ka mid ah sababaha keenay in Gurnah uu wax ku qoro Ingiriisiga - maaha luqadda Sawaaxiliga, oo ah luqadda ay ku hadlaan inta badan dadka Tansaaniya, waana luqadda hooyo ee qooraaga. Waxaa jiray baaqyo cusub oo soo jeedinaya in sheekooyinkiisa lagu turjumo Sawaaxili. Dr Ida Hadjivayanis, oo ah bare sawaaxili ah oo wax ka dhiga kuliyadda Barashada Arrimaha Bariga iyo Afrika ee Jaamacadda Soas ee London, ayaa durba shaqadaan bilowday ka hor inta uusan Gurnah ku guuleysan abaalmarinta Nobel Prize. Waxay hadda dhammaynaysaa tarjumaadda Sawaaxiliga ee ugu horreysay ee buugiisa, Paradise, oo lagu wado inuu soo baxo horraanta sannadka soo socda. Buuggan, oo la daabacay , waa sheekada wiil ku soo koray Tansaaniya horraantii Qarnigii -aad - waxa ay ahayd sheeko-faneed, taas oo loo magacaabay dhowr abaalmarinno oo qaali ah. Dr Hadjivayanis-na waxa ay rajaynaysaa in tarjumaaddeeda ay dad cusub u keento shaqadiisa.

Shan arrimood oo kaa caawinaya inaad ku guuleysato hadafkaaga sanadka cusub Dabcan sanadkan wuxuu kuu ahaa mid watay guulo, caqabado, khaladaad aad sameysay, dhacdooyin ku farxad geliyay isla markaana horumariyay xirfaddaada, iyo waxyaabo aan ku farxad gelin intaba…kuwani waa wax caadi ah oo ay tahay inaysan marnaba ku niyad-jebin. Qor waxyaabaha aad ku guuleysatay iyo kuwa aadan ku guuleysan intaba, si aad ugu adeegsato sanadka cusub. Dooro waxyaabaha ay tahay inaad muhiimad siiso aadna ku darto qorshooyinkaaga sanadka cusub. Waa maxay waxyaabaha aad qorsheyneyso sanadka cusub? Kala ogow meelaha aad horumar ka gaartay iyo meelaha aadan ka gaarin. . Kala saar qorshooyinkaaga xirfadeed iyo kuwa shakhsiga ah Hadafkaaga xirafadeed waa inuu ka duwanaadaa tan shakhsiyadeed, inkastoo ay mararka qaar is soo hoos galayaan. Haddii aad isku dhex darto waxaa laga yaabaa inaadan guulo badan ka gaarin. Si gaar ah, mid walba ugu samee qorshe aad hiigsaneyso. . U diyaarso qorshe sanadka cusub Ka feker hadafyada aad dooneyso inaad ku guuleysato marka la gaaro -kaDecember, sanadka soo socda. Kaddib, qorshee tallaabooyinka aad u baahan tahay inaad qaaddo si aad u gaarto hadafyadaas. Qor howlaha muhiimka ah amaba waxyaabaha aad is leedahay way kaa caawinayaan inaad gaarto hadafkaaga. Sidoo kale, u toog hay caqabadaha aad is leedahay way ku imaan karaan hadafyadaada. Haddii sanadkan uu cashar ina baray, waa inaan ku saleynaa sanadka cusub, si aan tusaale uga dhiganno. Haddii ay kuu socon waayaan amaba caqabad ay kaa hor timaaddo, waxaad sameysataa qorshe labaad oo kuu beddeli karto waxyaabaha aad sameysay. . Sameyso liis aad ku qorto waxyaabo aadan sameyn doonin Marka aad sameysato liis aad ku qortay waxyaabaha kuu qorsheysan, waxaad sidoo kale sameysaa liiska waxyaabaha aadan sameyn doonin ee kaa hor istaaga inaad gaarto hadafyadaada. Inaad garato waxyaabahaas caqabadda kugu ah waxay kuu suurto gelineysaa inaad wax qabad badan u lahaato hirgelinta hadafyadaada sanadka. Sameyso waqti u gaar ah naftaada. Haddii aad fasax aadeyso sii qorshee xilli hore. Hadduu aad dareemeyso inaad u baahan tahay inaad meel aaddo, sii qorsheyso adigoo meel u dhiganaya dhammaanba kharashka aad u baahan tahay inaad fasaxa ku aaddo. Daalka iyo walaahowga laga qaado inaad shaqada uun ku mashquusho adiga oo aan nasan uma fiicna caafimaadkaaga, inaad muddo dheer shaqeyso adigoon nasanna ma kordhineyso awoodda aad u leedahay inaad si fiicna u shaqeyso si aad ugu guuleysato hadafyadaada. Waa muhiim inaad si dhab ah uga fekerto caafimaadka jireed iyo kan maskaxeed, marka aad qorsheyneyso hadafyadaada sanadka cusub. . Sameyso mashaariic kale amaba waxqabadyo kale oo aad lacag ku sameyneyso Waxaad ka fekertaa waxyaabaha aad jeceshahay inaad sameyso, una adeegso kuwo aad lacag ka sameyn karto si aad u kordhiso dakhligaaga. Hirgelinta hadafkan, wuxuu kaa caawinayaa inaad ku shaqeyso xirfad cusub oo aad taqaano, kuwaasoo haddii aadan adeegsan kaa lumi lahaa. Ugu dambeyn, noqo qof dulqaad badan kuna raaxeysta wax waba oo uu ka barto nolosha.

Dhegeyso: Maxay Soomaaliya ugu soo bateen dilalka gabdhaha yaryar? Qiyaastii 10kii daqiiqaba, meel dunida ka mid ah, qof dumar ah ama gabadh ayaa waxaa dila qof ay garanayso - lammaane, nin ama xubin qoyskeeda ka tirsan, sida lagu sheegay warbixin cusub oo ay soo saareen xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan dambiyada iyo daroogada (UNODC) iyo UN Women. Taasi waa in la dilo qof maalin kasta, sida ay warbixintu sheegtay, dhammaan qaybaha adduunkana ayay saamaysay. Sannadkii -kii, ilaa , oo haween iyo gabdho ah ayaa waxaa dilay qof aad u dhow ama xubno qoysaskooda ka tirsan, ayay tiri warbixintu. Dilalkan ayaa ka dhigan % dhammaan dilalka ula kaca ah ee haweenka iyo gabdhaha adduunka oo dhan loo geysto. Warbixinta - oo la sii daayay si loogu xuso maalinta caalamiga ah ee ciribtirka xadgudubyada ka dhanka ah haweenka, -ka November - ayaa iftiimisay xaqiiqo naxdin leh, Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay: in gurigu uu yahay meesha ugu badan ee lagu dilo haweenka. Dilalka guryaha ka dhaca oo afka qalaad lagu yiraahdo Femicides sidoo kale waxaa lagu sameeyaa meel ka baxsan guriga, laakiin cadadka xogta kuwaas ayaa weli xaddidan, ayay tiri. "Dilalka guryaha ka dhaca meel goonni ah kama dhacaan. Waxay inta badan ka billowdaan rabshado isdaba joog ah oo ka bilaaban kara xakamaynta dabeecadaha, hanjabaadaha iyo dhibaataynta oo ay ku jiraan internet-ka," Sarah Hendriks, oo ah agaasimaha qaybta siyaasadda haweenka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sidaa tiri. , SACIID NADAARA Dhanka kale, iyadoo lagu gudo jiro toddobaadka ka hortagga tacdiyada ku saleysan jinsiga, ayaa haddana waxaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ku soo badanayay Soomaaliya xad-gudubayada ka dhanka ah haweenka. Tacaddiyadii ugu dambeeyay ayaa ahaa, sida muuqata kuwo lagu beegsanayay gabdhaha yaryarka ah oo qaarkood aan qaan gaarin. Arrimahaan ayaa waxaa walaac ka muujiyay bulshada iyo hay'adaha u dooda xuquuqda aadanaha gaar ahaan kuwa dumarka taageera. Wasiir Estonia u dhashay oo "ku jees-jeesay" ra'iisul wasaaraha Finland Madaxweynaha dalka Estonia ayaa raalligelin bixiysay ka dib markii wasiirka arrimaha gudaha ee dalkaas uu ra'iisul wasaaraha Finland ku tilmaamay "sida gabar tukaan iibisa". Madaxweyne Kersti Kaljulaid wuxuu sheegay in "ceeb ay ku tahay " hadalka Mart Helme, oo sano jir ah, kaas oo hoggaamiye ka ah xisbiga mididgta fog ee caanka ah ee Ekre. Ra'iisul wasaaraha Finland, Sanna Marin, oo sano jir ah, waa ra'iisul wasaaraha ugu da'da yar caalamka. Waxay hoggaamisaa isbeheysiga Bidix-Dhexe, oo madaxdiisa oo dhan ay yihiin dumar, waxayna ahayd xidig soo baxeysay sannadihii ugu dambeeyay. Mr Helme wuxuu hadalkiisaa muranka dhaliyay ka sheegay barnaamij ka baxa idaacadda xisbigiisa. "Hadda waan aragnaa sida gabar tukaan iibisa ay ku noqotay ra'iisul wasaare iyo sida dad jidadka ka qeylin jiray iyo kuwo aan waxbaran sida ay golaha wasiirada ugu soo biirayaan," ayuu yiri. Ms Marin waxay ka hadashay in ay ka soo jeeddo qoys sabool ahaa. Waxay ahayd kaaliye iibgeyn ka shaqeysa, ka dib ayey jaamacad ku biirtay, waxayna soo gashay xirfadda siyaasadda. Waxay ahayd qofkii ugu horreeyay qoyskeeda ee dugsiga sare ka baxa, ka dibna jaamacad dhigta. Iyadoo hadalka wasiirkaas uga jawaabeysay Twitter-ka waxay Ms Marin sheegtay inay "si xad dhaaf ah ugu faaneyso Finland". "Dalkan, canugga ka soo jeeda qoyska saboolka ah ayaa waxbaran kara, noloshana guulo badan ka gaari kara. Qofka ka shaqeeya tukaan ayaa noqon kara ra'iisul wasaare," ayey ku tiri qoraalkeeda. Mr Helme wuxuu sheegay in hadalkiisa si xun loo fahmay, wuxuuna raalligelin usoo diray Ms Marin. Wuxuu sheegay in uu doonayay inuu muujiyo "sida uu u ogyahay in ay macquul tahay in nolosha meel hoose laga soo billaabo lana gaari karo meesha ugu sareysa ee siyaasadda". "Haddii qof uu si xun u fahmay... marka hubaashii waxaan ka bixinayaa raalligelin ku socota ra'iisul wasaaraha Finland," ayuu hadalka ku daray. War qoraal ah oo ay soo saartay madaxweynaha, Estonia, Kaljulaid waxay ku sheegtay in ay wacday dhiggeeda Finland, Sauli Niinistö, ayna weydiisatay in raalligelinta la garsiiyo Ms Marin iyo dowladdeeda. "Waxaan sidoo kale u muujiyay weji-gabaxa aan ka dareemay arrimahaas oo dhan," ayey tiri. Axsaabta mucaaradka ee dalkaas Estonia ayaa Mr Helme ugu baaqay in uu is casilo, ama in ra'iisul wasaare Jüri Ratas uu shaqada ka ceyriyo. Xisbiga uu wasiirkaas ka tirsan yahay ee Ekre wuxuu isbeheysiga dowladda ku biiray bishii May, ka dib markii uu ku guuleystay . % boqolkiiba oo ka mid ahaa codadkii laga dhiibtay dooorashadii dalkaas ka dhacday. Xisbiga wuxuu ballan qaaday in uu difaacayo dadka asalka u ah Estonia. Mr Helme wuxuu caan ku yahay hadalladiisa aan gabashada lahayn iyo dhaqamadiisa muranka sababa.

Muxuu hogaamiyaha masiixiyiinta booqashadiisii ugu horreysay uga bilaabay dalkan Muslinka ah ee xiriirka dhow la leh Soomaaliya , AFP via Jaleecada hore, ma jiraan calaamado badan oo muujinaya in magaalada deggan ee Iznik ee Türkiye, oo qiyaastii laba saacadood u jirta Istanbul, ay ahayd magaalo qadiimi ah oo wax ka beddeshay habka taariikhda. Kaliya waxay qaadataa nus saac in lagu dhex lugeeyo magaaladan yar oo ay ku nool yihiin , oo qof, iyagoo maraaya jidad ciriiri ah oo qurxoon, kuwaas oo balakoonadooda ay ka buuxaan ubaxyo. Marka laga gudbo waddooyinkaas oo la gaaro xeebaha harada Iznik, oo ku taal dhinaca kale ee magaalada, weli waxaa jira calaamad yar oo muujinaysa in tani ay mar ahayd mid ka mid ah caasimadaha boqortooyooyinkii Byzantine iyo Cusmaaniyiinta. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, magaalada oo mar loo yaqaan Nicaea, ayaa martigelinaysa Pope Leo XIV, hogaamiyaha kaniisadda Katooliga, safarkiisii ​​ugu horreeyay ee dibadda ah tan iyo markii uu xafiiska qabtay May . Ujeedada ugu weyn ee safarkan ayaa ah in Baadarigu uu ka soo qayb galo xaflada Bartholomew oo ah Baadariga Constantinople iyo madax kale oo Masiixiyiin ah oo lagu xusayo sannad-guuradii ,700aad ee Golaha Koowaad ee Nicaea, taas oo la qabtay AD. Safarka ayaa markii hore loo qorsheeyay in uu ku tago halkaasi Pope Francis, oo dhintay bishii Abril. Ka dib dhimashadiisa, booqashadan dib ayaa loo dhigay. "Mid ka mid ah boogaha ugu qoto dheer ee Kaniisadda maanta waa in annaga Masiixiyiinta ah aan u kala soocnay midba iyo waxa kale kale," Pope Leo XIV ayaa ku yiri wareysi la daabacay Sebtembar. Waxa uu sheegay in uu si gaar ah u taageersan yahay xuska golaha Nicaea sababtoo ah waxa uu u arkaa mid ka dhexeeya qaybaha kala duwan ee diinta Misiixiyiinta. Leo XIV waa baadarigii shanaad ee booqda Turkiga. Ma jiro tirokoob rasmi ah oo laga sameeyay tirada dadka Masiixiyiinta ah ee ku nool dalka, balse warbixin ay soo saartay wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda ee Maraykanka , oo ku salaysan bulshooyinka Masiixiyiinta ah, ayaa tiradooda lagu qiyaasay , . Baadariga ayaa lagu wadaa inuu magaalada Ankara kula kulmo Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan. Laakiin Maxay magaaladan goob muhiim ah ugu tahay Masiixiyiinta? Sawirka, Ali Atmaca/Anadolu Ajansı/Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Jawaabta su'aashan waxay ku beegan tahay qarnigii afraad ee AD, markii "Golaha Koowaad ee Nicaea" la qabtay. Waqtigaas, Boqortooyada Roomaanka waxay fidday min Scotland ilaa badda cas iyo Morocco ilaa saxaraha casriga ah ee Suuriya, Urdun iyo Ciraaq. Waxaa madax ka ahaa Constantine the Great, oo ahaa boqorkii ugu horreeyay ee Masiixi ah. Waxa uu Masiixiyiinta siiyey xuquuqaha sharciga ah ee ugu dhammaystiran tan iyo dhimashadii nebi Ciise saddex qarni ka hor, isaga oo u oggolaaday inay si furan u cibaadeystaan. Constantine wuxuu rabay inuu qabto shir wadaaddada si loo xalliyo khilaafaadka caqiidada. Golihii AD waxa uu noqday isbedel ku yimid taariikhda Roomaanka iyo Kiristaanka. Turhan Kacar, oo ah taariikhyahan ka tirsan jaamacadda Mugla Sitki Kucman, ayaa BBC-da laanteeda afka Turkiga u sheegay in culimadu ay markii hore qorsheynayeen in ay isugu yimaadaan magaalada Ankara ee casriga ah, balse Constantine ayaa warqad uu soo qoray ku amray in ay aadaan Nicaea. Sida laga soo xigtay Cachar, Constantine wuxuu rabay inuu shakhsi ahaan hogaamiyo golaha: "Waxa uu ka ogaa kulamadii hore ee kaniisadaha in haddii hoggaamiyaha kiniisaddu keligood laga tago, ay isku dhici doonaan." Taariikhyahanku wuxuu sheegay in isagoo qabtay Golaha Nicaea, Constantine wuxuu u beddelay diinta sidii"qalab ay adeegsato dawladda": "Markii hoggaamiyaha kiniisaddu tageen Nicaea, waxay ahaayeen wakiillo ka socda bulshooyinkooda, laakiin markay ku noqdeen magaalooyinkooda, waxay ahaayeen wakiillo ka socda dawladda." Paolo Raffaele, oo ah madaxa Kaniisadda Katooliga ee St. Stephen ee Istanbul, ayaa sidoo kale aaminsan in golaha la qabtay markii "kaniisaddu ay bilowday inay la shaqeyso dawladda." Waxa uu BBC-da u sheegay in goluhu uu door muhiim ah ka qaatay qeexidda caqiidada aasaasiga ah ee diinta Kiristaanka, isaga oo intaa ku daray in lagu heshiiyey in la qaato dabeecadda iyo habdhaqankii Ciise Masiix ee Nicaea. Xuska sannad-guurada , ee golaha ayaa fursad u siinaya Masiixiyiinta inay u dabaaldegaan calaamad muhiim ah oo caalami ah oo kaniisaddaha ah. Professor Kachar wuxuu xusay in waqtigii Golaha Nicaea, kaniisadaha Masiixiyiinta aan weli loo qaybin Catholic iyo Ortodoks, sababtaas awgeed, dhacdadan taariikhiga ah ayaa loo arkaa "madal midnimo" hoggaamiyeyaasha ruuxiga ah ee maanta. Pope Leo XIV wuxuu qaban doonaa isu soo bax diimeed oo la filayo inay yimaadaan ilaa lix kun oo qof Noofambar wuxuuna u dhoofi doonaa Lubnaan maalinta xigta si uu u bilaabo lugta xigta ee safarkiisa.

Doorashada qof iyo Cod fursad ma siin doonta Haweenka Soomaaliya , Xamdi Daahir Siyaad. Doorashada golayaasha deegaanka ee Muqdisho waxaa dadka qaar u arkaan tallaabo muhiim ah oo ka mid ah geeddi-socodka dimuqraadiyadda Soomaaliya ee xilligan. Waxaa doorashadan ka qeyb galaya sida ay guddiga doorashada sheegeen musharax. Musharaxiintaasi waxaa ka mid ah haween u sharaxan xilalka degmooyiinka kala duwan ee Muqdisho. Musharaxiinta u tartamaya golayaasha deegaanka waxaa ka mid ah Xamdi Daahir Siyaad. Xamdi oo muddooyinkii dambe Muqdisho ka waday ololaha ay ku dooneyso inay ku hesho codka dadweyna ayaa sheegtay in ay kalsooni ku qabto in la dooran doono, baqdin bandanna aysan ka qabin in bulshadu ay fahmi waayaan muhiimadda ay leedahay in gabdhuhu ka qeyb-galaan siyaasadda deegaanka. "waxaan filayaa oo rajeenayaa guul iyo in dadka reer Muqdisho doortaan kartida iyo aqoonta, bulshada boqolkiiba boqol waxaan aaminsanahay in ay xitaa dumar ahaan iigu codeeyn doonaan". Xamdi iyo musharaxiinta kalaba waxa ay bar-bilow u yihiin doorashooyin la qorsheenayo in ka qabsoomaan Soomaaliya sida uu sheegay guddiga doorashadu degmo oo aan magaaalada Muqdisho ahayn ayaa u qorsheysan in doorasho laga qabto marka la soo afjaro tan hadda ka socota magaalada Muqdisho. "waa guul weyn oo dimoqaraadiyadeed inaan noqdo wajigii ugu horreeyey ee siyaadeed u tartama golahaan; waxa ay ii tahay dhiiragelin inaan ka dhigo raad waanagsan oo la xusuusto muddo dheer", ayey tiri Xamdi. Tartanka musharrixiinta waxa uu ahaa mid ballaaran, balse tirada ay ururada soo gudbiyeen sida uu sheegay gudoomiyaha guddiga Madaxa Bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka (NIEBC haweenku waxa ay ka yihiin musharax, taas oo noqoneysa ku dhawaad % musharrixiinta guud. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Waxaa sidoo kale xusid mudan in sharciga doorashooyinka ee Soomaaliya uu dhigayo in ururrada/xisbiyadu marka ay soo gudbinayaan liisaska musharrixiinta ay u hoggaansamaan qoonda haweenka oo ah ugu yaraan %, si loo dhiirrigeliyo ka qaybgalka dumarka ee siyaasadda. xilli ka hor doorashadaba aan la helin tiro badan waxa ay Caasho Cumar Geesdiir oo ah oo ka shaqeysa arrimaha haweenka iyo xuquuqda adanaha ku sheegtay rajo xumo muujineysa haweenka soo bixi kara ay noqon doonaan lambar yar. "Doorasho xor ah oo qof iyo cod ah tii hore kadib ayaa hadda la sameynaa,dhibaatada jirta dadka waxa ay ku wareersan yihiin in xisbi la dooranaayo iyo in qof la dooranaayo, horta wacyi gelin ayaa meesha ka maqneed, hadda natiijada la helayna marka ay dumar noqoto, runtii aad iyo aad waxa u dareemaa inuu u yarhay, dhibaatadana waxa ay tahay dumar ahaan aad ayan siyaasadda uga dib dhacsannahay", ayey tiri Caasho Geesdiir. Doorashadaan heer degmo waxa ay dad badan u arkaan in tahay mid fursad siin karta qof kasta oo muqdisho ku nool, gaar ahaan haweenka oo aan helin mudnaantii ay lahaayeen, kuwaas oo ka shaqeeya qeybaha kala duwan nolosha, sida ay qabto musharaxad Xamdi, gabdhahu waxa ay qaadan kaalin walba oo loo baahdo. "Inaan ahay hooyo kaligeed ubad korisa waxa ay I bartay mas'uuliyadda. Horta bulshadeenna waxaa garabka ku sida hooyooyin adag oo aan nin garab ka helin badanaa, haddii hooyo Soomaaliyeed ay kaligeed reer dhan kasoo saari karto dhib iyo marxalad kasta maxaa diiday in ay hogaamiso degmo ama golo deegaan". Sawirka, Xamdi Daahir Siyaad Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan Muqdisho waxa ay fureysaa baal cusub oo dhanka doorashada ah kadib muddo, wadanka lagu maamulayey doorasho aan toos ahayn, taas oo la dooranayey kaliya golaha sharci dejiyeyaasha, kuwaas oo iyagana soo dooranayey madaxweynaha. Balse waxaa la rajeenayaa in loo gudbo deegaan doorasho ku saleesan ururo iyo xisbiyo, waxa ayna meesha ka saari doontaa nidaamka awood qaybsiga ee ku salaysnaa qabiillada, nidaamkaas oo ahaa mid caqabad ku ah in ay siyaasadda soo gaalaan haween fara badan. In kasta Caasho Geesdiir ay qabto in dumarku iyada aysan dedaal ku bixin sida raggu dedaal ugu bixiyaan in ay kusoo baxaan kuraasta. "waxaa loo baahan yahay dumarka in ay is ogaadaan, meel kasta oo ay gabar jooogto, kuwa xildhibaannada ah, dumarka in ay dhagahooda furaan ayaa la rabaa oo ay hurdada ka kacaan, tan hadda tusaale waa in ay noqoto doorashada Banaadir si aysan uga dhicin meelaha kale waa in ay xuquuqdooda helaan oo ay soo galaan siyaasadda". Doorashadan ma ahan mid si toos ah qof loo dooranayo ee waa doorasho loo codeynayo xisbiyo. Sida guddiga doorashadu sheegeen dadka codeynaya ayaa kala dooranaya xisbiyo iyo ururo siyaasadeed oo gaaraya ilaa iyo urur. "Qof lama dooranayo ee waxaa la dooranayaa xisbiyo" ayuu yiri guddoomiyaha guddiga doorashooyinka Soomaaliya. Doorashada waxaa xusid mudan in ay qaadaceen qaar ka mid ah mucaaradka gaar ahaan Madasha mucaaradka Samatixinta Soomaaliyeed.

Xaalka gabdho ciyaartooy Soomaali ah oo ku xayiran Morocco kaddib dhulgariirkii cuslaa ee ka dhacay , Gift Stars Sports Club/FACEBOOK Dadka farahabadan ee uu saameeyey dhulgariirka culus ee ka dhacay Morocco waxaa ka mid ah hablo Soomaaliyeed oo ciyaartooy ah oo halkaasi u joogay tartan Kubadda Kolayga ah oo ay ka qayb gelayeen, kuwaas oo sida ay noo sheegeen xaalad ‘naxdin’ ah ku sugan. Hablahan oo ka tirsan kooxda lagu magacaabo Gifts Club oo ah naadi ka kooban hablo Soomaali ah oo ka kala yimi dalalka Australia, USA, Kenya iyo Soomaaliya ayaa magaalada Marrakesh ee dalka Morocco kaga qayb gelayey koobka Arab Basketball Club Champions oo sannadkan halkaas lagu qabtay. Sucaad Cabdillaahi Galow oo ka mid ah madaxda ururka Somali Women Foundation oo iyadu hoggaaminaysay kooxdan ayaa BBC-da uga warrantay xaaladdii ay dareemeen iyo wixii ay la kulmeen markii habeenkii xalay ahaa dhulgariir culusi ku dhuftay qaybo ka mid ah dalkaas. “Ku dhawaad kii habeennimo oo xilligaas ay habluhu seexdeen ayaannu dareenay wax yar oo dhul gariir ah, marba marka ka danbaysana wuu sii kordhayay. Hotelkaan degganayn oo ah mid aad u adag haddana Ilaahay Amarkii sidii warqadda ayuu ruxmayey, oo Ilaahay uun baa na badbaadsaday,” ayay BBC da u sheegtay Sucaad. “Marki hore wax xog ah kamaannaan hayn dhulgariirkan iyo sida looga falceliyo markuu dhaco, laakiin dhismihii waannu ka baxnay oo waddada iyo meel dhismaha iyo dhirta ka fog ayaannu tagnay oo xalay u hoyannay” ayay hadalkeeda sii raacisay Sucaad. Sawirka, Gift Stars Sports Club/FACEBOOK Hablahan ciyaartoyda ah oo ka koobnaa hablood ayaa ka kala yimid dalal ka duwan, kuwaas oo badankoodu ay qurbaha ku dhasheen. Xilliga dhulgariirku dhacay oo ahaa xilli danbe oo abbaaro kii habeennimo ah ayaa iyaga u ahaa xilli hurdo. Xaaladda dhulgariirka ayaana aad uga nixisay iyaga oo qaarkood ay galeen xaalad naxdin ah markii ay ku tooseen waxa socda, sida ay sucaad nooga warrantay. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. “Hablo yaryar oo debedaha ku dhashay oo dhulgariir in ay akhriyaan mooyaane aan weligood maqlin, oo arag, oo hurda, maalinka xigtana isu diyaarinayey tababar iyo ciyaar ay lahayeen makhribka, waad qiyaasi kartaa sida ay u naxeen” ayay tidhi Sucaad oo ka warramaysay sida uu ahaa dareenka hablaha yaryar markii dhulgariirku dhacayay. Waxaanu isku daynay inaan la hadalno qaar kamid ah gabdhaha, balse ma aysan awoodin badnkood inay nala hadlaan maadama ay xaalad daal iyo naxdin ah ku jireen sida ay noo sheegeen. Hani Cali oo ka timid iyadu magaalada Muqdisho kana tirsan hablaha Gift Stars oo ahayd ciyaartooyadda keliya ee nala hadashay ayaa sheegtay in wixii ay xalay aragtay uu ahaa ‘wax fajaciso ah'. ‘Wax laga naxo oo aad u xun ayaan xalay aragnay, alxamdulilaah se hadda waan nabad qabnaa oo Ilaahii naga ammaansaday ayaa mahadsan’ ayay BBC u sheegtay Hani. Dhulgariirkan ku dhuftay dalkaas ayaa cabbirkiisu ahaa . , waxaana ku dhintay ugu in kabadan qof illaa hadda inta la xaqiihiyey, sida ay sheegtay wasaaradda arrimaha gudaha ee dalkaasi. Meesha xudunta u ah ayaa ah aagga buuraha Atlas ee sare, oo 71km ( mayl) koonfur-galbeed kaga beegan magaalada Marrakesh, sida ay sheegtay hay'adda sahminta dhulka ee Maraykanka. Sawirka, Gift Stars Sports Club/FACEBOOK Sucaad Galaw, oo horkacaysay kooxdan ayaa noo sheegtay in ay hadda qorshaynayaan sidii ay ugu bixi lahaayeen dalka, isla mar ahaantaana ay wejahayaan caqabad dhanka diyaaradaha maadaama badi diyaaradihii buuxaan, ayna ku qasban yihiin in ay aadaan magaalada Casablanca si ay halkaas uga raadiyaan in ay ka helaan safarro u socdo dalalkii ay ka kala yimaaddeen si ay u baxaan. "Hadda waxaannu ku jirnaa hotel kii aan degganayn oo laga wada guuray oo aannu annagu ku hadhnay maadaama dadkii kale ay dalalkoodii diyaarado u soo direen, annaguna waxannu qorshaynaynaa in aannu safar gaadhi ku tagno Casablanca oo halkaa ka sii baxno" ayay tiri Sucaad. Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Morocco oo fadhigeedu yahay magaalada Rabat ayay noo sheegeen in xidhiidh fiican ka dhexeeyo oo ay iyadu siisay talada bixitaankooda kalana shaqaynayso sidii ay si nabad uga bixi lahaayeen dalkan. Ciyaaraha ay ciyaareen hablahan ayaa ahaa laba kulan halka ay u hadhsanaayeen afar kulan oo kale. Koobkan oo ah kubbadda kolayga ayay ka soo qayb galan naadiyo kala duwan oo ka kala yimaadda dalalka Jaamacadda Carabta oo ay Soomaaliya ku jirto.

Qabatinka Internet-ka: Ma dhibaato sii kordheysaa oo saameyn ku leh dunida? , Deepak Kanda Cam Adair wuxuu ugu dambayntii ogaaday in uu la qabsiga ciyaaraha game-ka ee qaabka online-ka ah ay yihiin wax ka baxsan is xakamayntiisa, taas oo ku kaliftay in uu go'aansado in uu soo afjaro. "Waxaan la halgamay sano," ayuu yidhi. "Waxaan ka baxay dugsiga sare, weligay ma aadin kulliyad, waxaana iska dhigay qof haya shaqooyin kale, taas oo aan ku khiyaanayay qoyskayga", ayuu yiri. "Ugu dambeyntii waxaan qoray warqad is-dilid ah, waxayna ahayd habeenkaas in aan gartay inaan u baahanahay in qof i caawiyo aan helo. Hadda waxaan xor ka ahay , -maalmood, ciyaarihii game-ka ee balwadda ii noqday," ayuu intaa ku daray. Mr Adair, oo ah -jir u dhashay dalka Canada, waa aasaasaha barnaamijka dadka doonaya in game-ka internet-ka ee balwadda u noqday ay iska dhaafaan, waxaana barnaamijka lagu magacaabaa Game Quitters. Waa barnaamijka ay sameysteen koox dadka ka caawiysa khadka tooska ah, gaar ahaan kuwa dhibaatada ay ka haysato ama qabatimay ciyaaraha Internet-ka ama (video games). Waxaa barnaamijkan hadda xubin ka ah in ka badan , oo qof oo ku kala baahsan daafaha dunida. In kasta oo tikniyoolajiyadda, gaar ahaan internet-ka, uu gacan ka geystay in dunida ay horey u socoto, intii lagu jiro feyriska Corona, haddana Cam Adair wuxuu waqtigaas u ahaa mid adag. "Cudurka safmarka ayaa ii horseeday in aan waqti badan ku qaato daawashada muuqallada iyo dadka dheela ciyaaraha kombiyuutarka iyo daawashada YouTube," ayuu yiri Adair. Xarunta dawooyiinka iyo caafimadka Mareykanka ayaa warbixin ka soo saartay dadka la qabatimay oo balwadda uu u noqday Internet-ka. Qofka oo aan iska xakameyn karin isticmaalka internet-ka iyo game-ka kumbuyuutarada, ayay xarunta u aragtaa balwad adag oo dad badan ay la qabsadeen. In kastoo ay dad badan ku doodaan in la qabsiga Internet-ka uusan halis u ahayn sida balwadaha kale ee maandooriyayasha ah, haddana internet-ka waa dhibaato dad badan ay u nugul yihiin. "Fikirka nolosha wuxuu horseedaa damaca qof ee ah in uu isticmaalo isaga oo ka baxsanaya walwalka," ayuu yiri. "Feyriska Corona ayaa sii kordhiyay walaaca dhanka nolosha ah ee ay dad badan qabaan", ayuu yiri Dr Andrew Doan, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay cilmiga neerfayaasha iyo sidoo kale la qabsiga internet-ka "Isticmaalka xad-dhaafka ah, si uu qofka uga baxsado walwalka waa halis muujinaysa in qofka uu sheyga balwad u noqday ama uu la qabatimay ." ayuu intaa ku daray. Si dadka la qabatimay internet-ka looga caawiyo in ay iska daayaan ama yareeyaan internet-ka, dhowr shirkadood oo dhanka tiknoolajiyadda ah ayaa soo saaray qalab loo adeegsan karo xannibaadda ama xaddidayo in qofka uu galo baraha internet-ka. Linewize waa mid ka mid ah shirkadaha noocan ah, oo loogu talagalay in carruurta iyo waalidiinta lagaga xaddido adeegsiga badan ee Internet-ka. Bogagga internet-ka iyo app-ka ayaa u oggolaanaya waalidiinta in iyaga oo guriga ka maqan ay xaddidaan oo ay kormeeraan wakhtiga badan ee ay carruurta ku bixiyaan ciyaaraha game-ka ee kombiyuutarada ama taleefoonada. Linewize sidoo kale waxaa ku jira aalad "lagu xiro" oo looga hortago in ay caruurta galaan baraha lagu faafiyo muqaalada anshax xumada ah. Teodora Pavkvic, oo ah aqoonyahan ku takhasusay cilmi-nafsiga, ahna khabiir dhanka tiknoolajiyadda, oo deggan San Diego, ayaa sheegtay in dhallinyarada ay si gaar ah ugu nugul yihiin in ay wakhti badan ku qaataan internet-ka. Balse waxay intaa ku daray in waalidiinta qaar, marka ay caruurta qaangaar yihiin, ay u ogolaadaan isticmaalka badan ee internet-ka. "In qofka uu Maareeyo wakhtiga uu internet-ka uu ku bixinayo, oo uu isu dheelitiro caafimaadkiisa, waa mid u baahan garsho aad u heer sareeysa, taasi oo uusna qofka si buuxda u gaareyn illaa aan ka gaarnno da'da sano," ayay intaa ku dartay. Dadka waawayn, ayaa marka internet-ka laga reeb, waxay sidoo kale la qabatimaan ciyaarta khamaarka, waxaana soo baxay barnaamijyo online ah oo lagu ciyaaro. BetBlocker waa barnaamij u oggolaanaya dadka in ay iska xiraan tobannaan kun oo bogag oo ah kuwa khamaarka. Marka la xaddido website-yadan, qofka ma geli karo aaladaha khamaarka ilaa wakhtiga iyo taariikhda uu ku xiray ay ka gareyso. App-ka BetBlocker - oo ah lacag-la'aan - waxaa xannibi kara lamaanahaaga, saaxiibkaaga, ama waalidka. Dadka Isticmaala waxay xannibi karaan aaladaha khamaarka saacado, maalmo, ama toddobaadyo. Dadka waxay sidoo kale isticmaali karaan app-ka si ay u xannibaan bogagga kale, sida kuwa ciyaaraha. GamBlock waa app kale oo loo isticmaali karo si la mid ah BetBlocker, si looga hortago in qofka uu galo goobaha internet-ka ee khamaarka lagu dheelo. Madaxa shirkaddan laga leeyahay dalka Australia, David Warr, ayaa yiri: "Ma nihin khamaar-diid. Taa beddelkeeda waxaan diiradda saarnaa caawinta dadka dheela khamaarka ee dhibaatada kala kulma." Dr Doan oo isagu ka mid ahaa dadka la qabatimay ciyaaraha ama (video games), waxaa uu soo maray waddo adag. Wuxuu sheegay in intii uu jaamacadda ku jjray uu illaa saacadood ciyaari jiray game-ka, toddobaadkiiba, islamarkana uu muddo sano ah waday arrintaas". Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Cam Adair wuxuu ku rajo weyn yahay in shirkadaha tiknoolajiyadda, sida Linewize, BetBlocker iyo GamBlock, ay door muhiim ah ka ciyaari doonaan in uu iska dhaafo ciyaaraha game-ka internet-ka. Waxay muhiimadu tahay in qof kasta oo ka welwelsan nooc kasta oo ka mid arrin balwad u noqotay ama uu la qabatimay, in uu la xiriiro dhakhtar. Adair sheekadiisa oo qeyb ka ah cilmi-baaris la sameeyay, hadda waa nin fagaareyaasha ka hadla, isaga oo dadka ka wacyigaliya qabatinka internet-ka.

Haasaawaha: Maxay gabdhaha Kenya u raadsadaan macallimiin bara shukaansiga? Waxbarashada dhanka haasaawaha way sii kordheysaa sanad kasta, waxaana sabab u ah in ay bateen dumarka raadinaya in ay helaan rag ay nolosha la wadaagaan. Macallimiinta dumarka bara shukaansiga waxay inta badan ballan qaadaan in macaamiishooda ay heli doonaan niman, iyadoo aysan jirin cid dammaanad qaad u sameyn karta arrintaas - balse mararka qaar waxay u muuqataa inay ku guuleystaan farxad siinta iskaabulada. "Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego qaar ka mid ah khaladaadka aad sameysaan," ayuu yiri Robert Burale oo taagan masraxa, iyadoo uu dhawaaqayo muusig uu halkaas ka garaacayo DJ. "Diyaar ma u tihiin arrintaas?" ayuu weydiinayaa dadka ku sugan hoolka. Waxaa durbadiiba la maqlayaa hadallo hoose oo u muuqday in ay yihiin kuwo la isku ceebsanayo. Kaddib ayuu Robert, oo socsoconayay intii uu khudbaddiisa wadayoo dhan, mar qura u aamusay si lama filaan ah, makarafoonkii ayuu ku qabsaday hal gacan, gacantii kalena wuxuu ku taagay dadkii hortiisa dhoobnaa. "Gabdhihiinna waxaad khalad ku sameysaan inaad ninka siisaan mudnaan la mid ah midda la siiyo nin xaas loo yahay isagoo wali idiin ah saaxiib oo kaliya, heerkaasna aan gaarin," ayuu yiri isagoo qeylinaya. "Raggu waa ugaarato! Mar haddii uu libaax dhuunta kaa qabto, adigana aad dhiig bax u dhimato - wuxuu islamarkiiba raadsanayaa ugaar kale." "Marka fadlan. Haddii uusan ku guursanin iska illow." Dumarkii ayaa iyagoo madaxa ruxaya u sacbiyay. Robert Burale waa macallin dadka bara arrimaha jacaylka iyo haasaawaha, munaasabaddanna - oo lagu magacaabay Haweeney qaali ah - waxaa looga golleeyahay in wax loogu sheego dumarka iskaabulada ah ee rajeynaya inay reer yeeshaan, waxaana lagu baraa sida ay ku heli karaan nin ay xaas u noqdaan. Dhowr maalmood ka hor waxaan isku aragnay bannaanka hore ee xafiiskiisa ku yaalla magaalada Nairobi, Kenya. Waxay ahayd xilli kulul, wuxuuna xirnaa suud, shaati iyo garabaati iyo fasaleeti u eg garabaatigiisa, balse wuxuu sharraxay in aadan ogaan karin meesha ay maalintaada ku dhammaaneyso iyo cidda aad la kulmeyso. Mar walbana labiska ugu quruxda badan uu yahay suudka. Xafiiskiisa gudihiisa, muuqaallo uu ku duubay cashirrada haasaawaha ayaa ka daarnaa shaashado dhowr ah, wuuna nagu dhex wareejiyay si aan u aragno. In ka badan toban qof ayaa wax ku qorayay kumbuyuutarrada, haweeney da' yar oo qaybta soo dhaweynta fadhisana waxay sheegtay in daawashada muuqaalladiisa ay nafteeda ku badbaadday. Robert wuxuu sheegay inuu hayo sirta ku saabsan sida loo helo jacayl waara - inkastoo isaga qudhiisa noloshiisu aysan mar walba soo wanaagsaneyn. "Anigoo aan waxba qarineynin, guurkeyga ayaa u burburay si shaac baxsan," ayuu yiri. "Balse taas waxay ka dhigan tahay inaan dumarka si buuxda ugala talin karo sida loo yeesho xiriir guuleysta. Waan aqaannaa meesha ay dadku ka khaldamaan." Sida ay sheegtay hay'adda caalamiga ah ee tababarka - oo ah urur ka jira adduunka oo dhan - ganacsiga la xiriira tababaridda shakhsiyaadka ayaa labojibbaar noqday tan iyo sannadkii -kii, arrintaasoo uu sare u qaaday isticmaalka Online-ka. Inkastoo tirada aysan isku wada mid ahayn, barnaamijkan ayaa ka socday dalal badan, laga soo billaabo Mareykanka ilaa Kenya. Cashirrada ku saabsan haasaawaha ee fool ka foolka ah waxaa bil kasta ku baxa , oo doolar, sida uu sheegay Jon Birger oo ah khabiir ku xeel dheer dhaqaalaha lagu bixiyo shukaansiga. Hase yeeshee hay'adda caalamiga ah ee tababarka shakhsiyaadka ayaa shegetay in koorsooyinka noocan ah ay sanad walba ku baxdo lacag dhan $ bilyan oo doolar. Maalintii ka horreysay munaasabadda lagu magacaabay Haweeneyda qaaliga ah Marry waxay aragtay dariskeeda oo cunug yar u qabeynaya, shanqartoodana lagu wada baraarugyo. Way eegtay wayna u dhoolla caddeysay, sababtoo ah waxay iyaduba jeclaan lahayd inay heysato cunug yar. Mary waa jir mana la guursanin wali, inkastoo waddanka ay ku nooshahay da'da gabdhaha magaalooyinka badankood lagu guursado celcelis ahaan ay tahay sano. jir ayaa lagu guursadaa inta badan gabdhaha miyiga, sida laga soo xigtay warbixin uu soo saaray Bangiga Adduunka. Saddex ka mid ah gabdhaha walaalaheed ah ee ka yar yar ayaa horay loo guursaday. "Cadaadiska ugu badan wuxuu kaaga imaanayaa qoyskaaga, waalidiintaada, awoowe iyo ayeeyo, adeeryaal iyo abtiyaal, eeddooyin iyo habaryaro," ayay tiri. Si joogto ah ayay mar walba u weydiiyaan sababta ay wali u tahay iskaabulo. "Waxaan rabaa inaan ogaado meesha aan khaladka ka sameeyo," ayay tiri Mary. Balse haddii ay iskaabulo tahay ma waxay ka dhigan tahay inay wax khaldan sameyneyso, ayaan weydiinnay. Miyeysan jiri karin waxyaabo kale? Ama soo ma noqon karto in qofka saxda ah helitaankiisa uu yahay nasiib? "Ma garanayo. Dad badan ayaa ii sheega inaan ahay qof dookhiisu adag yahay. Ma ogi inaan dookh adagahay iyo in kale. Ma garanayo," ayay tiri. Mary waxa ay ka shaqeysaa xarun telefoonnada laga wacdo, fasalka uu koorsada ku bixiyo Robert Burale-na lacagtiisu waa $ doolar oo u dhiganta mushaarka ay hal isbuuc qaadato. Ma hubto in koorsadaas ay wax u qaban doonto iyo in kale - ma garaneyso in lacagta ay bixisay ay ku heli doonto nin guursada - balse way isku dayeysaa si kastoo ay ahaataba. "Way u qalantaa in la tijaabiyo, ayaan dhihi lahaa," ayay raacisay hadalkeeda. Gabadhan waxay sheegtay in hadda ka hor uu luggooyay nin ay u maleyneysay inuu guursan rabo. Iyadoo filaya in xaaladdu ay meel fiican mareyso ayay ku aragtay isbaddal lama filaan ah. "Markii aan wacay si aan u weydiiyo waxa jira, wuxuu igu yiri, 'dhageyso? qaabka nolosheyda wuu is baddalay. Heerkii aan taagnaana wuu isbaddalay." Halkaas marka ay sheegakada marsiineyso mar way aamustay. Robert ayaa hadalka qabsaday oo ku yiri: "Wuu ku quursaday sooma aha?" "Aad ayuu ii liiday, meel aad iyo aad u hooseysa ayuu i geeyay," ayay ku jawaabtay Mary. "Ninkaas wuxuu hoos u dhigay kalsoonida nafteyda," ayay sii raacisay hadalkeeda. Mary markii ay soo dhameysatay cashirka waxay sheegtay in ay kasoo heshay koorsada lasoo siiyay. Waxaan weydiinnay fikirkeeda ku saabsan talada la siiyay loogu sheegay in aysan isku dhiibin ninka ay shukaansaneyso ilaa ay ka ogaato inuu yahay nin guurka uu dhab ka yahay. "Waxay ila tahay, qaybtaas waxay u muuqatay wax laga tagay mar hore. Ma qaadanayo taladaas," ayay tiri. Mary waxay xiran tahay funaanad ay xabadka uga qoran tahay oraan dhaheysa "ha cabsanin". Waxay tiri: "Jacaylku kuma sugi karo." "Waxa ugu fiican ee aan ka qaatay cashirkii koorsada waa in aan mar walba isku dayo inaan faraxsanaado. Nafteydana aan farxad galiyo, diiraddana aan saaro sidii aan isu qancin lahaa si buuxda! "Wali waqti ayaan heystaa. Waqti fiican ayaa ii harsan. Wali waan yarahay. Haa!" Shan bilood kaddib, Mary wali waa iskaabulo, balse wax inay isbaddaleen ayay u muuqataa - waa iskaabulo balse way faraxsan tahay.

Maxaan ka ognahay safarka la sheegay in Cirro uu ku tegayo Israa'iil? , Xafiiska Afhayeenka Madaxweynaha JSL; naqshadeynta: BBC. Warar sheegaya in Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Iskeed ugu Dhawaaqday Madaxbannaanida ee Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro uu u safray, ama uu isu diyaarinayo safar uu ku tago Israa'iil, ayaa si weyn ugu faafay baraha bulshada ilaa shalay, balse waxaa garab socda qodobbo muhiim ah oo aanan weli la xaqiijin. Asalka wararkan wuxuu dib ugu biya-shubanayaa wicitaan taleefan oo dhacay -dii Diseembar , kaas oo dhex maray Madaxweynaha Somaliland iyo Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Israa'iil Benjamin Netanyahu. Wicitaankaas, ayaa Netanyahu wuxuu u sheegay Madaxweyne Cirro in Israa'iil ay aqoonsatay Somaliland iyo inay tageerayaan xaqa ay uleeyihiin is-maamul madax banaan, isagoo ku tilmaamay tallaabadaas mid taariikhi ah. Wuxuu sidoo kale ku casuumay Madaxweyne Cirro inuu booqasho rasmi ah ku yimaado Israa'iil, isagoo sheegay inuu gaarsiin doono madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump rabitaanka Somaliland u qabto ku biirista heshiisyada Abraham Accords oo ujeeddadoodu tahay in la caadiyeeyo xiriirka Israa'iil iyo dalalka Carabta. Sawirka, Xafiiska Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Israa'iil Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa ku sheegay wicitaanka inuu aqbalay casuumaadda, diyaarna u yahay inuu Israa'iil booqdo "sida ugu dhaqsaha badan ee suurtagalka ah", isagoo tilmaamay in safarku dhici karo sannadkan . Saas oo jidha, jadwal rasmi ah ama war rasmi ah oo safarka la xiriira lama shaacin. Shalay -kii Janaayo , qoraal lagu daabacay barta X oo uu qoray akoon magaciisu yahay Rabbi Avi Hirsch ayaa ku andacooday inuu helay xog ah in Madaxweyne Cirro uu gaaray Israa'iil. Safarkaas oo uu ku tilmaamay mid taariikhi ah oo lagu doonayo in Somaliland si rasmi ah loogu daro heshiisyada Abraham Accords. Qoraalkaas ayaa si degdeg ah u faafay, isagoonan wehelin wax ilo rasmi ah oo xigasho noqon kara. Magaca "Rabbi Avi Hirsch" waa mid Cibraani ah. "Rabbi" waxaa loogu yeeraa wadaadka Yuhuudiga ah, halka "Avi" uu macnihiisu yahay "aabbahay". Akoonkaas X ee warka faafiyay ayaa imika la hakiyay. Ka hor inta aan la cinwaanka hawada laga saarin, dad badan ayaa shaki geliyay runnimadiisa, iyagoo ku tilmaamay akoon majaajilo ama marin-habaabin u eg. Akoonka ayaa isticmaalayay sawirka Sheekh Cabdi Hirsi, oo ah falanqeeye siyaasadeed oo caan ah, inkastoo aysan jirin wax caddeyn ah oo muujinaysa inuu wax xiriir ah la lahaa akoonka ama sheegashooyinkiisa. BBC-du ma aysan awoodin inay si madax bannaan u xaqiijiso cidda dhab ahaantii maamuleysay akoonkaas ama halka uu ka keenay macluumaadka uu baahiyay. Dhinaca kale, xogta isha-furan, ama sirta suuqa taalla ee OSINT loo yaqaano, ayaa tibaaxaysa dhaqdhaqaaq lala xiriirinayo diyaarad gaar ah. Sida xogtu sheegayso, diyaarad nooca Hawker 800XP ah, kuna diiwaangashan lambarka T7-NKS, ayaa shalay, -kii Janaayo ka duushay garoonka Ben Gurion ee Israa'iil una jiheysatay Hargeysa, iyadoo martay hawada Itoobiya isla markaana sameysay wareegyo hakad ah ka hor inta aysan si toos ah u galin hawada Hargeysa. Wax caddeyn ah oo si rasmi ah u muujinaysa cidda saarnayd diyaaradda ama ujeeddada duullimaadka lagu ma soo bandhigin goobaha warbaahinta. BBC-du na si madax-bannaan ilaa hadda uma xaqiijin karto liiska rakaabka saarnaa ama sababta diyaaradani u timi Hargeysa. Sawirka, AfriMEOSINT/X BBC-da ayaa la xiriirtay Somaliland si ay u hesho xaqiijin ku saabsan safarka la sheegay ee Madaxweyne Cirro iyo wararka ku saabsan diyaaradda. Waqtigii warbixintan la diyaarinayay, mas'uuliyiinta Somaliland kama aysan jawaabin wicitaankeenna. Ilaa iyo inta ay ka imaanayaan xaqiijin rasmi ah oo ka timaadda Somaliland ama Israa'iil, wararkani waxay uun ahaan doonaan war suuq oo aanan la xaqiijin karin. Ra'iisul Wasaaraha ayaa -kii December ku dhawaaqay in Somaliland ay si rasmi ah ugu aqoonsadeen dal madax-bannaan. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si xooggan uga hortimid aqoonsigaas, waxayna ku tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanideeda. Dalal badan oo dunida ah ayaa sidoo kale taageero u muujiyay Soomaaliya, iyadoo aysan jirin dal taageeray aqoonsigaas.

Daraasad: 'Dawooyinka ay qaatan ragga ee uurka dumarka looga hortaggo waxay soo hoyiyeen guul' Baahida loo qabo kaniiniyada ka hortagga uurka ay ragga qaatan ee aan xiriirka la laheyn hormoonka ayaa laga yaabaa inay soo hooyaan guulo isla markaana horseedaan suurtagalnimada ah inay ka hortaggaan in shahwada ay ku dhex dabbaalato gudaha ilmo galeenka hooyada. Daraasado lagu sameeyay jiir ayaa tilmaamaya in kaniiniga uu xakamaynayo shahwada ugu yaraan dhowr saacadood - si looga hortago in ay gaarto ugxanta. Waxaa la qorsheeyay in baaritaanno iyo tijaabooyin badan lagu sameeyo arrintan, waxaa dawadan la siin doonaa bakeylaha ka hor inta aan lasoo gaarsiin banii'aadanka. Wuxuu qorshaha yahay in baaritaan buuxo lagu ogaado arrintani si loo ogaado waxtarka dawooyinka ragga ka hor istaaga inay wax uureeyaan. Fikradda ayaa ah in ragga ay qaadan karaan kaniiniga saacad ka hor galmada. Si ka duwan kaniiniga ay dumarka qaataan ee ka hortagga uurka, kan ragga kuma lug yeesho wax hormoonno ah. Saynisyahanada waxay sheegeen in tani ay tahay mid ka mid ah faa'iidooyinka kaniiniga oo ay baarayaan - meesha kama saari doono maadada testosterone isla markaana wax saameyn ah kuma yeelan doono yareynta hormoonka ragga. Taa baddalkeeda, "Dabbaasha ay sameyso shahwada" waxay weecisaa inta badan unugyada astaanta ah ee beegsada borotiinka ee loo yaqaanno adenyl cyclase ama sAC, kaniinigan loogu talagalay inay qaataan ragga si aysan wax u uureyn wuxuu xanibayaa maadada SAC. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Daraasad hore oo lagu sameeyay jiirarka, oo ay maalgaliyeen machadyada caafimaadka ee Mareykanka taasoo lagu daabacay joornaalka Nature Communications, hal xabbo oo daawadan ah, oo lagu magacaabo TDI- , ayaa xannibtay dabbaasha shahwada xilliga iyo ka dib galmada. Saameynta dawadan waxay socotay ilaa saddex saacadood. Ilaa saacadoodna, waxay u muuqatay mid gebi ahaanba jirka kasii baaba'ayso. Mid ka mid ah saynisyahannadaas, oo lagu magacaabo Dr. Melanie Balbach oo ka socota machadka Weill Cornell Medicine oo ku yaalla magaalada New York, ayaa sheegtay in kaniinigan si fudud loogu adeegsan karo ka hortagga uurka. Haddii ugu dambeyntii uu kaniinigan wax tar u noqdo banii'aadanka, ragga waxay qaadan karaan mar kasta, waxay go'aan ka gaari karaan xilligga ay wax dhali karaan. Khuburrada waxay ka digeen in dawadan aysan ka hortagin cudurrada lagu kala qaado galmada. Professor Allan Pacey, oo ah barafasoor ku takhasusay cudurada ku dhaca ragga oo ka tirsan Jaamacadda Sheffield, ayaa sheegay: "Waxaa jirta baahi weyn oo loo qabo in la helo kanini ay ragga qaataan oo wax ku ool ah, oo macquul ah, in kasta oo sanadihii lasoo dhaafay la sameeyay baaritaanno dhowr ah oo ku aaddan arrintani, hadana mana jirto daawo lagu guuleystay oo suuqa laga heli karo". "Habka halkan lagu sharraxay, ayaa ah in enzyme-ka muhiimka ah ee shahwada laga saaro, waa fikrad gebi ahaanba cusub. Laakiin Xaqiiqda ah in ay wax ka qaban karto, oo dib loo rogi karo, si dhakhso ah waa mid aad u xiiso badan. "Haddii tijaabooyinkaas lagu sameeyay jiirka si lamid ah loogu sameeyo banii'aadanka lana ogaado waxtarkeeda, waxay dawada noqon kartaa in ragga ay u isticmaalaan inay kaga hortaggaan uurka, waana guul in muddo ah la raadinayay".

Raashinka: Iska ilaali siddeed cunto oo sababi kara gaaska caloosha Socodka waa shey dabiici ah. Qofka caadiga ah wuxuu socdaa ilaa jeer maalintii. Balse haddii caloosha aad ka qabto gaas kuuma suuragaleyso in aad caafimaad ku sameyso lugeys ama jimicsi kale. Dabcan waxaa intaas sii dheer xanuun iyo dhibaato shakhsi ahaaneed. Khubarada waxay ku doodaan in waxyaabaha laab-jeexa keena ay yihiin kuwo u wanaagsan caafimaadkaaga guud, sida caleenta maaddada fiber-ka laga helo iyo cuntooyinka carbohydrates-ka. Jirkaaga awood uma laha inuu burburiyo raashinkan balse bakteeriyada ku jirta dheef shiidkaaga ayaa shaqadaas qabaneysa. Sidaas darteed, maxay yihiin noocyada cuntooyinka aad u baahan tahay marka aad soconeysid, raashinka noocee ah ayaa sababa shiirka badan ee jirka, waase goormee marka aad u baahan tahay inaad dhakhtar la tashato? Cuntooyinka dufanka leh waxay gaabis ka dhigaan shaqada dheef shiidka, sidaas darteed raashinkaas wuxuu ku daahayaa uur ku jirtaada, wuu ku dhex qurmayaa wuxuuna sababi karaa inay neeftaada soo shiirto. Hilibka baruurta leh waxaa ku badan maaddooyinka aashitada wata ee amino-acids, methionine iyo sulfur. Bakteeriyada jirkaaga ayaa burburineysa sulfur-kii kaddibna waxay ka dhigeysaa nooc kale oo ah "hydrogen sulfide". Markaas wuxuu usoo urayaa sida ukun quruntay oo kale. Arrintaas waxay kordhineysaa xaddiga gaaska ee calooshaada ay sii deyso marka aad cunto hilibka iyo raashinka kale, sidaas ayuuna laab jeex ku imaanayaa marka gaaskii tirada badnaa uu usoo gudbo meelo ka baxsan caloosha. Khudaarta caleenta ah waxaa ku badan maaddada fiber-ka oo uu jirkeenna u baahan yahay, balse waxay sidoo kale wadataa sokor ay seynisyahannada u yaqaannaan "raffinose". Skortaas jirkaaga lama falgali karo, sidaas darteedna waxaa ka imaan kara jahwareer caafimaad oo dhanka dheef shiidka ah. Toos waxay u aadeysaa mindhicirrada oo u isticmaalaya tamar ahaan. Hannaankaas waxaa ka dhalanaya "hydrogen, methane" waxaana ka abuurmaya neef ur badan. Fikrado kala duwan ayay dadka ka qabaan ukunta, balse inteenna badan gaas kama dhaxalno cunista ukunta. Laakiin waxaa xaqiiqo ah inay ku jirto maaddada methionine oo ka kooban Sulfur. Marka haddii aad dooneyso in aadan si xun u shiirin ukunta haku cunin raahinka kale ee dufanka leh. Haddii ay calooshaada aariyo ku dibirto ama aad shubanto marka aad ukun cunto, waxaa suuragal ah in uusan dheef shiidkaaga si fiican ula shaqeyneynin ukunta ama aad xasaasiyad ku qabto. Basasha, toonta iyo cuntooyinka la midka ah waxay sababi karaan aariyo caloosha ka buuxsanta oo sababa dibiro ama gaas. Caanaha lo'da iyo kuwa ariga waxay ka sameysan yihiin maaddo la yiraahdo "lactose" oo kordhisa gaaska sokorta. Taas waxaa kasii muhiimsan in % ka mid ah dadka waaweyn ee ku nool caalamka aysan awood u lahayn inuu dheef shiidkooda burburiyo lactose, waxayna u badan tahay inay ka cawdaan gaas iyo laab jeex haddii ay cunaan raashinka ka sameysan caanaha. Maaddooyin gaaska badan soo saara iyo fiber ayaa ku jira qamadiga iyo badarka kale ee qolofta leh, sida galleyda iyo masagada. Marka uu raashinka noocan ah dheef shiidka ku adkaado waxay caloosha soo saartaa aashito gaas ah oo ka tiro badan xaddigii loo baahnaa. Si la mid ah khudaarta kale ee cagaaran, kabashka, broccoli iyo caleenta kale ee noocaas ah waxay dhammaantood dhibaan dheef shiidka, kaddibna caloosha waxay ka dhigataa tamar si ay u soo saarto gaas xad dhaaf ah oo shiida ama burburiya. In badan oo ka mid ah khudaartan waxay abuuraan sulfur, sidaas darteed waad qiyaasi kartaa sida uu urkooda u xoog badan yahay. Qaar badan oo ka mid ah miraha khudaarta ah, sida tufaaxa, cambaha iyo kuwa la midka ah waxay ku jiraan raashinka ay adag tahay in si dhakhso ah uu caloosha ugu burburo. Mararka qaar tufaaxa iyo khudaarta isagoo kale ah waxay leeyihiin fiber waxtar weyn u leh caloosha inkastoo dhanka kalena ay kordhinayaan gaaska. Dad badan way ku adag tahay inay dheef shiidka ku baabi'iyaan haddana kama maarmi karaan. Gabagabadii, dhakhtar la tasho haddii raashinka noocyadan ah ay kuu horseedayaan dhibaato ka badan sida caadiga ah.

Somaliland oo BBC-da u faahfaahisay socdaalka Madaxweyne Cirro ee Qadar . Wafti uu hoggaaminayo madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Iskeed ugu Dhawaaqday Madaxbannaanida ee Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro ayaa maalmihii la soo dhaafay booqasho ku joogay dalka Qadar, halkaasi oo ay kula kulmeen mas'uuliyiin ka mid ah dawladda Qadar oo uu ku jiro Ra'iisul Wasaaraha ahna Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Qadar, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Bin Jasim Al-Thani. Socdaalkan ayaa waxa uu noqonaya kii ugu horreeyay ee madaxweyne Somaliland ahi uu ku tago dalka Qadar. Wasiirka madaxtooyada Somaliland Khadar Xuseen Cabdi ayaa BBC-da uga warramay socdaalka madaxweynaha oo uu sheegay mid ay uga gol lahaayeen raadinat iskaashi dhaqaale oo ay Somaliland la samaysato dalka Carbeed ee Qadar. "Ujeeddada socdaalkaygu waxay qayb ka ahayd safrro uu madaxweyuhu muddooyinkii la soo dhaafay ku tagayay dalal dhowr ah. Tan ugu weyni waxa ay ahayd sidii ay Somaliland iskaashi ula yeelan lahayd waddamada adduunka. Hore waxa aanu u tagnay Imaaraadka Carabta, Jabuuti iyo Kenya," ayaa uu yidhi. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in mas'uuliyiinta ay la kulmeen oo ay ka mid yihiin raysalwsaaraha dalkaas, wasiiru-dawlada arrimaha dibadda iyo wasiirka ganacsiga ay kala hadleen iskaashi dhaqaale oo ay la samaysteen Somaliland. "Waxaanu caalamka u sheegnay in Somaliland anay ahayn dal gamo madhan oo baahan. Bal se ay leedahya fursado waaweyn oo la maalgashan karo, gaar ahaan dhinacyada xoolaha, beeraha iyo kalluunka. Qadar-na taas ayaan kala hadalnay isfanna waanu ka gaadhnay. Waxana rajynaynaa in ay Somalialand waftiyo ka socda Qadar yimaadddaan si ay u darsaan." Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda ee Qatar, waxa uu Ra'iisul Wasaaraha ahna Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Qatar Sheekh Maxamed bin Cabdiraxmaan bin Jassim Al Thani, xaqiijiyey kulanka uu la yeeshay madaxweynaha Somaliland. "Intii kulanku socday, waxaa la is dhaafsaday aragtiyo ku saabsan xaaladaha cusub ee ka taagan Soomaaliya, muhiimadda ay leedahay taageeridda dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda iyo xasilloonida, iyo sidoo kale siyaabaha kala duwan ee lagu xoojin karo kalsooni-dhiska dhinacyada kala duwan." ayaa lagu yidhi War-saxaafadeed ay ku baahiyeen boggooda arrimaha dibedda. Wasiirka madaxtooyada Somaliland ayaan sidoo kale waxa ka weyddiinay wararka sheegaya in labada dhinac ay isla soo qaadeen xaaladaha amni iyo tan siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. "Soomaaliya isku gobol ayaanu ku naallaa. Sidaas darteed, si guud gobolka xasilloonidiiisa waanu ka wada hadalnay. Waxaa kale oo aannu isla soo qaadnay iskaashiga dhaqaalaha ee gobolka iyo sidii looga wada faa'iidaysan lahaa," ayaa uu yidhi wasiirka madaxtooyada Somaliland. War-saxaafadeedka ka soo baxay dawladda Qatar ayaa lagu yidhi "Ra'iisul Wasaaraha iyo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Qatar waxa uu intii kulankan uu socday caddeeyey in Dawladda Qatar ay aamisan tahay in mustaqbalka Soomaaliya uu ku xidhan yahay furfurnaanta iyo wada-shaqeynta dhaxalgalka ah ee u dhaxeysa dhammaan qaybaha bulshada Soomaaliyeed, taasoo lagu xaqiijinayo ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada qaranka ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya". Axmed Zaki Faarax Iidle oo ah falanqeeye siyaasaddeed oo la hadlay BBC-da ayaa tilmaamay in kala duwanaanta qaabka ay Somaliland iyo Qatar uga hadleen kulankankan uu muujiyey in labada dhinac ay qolo walba cid gaar ah farriin u diraysay. "Waxaad mooddaa marka aad akhrido War-saxaafadeedka Qatar in luuqadda ay ku hadlaysay ay muujinaysay in aanay waxba iska beddelin mowqifkeedii ay Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya kula macaamilaysay, halka Somaliland ay qoraal ku soo saartay Af-Soomaali oo ay dadkeeda kula hadashay luuqadda siyaasadda gudaha oo ay u sheegayaan in ay kala hadlayaan Qatar danaha Somaliland, markaa waxa muuqata in aanay jirin hal qodob oo labada war-saxaafadeed mideeya". Axmed Zaki Faarax Iidle, waxa uu xusay inuu aamisan tahay in ay jiri karaan waxyaabo laga wada hadlay oo labada dhinac midna aanu ku soo bandhin qoraallada ay soo kala saareen, waxaanu yidhi "Waxa dhici karta aragtiyada in laga wada hadlay qodobkii Madaxweyne Trump ka hadlay ee aan weli soo shaac bixin ee la xidhiidhay sidii Falasiiniyiinta Gaza loo soo rari karo, Somaliland-na loogu beddeli lahaa aqoonsi ay dawladda Mareykanku aqoonsato" ayuu sii raaciyey. Wasiirka madaxtooyada Somaliland, Khadar Xuseen Cabdi oo BBC-du weyddiisay sida uu u arko warsaxaafadeedka ka soo baxay dhinaca Qatar ayaa ku jawaabay in dal walba uu xaq u leeyahay waxa warsaxaafadeedkiisa gaarka ah, laakiin dhinacooda ay u arkayaan in ay guul ka gaadheen ujeeddada ay u tageen dalka Qatar. "Waddamadu iyaga ayaa garanaya waxa ay odhanayaan. Qadar iyo dalalka kalaba waxa ay ka siman yihiin in aanay aqoonsanayn Somaliland. Waana arrin hubaal ah in aanay Somaliland aqoonsi haysan. Laakiin waxa weyn oo dhib ahi kuma jirto warsaxaafadeedka waddanku soo saarayo. Nuxurka waa ujeeddada iyo waxa laga wada hadlay. Guul ayaanan ka gaadhnay."

Baraf dad ku dilay dalka Japan Ugu yaraan qof oo isugu jiray arday iyo macallimiin ayaa la fahamsan yahay inay ku dhinteen Japan, ka dib markii uu baraf ku soo dumay. Waxay ka qayb qaadanayeen safar ay ku aadeen buur, meel u dhow magaalada bartamaha ku taalla ee Nasu. Sideedda qof oo barafka hoostiisa laga soo saaray kama muuqan wax astaan ah oo ka mid ah astaamaha nolosha, lagumana dhawaaqin inay naftu ka baxday. Afar kale oo arday iyo macallimiin isugu jira ayaa la la' yahay. In ka badan arday oo ka kala socday iskuul ayaa wakhtigaas buurta dusheeda saarnaa. Baraf xoog leh ayaa labadii maalmood e u dambeeyey halkaa ka da'ayey. Japan oo dhisaysa kombuterkii ugu waynaa adduunka Japan iyo Shiinaha oo isku haya dhul 'Carruurta Tanzania oo ugu caafimaad badan adduunka oo dhan'

Uganda oo billowday tijaabada tallaalka xanuun uu ka walaacsan yahay dal Soomaaliya deris la ah Dalka Uganda ayaa bilaabay tijaabada tallaalka cudurka Ebola gaar ahaanna nooca Suudaan, kadib markii uu dib u dillaacay mar kale. Ma jiro tallaal ansax ah oo loogu tala galay nooca Suudaan ee Ebola. Arrinkaasi ayaa ka dambeeyay kadib markii cudurku ka dillaacay dalkaas hal qofna uu dilay labo kalena ay qaadeen. Bukaankii ugu horreeyay oo ah nin jir ahaa oo kalkaaliye caafimaad ahaa ayaa toddobaadkii hore geeriyooday. Isniintii, qofkii ugu horreeyay ee tijaabada ka qeyb qaatay oo haatan karantiil ku jira ayaa helay kuuro tallaalka ah ama lagu muday. Tallaalka ayaa waxaa soo saaray mashruuca dadaalka tallaalka AIDS ee caalamiga ah oo ah urur aan faa'iido-doon ahayn. Hal tallaal yaa jira hadda. Si kastaba há ahaatee, nooca Zaire ayaa ku badnaa DR Congo. Dhowaan, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Kenya ayaa digniin dadweyne soo saartay kaddib markii cudurka Ebola nooca loo yaqaaan (Sudan Ebola Virus Disease) laga xaqiijiyay dalka deriska la ah ee Uganda. Sida ay qortay Hay'adda Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) fayraskaan Suudaan waxuu lamid yahay lana bah yahay fayraska Ebola, waana xanuun darran oo cadadka dadka uu ku dhaco dhimashoodoodu badantahay qiyaastiina gaadhayso sida ay sheegtay hay'addu % Illaa % marka la eego safmareenadiisii hore. Waxayna sidoo kale Hay'adda Caafimaadku Adduunku xustay in maqnaanshaha dawadiisa iyo hababkiisa ka hortag ay keenayso saamayn ba'an uu yeelan karo xanuunkani. Xoghayaha Guud ee Caafimaadka Dadweynaha dalka Kenya, Mary Muthoni, ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in dowladda ay ka go'an tahay badbaadinta muwaadiniinta maaddaama xadka Kenya iyo Uganda uu yahay mid furan. Waxay xustay in la xoojin doono kormeerka dhammaan goobaha laga soo galo dalka. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Calaamadaha caabuqa Ebola waxaa ka mid ah qandho, daal, murqo xanuun, madax-xanuun, cune xanuun, oo ay ku xigaan matag, shuban, finan, iyo dhiig-bax gudaha iyo dibadda ah. Waxa lagu kala qaadaa marka la taabto dareere iyo unugyo jireed oo buka. Cudurka Ebola ee Sudan ayaa ah mid aad u daran, wuxuuna dilaa ugu yaraan % dadka uu ku dhaco cudurko, sida ay sheegtay hay'adda caafimaadka adduunka ee WHO. Uganda waxaa hadda ka dilaacay cudurka markii lixaad. Ilaa ka mid ah dad ay istaabteen dhibbaneyaasha ayaa la tallaali doonaa wejigan soo-bandhigidda ah ee ay si wadajir ah u fulinayaan mas'uuliyiinta Uganda iyo WHO, sida ay hay'adda Qaramada Midoobay ku sheegtay bayaan Isniintii. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Uganda ayaa xaqiijisay qof inay jiraan kuwaasi oo ay is taabteen dadka la xaqiijiyay inay cudurka qaadeen. WHO ayaa la kaashanaysa wasaaradda caafimaadka Uganda, machadka cilmi-baarista fayraska Uganda, iyo Machadka Sambabka ee Jaamacadda Makerere si ay tijaabadan u fuliyaan. Arrinkan ayaa ah astaanta guul weyn oo ah dhanka waxqabadka degdegga ah waxaa uuna muujinayaa awoodda iskaashiga ee loogu tala galay sugnaanta caafimaadka ee caalamiga ah, sida ay sheegtay agaasimaha Afrika ee WHO. Matshidiso Moeti ayaa intaasi ku dartay in haddii la xaqiijiyo inuu waxtar leeyahay tallaalku uu sii xoojin doono tallaabooyinka looga badbaadinaayo bulshooyinka dillaacitaanka cudurka mustaqbalka. In nooca Sudan ee fayrasku dillaacay ayaa horay looga xaqiijiyay gudaha Uganda September wuxuuna dilay in ka badan qof. Waxaase shaaca laga qaaday Janaayo . Inkastoo Uganda ay heli kartay isla tallaalka tijaabada ah ee haatan la hadal hayo waqtigaas, tijaabooyinka ayaanan la samayn kareyn inta safmarku uusan dhammaan ka hor. Dabayaaqadii toddobaadka, kuurooyinkii ugu horreeyay oo dhan , oo ah tallaalka tijaabada ah iyo daawooyin ayaa la keenay xarunta Uganda ee Kampala. Hay'adaha caafimaad iyo kooxaha cilmi-baarista ayaa u shaqeeyay si degdeg ah ayagoo cilmibaareyaasha la wargaliyay, ayadoo la diyaariyay tas'hiilaadka lana dejiyay borotakoollo daraasadeed.

Somaliland oo BBC uga warrantay waxay Davos ka hayso, iyo Eric Trump wixii ay ka wada hadleen. , Somaliland TV Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa kulammo heer sare ah ku yeeshay magaalada Davos ee dalka Switzerland, kuwaas oo ka dhacay dhinacyada Shirweynaha Dhaqaalaha Adduunka, iyadoo dadaalladu diiradda saarayeen xoojinta xiriirka caalamiga ah iyo soo jiidashada maalgashi shisheeye. Kulammadan oo ay ka mid ahaayeen wada-hadallo uu la yeeshay Madaxweynaha Israa'iil Isaac Herzog iyo Eric Trump — oo ah wiilka Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump isla markaana ah madaxweyne ku-xigeenka fulinta ee shirkadda Trump Organization — ayaa ka dhacay casho gaar ah oo ay ka qayb galeen siyaasiin sar-sare iyo ganacsato caalami ah. Mas'uuliyiinta Somaliland ayaa sheegay in kulammadu diiradda saareen iskaashi dhaqaale, fursado maalgashi iyo doorka istaraatiijiyadeed ee gobolka ee marinnada ganacsiga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in dalku u furan yahay maalgashi, isaga oo si gaar ah u muujiyay dekedda biyaha-dheer ee Berbera, taas oo loo arko xarun mustaqbalka muhiim u noqon karta saadka, ganacsiga iyo kaabeyaasha tamarta. La-taliyaha sare ee Dhaqaalaha ee Madaxweyne Cirro Dr Cabdiraxmaan Ducaale Bayle ayaan BBC-da u xaqiijiyey in ay Eric Trump ka wada hadlan dhanka fursadaha ganacsi ee Somaliland, isaga oo sheegay in uu danayn muujiyey. Waxaan u sharraxnay Somaliland iyo khayraadkeeda, isaguna waxa uu muujiyay xiise uu u qabo Somaliland iyo fursadaha ay leedahay. Arrimaha aan ka wada hadalnay waxaa ka mid ahaa sidii maalgeliyeyaal caalami ah loogu soo jiidi lahaa dhinacyada xoolaha nool iyo beeraha, si aan u warshadaynno una dhoofinno suuqyada caalamka. Dhanka kale, hoggaamiyeyaal kale oo dunida ah ayaannu la wadaagnay khayraadkeenna dabiiciga ah sida gaaska iyo macdanaha." Ayuu BBC-da u sheegay Dr Bayle. Dhanka kale Dr Cabdiraxmaan Bayle, ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in hab-fekerka dawladdu is beddelay. "Markii ugu horreysay, dunida kama codsanayno gargaar," ayuu yidhi. "Waxaan u soo bandhigaynaa khayraadkeenna. Shacabkeenna waa dad u furan iskaashi, maalgashi iyo koboc wadaag ah." Eric Trump ayaa ka hor cashada ka qayb-galay kulan kale oo gaar ah oo ay martigelisay isla madasha Davos Lodge, kaas oo cinwaankiisu ahaa Isbeddellada Caalamiga ah iyo Fursadaha Suuqyada Horumaray. Inkasta oo uusan ahayn mas'uul dowladeed, Eric Trump waa Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Fulinta ee ururka qoyska Trump, isla markaana madaxweynaha Mareykanka waxyaabo badan kala taliya.
