Kulanku wuxuu ahaa mid martiqaad kaliya lagu galayay, oo qabanqaabiyeyaasha ayaa dad gaar ah casuumayay kuwaas oo aysan shaacin. Laakiin BBC Somali ayaa gaarkeeda u fiirisay sawirrada uu Madaxweyne Cirro la wadaagay bulshada, waxaana ka aqoonsanay magacyo waaweyn oo cashada joogay, anagoo kaashaynaa, xogta khadka ku jirta, aaladaha aqoonsi wajiyeedka iyo keydka munaasabada oo qeyb kamid ah martidu cinwaanadooda gaarka ah soo galiyeen. Mas'uuliyiinta ugu sarreeya ee aanu xaqiijinay waxaa ka mid ahaa Nir Barkat, Wasiirka Dhaqaalaha iyo Warshadaha ee Israel. Waa xubin ka tirsan golaha wasiirrada, horeyna u soo noqday duqa magaalada Qudus, isaga oo door muhiim ah ka ciyaara diblomaasiyadda dhaqaale ee Israel iyo xiriirka ay la leedahay maalgashadayaasha caalamiga ah.

The woman helping amputees rebuild their lives in war-torn Ukraine Serhiy Petchenko lost both hands while defending Ukraine from Russian invaders in June . After surviving the bitter months-long battle for the city of Bakhmut, his injury came in a railway incident further from the front line. It left the -year-old feeling helpless and in despair. After the amputations, his wife, Anna, had to remain by his side / for six months. "What helped us survive is our love," says Serhiy. But it's hard to believe he went through such an ordeal when you see him now, standing on the doorstep of a brand-new café, which he is about to open in Lviv, in the west of Ukraine. He smiles widely, his arms - and hands - by his side. Serhiy received two prosthetic hands and full rehabilitation at the Superhumans Center, a private clinic for people with war injuries, located outside the city. At the same time, the couple received the training they needed to open a family business. Serhiy says the centre gave him a chance to return normal life, while learning to live with a new disability. At least , Ukrainians have lost limbs in nearly three years of war according to the Ukrainian Health Ministry - both soldiers and civilians. "Some people have double, triple, quadruple amputations. All these people will need prosthetics, or some will use wheelchairs," says Olga Rudnieva, CEO and co-founder of the Superhumans Center. Many amputations are the result of delays in evacuation from the battlefield. The barrage of incoming fire can be so intense that it may take many hours to get a wounded soldier to hospital. With more than one million people on the front line, Rudnieva says, Ukraine will become "the country of people with disabilities". "We want to normalise disability. OK, that's how the country is going to look," she says, describing the thinking behind her centre. "Most of the people here at the centre shouldn't be alive. The fact that they are is a miracle in itself." Rudnieva co-founded the centre amid the Russian missile attacks that have rained down on the country since February . Some people called her "crazy" but she went ahead anyway. "If I have an opinion, I'm sharing my opinion. If I know what to do, I just go and do it," she says. Her partners and team raised funds all over the world for high-quality prosthetics and reconstructive surgery. Her passionate presentation, explaining how injuries can be empowering, turned some celebrities into Superhumans supporters, including British adventurer Bear Grylls, Virgin boss Richard Branson, singer Sting and actress Trudie Styler. "We truly believe that you can be empowered by trauma. The trauma can ruin you or it can build your superpower," she says. The Superhumans Center supplements Ukraine's military hospitals and clinics, which are overloaded with the constant flow of wounded soldiers from the ,200km long front line. Since it opened in April , more than , patients have received treatment here - both military and civilian, adults and children. Almost of them have received prosthetic limbs. "It's the global headquarters of resilience," says -year-old Rudnieva. walking energetically between patients' wheelchairs. They are waiting for modern prosthetics or are already practising to use their new limbs. She asks some of the young men around, with double and triple amputations, to show her what they have learnt so far. Ukrainian soldiers use callsigns instead of names, and Rudnieva has one too - "Mum". "They learned to walk with their mothers, and I was the second person they learned how to walk with," she says proudly. At the start of the war, Ukraine was not ready to support so many people with disabilities. "Ukrainian soldiers are less afraid to be killed than to be wounded, because a severe injury means you are going to be disabled for the rest of your life – and the infrastructure is not right, and society is not ready, and the healthcare system is not right," says Rudnieva. A few times a day she visits the rehabilitation room where the "superhumans", as she calls them, are learning to walk again. Among the battle-hardened men is gentle Olena, a bakery manager from the city of Kostiantynivka in eastern Ukraine. She lost her leg in a Russian rocket strike on the way to her mum's birthday party. "The first thing I'll do when I have my artificial leg, if the weather is fine, is just go for a walk. Without any rush, without an aim. I'll just take a walk to recall how it feels," she says. At present she uses a leg that belongs to the rehabilitation room, but soon she will have one of her own. Rudnieva remembers Olena's story in detail, and the stories of her other patients. She knows about their wives and husbands, parents and pre-war jobs. "Younger guys bring me their girlfriends and ask my opinion," she says, with a smile. Couples have even come came to her before taking a decision on whether to divorce or not. A severe war injury is a challenge not just for the survivor, but for his or her entire family, and it tests relationships. Showing the newly equipped children's room, Rudnieva smiles. "We are waiting today for Nazarchyk, Serhiy and Anna's son. He is so active. He will turn it upside down." Rudnieva says that her work has taught her to value life as never before, and also to stop fearing death. Once a director of the Olena Pinchuk Foundation, working to halt the spread of HIV/Aids across Ukraine, she was abroad when Russia invaded. For a few months she ran a humanitarian aid hub in Poland, then she returned to Ukraine and founded her life-changing project. She wasn't the only one. Ukrainian civil society quickly rallied round, both to support the war effort - fundraising for drones and vehicles, importing medical equipment or clothing - and to keep society going while the country fought for its life. There are now other private rehabilitation centres, ambulances and taxis that help evacuate people from half-destroyed towns, food services for refugees, and many other initiatives that supplement services provided by the state. And women have played a key role. "When the full-scale invasion started, I, as a feminist, was very scared. I thought that it's the end of feminism, because war is a very masculine thing," Rudnieva says. But later on she realised that women have taken over many responsibilities as men have gone away to fight, as well as in some cases becoming fighters too. "I think that women proved to be absolutely amazing during this war," says Rudnieva, as some of her words are drowned out by sirens - part of the soundtrack of Ukraine's new life. "I'm really proud to be among Ukrainian women." BBC Women names inspiring and influential women around the world every year. Follow BBC Women on Instagram and Facebook. Dhowr tilmaamood oo kuu sahlaya sida aad u kala saari karto sawirka saxda ah iyo kan garaadka macmalka ah Dunida casriga ah waxaa soo badanaya sawirrada qaabka dhijitaalka ah loogu badali karo dhawr nooc ama xitaa laga soo saaro qaab kale oo asal ahaanba ka duwan sida saxda ah, iyadoo la adeegsanayo garaadka macmalka ah ee loo yaqaanno (AI), way sii adkaanaysaa in la aamino waxa ay indhaheenu arki karaan. Farsamooyinka loo isticmaalo in sawirada lagu maamulo waa kuwo aad u casriyeysan, dabcan waxa aan galnay duni ka duwan tii hore marka ay noqoto habka casriga ah ee tiknoolojiyadda, waxa aan galnay xilligii been-abuurka la barbar dhigayay waaqiciga iyo waxa saxda ah ee jira. Sawirrada noocan oo kale ah ee la beddelo waxay horseedi karaan faafitaanka macluumaadka khaldan waxayna xitaa saameyn ku yeelan karaan ra'yiga dadweynaha iyo dhacdooyinka muhiimka ah sida doorashooyinka. Iyada oo sawirka boqoradda Wales iyo carruurteeda lagala baxay wakaaladaha wararka ayaa waxaa laga walaacsanyahay sida "loo maareeyay", waxaana lasoo dhex dhigay baraha waliba si aan horay loo arag. Haddaba, ma jiraan waxyaabo aan sameyn karno si aan u aragno sawirka laga yaabo in la beddelay ama AI lagu sameeyay? Iftiin aan caadi ahayn inta badan waa astaanta in sawirka la bedelay. Hubi dhibcaha iftiinka ee indhaha dadka, tusaale ahaan, Isha gudeheeda iftiin ayaa inta badan ka muuqan doona dadka indhahooda. Haddii cabbirka iyo midabka aysan ku habboonayn goobta, ama haddii ay u muuqdaan kuwo kala duwan, markaa waxaa laga yaabaa inaad gasho xaalad shaki. Habka aragtida iyo walxaha ka muuqdaa dusha sare ee sawirka ayaa sidoo kale bixin kara tilmaamo. Hooska waxyaabaha sawirka ka muuqda ayaan wada muuqan karin haddii la isku daray sawirro badan, hase yeeshee maskaxda ku hay in sawirrada qaar lagu qaadi karo meelo iftiin badan. Waxaa habboon in la eego habka iftiinka u baxayo marka loo eego wajiga qofka. Haddii Qorraxdu ay gadaashooda taagantahay, tusaale ahaan, dhegahoodu waxay u ekaan karaan casaan ama guduud xigeen. Garaadka macmalka ah ayaa sidoo kale soo saari kara iftiin aan habooneyn iyo hoos aan markii hore jirin, laakiin sida cad, AI ayaa sameyn kara wejyo aad loo rumeysan karo xitaa marka loo eego aadanaha. , PRINCE OF WALES Habka kale ee xaqiiqo helidda waa in la raadiyo sifooyin ay adagtahay in mararka qaar la helo. Barnaamijkan AI ayaa hadda ku liita samaynta gacmaha iyo dhegaha ama hagaajinta qaababkooda iyo xitaa tirada faraha. Kuwani waa astaamo isku mid ah oo inta badan dhiba farshaxaniisteyaasha, laakiin sida dhinacyada kale ee sawirada AI lagu sameeyay dadku waxay u muuqdaan kuwo dhab ah, kuwaasi waxay abuuraan shaki aan caadi ahayn oo u muuqda mid aan dabiici u ahayn indhaheenna. Waxa hoose ee ku dhex qarsoon gunta sawirada dhijitaalka ah ayaa ah xogo badan oo kaa caawin kara in ay yihiin been abuur ama inkale. Mar kasta oo kamarad dhijitaal ahi ay sawirka qaaddo, xogo badan ayaa lagu qoraa faylka sawirka. Tusaale ahaan, Jadwalka waqtiga ayaa horseeday su'aalo ku saabsan in madaxweyne Donald Trump uu dhab ahaantii ka shaqeynayay Aqalka Cad maalin kadib markii uu shaaca ka qaaday in laga helay xanuunka Covid- bishii Oktoobar ee -kii. Dareemayaasha kamarad kasta oo dhijitaalka ah ayaa leh cillado yaryar oo wax soo saara kuwaas oo keena khaladaad gaar ah oo ka tagaya nooc la garan karo sida "faraha" ku sawirma ama laga dhex arki karo haddii si aad ah loo fiiriyo sawirada. Tani waxay markaa la xiriirtaa kamarad gaar ah waxayna kaa caawin kartaa in la aqoonsado sawirka la farsameeyay. Sawirka AI lagu sameeyay ma muujinayo in gacmaha lagu taabtay ama faro ay ku yaalliin. Shirkadaha internetka sida Google-ka ayaa soo saaray qalab lagu xaqiijinayo sawirka oo dadka ka caawin kara in ay ogaadaan sawirada AI ay soo saartay. Facebook iyo Instagram waxay bilaabeen inay calaamadiyaan sawirrada AI ay soo saartay ee ka imanaya ama lagasoo gelinayo dhinaca Meta waxayna shirkadaha kale qorsheynayaan inay sidaas oo kale ku sameeyaan sawirada ay soo saareen aaladaha AI.

Maaddo ku jirta cabitaan Soomaalidu isticmaasho oo la sheegay inay kansar sababto Maaddada macaan ee Aspartame oo laga helo cabitaanno kala duwan, cuntooyin iyo xanjoonka ama nacnaca ayaa si rasmi ah loogu daray waxayaabaha “kansarka ku sababa” aadmiga, sidaas waxaa ku doodaya warbixin caafimaad oo soo baxday. Digniinta ayaa dadka wareer ku abuurtay maaddaama aysan caddeyn inta ay la egtahay halistu – in ay tahay mid yar ama halis weyn. Waxayaabaha kale ee lagu daray kuwa “kansarka sababa” waxaa ka mid ah, dacarta, shidaalka diesel-ka iyo nooca khudaarta dadka Aasiya ugu keydiyaan daasadaha. Maaddada Aspartame waxay oo jeer ka macaan tahay sonkorta, sidaas darteed kalooriyad la’aan ayey bixisaa dhadhanka macaanka. Waxaad ka heli kartaa liiska maaddooyinka cuntooyin badan ama cuntooyinka aan sonkorta lahayn oo ay ku jiraan cabitaannada ay isticmaalaan dadka cayilka ka baqaya, xanjada iyo qaar ka mid ah caanaha la fariisiyey ee yoghurt. Cabitaannada caanka ah ee ay ku jirto aspartame waxaa ka mid ah cabitaanka shirkadda kooka koolla ee loo yaqaan Diet Coke, Coke Zero, Pepsi Max, iyo Up Free, laakiin macaaneeyahan ayaa ku jira ilaa , oo cuntooyin kala duwan ah. Maaddadan waxaa la isticmaalayey tobannaan sano waxaana ansixiyay hay'adaha badbaadada cunnada, laakiin waxaa jiray muran badan oo ku xeernaa. IARC, oo ah garabka cilmi-baarista kansarka ee Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka, ayaa dib u eegis ku sameyneysay ilaa , oo daraasadood, kuwaas oo ku saabsan xiriirka ka dhexeeya aspartame iyo kansarka. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters ayaa sheegtay in ay la hadashay ilo ku dhow hawlahan ay ururku wadaan, aspartame-na waxaa lagu suntay "Walxaha kansarka sababa" - laakiin waa maxay sumadani dhab ahaantii? BBC-du waxay fahamsan tahay in ogeysiisyada rasmiga ah ay samayn doonaan IARC iyo guddi khubaro gaar ah oo u xilsaaran maadooyinka cuntada - oo ay weheliso daabacaadda joornaalka caafimaadka ee Lancet Oncology 14ka bishan Luulyo . IARC waxay isticmaali doonta afar qeexitaan oo kala duwan: Qabyta – Kansar ku sababa aadmiga Qaybta 2A – u badan in ay kansar ku sababaan aadmiga Qaybta 2B – Suurta gal ah in ay kansar ku sababaan aadmiga Hase yeeshee halkan ayuu ka jiraa wareerka ugu badan. "Kala soocidda IARC waxba noogama sheegi doonto heerka dhabta ah ee khatarta ka imanaysa aspartame, sababtoo ah taasi maaha waxa kalasoocidda IARC ay ka dhigan tahay" ayuu yiri Kevin McConway, barfasoore ku takhasusay tirakoobka ee Jaamacadda Open. IARC waxay noo sheegaysaa sida ay caddayntu u xooggan tahay, ee maaha sida ay maadadu khatarta ugu tahay caafimaadkaaga. Qaybta "suurtogal" waxaa la adeegsadaa marka ay jirto caddaynta "xaddidan" ee dadka ama xogta laga helay tijaabooyinka xayawaanka. Waxaa ka mid ah naaftada, 'talc on perineum', nikkel, dacarta aloe vera, khudaarta daasadaha lagu keydiyo( qaab ay isticmaalaan dadka Aasiyada bari) iyo keydinta walxaha kiimikada ah. "Waxaanse carrabka ku adkeynayaa in caddaynta ah in waxyaalahan ay sababi karaan kansarku aysan aad u xoogganayn ama waxaa lagu dari lahaa kooxda ama 2A," ayuu raaciyay barfasoore McConway. Kala soocidda IARC waxay keentay jahawareer hore, waxaana lagu dhaleeceeyay inay abuureen qaylo-dhaan aan loo baahnayn. Markii hilibka cas ee la warshadeeyay lagu asteeyay wax kansar sababa, waxay keentay warbixino la mid ah sida kuwa sigaarka sigaarka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Hay'adda Caafimaadka Adduunka iyo Guddiga Khubarrada ee Ururka Cuntada iyo maadooyinka Cunnada lagu daro ayaa lagu wadaa inay soo warbixiyaan bisha Luulyo.

Muxuu yahay geedka Soomaaliya aan looga faa'iideysanin ee dunida muhiimka ka ah? Dacarta Cas waxaa laga helaa meelo badan oo ka mid ah Soomaaliya, hase yeeshee khubarada dhinaca seyniska waxay aaminsan yihiin inuu yahay geed dhif ah oo ay adag tahay in la helo. Horaantii sanadkii lasoo dhaafay, Dr. Mary Barkworth oo baratay Cilmiga Botony, kana ka tirsan Jaamacada Utah State University USA, ayaa geedkan oo afka qalaad lagu yiraahdo "Asphodelaceae" ka heshay Somaliland. Markii ugu horreysay waxay ku aragtay madxafka Jaamacadda Hargeysa. Maqaal ay ku daabacday wargeyska PUBFACTS, ee soo bandhiga xogaha seyniska, ayey ku sharraxday in geedkaas uu ka duwan yahay dhirta dacarta ee laga helo caalamka intiisa kale. Dr Barkworth ayaa diiwaanka ku gashay in loo aqoonsan yahay inay garatay geedkaas dhif iyo naadirka ah. Barfasoor Yaxye Sheekh Caamir, oo ah aqoonyahan ku takhasusay cilmiga dhaqaalaha, ayaa sheegay khubarada reer galbeedka ay mar walba magacooda ku qoraan helitaanka waxyaabo caadi ka ah bulshada Soomaalida dhankooda, si fiicanna ay muddo dheer usii yaqaanneen. "Waa la yaab in la yiraahdo 'Qofkii ugu horeeyay ee helay', soo annagu iyaga ka hor ma aqoon, oo waalidiinteenu uma isticmaali jirin Daawo ahaan." ayuu yidhi Yaxye Caamir oo la hadlay BBC-da. Wuxuu qoraal dheer oo uu kaga hadlayay sida uu geedkan muhiim uga yahay caalamka iyo sida aan Soomaaliya looga faa'iideysanin ku shaaciyay boggiisa Facebook. Dhanka kale, Barfasoor Yaxye ayaa Soomaalida ku dhiirrigaliyay inay dhaqaale ahaan iyo dawo ahaanba uga faa'iideystaan geedkan. "Dhaqan ahaan waxaan ugu soo isticmaali jirnay daawo ahaan, laakiin hadda waxaa kale oo looga faa'iideysan karaa in la warshadeeyo oo cabitaan ahaan laga dhigto. Wuxuu geedkan u roon yahay kansarka naaska ku dhaca iyo cudurrada wadnaha. Annagu waxyaabo badan uma isticmaalo, sababtoo ah ma garaneyno, waxaa kaliya oo aan u isticmaalnaa maqaarka kore." Ayuu yidhi. Sida uu Yaxye sheegayo, waxyaabaha ugu badan oo loo adeegsado dhacaanka dacarta waxaa ka mid ah in lagu qallajiyo ama lagu baabi'iyo nabarrada kasoo baxa maqaarka, in xoolaha laga mariyo cadhada, dadka indhaha caadka ka saarmo oo looga dhicbiyo iyo in digaagga loogu daro biyaha. Dhawaan ayey ahayd markii khubaro Soomaali ah ay ka fal celiyeen war kasoo baxay seynisyahanno reer Galbeed ah oo sheegay inay Jabuuti ka heleen xayawaan dhif ah oo aan la arkin muddo sano ah. Noolahaas, oo loo yaqaanno Walo San-dheer ayaase si caadi ah u joogay inta badan dhulka Soomaalida. Inta badan arrimaha ku saabsan waxyaabaha laga helo Soomaaliya ee aan laga warqabi caalami ahaan ayaa loo aaneeyaa in muddadii uu dalka burbursanaa aan la diiwaan galinin macluumaad badan oo ku saabsan xayawaanka iyo dhirtaba. Cilmi Baareyaal ayaa ogaaday in Dacar Cas oo laga helo Jamhuuriyadda iskeed ugu dhawaaqda madaxbannaanida ee Somaliland ay tahay mid aan lagu arag dunida inteeda kale, sida uu BBC-da horay ugu sheegay Axmed Ibraahim Cawaale oo madax ka ah xarun ka shaqaysa daryeelka iyo badbaadinta dhirta oo layiraahdo Candle Light. "Dacartan ayaa noqonaysa middii -aad ee dhulka Soomaalida laga helo, inta la ogyahay" ayuu intaas ku daray Axmed." Maadaama oo aynan dacartu ku cusbayn dadka Soomaalida ah sidee lagu ogaaday in ay tahay nooc gooni ah ayay BBC-du waydiisay Axmed. Cilmi baareyaasha ayaa sheegay in ay iskood baaritaan u sameeyeen ka dibna la kaashadeen xarun caalami ah oo lagu aruuriyo dhirta adduunka oo dhan. Markii ugu horreysay ee fikradda baadhitaanka ay imaaneysay, Axmed oo safar ah ayay soo jiidatay qaabka ay u samaysan tahay dacarta sannadkii . "Waxaa markiiba isoo jiitay in ay tahay dacar si baahsan u fidda oo isku qabsata, dhinac ilaa mitir ayay gaarraysay, dhinaca kalana mitir". Markii uu u kuurgalay waxaa ku dhalatay in uusan halkaa ka hadhin, sannadkii xigay ee ayuuna billaabay cilmibaarasta Dacarta Cas. "Dacartu waxay ku kala duwan tahay ubaxa iyo qaabka ay u samaysan yihiin, qodxaha yaryar ee dacarta intay isu jiraan, waxyaabahaas iyo baaritaanno kale ayaa lagu kala saaraa" ayuu yiri Axmed oo BBC-da la hadlay.

Sooyaalka abwaan Saxardiid Jebiye oo saaka Hargaysa ku geeriyooday Allah ha u naxariistee waxa magaalada Hargaysa ku geeriyooday abwaankii weynaa ee Saxardiid Maxamuud Cilmi oo ku magac dheeraa Saxardiid Jebiye. Saxardiid Jabiye waxa uu -kii ku dhashay magaalada Hargaysa, wuu ku barbaaray waxaanu maanta ku geeriyooday isla magaalada Hargaysa. Abwaan saxardiin waxa uu ahaa hal abuur hibo gaar ah u leh tirinta maansada iyo falkinta codadka heesaha lagu qaado. Laxanno badan oo caan ah oo weliba kuwa loogu jecelyahay codadka Qaraamka ah ayuu magaciisu ku suntanyahay. Saxardiid wuxu halgan dheer oo af iyo adin ba leh kaga qayb galay halgankii xorriyad doonka ee gumaystihii Ingiriiska ay shacabkii Somaliland kaga soo horjeedeen. Waxaanay sugaantiisu waayadaa ka mid ahayd tii shucaaha xorriyad doonka ifisay ee Soomaalidii kale ee Geeska Afrika ku saaqday dareenka ummadnimo iyo xorriyada labada. Baadigoobka "gabadha ugu gabayga wanaagsan ee sannadkan ee laanta af Soomaaliga ee BBC" ayaa furmay Dhambaal gabay jacayl ah, ma u diri lahayd gabadh ku diiddan? Heeso badan oo wadani ah ayuu curiyey waxaana ka mid ah oo had iyo goor carrabka Soomaalid ku dikriyaa heeska caanka ah ee An Maallo Hasheena Maandeeq, taas oo uu laxankeeda lahaa isna Allah ha u naxariistee Cabdillaahi Maxamuud Xirsi oo ku magac dheeraa Cabdillaahi Qarshe. Barbaarkiisii iyo bilawgii fanka Allah ha u naxariistee Saxardiid Maxamuud Cilmi wuxu ku hano qaaday magaalada Hargaysa oo uu ku dhashay, waxaanu noqday dirawal. Markaa uu shaqada bilaabay waa marka hal abuurkiisu soo baxay ee ugu horrayn ay dhegaha ku culan jireen intii ay isku xirfadda ahaayeen oo keli ahi. Saxardiid oo ka hadlayey markii ugu horraysay ee suugaantiisu wada gaadho bulshada ee ay soo dhaaftay intii ay xirfadda iyo kaftan wadaagga ahaayeen ayaa yidhi "wixii qarsoonaa ee aan dee iska odhan jiray uuni way fara badnaayeen, laakiin markii codkaygu soo baxay ama ta'liiftaydu soo baxday waxay ahayd riyaawad aan sameeyey oo la odhan jiray 'Gardiid waa Alla diid' riwaayaddaa Maandeeq baa ku jirtay sagaal iyo kontonkii." Allah ha u naxariistee Saxardiid Jebiye waxay isku jiil ahaayeen oo ay fanka iyo suugaanta dhidibbo u wada ahaayeen hal doorkii casriyeeyey suugaanta Soomaalida ee hogaanka u qabtay fanka casriga ah. Waxa uu ka mid ahaa kooxdii Walaalaha Hargaysa ee muusiga ku ladhay heellooyinkii Soomaalida ee fanka casiraga ah ballaysimay. Abwaanadii ay mar wada kacaameen ee ay wada shaqayn jireen waxa ka mid ahaa, Allah ha u wada naxariisto dhamaantood e, Xuseen Aw-Faarax Dubbad, Barkhad-Cas, Cabdillaahi Qarshe iyo rag kale oo badan. Heesaha uu tiriyey Saxardiid Jebiye hooballadii qaaday ee soo bixitaankooda uu gacanta ku lahaa waxa ka mid ahaa Cimaan Maxamed Cabdikariin oo ku magac dheeraa Cimaan-gacanlaw, Xaliimo Khaliif Cumar oo ku magac dheerayd Magool, Axmed Muxumed Good oo ku magac dheeraa Shimbir, Hibo Maxamed oo dhamaantood ahaa hal doorkii hooballada Soomaalida. Allah ha u naxariistee Saxardiid Jebiye kuma koobnayn curinta suugaanta oo keli ah e waxa uu xataa qayb libaax ka qaatay kobicii heesaha casriga ah ee Soomaalida. Heesaha Qaraamka ah oo ah kuwa aan had iyo goor laga xiise goyn la'aantooda aan muusig Soomaali leedahay hano qaadeen ayaa waxa uu Saxardiid ku lahaa gacan weyn oo suurto gelisay hore u socodkoodii erayaa iyo codadkaba. Laxannada lagu qaado heesaha Qaraamka ah oo aad u faro badan, oo weliba waayadii hore ilaa haatan dadka sida gaarka ah u dhuuxaa codadka lagu qaado aanay odhan laxan ee ay adeegsadaan eray waayadaa u gaar ahaa oo ah 'sawd' ayaa Saxardiid kuwa ugu mucda weyn ee maanku aanu ka go'in lahaa curintooda. Hoobalka Maxamed Maxamuud Cige oo ku magac dheer Busi oo ayaa yidhi "codadka Qaraamka ee uu Saxardiid Jebiye allifay waxa ka mid ah sawdka Murug oo saddex siiqo oo kala duwan loogu luuqeeyo iyo sawdka kale ee Kaar oo dhammaantood ka mid ah kuwa ugu macaan codadka Qaraamka." Allah ha u naxariistee abwaan Saxarxii Maxamuud Cilmi beryahan ba wuxu u jiifay xanuun waxaana dhawaan lagu qalay isbitaal ku yaal dalka Turkiga oo lagu soo dabiibay. Waana xanuunka uu manta u geeriyooday. Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Muuse Biixi Cabdi, ayaa tacsi u diray qoyskii marxuumka iyo guud ahaan ba ummadda Soomaalida ee uu ka baxay abwaan Saxardiid Jebiye, waxaanu marxuumka ku sifeeyey abwaan qaranka ka baxay oo si weyn loogu xasuusan doono taariikhdii ma guurtada ahayd ee uu ku lahaa fanka iyo suugaanta gaar ahaanna doorkii uu ka qaatay xornimo doonkii. Allah ha u naxariistee maanta gelinkii dambe ayaa abwaan Saxardiid Maxamuud Cilmi lagu aasay magaalada Hargaysa.

Maxaa ka soo kordhay xaaladda weriye Raage Oomaar oo xanuunsaday xilli uu toos u akhrinayay warka telefishinka? . Weriyaha ITV News Raage Omaar ayaa hadda ka soo kabanaya xaaladdii caafimaad ee ku timid isaga oo si toosa u tabinaya wararka. Sida laga soo warbaahinta ITV Raage ayaa hadda ku sugan gurigiisa ka dib markii laga soo saaray isbitaalka oo lagu soo dabiibiyay. Wuxuuna qof walba uga mahad celiyay "naxariista iyo caafimaadka uu u rajeeyay". Afhayeen u hadlay ITV News ayaa yiri: "Waxaan daawadayaashii warkii xalay ugu mahadcelineynaa sida ay uga walaacsanaayeen xaaladda caafimaad ee Raage Omaar. "Kadib daawaynta isbitaalka, wuxuu hadda ku jiraa xaalad soo kabasho ah isaga oo gurigiisa ku sugan”. "Waxaan Raage u rajaynaynaa soo kabasho degdeg ah waxaanan rajaynaynaa inuu dib ugu soo laabto shaashada marka uu soo caafimaado." War qoraal ah oo uu la wadaagay ITV News, ayuu Raage Omaar ku sheegay: “Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan qof kasta ugu mahadceliyo naxariistiisa iyo caafimaadka ay rajeeyeen, gaar ahaan dhammaan shaqaalaha caafimaadka, dhammaan saaxibadeyda cajiibka ah ee ITV News, iyo daawadayaashayada oo muujiyay walaac. "Waqtigaas, waxaan go'aansaday inaan dhameeyo barnaamijka, waxaan ka mahadcelinayaa dhammaan taageerada la i siiyay." Raage, ayaa markii ay la soo daristay xaaladda caafimaad tabinayey warka tobanka fiidnimo ee habeenkii Jimcaha ahayd xilliga London, waxaana la arkayey muuqaalka isagoo u muuqda qof gariiraya oo ku dhibtoonaya in uu soo saaro ereyadiisa marka uu ka hadlayo qayb maalmaha fasaxa ah intii uu ku guda jiray akhrinta warka. Daawadeyaasha ayaa si degdeg ah dareenkooda ugu soo bandhigay baraha bulshada iyagoo ay walaac ka abuurtay baraha bulshada. Wariye Raage Oomaar oo hadda sano jir ah , ayaa waxa uu yahay tafatiraha arrimaha caalamiga ee telefishinka ITV News, wuxuuna hore u ahaan jiray weriye ka tirsan BBC-da. Ma jiro faahfaahin intaas dhaafsiisan oo laga bixiyay xaaladda Raage iyo waxa ku dhacay intii uu socday war akhrintiisa. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ITV ayaa ka saartay barnaamijka dib u socodsiintiisa ITV+ , iyadoo fariinta taa beddelkeeda u sheegaysa daawadayaasha in ITV "uusan si ku meel gaar ah u awoodin inuu kuu keeno adeeggayaga + ". "Waxaan dib u bilaabi doonaa muddo gaaban," ayaa lagu yiri. Wariye Raage Omaar, oo ah saxafi asalkiisu Soomaali yahay, balse heysta dhalashada dalka Ingiriiska, waxa uu sidoo kale u soo shaqeeyey BBC-da, intii uu socday duullaankii Ciraaq iyo burburkii Baqdaad sanadkii -dii Wuxuu helay abaalmarino caalami ah oo ku mutaystay shaqadiisii, taa soo ay ku jirto Peabody Award oo uu ku mutaystay warbixintii uu BBC-da uga soo diray Suudaan iyo BAFTA oo uu BBC-da ka siiyay duullaankii Afgaanistaan oo uu ahaa weriyaha keliya ee TV-ga reer galbeedka ah ee ka soo warrama gudaha Daalibaan. Intaas k adib waxaa uu ku biiray telefishinta Al Jazeera sanadkii - , halkaas oo uu ku soo bandhigay taxane dokumenti ah oo habeen walba ah oo la yiraahdo Witness, isagoo sidoo kale ka shaqaynayey Bariga Dhexe. Hadda waxa uu ITV News uga tebiyaa sheekooyinka waaweyn ee adduunka oo uu sidoo kale u soo bandhigaa barnaamijka arrimaha taagan ee ‘On Assignment.’ Sidoo kale waxa uu soo saaray warbixino qotodheer oo gaar ah oo ku saabsan UK iyo dibaddaba. Raage, ayaa -kii loo dallacsiiyay Tafatiraha Arrimaha Caalamiga ah ee ITV News. Raage Cabdilaahi Oomaar, wuxuu sanadkii -dii ku dhashay Muqdisho, waxaa ka soo jeedaa qoys caan ka ah Soomaliyeed, aabbihiis wuxuu ahaa ganacsade caan ah. Raage, waxaa qoyskiisu u guuray Boqortooyada Ingiriiska isagoo labo jir ah. Waxa uu leeyahay dhawr walaalo ah, oo uu ka mid yahay walaalkiis ka weyn, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Oomaar, oo soo noqday wasiirkii arrimaha dibadda dawladdii KMG ahayd ee Soomaaliya. Febraayo ayaa waxaa markii ugu horreysay xilkaas u magacaabay Cumar Cabdirashiid cali Sharma'arke, ka dibna waxaa mar kale Nofembar - Febraayo xilkaas u magacaabay Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo. Waxbarashadisa, Raage, waxaa uu ku qaatay dalka UK, isagoo ka baxay Dugsiga Dragon, Oxford, iyo Cheltenham College ee Gloucestershire, waxaana uu bartay taariikhda casriga. Omaar waxa uu shaqadiisa saxafinnimo ka bilaabay tababaridda wargeyska Codka, sannadkii -kii, waxa uu u wareegay dalka Itoobiya halkaas oo uu si madax-banaan uga shaqeeyay weriye ajnebi ah, isaga oo inta badan la shaqaynayay BBC-da laanteeda la hadasha caalamka. Sanad ka dib, Omaar waxa uu ku laabtay London oo uu ka soo shaqeeyay soo saare iyo baahinta weriyaha BBC-da. Waxa uu u wareegay Koonfur Afrika ka dib markii loo magacaabay wariyaha BBC-da ee Afrika., halkaas oo ay xaaskiisa iyo carruurtiisu ula guureen ilaa sanadkii -tii Abaalmarino kala duwan ayuu Raage helay intii uu ku jiray safarka saxaafada ee caalamiga. Sannadkii , Omaar waxa uu helay abaalmarinta akadeemiyada dhaqamada kala duwan ee qowmiyadaha ee weriyaha TV-ga ugu wanaagsan. Sannadkii 2008dii, waxa sidoo kale la guddoonsiiyey Abaalmarinta Daawashada Warbaahinta Carabta oo uu ku mutaystay wacnaanta saxaafadda Bishii Janaayo iyo , Omaar waxaa loo magacaabay abaalmarinta adeegga warbaahinta ee Abaalmarinta Muslimiinta ee dalka Ingiriiska. Raage, ayaa sidoo kale warbixinno dareen leh ka soo wariyey Soomaaliya muddadii uu ka shaqaynayey warbaahinta Calaamiga. Wuxuu mar hormuud ka ahaa aqoonyahano doonayey in Hargeysa laga dhiso maktabad weyn oo oo sare u qaadda aqoonta jiilka soo koraya ee Somaliland.

Xaawo Jookar: Gabadhii ugu horreysey ee Cadaado bajaaj ku wadday iyo caqabadihii ay kala kulantay , Xaawo Jookar Xaawo Maxamuud Faarax oo loo yaqaan Xaawo Jookar, waa hooyo da’ yar oo ku nool degmada Cadaado ee gobolka Galgaduud, waxayna noqotay gabadhii ugu horreysey ee bajaaj uga shaqeysata Cadaado. Waxay BBC uga warrantay billowgii nolosheeda iyo waxa ku kallifay in ay bajaajle noqoto, caqabadihii kala soo dersay shaqada iyo sidii ay uga dabaalatay. “Waxaan ku dhashay miyiga gobolka Galgaduud, waxaana ku soo barbaaray islamarkaana wax ku soo bartay Cadaado iyo Xeraale. Anigoo da’ yar ayaan guursaday, ka dibna waxaa la igu furay shan carruur ah oo aan lahayn cid igu biisha. Maaddaama aan ahaa qof waxbartay, waxaan isku dayey in aan helo shaqo aan ilamaha ku korsadob. Laakiin ma fududa in shaqo laga helo deegaamadan. Qofka shaqo rabana waa in uu marka hore si mutadawacnimo ah ku shaqeeyo. Si haddaba aan mustaqbalka fursad shaqo uga helo, waxaan si bilaash ah uga hawlgalay isbitaal ku yaal magaalada Cadaado. Muddo markii aan halkaas ka shaqeynayey ayaa waxaa la qaaday imtixaan lagu xulanayo shaqaale rasmi ah, laakiin aniga waa la iga reebay. Maaddaama aan haystay shan carruur ah oo la igu dayacay, islamarkaana aanan haysan dhaqaale aan ku shaqeysto, waxaan ka fikirey sidii aan ku heli lahaa shaqo aan nolasha carruuteyda ku maareeyo. Laakiin wey igu adkaatay. Markii aan ka quustay shaqooyinkii aan ku haminayey oo dhan, ayaa waxaa ii soo baxday in aan bajaaj kireysto si aan carruurta uga biisho. Waxaan u tagey wiil bajaajyada kireeya, anigoo weydiistey bajaaj aan ku shaqeysto. Wiilkii aad ayuu iila yaabay. Cabbaar ayuu ka meermeeray codsigeygii, laakiin ugu dambeyntii wuu ogolaaday, wuxuuna igu xiray sharuud ah in aan qoyskeyga kala imaado dammaanad – malaha wuxuu ka cabsaday in loo qabsado haddii lacalla dhib i soo gaaro. Marka la eego qaabka ay u fikiraan bulshada aan la noolahay, ragga iyo dumarku shaqooyinka wey kala leeyihiin. Waxayna aaminsan yihiin in haweenka aan loogu talogalin shaqooyinka qaar, sida wadista gaadiidka dadweynaha oo ay u yaqaannaan hawl rag. Waxa qura ee ay ku filan yihiinna ay tahay hawsha guriga. Laakiin anigu waxaan aaminsanaa in shaqo kasta oo nin qabto aan qaban karo. Sidaas darteed, markii aan u baahday qof i damiinta, caqabaddii ugu horreysey waxaan kala kulmay qoyskeenna, ka dib markii la iga fidiyey sheekooyin been ah oo la leeyahay waxay bajaajta u rabtaa in ay ku soo caanbaxdo oo baraha bulshada laga barto, taas oo dadkii aan kaashan lahaa iga horkeentay. Tusaale ahaan, adeerkey oo aan ugu tagey in uu i damiinto wuu i soo eryey. Wuxuuna ii sheegay in aan magaalada shaqo kale ka raadso. Laakiin maaddaama aan ahay hooyo u halgameysa nolosha ubadkeeda, waan ku mitiday mowqifkeygii. Ugu dambeyntiina wiilkii ayaa bajaajta wuu iga kireeyey, ka dib markii aan soo bartay sida loo wado. Subaxii dambe bajaajta ayaan waddada saaray anigoo aan aqoon waxaan bulshada ka fisho, laakiin isku kalsoon. Sawirka, Social/Xaawo Maaddaama aan ahaa gabdhii ugu horreysey ee bajaaj ku dhex wadda magaalada Cadaado, bulshadu siyaabo kala duwan ayey uga falceliyeen. Walow dadka intiisa badan ay ila yaabeen, haddana waxaa badnaa inta i soo dhaweysey oo igu dhiirrigelisey. Nasiib wanaag dadka dib ii taageeray waxaa ka mid ahaa adeerkeygii markaan hawsha billaabayey i tuuryeeyey. Waxaana yeeshay taageereyaal badan. Maalintii waxaan bixin jirey $ oo kiro ah. Inta kalena nolosha carruurteyda wey iigu filnaatay. Markii aan muddo sanad iyo bar ah ku shaqeysanayey bajaajtii kirada ahayd oo la ogaadey in aan naag shaqeysaneysa ahay ayaa ciddeydu lacag isugu key dareen, waxaana ku gatay bajaaj aan anigu iska leeyahay. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Markaad tahay qof dumar ah oo bajaaj wadda waxaad u nugushahay handadaad iyo halis badan oo kaaga imaaneysa dhinacyo badan. Tusaale ahaan, waxaa tunjileec ku bidi kara burcad, dad cabsan iyo kuwo ka xun horumarkaaga. Sidaas darteed, inkasta oo meeshan la is wada yaqaan oo aan la isku dhuuman karin, haddana waxaan shaqeysan jirey anigoo feejigan. Inta badanna waxaan iska ilaalin jirey in aan habeen shaqeeyo ama aan meel magaalada ka baxsan aado. Mar waxaa jirtey niman ka shaqeeya kaawo dhagax guryaha lagu dhiso laga bixiyo ay yiraahdeen meel magaalada ka baxsan nagee. Intii la sii socdey waxaan nimanka ka eegayey muraayad haadka. Ka dibna waxaan arkay iyaga oo war isku xadxadaya, dabadeedna waan ka shakiyey. Anigoo sidii u shakisan ayey meel dhexe igu joojiyeen. Labo nin ayaa degey oo hareeraha iga istaagey, halka midna Bajaajka ku dhex haray, isagoo leh lambarkaaga sheeg aan lacagta kuu tuuree. Markaas ayaan fahmay in la ii tashaday. Ka dibna si halhaleel ah ayaan mootada uga boodey. Nasiib wanaag waxaan sitey bastoolad qarsoon wiil aan ilmo adeer nahay ii dhiibey si aan isugu ilaaliyo. Marka intaan la soo baxay ayaan hal xabbo kor ugu ridey anoo leh dhan isugu bayra. Sidaas ayaana uga bedbaadey dhagartoodi. Xulkan ayaa wacdaro ka dhigay Koobka Adduunka sanadakn -ka, siddeed ciyaar waxaa laga dhaliyay hal gool ah oo iyagu iska dhaliyeen, ninka kaalinta weyn ka qaatay guulaha ay gaareen Morocco waa goolhaye Yaasiin Bouno oo loo garan og yahay Bono. “Waxaan halkan u joognaa sidii aan wax uga baddali laheyn aragtida nalaga aaminsan yahay si aan meesha uga saarno cabsida” ayuu yiri Yaasiin. “Morocco waxay diyaar u tahay inay wajahdo koob kasta oo adduunka ka dhisan”. Bandhiggii cajiibka ahaa ee uu soo sameeyay Bono bishii August -kiii waxay sababtay in kooxdiisa Sevilla ay - uga badiso Manchester United, waxay markii lixaad ee ay ku guuleysteen koobka Europe League. Ciyaarta caawa ee Faransiiska iyo Morocco Caawa marka ay saacadda Geeska Afrikada Bari tahay waxaa wada cayaaraya -ka fiidnimo. Muxuu yahay xiriirka ka dhaxeeya nooca dhigga qofka iyo u adkeysiga gaajada? Soonka bisha Ramadhaan oo laga helo caafimaad aad u badan hadana dad badan waxay dhibaato kala kulmaan isbeddelka ku imanaya habkii hore ee ay wax u cuni jireen ama ay u cabbi jireen taasoo mararka qaar ay la soo dersito daal iyo tabardarroo aad u badan dadka qaba cudurrada macaanka iyo dhiig karkana ay dhibaatooyin caafimaad darro ay kala kulmaan. Haaddaba qormadan kooban ayaa waxaan isku dayeynaa inaan akhristayaasha kula wadaagno talooyin wanaagsan oo la xiriira afurka iyo suxuurta caafimaadka ugu wanaagsan ee loo baahan yahay in la raaco. BBC Carabi waxay la hadashay dad badan oo muslimiinta sooman ka mid ah waxayna wax ka weydiisay qorshahooda ku aadan bisha ramadhaan ee la xiriira cunnooyinka ay isticmaalayaan inta bisha soonka lagu guda jiro iyada oo u sii kala qaadeyso jinsi iyo qoys. Nooca dhigga qofka uu yahayna sida oo kale wuxuu xiriir la leeyahay qofka sida uu dulqaad iyo samir uu ugu yeelan karo gaajada maalinta dhan uu sooman yahay. Qofka Sooman waxa uu ku suxuurto ayaa sabab u noqon karta qofka inuu daalo, gaajoodo ama uu oomo inta uu maalinki sooman yahay. Fadi Cabbaas oo ah nin cunnooyinka ku takhasusay oo u dhashay dalka Suuriya wuxuu ku talinayaa iney dadku talooyinkan raacaan si soonka uu ugu noqdo mid fudud, tabar la'aanna ay kala kulmin caafimaad buuxana u horseeda. "Xilliga suxuurta waa inaad isticmaashaa cunnooyinka % biyo ka kooban cunnooyinka aad cuneysidna yaree wakhtina u dhaxeysii (ugu yaraan shan daqiiqo), cuntada aad ku suxuuraneysidna haddii aad heli karto waa iney kuu wehiliyaan Khudaar sida Qajaarka, Salar iyo Kaabej) cuntooyin kala nooca ahna ha isku darin. Cuntada aad ku suxuuraneysidna waa iney ahaato mid aan cusbo iyo dufan badan laheen, maadaamaa ay jirka ku qasbayaan inuu biyo badan uu maalinki u baahdo taasina ay keento saacadaha soonka ugu horreeyaba inuu qofku oomo", ayuu yiri Cabbas. Wuxuuna intaa ku daray: "Sokortna waa inaan la isticmaalin ama aad loo yareyaa waxaana ka sii fiican in la cuno khudaarta sokorta dabiiciga ah laga helo sida (Qaraha, Strawberries iyo Liin Macaanta) ama koob sharaab dabiici ah, suxurtaada waxa ugu dambeeyana ha noqdo biya nadiif ah oo la cabbo." Hay'adda Caafimaadka Qaranka ee UK waxay iyaduna ku talineysaa xilliga suxuurta inaan qaxwa iyo shaah la cabbin sababta oo ah waxaa ku jira maaddada Caffeine oo sababeysa inuu qofka aad u kaadiyo kaddibna qofka ay ku keento cadaadis dhinaca kaadi haysta maadaamaa biya jirka ka baxa mooyee wax soo galaya jirin. Jirka marka uu dareeraha ku yaraadana qofka sooman waxaa la soo dersaya caafimaad darro sida madax xanuun, dhiigga oo hoos u dhaca, dhibaatooyin dhinaca kaliyaha iyo kuwo kale. Qorshaha bisha Ramadhaan ee xagga cunnooyinka inkasta oo uu ku xiran yahay awoodda dhaqaale ee qoyska haddana waxay dadku intooda badan ay maalin walba cunaan cunnooyin kala jaadjaad ah iyada oo dadka qaar ay cunnooyinka kala nooca ah la'aantood ay xilliga afurka farxad heleynin. Balse qofka cuntooyinka kala nooca ah ku afura ama ku suxuurta saacadaha ugu horreeya soonkaba wuxuu dareemayaa gaajo aad u daran. Cuntada badanna sideedaba waxay keentaa calool xanuun, dibbir, caajis, hurdo iwm. Dadka qaarkana waxay ku keenaan Dhiigga ama Sokorta iney ku kacdo. Sawirka, Narisara Nami/GettyImages "Dumarka shaqeeya iyo kuwa aan shaqeynin tamarta jirkooda ee ay gubaan wey ku kala geddisan yihiin inkasta oo ay ku xiran tahay hadba xaaladda noolaleed ee ay ku sugan yihiin", ayuu yiri Faa'id. Wuxuu aaminsan yahay qofka waxa uu cuno iyo iney dareenkiisa saameyn ku yeelanayaan. Xilliga ay haweeneyda gaaja dareentana inta ay raggu dareemaan in la mid ah ayey dareemayaan. Nooca dhiigga qofkana wuxuu xiriir la leeyahay sida uu ugu adkeysan karo gaajada iyo dulqaadka uu soonka u yeelan karo. Faa'id oo ku takhasusay cunnooyinka wuxuu sheegay dadka dhiiggooda uu yahay 'O' iney gaajada aad ugu adkeystaan xagga adkeysigana waxaa ku xiga dadka dhiiggooda uu yahay 'A' ama 'AB', balse dadka nooca dhiiggooda uu yahay 'B' ayaa ah kuwa ugu adkeysiga yar gaajada iyo soonkaba guud ahaan. Hal sabab oo la sheegay inaysan u dhiman Homboboradii ku soo caariday xeebaha magaalada Boosaaso , Wasaaradda Kalluumaysiga Puntland Mowjadaha badda ayaa xeebta ku soo tufay in ka badan xabo oo ah xayawaanka nooca loo yaqaanno Hombobarada oo ka mida noolaha ku nool badda, deegaan u dhaxeeya magaalo xeebeedka Boosaaso iyo Mareero ee gobolka Bari ee maamulka Puntland. Dadka deegaanka ayaa arkay tirada intaa le'eg ee xayawaanka Hombobarada ah oo xeebta yaalla kuwaas oo qaar ay dhinteen halka qaarna ay noolyihiin, waxayna tiro an la cayimin ay ku guulleysteen inay dib badda ugu celiyeen iyagoo nool sida uu BBC-da u sheegay wasiirka Kalluumaysiga iyo khayraadka baddda Puntland Cabdirisaaq Cabdillaahi Xagaa. Wasiirku wuxuu intaa ku daray inay markii ay heleen warka ay deegaanka u direen khuburo yaqaan cilmiga badda si ay u soo eegaan xaalladda. "Dowladdu waxay qaaday si loo baaro sababtaa inaan meeshii gayno rag cilmiga badda yaqaanna iyo kuwa Scientist ah oo ka socday jaamacadaha iyo machadka cilmiga baddda ee Puntland, waxaana ka soo qaadnay muunado, dheecaan iyo cad ah, si laabka loogu baaro sababta iyo haddii cuduro ku dheceen iyo waxa ku siyaado noqday tirada intaa le'ey ayaa ah wax la yaab leh"ayuu yiri wasiir Xaga. Waxaa kale oo BBC-da u sheegay wasiir Xagaa in sidoo kale muunado (samples) laga soo qaaday biyhii badda iyo ciida xeebta ee biyuhu soo gaareen si loo hubiyo bal haddii badda ay ku jireen Gaas ama saliid taas oo ay shaybaaristayaashu ka shaqaynayaan. Wuxuu sheegay in wixii lagu samayn kari waayo gudaha ay la kaashanayaan wadamada dariska ah iyo hay'addaha UN-ka. Deegaankii ay Hombabaradu ku soo caariday ayuu sheegay inay dowladda hoose ee magaalada Boosaaso iyo wasaaaradda Deegaanku ay ka shaqeeyeen si loo nadiifiyo si aan cuduro kale uga dhalan. Sida uu BBC-da u sheegay wasiirka Kalluumaysga Puntland, xawayaankan ku soo caariyey badda deegaan u dhow magaaladaBoosaaso maha dhammaan jaadadka ay ka kooban tahay Hombobaradu. "Hal Nooc weeye, noocaani waxaad dhanka muuqaalka marka laga eego Hombobarada waxaa jira nooc liid cadaana dhinacyada ku leh oo meelaha lagu ciyaaro ama lagu dabaasho lagu xanaaneeyo iyo nooc isku wada eg oo madow ah oo khubaradu ii sheegeen in la yiraahdo "Baro Xume," noocaan ayuu ahaa "ayuu intaa raaciyey. Hombobarada ayaa ah nooc ka mida xayawaanka ku nool badda oo sida khubaradu tilmaamaan leh hab dhaqan u gaara oo nololeed. Sawirka, Wasaaradda Kalluumaysiga Puntlad Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Inkasta oo baaritaano dheeriya wali ku socdaan sababa rasmiga ah ee dhalisayin tirada boqolka ka badane ee Hombobarada ah ku soo caaarisay xeebaha Boosaaso hadda wasiirka Kalluumaysiga Puntland ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in khubaradu ay soo jeediyeen inay jirin waxyaabo la faafiyey oo ah inay u dhimatay Sumow badda ah. "Waxay noo sheegeen inay arrinta sumowgu ama dadka leh Chemicaaal iyo waxbaa baddu lagu shubay sunbaa lagu shabay ba leh inay leeyihiin suurta gal maaha taasi sababtoo ah haddii sumayn jirto noolaha kale oo ka tabar yar oo ka adkaysi yar ayaa xeebta lagu arki lahaa oo mayda oo yaalla oo noocyada kala duwan eoo kalluunada noocyadiisa kala duwan ayaa xeebta lagu arki lahaa kuma aanna arag laguma hayo iyada kaliya ayaana soo baxday" ayuu BBC-da u sheegay wasiirka kalluumaysiga Puntland. Wasiir Xagaa, wuxuu intaa raaciyey inay jiraan waxyaabo caama oo baddanaa la yiraahdo inay keenaan inay xeebta u soo baxdo Hombobaradu. "Maadaama ay raxan raxan isu raacdo hoggaamiye ayey leedahay hab dhaqankeeda, haddii hogaamiyahaasi wareero oo xeebta u baxo kuligood hoggaamiyahay raacaan oo banaankay u baxaan waana dhacdooyin dhaca waqtiyada qaarkood, sidoo kale meelaha jabaqdu ku badato ama waxyaabaha baaritaano ha laga samaynayo baddda ama maraakiibta waaweyn ama wuxuun badda laga qabanayo wey wareraan hab socodka ka luma mararkaasna waxaa ku dhaca inay soo caariyaan intaas ayey noo sheegeen" ayuu yiri Xagaa. Baaritaanada lagu ogaanayo sababta dhalisay in tirada intaa le'eg ee xayawaankan ay hal mar ku soo caaryaan xeebta ayaa wali socota kuwaas oo khubarada cilmiga baddaha iyo shaybaaradu wadaan. Wasiirka Kalluumaysiga Puntland Cabdirisaaq Cabdillaahi Xagaa, ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay dadka deggan deegaanada xeebaha ay ugu digayaan inay cunaan noolayaasha badda soo tufto ee an la ogayn sababta. Homboborada ayaa ah nooc ka mida xayaawanada naasleyda ah ee ku nool baddaha.

Inta badan dadka waxay maqlaan talo ah: "cun beer si dhiiggaagu u fiicnaado," waxaana si gaar ah loogu sheegaa haweenka uurka leh ama dadka daciifka ah. Taasi waa sababta ay dad badani u jecel yihiin cunista beerka ari ama digaag, balse su'aashu waxay tahay: ma run baa arrintaas? Ma caawin kartaa cunista beerka digaag ama ari in ay yarayso dhaawaca ee bini'aadamka? Arrintan la xiriirta, Machadka Qaranka ee Caafimaadka ee Maraykanka (NIH) wuxuu sheegay in fitamiinno, bir (iron), borotiin iyo nafaqooyin kale oo badan laga helo beerka digaagga iyo ariga, sidoo kale waxaa laga helaa beerka lo'da iyo doofaarka.Dhanka kale, fitamiin A badan looma tixgeliyo mid u wanaagsan haweenka uurka leh.Hay'adda Caafimaadka Qaranka ee UK (NHS) ayaa sheegtay in haweenka uurka leh ay ka fogaadaan cunista beer badan, sababtoo ah heerarka sare ee fitamiin A ee ku jira waxay waxyeello u geysan karaan uurjiifka.

"Hooyadey horteed ayay caadada iga go'day" Bal qiyaas adigoo dhowr iyo taban jir ah ama oo markaas ay caadada kaa tagto. Ma aheyn wax ay Emma, Soe-Myat IYO Elspeth, qiyaasayeen carruurnimadooda. Markii la ogaaday waxa ay qabaan waxay noqotay bilowga safar dheer oo noloshooda soo mara kaas oo haweenka oo dhan ay la kulmaan xilli ka mid ah noloshooda balse inta badan kama hadlaan. Waxay aheyd August -kii goor subax ah, markaas oo dhakhtar uu baaray galka caafimaadka ee Emma Delaney, wuxuuna u sheegay in ay caadada kaga tagtay jir. Emma waxay ka kici weysay kursiga salkiisu adkaa ee isbitaalka, waxaana madaxeeda ka dhexguuxayay wixii uu lahaa. Caadadii aan soo laaban ilaa markii ay kaniinka joojisay dhowr sano ka hor marna ma soo noqoneyso. Suurgal ah uma ahan in si dabiici ah ay uur u qaaddo. “Ma garanayo wax aan ku jawaabo.. wuxuu sheegay sida inaan lumiyay furayaasheyda oo aan carruur dhali karin” ayey tiri Emma waxay qeyb ka tahay haween ay saameysay xaalad loogu yeero “Ugxansidaha oo shaqada qabaneyn” taas oo lala xiriiriyo hab kasta oo jir wixii ka yar ay caadada kaga tagto. Inta badan lama oga sababta balse haweenka qaba dhibaatadaas waxay dareemaan astaamaha caada istaagga ilaa ay ka gaaraan sano Mid ka mid ah 100kii haween ee UK ayaa xaaladdaas qabta, waxayna khubarrada aaminsan yihiin inay intaas ka sii ballaaran tahay. Waa arrin weli la baarayo “Gabi ahaanba si ku filan loogama hadal caado istaagga haweenka da’da yar” ayey tiri

Si dhab ah ayaan tababarka u qaataa balse Ramadaanka ayaa ka muhiimsan. Tababarka orodka dheer ee Maradoonka aad ayuu u adag yahay. Adigoo sooman in aad u diyaargarowdo tartanka ciyaartoyda ugu fiican adduunka ee masaafadiisu tahay. mayl waa wax aad u adag. Mahamed Mahamed waxa uu ka mid yahay jiilka oradyahanada Britain ee masaafada dheer orda, kuwaas oo ku sii dhawaanaya rikoodhkii uu dhigay Mohamed Farah ee oradka maradoonka. Oradyahanka jirka ah ee isu diyaarinaya orodka maradoonka ee London sanadkan ayaa hadana sooman. Wuxuu tababarka dhameeyaa xilli dambe, wuxuuna isku wadaa soonka iyo orodka. Mahamed, oo kaalinta afraad kaga jira liiska orodyahannada ugu fiican UK ayaa iska indhatiray talooyin loo soo jeediyay oo ah in uu dib u dhigo soonkiisa inta uu tababarka ku jiro si uu u jabiyo rikoorka labada saacadood, toddoba daqiiqo iyo shan ilbiriqsi ah. "Dadka qaar waxay u maleeyaan in aanan soomin marka aan tababarka ku jiro," ayuu Mahamed ku yiri wakaaladda wararka ee PA. "Gaar ahaan hadda, waxaan galayaa tartan, waxay u haystaan in aan diiradda saarayo tababarka oo mar dambe aan dib ka soomayo. "Laakiin waan la qabsaday. Waxay noqotay jadwalkayga caadiga ah. Waan uga mahadcelinayaa taladaas, balse anigu waxaan sii wadaa dhammaan soonka iyo orodaka." Mahamed waxa uu deggen yahay magaalada Ifrane ee Buuraha Atlas ee Morocco, wuxuuna isu diyaarinaya tartanka dhacaya bisha soo socota ee Abriil. Goobta uu joogo waxay u ogolaaneysaa in uu si badqab ah ugu tababarto iftiinka garoonka habeenkii, isaga oo la jira Muslimiin kale oo sooman bisha barakeysan ee Ramadaan. Maadama aan maalintii biyo la cabeyb, cunto la cuneyn waxay tababarka ka dhigeen habeenkii. Maalmaha qaar, jadwalkiisa tababarka wuxuu gaaraa saacadaha hore ee subaxda. Waxa uu bilaabaa kulankiisa koowaad qiyaastii -ta galabnimo, kaddibna wuu afuraa oo masaajidka tagaa ka hor inta uusan dhammayn kulankiisa labaad. Markuu si ku filan u cunteeyo, Mahamed wuxuu seexdaa hal ama laba saacadood, kaddibna wuu soo toosaa qiyaastii -ta subaxnimo si uu mar kale wax u cuno, ka hor inta uusan sariirta ku noqon si uu markaas kaddib hurdo ugu sii darsado. Mahamed waxa uu sheegay in wax yar ay adag tahay. "Shaqadayda si sax ah ayaan u sameeyaa, laakiin Ramadaanka waa kan ugu muhiimsan. Waxa uu iga caawiyaa in aan diiradda saaro. Waxa uu iga dhigayaa in aan fahmo cidda aan ahay iyo waxa aan samayn karo." Mahamed waxa uu ka mid yahay afar orodyahan oo Britan u dhashay oo wali firfircoon kuwaas oo ka qeybgala orodka dheer ee maradoonka. Mahamed waxa uu ku orday wax ka yar saac iyo daqiiqo, isaga oo ay weheliyaan Alex Yee, Emile Cairess iyo Philip Sesemann, waxaana lagu tilmaamay "jiil cusub". Kaddib markii uu kaalinta afraad ka galay Marathon-kii London ee la qabtay sanadkii -kii, Mahamed waxa uu doonayay in uu dhigo rikoodh cusub maradoonka London ah ka hor inta uusan u tartamin billad

Internetka ma farxadda ayuu dadka ka qaadaa? Tim Burton oo ah filim sameeye caan ah ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in internetka uu ka qaaday farxadda. “Qof kasta oo igaranaya wuu ogyahay in aan ahay qof tiknolojiyada ku xiran” ayuu BBC-da u sheegay jirkan filimada maamula. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay markasta oo uu internetka galo in uu ka qaado welwel. “ “Cabsi ayaa igasha, waxaan dareemaya sida in aan jid mugdi ah qaaday, marka waxaan isku dayaa in aan ka fogaado sababtoo ah iima fiicna”. Tim Burton waxaa si weyn loogu yaqaan in uu ahaa ninkii ka dambeeyay filimada Batman, Edward Scissorhands iyo kuwa kale oo badan. Isagoo ka hadlayay sida uu u isticmaalo tiknolojiyada ayuu sheegay in si dhaqso ah uu ku welwelo, kana badan dadka kale. “Islamarka aan bilaabo in aan isticmaalo internetka waxaan dareemaa sida qof soo dhacayo”. Filim sameeyahan wuxuu sheegay in mashquulka sida in uu daawada darruuraha ay ka caawiso in uu dareemo fiicnaan. Taalooyin xawaanada Daynasoorka oo dhowr nooc ah ayuu qeybta dambe ee gurigiisa ku haystaa. Burton waxa uu joojiyay isticmaalka taleefoonkiisa gacanta. Meelaha lagu iibiyo muuqaalada xayawaanada ayuu ka soo iibsadaa si ay ugu galaan halkii uu taleefoonka ka isticmaali lahaa. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay in jilaaga caanka ee la yiraah Nicolas Cage uu haysto xayawaanka Danasoorka oo nool. Tim Burton waxa uu ku dhashay meel u dhow Los Angles balse waxa uu -kii sano ee la soo dhaafay ku noolaa magaalada London. “Wadankeyga ayaan ku noqday sida shisheeye” ayuu BBC-da u sheegay. “Markii aan London imid anigoo Ajnabi ah waxaan dareemay sida in ay dalkeyga tahay. Halkan waa meel aan ku dareemay deganaasho”. Markii uu yaraa Burton waxaa uu fakarkiisa ku sharaxi jiray farshaxanka, wuxuuna ku koray daawashada aflaanta argagaxa leh iyo kuwa bahalada taas oo dhalisay jaceylka uu u qabo waxyaabahaas. Tim wuxuu sheegay in aflaanta sida King Kong iyo Frankenstein ay ahaayeen kuwa dareenkiisa qaata. Wuxuu dareemay in cabsida dhabta ah aysan ka imaaneyn bahalada balse ay ka imaaneyso dadka tuulooyinka ku nool. Wuxuu bahalada barbardhigay internetka isagoo sheegay in kooxo aan wajigooda la aqoon ay ku gelinayaan cabsidaas. Wuxuu aaminsan yahay in xayawaanka sida daanyeerada ay inta badan ka naxariis badan yihiin bani’aadanka. Tim Burton waxa uu ka hadlay cabsida uu ka qabo garaadka macmalka AI, gaar ahaan marka AI-da loo isticmaalo in laga dhigo sida dadka. Wuxuu ku tilmamay taas in ay la mid tahay muuqaalka qofka oo la xado. Isaga wuxuu sheegay in ay uga dhigan tahay in wax uu shaqsiyan u lahaa laga qaatay sida in hal abuurkiisa la qaato. Wuxuu ku soo gabogabeeyay in hadda uu qabo dareen ah in waxyaabaha asaasiga u ah hal abuurkiisa la qaatay. Burton waxa uu ku bilaabay shaqada filimada Disney ka hor inta uusan sameyn filimka Batman ee soo abxay -kii iyo Batman Returns oo soo baxay -dii. Wax weyn ayuu ku soo kordhiyay filimada muuqaalada laga sameeyo. Mar la weydiiyay hadii uu sameynayo filim kale, wuxuu ku jawaabay si dhaqso leh maya. Wuxuuna sheegay in cadaadisa lagala kulmayo filim sameynta waqtiga hadda la joogo in ay ka duwan yahay sidii hore Burton waxa uu diiday erayga “Burton-shi” oo ah eray lagu tilmaamo guushiisa. Inkastoo eraygaas uu caan ku yahay in lagu tilmaamo waxqabadkiisa hadana isaga ma jecla. “Marna ma jeclaan ayuu yiri, ma doonayo in aan sheey noqdo”. Wuxuu sheegay in noloshiisa oo dhan uu ka shaqeynayay in uu sida bani’aadanka noqdo.

Nidaamka Sir dhowrka. BBC waxaa ka go'an ilaalinta xogtaada gaarka ah iyo tan qoyskaagaba marka aad isticmaalaysaan adeegyada BBC. Mar walba oo aad soo gudbiso wararkaas, waxaa sharcigu na farayaa in warkaaga aan u adeegsanno si waafaqsan dhamaan sharciyada UK ee ku saabsan ilaalinta wararka gaarka ah, kuwaas oo uu ku jiro sharciga ilaalinta xogta ee soo baxay. Boggaga internetka waxay wataan tilmaamo kugu sii xirayo boggag kale oo qayb sadexaad ah. Marka aad gasho si aad uga qaybqaadato ama si aad u hesho mid ka mid ah adeegyada boggaga kale BBC sida wargaysyada, tartamada, wada sheekaysiga tooska ah iyo guddiyada fariimaha, waxaa dhici karta in aad ku waydiinno warar gaar ah oo kugu saabsan. Waxaa ku jira kara magacaaga, cinwaanka emailkaaga, cinwaankaaga boostada, telephone ama telefoonka gacanta ama taariikhda dhalashada. Hadii aad galiso faahfaahintaas meelaha lagaa dalbo, waxaad BBC u ogolaanaysaa iyo adeegyadeeda cidda gudbisa in ay kuu soo gudbiyaan adeegyada aad doorato. BBC waxay kaloo adeegsataa aqbaar kaydiyayaasha (Cookies). Cookie waa qayb yar oo kaydisa wararka ku soo saabsan xulashadaada boggaga, ogolaanaysana in boggaga ay u qaabayso si ku haboon danayntada. Waad ku hagaajin kartaa internet-kaagu in uu aqbalo dhamaan aqbaar kaydiyayaasha, si aad ugu wargaliso marka aqbaar kaydiye la samaynayo ama in aadan heli wax aqbaar kaydiye ah (Cookies). Si la mid ah, waxaan uruurinaa cinwaanada IP (Cinwaanka IP waa nambar si gaar ah loogu garan karo computer kasta ama qalab kale ee internet-ka loo adeegsado. Waxaan adeegsanaa barnaamijka lafaguridda si uu u eego cinwaanada IP iyo aqbaar kaydiyayaasha, iyadoo ujeedadu tahay in la horumariyo khibradaada adeegsiga. Waxaa kaloo aan u isticmaalaynaa cinwaanka IP si aan u go'aansanno in aad ka soo galayso adeegyada BBC meel gudaha ama dibedda UK ah. Hadii aad da' ahaan jirto ama ka yar, fadlan soo hel fasaxa waalidkaa ama qofka mas'uulka kaa ah ka hor inta mar walba oo aad wararkaaga gaarka ah galinayso boggaga BBC. Muxuu yahay xanuunkan cusub ee soo ridanaya carruurta Mareykanka iyo Yurub? Saraakiisha caafimaadka ayaa sheegay inay haatan baarayaan kiisas xanuunka cagaarshowga ah oo aan wax badan lafa fahansaneyn kaas oo lagu arkay carruurta afar dal oo Yurub ku yaalla iyo Mareykanka. Kiisaska cagaarshowga, oo ah xanuun beerka ku dhaca, ayaa laga sheegay dalalka Denmark, Ireland, iyo Netherlands, Spain iyo Mareykanka, sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha caafimaadka. Toddobaadkii la soo dhaafay dowladda UK ayaa sheegtay in waaxaha caafimaadka ee UK sheegeen inay ka war heleen kiisas aad u badan oo caabuq ah oo carruurta laga helay. Sababaha caabuqan ayaanan weli la ogeyn. Xarunta Yurub ee Xakameynta Cudurrada (ECDC) ma aysan sheegin inta kiisas ee laga helay guud ahaan afarta dal ee Yurub ka tirsan.

Lix waxyaabood oo kuu horseedi kara kansarka naasaha Kansarka ku dhaca naasaha ayaa kamid ah noocyada ugu khatarta badan, waxaana guud ahaan dunida ka jira in ka badan. milyan kiis, sida ay muujinayso xogta hay’adda caafimaadka adduunka (WHO) ee sanadkii. Waxaa la saadaaliyay in mid kamid ah -kii dumar ah uu ku dhici doono xanuunka oo kamid ah kuwa sababa dhimashada ugu badan. Sanadkii, ku dhawaad, oo haween ah ayaa dunida ugu geeriyooday kansarka naasaha. % dumarka qaba xanuunkan ayaa ku nool qaaradaha Ameerika. Waxaa jira waxyaabo si gaar ah dumarka ugu nugleeya khatarta kansarka naasaha, waxaana kamid ah: Dumarka aan jimicsan ama inta badan fadhiya ayaa khatar ballaaran ugu jira xanuunkan, sida ay sheegtay xarunta ka hortagga cudurrada ee Maraykanka (CDC). Waxaa muhiim ah in dumarka ay dhaq-dhaqaan oo uu jirkoodu shaqeeyo. Waxaa lagu taliyay in haweenka ay todobaadkiiba jirkooda ka shaqeysiiyaan daqiiqo ilaa oo daqiiqo. Jimicsiga noocaas ah ayaa u wanaagsan wadno garaaca, dhididka iyo neefsiga qofka. Dumarka da’da ah ee haddana uu badan yahay miisaanka jirkooda ayaa khatar badan ugu jira kansarka naasaha. Khubarada caafimaadka ayaa dumarka kula taliyay inay ilaaliyaan culayska jirkooda, ayna xakameeyaan cunnada ay qaataan. Noocyada hormoonada, gaar ahaan kuwa ay dumarka isticmaalaan marka ay dhalmo daayaan ayaa sare u qaadi kara khatarta kansarka naasaha, gaar ahaan haddii la isticmaalo wax badan shan sano. Waxaa haboon in dhakhaatiirka la weydiiyo qaab aan hormoon ahayn oo lagula tacaali karo xaaladaha ka dhashay marxaladda dhalmo deynta. Haddii haweynaydu uurka koobaad qaado ayadoo ka weyn jir, isla markaana aanay nuujin canuga, ama ay dhasho iyadoo aan bilo dhamaysan, waxa ay khatar ugu jiri kartaa kansarka naasaha. Taa bedalkeeda, dumarka dhowr bilood nuujiya carruurtooda ayaa waxaa hooseeya Sida ay sheegtay CDC, haweenka khamriga caba ayaa khatar ugu jira kansarka naasaha. Waxaa dumarka lagula taliyay inay gebi ahaanba ka fogaadaan cabitaanka khamriga. Waxaa la xaqiijiyay in cabitaanka sigaarka uu sababi karo noocyo badan oo ah kansarka. Waxaa muhiim ah in qofka uu isla ilaaliyo dhuuqidda sigaarka ama in lagu ag cabo, si uu uga badbaado khatarta kansarka. Arrimaha kale ee ay kamidka yihiin in qofka ay jirkiisu gasho kiimiko, isbedalka hormoonka iyo habeenkii oo la shaqeeyo ayaa sare u qaadi kara khatarta ah in qofka u uku dhaco kansar. Waxaa dadka lagula taliyaa in kol kasta ay iska baaraan kansarka, maadaama xaaladihiisa bilowga ah wax laga qaban karo. Dumarka ayaa si gaar ah loogula taliyay inay gacantooda ku dareemaan wax kasta oo ku soo siyaada naasahooda, si loo baaro kadibna loo ogaado waxa ay yihiin.

Cudurka coronavirus: Maxay tahay dhirta artemisia ee "lagu daweeyo" Fayraska Covid-? Bishii April ee sannadkan, dalka Madagascar ayaa soo jiitay indhaha caalamka ka dib markii uu shaaciyay in dhir maxalli ah uu kula tacaali doono Fayraska Korona. Madaxweynaha waddankaasi, Andry Rajoelina, ayaa shacabkiisa u ammaanay cabitaan ka sameysan dhirta loo yaqaan Artemisia. Illaa hadda ma jirto caddeyn muujinaysa in dhirtaasi - oo qeyb ahaan lagula tacaalo cudurka Malaariyada - ay wax ka tari karto fayraska Covid-, sida ay shaacisay hay'adda caafimaadka adduunka ee WHO. Dhirta Artemisia ayaa asal ahaan ka timid qaaradda Aasiya, waxaana hadda ay ka baxdaa caalamka oo dhan gaar ahaan deegaannada kuleylka iyo qoraxda leh. Dadka Shiinaha ee xanuunnada ku daweeya dawo dhireedka ayaa muddo, oo sano ka badan ku dabiibi jiray cuduro ay duumada ama malaariyada ka mid tahay, waxayna sidoo kale u isticmaali jireen xanuun baabi'iye iyo qandho jebin. Shiinaha waxaa dawo dhireedkan looga yaqaan "qinghao." Madaxweynaha Madagacscar, Rajoelina, ayaa bishii April ee sannadkan sheegay in tijaabooyin la sameeyay ay muujiyeen in dawo dhireedka laga sameeyo Artemisia ay waxtar u leedahay bukaannada Covid-. Sheegashadaasi ayuu markale ku celiyay bishan September. Balse ma jirto caddeyn si shaac-baxsan u muujinaysa arrinkaasi. Sidoo kale lama oga waxyaabaha laga sameeyay cabitaanka ay soo saartay Madagascar, inkastoo dowladda dalkaasi ay sheegtay in "% ay tahay dhirta Artemisia oo la farsameeyay. Dalkaasi ayaa sidoo kale billaabay soo saaridda kaabsool iyo dawo kale oo la isku duri karo, kuwaas oo hadda maraya heer tijaabo ah. Khubaro ka socota Jarmalka iyo Denmark ayaa tijaabo ku sameeyay dhecaanka dhirta Artemisia, waxayna sheegeen in ay ku arkeen in xoogaa waxtar ay u leedahay noocyada cusub ee Fayraska Korona. Waxay arrintaas ku ogaadeen tijaabo shaybaar. Cilmibaarista - oo aanay si madaxbannaan u hubin khubaro kale - ayaa muujinaysa in isticmaalka dheecaanka ay muujisay ka hortagga Fayraska, marka lagu daray maadada ethonal-ka oo saafi ah iyo biyo la miiray. Khubarada ayaa kala ka shaqeynaya Jaamacadda Kentucky, sidii mustaqbalka dawo dhireedka loogu tijaabin lahaa bani'aadanka. Shiinaha ayaa dhankiisa wado tijaabo u gaar ah oo ku aadan dawo dhireedka laga sameeyo artemisia Annua.

: Qodobbo kaa caawin kara inaad naftaada horumariso sanadkan Billowga sanadka cusub waa waqti lagu samayn karo isbeddel nololeed iyo go'aamo lagu wanaajinayo maskaxda iyo caafimaadka isla markaana lagu dhisayo qorshaha iyo hiigsiga cusub. Imaatinka sanad kale oo cusub, waxaa laga yaabaa inaad ka fikirto waxa aad rabto inaad gaarto iyo nooca qofka aad rabto inaad noqoto -ka bilood ee soo socda. Inta badan dadka waxay joojiyaan go'aanadooda bartamaha sanadka, sida laga soo xigtay hal daraasad. Waxaan soo qaadan doonnaa dhowr qodob oo qof kasta u noqon karta waddo uu u mari karo guusha sanadka cusub, isla markaana ay ku taliyeen seynisyahannada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, go'aaminta waxa aad diirada saarayso, waxay noqon kartaa mid adag. Haddaba, si ay kaaga caawiyaan inaad go'aansato, halkan waxaa ah toddoba arrimood oo noloshaada ah oo aad diiradda saari karto toddobaadka ugu horreeya ee sannadka cusub adigoo isticmaalaya qaar ka mid ah talooyinka sayniska. Waxaa muhiim ah in qof kasta oo inaga mida uu helo hurdo ku filan si uu wakhtigiisa wax badan ugu qabsado, saynisyahannadu waxay yiraahdeen waa inaan dhammaanteen waqti badan ku qaadannaa sariirta xilliga. Cilmi baaris ayaa muujisay in aadanuhu ay dareemaan hurdo xilliyeedka, taasoo la macno ah inay u baahan yihiin nasasho badan. Cilmi-baaris dhawaan la sameeyay ayaa sidoo kale lagu ogaaday in hurdada oo joogto ah ay naga caawin karto inaan ilaalinno caafimaad qabka. Haddii aad tahay qof ku fiican jimicsiga, xitaa haddii aadan tegin goobaha lagu jimicsado waxa aad sameyn kartaa jimicsi aan badneyn, dhaqdhaqaaqa lugaha jilbaha iyo is jimcinta kale ee jirka iyo waliba jucinta faraha, waxay ku siin karaan furfurnaan iyo in ay gacan ka gaystaan dhimista walaaca. Sidoo kale waa wakhti ku habboon in la baxo oo la sameeyo xoogaa jimicsi qabow, taas oo lala xiriiriyay caafimaadka wadnaha oo wanaagsan, habka difaaca jirka iyo kor u qaadida miisaanka oo yaraada iyadoo la beddelo unugyada dufanka cad. Ha ka xishoon inaad ku lugeyso meelaha boorka iyo dhoobada leh, wasakheynta waxay kaa caawin kartaa inaad kor u qaaddo kala duwanaanta dareemaha maskaxeed ee ku nool jirkeena. La sheekeyso dadka kugu cusub, isku day in aad ku dhiirrato waxyaabo badan oo kugu cusub, la qabso nolosha waliba siyaabo kala duwan, Dhammaan waxyaabahan waxay kaa caawin karaan inaad dareento farxad, adkeysi badan iyo walbahaar yar, sida uu qabo saynisku. Waxa kale oo aad isku dayi kartaa wax cusub, haddii ay ahaan lahayd barashada xirfad cusub si aad u kordhiso shaqada maskaxdaada, taas oo kaa caawineysa dib u dhiska maskaxeed. Haddii ay taasi u egtahay shaqo aad u adag, waxaad had iyo jeer isku daydaa inaad ka fikirto waxyar oo naftada raalli gelin kara. Cilmi-baaristu waxay muujinaysaa in haddii aad isku aragto inaad yar tahay, laga yaabo inaad sii noolaato muddo dheer. In mararka qaar aad araagto waxyaabo kaa nixiya iyo in aad la kulanto cabsi waxay yarayn kartaa walbahaarka, waxay kor u qaadi kartaa xusuusta waxayna ku siin kartaa dareen weyn oo ku saabsan xiriirka dadka kale iyo adduunka kugu xeeran. Inaad yeelato saaxiibbo adiga ayay kuu fiican tahay, waxay kor u qaadi karaan habka difaacaaga, waxay hagaajin karaan caafimaadka wadnahaaga waxayna kaa dhigi karaan inaad dareento farxad. Haddii aad ku darsato waqtiga aad la qaadanayso asxaabtaada xoogaa madadaalo ah, waxa ay sidoo kale kaa caawin kartaa in aad dareento in aad ka sheekeyso waxyaabo badan oo kaa dhex guuxaya si aad nafis u dareento. Cunista cunto isku dheeli tiran dabcan way fiican tahay wakhti kasta oo sanadka ah, laakiin malaha xataa way ka sii fiicnaan doontaa markastaba. Cunto laga helo guryaha Soomaalida oo ay isticmaali jireen boqorrada oo kaliya. Waa nooc mulawax ah oo aad u jilicsan oo laga jecel yahay Koonfurta Aasiya, isla markaana si weyn loogu cuno digaag lagu kariyey subag. Cunytada noocan ah waa mid ka mid ah cuntooyinka ugu caansan gobolkaas. Keliya digaag laguma cuno ee malawaxaas waxaa lala cunaa cuntooyin kale oo badan, wuxuuna ka mid yahay waxyaabaha lama huraanka u ah ee aan sinaba uga maqnaan karin miiska cuntada ee gobolka. Waxa lagu daraa alaabo kale oo dhadhan kala duwan u sameeya. Malaha sababtaas awgeed ayuu malawaxani caan uga noqday dunida oo dhan. Dhawaan ayaa nooc ka mid ah rootigan oo toon lagu daraywaxay caan ka noqotay kuwa ugu wanaagsan dunida. Marka la diyaarinayo waxa lagu daraa subag sixin ah oo lagu mariyo malawax diirran, kadibna lagu dul rusheeyo toon la jarjaray. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa laga yaabaa inay dad badan u noqoto arrin cusub in malawaxa oo meel kasta laga helo uu dadka qaarkiis u yahay cunnada ugu wanaasgan. Waxa la sheegayaa in cuntadani ay ka mid ahaan jirtay kuwa ugu qaalisan ee la siin jiray boqorradii muslimiinta. Haddaba, sidee ayuu malwaxani uga soo baxay jikadii boqortooyada una soo gaadhay miisaska caadiga ah ee dadweynaha caalamku ku cunteeyaan? Fadlan halkan riix oo ku soo biir janalka WhatsApp ee BBC Somali si aad u hesho wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee caalamka, iyo kuwa gobolka Taariikhda malawaxa waa mid xoogaa mugdi ah oo aan si buuxda u caddayn, balse khubaradu waxay aamminsan yihiin in mulawaxu asal ahaan ka soo jeedo taariikhdii Faaris ee qadiimiga ahayd, maadaama magaca "naan" oo la mid ah malawax uu ka yimid af-Faarisiga. Waqtiyadii hore, dadka Faarisiyiinta ah waxay ka samayn jireen roodhi iyaga oo isku daraya biyo iyo bur, kaddibna waxay ku dubi jireen dhagaxyo aad u kulul. Qarnigii 13aad ilaa 16aad, xilliyadii guulaha Islaamku ka gaadhay Hindiya, malawaxu wuxuu u gudbay Bariga Aasiya (Hindustan), sababtoo ah Muslimiintii guulaystay waxay la yimaadeen dhaqammadoodii cuntada. Sidoo kale, dadka ka yimid Aasiya Dhexe iyo Galbeed waxay wateen qalabyo waxa lagu foorneeyo. Niha Varmani, oo si dhow ula socota taariikhda Koonfurta Aasiya, waxay sheegtay in "malawaxu uu lahaa cunto-kariye gaar ah oo si joogto ah u soo saari jiray rootiga. Tusaale ahaan, nooc ka mid ah mulwaxaas wax auu lahaa lakabyo rooti khafiif ah, halka malawaxa qaarkooda ay ay ka samaysnaayeen rooti yar oo si fiican u nuugi jiray maraqa cuntada." Inkasta oo laga yaabo in ay kala duwan yihiin haddana, Soomaalida ayaa ka mid ah dadka aadka u jecel cuntadan malawaxa ah ee aadka u jilicdasan, islamarkaana waxa si weyn loogu cunaa subag ama malab. Waa mid ka mid ah cuntooyinka ugu caansan meelo badan oo ay Soomaalidu joogto. Keliya subag laguma cuno ee malawaxa waxaa lagu cunaa cuntooyin kale oo badan sida hilib, fuul ama shaah. Way adag tahay in laga waayo miisaska Soomaalida gaar ahaan xilliyada quraacda ama cashada. Waxa laga helaa guryaha, hoteellada iyo makhaayadaha, waxaana lagu diyaariyaa bur, caano, ukum iyo saliid ama subag, iyadoo lagu dubo digsi kulul. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa laga yaabaa in ay dad badan u noqoto arrin cusub in malawaxa maanta qof walba heli karo ay hore u ahaan jirtay cunto si gaar ah loogu sameeyo guryaha iyo munaasabadaha qaarkood. Haddaba, sidee ayay malawax-du uga soo baxday jikada dhaqanka una noqotay cunto maalinle ah oo miis walba taalla?

Luuqaddee ku hadashaa riyada dhexdeeda? Wax yar ka dib markii aan bilaabay ka shaqaynta sheekadan, waxaan ku riyooday riyo wax ku ool ah. Waxaan ku sugnaa qol hotel ah, oo ay joogeen marti ka timid Mareykanka, Pakistan iyo dalal kale. Intooda badan waxay ku hadlayeen Ingiriis, halka mid ama laba ay ku hadlayeen afka Jarmalka, oo ah luqaddaydii hooyo. Hal mar ayaan waayay wiilkaygii oo waan argagaxay. Markaan helay, neefta ayaa igasoo boodday: "ach, da bist du ja!" - "phew, alla wakukaas" oo af Jarmal ah ayaan dhahay waana isku duubay. Marka aan ku hadli karno dhowr luqadood, waxaan mararka qaarkood la kulannaa xaalado noocan oo kale ah, markaas oo ay luuqaduhu iskaga kaa darsamayaan hurdada. Riyooyinkayga waxaan inta badan ku hadlaa Ingiriisi, oo aan maalin kasta kaga hadlo halkan London, laakiin sidoo kale Jarmal ayaa ah luqadda carruurnimadaydii aan ku hadli jiray. Laakiin sidee iyo maxay maskaxdeenu u abuurtaa riyooyinkan luuqadaha badan? Ma laga yaabaa in riyooyinkan ay saameyn ku yeeshaan xirfadaheena luqadda ee nolosha dhabta ah? Jaleecada hore, ma aha wax lala yaabo in dadka luuqadaha badan ku hadla ay, si isku dhafan ugu hadlaan afafka kala duwan amaba ay kolba luuqad ku boodaan, iyo in xataa dadka bartay luqad qalaad ay sidoo ku hadlaan luuqadahn riyadooda dhexdeeda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, luqadda aan ku hadalno maalintii inta badan waxay noqotaa tan aan ku royoonno habeenkii. Daraasad lagu sameeyay dadka dhegoolayaasha ah iyo kuwa maqalku ku adag yahay ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyay in ay riyooyinkooda ku wada xiriiraan si la mid ah habka ay sameeyaan marka ay soo jeedaan, iyaga oo adeegsanaya luqadda dhegoolaha (midaarka). Laakiin falanqaynta faahfaahsan ee riyooyinka luqadaha badan ayaa muujinaya sawir aad u adag. Marka hore, halkii ay si aan kala sooc lahayn ugu soo celin lahayd nuxurka luuqadda maalintii, maskaxdeenu waxay habeenkii u muuqataa inay ku dhex milmatay dhammaan noocyada welwelka, xusuusta, iyo dhibaatooyinka maalinlaha ah ee aan wajahayno. Waxay xitaa si cajiib ah u abuuri kartaa wada sheekaysi dhan oo ku hadlaya luqad kale ah oo aan la aqoon ama luqad aan aragnay ama maqalnay xilliga soo jeedka laakiin aynaan ku hadlin. Tusaale, anigu mararka qaar waxaan riyooyinkayga dhexdooda ku hadlaa afka Jabaan-ka oo ah luuqad aan bartay balse aanan si fiican ugu hadli karin. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Si loo fahmo xidhiidhka ka dhexeeya hurdada iyo luqadaha, aan ku bilowno hal luqad oo keliya: afka Ingiriiska oo ah luuqadda qormadan lagasoo turjumay. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad u maleyso inaad afkaaga hooyo si fiican u baratay muddo dheer, laakiin dhab ahaantii, waxaad si joogto ah u cusbooneysiineysaa aqoontaada. Xitaa dadka waaweyni eray cusub ayey labadii maalmood mar bartaan. "Waa wax iska cad ah in caruurnimadeena aan barano ereyo badan oo cusub, gaar ahaan tobanka sano ee ugu horeeya. Laakiin tani waxay dhacdaa mar walba inanga oo aan ku baraarugin, "ayuu ku yiri Gareth Gaskell oo ah borofisar cilmi-nafsiga iyo agaasimaha Hurdada, Luuqadda iyo xusuusta,

Maxay tahay sababta dowladdan dhallinyarada ugu cadaadinayso inay guursadaan oo ay caruur dhallaan Chen waa gabadh da'yar oo u dhalatay dalka Shiinaha, waxaa ay haasaawe guur la sameeysa in ka badan nin oo ay hooyadeed soo diyaarisay. Waxay sheegtay in ragga haasaawaha ay la sameeyso qaarkooda ay aad u xun yihiin, sababtoo ah intooda badan ma aysan ka helin rajadii ay ka qabtay, waxaan ay tilmaantay in aysan rabin in carruur ay dhasho taas oo ragu ay ka biyo diideen. "Dhalitaanka Ilmo aad ayay u dhib badan tahay mana jecli dhallitaanka," ayay tiri Chen, oo ku jirta da'deeda -meeyda. Chen waa Magaca awoowgeed mana doonayso in magaceeda oo dhameeystir warbaahinta loo isticmaalo. "Macquul ma aha in la helo nin aan caruur rabin, Ninku inuusan caruur dhalin waxay la mid tahay in la dilo" ayay hadalkeed sii raacisay. Inkasta oo ay jireen shukaansi fara badan oo aan guulaysan oo Chen rag kala duwan ay la yeelatay, haddana cadaadiska guurka ee ay ku hayaan waalidkeed ayaan ahaayeen mid yar, waxaan ay xusatay in hadda ay ka baqayso in ay is disho. Chen wax cadaadiska ku haya ma ahan waalidkeed oo kaliya balse Dowladda iyo Xisbiga haya talada dalkaasi ayaa doonaya in dhalinyaradu guursadaan oo ay caruur dhallaan. Heerka guurka iyo dhalmada ee Shiinaha ayaa waxaa ku yimid hoos u dhac weyn, xisbiga shuuciga ee Shiinaha xukuma ayaa ku dhiirigelinaya malaayiin haween iyo rag dhallinyaro ah inay beddelaan arrinta. Sannadkii hore, tirada dadka Shiinaha ayaa hoos u dhacay markii ugu horreysay muddo sano ah, waxaana heerka guurka uu gaaray halkii ugu hooseeyay. Tirada guurka la diiwaangaliyay ayaa sidoo kale ahyed mid ka yar. milyan waana halkii ugu yareeyda tan iyo sanadkii. Hoos u dhac dhaqaalaha iyo shaqo la'aanta sii kordheysa awgeed,ayaa da'yarta Shiinaha ayaa ka weeciyay rabitaanka waalika iyo amarka Dowladda. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Walaaca dowladda ee arinta ayaa gaaray hoggaamiyaha Shiinaha, waxaana uu dhawaan jeediyay khudbad uu kaga hadlayay baahida loo qabo in la abuuro dhaqan cusub oo guurka iyo dhalmada ah, Waxa uu sidoo kale ka hadlay "hagidda iyo xoojinta guurka " si loo qaabeeyo aragtida dhalinyarada ee guurka, carruurta iyo qoyska. Guud ahaan dalka waxa laga abaabulay hawl-wadeeno ka shaqeeya sidii dhalinyarada loogu dhiirigelin lahaa in ay guursadaan, iyadoo kuwa is qabana lagu dhiirri galiyey in ubad ay isku dhallan. Horaantii sanadkan, magaalo yar oo ku taal bariga gobolka Zhejiang ayaa ku dhawaaqday in ay siin doonto lamaanayaasha, yuan oo u dhiganta ($; £) oo ah "abaalmarin" haddii aroosaddu ay da tahay sano ama ka yar tahay. Arintan ayaa carro ku abuurtay dadka deegaanka, kuwaas oo ku tilmaamay dawlada hoose inay dhegaha la’ yihiin oo ay u qaateen in lacagta intaa le’eg ay saamayn ku yeelan karto go’aankan weyn. Dhulka miyiga ah, oo halka ay u badan yihiin ragga aan guursanin ee la daalaa dhacaya sidii ay lamaane ay u heli lahaayeen, ayuu maamulka dumarka ku amray in ay joojiyaan dalabaadka qiimaha sare ee arooska ku baxay. Khubarada ayaa sheegaya in hoggaanka Dowlladda Shiinaha aysan suurtagal ahayn inay fahmaan waxa u horseedaya go,aanka dhalinyarada, gaar ahaan haweenka ee guurka u diiday. Khubaradu waxay rumaysan yihiin in dadka aan guursan ee Shiinuhu ka kooban yahay laba kooxood oo aan la isbarbardhigi Karin, kuwaas oo kala ah dumar ku nool magaalooyinka iyo ragga reer miyiga ah. Ragga reer miyiga ah waxay la halgamayaan rajooyinka abuurid xagga dhaqaalaha, oo ay isku bixin karaan qiimaha arooska ee sare iyo shaqo la isku hallayn karo oo ay ku masruufi karaan qoyska.
Tani marka ay dhacdo, badanaa waxaa ugu wacan milkiilaha ayaa la wadaagay kaliya koox yar oo dad ah, beddelay cidda arki karta ama waa a tirtiray.

Muxuu yahay xiriirka ka dhaxeeya nooca dhigga qofka iyo u adkeysiga gaajada? Soonka bisha Ramadhaan oo laga helo caafimaad aad u badan hadana dad badan waxay dhibaato kala kulmaan isbeddelka ku imanaya habkii hore ee ay wax u cuni jireen ama ay u cabbi jireen taasoo mararka qaar ay la soo dersito daal iyo tabardarroo aad u badan dadka qaba cudurrada macaanka iyo dhiig karkana ay dhibaatooyin caafimaad darro ay kala kulmaan. Haaddaba qormadan kooban ayaa waxaan isku dayeynaa inaan akhristayaasha kula wadaagno talooyin wanaagsan oo la xiriira afurka iyo suxuurta caafimaadka ugu wanaagsan ee loo baahan yahay in la raaco. BBC Carabi waxay la hadashay dad badan oo muslimiinta sooman ka mid ah waxayna wax ka weydiisay qorshahooda ku aadan bisha ramadhaan ee la xiriira cunnooyinka ay isticmaalayaan inta bisha soonka lagu guda jiro iyada oo u sii kala qaadeyso jinsi iyo qoys. Nooca dhigga qofka uu yahayna sida oo kale wuxuu xiriir la leeyahay qofka sida uu dulqaad iyo samir uu ugu yeelan karo gaajada maalinta dhan uu sooman yahay. Qofka Sooman waxa uu ku suxuurto ayaa sabab u noqon karta qofka inuu daalo, gaajoodo ama uu oomo inta uu maalinki sooman yahay. Fadi Cabbaas oo ah nin cunnooyinka ku takhasusay oo u dhashay dalka Suuriya wuxuu ku talinayaa iney dadku talooyinkan raacaan si soonka uu ugu noqdo mid fudud, tabar la'aanna ay kala kulmin caafimaad buuxana u horseeda. "Xilliga suxuurta waa inaad isticmaashaa cunnooyinka % biyo ka kooban cunnooyinka aad cuneysidna yaree wakhtina u dhaxeysii (ugu yaraan shan daqiiqo), cuntada aad ku suxuuraneysidna haddii aad heli karto waa iney kuu wehiliyaan Khudaar sida Qajaarka, Salar iyo Kaabej) cuntooyin kala nooca ahna ha isku darin. Daraasad lagu ogaaday sida ugu fiican ee loo aamusiin karo cunug oynaya Seynisyahanno ayaa sheegay in ay heleen jawaabta ugu habboon ee ay ku raadinayeen cilmi-baaris lagu ogaanayay sida ugu fiican ee loo aamusiiyo ilmaha marka ay oynayaan. Tijaabooyin qeyb ka ahaa daraasadda oo laga sameeyay dalalka Japan iyo Talyaaniga ayaa lagu soo bandhigay Majalladda “Current Biology”. Waxaa daraasaddan lagu ogaaday in sida ugu habboon ee loo aamusiin karo cunug oynaya ay tahay in laabta la geliyo oo lala socdo muddo shan daqiiqo ah, kaddibna lala fariisto oo isla qaabkaas loo hayo shan ilaa siddeed daqiiqo oo kale. Khubaradu waxa ay ku taliyeen in markaas kaddib cunugga dib loogu celiyo meeshii laga qaaday markii ugu horreysay. Qoraaga hoggaamineysay cilmi-baaristan, Kumi Kuroda, oo ka tirsan Xarunta Seyniska ee Japan, ayaa sheegtay in iyadoo xitaa soo korisay afar carruur ah aysan waligeed waxba ka ogeyn habkan, sidoo kalena aysan fileyn natiijadan. Kooxda seynisyahannada ah ayaa markii hore sameeyay cilmi-baaris ay u ugu kuur galeen habka nolosha ee eeyaha, daanyeerrada iyo jiirarka. Waxaa la xaqiijiyay in xayawaankan dhammaantood ay ilmahooda xasilaan marka ay la socdaan iyagoo xambaarsan, mar walba oo ay sidaas sameeyaanna garaaca wadnaha cunugga hoos u dhaco ama gaabiyo. Daraasadda lagu sameeyay bani’aadanka ayaa loo adeegsaday hooyo. Hooyooyinka heystay carruurta ay da’doodu u dhaxeyso ilaa bilood ayaa lagu tijaabiyay afar xaaladood: in la xambaaro oo lala socdo, in dhabta la saaro hooyada oo fadhisa, in la geliyo sariir aan dhaqdhaqaaqeyn iyo in la saaro sariir ruxeysa. Natiijada ayaa muujisay in sida ugu fiican ee uu cunugga oynaya ku aamusi karo ay tahay in la qaado oo lala soc-socdo cabbaar. Marka sidaas la sameeyo, waxay u badan tahay in cunugga u uku aamuso ilaa ilbiriqsi, islamarkiina uu garaaca wadnihiisa xasilo. Waxaa daraasaddan lagu ogaaday in arrintan ay ka fiican tahay sidii la aaminsanaan jiray oo inay tahay habka ugu fiican ee loola dhaqmo carruurta oyneysa, oo ahayd in la saaro dhabta hooyada oo fadhisa. Seynisyahannada ayaa sidoo kale ogaaday in haddii cunug oynaya la soc-socdo muddo shan daqiiqo ah ay u badan tahay inuu hurdo daqiiqadahaas gudahooda. Boqolkiiba ka mid ah carruurtii tijaabadaas la mariyay ayaa seexday, markii hal daqiiqo oo lixaad lagu sii darayna, boqolkiiba ka mid ah oo kale ayaa seexday. Sidaas awgeed habkan [in la xanbaaro oo lala socdo cunugga] uusan joojineyn oo keliya oohinta base uu sidoo kale billow u yahay hannaanka hurdada.
