Waa tuma diyaaradda Shiinaha laga leeyahay ee la tartamaysa diyaaradihii caalamiga ahaa? , Bandhigga Diyaaradaha ee Singapore, goobta bandhigga waxaa safan moodeello yaryar oo diyaarado ah, qolal duulimaad oo la tijaabin karo, iyo bandhigyo is-dhexgal ah oo muujinaya diyaaradaha ganacsiga ee ugu dambeeya iyo tignoolajiyadda duulista. Hal goob oo si gaar ah u soo jiidanaysa dareenka waa tan Comac, oo ah shirkadda diyaaradaha ee ay leedahay dawladda Shiinaha, taas oo horumar weyn sameysay tan iyo markii diyaaraddeeda rakaabka ee C919 ay markii ugu horreysay ka duushay Shiinaha una safartay Singapore laba sano ka hor — safarkeedii ugu horreeyay ee ka baxsan dhulka Shiinaha. Diyaaraddan ayaa loo naqshadeeyay inay la tartanto Airbus A320neo iyo Boeing 737 MAX, waxaana si isa soo taraysa ay uga dhex muuqataa danaynteedu suuqyo ka baxsan Shiinaha. "Comac waxay indhaha ku haysaa suuqa duulista ee Koonfur-bari Eeshiya." Bandhigga diyaaradaha wuxuu u yahay Comac fursad ay isku muujiso inay noqon karto tartame suurtagal ah oo dhinac ah Airbus iyo Boeing gudaha gobolka Eeshiyada–Baasiifigga, oo ah suuqa duulista ee ugu kobaca badan caalamka, xilli ay shirkadaha duulimaadyadu ay la tacaalayaan dib-u-dhacyo ku yimaadda keenista diyaaradaha iyo silsiladaha sahayda oo muddooyinkan danbe cidhiidhi noqday. "Waxaan u maleynayaa in mustaqbalka, Comac ay noqon doonto tartame caalami ah… balse waxay u baahan doontaa waqti," ayuu BBC u sheegay Willie Walsh, agaasimaha guud ee Ururka Gaadiidka Cirka ee Caalamiga ah (IATA). "Waxaan u maleynayaa in 10 ama 15 sano kadib, aan ka hadli doonno Boeing, Airbus iyo Comac… Shaki la'aan, waxay noqon doonaan ciyaaryahan weyn mustaqbalka." Falanqeeyayaashu waxay sheegeen in si dhab ah loogu baahan yahay shirkad kale oo samaysa diyaaradaha gobolka dhaca EeshiyadaBaasiifigga. Shirkadaha diyaaradaha ee gobolka ayaa dareemaya culays ka dhashay dib-u-dhacyada keenista diyaaradaha ee Boeing iyo Airbus, taas oo ay sii xoojiyeen yaraanta matoorada iyo caqabadaha guud ee ka jira dhanka adeegyada kale ee loo baahan yahay. Hubanti-la'aanta ku saabsan canshuuraha (tariffs) iyo xiisadaha ganacsiga ayaa sii adkeeyay caqabadaha haysta warshadaha wax-soo-saarka, taas oo saameyn ku yeelatay hababka wax-iibsiga iyo istaraatiijiyadda kobaca ee gobolka. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Xogta IATA ayaa muujinaysa in shirkadaha diyaaradaha ee caalamka ay sugayaan waqti ka dheer sidii hore si ay u helaan diyaarado cusub, taas oo keentay in celceliska da'da diyaaradaha la adeegsado ay kor u kacdo, isla markaana ay kordhaan kharashaadka hawlgalka, maadaama diyaaradaha duqoobay ee duugga ah ay shidaal badan cunaan. Willie Walsh ayaa sheegay in shirkadaha diyaaradaha ee Aasiya-Baasiifigga ay gaadhi karaan koboc macno leh, sannadka 2026 haddii diyaarado la heli lahaa. "Arrintani waa mid aad u niyad-jab leh marka ay noqoto dhanka shirkadaha diyaaradaha. Wakhtiga u dhexeeya dalabka diyaaradda iyo helitaankeeda wuxuu gaadhaa qiyaastii toddoba sano," ayuu yidhi. Tani waa sababta ay Comac u soo baxeyso inay noqoto ikhtiyaar kale oo ay dooran karaan shirkado badan oo duulimaad oo ka jira Eeshiyada-Baasiifigga. Shirkaddu waxay sheegtay inay gaadhsiisay in ka badan 200 oo diyaaradood oo nooca C909 iyo C919 ah, iyadoo qiyaastii rubuc diyaaradahaas ay ka hawlgalaan shirkado ku yaalla Laos, Indonesia iyo Vietnam. Shirkadda GallopAir ee Brunei ayaa dalbatay tiro badan oo ka mid ah diyaaradaha Comac, halka Cambodia ay sidoo kale qorshaynayso inay iibsato ku dhowaad 20 diyaaradood. "Waxaan u baahan nahay alaab-bixiyeyaal badan oo ku jira warshadaha diyaaradaha," ayuu yidhi Subhas Menon, oo ah agaasimaha guud ee Ururka Shirkadaha Diyaaradaha ee Aasiya-Baasiifigga (AAPA). "Dhibaatada warshaddan ka jirta ayaa ah in wershadaha diyaaradaha ay xidhan yihiin, mararka qaarna waxsoosaarka adag yahay." "Waxaan arrintan sugaynay muddo dheer. Soo gelitaanka Comac waa arrin la soo dhaweynayo. Gaar ahaan Aasiya-Baasiifigga, waxaan u baahan nahay alaab-bixiyeyaal badan." Shirkaddu waxay ku jirtaa xaalad wanaagsan iyada oo haysata taageero xooggan oo ka timaadda dowladda, halka qiimaha hoose ee diyaaradaha ay ka dhigi karaan kuwo soo jiidasho leh shirkadaha duulimaadka ee qiimaha jaban, kuwaas oo ka hawlgala suuqyada soo koraya. "Mustaqbalka, waxaan soo dhaweynaynaa dhammaan kuwa cusub ee soo galaya suuqan. Waxaan dooneynaa inaan aragno tartan badan. Comac weli waxay mari doontaa geeddi-socodka shahaado-siinta, waxaana filaynaa in mar uun siiba 2030-meeyada ay noqon doonto xulasho soo jiidasho leh oo anfacda annaga iyo shirkado kale oo badan," ayuu BBC-da u sheegay Mike Szucs, oo ah madaxa fulinta ee shirkadda duulimaadka qiimaha jaban ee Cebu Pacific ee Filibiin. Marka laga soo tago is-ballaadhinta ay ka waddo Eeshiyada-Baasifigga, Comac waxay sidoo kale raadinaysaa shahaado ganacsiyeed Yurub ah, iyada oo hay'adaha sharci-dejinta ay sameynayaan duullimaadyo tijaabo ah oo lagu hubinayo diyaaraddeeda C919. Tani waxay u oggolaan lahayd inay diyaaradaha ka iibiyaan shirkadaha duulimaadka ee Yurub. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, jidka hor yaalla weli waa mid dheer. Hay'adaha sharci-dejinta ayaa sheegay in helitaanka shahaadada Yurub ay qaadan karto ilaa 2028 ama xitaa 2031. Dhanka kale, is waafajinta qaybo Shiineys iyo kuwo Reer Galbeed ah, nidaamyada xakamaynta duullimaadka iyo barnaamijyada software-ka ayaa sidoo kale ah caqabado farsamo oo adag, gaar ahaan dalabyada caalamiga ah. Kaabayaasha dayactirka iyo hagaajinta diyaaradaha waa caqabad kale, sidoo kale tababarka duuliyeyaasha — waaxyo ay shirkadaha sida Boeing iyo Airbus muddo tobannaan sano ah ku lahaayeen nidaamyo iyo kaabayaal si fiican u dhisan ayaa iyana ka mid ah meelaha ku adkaan doona. Gobolkan dhaca Eeshiyada-Baasiifigga gudaheeda, Comac waxay sidoo kale wajahaysaa tartan ka baxsan Boeing iyo Airbus. Shirkadda Brazil ee Embraer ayaa si tartiib ah uga heshay saldhig gobolka, iyadoo shirkadda duulimaadka jaban ee Singapore ee Scoot, Virgin Australia, iyo shirkadda Japan ee All Nippon Airlines (ANA) ay dalbadeen diyaarado Embraer ah. Dhanka kale, Boeing iyo Airbus weli waxay leeyihiin samaayn iyo joogitaan xooggan oo gobolka ah. Waxaa sidoo kale jira su'aalo la xidhiidha tirada dalabyada Comac. Hore ayay u sheegtay inay haysato in ka badan 1,000 dalab oo ah diyaaradaha rakaabka ee C919 oo ay ka heleen shirkadaha Shiinaha, balse ilaa hadda wax ka yar toban iyo dhowr ayaa la gaadhsiiyay. Xaqiijinta tirada dalabyadan ayaa sida oo kale adag, maadaama Comac ay tahay shirkad Shiineys ah oo ay dawladdu leedahay, isla markaana aan si furan suuqa saamiyada uga diiwaangashnayn sida Boeing ama Airbus. Haddii aysan Comac awoodin inay wax ka qabato qaar ama dhammaan caqabadahan, Boeing iyo Airbus ayaa ay u badan tahay inay sii wadaan xakamaynta hawada sare ee Eeshiyada-Baasifigga.

Imaaraadka oo saldhig ciidan ka dhisanaya Berbera Dawlada Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa la sheegay in ay saxiixday heshiis ay ku dhisayso xarun ciidan oo labaad oo ay ka dhisayso geeska Afrika. Saldhigan cusub, sida laga soo xigtay ilo wareed goob joog u ahaa wadaxaajoodkaas oo ay soo xigatay warbaahinta shephardmedia ee ka faaloota arrimaha sirdoonka ganacsiga oo fadhigeedu yahay magaaladda London waxay sheegtey in saldhiga cusub dowladda Imaaraadku ka dhisanayso magaalada Berbera ee Somaliland, isagoo noqon doona mid ciidamadda Badda iyo cirka. Heshiiska isafgaradka ah waxaa la saxiixay bishii September markaas oo wafdi heer sare ah oo ka socday Somaliland ay booqdeen wadanka Imaaraadka Carabta. Sacuudiga oo Jabuuti ka furanaya saldhig militari Dhul 40km oo isku wareeg ah kaabiga ku haya dekadda iyo garoonka diyaaraha Berbera ayaa wargeysku wuxuu leeyahay waxaa la siiyey Imaaraadka Carabta ,muddo 25 sano ah, waxaana wararku sheegayaan in ay dhici karto in la kordhin karo. Saldhig ayaa Somaliland waxay ku badalan doontaa tababaro xagga ciidanka ah, taageero iyo ilaallin deegaankeeda, iyadoo Somaliland ay xudduud la leedahay Koonfurta aadna ugu baahan tahay ammaan buuxa. Dhanka kale Maamulka Somaliland wasiirka duulista hawadda iyo gaadiidka cirka, Farxaan Aadan Haybe oo ay BBC wax ka waydiisay arrinkan wuxuu sheegay in uu jiro isfahan arinkaas ku aadan, balse heshiis rasmi ah aan wali la saxiixin.

Bariga Dhexe: Erdogan oo booqanaya Sacuudiga, ma isu soo dhawaan doonaan labada waddan? , Madaxtooyada Turkiga Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Rajab Tayib Erdogan ayaa Khamiista maanta u socdaali doona dalka Sacuudiga, halkaas oo uu kula kulmi doono Dhaxal-suge Maxamed bin Salmaan. Xukuumadaha Ankara iyo Riyaadh ayaa bilihii dambe waday dedaallo ay isugu soo dhawaanayaan kadib dhowr sano oo uu xiriirkooda gaaray meel adag. Xiriirka labada waddan ayaa xumaa tan iyo markii sanadkii 2018 ay koox khaarajinta qaabilsan oo Sacuudi ah ay gudaha qunsuliyada dalkaas uu ku leeyahay Istanbul ay ku dileen weriye Jamaal Khashoggi. Xukuumadda uu hogaamiyo Erdogan ayaa xilligaas ku eedaysay madax Sacuudi ah oo uu kamid yahay Maxamed bin Salmaan inay ku lug lahaayeen khaarajinta weriyaha, waxaana uu Turkiga furay dacwad ku aaddan kiiskaas. Sacuudiga oo ka carooday qaabka uu Turkiga u wajahay kiiska ayaa billaabay inuu xayiraad aan rasmi ahayn saaro badeecadaha ay Ankara u dhoofiso Boqortooyada. Turkiga ayaa sanadkii 2020 billaabay dedaallo u uku wanaajinayo xiriir xumaaday ee kala dhexeeya waddamada Masar, Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta, Israa'iil iyo Sacuudiga. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale kaalmo dhaqaale weydiistay waddamo ku yaalla Khaliijka Carabta xilli sicir bararka iyo qiimaha sarreeya ee tamarta ay culays weyn saareen waddankaas. Bishii la soo dhaafay, Sacuudiga ayaa ka codsaday Turkiga inuu ku wareejiyo kiiska dilkii Khashoggi oo ka socday dalkaas, waxaana bishan ay Ankara aqbashay codsigaas iyadoo kiiska ku wareejisay Riyaadh. "Madaxweyne Erdogan waxa uu Dhaxal-suge Maxamed bin Salmaan kala hadli doonaa arrimo ay kamid yihiin dhaqaalaha, maalgashiga, xaaladda gobolka iyo sidii xal buuxa looga gaari lahaa khilaafka hareeyay xiriirka labada waddan," ayuu yiri mas'uul ka tirsan dowladda Turkiga oo la hadlay wakaaladda Reuters. Madaxweyne Edrogan oo u tacsiyeeyay madaxweynaha Israa'iil "Dilkii Khashoggi waxa uu ahaa dhacdadii ugu xumayd ee isoo marta" Maxamed bin Salmaan, ayaa waraysi uu dhawaan siiyay wargeyska the Atlantic waxa uu ku sheegay in dilkii loo geystay weriye Jamal Khashoggi uu ahaa dhacdadii ugu xumayd ee abid soo marta. Amiirka ayaa beeniyay inuu amray dilka weriyahaas oo rag ka tirsan laamaha ammaanka ee Sacuudiga ay October 2018 ku dhex khaarajiyeen qunsuliyadda ay Boqortooyada ku leedahay magaalada Istanbul. Dilka weriyaha oo lagu eedeeyay dhaxal sugaha - hay'adda sirdoonka Maraykanka ee CIA na ay sheegtay inuu isaga amray - ayaa waxaa ka carooday dalal badan iyo hay'adaha u doodda xuquuqda adaanaha. "Waan dareemi karaa carada ay weriyayaasha ka qaadeen dilka [Khashoggi], waana ku ixtiraamayaa dareenkaas. Balse dhibaato iyo xanuun ayaa inaguba naga soo gaartay geeridiisa," ayuu bin Salmaan u sheegay wargeyska. The Atlantic ayaa sheegay in laba qof oo amiirka u dhaw ay u sheegeen in bin Salmaan uu dareemay in "arrinta Khashoggi ay ahayd tii ugu xumayd ee soo marta abid, isla markaana ay wiiqi kartay qorshihiisa oo dhan." Dhaxal sugaha ayaa waraysiga ku sheegay in lagu xadgudbay xuquuqdiisa oo lagu tilmaamay inuu yahay dembiile isaga oo aanay xukumin maxkamad. Waxa uu sheegay in dad galay dembi waaweyn, sida duqeynta aroosyo ka dhacay Afghanistan ama tacaddiyada loo geysto maxaabiista Guantánamo Bay aan sidaa loola dhaqmin.

Waa dhacdo aad u xanuun badan, ayna yar yihiin dadka la kulma qaddartan oo kale. Allaha u naxariistee Aasiya Cabdi ayaa geerideeda si weyn loogu baahiyay baraha ay bulshadu ku kulanto ka dib geeri xanuun badan oo ku timid iyada iyo xubno ka tirsan qoyskeeda. Aasiya waxa ay ku nooleyd magaalada Doolow ee gobolka Gedo, ka dib muddo badan oo ay xiriir wadaag ahaayeen wiil lagu magacaabo Maxamed Xasan Khaliif waxa ay ugu dambeyn ku heshiiyeen guur. Asiya oo maalmo fasax ah ku tagtay magaalada Caasimadda ah ee Muqdisho, waxa ay dib ugu soo noqotay Doolow, halkaa oo uu meherkoodii si habsami leh uga dhacay. 23-kii bishii aynu ka soo gudubnay ee Diseembar ayuu dhacay arooskoodii, hase yeeshee xilligaasi wixii ka dambeeyay waxaa farxaddii guurka hareysay murugo iyo tacsi waa saddex toddobaad gudahood. Isla maalmihii guurkooda uu dhacay waxaa geeriyootay Aasiya ayeydeed, waxaana halkaa ka dhacday tacsi sababtay in ay soo gaabtaan maalmihii dabaal degga ee arooska. Tacsida kadib Aasiya iyo seygeeda waxa ay ku heshiyeen in ay soo baxdo oo ay timaado Nairobi, waxa ay soo gaartay Ismaamulka Mandera halkaas oo loogu diyaariyay tigidkii ay diyaaradda kusoo raaci lahayd si ay Nairobi oo gurigii looga kireeyay ay u timaaddo. Maxamed Khaliif oo ah seyga Aasiya ah waxa uu xilligii uu meherka dhacayay ku sugnaa dalka Koonfurta Sudan oo ah halkaas oo uu ka shaqeeyo, adeerradiis ayaana dhameeyay howsha guurka iyo doonista gabadha waxaana ay ku ballameen in ay Nairobi timaaddo si ay ugu aqal galaan. Maxamed oo BBC-da u warramay ayaa yiri, “Anigu waxa aan kaga soo hormaray Nairobi si aan aqalkii noogu diyaariyo, gabadha waxaa safarka la soo gashay habaryarteed oo dooneysay in ay Nairobi Keento, balse wixii intaa ka dambeeyay musiibo ayaa dhacday. Diyaaraddii ay subixii kasoo raaci lahaayeen Mandera ayaa loo sheegay in ay dib u dhacday iyadoo maalmahaas ay diyaaraduhu hakad galeen, waxa ay go’aansadeen in ay gaari soo raacaan, hase yeeshee amar Alle ayaa dhexda ku helay oo shil ayey galeen”. Magaalada Garissa oo ay nabad ku yimaadeen markii ay ka soo baxeen ayuu shilku dhacay oo xitaa markii hore gaarigii ayaa cillad ku timid markaa Maxamed iyo Aasiyo way wada hadleen si farxadi ku jirto maadaama ay dareemayeen in is aragoodu uu dhow yahay. Maxamed ayaa sheegay in ay gabadha habaryarteed oo lagu magacaabayay Faadumo ay shilkaasi ku naf weyday Aasiyana uu soo gaaray dhaawac daran. Maxamed ma uusan jecleyn in Aasiya iyo habaryarteed ay ku soo safraan gaari maadama ay waddadu dheereyd safarkuna uu khatar badnaa, wuxuu isku dayay in uu ku qanciyo in ay diyaaradaha sugaan, hase yeeshee markii dambe waxaa la’isku af gartay in safar dhulka ah la soo galo. “Markii iigu dambeysay waxaan isla hadleynay in kabadan 30 daqiiqo oo ay taagnaayeen meel uu gaarigu kaga cilladoobay, markii uu u hagaagay ayey soo bexeen oo aan is macsalaameynay, 12 daqiiqo kadib waxaa i soo wacday gabar saaxiibteed ah oo Iyana safarka ku wehlineysay oo aad u ooyeysa waxana ay ii sheegtay in ay qaddari dhacday”, ayuu yiri Maxamed Khaliif. Waxa uu sheegay in ay gabadhii ku war gelisay in habaryar Faadumo ay xaaladeedu aad u adag tahay Aasiyana ay gacan ka go’day isla markaana aysan wax gurmad ah heysan. Garissa ayaa dib loogu celiyay si halkaa loogu dabiibo xaaladooda. Saacad kadib ayaa lasoo sheegay geerida habaryar Faadumo, waxaana Nairobi loola soo cararay Aasiya. Markii habaryar ay geeriyootay waxaan Maxamed iyo dadkii kale ay xoogga saareen in Aasiyo loo soo qaado Nairobi si loola tacaalo xaaladeeda. “Dhakhaatiirtu waxa ay sheegeen in gabadha uu maskaxda dhiig uga furmay isla markaana loo baahan yahay in qalliin deg deg ah lagu sameeyo, intaa ka dibna qalliinkii ayaa lagu guuleystay, ka dib ayaa naloo sheegay haddana in maskaxda iyo wadnaha gabadha aysan wada shaqeyneyn oo xaalad culus ay gashay markale”, ayuu yiri Maxamed. Waxa uu codsaday in loo fasaxo in uu gudaha ugu galo qolka ay ka jiiftay isbitaalka isagoo tilmaamay in habeenkii oo dhan uu dul taagnaa marka gacanta saaro meel ka mida jirkeedana uu ka dareemayay qabow badan. “Subixii ayaa dhakhtarku noo yimid, waxa uu xoogaa ka dib noo sheegay in gabadhu ay xaaladeeda sii cuslaaneyso, xogaa uu gudaha ku jiray ka dibna waa uu noo yimid waxana uu nagu war geliyay akhbaarka geerideeda”, ayuu yiri Maxamed Xasan Khaliif. Maxamed waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in geerida ayeeyadeed oo ay aad u jecleed ay Aasiya ku abuurtay murug badan, isla markaana ay wakhti ku qaadatay in uu dejiyo ama samirsiiyo. Waxa uu ku ammaanay in ay ahayd gabar af gaaban oo aqlaal badan, isla markaana uu u duceynayo. Waxa uu sheegay in uu hilmaami waayay hadal ay ku tiri ka hor inta aysan soo gelin safarka dhulka ah ee ay shilka ku galeen. “Waxa ay igu tiri waan ogahay in aadan jecleyn safar dhulka ah mana rabo in aan sameeyo wax aadan raalli ka ahayn, laakiin niyada ii fur, anigana waxa aan ku iri wan ku fasaxay waana idiin duceeyay ee Allaha idin nabad keeno”, ayuu sii raaciyay Maxamed. Shalay ayaa Aasiya lagu aasay magalaada Nairobi oo ugu dambeyn ay ku geeriyootay.

Iran, Mareykanka iyo Koobka Adduunka ee bilaabanaya saddex bilood gudaheed In ka yar 100 maalmood, Maraykanka waxa uu noqon doonaa mid ka mid ah dalalka martigelinaya Koobka Adduunka ee sanadkan 2026, waa tartan ay xulka qaranka Iran u soo baxeen. Sabtidii, Maraykanka iyo Israa'iil waxay weerar ku qaadeen Iran, taasna waxay dhalisay weerarro aargoosi ah oo lagu qaaday qaar ka mid ah dalalka Bariga Dhexe. Haddaba maxay dagaalladani uga dhigan yihiin FIFA iyo dalalka ka qeybgalaya Koobka Adduunka oo horeyba si weyn loo siyaasadeeyay? BBC qeybta isboortiga ayaa isku dayday in ay arrintan si dhow u eegto. Iran waxay qeyb kula jirtaa dalal ya ka mid yihiin New Zealand, Belgium iyo Masar. waxay Los Angeles kula ciyaareysaa dalalka New Zealand iyo Belgium, kaddibna Masar ayey isku arkayaan magaalada Seattle. Iran kama bixin tartanka sanadkii hore markii Maraykanku duqeeyey xarumaha nukliyeerka ee dalkaas. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, rabshadaha iyo qalalaasaha hadda jira oo aad uga sii daray awgood, madaxda xiriirka kubadda cagta Iran ayaa la sheegay in ay shaki geliyeen ka-qaybgalka tartanka. "Wixii dhacay… iyo weerarka uu Maraykanku qaaday kaddib, uma muuqato in aan si rajo leh u eegi karno Koobka Adduunka, balse madaxda ciyaaraha ayaa go'aankaas leh," ayuu ka soo wariyay telefishinka Iran Mehdi Taj oo ah madaxweynaha xiriirka kubbadda cagta Iran. Dilka Hoggaamiyihii Sare ee Iran, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, iyo hubaanti la'aanta weyn ee ka taagan mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee dalka, waa wax aan macquul ahayn in la saadaaliyo go'aan noocaas ah cidda qaadan doonta. "Tehran, uma ahan dagaal gaaban oo 12 maalmood ah ama xiisad kooban oo la hakin karo kaddibna dib loo bilaabi karo," ayay tiri Dr Sanam Vakil, oo ah agaasimaha Barnaamijka Bariga Dhexe iyo Waqooyiga Afrika ee machadka Chatham House. "Marxaladdan cusub ee colaadda waa mid ku saabsan jiritaanka nidaamka, mana u muuqato mid si degdeg ah ku dhammaan doonta." Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta Adduunka, FIFA, waxay sheegeen in ay la socdaan xaaladda, balse mas'uuliyiin ayaa si gaar ah u sheegay in ay filayaan in Iran ka soo qaybgasho Koobka Adduunka. Sabtidii, xoghayaha guud ee FIFA, Mattias Grafstrom, ayaa sheegay, "Diiraddayadu waa in aan helno Koob Adduun oo ammaan ah iyadoo qof walba ka qaybgalayo." Sida xeerka FIFA uu dhigayo, haddii koox ka baxdo ama laga reebo, FIFA waxay "qaadi kartaa tallaabo kasta oo loo arko mid lagama maarmaan ah," waxayna "go'aansan kartaa in dal kale lagu beddelo kan ka baxay." Ciraaq iyo Imaraadka Carabta ayaa noqon kara in lagu baddelo Iran hadii ay booska baneyso , Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Madaxweynaha Maraykanka, Donald Trump ayaa sanadkii hore saxiixay amar madaxweyne oo mamnuucaya muwaadiniinta 12 dal oo ay ku jirto Iran in ay soo galaan Maraykanka, isagoo ku sababeeyey arrimo amni. Inkastoo ciyaartoyda iyo tababarayaasha Koobka Adduunka laga dhaafay xayiraadda, Iran waxay ku hanjabtay in ay qaadacdo isku aadka bishii Desember ee Washington kaddib markii fiiso loo diiday qaar ka mid ah mas'uuliyiinteeda. Haddii Iran ay ka qeybgasho tartanka, waxaa la filayaa in si aad ah loo adkeeyo amniga kulamada iyo xerada tababarka ee Arizona. Koobka Adduunka 2022 ee lagu qabtay Qatar, Iran waxay la ciyaartay Maraykanka, waxaana xilligaas dalka ka dhacay bannaanbaxyo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah dowladda. Los Angeles, oo Iran laba jeer ku ciyaari doonto, waxay hoyi u tahay Iraniyiinta ugu badan ee ku nool Mareykanka. "Waxaan ku jirnaa xaalad aan hore noo soo marin, iyadoo ay ka harsan in ka yar 100 maalmood bilaabashada Koobka Adduunka, isla markaana Mareykanku uu bilaabay dagaal ka dhan ah dal ka qaybgalaya ciyaaraha," ayuu yiri Nick McGeehan oo ka tirsan ururka xuquuqda aadanaha ee FairSquare. "Haddii Iran ka baxdo tartanka, taas oo suuragal ah, FIFA waxay dareemi doontaa nafis maadaama ay yarayneyso bannaanbaxyo iyo qalalaasaha dhici kara." Saraakiil ka tirsan dowladda Maraykanka ayaa ka digay in ay jiri karaan cawaaqib amni oo "musiibo ah" haddii 11-ka magaalo ee martigelinaya ciyaaraha aan la siin maalgelintii hakadka ku jirtay sababo la xiriira xiritaanka qayb ka mid ah dowladda. Waxaa sidoo kale jira walaac isa soo taraya oo ku saabsan in la adeegsado saraakiisha waaxda socdaalka ee ICE iyo rabshado ka dhaca Mexico oo ah dalka labaad ee martigelinaya ciyaaraha. Sawirka, Bishii December, FIFA waxay Trump ku guddoonsiisay 'Abaalmarinta Nabadda' markii ugu horreysay xafladdii isku aadka Koobka Adduunka 2026, waxayna sheegeen in uu "door muhiim ah" ka qaatay heshiis xabbad-joojin ah ee u dhexeeya Israel iyo Falastiiniyiinta, isla markaana uu isku dayay in uu soo afjaro colaado kale. Toddobaadyadii xigay, Maraykanku wuxuu qaaday tallaabooyin militari oo ka dhan ah Venezuela, Nigeria iyo Iran, wuxuuna muujiyey suurtagalnimada dagaallo kale oo ka dhici kara Greenland, Mexico iyo Colombia. Bishii January, Trump wuxuu sidoo kale Cuba ugu baaqay in ay "heshiis la gasho" ama la kulanto cawaaqib. Trump si adag ayuu u difaacay siyaasaddiisa arrimaha dibadda, isagoo ku adkaysanaya in uu ku shaqeynayo danaha Maraykanka. Go'aanka Trump ee weerarka Iran ayaa la kulmay taageero iyo cambaareyn labadaba, balse waxaa hubaal ah in ay kordhin doonto su'aalaha laga qabo go'aanka FIFA ee ku dhawaanshaha Trump, iyadoo dhaleeceeyayaashu ku doodaan in ay khatar ku tahay dhexdhexaadnimada hay'adda. Bishii January, 27 xildhibaan oo ka kala socday xisbiyada UK ee Labour, Liberal Democrats, Green Party iyo Plaid Cymru ayaa saxiixay mooshin baarlamaan oo ku baaqaya in laga saaro Maraykanka tartamada waaweyn ee caalamiga ah, oo uu ku jiro Koobka Adduunka. FIFA waxay ku adkaysanaysaa in ay sharci ahaan waajib ku tahay dhexdhexaadnimo. Sanadkii hore, Infantino wuxuu sheegay in FIFA "aysan xallin karin dhibaatooyinka juqraafi-siyaasadeed" kadib cadaadis lagu saaray in la cunaqabateeyo Israel. 2018, Koobka Adduunka waxaa lagu qabtay Ruushka oo afar sano markaas ka hor ku darsaday Crimea dhulkiisa. Ruushka waxaa sidoo kale lagu eedeeyey weerarro internetka ah iyo faragelin doorashooyin. Ugu dambeyn, FIFA ayaa Ruushka ka mamnuucday 2022 kaddib duullaankii Ukraine, markii dalal badan oo Yurub ah diideen in ay la ciyaaraan. Waxa cad in 48-kii saac ee la soo dhaafay, xaalad siyaasadeed oo horeba u adkayd in ay sii noqotay mid aad uga sii dareysa marka loo eego Koobka Adduunka.

Khubarrada saadaasha hawada ee California, dalka Mareykanka ayaa ka digaya in dabeylo xooggan oo sii hurin kara dabka Los Angeles ay mar kale halkaasi ku wajahan yihiin toddobaadkan, xilli shaqaalaha dab-damiska ay isku dayayaan inay demiyaan ilaa saddex dab oo halkaasi ka holcaya. Saraakiisha ayaa ka digay in kadib dabeylaha oo labadii maalin ee lasoo dhaafay degganaa, ay xoogeysan karaan gaar ahaanna waxaa laga baqayaa dabeylaha qallalan ee Santa Ana inay sii socdaan ilaa Arbacada. Dabkan ayaa saameeyay nolosha dadka halkaasi ku nool, waxaana ka mid ah Soomaali ganacsi ku leh xaafad ka tirsan magaalada. Xuseen Maxamuud Buulow oo maqaayad ku leh magaalada Ingliwood ee koonfurta Los Angeles, ayaa BBC-da uga warbixiyay guud ahaan saamaynta dabka. , Xuseen Buulow "Musiibadu waxay ku dhacday meel nolol kala duwan ay ka socotay oo dhismeyaal nooc kasta ah leh, haatan lama aqoonsan karo sida ay u kala dhisnaayeen, waa musiibo wayn," ayuu yiri Xuseen Buulow. Waxa uu intaa ku daray in dabka uu saamayn ku yeeshay ganacsigii iyadoona dadka inta badan ay ka qaxeen goobaha ka agdhaw halka uu dabku ka kacay. Dhanka kale waxa uu sheegay in Soomaalida halkaas ka dhaw ay yihiin kuwo aad u yar sidaasna aysan u jirin cabsi badan oo ay qabaan. "Dadka Soomaalida ah ee la shaqeeya shirkadaha filimaanta ama dad qaar ee ganacsi leh ayaa goobta ka dhawaa balse waa tiro aad u yar," ayuu raaciyay. Waxa uu xusay in waxa ugu daran ee ay ka cabsi qabaan ay tahay dhanka caafimaadka, iyadoo ay soo gaareen khashinka iyo danbasta ka soo baxaya gubashada. Tan ayaa sidoo kale sababtay in dadku aysan bannaanada iyo maqaayadaha isugu imaan taasoo saamayn ku yeelatay ganacsiga. Baaraha caafimaadka ee degmada LA ayaa cusboonaysiiyay tirada dhimashada Axaddii waxa ayna gaartay ilaa 24, halka saraakiishu ay sheegeen goor sii horaysay ugu yaraan 16 kale inay wali maqan yihiin. Ilaa 16 ka mid ah dadka dhintay ayaa laga helay aagga dab damiska ee Eaton, halka siddeed kalena laga helay aagga Palisades. Saddex kamid ah gaadiidka dab damiska ayaa ku gubtay agagaarka Los Angeles. Dabka ugu weyn waa Palisades, kaas oo hadda gubay in ka badan 23,000 eekar oo 11% ka kooban. Ka hor duufaanta dabaysha, xoogaa horumar ah ayaa laga sameeyay joojinta fiditaanka dabka ee Palisades iyo Eaton, kuwaas oo haatan ka gubanaya darafyada magaalada. Dab demiska maxalliga ah ayaa waxaa caawinaya shaqaale ka socda siddeed gobol oo kale, iyo sidoo kale Canada iyo Mexico, kuwaas oo qayb ka ah howlgalka. Dabka Eaton waa kan labaad ee ugu weyn wuxuuna ku gubay in ka badan 14,000 eekar. Waxa ku jira 27% Dabka Hurst ayaa isna gaaray 799 eekar, waxaana lagu dhawaaday in si buuxda loo xakameeyo. Dabkaan ka kacay LA ayaa saamayntiisu waxa ay dhalisay khasaare aad u badan waana kii ugu kharashka badnaa taariikhda Maraykanka. Axaddii, saadaasha gaarka ah ee Accuweather ayaa kordhisay qiyaasta horudhaca ah ee khasaaraha maaliyadeed ee dabka waxaana lagu sheegay inuu gaarsiisanyahay inta u dhaxaysa $250bn-$275bn. In kasta oo shaqaaluhu ay ku guulaysteen xakamaynta dabka ugu weyn, mas'uuliyiintu waxay ka digeen dabaysha la filayo inay ku soo wajahantahay aagga uu dabku ka dhacay taas oo horseedi karta "xaalad masiibo ah", iyada oo dhammaan gobolka LA lagu soo rogay digniinno la xiriira dabka.

Gaadiidka dadweynaha ha noqdo baska amaba bajaajta, diyaaradaha iyo kuwa kaleba, waxaa macquul ah inaad ku aragtay dad badan oo xiran sameecadaha dhegaha. Dabcan, iyagaa iskood u xirtay, balse ka warran haddii ay muhiim u tahay inay xirtaan? Marka ka warran haddii ay xirtaan sameecado iyagoo aan jecleyn balse ku qasban? Haa! Dadka qaar waa inay xirtaan sameecadaha dhegaha. Margot Noel, oo 28 jir ah, way ku qasban tahay inay xirato sameecadaha dhegaha. Dadkan waxay sidaa u sameynayaan inay naftooda ka badbaadiyaan dhibaato iyaga u gaar ah. Margot Noel waxay qabtaa xaalad lagu magacaabo misophonia. Haddii si fudud loo yiraahdo, misophonia waa xanuun. Dhawaqyada caadiga ah ayaa dadkan ka xanaajiya oo diiqad ku beera. Tan ayaa ka careysiisa, mararka qaarna way baqaan, mar mar xitaa waxay ku sugtaan wadno xanuun. Marka ay maqlaan dhawaqyada qaar, qeybaha maskaxdooda ka mid ah ee qaabilsan inay isku xirto dhawaqa iyo dareemaha ayaa degdeg u howlgala. Ma ogtahay in dhawaqyada caadiga ah ee yaryar sida qof neefsanaya, wax la xoqayo, cunto cunidda iyo xitaa dhawaqa qalinka wax qoraya inuu diiqad ku abuuri karo dadka qaar kana xanaajin karo? Dadka sidan ah waxay qabaan misophonia.

Magaalada caasimadda ah ee Muqdisho waxaa ruxay shaqaaqo u dhexeysay ciidamada Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo kooxo hubaysan oo kasoo horjeeda kuwaas oo ku dagaalamay xaafadda Tarbuunka gaar ahaan aagga garoonkii kooxda Horseed ee xulkii qaranka ee Soomaaliya oo haatan ay dad deegaameysteen burbrkii kadib. Iska hor imaadkii ka dhacay halkaas waxuu sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin tiradooda. Waxaana dhacdadaan si adag u canbeereeyay madax hore oo dalka soo martay, waxaana kamid ah madaxweynahii hore ee Soomaaliya Shariif Sheekh Axmed, Madaxweyne hore Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo, Ra'iisulwasaare hore Xasan Cali Khayre. Waxaa sidoo kale dhanka maamul goboleedyadana war kasoo saaray dowlad goboleedka Jubaland oo iyagana dhaleeceeyay waxii ka dhacay xerada Horseed. Dadka deegaanku waxay sheegeen in loo sheegay in ay isaga guureen dhulka maadaamada ay dowladdu leedahay sidaasna uu dagaal gacan ka hadal ah goobta uga qarxay, balse dowladdu waxay ku adkeysaneysaa in in dhacdadii ka dhacday xaafadda Tarbuunka ee magaalada Muqdisho ay ahayd mid ah xaqiijiin amni iyo ka hortagista hubka sharci darrada ah. Warsaxaafadeedkaas ay soo saareen laamaha amniga ayaa lagu sheegay in ay jiraan waxyeelo dhimasho iyo dhaawacba leh oo gaadhay dad shacab ah oo agagaarka ku sugnaa, xubno ka tirsan ciidamada amniga iyo qaarkamid ah waxay warbixinta booliisku ku sheegtay 'maleeshiyo hubaysnayd'. Ma jiraan ilo rasmi ah oo madax bannaan si rasmi ah u xaqiijin kara khasaaraha ka dhacay halkaas mid dhimasho, dhaawac iyo khasaaraha maaliyadeed ee shaqaaqadaasi dhalisay. , Cabdiqaadir Ciise Cabdi

Guidance: Ticketing for BBC events and programmes The purpose of this guidance note is to assist content makers in meeting the Editorial Guidelines relating to Ticket Sales. (See Editorial Guidelines Section 16: External Relationships, including Commercial Relationships, and Financing 16.4.37 – 16.4.38) The Editorial Guidelines state that: The BBC may recover costs from the proceeds of ticket sales for BBC UK Public Service or World Service events which contribute to the BBC's Mission and Public Purposes.[1] This should be in line with the Statement on Ticketing for BBC Public Service Events.[2] The BBC may charge for tickets to BBC concerts, concert series or other BBC events held at outside venues. The BBC should not charge for admission to regular recordings of other programmes. Entry should only be charged for events held at an outside venue, not normally for events held in BBC studios. However, there may be a way to charge for tickets to events held in a BBC concert hall or studio. Advice and approval can be sought from Editorial Policy. The BBC may also charge for tickets to BBC concerts held in the regular venues of the BBC performing groups. Some BBC concert halls or studios are used both for orchestral concerts and also to record regular BBC programmes. It is not appropriate to charge for tickets for the regular programme recordings. In other exceptional, circumstances if there is any proposal to sell tickets to any other BBC event on BBC premises, such as an event to raise money for a BBC charitable initiative, the proposal must be approved in advance by Editorial Policy. Proposals to ticket a BBC event, which is part of a third party event that will require the public to pay an entry fee, should be referred to Editorial Policy. Occasionally an outside organisation, for example a gardening club, may invite the BBC to hold an outside broadcast programme at their premises. In these cases, with the advance approval of Editorial Policy, it may be appropriate for the location to charge a modest fee to the audience that they invite, in order to cover their costs. The amount charged must be agreed with the BBC beforehand to ensure the fee is fair and is not set at a rate that is designed to make a profit. Sometimes a programme which is regularly recorded in a BBC studio puts on an event at an outside location. For example a radio comedy sometimes appears at the Edinburgh Festival. In such cases it may be appropriate to charge for tickets to the special outside broadcast show. Ticket revenue must only cover the costs of an event or series of events and not be used for broadcast or production costs. The proceeds are not designed to generate further income for the BBC, unless the sales raise money for a BBC charitable initiative, such as Children in Need or Comic Relief and this has been approved by Editorial Policy and the relevant charity. Tickets to events and/or BBC shows may be included in auctions and prize draws to raise money for BBC partner charities. Any such proposals must be referred to the Senior Editorial Figure in charge of the content which is to be included. They must also be referred to Editorial Policy and ITACU (Interactive Technical Advice and Contracts Unit). In order to ensure that proposals for ticketing events and/or setting up new events meet the Statement of Policy on use of alternative finance in BBC[3] content, contact the Fair Trading team, part of the Public Policy team. An Events Form from Fair Trading must be completed for Public Service events for which tickets will be charged where it is: (b) an existing event with significant changes to either (i) the event or (ii) the charged ticketing arrangements. Ticket prices must be referred to Fair Trading who will assess likely market impact. The final proposal, including the ticketing, must be approved by the relevant Head of Department/Controller who must refer to Editorial Policy, Public Policy and Regulatory Legal. While ticket revenue may be used for event costs, the BBC must pay for all broadcast costs. Occasionally there are requests from festivals, such as film festivals, to display a recorded programme, either prior to transmission or post- transmission. Approvals for this should come from the relevant Head of Marketing. It is not normally appropriate for a separate charge to be made to see the BBC material. However it may be acceptable for there to be an over-all entry charge to the whole event, if it includes a substantial amount of non-BBC content, for example when showcasing BBC content at a third party event such as a public festival. BBC Audience Services supply audiences for many TV and radio programmes and some BBC events with free tickets. They advertise the availability of tickets on the BBC Tickets site. Audience Services have a Code of Practice for free ticketing for BBC programmes. (See Code of Practice: BBC Guidelines for Ticketing and Stewarding BBC Studio Audience Programmes) Should a production wish to use another ticketing supplier they should establish that the company is reputable – no external organisation that the BBC becomes involved with should bring the BBC into disrepute. (See Editorial Guidelines 16.4.1 – 16.4.9) It is advisable to check that that there is no controversy associated with the company's ticketing and that they are reliable in sending out tickets. BBC Studios has a Privacy Team who work with BBC Information Security to assess suppliers' compliance with information security and data privacy policies and standards. Once this due diligence has been completed, the relevant Production's Business Affairs team can pull together the paperwork/contract. Ticketing for BBC broadcast events held at an outside venue may be handled by the BBC, by the external venue or by a ticketing company which has been contracted by the BBC or by the external venue, such as the box office at a concert hall. For a BBC event a direct link to the ticketing site is likely to be editorially justifiable. It should be clear that the public is leaving the BBC site to get to the source of the tickets. It is important that the primary purpose of the site that is linked to is the selling of public tickets. It would not be appropriate, for example, to link to a site whose primary purpose was to sell corporate hospitality to a BBC event. However it may be acceptable to link to a site selling public tickets for a BBC event as its primary purpose, which also sells added extras to the event (such as corporate hospitality), if there is appropriate separation between the main function and the subsidiary ones. On all external ticketing sites there should also be adequate separation between the use of BBC brands and third party brands. If in doubt, contact Fair Trading for further advice. Third party ticketing sites providing tickets for BBC events should not normally be referred to in on air trails. Usually an acceptable route is to point to the programme or channel website and link to external sites from there (for example to a ticketing site or an event/festival site). When a BBC commissioned programme or BBC commissioned event, such as Sports Personality of the Year, is ticketed, availability of the tickets may be trailed on air. Care should be taken if availability of tickets for events organised by third parties are mentioned. It is not usually appropriate to trail tickets on air or online for third party events. All ticketing arrangements must stand up to scrutiny and be clearly auditable. It is very important to ensure that event costs are calculated separately from the broadcast costs. Geela iyo Soomaalida ayaa sinnaba loo kala qaadi karin ama loo kala bixin karin, waana sidii caruur iyo hooyadood ama ilko iyo bishimahooda. Soomaalida ayaa suugaanteeda ku xusta geela iyaga oo u tiriya gabayo ama heeso lagu ammaanayo geela. Sidoo kale, waxay u bixiyaan magacyo aad u qurux badan oo ka turjumaya xiriirka ka dhexeeya geela iyo qofka dhaqda. Adduunyada casriga ah ayaa hadda ku baraarugaysa faa’iidooyinka uu leeyahay geela, caanahiisa iyo waxyaalaha kale ee laga sameeyo caanaha geela. Intii aan baarayay caanaha geela iyo faaiidooyinkooda waxaan ogaaday in ay jiraan meelo ka mid ah dalka Itoobiya oo laga aaminsan yahay in caanaha geela ay wax tar gaar ah u leeyihiin ragga iyo dumarka lamaanaha ah. Qeybaha hoose ayaan kusii sharrixi doonaa qodobkan. Waxaan wax ka weydiiyay faaiidada caanaha geela Diktoor Khadar Cabdullaahi oo ah dhakhtar cudurada guud, ahna falanqeeye arrimaha bani’aadamka, kana howl gala magaalada Hargeysa. Waxaan weydiiyay faaiidada dhabta ah ee caanaha geela, wuxuuna yiri. ‘’Caanaha geela waxaa badanaa ku jira nafaqooyin u fiican korriimada jirka, waxaana ka mid ah nafaqooyinkaas, calcium, thiamine, iyo pottasium oo u wada fiican korriimaha jirka. Waxaan sidoo kale wax ka weydiiyay faaiidada caanaha geela, Diktoor Cusmaan oo muqdisho ka howl gala. Wuxuuna yiri ‘’ Caanaha geela marka ay cusub yihiin waxay leeyihiin fiitamiino muhiim u ah jirka bani’aadamka oo ay ka mid yihiin calcium oo u roon lafaha iyo essencial enzymes oo adkeeya difaaca jirka.’’ Faaiidooyinka caanaha geela ayaa intaas ku ekeen, ‘’Caanaha geela waxay xakameeyaan macaanka jirka, waxay sidoo kale daawo u yihiin xasaasiyadaha kala duwan sida neefta, sanboorka, xasaasiyadda cuntada iyo wixii la mid ah.’’ Sidaas waxaa qoray Diktoor Cabdullahi Mahdi oo ka howlgala isbitaalka Eastend oo ku yaalla magaalada Nairobi ee dalka Kenya, sidoo kalena ah qoraa macluumaadka caafimaadka ah ku daabaca bogga SomaliDoc.

Muxuu yahay Kaarka Buluuga ah ee muranka dhaliyey ee kubadda cagta lagu soo kordhiyey , AFP VIA Kubadda cagta ayaa mar kale lagu soo dari doonaa mid ka mida qorshayaal loo arko inay qayb ka qaadan karaan sidii loo hormarin lahaa, balse waxaa durba soo baxaya diidmo ay ka muujinayaan dadka ku xeeldheer ciyaaraaha. Sharci-dajiyayaasha kubbadda cagta IFAB ayaa ka doodi doona xeerar cusub oo ah anshax marin ciyaartooyda ah, waxayna arki doonaan kaararka buluugga ah. Kaarkan waxaa la yiraahdaa ‘Sin-bins’ waa calaamad lagu ganaaxayo ciyaartoyda kubadda cagta kaasoo ku biiraya digniinaha hadda jirta ee Jaalaha iyo gaduudka ee loo taago ciyaartoyda marka ay galaan khalaadaad is xiga. Garsoorayaal hore oo kubadda cagta ah qaar ayaa gadaal ka riixaya qorshan iyagoo ku sifeeyey inuu yahay mid loo baahan yahay xiligan kubadda cagtu ay samaysay horumaro waaweyn. Guddiga Xiriirka Kubada Cagta ee Caalamka ee la yiraahdo IFAB ayaa qorshaynaya inay kaarkan ku qabtaan kulankooda sanadlaha ah ee Loch Lomond oo bisha soo socota ka dhici doona Scotland iyadoo si tijaabo ah loo adeegsan doono kaarka Buluuga ah. Horyaalka Premier League ayaa horay u diiday inuu qeyb ka ahaado soo saarista bilowga ah ee tijaabo kasta, halka xiriirka kubbadda cagta adduunka ee Fifa uu sheegay in "warbixinta waxa loogu yeero 'kaarka buluuga ah' ee heerarka sare ee kubada cagta ay yihiin kuwo khaldan oo dhicis ah". Sida uu sheegay Maxamed Axmed Deysane oo ah khabiir ka faalooda kubada cagta, kaarkan ayaa noqonaya mid qaadan doona waqti dheer si loo meel mariyo. Labada waqti ee ugu badan ee la adeegsan doono kaarkan Buluuga ah ee ‘Sin-bins’ ayaa kala ah, marka ciyaartoy caraysan uu u ordo dhanka garsooraha taas oo aan haddda loo adeegsan inta badan calaamadda Jaalaha ah ama ‘yellow card’ iyo tan labaad oo ah marka mid ka mid ah ciyaartoyda wada ciyaaraysa uu soo jiido ama si xoog ah dhulka u dhigo mid kale. Marka kaarka Buluuga loo taago ciyaaryahan waxaa uu banaanka u baxayaa ilaa 10 daqiiqo oo ganaax ah, taas oo fursad u ah kooxda kale. Hadii labo kaar oo Buluug ah loo taagana ciyaaryahanka ayaa la siinayaa kaarka gaduudan ‘Red card’. Heerka uu gaarsiisan yahay ganaaxa ka dhalanaya kaarkan ayaa ah mid ka hooseeya labada calaamadood ee jaalaha iyo gaduudka. Sida uu qabo Deysane, tan waxay meesha ka saaraysaa in garsoorayaashu ku deg degaan sida hadda dhacda calaamadaha la isticmaalo ee jaalaha iyo Gaduudka, taas oo fursad u ah ciyaaryahanada. Kaarkan ayaa hore loo adeegsaday gaar ahaan ciyaaraha aan diiwan gashayn sida kuwada dhalinyarada. Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Waxaa durba soo baxaya falcelin laga muujinayo kaarkan lagu wado in lagu soo kordhiyo kubada cagta, qaar ka mida khabiirada kubadda cagta iyo ciyaartoy hore ayaa ka hadlay kaarkan. Xiddigii hore ee Realmadrid, Arsenal iyo xulka Jarmalka Mascuud Ozil ayaa ka mid ah dadka ka hadlay kaarkan, laakiin wuxuu isagu si gaara u xusay in kooxo badan ay dhibaato ka soo gaari doonto hadii la dhaqan galiyo. Ozil ayaa xusay in kooxda Atlentic Madrid oo ka dhisan Spain ay tahay kooxda ugu badan ee u dhibanaan doonta kaarkan isagoo ku sababeeyey in kooxdaas ay difaacyadeedu galaan khaladaad badan oo ay ku galaan ciyaartoyda kooxaha la ciyaaraya. “Waxaa arki doontaa Atletico Madrid oo lix ciyaaryahan ku soo hareen garoonka haddii kaarkan Buluuga la hirgaliyo” ayuu si kaftana u yiri Ozil. Tababarayaal hore oo kubadda cagta ayaa iyaguna tilmaamay in tani ay mar kale soo kordhin doonto in khilaafka uu sii xoogaysto. Mudooyinkii danbe kubadda cagta ayaa lagu soo kordhiyey laba agab oo cusub oo kala ah Goal-line technology iyo VAR, waxayna labaduba dhaliyeen muran xoog leh oo kubadda cagta. Nidaamka Goal-line technology ayaa lagu hubiyaa saxnaanshaha goolka iyo in kubaddu ka gudubtay xariiqinta u dhaxaysa labada birood ee goolka taas oo wargalin siisa garsooraha dhexda oo qalab ugu xiran yahay gacanta. Sawirka, VAR, waa tiknoolajiyad kale oo iyadana lagu soo kordhiyey kubada cagta taas oo caawisa garsoorayaasha laakiin ilaa hadda waxaa ka tagaan khilaaf xoog leh. Aaladan ayaa awood u leh inay soo kala dhexgasho goolasha lagu murmo, khaladaadka lagu galo diilinta ganaaxa iyo digniinta gaduudan ee ay bixiyaan garsoorayaasha. Ilaa iyo markii VAR la ogolaaday in la isticmaalo waxaa tabasho xooggan ka muujiyey maamulayaasha kooxaha kubadda cagta ee caalamka oo tilmaamay inay iyadu qayb ka tahay khalaadaadka jira. Lama oga in uu dhaqan gali doono qorshahan kaarka Buluuga ah ee la doonayo in lagu soo daro calaamadaha Jaalaha iyo Gaduudka ee hadda loo isticmaalo kubadda cagta.

Faahfaahinta wixii maanta ka dhex dhacay baarlamaanka: Feer iyo Firimbi Xildhibaannada labada aqal ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta kulan wadajir ah ku yeeshay xarunta Golaha Shacabka ee magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo looga doodayey qeybinta ajandaha lagu meel marin doono wax ka beddelka lagu sameeyey qaar kamid ah cutubyada dastuurka Soomaaliya. Kulanka ayaa waxaa shir-guddoominayey Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) oo ay wehlinayeen Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Koowaad ee Golaha Aqalka Sare Mudane Cali Shacbaan Ibraahim, iyo xubnaha kale ee guddoonka labada aqal. Kulankan ayaa waxaa hareeyey buuq xooggan oo ay sameeyeen xildhibaanno ka tirsan mucaaradka, kuwaas oo si cad uga soo horjeeday qorshaha wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka ee ay waddo dowladda. Fadhiga waxaa yimid oo ka qeyb-galay xildhibaanno gaarayay 180 xildhibaan oo ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka iyo 31 Senator oo ka socda Aqalka Sare. Intii uu socday kulanka, mudanayaasha labada aqal waxaa loo qeybiyey warbixinta soo-jeedinta wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka ee la xiriira cutubyada 5-aad ilaa 9-aad. Sidoo kale, xildhibaannada waxaa la siiyey warbixin faahfaahsan oo sharxaysa soo-jeedintaas iyo wax-ka-beddel la doonayo in lagu sameynayo Qodobbada 49-aad, 50-aad iyo 54-aad ee cutubka 4-aad ee Dastuurka. Fadhiga maanta ee baarlamaanka waxa uu intiisa badan ahaa mid uu buuq hareeyey, markii uu yimid guddoomiyaha ayaa waxaa bilaabatay in xildhibaannadii diidanaa ajendihii maanta ay jeex-jeexaan waraaqihii uu ku qornaa ajendaha. Wax ka beddelka dastuurka ayaa la hadal hayey muddooyinkii u dambeeyey, xildhibaannada maanta diidanaa ayaa ku dooday in aysan suuragal ahayn in wax laga beddelo dastuurka hadda, waxa ay sidoo kale Mudanayaashan ku eedeeyeen Madaxtooyada iyo Guddoonka Baarlamaanka inay doonayaan inay meel mariyaan isbeddello dastuuri ah oo aan haysan taageerada shacabka iyo Baarlamaanka. Xildhibaan Cabdirashiid Xiddig oo ka mid ah mudanayaasha diiddan wax ka beddelka ayaa mar uu wariyaha BBC-da la hadlayey yiri "waxaa la soo diyaariyey in baarlamaanka waqtigiisa la dheereysto, dastuur aan heshiis lagu ahayn oo wax ka beddel lagu soo sameeyey oo guruub gaar ah ay wataan intaas ayaa la rabay in baarlamaanka la keeno annagana taas ayaan diidnay". Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Shalay ayey ahayd markii guddiga joogtada ah ee baarlamaanka ay isku fahmi waayeen oo ay kula tageen meel marinta ajandahan wax ka beddelka dastuurka. Dhanka kale, xildhibaannada taageersan wax ka beddelka dastuurka ayaa qaba in ay tahay la sii wado shaqada baarlamaanka si loo dhammeestiro meel marinta iyo aqrinta ajandaha wax ka beddelka dastuurka. Maxamed Cabdiqaadir oo kamid ah xildhibaannada taageersanaa ayaa yiri "waxaa aaminsanhay in shaqada la wado, waxaan aaminsanahay aragtida naga duwan in baarlamaanka la yimaado fagaaraha laga hadlo ra'yiga la weydiiyo". Isagoo intaas ku daray "in firinbi la soo qaato wax micno ah ma sameeneyso malaha". Jadwalka ayaa ka koobnaa sadex marxaladood oo kala dambeeya, sida ku cad nuqun ay BBC-du heshay, marxaladda kowaad ayaa loogu talo galay in lagu qeybiyo nuqullada ay ku qoran yihiin 'soo jeedinta wax ka beddelka dastuurla', halka marxaladda 2aad ay noqonayso 'ka doodista wax ka beddelka dastuurka', iyo marxaladda u dambeysa oo ah 'dhammeystirka soo jeedinta wax ka beddelka dastuurka'. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa ku wargeliyey xildhibaannada labada aqal in ay si qoto dheer u akhriyaan soo-jeedimaha iyo warbixinta la socota, si loogu diyaargaroobo doodda rasmiga ah ee wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka. Ugu dambeyntii Xildhibaanada mucaaradka ayey u suurto gashay inay baajiyaan kulankii wadajirka ahaa ee labada aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ee la doonayay in lagu meel mariyo wax ka beddelka Dastuurka, kaasoo ay ku tilmaameen mid aan sharci ahayn, inkasta oo guddoomiye Aadan Madoobe uu ka codsaday in la ansixiyo waxa uuna sheegay in maanta qorsha uu ahaa in la qeybiyo ajandaha ayna qeybiyeen oo lagu guuleestay hawshii maanta meesha loo yimid. "Xildhibaannada sharafta leh maanta si fiican ayaa loo soo xaadiray, waana loo qeybiyey ajendaha hala soo aqristo". Guddoomiyaha oo ay ku buuqayeen xildhibaannada kasoo horjeeday ayaa sheegay in lala hadli doono xildhibaannadii diyaar u ah wadahadal. Muuqaalladii maanta ee laga soo tabinayey fadhiga baarlamaanka ayaa muujinayey xildhibaanno gacanta iskula tegey, buuq iyo fowdo. Ma aha markii ugu horreysay ee rabshado ay ka dhacdo gudaha baarlamaanka. Dabayaaqadii bishii Abriil ee sannadkii hore ayaa sidaasoo kale ay xildhibaannadu gacanta isu qaadeen.
