"Sidaas darteed, ka-noqoshada aqoonsiga [madax-banaanida iyo madax-bannaanida dalka, waxaa guud ahaan loo arki karaa xasillooni-darro iyo mid d diblomaasiyada ka so horjeedda." Marka la eego, aqoonsiga Itoobiya ee 1993-kii ee dawladda Ku-meel-gaarka ah waxay noqon kartaa "mid aan laga noqon karin," ayuu yiri Visokan. Sidaa darteed, "Itoobiya ka laabashada aqoonsiga Eritrea waa mid aan sal lahayn. "Intaa waxaa dheer, maadaama Eritrea ay xubin buuxda ka tahay Qaramada Midoobay, ka bixitaanka Itoobiya ee aqoonsiga waxaa laga yaabaa inuu faa'iido amni u keeno labada dal laakiin ma wiiqi doono mowqifka caalamiga ah ee Eritrea iyo maqaamkeeda dal madax-bannaan," ayuu yiri. Ilaa hadda, Itoobiya ma aysan sheegin inay doonayso inay si cad u aqoonsato madax-bannaanida Eritrea iyo in kale. Arrinkan, diblumaasiyadda sii wiiqmeysa ee Eritrea iyo duullaanka Ruushka ee Ukraine, ayaa waxay walaac ku noqdeen dad badan oo Eriteriyaan ah. Ku guuldaraysiga Eritrea ee ah in ay aqoonsatoa Falastiin ayaa sidoo kale isha lagu hayaa.

Haasaawaha: Maxay gabdhaha Kenya u raadsadaan macallimiin bara shukaansiga? Waxbarashada dhanka haasaawaha way sii kordheysaa sanad kasta, waxaana sabab u ah in ay bateen dumarka raadinaya in ay helaan rag ay nolosha la wadaagaan. Macallimiinta dumarka bara shukaansiga waxay inta badan ballan qaadaan in macaamiishooda ay heli doonaan niman, iyadoo aysan jirin cid dammaanad qaad u sameyn karta arrintaas - balse mararka qaar waxay u muuqataa inay ku guuleystaan farxad siinta iskaabulada. "Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego qaar ka mid ah khaladaadka aad sameysaan," ayuu yiri Robert Burale oo taagan masraxa, iyadoo uu dhawaaqayo muusig uu halkaas ka garaacayo DJ. "Diyaar ma u tihiin arrintaas?" ayuu weydiinayaa dadka ku sugan hoolka. Waxaa durbadiiba la maqlayaa hadallo hoose oo u muuqday in ay yihiin kuwo la isku ceebsanayo. Kaddib ayuu Robert, oo socsoconayay intii uu khudbaddiisa wadayoo dhan, mar qura u aamusay si lama filaan ah, makarafoonkii ayuu ku qabsaday hal gacan, gacantii kalena wuxuu ku taagay dadkii hortiisa dhoobnaa. "Gabdhihiinna waxaad khalad ku sameysaan inaad ninka siisaan mudnaan la mid ah midda la siiyo nin xaas loo yahay isagoo wali idiin ah saaxiib oo kaliya, heerkaasna aan gaarin," ayuu yiri isagoo qeylinaya. "Raggu waa ugaarato! Mar haddii uu libaax dhuunta kaa qabto, adigana aad dhiig bax u dhimato - wuxuu islamarkiiba raadsanayaa ugaar kale." "Marka fadlan. Haddii uusan ku guursanin iska illow." Dumarkii ayaa iyagoo madaxa ruxaya u sacbiyay. Robert Burale waa macallin dadka bara arrimaha jacaylka iyo haasaawaha, munaasabaddanna - oo lagu magacaabay Haweeney qaali ah - waxaa looga golleeyahay in wax loogu sheego dumarka iskaabulada ah ee rajeynaya inay reer yeeshaan, waxaana lagu baraa sida ay ku heli karaan nin ay xaas u noqdaan. Dhowr maalmood ka hor waxaan isku aragnay bannaanka hore ee xafiiskiisa ku yaalla magaalada Nairobi, Kenya. Waxay ahayd xilli kulul, wuxuuna xirnaa suud, shaati iyo garabaati iyo fasaleeti u eg garabaatigiisa, balse wuxuu sharraxay in aadan ogaan karin meesha ay maalintaada ku dhammaaneyso iyo cidda aad la kulmeyso. Mar walbana labiska ugu quruxda badan uu yahay suudka. Xafiiskiisa gudihiisa, muuqaallo uu ku duubay cashirrada haasaawaha ayaa ka daarnaa shaashado dhowr ah, wuuna nagu dhex wareejiyay si aan u aragno. In ka badan toban qof ayaa wax ku qorayay kumbuyuutarrada, haweeney da' yar oo qaybta soo dhaweynta fadhisana waxay sheegtay in daawashada muuqaalladiisa ay nafteeda ku badbaadday. Robert wuxuu sheegay inuu hayo sirta ku saabsan sida loo helo jacayl waara - inkastoo isaga qudhiisa noloshiisu aysan mar walba soo wanaagsaneyn. "Anigoo aan waxba qarineynin, guurkeyga ayaa u burburay si shaac baxsan," ayuu yiri. "Balse taas waxay ka dhigan tahay inaan dumarka si buuxda ugala talin karo sida loo yeesho xiriir guuleysta. Waan aqaannaa meesha ay dadku ka khaldamaan." Sida ay sheegtay hay'adda caalamiga ah ee tababarka - oo ah urur ka jira adduunka oo dhan - ganacsiga la xiriira tababaridda shakhsiyaadka ayaa labojibbaar noqday tan iyo sannadkii 2015-kii, arrintaasoo uu sare u qaaday isticmaalka Online-ka. Inkastoo tirada aysan isku wada mid ahayn, barnaamijkan ayaa ka socday dalal badan, laga soo billaabo Mareykanka ilaa Kenya. Cashirrada ku saabsan haasaawaha ee fool ka foolka ah waxaa bil kasta ku baxa 8,000 oo doolar, sida uu sheegay Jon Birger oo ah khabiir ku xeel dheer dhaqaalaha lagu bixiyo shukaansiga. Hase yeeshee hay'adda caalamiga ah ee tababarka shakhsiyaadka ayaa shegetay in koorsooyinka noocan ah ay sanad walba ku baxdo lacag dhan $13 bilyan oo doolar. Maalintii ka horreysay munaasabadda lagu magacaabay Haweeneyda qaaliga ah Marry waxay aragtay dariskeeda oo cunug yar u qabeynaya, shanqartoodana lagu wada baraarugyo. Way eegtay wayna u dhoolla caddeysay, sababtoo ah waxay iyaduba jeclaan lahayd inay heysato cunug yar. Mary waa 35 jir mana la guursanin wali, inkastoo waddanka ay ku nooshahay da'da gabdhaha magaalooyinka badankood lagu guursado celcelis ahaan ay tahay 21 sano. 19 jir ayaa lagu guursadaa inta badan gabdhaha miyiga, sida laga soo xigtay warbixin uu soo saaray Bangiga Adduunka. Saddex ka mid ah gabdhaha walaalaheed ah ee ka yar yar ayaa horay loo guursaday. "Cadaadiska ugu badan wuxuu kaaga imaanayaa qoyskaaga, waalidiintaada, awoowe iyo ayeeyo, adeeryaal iyo abtiyaal, eeddooyin iyo habaryaro," ayay tiri. Si joogto ah ayay mar walba u weydiiyaan sababta ay wali u tahay iskaabulo. "Waxaan rabaa inaan ogaado meesha aan khaladka ka sameeyo," ayay tiri Mary. Balse haddii ay iskaabulo tahay ma waxay ka dhigan tahay inay wax khaldan sameyneyso, ayaan weydiinnay. Miyeysan jiri karin waxyaabo kale? Ama soo ma noqon karto in qofka saxda ah helitaankiisa uu yahay nasiib? "Ma garanayo. Dad badan ayaa ii sheega inaan ahay qof dookhiisu adag yahay. Ma ogi inaan dookh adagahay iyo in kale. Ma garanayo," ayay tiri. Mary waxa ay ka shaqeysaa xarun telefoonnada laga wacdo, fasalka uu koorsada ku bixiyo Robert Burale-na lacagtiisu waa $50 doolar oo u dhiganta mushaarka ay hal isbuuc qaadato. Ma hubto in koorsadaas ay wax u qaban doonto iyo in kale - ma garaneyso in lacagta ay bixisay ay ku heli doonto nin guursada - balse way isku dayeysaa si kastoo ay ahaataba. "Way u qalantaa in la tijaabiyo, ayaan dhihi lahaa," ayay raacisay hadalkeeda. Gabadhan waxay sheegtay in hadda ka hor uu luggooyay nin ay u maleyneysay inuu guursan rabo. Iyadoo filaya in xaaladdu ay meel fiican mareyso ayay ku aragtay isbaddal lama filaan ah. "Markii aan wacay si aan u weydiiyo waxa jira, wuxuu igu yiri, 'dhageyso? qaabka nolosheyda wuu is baddalay. Heerkii aan taagnaana wuu isbaddalay." Halkaas marka ay sheegakada marsiineyso mar way aamustay. Robert ayaa hadalka qabsaday oo ku yiri: "Wuu ku quursaday sooma aha?" "Aad ayuu ii liiday, meel aad iyo aad u hooseysa ayuu i geeyay," ayay ku jawaabtay Mary. "Ninkaas wuxuu hoos u dhigay kalsoonida nafteyda," ayay sii raacisay hadalkeeda. Mary markii ay soo dhameysatay cashirka waxay sheegtay in ay kasoo heshay koorsada lasoo siiyay. Waxaan weydiinnay fikirkeeda ku saabsan talada la siiyay loogu sheegay in aysan isku dhiibin ninka ay shukaansaneyso ilaa ay ka ogaato inuu yahay nin guurka uu dhab ka yahay. "Waxay ila tahay, qaybtaas waxay u muuqatay wax laga tagay mar hore. Ma qaadanayo taladaas," ayay tiri. Mary waxay xiran tahay funaanad ay xabadka uga qoran tahay oraan dhaheysa "ha cabsanin". Waxay tiri: "Jacaylku kuma sugi karo." "Waxa ugu fiican ee aan ka qaatay cashirkii koorsada waa in aan mar walba isku dayo inaan faraxsanaado. Nafteydana aan farxad galiyo, diiraddana aan saaro sidii aan isu qancin lahaa si buuxda! "Wali waqti ayaan heystaa. Waqti fiican ayaa ii harsan. Wali waan yarahay. Haa!" Shan bilood kaddib, Mary wali waa iskaabulo, balse wax inay isbaddaleen ayay u muuqataa - waa iskaabulo balse way faraxsan tahay.

Haweeneey u shaqayn jiray shirkadda iska leh Facebook oo fashilisay faafreebyo loo sameeyay dowladda Shiinaha Qofkaan u shaqayn jiray Meta ayaa u sheegay senetarada Mareykanka Arbacadii in shirkadu ay wiiqday amniga qaranka si ay Shiinaha ugu dhisto ganacsi dhan $18 bilyan. Intii lagu guda jiray dhegeysiga aqalka Kongareeska ee Sarah Wynn-Williams, oo hore u ahaan jirtay agaasimaha siyaasadda guud ee Facebook, ayay sheegtay in ay ogayd markii ay maamulayaashu go'aansadeen in ay siiyaan xisbiga Shuuciga Shiinaha xogta isticmaaleyaasha Meta, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa Mareykanka. Meta ayaa waxba kama jiraan ku tilmaantay hadalada Wynn-Williams. "Warka Sarah Wynn-Williams waa uu ka fogyahay xaqiiqada oo waxaa ka buuxa sheegashooyin been ah," ayuu yiri afhayeenka Meta Ryan Daniels. Daniels waxa uu sheegay in maamulaha guud ee Mark Zuckerberg uu si guud uga hadlay xiisaha shirkad ay u leedahay in ay adeegyadeedu ay gaaraan Shiinaha, balse waxa uu intaa ku daray. "Xaqiiqdu waa tan: kama hawlgalaan adeegyadeena Shiinaha maanta." Meta, si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxay dakhli xayaysiis ah ka soo saartaa xayaysiisyo fadhigoodu yahay Shiinaha. Intii lagu guda jiray marag-furka haweeneydaan ee guddi-hoosaadka garsoorka ee Senate-ka, waxay sidoo kale ku eedaysay shirkadda Meta ee iska leh Facebook iyo Instagram inay "gacmo daboolan" kula shaqeysay Beijing si ay u dhisto qalab faafreeb oo loogu talagalay in lagu aamusiyo dhaleeceynta Xisbiga Bulshada Shiinaha. Si gooni ah, waxay sheegtay in Meta ay u hoggaansameen dalabaadka Shiinaha ee ah in la tirtiro akoontiga Facebook ee Guo Wengui, mucaarid Shiinees ah oo ku nool Mareykanka. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Meta waxa ay ku adkaysanaysaa in uu hawada ka maqnaado bogga Mr Guo oo ay sheegtay in ay u hakisay boggiisa sababo la xiriira in uu ku xad gudubay Xeerarka Bulshada ee shirkadda. "Hal shay oo ay wadaagaan xisbiga Shuuciga Shiinaha iyo Mark Zuckerberg ayaa ah inay rabaan inay aamusiyaan kuwa dhaleeceeya. Taas waxaan u leeyahay khibrad shakhsi ahaaneed," Wynn-Williams ayaa tiri intii ay hadlaysay. Bishii Maarso, Wynn-Williams waxay soo saartay xusuus-qor loogu magac daray "Dadka Aan waxba kala jeclayn" oo ku saabsan khibradeeda shirkadda, oo markaa loo yaqaanay Facebook. Meta ayaa ku guulaysatay xukun degdeg ah oo ka dhacay dalka Maraykanka kaas oo si ku meel gaar ah uga horjoogsaday haweyneydaan xayaysiinta buugeeda, kaas oo ay ku jiraan dhawr dacwadood oo muhiim ah oo ku saabsan wakhtigeedii shirkada. "Buugga beenta iyo sumcad-dilka ah waligiis lama daabicin," Meta ayaa markaas tiri. Dhageysiga Arbacada oo la horgeeyay xubnaha senate-ka Mareykanka ayaa waxaa hogaaminayay Senator Josh Hawley, oo ka tirsan xisbiga Jamhuuriga ee Missouri Sanatar Hawley ayaa furay dhagaysiga isagoo sheegay in Meta "ay gabi ahaanba sameynin waxba si ay uga hortagto" marqaatiga Arbacadii ay bixisay Wynn-Williams, oo ku biirtay Frances Haugen iyo Arturo Béjar oo ah shaqaalihii hore ee ka hadlay warbaahintan bulshada. "Waa maxay sababta ay Facebook-ga uga quusatay inay ka ilaaliso markhaatigan inay sheegto waxay ogtahay?" Ayuu yiri Hawley. Dhageysi kulul oo Jannaayo 2024 ka dhacay golaha Congresska oo uu Zuckerberg sidoo kale ka hor hadlay golaha, ayuu Senatar Hawley ayaa ka dalbaday maamulaha guud inuu raali gelin siiyo qoysaska sheegay in caruurtooda ay waxyeelo ka soo gaartay barihiisa bulshada. Zuckerberg gadaashiisa ayaa waxaa xilligaas fadhiyey qoysas badan oo sheegay in caruurtooda ay is-waxyeeleeyeen ama ay is dileen sababo la xiriira baraha bulshada. Zuckerberg ayaa soo jeestay oo u sheegay qoysaskii ka soo qeyb galay kulanka in "qofna uusan ahayn in uu maro" waxa uu maqlay. Intii lagu guda jiray dhageysiga Arbacada, ayaa Hawley wuxuu sheegay in Meta ay soo jeedisay in Wynn-Williams ay wajihi karto ganaax lacageed markay hadasho.

BBC da oo wariye hore Huw Edwards ka dalbatay in uu soo celiyo £200,000 oo uu mushaar ahaan u qaatay , BBC da ayaa waxay ka dalbatay Huw Edwards in uu soo celiyo lacag £200,000 taas oo uu u qaatay mushaar ahaan kadib markii la xiray bishii November ee sanadkii la soo dhaafay kadib eedeymo la xiiiray in uu ku xadgudbay caruur. Barnaamij daadihiaha hore “si xun ayuu u dhaqmay” isaga oo iska sii watay in uu qaatay mushaarkiisa isaga oo ogaa waxa uu sameeyay, sidaas waxaa yiri madaxa BBC da Samir Shah oo soo saaray warqad. Edwards oo horay u ahaa war aqriyaha ugu darajo sarreeya BBC da, ayaa sii qaadanayay mushaar muddo shan bilood ah kadib markii la xiray iyada oo lagu eedeeyay saddex dambi oo ah in uu masawiro anshax darro ah ay isla wadaageen caruur. Waxaa laga mamnuucay shaqada bishii July waxaana la xiray afar biloodka dib xilligaas. Iskama uusan casilin shaqada BBC da ilaa bishii April. Shah ayaa waxa uu sheegay in Edwards “uu ku noolaa laba nololood oo kala duwan” isaga oo ahaa qqofka wajiga u ah barnaamijyo badan sido kalana ahaa wartabiye aad loo jeclaa, balse “wuxuu qiyaanay aaminaadii ay aamineen shaqaalaha iyo dhagaystayaasha intaba” Wuxuu sheegay in wariyuhu uu ahaa “dambiile” iyo in “dhibanayaashu ay yihiin caruurta uu dhaqan xumadiisa” suuqa uga dhex sameeyay. Sawirka, Edwards ayaa waxa uu qirtay bishii July in uu galay saddex dambi oo lagu soo eedeeyay oo la xiriiray in uu sawiro anshax darro ah la wadaagay caruur. Dambiyadaan ayaa waxaa la sheegay in ay dhaceen intii u dhaxaysay sanadihii 2020 kii ilaa 2022 kii ayna ahaayeen is waydaarsiga 37 sawir oo la iskula wadaagay WhatsApp ka sida ay sheegeen booliska Metropolitan ka. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. BBC du ma aysan sheegin in ay nidaam sharci ah la aadi doonto Edwards hadiii uu lacagta soo celin waayo. Agaasimaha guud ee BBC da ayaa waxa uu sheegay todobaadkii la soo dhaafay isaga oo waraysi bixinayay in hay’addu ay ogeed qabashada Edwards iyo in loo haystay arrin aad u darran oo la xariira in caruur ay wadaageen sawiro anshax darro ah. Waxaa la fahansan yahay in markii la xiray Edwards in BBC du ay isku dayday in ay ogaato in uu qiranayo in uu hayo sawiro nuucaas ah . Inkasta oo ay BBC du arrintaan su’aalo ka waydiisay hadana uma aysan suuragalin in ay xaqiiqdo ogaato. War ay soo saaraan guddiga guud ee BBC da ayaa lagu sheegay in “ay taageereen go’aan uu qaatay agaasimaha guud iyo kooxdiisa xilligaas”. Waxaa intaas lagu daray in Edwards uu ahaa mid si furan u hadlayay markii BBC du wax ka waydiisay xarigiisa, “marnaba ma aynaan sii wadneen in aan siino xoolaha dadwaynaha”. “Waxa uu si cad hoos ugu eegay aaminaadii ay siisay BBC da waxa uuna oo soo hooyay sumcad darro”. Warka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay guddiga guud “waxay isku raaceen in cashiro laga barto xaaladdaan, ayna ka mid tahay in dib loo eego waxa BBC du ka yelayso mushaa siinta marka qofkalaga mamnuuco shaqada”. Inkasta oo arrintani tahay noloshiisa gaarka ah quseysa, ayaa hadana “guddigu waxay aaminsan yihiin in dhacdooyinkan ay toosh ku ifiyeen in su’aalo la galiyo isu dheelitirka awoodda xarumaha shaqada”. BBC da ayaa waxay ku dhawaaqday dib u eegis cusub oo madax abannaan oo lagu eegayo dhaqanka ka jiro xafiisyada shaqada ee BBC da. Xogo la xiriira dib u eegis lagu sameynayo huggaanka ayaa waxaa lagu dhawaaqi doonaa horraana bisha septemper. Wasiirka dhaqanka ayaa waxa uu soo dhaweeyay dib u eegista iyada oo tiri “aaminaadda bulshada waa mid muhiim ah BBC da dhexdeeda”. “Shaqaalaha BBC da waxay in ay amni ku dhex dareemaan goobta shaqada oo ay kalsooni ku dareemaan hadii cabasho aan la xiriirin warbixino ay soo gudbiyaan in si cadaalad ah loola macaamilo”. BBC du waxay la xiriirtay qareenka Huw Edwards si uu wax uga yiraahdo arrintaan.

Taliyaha ciidamada Uganda oo Maraykanka ka dalbaday magdhaw in laga siiyo ciidanka uga dhintay Soomaaliya Taliyaha Ciidamada Difaaca Uganda, Janaraal Muhoozi Kainerugaba, ayaa ka dalbaday dawladda Maraykanka ilaa 100 Bilyan oo Doollar oo magdhow u ah dhaqaalaha iyo khasaaraha nafeed ee ciidamada Uganda ka soo gaaray Soomaaliya intii ay nabad ilaalinta u joogeen. Qoraalo taxane ah oo lagu soo daabacay bogga X ee horay loo oran jiray (Twitter) ayaa dalabkaan lagu sameeyay. "$100 bilyan waa inta ugu yar ee aan ka rabo USA. Waana in ay bixiyaan lacagta laga doonayo," sida waxaa yiri Janaraal Muhoozi. Taliyaha oo ah wiilka uu dhalay madaxweynihii dalka Uganda, Yoweri Museveni, ayaa sidoo kale ku yiri hal qoraalka. “Mareykanku waxaan uu ugu yaraan ku leenahay 100 bilyan oo shaqada aan ka qabanay Soomaaliya darteed. Waxaan sugeynaa lacag bixinta.” Uganda ayaa ahayd waddankii ugu horreeyay ee ka socda Bariga Afrika oo ciidamo u soo daad-gureeyo Soomaaliya sannadkii 2007-dii, iyagoo ka tirsanaa howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya (AMISOM), iyaga oo door muhiim ah ka qaatay taageeridda dowladda Soomaaliya ee ay taakuleyso Qaramada Midoobay iyo dagaalka ka dhanka ah ururka Al-shabaab ee xiriirka la leh Al-Qaacida. Ciidamada Uganda, ayaa waxaa soo gaaray khasaarooyin kala duwan, waxaana ay qeyb ka qaateen xasilinta goobihii ay horey u maamuli jireen mintidiinta Shabaab, gaar ahaan Magaalada Muqdisho. Dalabka Muhoozi ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ay sii xoogaysanayso xiisadda u dhaxaysa Uganda iyo Maraykanka, gaar ahaan ka dib markii Uganda laga saaray Heshiiska Kobaca iyo Fursadaha Afrika (AGOA), ayaa siinayay waddanka Uganda fursadda ah in ay cashuur la’aan ku galaan suuqyada Maraykanka iyaga oo keeni karay ka badan 1,800 oo badeecooyin ah. "Maraykanku waa inuu raaligelin ka bixiyaa in uu Uganda ka saaray Axdiga AGOA," Muhoozi ayaa sida ku yiri qoraalkiisa. "Waa in si deg deg ah dib naloogu soo celiyo, ka dibna, waxaan ka hadli doonaa magdhowga dhammaan askartii nooga dhimatay Soomaaliya. Go'aanka Uganda looga saaray AGOA, ayaa waxa uu dhaqan galayay 1 dii bisha Janaayo ee sanadk 2024, waxaa sidoo kale ku jiray wadamada laga saaray Gabon, Niger, iyo Jamhuuriyadda Bartamaha Afrika. Go'aanku wuxuu sheegay in "xadgudubyada weyn" oo la xiriira xuquuqda aadanaha ee caalamiga ah lagu gaystay wadamadaas. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale dhawaan cunaqabateyn ku soo rogay saraakiisha Uganda si uu uga jawaabo musuqmaasuqa dalkaas ka jira iyo warbixinnada dilalka aan sharciga ahayn ee laga soo taiyay dalkaas, taasoo ay cambaareeyeen hay'adaha caalamiga ah ee xuquuqul insaanka udooda. Janaraal Muhoozi ayaa ah nin lagu yaqaano hadalada la yaabka leh ee hadal haynta dhaliya. Gudaha Uganda waxaa dad badani ku naaneysaan “Janaraalka Twitter ka”. Waxaa kale oo lagu yaqaanaa in uu marar badan sameeyo hadallo kicin ah - iyo kuwa kale oo kaftan u badan, kuwaas oo uu soo galiyo baraha bulshada. Bishii Oktoobar ee sandkii 2022 kii, wuxuu dhaliyay hadal hayn aad u nadam oo caalami ah ka dib markii uu si aan qarsooneyn uu 100 neef lo’ ah gabaati ahaan ugu yaboohay Giorgia Meloni, oo xilligaas qarka u saarneed in ay noqoto ra'iisul wasaaraha Talyaaniga, waxa uuna raaciyay hanjabaad ah in uu qabsan doono caasimadda Talyaaniga ee Rome haddii dalabka la diido. Waxa kale oo uu ku hanjabay in uu Kenya soo weerari doono oo uu Nairobi qabsan doono, taas oo keentay in Aabihiis, Madaxweyne Museveni, uu ka cudur-daarto warkaas. Arrintaas ayaa sidoo kale sababtay in Muhoozi laga qaado kaalintiisii taliyaha ciidamada Uganda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dib ayaa loo soo celiyay waxaana loo dalacsiiyay Taliyaha Ciidamada Difaaca markii ay taariikhdu ahayd bishii Maarso 2024. Inkasta oo uu hab dhaqankiisu yahay mid mar walba muran badan dhaliya, hadana Muhoozi waxa uu weli yahay xubin udub dhexaad u ah millatariga iyo siyaasadda Uganda, isaga oo ku dhawaad hal milyan oo followers ah ku leh barta X.

Maxaa badal u ah oo diyaarsan bacaha lagu adeegto ee Soomaaliya? Magaalada Muqdisho waxaa ka bilowday dhaqan galinta joojinta bacaha halka mar la isticmaalo kaddib markii Dawladda Federaalku soo saartay amar lagu mamnuucayo bacaha oo dhibaato ku ah dadka, xoolaha iyo deegaankaba. Muddo sideed bilood ah ayuu soo socday qorshaha dawladdu ku doonaysay in lagu joojiyo isticmaalka bacaha halka mar la isticmaalo, iyadoo ugu dambeyn dawladdu sheegtay in wixii hadda ka dambeeya aan loo dul qaadan doonin ganacsatada iyo dadka isticmaala bacaha. “Ciddii lagu arko Bac ama ka ganacsigeeda waxaa laga qaadi doonaa tallaabo adag oo sharciga waafaqsan , wixii hadda ka danbeeyana Bacaha waa mamnuuc,” ayuu sheegay afhayeenka Boolisku Cabdifitaax Aadan Xasan. Weli sharci faahfahsan lagamasoo saarin ciqaabta ka dhalan karta qofii isticmaalla bacda halka mar ah laakin Wasiir Khadiija oo ka jawaabeysay su’aashaas ayaa sheegtay in Booliska iyo Maxkamadaha madaniga ah ay la macaamili doonaan qaabka loo ciqaabayo. Dawladda Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in sababaha loo mamnuucay bacaha ay ka mid tahay “in lala jaanqaado shuruucda ilaalinta deegaanka ee Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC) oo ay Soomaaliya dhawaan ku biirtay”. , Khadija Mohamed Al-Makhzoumi Cabdi xirsi Cali oo ah aasaasaha shirkadda Africansolution ee fadhigeedu yahy magaalad Muqdisho, xog ogaalna u ah walxaha caagadaha ka samaysan ee yaalla suuqyada Soomaaliya ayaa BBC u sheegay In aanay hadda suuqyada diyaar ku ahayn agab kale oo bacaha lagu beddeli karo. Cabdi Xirsi oo shirkadiisu ay soo saarto alaabooyin deegaan u wanaagsa sida jiliga guryaha la saarto oo ay ka sameeyaan bacaha iyo caagadaha oo ciid lagu daray ayaa sheegay in ay aad ugu adkaatay in ay soo saaran alaabooyinkaas sababtuna ay tahay korontada oo qaali ku ah. Waxa uu sheegay "in loo baahanyahay in mashruucan ay dawladdu gacan ka geysato si loo helo koronto raqiis ah, kaddibna waxa la tababari karaa aayuu yiri dhalinayarada iyo dumarka si ay uga qeeyb qaataan wax soo saarka alaabooyina deegaanka u wanaagsan". "Si bacaha loo joojiyo loona soo saaro agab kale oo deegaanka u wanaagsan , ay waxaa lagama maarmana ah dowladdu in ay sameyso wacyi gelin badan iyo in ay gacan geeysato sidii loo soo saari laha wax soo saar kale oo lagu beddelo bahaca sida Kenyba ka jirta", ayuu sii raaciyay hadalkiisa. Sawirka, Cabdi Xirsi Cali Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Waayadii hore, gaar ahaan 20 sano ka hor wax bac ah dadku uma isticmaai jirin adeegga amaba waa ay yareyd taas beddelkeedana wax ay isticmaali jireen dambiilo iyo sallado. Laakin, waqtiyadii danbe ee dukaameysigu batay , tiknoolajitada casriga ahina ay fududeeysay soo saarista bacaha waxa Meesha ka baxay isticmaalka dambiilaha, waxa iyadana qeeyb ka qaatay dadka oo ka cusleystay in ay dambiilaha iyo salladaha horrey usii qaataan marka ay soo dukaameysanayaan. Waxa iyadana qeeyb ka qaatay isticmaalka bahacaha, dukaamada oo fududeeyay, oo qofkii wax ka gataba siinaya bac bilaash ah, sida ay qabaan dad badani. Dalalk horre u maray ee Galbeedka sida Ingiriiska oo markii horre ay bacahu lacag la’aan ahaayeen, marka aad dukaamada waaweyn wax kasoo iibsaneysid ayaa hadda ka dhigay lacag si qofku uu ugu yaraan uu u yareeyo isticmaalka bacaha si uu qofku u keydsado bacaha duugga ah, oo mar labaad uu istcimaalo, taas oo lagu yareynayo isticmaalka bacaha. Dadweynaha magaalada Muqdisho qaar ayaa soo dhaweeyay amarka lagu mabnuucayo bacaha. Weriyaha BBCda Ibraahim Maxamed Aden ayaa makarafoonka la dhexmaray qaar ka mid ah daweynaha muqdisho oo uu wax ka weeydiiyay ra’yigooda ku aadan mamnuucidda. Maxamed Nuur Xuseen ayaa sheegy in uu aad usoo dhaweynayo mamnuucidda bacaha, isagoo sheegay in bacdu ay dhibaato weyn ku hayso, in la mabnucana ay wanagsantahay , isagoo sheegay in haddii Soomaaliya oo dhan laga wada aruriyo ay dan weyni ku jirto, isagoo intaasi ku daray in xoolihii iyo xaafadahaba ay dhib u keentay . “ Leyla Aden Macallin Iibraahim ayaa taageersan amarka lagu mabnuucayo bacaha , iyada oo sheegtay in ay ku faraxsantahay hasa syeshee waxa ay sheegtay in ay iyadu isticmaasho haatan bacaha marka ugu danbeeysana ay gubaan taas oo ay sheegtay in aanay caafimaad ahaan wanaagsaneyn. Dalalka Bariag Afrika ee (EAC) ayaa horrey u mabnuucay isticmalka bacaha. Dalka Kenya oo ka mid ah dalalkaas ayaa waxa si weyn uga dhaqangalay mamnuucidda isticmaalaa bacaha, waxaana taas beddelkeeda ay dadku isticmaalaan bacaho laga sameeyay matya iyo waxyaabo kale oo deegaanka u wanaagsan. Sawirka, TANZANIA STATE HOUSE Madaxweynahi horre ee geeriyooday ee Tanzania John Magufuli ayaa booqasho lama filaan ah oo ku tagay suuq kalluunka lagu iibiyo sanadkii 2019 kii , waxa uu sii qaatay dambiil si uu ugu adeegto. Tallaabadan ayuu madaxweynuhu ku taageerayay go'aanka dalkiisa looga mamnuucay isticmaalka bacaha. Hase yeeshee, dalka Tanzania loogama baranin in nin uu suuqa la yimaado dambiil, taasna waxaaba kasii daran inuu arrintan uu sameeyo nin madaxweyne ah. Go'aanka uu suuqa ula tagay dambiisha ayaa la filayaa inuu sii adkeeyo sharciga mamnuucista bacaha, kaasoo laga dhaqan galiyay dalkaas. Tanzania Dadka lagu qabto bacaha ayaa wajihi kara ganaax lacageed oo dhan $87 ama xarig ilaa 7 maalmood ah, sida ay ku warrameen warbaahinta maxalliga ah ee dalkaas. Laakiin qofkii lagu qabto inuu warshadeeyo bacaha ama dalka soo galiyo, ganaaxiisu wuxuu noqon karaa $430,000 oo doolar ama xarig 2 sano ah. Qaaradda Afrika ilaa 30 waddan oo Afrikaan ah ayaa mamnuucay isticmaalka bacaha.

Sida bulshadani ugu eg tahay Soomaalida iyo waxa ay wadaagan Bartamaha gobollada woqooyi ee dalka Kenya waxaa ku dhaqan qoomiyad lagu magacaabo Rindiile kuwaas oo ay isi-shabahaan Soomaalida dhanka muuqaalka, dhaqanka iyo afka ba. Waxay ka mid yihiin bulshooyinka la isku yiraa Kushiitiga ee dega Barriga Afrika. Haddaba, intaan ka ogow xiriirka ka dhexeeya dhaqanka, luuqadda iyo dadka labada qoomiyad ee Soomaalida iyo Rendille. Inkasta oo xiriirka dhalasho ee ka dhexeeya labadan qoomiyad aysan dood ka taagneyn hadana waxaa jira aragtiyo kala duwan oo ku saabsan sida ay u kala tageen. Dadka Soomaalid ah qaar ayaa sheegay in ay ahaayeen mid ka mid ah qabaa’ilka Soomaalida balse xurguf dhex martay beela kale oo Soomaalida ka mid ah awgeed ayay uga guureen dhulkii hore ee ay degenaayeen, iyaga oo degay dhulka ay hadda degaan. Laakiin ma ahan la hayo cadeymo xoogan oo lagu dhisay, ama taariikh qotodheer oo faahfaahineysa sida ay Soomaalida iyo bulshada Rendille ay wax uga dhaceeyaan. Laakiin waxaa xaqiiqo ah in ay iyaga iya Soomaalidu hal meel kasoo wada jeedaan oo ay yihiin qabiilolo fac ahaan siman isla markaana weligoodba gooni ahaa. Waxay ku wada af tirsadaan bulshooyinka Kushiitiga oo ay wadaagaan qowmiyadda Oromada iyo kuwa kale. Rendille waa dad dhaadheer oo dhuudhuuban sida Soomaalida iyo qabaa’illada kale ee Kushitigga la isku yiraah. Waxay isugu jiraa maarriin iyo madow sida Soomaalidaba. Wajiga iyo sanqaroorlka aan ballaarnayn ee dadka Rendille waa mid ka mid ah astaamaha ugu horeeya ee muujinaya qaab dhismeedka wajiga ee ay Soomaalida wadaagaaan. Sida ka muuqata sawirka sare waxay leeyihiin timaha Afrikaanka ee jileeca xiga sida kuwa Soomaalida oo kale, balse waxay sidoo kale leeyihiin timaha isku dhafan sida qoomiydaha baantuuga oo kale. , Rendille waa dad reer guuraa ah isla markaana xoolaha dhaqda si la mid ah Soomaalida. Waxay dhaqdaan saddexda nooc ee Soomaalidu ka dhaqato xoolaha oo kala ah Geela, Lo’da iyo ariga. Si la mid ah Soomaalida, Rendille ma aha bulsho magaalo waxayna u badan yihiin miyiga maadamaa ay xoolo dhaqato yihiin, waxayna xilliyada kala duwan ee sannadka u guuraan meelo kala gedisan oo isla deegaanka ay ku dhaqan yihiin ah, si ay xoolahooda ugu raadiyaan daaqsin iyo biyo. Ragga Rendille waxay xirtaan maro ay sida macawista oo kale u guntadaan balse ay badanaa ka xirtaan meel ka sareysa halka macawista laga guntado iyo mararka qaar mid ay u isticmaalaan sida maradii qaydka la oran jiray ee ay Soomaalidii hore xiran jirtay. Waranka iyo gaashaanku astaan kale oo ay caan ku yihiin ragga Soomaalida iyo Rendille labaduba. Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Raga iyo dumarka Rendille ayey labaduba xirtaan kuul fara badan oo ay ku xirtaan meela kala duwan sida, luqunta cukurrada, jinta iyo dhexda. Mararka qaar waxay jeeni qaarsadaan kuul dheer oo midabbo kal duwan leh. Dumarka Rendille waxay xirtaan garays iyo maro kale oo ay u isticmaalaan sida guntiinada. Si la mid ah ragga, Rendille dumarkooduna waxay xirtaan kuulo aad u badan oo ay ka raariciyaan qoortooda ilaa garbaha. Kuusha oo ah nooca yaryar balse loo farsameeyay qaabka suunkii hore ee Soomaalida ee jaclaha la oran jiray ayey ku xirtaan gacanta ilaa jinta. Isla kuusha ayey dumarku ka samaystaan koofiyad inta badan ka bannaa qaybta sare ee madaxa. Dhagaha ayaa u duran dumarka Rendille badankood waxaana ugu jira dhagadhago u samaysan sida fargashiga. Waxay leeyihiin ciyaro dhaqameed u eg dhaantada, taas oo raggu ay guuxaan halka dumarku ay heesaan. Xilligan casriga ah oo baraha bulshadu isku xiraan dad badan oo aan awal xiriiri karin ayey dadka Rendille ee magaalooyinka dega waxay aroosyada ka shidaan heeso Soomaali ah. Sawirka, Waxyaabaha soo jiidashada leh ee ku saabsan xiriirka ka dhexeeya Soomaalida iyo Rendille wa afka. Waxa baraha bulshada kusoo badanaya da’ yarta Rendille ee ka hadla sida ay isugu dhowyihiin afafka Soomaaliga iyo Rendille. Waxaad sidoo kale arkaysaa Soomaali ka hadlaysa ama qof Rendille ah kala sheekaysanaysa erayada isku midka ah labada af, waxaadna ogaanaysaa in afkani uu yahay afka aan Soomaaliga ahayn ee ugu soo dhow. Bal isku day inaad fahanto maahmaahdan afka Rendille ah: “Beene ma jebto eehicheeda jeba”. Sidan ayey ka dhigan tahay Afsoomaaliga : ”Beeni ma jabtee ehelkeedaa jaba. Waxaan filayaa inaad soo dhaweysay amaba aad garatay. Tanna bal isku day ”Faraas lama mislekorto”, tani waxay ka dhigan tahay laba faras hal mar la islama fuulo, balse erayada ‘lama’ iyo ‘korto’ ayaa sida ka muuqata ah erayo ay ‘laba’ iyo ‘fuulis’ u adeegsadaan Soomaalida koonfurtu. Jumlooyinka hoos ku qoran dhanka bidix waa af Rendille midigtuna waa af Soomaali, eeg sida ay isugu midka yihiin: Kaalay inta fadhiiso >> kaalay halkan fadhiiso Madax ibolkha >> madaxa ayaa i xanuunaya Argaba qabaa >> Hargabbaan qabaa Si kastaba há ahaatee, afka Rendille wuxuu aad ugu dhow yahay lahjadda Soomaaliga ee Maayga marka la eego erayada iyo qaabka jumlooyinka loogu dhawaaqo. Balse waxaad sidoo kale ku arkaysaa erayo aad garanayso in ay yihiin kuwa aan afka Soomaaliga ee casriga ah aad loogu adeegsan, walow laga isticmaalo deegaanka Geeska Afrika meelo ka mid ah.

"Walaalka weyn" ee ka caawinaya Arsenal iyo Arteta inay u gudbaan diilinta guusha , Ka dib saddex xilli ciyaareed oo isku xigta oo Premier League ah oo ay ku dhammeeysteen kaalinta labaad, Mikel Arteta wuxuu bilaabay inuu raadiyo jawaabo. Maxaa loo baahan yahay si kooxdiisa Arsenal F.C. looga dhigo horyaal mid hanata? Kooxdu waxay u baahnayd ciyaartoy badan oo qoto dheer (depth). Sidoo kale maskaxda iyo adkaysiga kooxda waa inay noqdaan kuwo ka sii adag. Naadigu wuu ka jawaabay taas isagoo soo iibsaday siddeed ciyaaryahan oo cusub. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ciyaaryahankii ugu muhiimsanaa ee xagaaga yimid waxa laga yaabaa inuu ahaa mid aan la dareemin. Arteta wuxuu u jeestay mid ka mid ah saaxiibbadiisii ugu da'da weynaa ee uu si weyn u aaminsan yahay: daaficii hore ee Argentina ee u soo ciyaaray Paris Saint Germain F.C., Real Madrid C.F. iyo Manchester United F.C., oo ah Gabriel Heinze, kaas oo beddelay kaaliyihii hore Carlos Cuesta. Arteta iyo Heinze waxay markii ugu horreysay ku kulmeen PSG sannadkii 2001, markaas oo kooxda uu maamulayay Luis Fernandez. "Waxay ahaayeen wiilal aad u wanaagsan," ayuu yidhi Fernandez, oo Arteta kalasoo wareegay FC Barcelona Janaayo 2001, halka Heinze uu lix bilood ka dib uga yimid Real Valladolid. "Waxay ahayd farxad inaan tababaro. Waxa ugu wanaagsan ayaa ah inaysan is beddelin. Maanta weli waa isla dadkaas: daacad ah oo shaqo badan. Markaan arko waxa ay ka qabanayaan Arsenal, aad ayaan ugu faanaa." Waxay u muuqataa arrin aad muhiim u ah in waqtigan muhiimka ah ee xirfadda tababarenimo ee Arteta uu u jeestay qof mar PSG ugu ahaa sida "walaal weyn". Arteta wuxuu jiray 18 sano markii uu ka tagay dalkiisa. Wuxuu dhowaan sheegay in 18-kii bilood ee uu ku qaatay Paris ay ahaayeen "khibrad aan waligeed iga bixi doonin, oo qaabaysay ciyaaryahankii aan doonayay inaan noqdo, isla markaana igu dhalisay rabitaanka inaan noqdo tababare." Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Kooxdii PSG ee xilligaas waxay ahayd mid ay ka buuxaan xiddigo iyo shaqsiyaad adag. Marka laga reebo Heinze, Arteta wuxuu qolka labiska la wadaagay ciyaartoy ay ka mid yihiin Ronaldinho, Mauricio Pochettino, Jay Jay Okocha iyo Nicolas Anelka. Bilihii ugu horreeyay waxay ahaayeen kuwo adayg ku ah Arteta oo ahaa nin xishood badan oo aamusnaan badan, inkastoo ay joogeen waalidkiis. "Aad bay u adkayd," ayuu xasuustaa Yves Ribardiere. "Mikel wuxuu deganaa hoteel aad u fudud. Waxay ahayd jiilaal, cimiladuna qabow oo ciiro leh. Wuxuu ku jiray qol yar oo wakhti badan faaruq ah buuna haystay. Marar badan ayaan la joogay si aan u hubiyo inuusan niyad jabin." Ciyaartoydii ku hadli jirtay Isbaanishka ee PSG ayaa sidoo kale ka caawiyay inuu la qabsado. Mauricio Pochettino, oo markaas jiray 28 sano, ayaa Arteta garab istaagay ka hor inta uusan Heinze iman. "Mauricio wuxuu u ekaa sida aabbe," ayuu xasuustaa daaficii hore ee PSG Didier Domi. "Gabi (Heinze) wuxuu ka da' u dhawaa Mikel, sidaas darteed wuxuu u ekaa walaal." Heinze wuxuu Arteta ka weyn yahay afar sano, balse si degdeg ah ayay isula qabsadeen. "Waxay wada joogeen tababarka, sidoo kalena waqti ayay wada qaadan jireen bannaanka garoonka iyaga iyo qoysaskooda," ayuu xasuustaa Fernandez. "Gabi wuxuu ahaa tartame adag oo mar walba doonayay inuu ka fiicnaado qofka ka soo horjeeda. Mikel wuxuu ahaa ciyaaryahan deggan oo aad u farsamo fiican," ayuu raaciyay Fernandez. Edouard Cisse wuxuu sheegay in labada nin ay sidoo kale wax badan ka sinnaayeen. "Labadooduba waxay ahaayeen dad xamaasad badan oo dadaal badan," ayuu yiri Cisse. "Gabi wax walba ayuu bixin jiray, xitaa tababarka. Wuxuu rabay inuu guuleysto. Mikel wuxuu ahaa mid deggan, laakiin waa la ogaa inaan la kicin karin." Heinze dabeecaddiisa dagaalka badan wuxuu la galay shaqada tababarenimada. Wuxuu tababare ka noqday kooxo ay ka mid yihiin Godoy Cruz, Argentinos Juniors, Velez Sarsfield iyo Newell's Old Boys, iyo sidoo kale Atlanta United FC. Sawirka, Waqtigan xaadirka ah ee waqooyiga London, Arteta wuxuu ka faa'iidaysanayaa xamaasadda Heinze halka Arsenal ay si fiican u ciyaarayso. "Waxay la mid yihiin laba foolkaanno," ayuu yiri Cisse. "Mid mararka qaarkood qarxa (Arteta), iyo mid mar walba qarxa (Heinze). Mikel kuma qaylin karo ciyaartoydiisa mar kasta, sidaas darteed wuxuu u baahan yahay caawinaad. Gabi taas ayuu maalin kasta ka sameyn doonaa tababarka." "Waa isku-darka ugu fiican," ayuu yiri Cisse. "Mikel shaqo cajiib ah ayuu qabtay, laakiin si kooxdu ugu guulaysato wuxuu u baahan yahay caawinaad. Gabi, rabitaankiisa xooggan ee guusha awgiis, wuu sameyn karaa." Heinze, oo ahaa daafac adag oo guulo horyaal ka gaaray Faransiiska, Ingiriiska iyo Spain, isla markaana 72 kulan u saftay xulka qaranka Argentina, wuxuu si degdeg ah u helaa ixtiraamka ciyaartoyda marka ay tababarka joogaan, gaar ahaan kuwa daafaca. Ma aha wax iska dhacay in difaaca ugu fiican Ingiriiska uu xilli ciyaareedkan sii xoogeystay. "Gabi wuxuu u nool yahay kubadda cagta," ayuu yidhi Fernandez. "Mar walba wuxuu baranayaa ciyaarta, gaar ahaan shaqada difaacayaasha. Maanta waxaad leedahay tababare goolhayeyaal, tababare kubbadaha taagan sidoo kalena waa muhiim in qof gaar ah uu tababaro difaacayaasha." "Mar walba waad horumarin kartaa: boos qaadashada, taakenta, iyo kubbad bixinta. Halkaas ayuu Gabi ka caawin karaa. Marka qof khibrad sidaas u weyn leh wax kuu sheego, waad dhageysaneysaa." Arteta shaki kuma jiro inuu Heinze ku aamino hawlahaas muhiimka ah. Labadooda waxaa ka dhexeeya xiriir ka qoto dheer kubadda cagta. "Awoodda tababare waxay ku jirtaa inuu isku hareereeyo dad uu si buuxda u aaminsan yahay," ayuu yiri Fernandez. "Mikel doorasho aad u wanaagsan ayuu sameeyay. Gabi waa daacad, waa qof run sheeg ah oo qalbi furan, Mikelna wuu ogyahay inuu maalin kasta garab istaagi doono." Iyadoo xilli ciyaareedka Arsenal uu ku sii socdo dhammaad xiiso leh, kalsoonida ka dhexeysa labadan nin ee bannaanka garoonka ka jirta waxay noqon kartaa mid qiimo u leh sida ciyaaryahan kasta oo cusub oo la soo iibsado.

Afghanistan: Khilaafka ka dhex bilaabmay hogaanka Daalibaan oo ragga qaarkii gacan isku la tageen Khilaaf weyn ayaa ka dhex bilaabmay hoggaamiyeyaasha Daalibaan oo ku saabsan sida loo dhisayo dowladda cusub ee Afghanistan, sidaana waxa BBC-da u sheegay saraakiil sare oo ka tirsan Daalibaan. Muranku wuxu u dhexeeya aasaasaha kooxda Mullah Abdul Ghani Baradar iyo xubin ka tirsan golaha wasiirada oo waxay isku maan dhaafeen madaxtooyada dhexdeeda. Waxaa jiray warar aan la xaqiijin oo sheegaya ismaandhaafka hoggaanka Daalibaan taagnaa tan iyo markii Baradar laga waayay fagaareyaasha maalmihii la soo dhaafay. Hase yeeshee arintaas wuu beeniyey ururku. Daalibaan ayaa la wareegtay gacan ku haynta Afghanistan bishii la soo dhaafay tan iyo xilligaasna waxay ku dhawaaqday in dalkaasi yahay "Imaarad Islaami ah". Golahooda cusub ee ku meel gaadhka ah gabi ahaanba waa rag waxayna ka kooban yihiin saraakiil sarsare oo Daalibaan ah, kuwaas oo qaarkood caan ku yihiin weeraradii lagu qaaday ciidamada Mareykanka labaatankii sano ee la soo dhaafay. Xog ay laanta Af-Pashto ee BBC -du ka heshay Daalibaan ayaa tibaaxaysa in Baradar iyo Khalilu Raxmaan Xaqaani - oo ah wasiirka qaxootiga isla markaana ah shaqsi caan ka ah shabakadda xagjirka ah ee Haqqani - ay is weydaarsadeen ereyo adag, rag kala taabacsanina ay gacan iskula tageen ba. Xubin sare oo ka tirsan Daalibaan oo fadhigiisu yahay Qatar iyo qof ku xidhiidh la leh dhinacyada is khilaafsan ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyay in muran dhacay dabayaaqadii toddobaadkii hore. Wararka ayaa sheegay in muranku soo baxay ka dib markii Baradar, oo ah ra'iisul wasaare ku -xigeenka cusub tibaaxay in aanu ku la dhacsanayn qaab dhismeedka dawladdooda ku meel gaadhka ah. Waxaa la sheegay in khilaafku ka dhashay cidda sheegan karta libta guushii ay Daalibaan ka gaadhay Afghanistan. Baradar ayaa lagu soo waramayaa inuu rumeysan yahay in guusha lagu gaadhay diblomaasiyaddii ay rag uu ku jiraa wadeen halka xubnaha ka tirsan kooxda Xaqaani ay iyaguna qabaan in libta lagu gaadhay dagaal. Baradar ayaa ahaa hoggaamiyihii ugu horreeyey ee Daalibaan ee si toos ah ula xidhiidhay madaxweyne Mareykan ah ka dib markii uu taleefan kula sheekeystay Donald Trump sannadkii 2020. Taa ka horna wuxuu saxiixay heshiiskii Doha ee ku saabsanaa bixitaanka ciidamada Mareykanka isaga oo wakiil ka ah Daalibaan. Dhanka kale kooxda Xaqaani ee awoodda badan ayaa lala xidhiidhiyaa qaar ka mid ah weeraradii ugu rabshadaha badnaa ee ka dhacay Afghanistan ka dhanka aha ciidamada Afghanistan iyo xulafadooda reer Galbeedka sannadihii la soo dhaafay. Kooxdan ayaa Maraykanku u aqoonsaday urur argagixiso. Hoggaamiyahooda Sirajuddin Haqqani, waa wasiirka arrimaha gudaha ee xukuumadda cusub. Wararka xanta ah ee ku saabsan soo bixitaanku waxay sii fidayaan tan iyo dabayaaqadii toddobaadkii hore, markii Baradar - oo ka mid ahaa wejiyada ugu caansan ee Daalibaan - laga waayay fagaarayaasha. Waxaa baraha bulshada la isla dhexmarayay in laga yaabo inuu dhintay. Xogo ay BBC-du ka heshay Daalibaan ayaa sheegay in Baradar uu ka tagay Kabul uuna u safray magaalada Kandahar ka dib markii uu khilaafku soo if baxay. Cod la duubay oo lagu sheegay inuu ahaa Baradar ayaa la faafiyey daayay Isniintii oo aasaasaha Daalibaan ayaa sheegayo inuu "ku maq maqnaa safarro". "Meel kasta oo aan joogo xilligan, dhammaanteen waan fiicanahay," ayuu yiri. BBC-da umay suurto galin in ay xaqiijiso codkaas oo lagu faafiyey bogaga internet-ka ee taageera Daalibaan. Daalibaan waxay ku adkeysteen in aanu jirin wax khilaaf ah iyo in Baradar uu badqabo laakiin waxay sii daayeen hadalo iska soo horjeeda oo ku saabsan waxa uu hadda sameynayo. Af-hayeen ayaa sheegay in Baradar uu aaday Kandahar si uu ula kulmo hoggaamiyaha ugu sarreeya Taliban, laakiin markii dambe wuxuu u sheegay laafta af-Pashto ee BBC in hoggaamiyahaasi " daalay oo uu doonayay waxoogaa nasasho ah". Dad badan oo reer Afghanistan ah ayaa dareemi doona inay haystaan sabab wanaagsan oo ay uga shakiyaan hadalka Daalibaan. Sannadkii 2015, kooxdu waxay qirtay inay qarinayaan geerida hoggaamiyahoodii Mullah Cumar muddo ka badan laba sano, muddadaasna waxay sii wadeen inay ku soo saaraan bayaanno magaciisa. Ilo wareedyo ayaa BBC -da u sheegay in Baradar la filayo inuu ku laabto Kabul oo laga yaabo inuu ka soo muuqdo shaashadaha si uu u beeniyo in wax muran ah uu dhacay. Waxaa weli la isla dhexmarayaa taliyaha ugu sarreeya Daalibaan, Hibatullah Akhundzada, oo aan weligiis lagu arag meel fagaare ah. Wuxuu mas'uul ka yahay arrimaha siyaasadda, militariga iyo diinta ee Daalibaan. Dhanka kale sii hayaha wasiirka arrimaha dibadda ee Afghanistan ayaa Salaasadii ku baaqay in deeq bixiyeyaasha caalamiga ah ay dib u billaabaan gargaarka, isagoo sheegay in beesha caalamku aysan siyaasadeyn kaalmooyinkooda. In ka badan $ 1bn oo gargaar ah ayaa dalka loogu yaboohay Isniintii, ka dib digniino ka yimid Qaramada Midoobay oo ku saabsan "masiibo soo socota".

Soomaalida ku ganacsata magaalo ku taalla Koonfur Afrika oo lagu amray inay ka tagaan dukaamadooda , Ajaanibta ay Soomaalidu ku jirto ee ku nool, kuna ganacsada magaalada Polokwane ee gobolka Limpopo ee dalka Koonfur Afrika ayaa loo qabtay inay 7 maalin uga guuraan halkaas. Qaar ka tirsan dadka u dhashay waddankaas ee loogu tagay magaaladaas ayaa warqado u qeybiyay Soomaalida iyo ajaanibta kale, iyagoo ka dalbaday in dukaamadooda ay uga tagaan halkaas. Waxaa warqadda ogeysiiska ah sidoo kale ku xusneyd digniin loo jeediyay dadka aan u hoggaansamin dalabkaas. Arrintan ayaa keentay walaac aad u xooggan, sida uu BBC-da u sheegay Maxamed Maxamuud Cirra-wayne, oo ka mid ah hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaalida ah ee ku nool gobolka Limpopo. “Maanta waxaa nagu dhacay nooc Xenophobia [ajnabi naceyb] ah oo aanan horay u arag. Ilaa shalay way socotay, laakiin dhinaceenna magaalada Polokwane ee caasimadda gobolka Limpopo, waxaa noo yimid niman basas wata oo nagu soo dul degay. “Aniga iyo odayaashii kale ee bulshadaba waan joognay, waxaan amarnay inaan lala dagaallamin, oo la xiro dukaamada. Markii dukaamadii la xiray way hadleen nimankii waxayna dhaheen, ‘waa inaad halkan uga guurtaan 7 maalmood gudahood, dukaan walba iyo meherad walbana waa inay saxiixaan warqado muujinaya inay 7 maalmood ku guurayaan,” ayuu yiri Maxamed. Waxa uu sheegay inay arrintan aad ula yaabeen, ayna lama-filaan ku noqotay, isagoo intaas ku daray in dadka sidaas sameynaya aysan ahayn kuwo ka socda dhanka dowladda Koonfur Afrika. “Waxay nagu noqotay arrin aanan waligeen horay u arkin. Waa niman shacab ah oo aan dowladda ahayn. Waa ragga tagaasileyda ah oo aad u dhib badan iyo niman kale oo bulshada deegaanka ah oo ay wateen," ayuu yiri Maxamed. Dadkan digniinta siiyay ajaanibta ku ganacsata magaalada Polokwane ayaa Soomaalida marka laga soo tago waxay sidoo kale warqadaha u qeybiyeen ganacsatada ka kala socota dalalka Pakistan, Itoobiya, Bangladesh iyo Hindiya. Maxamed Maxamuud Cirra-wayne ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in Soomaalida ay ku gacan-seyreen amarka lagu siiyay inay uga guuraan magaalada ay hantida badan ku leeyihiin. “Ma aanan saxiixin warqadaha naloo keenay, waan diidnay. Labo dukaan oo ugu horreeyay ayaa saxiixay maaddaama lagu dul-daatay. Intii dambe waan joojinnay, waana la hadalnay ka bulsho ahaan iyo ka odayaal ahaan. Waxaan u sheegnay in wax warqad ah oo la saxiixayo aysan jirin,” ayuu yiri. Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada Soomaalida ayaa dowladda ku wargeliyay arrinta la soo gudboonaatay, sida uu sharraxayo Maxamed. “Waan ku wareejinnay waraaqihii, kiiskiina waan furnay. Booliska way noo yimaadeen, arrinta sida ay u dhacday ayaan u sheegnay, mana ahayn arrin kaligeen nagu eg oo waa mid ay nala qabaan ajaanibta magaalada oo dhan.” Soomaalida ku nool magaalada Polokwane, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaanno magaceedii hore ee “Pietersburg”, waxaa tiradooda lagu qiyaasay 150 ilaa 200 oo qoys. W aa mid ka mid ah magaalooyinka ugu waaweyn Koonfur Afrika, waxayna dhinaca waqooyi ka xigtaa gobolka Gauteng. Waxay si weyn u soo shaac-baxday intii ay socdeen ciyaaraha Koobka Adduunka ee sanadkii 2010, markaas oo ay ku jirtay magaalooyinka marti-geliyay kulamada qaar. Dhaqdhaqaaqyada ajnabi-naceybka ah ayaa sanadihii dambe ku soo badanayay Koonfur Afrika, iyadoo dadka u dhashay waddankaas ay dadka soo-galootiga ah ku eedeynayeen in ay ka qaateen fursadihii shaqo ee ay muwaadiniintu lahaayeen. Intii ay xiisaddan taagneyd, weerarro lagu beegsanayay dukaamada ajaanibta iyo mudaharaadyo ay sameynayeen dadka maxalliga ah ayaa sababay khasaare isugu jira dhimasho iyo burbur-hantiyeed. Sanadkii 2019 oo ay dhaceen weerarradii ugu xumaa ee ka dhanka ahaa ajaanibta ku ganacsada dalkaas ayaa la soo tebiyay in uu dhaqaalihiisa hoos u dhacay. Shaqo-la’aanta xilligaas ka jirtay Koonfur Afrika ayaa lagu qiyaasay 27%. Si guudna, waddankan ku yaalla dhinaca koonfureed ee qaaradda Afrika ayaa ka mid ah dalalka ay ka dhacaan dilalka ugu badan ee caalamka.

Madaxweynayaasha Afrika: Sida ay wiilashooda xukunka ugu barbaariyaan uguna diyaariyaan , Vincent Fournier/Jeune Afrique-REA Madaxweynaha Congo-Brazzaville, Denis Sassou-Nguesso ayaa wiilkiisa Denis-Christel u magacaabay wasiir - waa tallaabo ay warbaahinta u fasirteen in niyadda uu ku hayo inuu isaga baddelo. Denis Sassou-Nguesso ayaa markale dib loo doortay bishii Maarso ka dib markii uu dalkaasi xukumayay, tan iyo intii xornimada uu qaatay dalkaas, balse ilaa iyo hadda ma muuqato caalamado muujinaya in 77 sano jirkan uu baneynayo xilka. Waxaa loo arkaa in wiilkiisa Denis uu qaadayo tallaabadii uu aabihii xukunka ugala wareegi lahaa. Dhanka kale dalka dariska la ah ee Gabon waxaa madaxweyne ka ah Ali Bongo Ondimba, waa wiilka uu dhalay Omar Bongo oo dalkaasi xukumayay laga soo bilaabo sannadkii 1976-dii ilaa 2009-kii, halka dalka Jamhuuiyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Kongo uu muddo 17 sano ah uu xukumayay Joseph Kabila oo aabihii Laurent-Désiré, oo la dilay, uu xilka kala wareegay sannadkii 2001-dii. Madaxweynaha Equatorial Guinea, Teodoro Obiang, oo talada dalkaasi hayay tan sannadkii 1979-kii oo xukunka kala wareegay adeerkii, Macías Nguema, ayaa hadana wiilkiisa Teodoro Nguema Obiang Mangue, ka dhigay madaxweyne ku xigeen, taas oo macneheedu yahay inuu isaga kala wareegi doono xilka. Ka dib markii uu geeriyooday madaxweynihii Chad, Idriss Déby, bishii la soo dhaafay, wiilkiisa Mahamat oo ah janaraal afar xidigle ah, ayaa durbadiiba noqday hogaamiyaha militariga xilgaarsiinta ee dalkaas. Iyada oo ay jirto jilicsanaanta siyaasadeed ee Chad oo toddobaadyo ka hor lagu dilay keli taliye Idiris Déby, oo xukumayay muddo soddon sano ah, haddana caqabado waaweyn ayuu wajahay wiilkiisa Mahamat. Dalka Cameroon, waxaa la soo sheegayaa suurtogalnimada ah in madaxweyne Paul Biya, oo 88 sanno jir, uu xilka ku wareejin doono wiilkiisa Franck Biya. Arrintan ayaa soo shaacbaxday ka dib markii sawirka Franck Biya ay muwaadiniinta bilaabeen in ay baraha bulshada ku wadaagaan si ay olole ugu sameeyaan. dhanka dalka Uganda na, haatan waxaa baraha bulshada lagu arkayaa olole loo sameeynayo Janaraal Muhoozi Kainerugaba, oo ah wiil uu dhalay madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni. Janaraalka ayaa la sheegayaa inuu noqon doono qofka doorashada soo socota ee 2026-ka xisbiga talada haya u noqon doono musharaxa xilka madaxweynaha. Kaliye maahan arrimahan kuwa iyaga gaar u ah. Doorashadii Gabon ee sannadkii 2016-kii, Cali Bongo waxa uu wajahay wasiirkii hore ee arrimaha dibada ahaan jiray madaxa guddiga midowga afrika, Jean Ping. Si kastaba ha noqotee, Ping wuxuu keenay ujeedo siyaasadeed oo aasaasi ah, isagoo sheegay in uu yahay nin dowlad ah oo wajahaya mucaaradnimo oo kormeeri kara dib-u-habeynta iyo dimuqraadiyadda dhabta ah. Shan sano ka dib, wali ma uusan qiranin guuldaradii uu kala kulmay tartankaas, iyada oo ay jiraan su'aalo culus oo ku saabsan kalsoonida lagu qabo natiijada codbixintii ugu dambeysay oo si ciriiri ah u go'aamisay natiijada madaxweynaha. Sawirka, Steve Jordan/AFP/ Sidoo kale Dhibaatooyin noocyo kale duwan ah ayaa hareeyay xukunka Equatorial Guinea, oo weli gebi ahaanba awood badan leh, laakiin waxay bartilmaameed muhiim ah u ahayd baaritaanka garsoorka Faransiiska ee ku saabsan eedeymaha ah in hantida, qoysaska lagu iibsaday Faransiiska lacagta musuqmaasuqa. Labada Bongo iyo Nguessos, labaduba waa la bartilmaameedsaday 13-ka qof ee sida rasmiga ah baaritaanka loogu sameeyay waxaana sidoo kale ku jira qareen u shaqeyn jiray Madaxweynihii geeriyooday ee Omar Bongo iyo dhowr muwaadiniin Faransiis ah. Sannadkii 2015-kii, garsoorayaasha Faransiisku waxay amreen in lala wareego laba guri oo ku yaal Paris oo milkiilahooda dhabta ah ay rumeysnaayeen inuu ahaa Mr Sassou-Nguesso adeerkiis, Wilfrid Nguesso, waxay horey u amreen in lala wareego ku dhawaad ​​15 gaari oo nooca raaxada ah. Sannadkii 2016-kii Mr Sassou-Nguesso wuxuu bilaabay tallaabo sharci ah oo uu ku doonayo in kiisaska isaga la xiriira la tuuro, halka afhayeenka dowladda uu ku tilmaamay kiisaska in ay yihiin "wax is daba marin ballaaran" oo loola jeeday in lagu sumcad xumeeyo madaxweynaha. Waa madaxweyne ku xigeenka Equatorial Guinea, Teodoro, oo soo jiitay dareenka ugu badan, iyadoo booliisku ay harareeyeen hoygiisa qaaliga ah ee ku yaal Waddada 42-aad ee Foch ee magaalada Paris, waxayna qabteen dhowr baabuur, oo ay ku jiraan laba Bugatti Veyrons iyo Rolls Royce. Teodoro ayaa ugu dambeyn lagu xukumay inuu bixiyo $37 milyan oo dollar oo ganaax ah. Si kastaba ha noqotee, bishii Diseembar ee la soo dhaafay, Maxkamad ayaa diiday in uu bixiyo ganaaxas. Sharciga ay meelmariyeen baarlamaanka Faransiiska ayaa bixin doona dakhliga ka soo xarooda hantida noocan oo kale ah in meel loo dhigo loona isticmaalo maalgalinta mashaariicda horumarineed ee wadanka ay khuseyso. Haddana qabanqaabooyinka noocan oo kale ah waxay u baahan doonaan in si adag loo qaabeeyo. Ka dib markii maamulka magaalada Geneva, ay bilaabeen talaabo sharci ah oo ka dhan ah Teodoro iyo laba shaqsi oo kale oo lagu eedeeyay in ay lacago musuqmaasuqeen iyo ku takrifal hantida dadweynaha. Kiiska ayaa ugu dambeyntii la dhammeeyay bishii Sebtember, 2019-kii. Shan bilood ka dib, 22-kii Febraayo ee sannadkii hore, sawir hadda la tirtiray ayaa lagu baahiyay barta Instagram-ka. Wuxuu ahaa Teodoro oo muujinaya isaga oo baabuur ku dhex wataya waddooyinka caasimada Equatorial Guinea ee Malabo.

Shirkadda Meta oo ay dhici karto in Kenya maxkamad lagu saaro, dagaalka Itoobiya awgiis , Meta oo ah shirkadda iska leh Facebook, ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay kaalin ku lahayd khilaafkii ka bilowday Tigray oo ku faafay gobollada Amhara iyo Afar, waxaana laga dacweyn karaa maxkamadaha Kenya. Mandy Mudawarikwa, oo ah madaxa dacwadaha istiraatiijiga ah ee hay'adda Amnesty Internationl ayaa sheegtay in Maxkamadda Sare ee Kenya ay awood sharci u leedahay qaaditaanka dacwad ka dhan ah Meta oo la xidhiiidha faafinta waxyaabaha dhiirigeliya isirtirka iyo dilka intii uu socday dagaalkii dhiigga badani ku daatay. "Xukunka maanta waa tallaabo wanaagsan oo loo qaadayo in lala xisaabtamo shirkadaha waaweyn ee tignoolajiyada ee xadgudubyada xuquuqul insaanka. Waxay u gogol xaadhaysaa cadaaladda waxayna muujineysaa in la gaaray waqtigii aaladaha teknolojiyadda waaweyn lala xisaabtami lahaa," ayay tidhi Linda, oo ah agaasimaha fulinta ee Amnesty, qoraal ay soo saartay. Facebook ayaa bishii December laba sano ka hor lagu dacweeyay lacag dhan 2 bilyan oo dollar, ka dib markii lagu eedeeyay inay boggeeda ku faafisay fariimo naceyb iyo colaad hurin ah, xilligii uu socday dagaalkii Tigray. Kooxda qareenada ee Meta ayaa horey ugu dooday in shirkada aysan ka muuqan gudaha Kenya sababtoo ah waxay ka diiwaan gashan tahay Mareykanka. Waxay sidoo kale kooxda shirkadda metalaysa ku doodeen in xadgudubyada xuquuqul insaanka ee lagu eedeeyay ay ka dhaceen Itoobiya, isla markaana aanay ahayn in lagu dhegeysto gudaha Kenya, balse maxkamadda sare ee Kenya ayaa sheegtay inay awood u leedahay inay dhegaysato oo ay tixgeliso dacwadda. Dadka dacwadda ka gudbiyay Meta waxaa ka mid ah Abraham, oo kasoo jeeda Tigray, kaasoo aabihiis, Professor Maereg Amare, lagu dilay sabab la xiriirta qoraal uu Facebook soo dhigay. Professor Maereg, oo ahaa macallin ka tirsanaa Jaamacadda Bahir Dar, waxaa la tooriyeeyay ka dib markii qoraalka uu kiciyay rabshad ka dhan ah isaga. Inkastoo Abraham uu ku wargeliyay Facebook qoraaladaas in la qaado, haddana barta bulshada ee Facebook ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay diiday inay ka saarto, taasoo ah arrin muhiim ah oo kiiska ku saleysan yahay. Dadkii weerarka geystay lama qaban, maadaama dadka deegaanka ay taxadar sameeyeen si aysan ugu dhexgelin arrinta loo geysanayay Professor Maereg. Professor Maereg wuxuu geeriyooday toddobo saacadood kadib markii la weeraray, bishii Oktoobar 2021. Facebook waxay ku jawaabtay warbixinta uu Abraham gudbiyay saddex toddobaad kadib markii uu gudbiyay, iyo siddeed maalmood kadib geerida aabihiis. "Haddii Facebook ay joojiso hadallada nacaybka ah oo ay si wanaagsan u maamusho qoraallada lagu daabaco barteeda, aabbahay ma dhiman lahayn," ayu Abraham horey ugu sheegay BBC. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Marqaatiyadiisa uu siiyay maxkamadda, Abraham wuxuu sheegay in aaladda Facebook ay kor u qaaddo farriimo "nacayb hurinaya oo rabshad kicinaya." Wuxuu xusay in waxyaabaha noocaas ah ay kordhiyaan ka-qaybgalka isticmaalayaasha, sidaas awgeedna aan laga saarin. Dacwad-qaadaha kale ee kiiska waxaa ka mid ah Mudane Fisseha Tekle, oo ah cilmi-baare ka tirsan Amnesty International. Ka-qaybgalka Mudane Fisseha wuxuu iftiiminayaa doorka weerarada internetka inta lagu jiray dagaalkii laba sano ahaa ee Itoobiya, gaar ahaan shaqooyinka xuquuqda aadanaha ee ka socday dalka. Mudane Fisseha, oo u soo guuray Kenya, ayaa shaaca ka qaaday inuu ka baqay badqabka naftiisa sababo la xidhiidha waxyaabaha laga faafiyay Facebook. Marka laga reebo labada dacwad-qaade ee Itoobiyaanka, waxaa sidoo kale jira Katiba, oo ah urur Kenyan ah oo u dooda xuquuqda aadanaha, kaasoo dacwad ka gudbiyay Meta. Dacwad-qaadayaasha waxay dalbanayaan magdhow dhan $2 bilyan sababo la xidhiidha dhibaatada ay ku muteen hadalada nacaybka ah ee lagu faafiyay Facebook. Waxay sidoo kale codsanayaan in isbeddelo lagu sameeyo nidaamka algorithm-ka ee Facebook si loo xalliyo dhibaatadan. "Wadamo badan, bulshooyinka iyo shakhsiyaadka ay saameeyeen xadgudubyada xuquuqda aadanaha ee shirkadahan waxay inta badan ku dhibtoonayaan helitaanka caddaaladda. Tanina waa qayb kamid ah sababtoo ah shirkadaha sida Meta waxay isticmaalaan shuruudaha adeeggooda si ay u xaddidaan gaadhista maxkamadaha, si wax ku ool ah ayayna dhibanayaal badan ugu dhowranaan meel ka baxsan maxkamadda," Mandi Mudarikwa ayaa ku nuuxnuuxsatay. Mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinka hagaajin ee dacwad-qaadayaasha codsadeen waa $1.6 bilyan oo magdhow ah oo ku saabsan dhibaatada ay sababtay hadallada nacaybka iyo rabshad hurinta, iyo sidoo kale $410 milyan oo magdhow ciqaabeed ah oo ku saabsan dhibaatada ka dhalatay waxyaabaha ay Facebook maalgelisay. Dacwadu waxay sidoo kale codsaneysaa in Facebook ay joojiso "faafinta qoraallada nacaybka hurinaya iyo kuwa khatarta ah" iyada oo loo marayo nidaamkeeda algorithm-ka, iyo in shaqaale dheeraad ah la shaqaaleeyo si ay ula socdaan oo u maamulaan waxyaabaha ku qoran luuqadaha gudaha ee dalka. Meta ayaa hore u sheegtay in maxkamadaha Kenya aysan lahayn awood sharci oo ay ku maamulaan dacwada shirkadda, iyada oo lagu andacoonayo in heshiiska adeegga shirkadda uu dhigayo in kiisaska noocan oo kale ah kaliya lagu dhageysan karo maxkamadaha Mareykanka. Linda waxay tiri, "Go'aankan wuxuu rajo siinayaa bulshooyinka adduunka oo dhan inay cadaalad heli karaan. Waa in diiradda laga saaraa suuqyada faa'iidada ku salaysan ee aan lahayn isla xisaabtanka, gaar ahaan meelaha ka baxsan Mareykanka iyo Yurub." Waxay ku dartay, "Waa waqtigii barxadaha bulshada ay qaadan lahaayeen masuuliyadooda oo ay mudnaanta siin lahaayeen xuquuqda aadanaha halkii ay ka hormarin lahaayeen faa'iido." Amnesty International ayaa hoosta ka xarriiqday doorka Meta ee dagaalkii dhiigga badnaa ee Itoobiya ee labada sano socday, iyada oo warbixin ku daabacday cinwaanka "Khaladaadka Meta waxay qayb ka ahaayeen xadgudubyada ka dhan ah bulshada Tigray intii lagu jiray colaadda waqooyiga Itoobiya" bishii Oktoobar 20, 2016. Warbixinta waxay muujisay in algorithm-ka Facebook uu ka caawiyay faafinta hadallada nacaybka ah ee lagu bartilmaameedsanayo bulshada Tigray, iyo in shirkadda ay ku guuldareysatay inay si hufan u maamusho waxyaabaha noocaas ah ama ay bixiso jawaabo ku habboon.

Shanta cunto ee mustaqbalka , Stacy Michelson/BBC Haddii aad dooneyso inaad caafimaad qabto isla-markaana koonka aad badbaadiso maxay yihiin cunnooyinka ugu wanaagsan inaad quudato? Moringa- Soomaalidu waxay u taqaannaa Wama wuxuu intiisa badan ka baxaa jiinka wabiyada balse wuxuu ka bixi karaa meel kasta oo lagu bero. Caalamka aan ku noolnahay cunnooyinka laga isticmaalo waxay u badan yihiin cuntooyin kooban oo inta badan seddex qaybood ka kooban sida (bariiska, galleeyda iyo qamadiga) oo laga helo 60% tamar qof kasta oo isticmaalo. Dadka inta badan waxay ahmiyadda siiyaan waxa ay cunaan balse muhiimad badan ma siiyaan cuntooyinka Fiitaaminnaa iyo Macdanta ay ka helaan. Haddaba warbixin cusub ayaa soo saartay liiska 50 cunto oo wanaagsan iyada oo ka sii dhex saartay "cunnooyinka mustaqbalka" u wanaagsan caafimaadka qofka. Sawirka, Stacy Michelson/BBC Geedka Moringa waxaa lagu tilmaamaa inuu yahay "geed mucjiso ah" waana geed si degdeg ah u baxa isla-markaana abaarta wax saameyn ah ay u geeysanin, asal ahaanna geedkaasi wuxuu ka soo jeedaa Koonfurta Qaaradda Aasiya halkaasoo dawo ahaan looga isticmaalo. Caleenta geedka Moringa maadaamaa ay aad u baxdo waxaa sanadki la jari karaa ilaa iyo 7 jeer wauxuuna geedku leeyahay Fitaamin A iyo Fitamin B iyo Macdinta ay ka midka tahay kaalshiyam iyo botaasiyam. Sawirka, Waddamada Filibbiin iyo Induniisiya waxaa si weyn looga isticmaalaa miraha geedkaasi iyaga oo suugo ahaan halkaasi looga korsado, maadaamaa uu miraha Moringaha hodan uu ku yahay Oleic acid oo lalal xidhiidhiyo inuu aad ugu wanaagsan yahay hoos u dhigidda subagga jirka ku jira. Caleenta marka la shiidana waxaa laga sameeysan karaan suugo cunto ahaan loo cuno, maraq la cabbo iyo shaaha oo lagu darsado. Priya Tew, oo ku takhasustay cilmi baarista cunnooyinka isla-markaana afhayeen u ah wakaaladda baaritaannada ku sameeyso cunnooyinka uu fahdigeedu yahay Britain waxay sheegtay "Cuntada ugu wanaagsan ee ay qoyskooda isticmaalaan loogana jecel yahay inta ay Sirilanka joogtay waa geedka Moringaha wuxuuna si weyn uu adkeeyey ilkaha wuxuuna baab'iyaa suuska ilkaha." Sawirka, Stacy Michelson/BBC Wakaame- waa caleen si weyn looga beerto qaaradda Aasiya waana cunta si weyn looga isticmaalo. Caleenta waa Kaame waxaa qarniyo aad u badan soo beeranayey beeraleyda badaha wax ka beerta iyaga oo cunna ahaan u isticmaala. Balse wakhti xaadirka caleenta Wakaama marka waxtarkeeda la fahmay waxaa si weyn u beerta beeraleyda Faransiiska. New Zealand iyo Argentina. Goob kastana waa lagu beeri karaa iyada oo aan dawo iyo bacramin loo isticmaalin waxaana lagu engajiyaa ceedceedda. Caleenta Wakama marka la qalajiyo ayaa cuntooyinka lagu darsadaa, waxayna caleentan ka mid tahay caleemaha cunna ahaan loo isticmaalo oo laga helo eicosapentaenoic acid. "Caleenta Wakama oo la engajiyo waxaa laga helaa Iodine iyo Omega 3, gaar ahaanna dadka aan dheefta xoolaha inta badan isticmaalin ayuu waxtar aad u weyn uu u leyaahay. Waxaana si weyn looga isticmaalaa Hong Kong" ayey tiri Priya Tew. Waxayna sida oo kale ka digtay inaan wax badan laga isticmaalin oo aan la isku badin maadaamaa maaddada Iodine ay aad ugu badan tahay. Sawirka, Stacy Michelson/BBC Fonio- Waa nooc cawska u eg waxaana si weyn looga beertaa galbeedka qaaradda Afrika. Waana geed gaab cawska aan aad looga garaneyn. Fonio waxaa qaaraddan Afrika laga beeran jiray 5,000 oo sano ka hor, sida oo kale Masaarida qadiimka ahaydna iney si weyn u soo beeran jireen ayey taariikhdu sheegeysaa. Wuxuuna Fonio uu midab ahaan isugu jiraa madow iyo caddaan, waxayna mirahiisa ku bislaadaan oo la soo guran karaa 60-70 maalmood, iyada oo si weyn looga beerto galbeedka Afrika. Miraha Fonio wuxuu hodan ku yahay maaddooyinka kala ah iron, zinc iyo magnesium, waxaana Fonio loo karsadaa sida bariiska iyada oo waddamada qaar ay ka sameeyaan khamrigaa biirta loo yaqaanno. Priya Tew waxay sheegeysaa "Iney jeceshahay iney Fonio mar un tijaabiso cilmi ahaan mooyee maadaamaa ay fursad u helin iney cunto, wuxuuna Fonio iska caabbiyaa abaaraha isaga oo ka baxa deegaannada ay biyaha iyo roobkaba ku yar yihiin waxaana lagu daray cunnooyinka mustaqbalka ugu wanaagsan. Sawirka, Stacy Michelson/BBC Tiinka waxaa si weyn looga isticmaalaa dalka Mexico iyada oo mirihiisa, caleentiisa iyo dheecaankiisaba ay u isticmaalan cunta la karsado ama sharaab la cabbo. Wuxuuna Tiinka si weyn uu uga baxaa bartamaha iyo koonfurta Mareykanka, Australiya iyo Yurub. Qaar ka mid ah khubarada caafimaadka waxay sheegayaan Tiinka qofka isticmaala inuu ka caawinayo jirka qofka baruurta ku jirto inuu gubo, uu qayb ka qaato qofka inuu hilibka iska rido. Tijaaba kale oo lagu sameeyey tiinka ayaa sheegeysa inuu hoos u dhigo heerka sokorta dhiigga ku jirta gaar ahaanna dadka qaba macaanka nooceeda labaad. Qofkasta oo doonayo inuu Tiinka cunistiisa uu tijaabiyo waxaa loo baahan yahay inuu isku badinin maxaa yeelay dadka qaar wuxuu ku keenaa saameyn ay ka mid tahay inuu shubmo, labbalabbo iyo caloosha oo qofka dibbirto. "Faa'idooyin caafimaad oo aad u badan ayuu Tiinku leeyahay, balse waxaa muhiim ah ineynu ogaanno inaan saameynta caafimaad uu Tiinku leeyahay oo dhan aan baaritaan lagu sameyn sidaa darteed qofka isticmaalayo si taxaddar leh uu u isticmaalo." ayey tiri Priya Tew. Sawirka, Stacy Michelson/BBC Miraha Bambara oo digirta aad ugu eg saliidda wey ku yartahay wuxuuna leeyahay macaan ka duwan noocyada digirta ee kale. Bambara waxaa lagu soo daraya shanta cunno ee mustaqbalka u wanaagsan in lagu xisaabtamo beerashadiisa iyo isticmaalkiisa la badiyo. Miraha Bambara oo qaaradda Afrika si weyn uga baxa waddamada kale ee laga beerto waxaa ka mid ah Maleesiya iyo Koonfurta Thailand. Waxaana Bambara loo isticmaalikaraa in la dubo, in la shiido, in la shiuilo iyo in la kariyo iwm. Sawirka, Geeska Afrika miraha Bambara waxaa looga isticmaalaa in maraq ahaan loo karsado ama in khudaarta lagu darsado wuxuuna leeyahay nafqo aad u badan. Wuxuuna sare u qaadaa awoodda jirka uu cudurrada isaga difaaco. Waxaana Bambara lagu daray shanta cunno ee ugu fiican mustaqbalka soo socdana loo baahan yahay in ahmiyadda la siiyo isticmaalkiisa iyo beerashadiisa.

Guidance: Charitable Appeals Since the 1920s and at the instigation of Lord Reith, the BBC has been offering charities the opportunity to broadcast appeals using BBC airtime. These now take the form of the Radio 4 Appeal which is weekly and the BBC One Lifeline Appeal which is monthly. There is an online application process with 4 open rounds each year. All applicants have to demonstrate UK or international scope and/or significance and provide information about their finances and governance. They must be able to explain how they will use the airtime, within the BBC Editorial Guidelines in particular on impartiality, to explain their work. All applications are sent for independent assessment and then also reviewed and recommended by the members of the BBC's Appeals Advisory Committee. Charities that are selected for broadcast appeals attend a BBC briefing and work with BBC producers to deliver the appeal. They are required to submit feedback forms and impact stories following the broadcast. Charities that have a successful appeal are eligible to reapply after 3 years. Charities making an unsuccessful application may reapply after 1 year. There are also up to 11 slots offered annually on BBC Radio Ulster/Foyle to local charities in Northern Ireland. It may be helpful to point charities to these broadcast appeals if asked how the BBC supports charities. More information about the application process is available from the BBC Charity Appeals Unit; the Charity Appeals Adviser for the Unit is Emma Kingsley via: In addition BBC local Radio stations and BBC Regions may wish to mount a specific BBC charity appeal for a project within their local area. All such proposals must be referred to the Appeals Adviser and Senior Adviser (charities) Editorial Policy . Approval will also be needed from Directors Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland or England and the BBC Appeals Advisory Committee. For contacts see above. Editorial Policy advice for those producing the broadcast content of the appeals on may be obtained from Senior Adviser, Editorial Policy, for contacts see the listed end of this guidance note. In addition at two points a year the BBC runs specific on air appeals seasons with BBC Children in Need and Comic Relief (see section 3. below) These are both 'grant givers' and therefore by supporting them the BBC audiences are in effect giving to a very large number of charities and projects with a wide geographical spread. The Disasters Emergency Committee or DEC is a membership organisation which represents 15 of the UK's humanitarian agencies. The relationship between the BBC and the DEC goes back over 50 years and there is an Memorandum of Understanding between the two organisations which sets out the 3 criteria for the BBC to launch on all its platforms, on behalf of the DEC, a disaster emergency appeal. When the DEC considers there is an emergency disaster that meets these criteria they will put a request to the BBC via the Charity Appeals Adviser. The ultimate decision for the BBC to run one of these appeals lies with the Director General in consultation with other members of the BBC Executive Committee. Once an appeal request has been granted, the Charity Appeals Adviser will liaise with the radio, television and digital teams who make the appeal and ensure it is distributed to all the various BBC networks. The appeal is made by BBC teams conforming to all BBC Editorial Guidelines and Editorial Policy advice will be given on the content (see contacts at the end of this guidance note). Charities which are members of the DEC are not eligible for the BBC broadcast appeals (ie the Radio 4 and BBC One Lifeline appeals). The BBC has a tradition of mounting major pan-BBC charity fundraising initiatives such as BBC Children in Need, Red Nose Day (for Comic Relief), and also reflecting Sport Relief (for Comic Relief). BBC Children in Need and BBC Media Action are BBC charities and bear the BBC brand. Comic Relief is not a BBC charity and unlike BBC Children in Need does not bear the BBC brand. It has been a major partner of the BBC and co producer for more than 20 years and together with the BBC has developed the Red Nose Day and Sport Relief on air appeals. The BBC maintains editorial control over all on air and BBC on line activities in relation to Comic Relief. BBC Children in Need, and Comic Relief do not themselves run projects, but are charities which distribute money to a range of projects run by a range of charities, not for profit organisations and community groups. Therefore in raising money to be distributed by BBC Children Need, or Comic Relief the BBC is not seen to be endorsing one particular project or one particular charitable cause. These cross-BBC appeals are reflected across the range of BBC services and in all media. A key aim is to get the public involved across the nations to undertake activities to support the appeal. The initiatives are mounted on a major scale. BBC charity appeal fundraising programming should normally fit within an agreed on-air 'appeal window'. This usually begins about 2/3 months before the main Appeal Night and around 1 months after. Any BBC Children in Need or Comic Relief other charity related BBC programming outside the window must be discussed with Editorial Policy and the BBC Charity Appeals Adviser. Typically the initiative culminates in a major appeal day on radio and night on TV, where donations are pledged by the public and the results of their fundraising are reported. In the build up to the main appeal night, the BBC broadcasts specially commissioned programmes or special strands within existing programmes to raise awareness of the appeal and to build audiences for the main telethon and radio activity . The programming may be across the whole range of BBC outlets including network television and radio, regional television, local radio and BBC websites and social media. In addition, the public is given information about BBC-wide charitable appeals so they can find out how to get involved, raise money and generally support the charities and obtain fundraising materials and merchandise. For each appeal a key executive figure or one for each relevant division of the BBC is usually agreed by the BBC who is responsible for liaison between the BBC and the charity and to whom referral must be made as outlined in this Guidance. There is always an Commissioning Executive with an overview of the relationship for BBC Content. This liaison figure(s) will ensure that all proposed fundraising activities and related programming fits with the values of the charity as well as according to BBC principles and standards, in liaison with BBC Editorial Policy. The BBC may reflect the work of these charities and any areas of their work that are being highlighted during a particular year's appeal for funds. For example, Comic Relief may wish to focus one year on projects which tackle the spread of malaria or BBC Children in Need may choose to highlight projects which tackle bullying. However, the BBC must not allow its content to be used as a vehicle for political campaigning or lobbying. Very careful editorial decisions may have to be taken to ensure that this line is not crossed. Editorial Policy Senior Adviser must be consulted at as early a stage as possible. The use of politicians should be handled with great care. Politicians should not be allowed to use their inclusion in BBC charity programming or related on-air activities to promote specific public policy or party political measures or initiatives. Any proposals to involve any politicians in particular party leaders on air must be referred in advance to the Chief Adviser Politics. For many years corporate and non-corporate supporters have helped BBC Children in Need and Comic Relief. These supporters, via their customers and staff, make a significant contribution mainly through selling special fundraising merchandise and providing a focus for staff and public fundraising. Much of this special merchandise is in the form of official charity products, which have been specifically produced for the appeal and are unique to the charity and sold by specific retailers who have agreed to help fundraise. For example Sainsbury's and Oxfam sell the Comic Relief Red Nose. Asda and Boots and other retailers sell Pudsey bears and other BBC Children in Need goods such as pens, Pudsey branded clothing and Christmas cards. In other cases charity supporters may produce special versions of existing products with a percentage being donated to the charity during the appeal period, for example a special flavour of a confectionary product. In addition, special records are often released, which raise money for the charity. Such releases may be mentioned on-air where editorially appropriate. Corporate support for cross BBC charitable appeals may also be in the form of considerable technical assistance to the charities, for example technology companies may provide major technical support and services on the main appeal nights. In such cases the technical support is offered to the charity and not the BBC and is not part of the BBC television production cost. There is no contractual relationship between the BBC and such technical supporters. The technical assistance offered to the charities enables them to set up, run and operate telephony and online donation mechanisms on the appeal night and in some cases across the year. For all trails the following will apply: The BBC has set up a specialist unit to provide advice on all technical aspects of running a competition, vote or any other uses of Telephony. The Interactive Technical Advice and Contracts Unit (ITACU) oversees the delivery, management and contracting of all BBC's Premium Rate Telephony and other telephony relating to voting and competitions for all programmes, and charity events both independent and in-house, across all divisions and output. Cross BBC charitable initiatives involve fundraising via telephony, online, red button, post and text donations. As appropriate, specialist charity appeals members of ITACU will work with the charity, Senior Adviser Editorial Policy and the Executive in charge of liaison with the charity, to ensure that all such uses are approved in line with regulation in terms of technical and legal issues. ITACU must be consulted at the earliest possible opportunity With high level approval, Premium Rate Telephony may be used to raise funds for these BBC charitable appeals. Premium Rate telephony may only be used for a competition vote or other fundraising mechanism which is directly related to the charitable appeal. Such uses of Premium Rate Telephony may only be carried out with detailed advice from Editorial Policy and ITACU. Any proposal must be signed off by the Divisional Director and referred to Editorial Policy well in advance. Interactive activities may include: Specially commissioned 'Feeder shows' may be produced which are designed to fundraise and/or build interest in the appeal before the main night. These shows usually run as a series in the weeks leading up to the main appeal night or stripped across the week before. They are often entertainment and factual entertainment shows specifically commissioned with a specific fundraising mechanic such as a vote and /or containing appeal films with a donation number call to action. The editorial connection or link to the charitable appeal must be made clear to the audience and the BBC Executive in charge of the production must retain editorial control of all content including any material relating to the charity. We may broadcast special factual programmes, dramas, comedies or other programmes including social media and iPlayer content in the run up to the appeal night to showcase the work of the charity, reflect the effect of donations from the previous appeal and highlight specific themes of that year, such as mental health and domestic violence. However, care must be taken to ensure that the BBC programming does not appear to campaign or lobby on any political issues or matters of public policy. Particular care has to be taken when any drama, comedy, factual or other programme highlights matters of public policy. Programmes may consider or reflect issues such as poverty, social equality, environmental concerns and other major issues. However, it is essential when highlighting these areas that the BBC does not appear to be advocating any political solution or actively encouraging any public campaign or lobby. The BBC should ensure the work of the charity and any projects they support is accurately reflected. The BBC must ensure that it maintains editorial control over all such programming.The Senior Editorial policy Adviser for Charity Appeals should be consulted as well as the relevant genre Senior Editorial Policy Adviser The link with the charity appeal must be made clear on air immediately before the programme, or clearly within the programme. Early discussions should be held with Senior Adviser Editorial Policy and the Executive responsible for liaison with the charity to ensure the suitability and editorial fit of such programming. With the agreement of Editorial Policy and ITACU, it may be appropriate to give information during or at the end of the programme about how to donate to the charitable appeal. Cross-BBC charity fundraising initiatives typically have a central on-air Appeal Night in the form of a telethon. The emphasis of the night is audience donations which are solicited through a range of donation mechanics, including telephone, post, online, red button and text. For BBC Children in Need, Comic Relief the main programme typically consists of suitably themed entertainment; appeal films which show how monies raised in previous appeals have been spent; where monies being raised in the current appeal will be spent and OB inserts from around the country. Throughout the evening the audience is regularly informed of the total and the different ways in which people have donated and raised money in the run-up to the appeal. The following relates to the Main Appeal Night itself: The Main Appeal night programme will reflect the enormous range of fundraising activity throughout the country and the myriad of fundraising initiatives. The BBC may thank members of the public and highlight the fundraising efforts of individuals, communities, organisations, companies their customers and their staff that have raised money and helped support the charity appeal. These acknowledgements should highlight the range of ways in which people have raised money from a whole raft of activities from 'bring and buy' sales and community initiatives, to buying Pudsey bears, red noses or other charity related merchandise. The money raised in this way is added to the 'totaliser' on the night in a clear and transparent manner. These 'thank yous' may come in the form of special inserts from around the country showcasing the work of communities and individuals, cheque presentations on location and in the studio, crawling astons , announcements from presenters and short films reflecting significant fundraising efforts. The editorial purpose of such reflections should be to thank the public and to inspire viewers to donate and to continue with fundraising activities. The following principles must be applied: Commercial logos should not be used in graphics except: Any use of commercial logos in graphics must be approved by Editorial Policy. Films reflecting the work of corporate supporters must abide by the following: Comic Relief is not a BBC charity. It will organise and set up its own events and challenges. These events may be designed to raise the profile of the appeal, showcase the work of the charity and highlight projects for which money is being raised. During the main appeal period Comic Relief may mount special challenges and events to raise money. Such events have included celebrity endurance feats such as those undertaken by David Walliams; celebrity challenges such as the Kilimanjaro climb and the now well established Sport Relief Mile. In 2008 some 400,000 people across the UK took part in the Sport Relief Mile and raised millions of pounds for the appeal. These are Comic Relief events, not BBC events. It would be very difficult to justify using the licence fee to pay for the organisation and administration of such events. Comic Relief undertakes the task of mounting events such as the Sport Relief runs all over the country with the help of a range of supporters. Any proposals for the BBC to cover such events must be referred to Editorial Policy at the earliest stage. BBC staff members may wish to raise money for charity, either individually, or as a group in off-air activities like fun runs or sponsored events. Staff are able to undertake activities organised by external organisations in a private capacity for fundraising activity for charitable purposes but not for campaigning or political action.
