(See Editorial Guidelines Section 16: External Relationships, including Commercial Relationships, and Financing 16.4.37 – 16.4.38) The Editorial Guidelines state that: The BBC may recover costs from the proceeds of ticket sales for BBC UK Public Service or World Service events which contribute to the BBC's Mission and Public Purposes.[1] This should be in line with the Statement on Ticketing for BBC Public Service Events.[2] The BBC may charge for tickets to BBC concerts, concert series or other BBC events held at outside venues. The BBC should not charge for admission to regular recordings of other programmes. Entry should only be charged for events held at an outside venue, not normally for events held in BBC studios. However, there may be a way to charge for tickets to events held in a BBC concert hall or studio. Advice and approval can be sought from Editorial Policy. The BBC may also charge for tickets to BBC concerts held in the regular venues of the BBC performing groups. Some BBC concert halls or studios are used both for orchestral concerts and also to record regular BBC programmes. It is not appropriate to charge for tickets for the regular programme recordings. In other exceptional, circumstances if there is any proposal to sell tickets to any other BBC event on BBC premises, such as an event to raise money for a BBC charitable initiative, the proposal must be approved in advance by Editorial Policy. Proposals to ticket a BBC event, which is part of a third party event that will require the public to pay an entry fee, should be referred to Editorial Policy. Occasionally an outside organisation, for example a gardening club, may invite the BBC to hold an outside broadcast programme at their premises. In these cases, with the advance approval of Editorial Policy, it may be appropriate for the location to charge a modest fee to the audience that they invite, in order to cover their costs. The amount charged must be agreed with the BBC beforehand to ensure the fee is fair and is not set at a rate that is designed to make a profit. Sometimes a programme which is regularly recorded in a BBC studio puts on an event at an outside location. For example a radio comedy sometimes appears at the Edinburgh Festival. In such cases it may be appropriate to charge for tickets to the special outside broadcast show. Ticket revenue must only cover the costs of an event or series of events and not be used for broadcast or production costs. The proceeds are not designed to generate further income for the BBC, unless the sales raise money for a BBC charitable initiative, such as Children in Need or Comic Relief and this has been approved by Editorial Policy and the relevant charity. Tickets to events and/or BBC shows may be included in auctions and prize draws to raise money for BBC partner charities. Any such proposals must be referred to the Senior Editorial Figure in charge of the content which is to be included. They must also be referred to Editorial Policy and ITACU (Interactive Technical Advice and Contracts Unit). In order to ensure that proposals for ticketing events and/or setting up new events meet the Statement of Policy on use of alternative finance in BBC[3] content, contact the Fair Trading team, part of the Public Policy team. An Events Form from Fair Trading must be completed for Public Service events for which tickets will be charged where it is: (b) an existing event with significant changes to either (i) the event or (ii) the charged ticketing arrangements. The form should be sent to Fair Trading, Editorial Policy and a relevant senior editorial figure or, for independents, the commissioning editor. Ticket prices must be referred to Fair Trading who will assess likely market impact. The final proposal, including the ticketing, must be approved by the relevant Head of Department/Controller who must refer to Editorial Policy, Public Policy and Regulatory Legal. While ticket revenue may be used for event costs, the BBC must pay for all broadcast costs. Occasionally there are requests from festivals, such as film festivals, to display a recorded programme, either prior to transmission or post- transmission. Approvals for this should come from the relevant Head of Marketing. It is not normally appropriate for a separate charge to be made to see the BBC material. However it may be acceptable for there to be an over-all entry charge to the whole event, if it includes a substantial amount of non-BBC content, for example when showcasing BBC content at a third party event such as a public festival. BBC Audience Services supply audiences for many TV and radio programmes and some BBC events with free tickets. They advertise the availability of tickets on the BBC Tickets site. Audience Services have a Code of Practice for free ticketing for BBC programmes. (See Code of Practice: BBC Guidelines for Ticketing and Stewarding BBC Studio Audience Programmes) Should a production wish to use another ticketing supplier they should establish that the company is reputable – no external organisation that the BBC becomes involved with should bring the BBC into disrepute. (See Editorial Guidelines 16.4.1 – 16.4.9) It is advisable to check that that there is no controversy associated with the company's ticketing and that they are reliable in sending out tickets. BBC Studios has a Privacy Team who work with BBC Information Security to assess suppliers' compliance with information security and data privacy policies and standards. Once this due diligence has been completed, the relevant Production's Business Affairs team can pull together the paperwork/contract. Ticketing for BBC broadcast events held at an outside venue may be handled by the BBC, by the external venue or by a ticketing company which has been contracted by the BBC or by the external venue, such as the box office at a concert hall. For a BBC event a direct link to the ticketing site is likely to be editorially justifiable. It should be clear that the public is leaving the BBC site to get to the source of the tickets. It is important that the primary purpose of the site that is linked to is the selling of public tickets. It would not be appropriate, for example, to link to a site whose primary purpose was to sell corporate hospitality to a BBC event. However it may be acceptable to link to a site selling public tickets for a BBC event as its primary purpose, which also sells added extras to the event (such as corporate hospitality), if there is appropriate separation between the main function and the subsidiary ones. On all external ticketing sites there should also be adequate separation between the use of BBC brands and third party brands. If in doubt, contact Fair Trading for further advice. Third party ticketing sites providing tickets for BBC events should not normally be referred to in on air trails. Usually an acceptable route is to point to the programme or channel website and link to external sites from there (for example to a ticketing site or an event/festival site). When a BBC commissioned programme or BBC commissioned event, such as Sports Personality of the Year, is ticketed, availability of the tickets may be trailed on air. Care should be taken if availability of tickets for events organised by third parties are mentioned. It is not usually appropriate to trail tickets on air or online for third party events. In some exceptional cases it may be acceptable, for example where a BBC orchestra is performing at an event. Advice should be sought from Editorial Policy. All ticketing arrangements must stand up to scrutiny and be clearly auditable. It is very important to ensure that event costs are calculated separately from the broadcast costs. Production, commissioning and Commercial Rights and Business Affairs (CRBA) should keep separate accounts of event and production costs and records of ticketing revenue going to the BBC or via the BBC. Separate records must be kept of all ticket revenue going to the BBC or going via the BBC. Danny Danon waa Safiirka Joogtada ah ee Israa'iil u fadhiya Qaramada Midoobay. Waxa uu dhashay 8-da May 1971, wuxuuna leeyahay waayo-aragnimo dheer oo dhinaca siyaasadda iyo diblomaasiyadda ah. Danon hore ayuu u soo noqday xildhibaan ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Israa'iil (Knesset), Wasiir, iyo Safiir UN intii u dhaxaysay 2015–2020, ka hor inta aan mar kale dib loogu soo magacaabin xilkan. Danny wuxuu noqday Israa'iiligii ugu horreeyay ee hoggaamiya guddi ka tirsan QM, kaddib markii 2016kii loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Lixaad (Arrimaha Sharciga). Sannadkii xigayna, wuxuu noqday Madaxweyne Ku-Xigeenka Golaha Guud intii lagu jiray fadhigii 72-aad QM (2017–2018). Intii uu xilka hayay, Danny Danon wuxuu hormuud ka ahaa go'aanno iyo dadaallo badan oo wax ka beddelay mowqifka Israaiil ee Qaramada Midoobay. Sannadkii 2016, wuxuu hoggaamiyay shirkii caalami ee ugu horreeyay ee QM lagaga soo horjeeday dhaqdhaqaaqa Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions (BDS). Sidoo kale, Danon wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij uu ku hoggaaminayay safiirrada kale ee QM safarro dhowr ah oo ay ku tageen Poland iyo Israel. Danny Danon ayaa soo noqday wakiilka Hay'adda Yuhuudda (Jewish Agency) halkaas oo noqotay bartii uu ka soo galay siyaadda, waxa ay ku yeelatay shaqadaasi noloshiisa raad weyn. Bishii Juun 2006, Danon waxaa loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Likud, isagoo ka adkaaday Yuval Steinitz, xildhibaan ka tirsanaa Knesset. Wuxuu si gaar ah ugu xil saarnaa ka hortagga Yuhuud nacaybka. Intii uu xilka hayay, Danon wuxuu si aad uga soo horjeeday qorshihii kala go'a ee Ra'iisul Wasaare Ariel Sharon, gaar ahaan aftidii loo qaaday ee ay sameeyan guddiga dhexe ee xisbiga Likud, taas uu Danon kaga adkaaday Sharon. Waxii intaas ka dambeeyey waxa uu ahaa nin mowqif adag oo aan ka gamban danaha Israa'iil. Fadlan halkan riix oo ku soo biir janalka WhatsApp ee BBC Somali si aad u hesho wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee caalamka, iyo kuwa gobolka Danon waxa uu kamid baarlamaankii 19aad ee Knesset, isaga oo sidoo kale noqday ku xigeenka wasiirka difaaca Israa'iil waqtigaas oo uu Intii uu xilka hayay, wuxuu diiradda saaray sidii loogu kordhin lahaa ciidanka difaaca Israa'iil (IDF) dadka Masiixiyiinta ah, iyo Yuhuudda Itoobiya, hagaajinta adeegga ee askarta kaydka ah, dejinta shuruudo loogu talagalay faa'iidooyinka dhaqaale ee ciidamada ammaanka, iyo dhimista tirada askarta ka baxeysa milatariga. Taas oo lagu sheego inuu waqtigaas ahaa ninkii isku taagay inu adkeeyo xiriirka Itoobiya iyo Israa'iil. waa shaqsi aad uga soo hor jeesta heshiisyada nabadda ee lala galayo Falastiin, sanadkii 2013, Danon wuxuu ku adkeystay qaraar ahaa 'qof kasta oo taageersan heshiis nabadeed oo lala gaaro Falastiiniyiinta in uusan boos ku lahayn xisbiga Likud oo uu xubin ka yahay. Waxa uu ka soo horjeedaa xalka labada dal wuxuuna ku doodayaa in lagu fidiyo xukunka Israa'iil inta badan dhulka Daanta Galbeed (West Bank). Sidoo kale, Danon Waxa uu caan ku yahay difaacidda mowqifka adag ee siyaasadda Israa'iil ee fagaarayaasha caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan Qaramada Midoobay, isaga oo si joogto ah uga hadla arrimaha amniga, sharciga caalamiga ah iyo danaha Israa'iil ee khilaafaadka caalamka. Kadib markii Benjamin Natenyahu ku dhawaaqay aqoonsiga Somaliland, Danon ayaa dhowr qoraal oo uu barahiisa bulshada ku qoray ku sheegay in tallabadaan ay ahayd mid uu dalkiisa ku saxan yahay. "Israa'iil kama xishooneyso doodaha siyaasadeed", ayuu ku yiri Danny Danon qoraal uu daabacay fiidnimadii Sabtida, isaga oo ka hadlaya kulan degdeg ah oo Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay maanta oo Isniin ah, gelinka dambe, isugu imanayeen, ka dib markii ay Israa'iil aqoonsatay Somaliland Danon ayaa sheegay in mowqifka dalkiisu uu ku saleysan yahay danaha istaraatiijiyadeed iyo aragti siyaasadeed oo Israa'iil ay ka leedahay gobolka Geeska Afrika. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in Israa'iil ay rumeysan tahay xaqa ay bulshooyinka qaarkood u leeyihiin aayo-ka-tashigooda, isla markaana ay Somaliland u aragto meel leh xasillooni iyo maamul iskiis u taagan marka loo eego duruufaha gobolka. Safiirku wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in Israa''iil ay doonayso inay ballaariso xiriirrada ay la leedahay dalalka ku yaalla Afrika, gaar ahaan kuwa leh muhiimad istaraatiijiyadeed oo dhanka amniga, ganacsiga iyo marin-biyoodka ah, waxa uu intaas ku daray in tallaabo kasta oo Israa'iil ay qaaddo ay u aragto mid waafaqsan danaha amnigeeda qaranka iyo iskaashiga mustaqbalka fog. Isagoo ka jawaabaya dhaliilaha ka yimid dalal kale, ambasadoorku wuxuu sheegay in Israa'iil ay ixtiraamayso aragtiyada beesha caalamka, balse ay aaminsan tahay in wada-hadal iyo xaqiiqooyinka dhulka ka jira lagu saleeyo go'aamada siyaasadeed, halkii laga raaci lahaa cadaadis dibadeed ama mowqifyo hore oo aan wax isbeddel ah ku imaan. Jaamacadda Carabta ayaa dalbaday kulan deg deg ah oo ay iskugu yimaadan golaha ammaaanka qaramada midoobey, kaas oo looga hadlayo aqoonsiga, Danon ayaa sheegay inuu difaaci doono mowqifka iyo tallaabada uu dalkiisa qaaday. Danon ayaa ah nin saameyn weyn ku leh gudaha QM iyo waddamada Israa'iil taageera.

Caa'isha Al-Baa'uuniya: waa taariikh nololeedkii gabadhii xifdisay qur'aanka kariimka ah iyadoo 8 jir ah , AI/ DEEPAI tool Jacaylku waa badweyn aan lahayn xeeb. Oo waxaa jira iftiin aan mugdi ku jirin. Jacaylku waa sir ay adag tahay in la helo. Waxaana jira hal qodob oo ay adag tahay in la sharaxo. kuwani waa tix ka mdi ah gabayo ay tirisay Caa'isha Al-Bacuniyah oo ku noolayd Shaam qarnigii 15-aad. Caa'isha al-Bacuniyyah, oo uu ku tilmaamay mid ka mid ah taariikhyahanada mid ka mid ah mucjisooyinka waqtigeedii, waxa ay ku dhalatay Dimishiq 1456. Aabaheed, Yuusuf, waxa uu ka mid ahaa 'qoyska al-Ba'uuniyah', oo caan ku ahaa culimo, gabayaa iyo sharci-yaqaano, iyo Qaadi (Xaakim) ka aha magalada Dimishiq. Taariikhyahan reer Falastiini ah Walid Khalidi ayaa aaminsan in Caa'isha "ay si buuxda u muujisay hibada suugaaneed iyo suufiyada qoyskeeda." Sawirka, Caa'isha iyo walaalaheed waxa barashadooda ugu horreysey ee Qur'aanka, Axaadiista, Fiqhiga, iyo gabayada waxay baray aabbahood. Professor cilmiga fiqiga ah Emil Homerin oo qoray taariikh nololeedka Caa'isha ayaa sheegay in ay (Caasha) xifdisay qur'aanka kariimka ah iyada oo 8 jir ah. Taariikh-nololeedkan waxa kale oo uu xoogga saaray doorkii Nebi Muxamed nabadgalyo iyo naxariis dushiisa ha ahaatee ee Caa'isha ruuxeeda, waxaana uu baaray saamaynta shakhsiyaadka ay ka mid yihiin Ibn Al-Carabi, al-Busiri, iyo Ibn Al-Farid. Homerin waxa uu qoray in xilligii Mamluk (Boqortooyadii Mamluk ee Masar iyo Shaam ka talinaysay sannadihii 1250 ilaa 1517) Carabiga, iyo suugaanta ay aad u kobceen, culimadii iyo ardaydii dunida Muslimka oo dhanna ay u dareereen Qaahira iyo Dimishiq. Tani waxay abuurtay fursado safar, waxbarasho, iyo shaqo. Qoraaga iyo gabayaagii Caa'isha al-Bacuniyah waxa ay sidoo kale ka gudubtay caqabado badan oo dhinaca bulshada iyo dhaqanka ah si ay u gasho saaxada barashada diinta iyo suugaanta, iyada oo dumar ah. Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Sida ku cad taariikh nololeedkan ku qoran afka Ingiriisiga ee Homer, Caa'isha waxay u badan tahay inay wax ku qortay Carabi in ka badan inta haween kale ka hor qarnigii 20aad. "Suuqa caalimiyad ahaan iyo gabayaa Carbeed, qoraaladeedu waxay ahaayeen kuwo aan caadi ahayn marka la eego halbeeg kasta oo waqtigeedii ah. Dumar badan oo Islaami ah qarniyadii dhexe waxay ahaayeen culimo iyo macalimiin la ixtiraamo, laakiin aad bay u yarayd inay soo saaraan buugaag iyaga u gaar ah. Caa'isha al-Bacuniyah waxay qortay in ka badan labaatan buug oo malaha tiraab Carabi iyo gabayo ka badan dumar kasta oo Muslim ah ka hor qarnigii 20-aad. Homerin waxa kale oo uu laba ka mid ah buugaagta Caa'isha ka turjumay afka Carabiga una turjumay Ingiriis. Sida laga soo xigtay isaga, helitaanka erayada Caa'isha waxay la mid tahay 'helitaanka irbad mel ku jirta'. Homerin, oo dhintay laba sano ka hor, ayaa wareysi uu bixiyay ku sheegay sida uu u helay qoraallada Aisha oo uu sheegay inay ahaayeen (qoraalo gacanta lagu qoray). "Mar aan Masar tagay, waxaan ka shaqaynayey gabayo laga soo bilaabo xilligii Mamluuk, waxaan raadinayey nooc kasta oo abwaanno ah, laakiin dedaalkaygii waxa ka mid ahaa in aan helo dumar gabyaa ah, Daarul-kutub ee Qaahira, waxa aan eegayay liiska magacyada. Waxa uu intaa ku daray in Caa'isha ay ka mid tahay dumarka suufiyada ah ee Islaamka wax ka qoray ka hor inta aan la gaarin casrigan, taasina waxa ay ina siinaysaa aragtiyo muhiim ah oo ku saabsan bulshada haweenka, suufiyada Islaamka iyo guud ahaan Islaamka. Sida uu sheegay Homer, waxay ahayd mid had iyo jeer rajo leh, had iyo jeer rumaysan naxariista Eebbe, sida gabyaagii weynaa ee Faaris Jalaaludiin Ruumi. Sawirka, Book Cover / The Principles of Sufism Caa'isha waxa ay guursatay Axmad bin Muxammad bin Naqiib Al-Ashraf oo ahaa caalim ka soo jeeda qoys Dimishiq ah oo uu nasabkiisu sida Caa'isha lafteedu sheegtay uu ka soo jeedo Imaam Cali. Waxay Qaahira kula noolayd wiilkeeda Cabdulluhaab afar sano. Markii ay Qaahira ka socotay ee u socotay Dimishiq, tuug ayaa xaday alaabtii Caa'isha, oo ay ku jiraan qoraalladeeda. Waxay gashay goob culuumta lagu barto oo Qahira ku taalla waxayna baratay fiqhiga, ama shareecada Islaamka, waxaana loo fasaxay inay barato sharciga oo ay soo saarto fatwooyin (ra'yi sharci). "Waxay caan ku noqotay sharci yaqaanimada," ayuu yiri Devon Stewart. Caa'isha waxa ay sidoo kale caan ku ahayd duruusteeda ku saabsan la kali noqoshada Alle iyo muhiimadda jacaylka cibaadada . Waxay ahayd qof caan ka ah dhaqanka Suufiyada ee waqtigeeda, waxayna kaalin mug leh ka qaadatay horumarinta Suufiyada Islaamka. Hordhaca kutubta Caa'isha waxa ay daaha ka qaaday in ay aad u jeceshahay daacadnimo weyn u haysay Nebiga nabadgalyo iyo naxariis dushiisa ha ahaatee. Muhammad Zubayr iyo Dr. Muhammad Idrees Lodhi waxay cilmi-baadhis ku sameeyeen in Caisha Al-Ba'uuniya ay tahay qofkii ugu horreeyay oo laga yaabo inay tahay haweenayda keliya ee wax ka qorta mawduucan. Caa'isha waxay ku muujisay jacaylka diiniga ah iyo shucuurta ay u qabto Nebiga gabay aanay xataa gabyaaga waaweyn ee ragga ahi samayn karin.

Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin oo ku baaqay "wadahadal toos ah" oo uu la yeesho Ukraine Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin ayaa ku casuumay Ukraine inay ka qeyb gasho "wadahadal toos ah" oo dhici doona 15-ka May, saacado uun kadib markii hogaamiyeyaasha Yurub ay ku booriyeen Moscow inay ogolaato xabbad-joojin 30 maalmood ah. khudbad telefishan oo dhif ah oo uu xiili dambe oo habeenimo ka jeediyey aqalka Kremlin-ka, Putin wuxuu sheegay in Ruushku uu raadinayo "wadahadallo dhab ah" oo loogu talagalay "in loo dhaqaaqo xasillooni iyo nabad waarta oo xooggan". Xilli hore oo sabtidii ah, Ra'iisul Wasaaraha UK Sir Keir Starmer ayaa booqday Kyiv isagoo la socda hogaamiyeyaasha Faransiiska, Jarmalka, iyo Poland si ay cadaadis ugu saaraan Ruushka inuu aqbalo xabbad-joojin aan shuruudo lahayn oo bilaabmi doonta Isniinta. Afhayeenka Kremlin-ka Dmitry Peskov ayaa markii dambe sheegay in Moscow "ay tahay inay tan ka fikirto" - laakiin wuxuu ka digay in "isku dayga in la cadaadiyo ay tahay wax aan faa'iido lahayn". Bayaankiisa gaarka ah, Putin wuxuu ku sheegay inuusan"ka saari karin suurtagalnimada ah" in wadahadalladu keeni karaan heshiis xabbad-joojin cusub oo ay gaaraan Ruushka iyo Ukraine. Hoggaamiyaha Ruushka wuxuu sheegay in wadahadallada la soo jeediyay lagu qaban karo magaalada Istanbul ee Turkiga, sidii horayba loo sameeyay, isla markaana uu Axadda la hadli doono Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan si ay uga wada hadlaan faahfaahinta. Kyiv wali kama aysan jawaabin casuumaaddaas. , Caasimadda Ukraine ayaa sabtidii martigelinaysay Raysal Wasaraha UK Sir Keir, madaxweynaha Faransiika Emmanuel Macron, Jarmalka Friedrich Merz iyo Poland Donald Tusk, kuwaas oo qayb ka ah "isbahaysiga rabitaan" oo ah koox waddamo ah oo ay ka go'an tahay inay taageeraan Ukraine. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Iyagoo dhinac taagan madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky, waxay ka qeyb galeen shir jaraa'id oo wadajir ah. Hoggaamiyeyaashu waxay uga digeen Ruushka in "cunaqabateyn cusub oo baaxad weyn leh" lagu soo rogi doono qeybaha tamarta iyo bangiyada haddii Putin uusan ogolaan xabbad-joojin 30 maalmood ah oo aan shuruud lahayn, taasoo quseysa cirka, badda, iyo dhulka. Waxay sidoo kale sheegeen inay arrinta soo jeedinta ay kala hadleen Donald Trump. Sir Keir ayaa markii dambe u sheegay BBC-da in Madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu ahaa "mid si buuxda u caddeeyay" in soo jeedintooda xabbad-joojin degdeg ah ay tahay "dalab ay tahay in la fuliyo". Kulanka kadib, Madaxweyne Zelensky ayaa u mahadceliyay hoggaamiyeyaasha isugu yimid Kyiv isagoo yiri: "Waad mahadsan tihiin taageeradiina Ukraine aad la garab taagan tihiin." "Maanta waxaan diiradda saari doonaa sida loo dhiso loona dammaanad qaado amni dhab ah oo waara," ayuu yiri. Mar uu ka jawaabayay soo jeedinta, afhayeenka Kremlin-ka Dmitry Peskov wuxuu yiri: "Waa horumar cusub. Laakiin isku dayga ah in nala cadaadiyo wax faa'iido ah ma leh." Warbaahinta dowladda Ruushka ayaa sidoo kale ka soo xigatay Peskov isagoo sheegay in hadallada ka imaanaya Yurub ay "guud ahaan yihiin kuwo colaadeed halkii ay ka ahaan lahaayeen kuwa lagu doonayo in lagu soo celiyo xiriirka naga dhexeeya." Sawirka, Moscow ayaa horay u sheegtay in ka hor inta aysan ka fiirsan xabad joojin ay tahay in reer galbeedku ay marka hore joojiyaan kaalmada milatari ee ay siiyaan Ukraine. Putin ayaa markii dambe soo saaray bayaan u gaar ah, iyadoo muuqaal laga baahiyay uu muujinayo weriyeyaal isugu yimid hool ku yaalla Kremlin-ka. "Waa tallaabadii ugu horreysay ee loo qaado dhanka nabad waarta oo muddo dheer socota, halkii ay noqon lahayd hordhac dagaallo kale oo hubeysan marka ciidamada Ukraine ay helaan hub cusub iyo ciidamo, ka dib hawlo degdeg ah oo qodis godad dagaal ah iyo sameynta saldhigyo cusub oo talisyo ah," ayuu yiri. "Yaa u baahan nabad noocaas ah?" Putin wuxuu sidoo kale ku eedeeyay Ukraine inay marar badan ku guuldareysatay inay ka jawaabto dalabyo xabbad-joojin ah oo Moscow soo jeedisay, kuwaas oo ay ka mid ahaayeen joojinta weerarada lagu hayo kaabayaasha tamarta muddo 30 maalmood ah iyo xabbad-joojintii ciidda Easter ee bishii la soo dhaafay. Xabbad-joojin kale oo uu Putin xusay waxay ahayd mid uu amray bishii Abriil si ay ugu beeganto xuska Dagaalkii Labaad ee Adduunka. Xabbad-joojintaas waxay dhammaatay Sabtidii saqdii dhexe. Inkasta oo dagaalku yaraaday, dhinacba kan kale wuxuu ku eedeeyey inuu isagu wax jabiyey Khamiista - isla maalintii la filayey xabbad joojinta ayaa dhaqangashay - Ukraine waxay ku eedaysay Ruushka in ka badan 730 xadgudub waxayna sheegtay inay "si habboon uga jawaabeyso". Wasaaradda gaashaandhigga Ruushka waxay ku adkeysatay in xabbad-joojintu ay socotay, ka hor inta aysan iyaguna ku eedeyn Ukraine 488 xadgudbyo ah "In kasta oo ay wax walba jiraan, waxaan u soo bandhigeynaa maamulka Kyiv inay dib u bilaabaan wada xaajoodyada... dib u soo celinta wadahadalka tooska ah, waxaanan ku adkeynayaa, iyada oo aan wax shuruud ah lagu xirin," ayuu yiri Putin Sabtidii. Wadahadalladii ugu dambeeyay ee tooska ahaa ee u dhexeeyay Moscow iyo Kyiv waxay dhaceen sannadkii 2022, markaasoo Ruushku bilaabay duullaankiisii buuxa ee Ukraine.

Ciyaartoyada Afcon ee indhaha lagu hayo Koobka 35-ta dal ee Afrika ayaa ka bilaabanaya Morocco 21-ka Bishan Desembar. Ciyaarta ugu dambeysa kulamadan ayaa ka dhaceysay magaalada Rabat 18-ka Janaayo. . Masar ayaa qaaday koobkan sanadkii 2010-kii. Lix ka mid ah magacyada ugu waa weyn ee tartanka AFCON ka qeybgalaya ayaan halkan ku soo bandhigeynaa. , Achraf Hakimi oo hada ah xiddiga sanadka ee ciyartoyda Afrika iyo kabtanka naadiga ayaa la filayaa in uu caafimaad ahaan ka qeybgali karo tartanka hadii aysan taasi dhicin waxay ku qasban yihiin in baddel loo helo. Ciyaartoyga Khadka dhexe ee Real Madrid, Brahim Diaz ayaa ahaa kan ugu goolasha badan isagoo dhaliyay 7 gool balse reer Morocco waxay rajeynayaan in Azzedine Ounahi oo xukuma khadk dhexe in uu soo baxayo. Ounahi waxa uu ka soo baxay akadeemiyada caanka ah ee VI. Culeys ayaa ku qabsaday Marseille kaddib markii uu halkaas u wareegay. Ciyaarihii adduunka ee 2022-kii ayuu muujiyay awood xooggan. Morocco waxay la ciyaari doonaan dalalka Comoros, Mali, iyo Zambia oo ay kuwada jiraan guruubka A. Xulka Marocco waxaa ku jira ciyaartoy awood leh sida Yassine Bonou iyo Youssef En-Nesyri. Hadii Hakimi uusan ciyaari karin sanadkan, waxaa suuragal ah in lagu beddelo Ounahi. Sawirka, Amoura waxa uu ka mid ahaa ciyaartoyda ugu goolasha badnaa qaarada Afrika isree-reebka koobka adduunka ee sanadkan. Weeraryahanka Wolfsburg waxa uu dhaliyay 11 gool sideed kulan oo u dalkiisa u saftay ilaa bishii Maarso. Goolasha uu dhaliyay waxaa ku jira saddex uu ka dhaliyay Mozambique. Riyad Mahrez waxa uu ahaa ciyaartoygii ugu muhiimsanaa horyaalkii sanadkii 2019-kii. Labadooda waxaa ka dhexeeya is-faham wanaagsan. Amoura waa ciyaartoy halis ah, waxay hadda guruubka E kuwada jiraan dalalka Sudan, Burkina Faso, iyo Equatorial Guinea. Way iska cadahay in guusha Nigeria ay si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay hadii uu weeraryahanka Galatasaray diyaar yahay, uuna caafimaad qabo. Xulka Nigeria waxay haystaan 15 dhibcood. Osimhen waxa uu halbowle u yahay xulka. Nigeria xaalku wuu ku adkaaday kulankii DRC kaddib markii lagu qasbay in ciyaarta uu ka baxo. Frank Onyeka oo ay isku naadi yihiin ayaa ku tilmaamay Osimhen "qof aan la gaarikarin". Hadii Nigeria ay dooneyso in ay meel fiican gaarto aad ayuu muhiim ugu yahay. Sawirka, Sadio Mane weli waa ciyaartoy muhiim u ah xulka horyaalka AFCON 2021 qaaday. Ndiaye and Ismaila Sarr hadda waxay ka dheelaan horyaalka Ingiriiska. Labadaas ciyaartoy iyo Mane hadii ay isla joogaan, xulkooda waxa uu haystaa saddex weeraryahan oo cajiib ah. Taageerayaasha xulka qaranka Senegal ayaa u arka Ibrahim Mbaye ciyaartoy mustaqbal leh. Mbaye waxa uu hore ugu dheeli jiray da'yarta Faransiiska. Wuxuu u ciyaaray PSG. Ciyaartii Champions Leauge ee Barcelona ayaa la safay isagoo baddel ku yimid. Sawirka, Xulka qaranka Uganda dib ayuu ugu soo laabtay AFCON. 2019-kii waxaa lagu reebay wareegga 16-ka. Sanadka 2017-ka waxay u diyaargaroobayaan in ay martigeliyaan ciyaaraha Ciyaarihii loogu soo baxayay koobka adduunka guruubkooda waxay galeen kaalinta labaad, waxay ka dambeeyeen Algeria. 22 jirkan waxa uu dhaliyay labo gool oo cajiib ah markii ay ka guuleysteen Mozambique bishii Sabtembar. Uganda waxay ku jirtaa guruub adag oo ah C, waxaana sugaya Nigeria iyo Tunisia iyo sidoo kale Tanzania. Sawirka, Mozambique waxay gaareen heer aysan weligood soo gaarin, waxayna u socdaalayaan Waqooyiga Afrika. Markii ugu horeysay waxaa xulkooda ku jira ciyaartoy ka dheela horyaalka Ingiriiska. Reinildo waxa uu noqday ciyaartoygii ugu horeeyay dalkiisa ee ka dheela horyaalka Ingiriiska kaddib markii uu ku biiray naadiga Sunderland. Ciyaartoygan ayaa ka yimid Atletico Madrid bishii July ka hor inta uusan Sunderland ku soo biirin. 31-jirkan ka dheelaa weerarka, wuxuu ka caawiyay xulka Black Cats in ay si weyn kor ugu soo kacaan.

Maxaa ka haray nukliyeerka Iran, weli khatar ma yahay? , Anadolu Agency Israel iyo Mareykanka ayaa sabtigii ku qaaday Iran weerar ay Israel ku tilmaantay "ka hortag". Weerarka ayaa dhacay kaddib wadahadalo ay Cumaan dhexdhexaadineysay oo kii ugu dambeeyay khamiistii lagu qabtay Geneva Mareykanku wuxuu diyaaradihiisa iyo maraakiibtiisa dagaal keenay Bariga Dhexe si uu Iran u weeraro haddii Tehran aysan ku heshiin arrimaha la xiriira barnaamijkeeda Nukliyeerka. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa 19-kii Feberaayo ku hanjabay "In waxyaabo xun dhici doonaan" haddii aan la gaarin "heshiis macno leh", isagoo ku celceliyay mowqifkiisa ah in Iraniyiintu "ayaan haysan karin hub Nukliyeer,... nabadi kma jireyso Bariga Dhexe haddii ay Iran haysto hub Nukliyeer." Iran way beenisay in ay dooneyso in ay haysato hubka Nukliyeerka balse dalal badan iyo Hay'ada Atoomikada adduunka ee IAEA taasi ma aaminsana. Xaaladda barnaamijka Nukliyeerka Iran ayaan wali la ogaan, tan iyo markii la beegsaday goobihii muhiimka ahaa ee Nukliyeerka intii lagu jiray dagaalkii 12-ka maalmood ee Israel iyo Iran. Mareykanku wuu ku lug lahaa duqeynta Iran, isagoo weeraray saddex goob oo Nukliyeerka Iran ah, oo ay ku jirto xaruntii ugu weyneyd ee cilmi-baarista Nukliyeerka ee Isfahan, iyo tan ku taal Fordow. Kaddib weerarradii Mareykanka, Trump wuxuu ku dhawaaqay in gabi ahaan la burburay xarumahaasi. Toddobaad kaddib madaxa hay'ada Atoomikada adduunka, Rafael Grossi, ayaa sheegay in duqeymaha ay sababeen waxyeelo weyn, wuxuuna sheegay in qaar ka mid ah howlaha bacriminta dib loo bilaabi karo bilooyin gudaheed. Grossi wuxuu wakaaladda wararka AP u sheegay bishii Oktobar ee sanadkii hore hadii la kordhiyo heerka bacriminta in ay ku filan tahay in lagu sameeyo 10 bam oo nukliyeer ah. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Iran Abbas Araqchi ayaa u sheegay wargeyska The Economist bishii Nofember ee sanadkii hore in la joojiyay naaxinta Yuraniyamka. Bishii Janaayo wuxuu Grossi u sheegay wakaaladda wararka Reuters in hay'adda Atoomikada Caalamiga ay kormeertay 13 goobood oo Iran ku yaal kuwaas oo aan la duqeyn isagoo intaas ku daray in hay'adda ay aragtay tiro badan oo Yuraniyam ah oo aad loo naaxiyay. Wax badan oo muhiim ah lagama oga arrimaha xasaasiga ah iyo diiwaanka nukliyeerka Iran sida halka hadda lagu keydiyo iyo xaaladda goobaha naaxinta. Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Dowladda Iran waxay ku adkeystaa in ujeedka howlaheeda Nukliyeerka ay la xiriiraan oo kaliya arrimo rayid. Iiraan waxay ka mid tahay saxiixayaasha Heshiiska Ka-hortagga Faafitaanka Hubka Nukliyeerka, waxayna oggolaatay oo keliya in nukliyeerka loo isticmaalo hab nabadeed sida ujeeddooyinka daawada, beeraha iyo tamarta. Baaritaan 10-sano ah oo ay samaysay Hay'ada Caalamiga ah ee Atoomikada ayaa daaha ka qaaday in Iran ay fulisay "hawlo kala duwan oo la xiriira sameynta qarxa Nukliyeerka" laga bilaabo dabayaaqadii 1980-meeyadii ilaa 2003. Hay'addu waxay sheegtay in macluumaadkaas ay muujinayaan in barnaamijkan, oo loo yaqaan "Project Amad", markii dambe la joojiyay. Balse 2009-kii waxay hay'ado sirdoon oo reer Galbeed ah ogaadeen saldhigga Foddow. Madaxweyne Donald Trump markii uu xukunka yimid ayuu go'aansaday in uu ka baxo heshiiska, wuxuuna ku dooday in heshiiska ku guuldareystay in uu Iran ka joojiyo helista bam nukliyeer ah, wuxuuna go'aansaday in uu cunaqabateyn ku soo rogo. Iran waxay taas kaga jawaabtay in ay jabiso qodobada heshiiska iyadoo naaxinta Yuraniyamka gaarsiisay 60 boqolkiiba. Bishii June sanadkii hore ee 2025-kii ayey hay'adda Atoomikada ku dhawaaqday in Iran ay jabisay heshiiska markii ugu horeysay muddo 20 sano ah. Maalintii xigtay waxaa weerar ku qaaday Israel. Sawirka, Muuqaallo uu qaaday dayaxgacmeedka bilihii u dambeeyay ayaa muujinaya in shaqo ay ka socoto xarumaha Natanz iyoIsfahan. Dhammaan meelaha laga galo Isfahan ayaa u muuqday in la xiray iyadoo saqafka korena la dhisay sida ay muujinayaan muuqaallada uu qaaday dayaxgacmeedka. Sawiradii ugu dambeeyay ee dayax-gacmeedka, oo markii ugu horreysay ay sharaxeen Machadka Sayniska iyo Amniga Caalamiga ah, ayaa muujinaya in Iran ay xoojisay dhismah dhulka hoostiis ah ee loo yaqaan Mount Kolang Gas La, sidoo kale loo yaqaan Mount Axe. Goobtan, oo aanay weerarin Israel iyo Mareykanka, waxay ku taal qiyaastii laba kiiloomitir koonfurta xarunta Nukliyeerka ee Natanz. Soo saarista Yuraniyam hub laga sameyn karo waxay dedejineysaa sameynta bam qarxa, laakiin habka bacriminta ma ahan mid keenaya hub diyaar ah, farsamo kale oo dheeri ah ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo gaaro sameynta bam Nukliyeer ah. Ka hor weerarkii Isreal iyo Mareykanka ee sanadkii hore, waxay qiimayntii ay samaysay Hay'ada Sirdoonka Difaaca ee Mareykanka bishii May 2025 ku sheegtay in Iran ay awood u lahayd, "waxay u badan tahay in ka yar toddobaad gudahood", in ay soo saarto Yuraniyam hub laga sameyn karo. Wuxuu Mareykanka sheegay "waan hubnaa in Iran aysan hub nukliyeer ah sameyneyn balse sanadihii dhawaa waxay qaaday howlo ay ku xoojineyso awoodeeda. Dr. Patricia Lewis oo ah khabiir madax-bannaan oo ku takhasustay xakamaynta hubka, ayaa sheegtay, "Iran waxay horumarineysay awoodaheeda hubka ilaa iyo 2003-dii". Sawirka, Hoggaamiyayaasha galbeedka ayaa muddo dheer ka hadlayay in loo baahan yahay in Iran laga joojiyo in ay haysato hub nukliyeer ah. Bishii May 2025, Trump wuxuu ka digay in "haddii Iran hesho hub Nukliyeer, ay dunida burburin doonto." Raysalwasaaraha Britain, Sir Keir Starmer, ayaa ku tilmaamay in hadii Iran ay nukliyeer yeelato ay tahay, "khatarta ugu weyn ee xasiloonida gobolka". Falanqeeyayaashu waxay aaminsan yihiin hadii ay Iran hesho hub Nukliyeer ay ku dhiirran karto dagaal.

Markabkaan lagu magacaabo Oruc Reis, ayaa dhismihiisa daaha laga furay sanadkii 2017, waxaa lagu naqshadeeyay oo lagu dhisay dalka Turkiga, ujeedka loo sameeyay ayaana ahaa sahminta juquraafiga badaha iyo naqshada oo loo yaqaan ‘oceanographic’ kaas oo muhiim u ah dadaallada sahminta badda ee Türkiye. Oruç Reis ayuu dhererkiisu yahay 87-mitir oo dherer ah una dhiganta 285-fiit , halka ballaciisu yahay 23-mitir oo u dhiganta 75-fiit, waxa uuna kor u dhisanyahay 34-mitir oo u dhiganta 111-fiit. Sidoo kale waxa uu leeyahay afar matoor oo nafto ah kuwaas oo kiiloowaatkoodu yahay 2,520-KW, waxa uuna awood u leeyahay sahminta seismic ee 2-D iyo 3-D, oo lagu sameeyo saliidaha iyo gaaska badda hoostiisa ku jira. Markabkaan ayaa awood u leh ku jirista badda muddo dheer, qaadista qalabka loogu talagalay sahminta laga sameynayo gudaha biyaha, waxaa kale oo uu leeyahay qeyb barxad ah oo ay ku soo dagi karaan diyaaradaha la shaqeynaya inta uu howlaha sahminta ku jiro. Markabkaan ayaa horay howlo sahmin ah loogu diray badda Mediterranean-ka, isaga oo ka dhaqaaqay dekedda lagu magacaabo Antalya oo ku taala koonfurta dalka Turkiga, isagoo ku sii jeeday bariga Mediterranean-ka. Safarkaas sahminta ah waxaa ku wehlinayay laba markab oo kale oo lagu kala magacaabo Ataman iyo Cengiz Han. Ujeedkii xilligaas loo diray ayaa ahayd sahan juquraafi, iyo raadinta khayraad dabiici ah. Xilligii uu howlgalka billaabay markabkaan wixii ka danbeeyay Turkiga ayaa dirayay maraakiibta qodista shidaalka si ay u sahamiyaan kheyraadka tamarta ee bariga Mediterranean-ka, iyagoona howlgallo kale ka sameeyay waqooyiga Qubrus. Wixii xilligaas ka danbeeyay waxaa soo baxayay dalal daris la ah Turkiga oo uu kamid yahay Giriiga, kuwaas oo diidanaa howlgallanaad iyadoona dowladda Turkiga ay ku tilmaamtay mid xadgudub ku ah danaha dalkooda oo ah midka ugu xeebta dheer Mediterranean-ka. Horraantii sanadkaan dowladaha Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya ayaa kala saxiixday heshiisyo is-afgarad ah oo shatti u ogolaanaya in saddax aag oo xeebaha Soomaaliya lagu sameeyo baaritaan la siiyay shirkadda Turkish Petroleum, oo ah shirkadda shidaalka qaranka ee Turkiga. Aagaggaan shatiga loo heysto ayaana laga sameyn doonaa sahanno, cabbirka goobahaan ayaana lagu sheegay qiyaastii 5,000-kiilomitir laba jibbaaran iyo 1,930 mayl laba jibbaaran. Shalay oo sabti ahayd ayuuna madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdogan, oo ay wehlinayaan masuuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Turkiga iyo wasiirka batroolka iyo macdanta Soomaaliya ay ka qeyb galeen munaasabad lagu sagootinayay markabka Oruç Reis, oo Soomaaliya ku soo wajjahan. Madaxweynaha Turkiga oo ka hadlayay bixitaanka markabkaan ayaa qoraal uu ku daabacay bartiisa X, waxa uu ku yiri: “"Oruç Reis, oo adeegyo muhiim u ah dalkeena ka qabtay tan iyo 2017, hadda waxa uu Soomaaliya ka samayn doonaa hawlo seismic ah oo dhan saddex goobood oo shati leh," Edogan ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Soomaaliya oo muddo dheer ku jirtay colaado iyo xassilooni darro “in hadda kadib ay noqon doonto mid ku tillaabsata hormar dhaqaale, barwaaqo iyo nabad,” waxa uu intaa ku daray in ay war wanaagsan ka filayaan howlaha cilmi baarista seismic, oo ay ka bilaabayaan xeebaha Soomaaliya. Markabka sahminta ayaana ka soo dhaqaaqay dekedda Filyos ee Zonguldak, oo ku taala waqooyi-galbeed Turkiga. Oruç Reis oo uu marinkiisu yahay badda Mediterranean-ka, waxa uu u soo gudbi doonaa kanaalka Suweys, kadibna waxa uu ku soo dhacayaa Badda Cas si uu ugu soo xirto meel u dhaw biyaha Soomaaliya. Waxaa la filayaa in safarka uu qaato ku dhawaad labaatan maalmood uuna dhammaadka bishaan soo gaaro xeebaha Soomaaliya.

Waa ay adag tahay in aan soo iibsado alaab qaali ah oo aan raqiis gedi karin," ayuu yiri Fu'aad Cumar oo ka mid ah ganacsatada Mombasa. Timirtu waa cunto muhiim u ah bulshada Muslimiinta ah ee ku nool daafaha caalamka. Timirta la isticmaalo sanadka oo dhan waxay ka ciyaartaa kaalin mug leh inta lagu jiro Ramadaanka taasoo dadka siinaysa tamar aad loogu baahan yahay soonka. Khalkhal galinta Badda Cas waxay sababtay in ganacsatada ay soo sheegaan daahitaan joogto ah iyo kharashyo badan oo alaabtooda la xiriira laakiin kharashyadkan dheeraadka ah ayaa hadda garaaya dukaamaystayaasha caadiga. Baasaboorka Soomaaliga oo gaaray meeshii ugu sarraysay sannadkan dhamaanaya ee 2025. Meeqa dal ayaa lagu tagi kara fiise la'aan Baasaboorka Soomaaliga ayaa u muuqda mid si isa taraysa u soo ceshanaya maqaamkii uu ku lahaa masraxa caalamka, taasoo astaan u ah xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee sii kordhaya iyo dib u soo kabashada dalka, ka dib tobanaan sano oo ah go'doon, amni darro iyo masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah. Tan iyo markii uu qarxay dagaalkii sokeeye 1991-kii, Baasaboorka Soomaaliga waxaa lagu sameeyay isbedello is-bedel ah oo ay ka mid tahay in la sameeyo nooc casri ah oo muddo shan sano ah soconaya. Isbeddelladani waxay muujinayaan dadaallada ballaaran ee dalku uu ugu jiro dib-u-dhiska hay'adaha iyo xoojinta meeqaamkiisa caalamiga ah. Sida aan ka soo xigannay warbaahinta Turkiga ee TRT, Sannadkii 2016-kii, Baasaboorka Soomaaliya ayaa kaalinta 101-aad ka galay qiimeynta Henley Passport Index, oo ah shirkad hormuud ka ah shirkadaha la-talinta iyo cilmi baarista dhanka la talinta dakhliga ee adduunka. Fadlan halkan riix oo ku soo biir janalka WhatsApp ee BBC Somali si aad u hesho wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee caalamka, iyo kuwa gobolka Wakhti xaadirkan, kaalinta baasaboorka Soomaaliga waxa ay kor u kacday sideed kaalimood, wuxuuna baasaboorka Soomaaligu ku jiraa kaalinta 95-aad, marka loo eego qiimeyntii ugu dambeysay ee la soo saaray bishii Luulyo 2025. Soomaalidu waxay hadda u safri karaan in ka badan 30 waddan iyagoon haysan fiisahe baasaboorka u saaran. Tilmaan-bixintan oo ay ku shaqaynayso xogta Hay'adda Caalamiga ah ee Gaadiidka Cirka (IATA) iyo cilmi baarisyo labaatan sannadood qaatay, ayaa lagu qiimeeyey 199 baasaboor oo lagu tago 227 dal, iyada oo lagu qiimeeyey tirada dalalka ay dadka haystaa ku tagi karaan ayadoo aan fiise la sii qaadan. Horumarkan ayaa Soomaaliya ku daraya tiro dowlado ah oo horumariyay dhaqdhaqaaqooda caalamiga ah tobankii sano ee la soo dhaafay, iyadoo in ka badan 80 baasaboor oo adduunka ah ay kor u kaceen ugu yaraan toban darajo. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Isbeddelka caalamiga ahi sidoo kale waa cad yahay: 2006, dadka safarka ah waxay aadi karaan celcelis ahaan 58 goob fiise la'aan; sanadka 2025, tiradaasi waxay ku dhowaatay labanlaab ayadoo gaartay ilaa 109. Dr. Christian H. Kaelin, oo ah abuuraha Henley Passport Index, waxa uu xusay in natiijadu ay ka tarjumayso tartan caalami ah oo dublamaasiyadu udub dhexaad u tahay. "Isku duubnaanta aan ku aragno meesha ugu sarreysa waxay hoosta ka xariiqaysaa in helitaankaas la kasbado - oo ay tahay in la ilaaliyo - iyada oo loo marayo diblomaasiyad firfircoon oo istaraatiijiyad ku salaysan," ayuu yiri. "Wadamada sida firfircoon uga wada xaajooda dhaafitaanka fiisaha oo dhiirri galiya heshiisyada fiisa la'aanta ee muwaadiniintooda ah waxay sii wadaan inay kor u kacaan". Guulaha Soomaaliya ee dhawaanahan waxaa loo aaneynayaa wax loogu yeeray "maalgashiga dowladda ee caasimadda diblumaasiyadeed", taasoo xaqiijinaysa sida ay TRT tiri sugidda heshiisyada fududeynta fiisaha laba geesoodka ah iyo soo gabagabeynta qabanqaabada ka-dhaafitaanka fiisaha ee dadka haysta baasaboorka diblomaasiga iyo midka adeegga. Tallaabooyinkani waa kuwo ka badan astaan rasmi ah: waxay calaamad u yihiin tallaabo la taaban karo oo loo qaaday xiriir dhow oo lala yeesho bulshada caalamka. Muwaaddiniinta Soomaaliyeed, isbeddelladii ugu dambeeyay waxay billaabeen inay u noqdaan faa'iidooyin wax ku ool ah. Nidaamka fiisaha cusub waxay si fudud u heli karaan adeegyada sida daawaynta, waxbarashada, fursadaha ganacsiga, iyo isdhaafsiga dhaqameed ee dibadda loo aado. Xeeldheerayaasha ayaa xusay in Baasaboorka Soomaaliga ee soo xoogaysanaya uu ka tarjumayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee kordhay iyo dadaallada ballaaran ee ay dowladdu ku doonayso inay ku xoojiso xiriirka caalamiga ah, taasoo muujineysa in si tartiib-tartiib ah dib loogu soo celinayo bulshada caalamka.

Xavier Crettiez oo bare jaamacadeed ah waxa uu ogaaday inuusan aqoonin inta badan magacyada rasimga ah ee ardayda uu wax u dhigo. Tani waa xaalad aan inta badan caadi ahayn marka loo eego goobaha waxbarashada, balse shaqada Prof. Crettiez aad bay uga fog tahay mid caadi ah, waxa uuna basaasiinta Faransiiska ah ka caawiyaa tababarka. "Marar dhif ah ayaan ogaadaa, xarunta laga soo diray qofkaan sirdoonka ah, marka loo eego koorsada, waxaana shaki ka qabaa magacyada la ii sheego in ay yihiin kuwa saxda ah", ayuu yiri macallinka. Haddii la rabo in la aas-aaso iskuul ay basaasiintu wax ku bartaan halka ugu haboon waa xarunta jaamacadda Sciences Po Saint-Germain ee duleedka Paris waxay u muuqataa mid si weyn ugu habboon. Iyadoo leh dhismayaal qarnigii 20-aad ee bilowgiisii la dhisay oo muuqaal aan cajiib ahayn leh, xitaa u eg kuwo mugdi ah, ayna ku hareeraysan yihiin waddooyin mashquul badan oo caajis ah iyo albaabbo bir ah oo waaweyn oo cabsi gelinaya, goobtu waxay leedahay dareen aad u qarsoon. Meeshu waxa ay jaamacadaha kale uga soocan tahay shahaadadooda iyo in ay isku keento arday kala duwan oo badankoodu ku jira da'dooda 20-meeyada iyo xubno firfircoon oo ka tirsan sirdoonka qarsoon ee Faransiiska, kuwaas oo inta badan da'doodu u dhaxayso 35 ilaa 50 sano. Koorsadan waxaa la yiraahdaa Diplôme sur le Renseignement et les Menaces Globales taas oo noqon karta"Shahaadada Sirdoonka iyo Hanjabaadaha Caalamiga ah. Waxa ay jaamacaddu diyaarintayda iska kaashadeeem Académie du Renseignement, oo ah la'anta tababarka ee arrimaha sirdoonka Faransiiska. Tani waxay timid kadib codsi ay mas'uuliyiinta Faransiisku sameeyeen toban sano ka hor. Kadib weerarradii argagixiso ee 2015 ka dhacay Paris, dawladda Faransiisku waxay billowday olole ballaaran oo shaqaaleysiin ah oo laga dhex sameeyey hay'adaha sirdoonka. Waxay ka codsatay Sciences Po, oo ka mid ah jaamacadaha ugu sarreeya Faransiiska, in ay dejiso koorso cusub oo labadaba lagu tababaro basaasiin cusub oo oo macquul ah, isla markaana la siiyo tababar joogto ah wakiillada hadda shaqeeya. Shirkado waaweyn oo Faransiis ah ayaa iyaguna si degdeg ah u muujiyay xiisaha ay u qabaan, iyagoo doonayay in shaqaalahooda amniga lagu daro koorsada, isla markaana ay shaqaalaysiiyaan qaar badan oo ka mid ah ardayda da'da yar ee ka qalin-jabisa Koorsada ayaa loo qorsheeyey 120 saacadood oo cashir la qaadanayo, cashiraduna waxa ay soconayaan in ka badan afar bilood. Arday ka baxsan kuwa dowladda ee sirdoonka ka socda ama xarumaha ka yimid waxaa laga qaadaya lacag gaareysa €5,000 ($5,900; £4,400). Ujeeddada ugu weyn ee koorsadu waa in la aqoonsado khataraha meel kasta oo ay ka jiraan, iyo sida loo daba galo loona wajaho loogana adkaado. Mawduucyada muhiimka ah waxaa ka mid ah dhaqaalaha, dambiyada abaabulan, kooxaha argagixisada ah, iyo rabshadaha siyaasadaha. Si aan uga qayb-galo mid ka mid ah fasallada oo aan ula hadlo ardayda, waxa la ii mariyey hubin iyo baaritaan ay sameeyeen laamaha amniga Faransiiska. Mawduuca casharkii aan ka qayb galay waxa uu ahaa "sirdoonka iyo ku-tiirsanaanta xad-dhaafka ah ee tignoolajiyada". Mid ka mid ah ardayda aan la hadlay oo da' ahaan 40-tameeyada ku jira, waxa uu magaciisa iigu sheegay Roger. Waxa uu igula hadlayey af Ingiriisi aad u kooban oo sax ah, waxa uuna ii sheegay inuu yahay nin ka sahqeeya maalgelinta bangiyada Waxa uuna intaa ku daray: "Waxaan la taliye ahaan uga shaqeeyey galbeedka Afrika, waxa aan koorsadaan ugu soo biiray inaan macaamiishayda halkaas u sameeyn karo qiimeynta khataraha." Prof. Crettiez, oo dhiga maaddada culuumta siyaasadda, ayaa sheegay in laamaha sirdoonka Faransiiska aad loo ballaariyey sanadihii u dambeeyay. waxa uuna intaas ku daray in hadda ay jiraan qiyaastii 20,000 oo sargaal oo ka tirsan waxa uu ugu yeeray " sirdoonka gudaha". Kuwaas waxaa ka mid ah DGSE, oo ka shaqaysa arrimaha dibadda, kana ah Faransiiska waxa MI6 u yahay UK ama CIA-da Maraykanka. Sidoo kale waxaa jira DGSI, oo diiradda saarta khataraha gudaha Faransiiska, kana dhiganta MI5 ee UK ama FBI-da Maraykanka. Laakiin, sida uu sheegay, arrintu kaliya ma aha argagixiso. "Waxaa jira labada hay'adood oo waaweyn oo ka shaqo leh aminga, balse sidoo kale waxaa jira Tracfin, oo ah hay'adda sirdoon oo si gaar ah ugu shaqo leh la dagaallanka lacag-dhaqidda. "Waxay si gaar ah uga walaacsan tahay kororka dhaqdhaqaaqyada maafiyada, gaar ahaan koonfurta Faransiiska, iyo sidoo kale, musuqmaasuqa ka jira qaybaha dawladda iyo kuwa gaarka loo leeyahay, taas oo inta badan ka dhalata faa'iidooyinka waaweyn ee ka yimaadda ka ganacsiga daroogada sharci-darrada ah." Macallimiinta kale ee koorsada waxaa ka mid ah sarkaal ka tirsan DGSE oo hore uga soo shaqeeyay Moscow, safiir hore oo Faransiis u fadhiyay Liibiya, iyo mas'uul sare oo ka tirsan Tracfin. Sidoo kale madaxa amniga ee shirkadda tamarta Faransiiska ee EDF,waxa uu bixiyaa mid ka mid ah cutubyada koorsada. Waxaa sii kodheysa xiisaha iyo sida ay u daneenayaan shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay. Shirkado waaweyn, gaar ahaan kuwa ka shaqeeya aminga iyo hawada sare, balse sidoo kale shirkadaha Faransiiska ee ka shaqeeya alaabaha xafiisyada, ayaa si isa soo taraysa u doonaya inay shaqaalaysiiyaan ardaydan, maaddaama ay wajahayaan hanjabaado joogto ah oo la xiriira amniga internetka, basaasnimo iyo weeraro dhanka online-ka ah. Qalin-jabiyeyaashii ugu dambeeyay waxaa si degdeg ah u shaqaalaysiiyay shirkadda isgaarsiinta ee Faransiiska Orange, shirkadda weyn ee hawada sare iyo difaaca ee Thales, iyo LVMH, oo leh magacyo caan ah sida Louis Vuitton, Dior, iyo shirkadaha khamriga shampaynka ee Dom Perignon iyo Krug. Iyagoo aan sheegin meesha ay ka socdaan iyo waxa ay qabtaan, gacmahooduna isku laaban yihiin, midkood ayaa yiri in koorsadan waxaa loo arkaa waddo degdeg ah oo qofka uga gudbi karo shaqada xafiiska una wareego hawlaha goobta. Tanina waa arrin soo kordhay waayadii dambe, sida uu sheegay mid ka mid ah macallimiinta, Sebastien-Yves Laurent, oo ku takhasusay doorka tignoolajiyada ee basaasnimada. "Xiisaha haweenka ee kusoo biiritaanka sirdoonka waa arrin cusub," ayuu yiri. "Waa ay danaynayaan sababtoo ah waxay aaminsan yihiin in ay ka qayb ka noqon karaan dhisidda adduun ka wanaagsan. "Haddii ay jirto hal qodob oo ay wadaagaan dhammaan ardaydan da'da yar, waa in ay yihiin kuwa aad u jecel dalkooda, taasina waa wax cusub marka loo eego 20 sano ka hor." Haddii aad xiisaynayso inaad codsato ka mid noqoshada koorsadan, dhalashada Faransiiska waa shuruud lama huraan ah, inkastoo muwaadiniin sita laba dhalasho la aqbalo mararka qaar. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Prof. Crettiez waxa uu sheegay inuu khasab ku tahay inuu aad u feejignaado. "Si joogto ah ayaan u helnaa codsiyo ka imanaya haween aad u qurxoon oo u dhashay Israa'iil iyo Ruush, kuwaas oo leh CV-yo cajiib ah. Sida la filan karo, isla markiiba waa laga reebaa," ayuu yiri. Sawir kooxeed dhawaan laga qaaday fasalka, si degdeg ah ayaa loo garan karaa cidda basaas/sirdoon ah iyagu waa ay ka jeestaan kamaradda. Inkasta oo dhammaan ardayda iyo sirdoonka xirfadlayaasha ah ee aan la kulmay ay ahaayeen kuwo jirdhiskoodu fiican yahay oo firfircoon. "Qaar yar oo ka mid ah dadka cusub ee la qoro ayaa ku dambayn doona shaqooyinka bannaanka laga soo qabto," ayuu yiri. "Inta badan shaqooyinka hay'adaha sirdoonka Faransiiska waa kuwo xafiisyada ku kooban."
