Tababarka orodka dheer ee Maradoonka aad ayuu u adag yahay. Adigoo sooman in aad u diyaargarowdo tartanka ciyaartoyda ugu fiican adduunka ee masaafadiisu tahay 26.2 mayl waa wax aad u adag. Mahamed Mahamed waxa uu ka mid yahay jiilka oradyahanada Britain ee masaafada dheer orda, kuwaas oo ku sii dhawaanaya rikoodhkii uu dhigay Mohamed Farah ee oradka maradoonka. Oradyahanka 28 jirka ah ee isu diyaarinaya orodka maradoonka ee London sanadkan ayaa hadana sooman. Wuxuu tababarka dhameeyaa xilli dambe, wuxuuna isku wadaa soonka iyo orodka. Mahamed, oo kaalinta afraad kaga jira liiska orodyahannada ugu fiican UK ayaa iska indhatiray talooyin loo soo jeediyay oo ah in uu dib u dhigo soonkiisa inta uu tababarka ku jiro si uu u jabiyo rikoorka labada saacadood, toddoba daqiiqo iyo shan ilbiriqsi ah. "Dadka qaar waxay u maleeyaan in aanan soomin marka aan tababarka ku jiro," ayuu Mahamed ku yiri wakaaladda wararka ee PA. "Gaar ahaan hadda, waxaan galayaa tartan, waxay u haystaan in aan diiradda saarayo tababarka oo mar dambe aan dib ka soomayo. "Laakiin waan la qabsaday. Waxay noqotay jadwalkayga caadiga ah. Waan uga mahadcelinayaa taladaas, balse anigu waxaan sii wadaa dhammaan soonka iyo orodaka." Mahamed waxa uu deggen yahay magaalada Ifrane ee Buuraha Atlas ee Morocco, wuxuuna isu diyaarinaya tartanka dhacaya bisha soo socota ee Abriil. Goobta uu joogo waxay u ogolaaneysaa in uu si badqab ah ugu tababarto iftiinka garoonka habeenkii, isaga oo la jira Muslimiin kale oo sooman bisha barakeysan ee Ramadaan. Maadama aan maalintii biyo la cabeyb, cunto la cuneyn waxay tababarka ka dhigeen habeenkii. Maalmaha qaar, jadwalkiisa tababarka wuxuu gaaraa saacadaha hore ee subaxda. Waxa uu bilaabaa kulankiisa koowaad qiyaastii 4-ta galabnimo, kaddibna wuu afuraa oo masaajidka tagaa ka hor inta uusan dhammayn kulankiisa labaad. Markuu si ku filan u cunteeyo, Mahamed wuxuu seexdaa hal ama laba saacadood, kaddibna wuu soo toosaa qiyaastii 4-ta subaxnimo si uu mar kale wax u cuno, ka hor inta uusan sariirta ku noqon si uu markaas kaddib hurdo ugu sii darsado. Mahamed waxa uu sheegay in wax yar ay adag tahay. "Shaqadayda si sax ah ayaan u sameeyaa, laakiin Ramadaanka waa kan ugu muhiimsan. Waxa uu iga caawiyaa in aan diiradda saaro. Waxa uu iga dhigayaa in aan fahmo cidda aan ahay iyo waxa aan samayn karo." Mahamed waxa uu ka mid yahay afar orodyahan oo Britan u dhashay oo wali firfircoon kuwaas oo ka qeybgala orodka dheer ee maradoonka. Mahamed waxa uu ku orday wax ka yar 2 saac iyo 8 daqiiqo, isaga oo ay weheliyaan Alex Yee, Emile Cairess iyo Philip Sesemann, waxaana lagu tilmaamay "jiil cusub". Kaddib markii uu kaalinta afraad ka galay Marathon-kii London ee la qabtay sanadkii 2024-kii, Mahamed waxa uu doonayay in uu dhigo rikoodh cusub maradoonka London ah ka hor inta uusan u tartamin billad Tartanka Qaaradda Yurub ee ka dhacaya magaalada Birmingham. Sida Mo Farah, sheekada Mahamed waxay wax badan u dhow tahay tan Mo Farah. Ka hor inta isaga iyo qoyskiisa aysan u soo guurin UK sanadkii 2011-kii, waxa uu ku noolaa Itoobiya. "Waxaan daawan jiray Mo iyo Jess Ennis anigoo ka fakaraya in sidoo kale aan sameeyo" ayuu yiri Mahamed. Wuxuu kaloo uu sheegay in markasta uu la kumo Mo Farah ay taladiisu aheyd "Dhageyso tababarayaasha, diiraddana saar waxa aad qabaneyso".

Awoodda militariga Turkiga: Taangiga casriga ah ee Altay ayaa la tijaabinayaa bisha April Dowladda Turkiga ayaa sheegtay in ay bisha April tijaabo ku billaabi doonto taangiga lagu magacaabay Altay ee ah kuwa ugu casrisan ee adduunka lagu isticmaalo, kaasoo muddo sannado badan ay ay ku howlaneyd soo saaristiisa. Ismaaciil Demir, oo ah madaxa warshadaha qalabka milatariga sameeya ee dalka Turkiga ayaa khudbad telefihsinka laga sii daayay Axaddii ku sheegay in ugu dambeyn lagu guuleystay farsameynta taangiga Altay, dhawaanna la tijaabin doono. Culeyska ugu weyn wuxuu Turkiga ka heystay sidii loo heli lahaa Matoorka awoodda badan ee uu ku shaqeeyo taangigaas, horayna waxay isugu fahmi waayeen Jarmalka oo Turkiga saaray Cunaqabateyn dhinaca hubka ah. Waxaa soo baxay warar sheegaya in hadda uu Turkiga matoorkaas ka iibsaday waddanka Kuuriyada Koonfureed, sidaasna ay ugu suuragashay inuu sameysto taangigan ugu muhiimsan ee loo adeegsado goobaha dagaalka. Wargeyska Defence News, oo soo xiganaya sarkaal Turki ah oo uusan magaciisa shaacinin, ayaa sheegay in shirkad fadhigeedu yahay Kuuriyada Koonfureed ay heshiis la gashay Ankara, taasoo hirgalisay guusha laga gaaray sameynta taangigaas. Turkiga ayaa markii hore mashruucan billaabay 2005 ilaa 2007 oo heerar kala duwan lasoo mariyay, laakiin dib u dhac badan ayaa yimid kaddib markii ay Jarmalka iyo Ankara isku fahmi waayeen isku day la doonayay in lagu helo matoorka uu ku shaqeeyo taangiga. Dowladda Jarmalka ayaa diidmadeeda u cuskatay cunaqabateyn dhanka hubka ah oo ay horay u saartay Turkiga. Turkiga ayaa hadda ku biiray dalalka faro ku tiriska ah ee heysta Taangiyada ugu awoodda badan ee ka qeyb gala dagaalka Dhulka, iyadoo taasi ay u sii dheer tahay inuu maamulan karo hannaanka taangiyada ay ku shaqeeyaan, maadaama ay yihiin kuwo lagu farsameeyay gudaha dalkiisa. Sannadihii lasoo dhaafay Ankara waxay xoogga saareysay inay ballaariso awooddeeda militari, waxaana uu Turkigu saameyn ku yeeshay dhaqdhaqaaqyo militari oo dibadda ah. Horaantii sanadkan 2021-ka, Mareykanka ayaa cunaqabateyn kusoo rogay Turkiga oo ay ka wada tirsan yihiin isbahaysiga NATO, kaddib markii Turkiga uu gacanta ku dhigay gantaallada difaaca ee uu Ruushka sameeyo, kuwaasoo uu ka dalbaday sanadkii lasoo dhaafay. Mareykanku wuxuu sheegay in qalabkaas gantaalaha ee S-400 ee Ruushka lagu farsameeyay uu yahay mid aan la jaan qaadi karin tiknolojiyadda NATO, sidoo kalana uu khatar ku yahay isbahaysiga Euro-Atlantic. Cunaqabateynta ay ku dhawaaqday waaxda arimaha dibada, bishii January, ee ka dhanka ah Turkiga, waa mid lagu bartilmaameedsaday waaxda soo iibinta hubka ee dalkaas. Cunaqabateyntan ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday Madaxa Agaasinka laamaha Difaaca ee Turkiga, Ismaaciil Demir iyo seddex kale oo shaqaale ah. Waxaa ka mid ah mamnuucida oggolaanshaha dal-ku-galka Mareykanka iyo sidoo kale in la xannibo wixii hanti ah ee u yaalla goobaha uu Mareykanka awoodda u leeyahay. Tallaabadaas waxaa si degdeg ah u cambaareeyay mas'uuliyiinta Turkiga iyo Ruushka. Mareykanku wuxuu mar hore Turkiga ka saaray barnaamijkiisii ​​diyaaradeed ee F-35. Taasina waxay ahayd tallaabo uu jawaab uga dhigay in Turkiga uu soo iibsaday gantallo kale.

Quruxleydii guurka ka diidday Nelson Mandela Nelson Mandela ayaa mar ku kaftamay, "khalad kuma lihi haddii ay haweenku i eegaan oo ay iga helaan. Runtii, waxba kama soo qaadi doono." Nelson Mandela, oo saddex jeer guursaday, ayaa isagoo da’a ah xitaa soo jiidan jiray haween ku nool daafaha dunida. Balse waxaa jirta haweeney diidday codsigii guur ee Mandela. Magaca haweeneydan oo Hindiya kasoo jeedda waa Amina Kachalia. Amina ayaa door muhiim ah ku lahayd dhaqdhaqaaqii caddaan-diidka ee Koofur Afrika. Markii ay 21 jir ahayd, Nelson Mandela ayaa kasoo qeyb galay xafladda dhalashadeeda Amina ayaa iyadana sidoo kale aadday Xabsiga Pollsmoor si ay ula kulanto. Amina waxaa guursaday Yusuf Kachalia oo geeriyooday sanadkii 1995. Xilligaas, waxaa billowday hannaanka uu Nelson isaga furayay xaaskiisii labaad Winnie. , GHALEB CACHALIA/FACEBOOK Wiilka Amina, Ghaleb Kachalia, ayaa yiri, "Waan ogeyn in Mandela iyo waaliddiinteydu ay saaxiibbo isku fiican ahaayeen. Wuxuu aalaaba imaan jiray gurigeenna. Xilli ka mid ah 90-meeyadii hooyadey ayaa aniga iyo walaashey Koko gees noola baxday waxayna inoo sheegtay in Mandela uu usoo jeediyay inuu guursado, iyaduna ay diiddan tahay." Xilligaas Nelson Mandela wuxuu ahaa 80 jir halka Amina ay 68 jir ahayd. Ghaleb oo la weydiiyay sababta ay hooyadiis u diidday guurka ninkan caanka ahaa, ayaa wuxuu ku jawaabay, "Hooyadey aad ayay ugu dhoweyd Nelson. Balse xitaa diyaar uma ahayn inay illowdo xusuusihii aabbahay. Aabbahay wuxuu iyada ka weynaa 15 sano. Laga yaabee kaddib geeridiisa ma aysan rabin nin markaasna uu ninkan weyn kusoo biiray nolosheeda." Sawirka, GHALEB CACHALIA/FACEBOOK Sawirka, GHALEB CACHALIA/FACEBOOK Weriyaha caanka ah Saeed Naqvi ayaa sheegay inuu fursad u helay inuu la kulmo Amina markii ugu horreysay markaasoo Nelson Mandela laga soo daayay xabsiga. Xilligaas seyga Amina ee Yusuf wuu noolaa. Markii uu u tagay inuu Nelson Mandela kula kulmo guriga Desmond Thutu kaddib markii xabsiga laga soo daayay, wuxuu arkay Amina uu dhinac fadhisa Mandela. Naqvi wuxu yiri, "Markaan eegay Amina, waxaan dareemay inay ahayd qof ilaa xad qurux badan, soo jiidasho leh oo kaftan badan. Waxay lahayd wax walba oo lagu arko qof geesi ah. Waxay kasoo shaqeysay Kongareeska Qaranka ee Afrika. Waxay saaxiib la ahayd Mandela heerka caqligeedana wuxuu la mid ahaa kan Mandela." Amina iyo Nelson Mandela ayaa dhowr jeer kulamo ku lahaa iyadoo uu goobjoog ahaa Saeed Naqvi, balse markii uu tegay Koofur Afrika sanadkii 1995, Yusuf wuu geeriyooday. Waxaan is arki doonnaa fiidka. Amina ayaa sheegtay inaysan is arki Karin fiidka, sababtuna ay tahay inay halkaa joogeyso muddo badan. Waxaan arrintan ka gartay sida ay labada qof isugu dhow yihiin. Dhacdadaan kaddib dhowr jeer oo kale ayuu sidan oo kale la kulmay markii Naqvi uu u tagay Amina si uu ula kulmo, wuxuu ogaaday inuu ku sugnaa guriga Mandela. Markii uu halkaas aaday, wuxuu ogaaday inuu meel kale aaday. Saeed Naqvi wuxuu sheegay inuu markii dambe ogaaday damaca Nelson ee ah inuu guursado Amina. Amina Kachalia ayaa markii dambe wareysi lala yeeshay ku sheegtay in xusuusihii ugu macaanaa ee Mandela ay qalbiga ku heysato isla markaana mar isagoo madaxweyne ah uu gurigooda yimid. Amina ayaa wareysiga ku tiri, "Wuxuu ku fadhiyay gambar gadaasheyda yaallay jikada dhexdeeda markii aan isaga u dubayay sambuus." Amina ayaa taariikhdeeda ku xustay in 'Mar kaddib guurkiisii saddexaad ee Grace Mitchell, uu Mandela tagay gurigooda ku yaallay Johannesburg uuna jaceylkiisa u bandhigtay. Waan diiday ayay tiri maaddaama aad hadda uun guursatay. Anigu xor baan ahay balse adiugu ma tihid. Mandela ayaa arrintan ka murugooday wuuna diiday inuu cunto iga cuno wuuna baxay. Sawirka, GHALEB CACHALIA Amina ayaa taariikhdeeda waxaa kale oo ay ku tiri, "Mandela jaceyl ma aqoon. Laga yaabee inuu dareenkan lumiyay markii uu xabsiga ku jiray. Wax jawaab ku habboon kama siin karin codsigiisa shukaansiga. Waan ka helay, laakiin ugama helin sida ninkeygii dhintay xitaa markii uu da’ ahaa." Saeed Naqvi ayaa sheegay in marka laga soo ago waxa ay Amina tiri iyo waxa uu wiilkeeda Ghalib u sheegay, inuu aaminsan yahay in hoggaamiyeyaasha sare ee Kongareeska Qaranka Afrika aysan rabin in Mandela iyo Amina ay xiriir dhow yeeshaan. Naqvi ayaa yiri, “U qaado in Nelson Mandela, oo ahaa geesigii caddaan nacaybka ee Koofur Afrika, uu sidoo kale ahaa geesiga xornimada Afrika. Farriin khaldan ayay aamini lahaayeen bulshada Afrika. Si kastaba, Mandela wax sidaas ah kuma heyn qalbiga iyo niyadda. Sawirka, Naqvi ayaa yiri, "Waxaa la is dhahayay in Mandela uu kuf iicnaa inuu guursado Grace Machel, xaaskii uu ka geeriyooday madaxweynihii Mozambique, intii uu guursan lahaa haweeney asal ahaan kasoo jeedda Hindiya, markii dambena jihadaas ayuu qaaday. Arrimahan weligood lama xaqiijin. Cidda haa tiri ama maya tiri. Balse wax baa ka dhexeeyay. Markii aan si dhow ula socday, waxaan dhihi karaa dabku labada dhinac isku si buu uga shidnaa!"

Sheekada Haboon oo ka bogsootay cudurka Kansarka iyo wixii ay soo martay Haboon Maxamed Axmed waxa ay sanadkii 2020 bishii September ogaatay in uu ku dhacay kansarka naasaha kaas oo aysan jirin cid qoyskeeda kamid ah oo uu horay ugu dhacay. Haboon xilliga uu kansarku ku dhacayay waxa ay shan bilood ka hor naas nuujinta ka joojisay gabadheedii ilmaha ugu yareyd. Waxa ay had iyo jeer ahayd dadka sameeya baaritaannada haddii ay ahaan lahayd booqashada dhakhaatiirta iyo haddii ay ahaan lahayd in iyada qudheedu ay nafteeda si gaar ah ula socoto iyada oo markaa ku nooleyd magaalada London ee UK. “Markii aan naaska ka jaray gabadheyda yar naaska bidix wuu guray oo caano ma keenin hase yeeshee naaska midig markasta caano ayaa ka iman jiray taas ayaa shaki weyn igu abuurtay aniga oo caanihii ka shakisan ayaan haddana isku arkay kuus ama buro yar” ayey tiri Haboon xilli ay wareysi siisay BBC labo sano ka hor. Dr Caasha Cumar Kablow oo ah dhakhtarad ku takhasustay cudurrada ku dhaca haweenka kana tirsan isbitaalka hooyada iyo dhallaanka ayaa sharraxday dadka u nugul kansarka naaska. “Kasarka naasku waxa uu ku dhacaa haweenka da’doodu weyn tahay, yacni kuwa 50-ka sano ka weyn, kuwa isticmaala dawooyinka hormooniska sida kuwa ilmaha looga hortago, haweenka buur-buuran ee miiskaanka badani saaran yahay iyo dadka uu ugu yimaado dhaxalka ama qoyskooda dad ka mid a uu ku dhacay”. Haboon markii la baaray ayaa ugu dambeyn la ogaaday in laga helay kansarka naaska heerkiisa labaad waxana ay sheegtay in ay soo wajahday cabsi badan maadaama ay ahayd hooyo ilmo korsaneysa, iyada oo sidoo kale loo sheegay in waqti waliba uu kansarkeedu gaari karo heerka afaraad. Haboon waxaa loo sheegay in ay qaadaneyso dawada kansarka iyada oo loo sheegay in siddeed jeer ay qaadan doonto daawadan oo saddexdii toddobaadba qofka mar la siiyo maadama ay tahay dawo aad u kulul oo bukaanka ka tan badin karta. Hase yeeshee markii Haboon ay shar jeer qaadatay dawada ayaa loo sheegay war farxad leh oo ah in gebi ahaanba kansarka laga waayay jirkeeda. , Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Labo sano kadib Haboon ayaa soo booqatay xarunta BBC-da iyada oo aan kala sheekeysannay xaaladdeeda caafimaad iyo halka ay wax u marayaan. “Farqi weyn ayaa u dhexeeya xaaladdeydi labo sano kahor markii aan BBC-da wareysi siinayay iyo maanta oo labo sano kadib ah, xilligaas weli la dagaallan ayaan ku jiray balse maanta alxamdulillah si rasmi ah ayaan uga bogsaday”, ayey tiri Haboon Maxamed. Haboon ayaa sheegtay in nolosheedii kansarka kahor iyo hadda oo sidoo kale ay ka bogsatay ay aad u kala duwan tahay oo ay gashay hab nololeed oo gebi ahaanba ka duwan kii hore. “Kansarka inta uusan igu dhicin ka hor waxan iska ahaa qof caadi ah oo wuxuu doono cuna xilliga uu doonana seexda, waxba jimicsi ahna aan sameyn, balse hadda xilliga cishaha ka dib waan seexdaa, cuntadeyda waa mid dheelli tiran, sidoo kalana waxa aan ku qasbanahay in aan jimicsi sameeyo mar waliba”, ayey tiri Haboon. Haboon waxa au sheegtay in ay caqabado kala duwan kala kulanto bulshada marka ay noqoto wacyi gelinta xanuunkan iyo in ay wakhti badan ku bixiso in dumarku ay ka feejignaadaan. “Nairobi marka aan imid waxa aan sii waday wacyi gelintii xanuunkan aan ka bogsaday, laakiin waxaa jira dad siyaabo qaldan uga fal celiya oo yiraahda haddiiba aad ka bogsatay maad iska aamustid balse waxa aysan ogeyn in ogaansho la’aanta xanuunkan ee xilli hore ay dhibaato badan keeni karto”. Waxa ay sheegtay in ay xilligii dhakhtarka ay booqaneysay uu dhakhtarku u sheegay in haddii ay bil kaliya soo daahi lahayd uu gaari lahaa heer aan waxba laga qaban karin balse baaritaanka xilliga hore ah iyo xaaladda qofka in uu isla socdo ay ka dhigan tahay kahortagga khatar badan. Haboon hadda waxa ay sheegtay in xanuunkan uu si rasmi ah jirkeeda uga baxay balse ay weli feejigantahay oo ay iska ilaaliso dhammaan waxyaaba nooca kansarkeedu diiddanaa. Dr Caasha Cumar Kablow ayaa sheegtay in kansarka oo xilli la hore la ogaado ay horseedi karto in laga bogsado walow dumar badan aysan xaalado jira awgood u saamixin, iyada oo sidoo kale dumarka qaar ay culeys kala kulmi karaan dhakhaatiirta gaarka loo leeyahay. “Wacyi gelinta marka aan sameyneyno aad ayaan uga xumaanaa, sababtoo ah marka aad dadka dhirri geliso oo aad tiraahdo dhakhtarka la soo xiriir dharkhtarkuna uu yahay mid gaar loo leeyahay xoogaa waxa aan dareennaa xanuun”, ayey tiri Dr Caasha. Hay’adda caafimaadka adduunka ee WHO waxay sheegtay in cudurka kansarka naasaha ee dunida laga helay sannadkii 2022 2.3 malyan oo qof, kuwaas oo 670,000 oo ka mid ah ay u dhinteen. Kansarka naasaha ku dhaca ayaa ah cudur ka jira dal kasta, wuxuuna ku dhacaa dumarka da’ kasta oo ay jiraan wixii ka dambeeya qaangaarnimada. Sidoo kale wuxuu ku dhacaa ragga.

Boqor Charles iyo safarkiisa ku aaddan daweynta Kansarka , HUW EVANS PICTURE AGENCY Buckingham Palace ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqday in King Charles III laga helay nooc ka mid ah kansarka. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka, waxaa natiijada xanuunkan laga helay boqorka ay soo baxday xilli uu horraanba qaadanayay daweyn la xiriirta xanuunada ku dhaca qanjirka loo yaqaanno 'prostate-ka', Boqorku waxa uu geli doonaa marxalad daawayn, laakiin waxa la rumaysan yahay in kansarkan laga helay uu weli kujiro marxaladdiisii hore. Bayaanka ay soo saartay Qasriga Boqortooyada ma aysan shaacin nooca kansarka, laakiin waxay sharraxday in boqorku uu bilaabay qaadashada "daawaynta caadiga ah" ee xanuunkan. Boqorka ayaa si shaqsi ah ugu wargaliyay labadiisa wiil xaaladiisa caafimaad, waxaana la sheegay in Amiir William uu xiriir joogto ah la leeyhaay aabihiis. Amiir Harry, oo ku nool Mareykanka, ayaa waxa uu la hadlay aabihiis wuxuuna u safri doonaa Boqortooyada Ingiriiska si uu arko isaga maalmaha soo socda. Boqorka ayaa ku soo laabtay London isagoo ka yimid Sandringham Norfolk subaxnimadii Isniinta, qasriga ayaa sheegay inuu bilaabay daawaynta bukaan socod ahaan. Qasriga Buckingham ayaa sheegay in boqorku "uu aad u wanaagsan yahay uuna rajeynayo inuu sida ugu dhaqsaha badan ugu soo laabto shaqadiisa xafiiska dadweynaha." Boqorku wuxuu dib u dhigi doonaa dhammaan hawlihiisa dadweynaha, Boqorad Consort Camilla iyo Prince William ayaa waxay gacan ka geysan doonaan inay u matalaan qaar ka mid ah waajibaadkiisa inta lagu jiro muddada daaweynta. Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan heerka kansarka ama ogaanshaha rasmiga ah lama shaacin. In kasta oo boqorka 75-jirka ah uu joojin doono hawlihiisii guud, haddana waxa uu sii wadi doonaa shaqadiisa dastuuriga ah ee madaxa dowladda, oo ay ku jirto dib u eegista waraaqaha rasmiga ah iyo ka qaybgalka shirarka gaarka ah. Waxaa jira hab dastuuri ah oo la raaco haddii ay dhacdo in madaxa qaranku uu awoodi waayo inuu guto waajibaadkiisa rasmiga ah, kiiskan oo kale, "la-taliyayaal dowladeed" ayaa loo magacaabi karaa inay ku shaqeeyaan magaca boqorka. Hadda, liiska lataliyayaasha waxaa ka mid ah Queen Consort Camilla, Prince William, Princess Anne, iyo Prince Edward, in kasta oo Amiir Harry iyo Prince Andrew aan loogu yeeri doonin howlahan sababo la xiriiraka bixitaankooda boqortooyada ee rasmiga ah. Amiir William wuxuu si ku meel gaar ah uga baxay hawlgelinta dadweynaha isagoo ku mashquulsan caawinta xaaskiisa, Catherine, oo ka soo kabanaysa "qaliin looga sameeyay caloosha." Laakin waxaa la shaaciyay horraantii isniinta in amiirku uu ku soo laaban doono howlaha guud dabayaaqada todobaadkan. Boqorka ayaa lagu arkay kaniisad ku taal Sandringham Axadii, halkaas oo uu ugu gacan haatiyay dad badan. Waxa uu qaliin qanjirka prostate-ka ka galay isbitaal gaar loo leeyahay oo ku yaalla London muddo hadda laga joogo in kabadan todobaad. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Waxaa la sheegay in uu ku faraxsan yahay in uu ka qeyb qaato wacyigelinta la xiriirta xanuunkan, iyadoo website-ka adeegga caafimaadka qaranka ee Britain uu sheegay in ay sare u kaceen tirada kiisaska la xiriira ka hadalka mowduuca qanjirka 'prostate-ka'. Tirakoobyada Boqortooyada Ingiriiska ayaa waxa ay muujinayaan in celcelis ahaan sannad kasta, in ka badan saddex meelood meel dadka cusub ee laga helo kansarka ilaa 36 boqolkiiba ay da'doodu tahay 75 sano ama ka weyn. Daawaynta Kansarka waxaa ka mid ah daawada chemotherapy, oo ah dawo loo isticmaalo in lagu dilo unugyada kansarka, taas oo ah daawaynta loo adeegsado shucaaca si ay u disho unugyada kansarka. Raiisel wasaaraha Ingiriiska Rishi Sunak ayaa muujiyay rabitaankiisa dhabta ah ee Boqorka isagoo yiri, "dhakhso iyo soo kabasho buuxda", sidoo kale hoggaamiyaha xisbiga shaqaalaha Sir Keir Starmer iyo afhayeenka aqalka baarlamaanka Sir Lindsay Hoyle ayaa boqorka u rajeeyay bogsasho deg deg ah.

‘Waa lay dilayaa. Waa lay daba socdaa. Waa lay falay’: Sida hurdo la’aantu u sababto xanuunada halista ah ee dhimirka , Hurdadu waxay faa'iidooyin badan u leedahay jirkeena iyo caafimaad qabka maskaxdeena. Si la mida sida neefta, cabbista iyo cunida uu jirku ugu baahan yahay inuu u helo si joogto ah ayey hurdadu ula mid tahay jirka inuu u helo xilliga habeenkii muddo siddeed saacadood ah. Waa taas sababta hurdadu uga mid tahay waxyaabaha aadka muhiimka ugu ah aadamaha sida khubaradu ay sheegeen. Waxaana mar walba maqalnaa ama aragnaa tallooyinka dhaqaatiirta ee la xiriira in qofku helo hurdo wanaagsan si uu uga badbaado cudurro badan oo ka dhasha hurdo la'aanta. Dhaqaatiirta ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in hurdadu,ay tahay cuntada jirka bani'aadamka waana hab lagu dhiso laguna dajiyo oo lagu sugo caafimaadka maskaxda qofka. Hurdadu waxay muhiim u tahay soo saarista hormoonnada qaarkood, sida hormoonka koritaanka. Sidoo kale, inta aad hurudid waxaa jirkaagu dayactir ku sameeya soo kabashada unugyada dhaawacan iyo kuwa dhimanaya. Hurdadu waxay sidoo kale noo ogolaataa inaan dib u soo celino, dib u habeyno oo si fiican u dheelitirno hababka jireed ee jirkeena dhexdiisa. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Cilmi-baadhis ay 2013-kii ay soo saareen cilmi-baarayaal ka tirsan jaamacadda Rochester ee New York, ayey ku sheegeen in sunta ku ururta maskaxdeenna saacadaha soo jeedka laga saaro maskaxda xilliga hurdada. Cilmi baarisyada caafimaadka ayaa qaba in qofka aan helin hurdo ku filan xilliga habeenkii ama dhammaan habeen iyo maalin uu halis ugu jiro in uu la kulmo xanuuno dhanka maskaxda ah oo haleela. Barre Xuseen Jaamac, waa dhakhtar bartay cilmi nafsiga iyo cudurada guud oo ka howlgalada dalalka UK iyo Ireland. Waxaa uu BBC-da u sheegay in khataro caafimaad oo badani ku gadaaman yihiin dadka aan helin hurdo ku filan. Dhakhtarku wuxuu u kala qaaday hurda la’aanta laba nooc oo kala ah mid ay sababaan xanuunno iyo mid ruuxa si ikhtiyaara u samaayo. “Waxaa loo kala qaybiyaa in qofku seexdo oo misna dhowr jeer kac kaco ama khalkhal kaga timaado hurdada. Taas ayaa noqon karaysa mid dhacda habeen ama labo amba toddobaad ah, midna waa mid joogto ah,” ayuu yiri Dr Barre. Sawirka, Hurdadu waa arrin jirka u sahasha inuu qabto shaqooyin waaweyn oo ku xiran jiritaanka qofka, sida dayactir dabiiciya oo uu isku sameeyo jirku inta uu qofku hurdo habeenkii sida uu BBC-da u sheegay Dr. Barre Xuseen. Shaqooyinka jirku qabto xilliga hurdada Hurdada oo ku yaraata qofka waxa ay sababi kartaa in xanuunada dhimirku ay ku dhacaan qofka markaas oo la arko qof isla hadlaya ama kaligiis meel taagan oo qaylinaya. “Marka hurdadu yaraato waxaa qofka ku badanaya welwelka, diiqada, ciririga marka xaaladaasi sii socoto waxa qofka ku dhacaya xanuuno ay ka mid yiiin calool istaaga, haddii qofku seexan waayo waxaa imaanaya laba xaaladood oo waaweyn oo la yiraahdo (psychotic episode) oo ah in qofku ka baxo xaaaladii caadi ahayd”ayuu BBC-da u sheegay Dr. Barre. Wuxuu intaa raaciye in xaaladas marka ay timaado (psychotic episode) la arkayo qofka oo dhahayo “Waa lay dilayaa. waa lay daba socdaa, waa lay falay. mararka qaarna u qofku maqlayo codod oo dhahayo hebel baa ila hadlaya. mararka qaarna hadalkiisa iyo fikirkiisuna khalkhalayo” Dr. Barre, ayaa xusay xaaladaaha noocaas oo kale ah ay aad ugu badanayaan dadka Soomaaliyeed taas oo muujisayo sida uu sheegay in xaalado dhimirka oo qofka ku soo food leh oo u baahan in la caawiyo. Dhakhtaru wuxuu tallo ku bixiyey in qofka haddii lagu arko dabeecadaas ka duwan sidii uu horrey u ahaa ay mudan tahay in la qabto oo la seexiyo si loo dajiyo ama lala gaaro xarumo caafimaad. Sawirka, Hurdadu waxay dawo u tahay xanuunno badan oo ku dhaca aadanaha, waxayna jirkeena siisaa. Haddii qofku uusan helin hurdo ku filan oo uu seexdo, dhakhaatiirka ayaa rumaysan inuu isku arki karo. Cilmi-baadhis uu hor kacayey Prof Charles Czeisler, oo ka tirsan Harvard Medical School ayaa lagu sheegey in dadka akhriya buugaagta elektaroonigga ah ka hor inta aanay seexan inay ku qaadato wakhti dheer inay seexdaan, ay hoos u dhigto heerka melatonin (hormoonka nidaamiya saacadda gudaha ee jidhka) oo ay yaraato. "50-kii sano ee la soo dhaafay, waxaa jiray hoos u dhac ku yimid celceliska muddada hurdada iyo tayada”sida cilmi baaristu sheegtay Mid ka mid ah siddeedii qofba wuxuu ku hayaa taleefoonka gacanta inuu shido qolka jiifka habeenkii, taasoo kordhinaysa khatarta hurdadeena inay carqaladeyso. Daraasado badan ayaa sheegaya in ay jiraan cadaymo muujinaya in hurdo la'aanta ay la xiriirto buurnaanta, macaanka, niyad-jabka iyo rajada nolosha oo hoos u dhacda - halka kuwo kale, sida Prof James Horne, oo ah cilmi-baare hurdada oo ka tirsan jaamacadda Loughborough ayaa aaminsan in hadalka noocaas ahi uu yahay "cabsi". Cilmi-baarisyaa iyo khubarada caafimaadka ayaa isku raacsan in helitaanka hurdo kugu filan ay horseed u tahay caafimaad iyo hab noleed hormarsan.

Daaman jabay, ilko daatay iyo $280 malyan: Maxaan kala soconnaa cayaartii feerka ee dhex martay Joshua iyo Jake Paul? , Labo meel ayuu ka jawbay daanka Jake Paul oo Miami kula feertamay Anthony Joshua. Youtuber-kan ayaa laga siibay labo ilig. YouTuber-ka, oo sidoo kale horay ula feertmay Mike Tyson, ayaa lix wareeg u adkaystay feerka Joshua, oo laba jeer horyaalka miisaanka culus ee adduunka u soo qaaday. Dhowr jeer ayaa la riday ka hor inta aanu ku dhicin feerkii ugu darnaa ee kaga yimaada Joshua. Paul, oo 28 jir ah, ayaa laba jeer lagu riday wareega shanaad iyo kan lixaad. Wuxuu sheegay dagaalka ka dib in uu "hubo in daankiisu jabay." Paul ayaa Instagram ku qoray: "Qalliinku si fiican ayuu u dhacay, waad ku mahadsan tihiin dhammaan jacaylka iyo taageerada. Toddoba maalmood waxaan cabbi doonaa kaliya dareere." Sidoo kale wuxuu baraha bulshada soo dhigay sawir raajo ah oo muujinaya jabka soo gaaray daankiisa. Paul, oo dhaawac awgiis uga maqnaa shirkii warbaahinta ee dagaalka kaddib, ayaa kaftan ku sheegay in uu wajihi karo feeryahanka kale ee Saul Alvarez. "Jabka daanka waa wax ku badan ciyaaraha, gaar ahaan feerka," ayuu yiri Nekisa Bidarian oo maamule u ah Paul oo intaas u daray "Waqtiga bogsashada badanaa waa afar ilaa lix toddobaad." Paul fursad yar ayuu u haystay in uu ka adkaado ninka aad uga khibrad badan, wuxuuna isku dayay in uu ka fogaado feerarka culus ee Joshua. Dagaalka si weyn ayaa loo dhaliilay sababo la xiriira kala duwanaashaha miisaanka iyo farqiga weyn ee xirfadda farsamo ee labada feeryahan. Paul, oo hore uga dagaallami jiray miisaanka fudud, ayaa sheegay in uu qorsheynayo in uu feerka ka nasto "muddo." "Waxaan bogsiinayaa daankayga jabay, dib ayaan u soo laabanayaa anigoo la dagaallamaya dad miisaankayga ah. Hadafkaygu waa in aan ku guuleysto suunka horyaalka adduunka ee miisaanka dhexe. Nasasho yar ayaan qaadanayaa. Lix sano ayaan si aan kala joogsi lahayn u shaqeynayay," ayuu yiri. Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Feerka dhexmaray Anthony Joshua iyo Jake Paul wuxuu ahaa mid la yaab leh, waxaana laga daawaday Netflix. IIlbiriqsiyadii ugu dambeeyay ee wareegga afraad ee feerka, garsoore Christopher Young ayaa ku dhawaaqay ereyo ay dad badan rabeen in ay dhahaan. Wuxuu isu keenay feeryahannada, wuxuuna ku adkeystay in ay si caddaalad ah u dagaallamaan. Joshua wuxuu lahaa toddobaadkii oo dhan, "waxaa isaaran culeys feerka iyo kan habeenkii jimcaha ee Miami". Ujeedka Pual waxa uu ahaa in uu "badbaado", wuxuuna ahaa ninkii toddobaadkan oo dhan ballanqaadayay in taariikh la yaab leh ay dhacso, wuxuuna ka gambanayay feerka. Markasta oo ay isku dhawaadaan wuxuu Paul isticmaalayay xirfada lagdanka isagoo qabsanayay lugaha Joshua. Dhowr feer ayaa u dhacday Paul. "Tani waa guul, balse ma ahan guul-wadareed," ayuu yiri Joshua oo intaas u daray dagaalka kaddib. "Wax badan ayaan u baahanahay in aan hagaajiyo. Kuma qanacsani." Joshua wuxuu helay qaybtiisa lacagta abaal-marinta, oo la sheegay in ay gaareyso $280 milyan, balse marka laga fiiriyo dhanka isboortiga, tartankan wax macno ah ma laheyn. Joshua wuxuu istaagay bartamaha halka lagu feertamo, wuxuuna dadweynaha u sheegay in uusan dan ka lahayn "sumcadii uu ka dhaxlay isboortiga." Joshua oo 36 jir, waa feeryahan miisaanka culus oo hore ugu soo guuleystay bilado dahab oo olombikada ah, wuxuuna sidoo kale hore u soo noqday horyaalka feerka miisaanka culus. Feerkan waxba kuma kordhin Paul maadama uusan waligiis heerkan oo kale uusan gaarin. "Waxaan rabay in aan dhaqso dhulka dhigo balse markii aan arkay dhiiranaanta iyo geesinimadiisa iyo sida uu isugu dayayo intii karaankiisa, waan tixgeliyay taas" ayuu yiri Joshua. Dagaalku wuxuu muujiyay in muuqaalka feerku isbeddelayo, halka buunbuuninta Netflix iyo soo jiidashada ganacsi ay wax weyn ka badaleen isboortiga. Paul mar walba waa nin aan la saadaalin karin. Inta badan wuxuu doonayaa in uu carqaladeeyo qaab dhismeedka ciyaaraha feerka. Ka hor feerka Joshua, Paul wuxuu ahaa feeryahan ku dagaallama miisaanka fudud. Ururka feerka adduunka waxay sheegeen in ay Paul ku qiimeyn doonaan bisha Luulyo lambarka 14-aad. Tani waxay ka dhigeysaa in uu hoos u dhacay hal darajo, sidaas darteed ku laabashada miisaankan ayaa u muuqada ikhtiyaarka ugu macquulsan haddii uu doonayo in uu ugu dambayn gaaro riyadiisa ah in uu u dagaallamo horyaal adduun. Sawirka, Jilaagii hore ee Disney ee noqday YouTuber-ka iyo feeryahan, waxaa bartiisa bulsho ku taxan dad ka badan 55 milyan, taasoo micnaheedu yahay "lacag aad u weyn inuu sameynayo." sida ay sheegtay Forbes, hantida Paul waxaa lagu qiyaasaa $50 milyan oo doolar. Wuxuu ku tababartaa bakhaar la beddelay oo qiimihiisu yahay 4 milyan oo doolar kuna yaalla dalka Puerto Rico. Waa xarun si buuxda u qalabaysan oo leh qolal soo kabasho iyo xarun jimicsi. Paul horay ayuu uga hadlay go'aankiisa ah in uu dib u helo suunka horyaalka adduunka. Marka la eego saamayntiisa, tirada dhagaystayaashiisa iyo hantidiisa, waa in aan filannaa in mar kale lagu arko riigada lagu feertamo, xitaa haddii dagaalkiisii ugu dambeeyay mararka qaar u ekaa "riwaayad" ama majaajilo.

Xildhibaannada Mareykanka oo madaxweyne Biden u sheegay go’aan ay ka gaareen Turkiga , Xildhibaannada Aqalka Sare ee Mareykanka oo isugu jira labada xisbi ee Jamhuuriga iyo Dimuqraaddiga ayaa warqad u diray madaxweyne Joe Biden, taasoo ay uga codsadeen in uu dib u dhigo mashruuca Turkiga looga iibinayo diyaaradaha F-16 oo lagu qiimeeyay lacag dhan $20 bilyan oo doolar. Siyaasiyiintan ayaa dalbaday in xukuumadda Ankara laga hor istaago diyaaradahaas ilaa inta ay ka ansixineyso hannaanka ay dalalka Sweden iyo Finland ugu biirayaan isbahaysiga NATO. Sweden iyo Finland ayaa sanadkii lasoo dhaafay codsaday in ay xubno ka noqdaan NATO ka dib markii uu billowday dagaalka uu Ruushku ku qaaday Ukraine, hase yeeshee dowladda uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa dhowr shuruudood ku xirtay in ay taageerto arrintaas. Isbuucii lasoo dhaafay ayuu Turkiga sheegay in Sweden uusan ka oggolaan doonin ku biirista NATO ka dib markii uu ka carooday dhacdo lagu gubay kitaabka Qur’aanka oo ka dhacday gudaha Sweden. Dadka Kitaabka dabka qabadsiiyay ayaa xilligaas ku sugnaa afaafka hore ee safaaradda uu Turkiga ku leeyahay Sweden. Sawirka, Ilaa 29 senator oo isugu jira Jamhuuri iyo Dimuqraaddi ayaa warqadda ay u dureen Biden ugu sheegay in labada dal ee Scandinavian-ka ay sameeyeen “dadaallo dhammeystiran oo niyad wanaag ku dheehan yahay” si ay u fuliyaan shuruudaha uu ku xiray Turkiga. "Marka la anisixiyo hab raacyada ay labadan waddan ugu biirayaan NATO ka dib waxa uu Aqalka Wakiillada ee Congress-ka ka fiirsan karaa in Turkiga laga iibiyo diyaaradaha dagaalka ee F-16,” ayaa lagu yiri warqaddan. Qoraalka la gaarsiiyay madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu yiri: “Haddii lagu guul darreysto in arrinta sidaas loo fuliyo waxa ay su’aalo ka imaan doonaan heshiiska ku saabsan iibinta diyaaradaha.” Waa markii ugu horreysay ee ay xildhibaannada Mareykanka si toos ah isugu xiraan iibinta diyaaradaha uu Turkigu rabo iyo oggolaanshaha in ay Sweden iyo Finland ku biirayaan gaashaanbuurta NATO. Waxaa lasoo tebiyay in maamulka Biden uu horay u sheegay in uu taageersan yahay qorshaha diyaaradaha looga iibinayo Ankara isla markaasna uusan isku xiri doonin labada arrin. Waxaase uu Aqalka Cad hoosta ka xariiqay in aqbalidda Turkiga ee codsiga Sweden iyo Finland ay saameyn weyn ku yeelan doono go’aanka Golaha Wakiilada. Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Dowladda Turkiga ayaa sheegtay in ay oggolaaneyso rabitaanka Finland balse ay kasoo hor jeeddo xubinnimada Sweden ka dib markii Kitaabka Qur’aanka Kariimka lagu gubay magaalada caasimadda u ah Sweden ee Stockholm. Raysul Wasaareyaasha Finland iyo Sweden, Sanna Marin and Ulf Kristersson ayaa ku dhawaaqay in ay ka go’an tahay iney si wadajir ah isula fuliyaan hannaanka ku biiriska isbahaysiga militeri ee NATO, iyagoo dhagaha ka fureystay hadalkii ugu dambeeyay ee kasoo baxay hoggaamiyaha Turkiga oo fasaxay Finland oo keliya. Ankara ayaa markii hore shuruud muhiim ah u arkeysay in dalalkan raadinaya xubinnimad NATO ay usoo gacan geliyaan shakhsiyaad ay u aqoonsan tahay argagixiso oo ku nool dalalkooda. Dhammaan 30-ka dal ee uu ka kooban yahay Isbahaysiga NATO, marka laga reebo Turkiga iyo Hungary, kama aysan hor imaan xubinnimada Sweden iyo Finlad. Bishii October ee sanadkii 2021 ayuu Turkiga gudbiyay codsiga uu Mareykanka uga iibsanayo 40 diyaaradood oo noocoodu yahay F-16.

Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee la dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa: 'Wax caddeyn ah looma hayo in dowladda Soomaaliya ay musuqmaasuq sameyso' , VILLA SOMALIA Soomaaliya waxay ka mid tahay dalalka ugu musuqmaasuqa badan caalamka, sida lagu sheegay qiimeyn la sameeyay. Ammaan darrada ayaa ah caqabad weyn oo heysata Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo ay xasilooni darradu sidoo kale wiiqeyso dhaqaalaha dalka. Saraakiil dowladda ka tirsan ayaa la sheegay inay u dulqaataan howlo sharci darro ah iyaga oo qaadanaya laaluush. Hay`adaha dowladda oo aan qaarkood shaqeyneyn ayaa sidoo kale loo aaneynayaa musuqmaasuqa la haray dalka. Maanta oo kale sanad walba waxaa dunida laga xusaa maalinta caalamiga ah ee la dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa. Sanadkan wuxuu xuska maalintan ku soo aadayaa xilli ay dalka Soomaaliya ku soo fool leedahay doorasho, waxaana jira walaac laga muujinayo in musuqmaasuq uu hareyn doono doorashada. Wasiirka caddaaladda iyo garsoorka ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya Cabdulqadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku guuleysatay inay la timaaddo hannaan lagula dagaallamayo musuqmaasuqa. "Waxaa la diyaariyay istaraatiijiyad, waxaa la diyaariyay shuruucdii lagula diriri lahaa, waxay xeer ilaalinta iyo maxkamada iyo hanti dhowraha ka shaqeeyeen kiisas badan oo musuq lagu helay oo ilaa iyo hadda ay maxkamaddoodu socoto, dowladdu la dirirka musuqmaasuqa tallaabooyin badan ayay u qaadday welina way waddaa," ayuu yidhi wasiirka. Wasiir Cabdulqaadir ayaa dhanka kale gaashaanka u daruuray eedeymaha ku aaddan in hay'adaha dowladda Soomaaliya gudahooda uu ka jiro musuqmaasuq. "Dowladdu waxay la dagaallameysaa nooc walba oo musuq ah, ama gudaheeda haka jiro ama bannaanka haka jiro. Arrimaha dowladda lagu eedeynayo wax caddeyn ah looma hayo, waa eray ay inta badan siyaasiyiin adeegsadaan." Golaha wasiirrada dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa bishii September meel mariyay guddiga la dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa ee Soomaaliya, kaas oo loogu talogalay in lagula dagaallamo musuqmaasuqa; lagu xoojiyo sumcadda hay`adaha dowladda; adeegyada rayidka; lagu hubiyo hufnaanta maamulka dhaqaalaha bulshada ; isla markaana lagu dhiirrigeliyo isla xisaabtanka. Qaramada Midoobay oo taageerta dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa soo dhoweysay guddigaas. "Waxaan soo dhaweyneynaa sida ay dowladda Soomaaliya uga go'antahay la-dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa, suurta gelinta in si caddaalad ku dhisan looga wada faa'iideysto kheyraadka iyo fursadaha, iyo in la dhiso kalsoonida lagu qabo hay'adaha dowladda." Ayuu yiri Wakiilka Gaarka ah ee Xoghayaha-Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, James Swan. Tan iyo sanadkii 2006, Soomaaliya waxaa si is daba joog ah loogu darayay liiska dalalka ugu musuqmaasuqa badan adduunka. Qiimeyntii musuqmaasuqa dalalka ee sanadkii 2019 ay hay`adda Transparency International ku sameysay 180 dal ayaa lagu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay mar kale tahay dalka ugu musuqmaasuqa badan adduunka. Waxay sagaal dhibcood ka keentay dhibcaha 100-ka ah ee ku saabsan dowladnimada, isla xisaabtanka iyo hufnaanta. Waxaa qiimeynta lagu ogaaday in dalalka meesha hoose ka galay liiska ay wax yar oo aan ku filneyn sameeyaan amaba aysan wax dadaal ah ku bixin la dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa horay u diidday qiimeynta oo ay ku sheegtay inay tahay "mid aan lagu kalsoonaan karin", iyadoo Wasiirka Maaliyadda Cabdiraxmaan Ducaale Beyle uu horay u sheegay inay dacweyn doonaan hay`adda Transparency International. Musuqmaasuqa la xiriira coronavirus Qaramada Midoobay ayaa walaaca ugu weyn ka qabta sida uu musuqmaasuqa u sii ragaadinayo xaaladihii cakirnaa ee horay dunida uga jiray xilli uu hadda dhibaato weyn dunida ka abuuray fayraska safmarka. "Musuqmaasuqu waa dembi, wax aan la aqbali karin, waana heerkii ugu sarreeyay ee meel ka dhaca aaminaadda bulshada. Wax ka qabashada fayraska wuxuu fursado cusub u abuurayaa hubanti la`aan, iyadoo lacagaha loogu talo galay dadka laga weecinayo xilligan oo ay baahida ugu badan u qabaan." Bishii August Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir ayaa xukun xabsi ah ku ridday afar ka tirsan shaqaalaha wasaaradda caafimaadka oo lagu eedeeyay musuqmaasuq la xiriira lacagtii loogu talo galay in wax looga qabto fayraska corona. Maxkamadda oo qaadda dembiyada ka dhaca magaalada Muqdisho iyo deegaannada ku hareereysan ayaa dembi ku heshay afartaas shaqaale, kaddib markii arrinta ku saabsan si xun u isticmaalidda lacaga dadweynaha ay muran badan dhalisay. Kiiskan ayaa soo baxay bishii April, markaas oo ahayd hal bil kaddib markii ay Soomaaliya shaacisay kiiskii ugu horreeyay ee Covid-19. Xilligaas, Wasaaradda Caafimaadka ayaa sheegtay in tiro saraakiil ah lagu hayo baaritaan la xiriira inay dano kale u isticmaaleen lacagaha dadweynaha. Soomaaliya waxaa haatan laga soo sheegay kiisas ka badan 4,500 oo fayraska corona ah. Masar iyo Soomaaliya oo ka wada hadlay arrimo muhiim ah oo ay Badda Cas ka mid tahay Madasha Dooxa ayaa dhawaan lagu qabtay dalka Masar. Mid ka mid ah diiradda shirku wuxuu ahaa xal wax ku ool ah oo loo helo xiisadda Soomaaliya. Inkastoo aysan magacaabin kuwaas, haddana dhawaanahan waddamada waaweyn sida Mareykanka, Ruushka iyo Shiinaha ayaa kordhiyay dhaqdhaqaaqyadooda Geeska Afrika iyo dadaalladooda ku aaddan inay ku guulaystaan diblomaasiyadda. Mareykanka iyo Shiinaha ayaa magacaabay ergaygii ugu horreeyay ee gaar ah ee Geeska Afrika. Sidoo kale, xiisadda ka taagan gobolka ayaa sii kordheysa. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Badr Abdelatty ayaa sheegay in diblomaasiyadda Masar ee ku aaddan Soomaaliya ay tahay mid lagu xaqiijinayo midnimada xudduudaha Soomaaliya, laguna hor istaagayo go'aannada dhinac kaliya ah ee gobolka laga qaato. Masar waxay dhinac joogtay Soomaaliya markii Somaliland ay oggolaatay inay deked badeed siiso Itoobiya horraantii sanadkan. Soomaaliya, Eritrea iyo Masar ayaa iyaguna kala saxiixday heshiisyo militari iyo kuwo kale oo ka soo horjeeda heshiiska Itoobiya. Masar ma rabto in Itoobiya ay yeelato deked badeed. Tan tilmaanta u ah ayaa ah is-afgaradka labada dhinac ee ka soo baxay shirkii Aswan ee u dambeeyay, kaasoo dhigayay in maamulka Badda Cas uu quseeyo oo keliya waddamada xudduudahoodu ay gaaraan badda. Sida uu sheegay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar, Masar waxay Soomaaliya siisay barnaamijyo tababar oo kala duwan, taageero ay siisay hay'adaha rayidka iyo amniga iyo fursado waxbarasho si ay Soomaaliya uga dhigto dal xooggan oo deggan. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Masar ay qayb hormuud ka ahayd howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee nabad-ilaalinta Soomaaliya, ee AUSSOM. Wuxuu sheegay in howlgalkiisu yahay soo celinta nabadda Soomaaliya balse ay jirto miisaaniyad la'aan lagu taageerayo ciidamada amniga Soomaaliya inta lagu jiro xilligan kala guurka ah. Badr Abdelatty ayaa sheegay in uu wadahadallo la yeeshay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayadoo ay ka wada qeyb galeen shirka Dooxa. Masar iyo Soomaaliya ayaa ka wada hadlay sidii ay u garab istaagi lahaayeen Soomaaliya si loo ilaaliyo xasiloonida gobolka Badda Cas, sida uu qoray wargeyska Al-Ahram ee kasoo baxa Masar. Nabadda Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas ayaa fure u ah horumarka gobolka, ayuu yiri, isaga oo intaas ku daray in uu sii wadi doono taageerada uu siiyo Soomaaliya si tan loo xaqiijiyo. Shirka ayaa waxaa ka soo qeyb galay Ergayga Gaarka ah ee Mareykanka u qaabilsan Suuriya Tom Barak, Wakiilka Gaarka ah ee Midowga Yurub u qaabilsan Koonfur Afrika Annette Weber, Xoghayihii hore ee Qaramada Midoobay Ban Ki-moon iyo Borge Brende oo ka socday Madasha Dhaqaalaha Adduunka. Diiradda ugu weyn ee wadahadallada ayaa ah sidii nabad waarta looga gaari lahaa Koonfur Afrika, horumarinta ballaarinta iyo gargaarka bini'aadantinimo. Horaan, markii Midowga Yurub ay ka qeyb gashay shirkii Aswan oo uu heshiis goonni ah la saxiixday Masar, waxay soo saartay bayaan ka caraysiiyay Itoobiya oo ku saabsan biya-xireenka Niil. Itoobiya ayaa cambaareysay. Masar ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay garab istaagtay qof kasta oo dhibaato kala dhexeysa Itoobiya tan iyo markii Itoobiya ay isku khilaafeen biya-xireenka. Dhowaan ayay Masar ka jawaabtay codsigii 13-ka sano ahaa ee ay u jeedinaysay Itoobiya inay heshiis ka gaaraan biya-xireenka. "Ma jiro shirqool aad ka waddaan Geeska Afrika oo aniga i jilba-dhigi doona," ayay tiri Itoobiya. Masar ayaa ku eedaysay Itoobiya inay diidday inay wadahadal yeeshaan oo sidoo kalena ay raacdo go'aannadeeda. Itoobiya, si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxay sheegtay inaysan u hoggaansami doonin, sababtoo ah heshiisyadii xilligii gumeysiga ee lagu saxiixay isticmaalka Niil kuma jirin dhammaan, mana aysan ixtiraamin danahooda qaran. Masar, si kastaba ha ahaatee, tan ma rabto. Sidii la isku raacay, waxay rabtaa inay go'aan madax-bannaan ka gaarto isticmaalka Niil intii lagu jiray xilligii gumeysiga. Itoobiya waxay bixisaa in ka badan 85% biyaha. Masar wax kaalin ah kuma laha Niil. Balse Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale sheegatay inay doonayso is-maamul. Sidaa darteed, Masar, oo ciidamo u dirtay si ay u ilaaliyaan amniga Soomaaliya, ayaa xoojisay xulafadeeda Soomaaliya iyo Eritrea.

Coronavirus: Ramadan aan taraawiixda lagu tukaneyn masaajidda , /AHMAD AL-RUBAYE Waxaa jiri doono isbedello waaweyn oo ku saabsan sida loo cibaadeysto Ramadaankan. Waxaa la xiray misaajidda, waxaa dadka loogu baaqay in ay kala fogaadaan, dalalka qaar waxay shacabkooda ugu baaqeen in salaadda taraawiixda ay guryaha ku tukadaan, waxaa jiro Bandow looga hortaggayo coronavirus. Sheekh Bashiir Axmed Salaad oo ah guddoomiyaha ha'yadda culimada Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in xilliga bisha Ramadaam ay dadka guryaha ku tukan karaan maadama misaajidda qaar ee dunida laga mamnuucay saaladda jamaacada si looga hortaggo inuu faafo fayraska corona. "Haddii daruufuhaas saameeyeen... awaamiirta ka soo bexeysa waddamada misaajidda xiray oo kale ayaa raaceysaa haddii waajibka la joojiyay, guryaha ayaa la isaga tukan karaa... wixii isku guri ahba qof iyaga ka mid ah ayaa tujin kara." Wuxuu sidoo kale sheekha sheegay in xilligan lagu gudo jiro cudurka safmarka ah ee Covid-19, aysan laheyn wax axkaam ah oo gaar ah balse dhibaato ay horseeday. "Runtii xilligan Coronavirus lagu gudo jiro axkaam gaar ah oo uu leeyahay majirto, laalkin qofka muslimka ah haddii Ramadaanku yimaado in uu soomo ayaa ku waajib haddii uusan laheyn cudur daar kale." Sawirka, /ARIF ALI Sheekh Maxamuud Maxamed Shibli, oo ka mid ah culimada Soomaalida ee ku sugan dalka Kenya ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in dhibaatada ka dhalatay coronavirus aysan saameyn ku yeelan diyaargarowga bisha barakeysan ee Ramadaan iyo guud ahaan diintaba. "Diyaargarowga ruuxda iyo iimaanka dadka saameyn badan bey ku laheyd marka shaki ma lahan in bisha Ramadaanku ay dhinacyo badan ka saameyneyso dadka cibaadooda iyo soonkooda", ayuu yiri. "Soonka waa cibaado ka madaxbannaan misaajidda, iyo saaladda ku xiran in masaajidda lagu tukado," ayuu hadalka kusii daray Sheekh Maxamuud Shiblii oo BBC-a u warramayay. Qeybo badan oo ka mid ah dunida muslimka ayaan taraawiixda laga tukan doonin bishan ramdaan maadama la xiray misaajidda. Sida culimada ay sheegeen "salaadda taraawiixda waa sunno". Culimada qaar waxay ugu baaqayaan in dadka taraawiixda ay guryahooda ku tukan karaan "maadama markii horeba ay ku haboneyd in lagu tukada guryaha." "Salaadda taraawiixda guriga bey kaga fadhli badneyd markii horeba, gurigana waa lagu tukan karaa," ayuu yiri Sheekh Shibli. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa dhawaan shaacisay in Salaadda taraawiixda iyo salaadda Ciidda lagu tukado guryaha, sida laga soo xigtay wakaaladda wararka ee dalkaas ee SPA. Muftiga Boqortooyada Sacuudiga Sheekh Cabdulcasis al-Sheekh ayaa sheegay in Jamaacada salaadda taraawiixda aanan misaajiddada lagu tukan doonin sannadkan sababo la xiriira tallaabooyinka ka hortagga faafidda coronovirus. Sawirka, /DEA / A. TESSORE Wasaaradda awqaafta iyo arrimaha diinta dowladda Soomaaliya waxay qodobo kasoo saartay qaababka looga hortaggi karo cudurka xilliga bisha Ramadaan. Saameynta cudurka uu ku yeelanayo bisha Ramadaan ka sokow, waxaa uu sidoo kale saameyn ba'an ku yeelanayaa nolosha dadka danta yar ee ku nool gudaha Soomaaliya ama dadka ku jiro xeryaha qaxootiga ama kuwa dalka gudihiisa ku barakacay. Dadkaas waxaa ka mid ah barakacayaal ku sugan xeryaha ku yaalla hareeraha iyo gudaha magaalada caasimadda ah ee Muqdisho. Khadiija Macalin Maxamed iyo carruurteeda 9-ka ah waxay kasoo barakaceen dagaal beeleed dhawaan ka dhacay deegaanno hoostago degmada Walaweyn ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, waxayna hadda ku sugan tahay geed ku yaalla degmada Deyniile, waxay BBC-da uga warrantay xaaladdeeda. "Hoy ma heysanno, waxaan cunno ah ma heysanno, horteenna soon waaye meel aan seexanno ma heysanno," ayay tiri Khadiija Macalin Maxamed oo la hadleysay BBC-da. Sheekh Bashiir Salaad ayaa ugu baaqay shacabka inay taageero u fidiyaan dadka barakacayaasha ah maadama ay yihiin dad nugul oo u baadan caawin. "Waxaan soo jeedinayaa in loo dhug yeesho dadka barakacayaasha ah ee baahan… waa dad tiro badan oo deggan meelo isku raran ah caafimaad ahaan iska liito... dadka noocaas ah in laga war qabo ayaan soo jeedinayaa". Sacuudi Carabiya waxay muslimiinta ugu baaqday in dadka saaladda taraawiixda ay ku tukadaan guryahooda halka Masar ay mamnuucday goobaha dadka lagu afuriyo. Inta badan dalalka muslimiinta waxay xireen misaajidda si looga hortaggo faafitaanka cudurka. Balse, Pakistana waxay ka qaaday xariyaadii saarneyd masaajidda si loogu tukada halkaas, waxayna soo rogtay tallaaboyin kale oo lagu xakameynayo in uu cudurka faafo sida lagu sheegay war qoraal ah oo ay dowladda soo saartay. Waddankan ku yaalla Koonfurta Aasiya, ayaa ku soo rogay xayiraad bil ka hor, waxaana xilligaas la ogolaaday in masjid walba ay ku tukan karaan ugu badnaan shan qof markiiba.

Koobka Adduunka 2022 ee lagu qabtay Qatar, Iran waxay la ciyaartay Maraykanka, waxaana xilligaas dalka ka dhacay bannaanbaxyo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah dowladda. Los Angeles, oo Iran laba jeer ku ciyaari doonto, waxay hoyi u tahay Iraniyiinta ugu badan ee ku nool Mareykanka. "Waxaan ku jirnaa xaalad aan hore noo soo marin, iyadoo ay ka harsan in ka yar 100 maalmood bilaabashada Koobka Adduunka, isla markaana Mareykanku uu bilaabay dagaal ka dhan ah dal ka qaybgalaya ciyaaraha," ayuu yiri Nick McGeehan oo ka tirsan ururka xuquuqda aadanaha ee FairSquare. "Haddii Iran ka baxdo tartanka, taas oo suuragal ah, FIFA waxay dareemi doontaa nafis maadaama ay yarayneyso bannaanbaxyo iyo qalalaasaha dhici kara." Saraakiil ka tirsan dowladda Maraykanka ayaa ka digay in ay jiri karaan cawaaqib amni oo "musiibo ah" haddii 11-ka magaalo ee martigelinaya ciyaaraha aan la siin maalgelintii hakadka ku jirtay sababo la xiriira xiritaanka qayb ka mid ah dowladda. Waxaa sidoo kale jira walaac isa soo taraya oo ku saabsan in la adeegsado saraakiisha waaxda socdaalka ee ICE iyo rabshado ka dhaca Mexico oo ah dalka labaad ee martigelinaya ciyaaraha. Bishii December, FIFA waxay Trump ku guddoonsiisay 'Abaalmarinta Nabadda' markii ugu horreysay xafladdii isku aadka Koobka Adduunka 2026, waxayna sheegeen in uu "door muhiim ah" ka qaatay heshiis xabbad-joojin ah ee u dhexeeya Israel iyo Falastiiniyiinta, isla markaana uu isku dayay in uu soo afjaro colaado kale. Toddobaadyadii xigay, Maraykanku wuxuu qaaday tallaabooyin militari oo ka dhan ah Venezuela, Nigeria iyo Iran, wuxuuna muujiyey suurtagalnimada dagaallo kale oo ka dhici kara Greenland, Mexico iyo Colombia. Bishii January, Trump wuxuu sidoo kale Cuba ugu baaqay in ay "heshiis la gasho" ama la kulanto cawaaqib. Trump si adag ayuu u difaacay siyaasaddiisa arrimaha dibadda, isagoo ku adkaysanaya in uu ku shaqeynayo danaha Maraykanka. Go'aanka Trump ee weerarka Iran ayaa la kulmay taageero iyo cambaareyn labadaba, balse waxaa hubaal ah in ay kordhin doonto su'aalaha laga qabo go'aanka FIFA ee ku dhawaanshaha Trump, iyadoo dhaleeceeyayaashu ku doodaan in ay khatar ku tahay dhexdhexaadnimada hay'adda. Bishii January, 27 xildhibaan oo ka kala socday xisbiyada UK ee Labour, Liberal Democrats, Green Party iyo Plaid Cymru ayaa saxiixay mooshin baarlamaan oo ku baaqaya in laga saaro Maraykanka tartamada waaweyn ee caalamiga ah, oo uu ku jiro Koobka Adduunka. FIFA waxay ku adkaysanaysaa in ay sharci ahaan waajib ku tahay dhexdhexaadnimo. Sanadkii hore, Infantino wuxuu sheegay in FIFA "aysan xallin karin dhibaatooyinka juqraafi-siyaasadeed" kadib cadaadis lagu saaray in la cunaqabateeyo Israel. 2018, Koobka Adduunka waxaa lagu qabtay Ruushka oo afar sano markaas ka hor ku darsaday Crimea dhulkiisa. Ruushka waxaa sidoo kale lagu eedeeyey weerarro internetka ah iyo faragelin doorashooyin. Ugu dambeyn, FIFA ayaa Ruushka ka mamnuucday 2022 kaddib duullaankii Ukraine, markii dalal badan oo Yurub ah diideen in ay la ciyaaraan. Waxa cad in 48-kii saac ee la soo dhaafay, xaalad siyaasadeed oo horeba u adkayd in ay sii noqotay mid aad uga sii dareysa marka loo eego Koobka Adduunka.

Guidance: Charitable Appeals Since the 1920s and at the instigation of Lord Reith, the BBC has been offering charities the opportunity to broadcast appeals using BBC airtime. These now take the form of the Radio 4 Appeal which is weekly and the BBC One Lifeline Appeal which is monthly. There is an online application process with 4 open rounds each year. All applicants have to demonstrate UK or international scope and/or significance and provide information about their finances and governance. They must be able to explain how they will use the airtime, within the BBC Editorial Guidelines in particular on impartiality, to explain their work. All applications are sent for independent assessment and then also reviewed and recommended by the members of the BBC's Appeals Advisory Committee. Charities that are selected for broadcast appeals attend a BBC briefing and work with BBC producers to deliver the appeal. They are required to submit feedback forms and impact stories following the broadcast. Charities that have a successful appeal are eligible to reapply after 3 years. Charities making an unsuccessful application may reapply after 1 year. There are also up to 11 slots offered annually on BBC Radio Ulster/Foyle to local charities in Northern Ireland. It may be helpful to point charities to these broadcast appeals if asked how the BBC supports charities. More information about the application process is available from the BBC Charity Appeals Unit; the Charity Appeals Adviser for the Unit is Emma Kingsley via: In addition BBC local Radio stations and BBC Regions may wish to mount a specific BBC charity appeal for a project within their local area. All such proposals must be referred to the Appeals Adviser and Senior Adviser (charities) Editorial Policy . Approval will also be needed from Directors Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland or England and the BBC Appeals Advisory Committee. For contacts see above. Editorial Policy advice for those producing the broadcast content of the appeals on may be obtained from Senior Adviser, Editorial Policy, for contacts see the listed end of this guidance note. In addition at two points a year the BBC runs specific on air appeals seasons with BBC Children in Need and Comic Relief (see section 3. below) These are both 'grant givers' and therefore by supporting them the BBC audiences are in effect giving to a very large number of charities and projects with a wide geographical spread. The Disasters Emergency Committee or DEC is a membership organisation which represents 15 of the UK's humanitarian agencies. The relationship between the BBC and the DEC goes back over 50 years and there is an Memorandum of Understanding between the two organisations which sets out the 3 criteria for the BBC to launch on all its platforms, on behalf of the DEC, a disaster emergency appeal. When the DEC considers there is an emergency disaster that meets these criteria they will put a request to the BBC via the Charity Appeals Adviser. The ultimate decision for the BBC to run one of these appeals lies with the Director General in consultation with other members of the BBC Executive Committee. Once an appeal request has been granted, the Charity Appeals Adviser will liaise with the radio, television and digital teams who make the appeal and ensure it is distributed to all the various BBC networks. The appeal is made by BBC teams conforming to all BBC Editorial Guidelines and Editorial Policy advice will be given on the content (see contacts at the end of this guidance note). Charities which are members of the DEC are not eligible for the BBC broadcast appeals (ie the Radio 4 and BBC One Lifeline appeals). The BBC has a tradition of mounting major pan-BBC charity fundraising initiatives such as BBC Children in Need, Red Nose Day (for Comic Relief), and also reflecting Sport Relief (for Comic Relief). BBC Children in Need and BBC Media Action are BBC charities and bear the BBC brand. Comic Relief is not a BBC charity and unlike BBC Children in Need does not bear the BBC brand. It has been a major partner of the BBC and co producer for more than 20 years and together with the BBC has developed the Red Nose Day and Sport Relief on air appeals. The BBC maintains editorial control over all on air and BBC on line activities in relation to Comic Relief. BBC Children in Need, and Comic Relief do not themselves run projects, but are charities which distribute money to a range of projects run by a range of charities, not for profit organisations and community groups. Therefore in raising money to be distributed by BBC Children Need, or Comic Relief the BBC is not seen to be endorsing one particular project or one particular charitable cause. These cross-BBC appeals are reflected across the range of BBC services and in all media. A key aim is to get the public involved across the nations to undertake activities to support the appeal. The initiatives are mounted on a major scale. BBC charity appeal fundraising programming should normally fit within an agreed on-air 'appeal window'. This usually begins about 2/3 months before the main Appeal Night and around 1 months after. Any BBC Children in Need or Comic Relief other charity related BBC programming outside the window must be discussed with Editorial Policy and the BBC Charity Appeals Adviser. Typically the initiative culminates in a major appeal day on radio and night on TV, where donations are pledged by the public and the results of their fundraising are reported. In the build up to the main appeal night, the BBC broadcasts specially commissioned programmes or special strands within existing programmes to raise awareness of the appeal and to build audiences for the main telethon and radio activity . The programming may be across the whole range of BBC outlets including network television and radio, regional television, local radio and BBC websites and social media. In addition, the public is given information about BBC-wide charitable appeals so they can find out how to get involved, raise money and generally support the charities and obtain fundraising materials and merchandise. For each appeal a key executive figure or one for each relevant division of the BBC is usually agreed by the BBC who is responsible for liaison between the BBC and the charity and to whom referral must be made as outlined in this Guidance. There is always an Commissioning Executive with an overview of the relationship for BBC Content. This liaison figure(s) will ensure that all proposed fundraising activities and related programming fits with the values of the charity as well as according to BBC principles and standards, in liaison with BBC Editorial Policy. The BBC may reflect the work of these charities and any areas of their work that are being highlighted during a particular year's appeal for funds. For example, Comic Relief may wish to focus one year on projects which tackle the spread of malaria or BBC Children in Need may choose to highlight projects which tackle bullying. However, the BBC must not allow its content to be used as a vehicle for political campaigning or lobbying. Very careful editorial decisions may have to be taken to ensure that this line is not crossed. Editorial Policy Senior Adviser must be consulted at as early a stage as possible. The use of politicians should be handled with great care. Politicians should not be allowed to use their inclusion in BBC charity programming or related on-air activities to promote specific public policy or party political measures or initiatives. Any proposals to involve any politicians in particular party leaders on air must be referred in advance to the Chief Adviser Politics. For many years corporate and non-corporate supporters have helped BBC Children in Need and Comic Relief. These supporters, via their customers and staff, make a significant contribution mainly through selling special fundraising merchandise and providing a focus for staff and public fundraising. Much of this special merchandise is in the form of official charity products, which have been specifically produced for the appeal and are unique to the charity and sold by specific retailers who have agreed to help fundraise. For example Sainsbury's and Oxfam sell the Comic Relief Red Nose. Asda and Boots and other retailers sell Pudsey bears and other BBC Children in Need goods such as pens, Pudsey branded clothing and Christmas cards. In other cases charity supporters may produce special versions of existing products with a percentage being donated to the charity during the appeal period, for example a special flavour of a confectionary product. In addition, special records are often released, which raise money for the charity. Such releases may be mentioned on-air where editorially appropriate. Corporate support for cross BBC charitable appeals may also be in the form of considerable technical assistance to the charities, for example technology companies may provide major technical support and services on the main appeal nights. In such cases the technical support is offered to the charity and not the BBC and is not part of the BBC television production cost. There is no contractual relationship between the BBC and such technical supporters. The technical assistance offered to the charities enables them to set up, run and operate telephony and online donation mechanisms on the appeal night and in some cases across the year. For all trails the following will apply: The BBC has set up a specialist unit to provide advice on all technical aspects of running a competition, vote or any other uses of Telephony. The Interactive Technical Advice and Contracts Unit (ITACU) oversees the delivery, management and contracting of all BBC's Premium Rate Telephony and other telephony relating to voting and competitions for all programmes, and charity events both independent and in-house, across all divisions and output. Cross BBC charitable initiatives involve fundraising via telephony, online, red button, post and text donations. As appropriate, specialist charity appeals members of ITACU will work with the charity, Senior Adviser Editorial Policy and the Executive in charge of liaison with the charity, to ensure that all such uses are approved in line with regulation in terms of technical and legal issues. ITACU must be consulted at the earliest possible opportunity With high level approval, Premium Rate Telephony may be used to raise funds for these BBC charitable appeals. Premium Rate telephony may only be used for a competition vote or other fundraising mechanism which is directly related to the charitable appeal. Such uses of Premium Rate Telephony may only be carried out with detailed advice from Editorial Policy and ITACU. Any proposal must be signed off by the Divisional Director and referred to Editorial Policy well in advance. Interactive activities may include: Specially commissioned 'Feeder shows' may be produced which are designed to fundraise and/or build interest in the appeal before the main night. These shows usually run as a series in the weeks leading up to the main appeal night or stripped across the week before. They are often entertainment and factual entertainment shows specifically commissioned with a specific fundraising mechanic such as a vote and /or containing appeal films with a donation number call to action. The editorial connection or link to the charitable appeal must be made clear to the audience and the BBC Executive in charge of the production must retain editorial control of all content including any material relating to the charity. We may broadcast special factual programmes, dramas, comedies or other programmes including social media and iPlayer content in the run up to the appeal night to showcase the work of the charity, reflect the effect of donations from the previous appeal and highlight specific themes of that year, such as mental health and domestic violence. However, care must be taken to ensure that the BBC programming does not appear to campaign or lobby on any political issues or matters of public policy. Particular care has to be taken when any drama, comedy, factual or other programme highlights matters of public policy. Programmes may consider or reflect issues such as poverty, social equality, environmental concerns and other major issues. However, it is essential when highlighting these areas that the BBC does not appear to be advocating any political solution or actively encouraging any public campaign or lobby. The BBC should ensure the work of the charity and any projects they support is accurately reflected. The BBC must ensure that it maintains editorial control over all such programming.The Senior Editorial policy Adviser for Charity Appeals should be consulted as well as the relevant genre Senior Editorial Policy Adviser The link with the charity appeal must be made clear on air immediately before the programme, or clearly within the programme. Early discussions should be held with Senior Adviser Editorial Policy and the Executive responsible for liaison with the charity to ensure the suitability and editorial fit of such programming. With the agreement of Editorial Policy and ITACU, it may be appropriate to give information during or at the end of the programme about how to donate to the charitable appeal. Cross-BBC charity fundraising initiatives typically have a central on-air Appeal Night in the form of a telethon. The emphasis of the night is audience donations which are solicited through a range of donation mechanics, including telephone, post, online, red button and text. For BBC Children in Need, Comic Relief the main programme typically consists of suitably themed entertainment; appeal films which show how monies raised in previous appeals have been spent; where monies being raised in the current appeal will be spent and OB inserts from around the country. Throughout the evening the audience is regularly informed of the total and the different ways in which people have donated and raised money in the run-up to the appeal. The following relates to the Main Appeal Night itself: The Main Appeal night programme will reflect the enormous range of fundraising activity throughout the country and the myriad of fundraising initiatives. The BBC may thank members of the public and highlight the fundraising efforts of individuals, communities, organisations, companies their customers and their staff that have raised money and helped support the charity appeal. These acknowledgements should highlight the range of ways in which people have raised money from a whole raft of activities from 'bring and buy' sales and community initiatives, to buying Pudsey bears, red noses or other charity related merchandise. The money raised in this way is added to the 'totaliser' on the night in a clear and transparent manner. These 'thank yous' may come in the form of special inserts from around the country showcasing the work of communities and individuals, cheque presentations on location and in the studio, crawling astons , announcements from presenters and short films reflecting significant fundraising efforts. The editorial purpose of such reflections should be to thank the public and to inspire viewers to donate and to continue with fundraising activities. The following principles must be applied: Commercial logos should not be used in graphics except: Any use of commercial logos in graphics must be approved by Editorial Policy. Films reflecting the work of corporate supporters must abide by the following: Comic Relief is not a BBC charity. It will organise and set up its own events and challenges. These events may be designed to raise the profile of the appeal, showcase the work of the charity and highlight projects for which money is being raised. During the main appeal period Comic Relief may mount special challenges and events to raise money. Such events have included celebrity endurance feats such as those undertaken by David Walliams; celebrity challenges such as the Kilimanjaro climb and the now well established Sport Relief Mile. In 2008 some 400,000 people across the UK took part in the Sport Relief Mile and raised millions of pounds for the appeal. These are Comic Relief events, not BBC events. It would be very difficult to justify using the licence fee to pay for the organisation and administration of such events. Comic Relief undertakes the task of mounting events such as the Sport Relief runs all over the country with the help of a range of supporters. Any proposals for the BBC to cover such events must be referred to Editorial Policy at the earliest stage. BBC staff members may wish to raise money for charity, either individually, or as a group in off-air activities like fun runs or sponsored events. Staff are able to undertake activities organised by external organisations in a private capacity for fundraising activity for charitable purposes but not for campaigning or political action. However, if staff wish to organise off-air fundraising events through the BBC (such as through Gateway or as a group of people from a local radio station coming together to create an activity) then they must refer the proposed activity to the Charity Appeals Adviser and Senior Adviser Editorial Policy well in advance. This is necessary in order to have sufficient time to ensure that the appropriate due diligence is done for any charity which may be the beneficiary of such activity. It is also to avoid the perception of BBC staff becoming the face of a charity and endorsing one charity over another. Any such activity must not stray into the area of lobbying or campaigning and specific care must be taken in relation to staff who work in News and Current Affairs, in relation to due impartiality. Please refer any such proposals well in advance . It is also important for any BBC Outlet planning to cover such activity to refer to Editorial Policy Senior Adviser well in advance who may consult with Charity Appeals Adviser Audience members may sometimes offer to make donations and/or offers of specific assistance to those whose situations have been highlighted in content. It is always best practice to direct them to a registered charity or range of suitable organisations, who can support the person and channel help most effectively. The reason for this is that such organisations usually have the experience and infrastructure to carry out appropriate due diligence checks and ensure that the assistance offered is the best for the person affected. In exceptional circumstances if audiences want to donate to individuals directly then the BBC team concerned should take advice in the first instance from the Senior Adviser, (Charities), Editorial Policy and the Charity Appeals Adviser. If content is associated with the fundraising of the DEC or one of the BBC partner charities such as Children in Need or Comic Relief, then it is more sensible to direct people to donate to those organisations. Dowladda oo ka hadashay weerarkii Bariire , Sarkaal ka mid ah ciidamada Soomaaliya, Janaraal Sheegow Axmed Cali, oo maamulayay saldhigga la weeraray ee Bariire ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah kooxda weerartay ay ku dileen dagaalka. Wuxuu tilmaamay iyo militariga Soomaaliya ay guuleysteen, iskana caabiyeen weerarka Al-Shabaab ee Bariire. "Saaka aroortii, seddax meel ayey naga soo galeen; dhinaca wobiga; dhinaca Koonfur iyo dhanka waqooyi. Ka dib way naga jabeen ka dib markii dharbaaxo culus ay ku dhacday, illaa maydooda aan meesha dhignay", ayuu yiri sarkaalka u hadlay dowladda Soomaaliya. Janaraal Sheegow ayaa tilmaamay in illaa 18 ka mid ah shabaab ay ku dileen dagaalka ka dhacay gobolka Shabellaha Hoose. AlShabaab ayaa sheegatay in ku dhowaad 30 askeri ay ku dileen weerarka, laakiin Janaraal Sheegow ayaa beeniyay arrintaas. Wuxuu Sheegow qiray in illaa 12 askeri ay ku dhinteen weerarka Al-Shabaab ee Bariire ay ku qaadeen saaka. Sidoo kale wuxuu Janaraalka beeniyay in Al-Shabaab ay qaateen gawaari xerada ciidamada tiilay. Kooxda ayaa sheegatay in 11 gaarii oo ay ka mid yihiin kuwa caafimaadka ka qaateen saldhigga. "Baabuurta waxay ahaayeen kuwa qaar kood ay haleysnaayeen, oo difaaca yaalay, oo baasuuko uu ku dhacay. Gawaarida way cuslaayeen, mid ay qarxiyeen iyo seddax kale; afar gaari baan ogahay hadda", ayuu yiri Janaraal Sheegow.

Waxa la sheegayaa in cuntadani ay ka mid ahaan jirtay kuwa ugu qaalisan ee la siin jiray boqorradii muslimiinta.
