Kalkii ugu danbeeyey ee Kenya heshay Kursiga, Soomaaliya ayaa taageertay Jabuuti oo Iyana u loolamaysay kursiga. Soomaaliya ayaan wali ka quusan inay olalaheeda raadinta sii wado. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sida ay marar badan ka sheegtay warbaahinta dadaalkii ugu badnaa galisay sidii dalku ugu biiri lahaa Dalada Bulshada Bariga Afrika oo ah dallad dhaqaale iyo bulsho oo ay ku midaysan yihiin dalal ku yaal bariga iyo bartamaha Afrika. Codsiga Soomaaliya oo la aqbalay ayaa waxaa socda qorshayaal farsamo oo ay ka wada shaqaynayaan guddiyo labada dhinac ah si loodhamaystiro ku biirista Soomaaliya ee dallada EACC. Suuq balaaran, isku socodka dadweynaha oo sahlanaada iyo qaadashada hal baasaboor ayaa kamid ah faa'iidooyin dhawr ah oo Soomaaliya ay doonayso inay ka hesho ku biirista dalladaan.

Maxay yihiin dadka aan Muslimka ahayn ee sooma bisha Ramadaan? Soonka bisha Ramadaan ayaa ka mid ah cibaadooyinka aasaasiga ah ee Islaamka, waana waajib Alle barakeeyay oo dhaca sanadkii mar. Balse waxaa su'aal mudan sababta dad aan Islaamka rumaysanayn ama xitaa aan diin oo idil aaminsanayn ay u soomaan bisha Ramadan. Qaar ka mid ah wadamada Islaamka, gaar ahaan kuwa carabta, waxaa lo ogyahay in jiraan dad muslim ah oo aan cibaadada laasimin inta badan balse sooma bisha Ramadaan. Dadkaas ayaa bulshooyinka carabta qaarkood looga dhex yaqaanaa "soon caabudayaal". Balse kuwaas ma ahan kuwa aan ka hadlayno, ama xitaa kuwa u sooma si ay isaga yareeyaan cadaadiska uga imaanaya bulshada. Waxaan rabnaa inaan diiradda saarno dad aan diin oo dhan shaqo ku lahayn balse sooma Ramadaanka. BBC laanteeda afka Carabiga ayaa waxa ay su'aalo waydiisay haween iyo rag ka soo kala jeeda wadamo kala duwan oo carbeed oo arrinkaan sameeya. Maadaama arrimahani ay xasaasi yihiin waxay la galnay shardi ah in aynu xogtooda shaqsiga ah banaanka keenin. Laba arrimood ayay u badatay jawaata dadkii nala hadlay kuwaas oo kala ah: in ay u sameeyaan sabab ruuxi iyo maskaxeed iyo sabab bulsho iyo qoys. Basma, oo u dhalatay dalka Tunisia, waxay ku nooshahay magaalo ku taal Yurub, waxaanay bilawdaa isu diyaarinta bisha Ramadaan toddobaadyo ka hor bilowga bisha. Diin kama ahan mana ku dhaqanto wax caadooyin diimeed ah sanadka oo dhan. "Hooyaday waxay ahayd qof diin leh oo aad ugu heellan, laakiin markaan weynaaday oo aan gurigayagii ka tagay, waxaan ka caasiyoobay caadooyinkaas, geeridii aabbahay iyo safarkaygii ka dib, Ramadaanku wuxuu qalbigayga ku lahaa meel gaar ah, taas oo ah nooc ka mid ah xusuusihii aan dhaxlay ee aan jaleeco ee la xiriira xilliyadii qoyskeenu isku imaan jireen." Basma waxay aad u jeceshay soonka, diyaarinta miiska cuntada iyo qurxintiisa, soo iibinta saxanada, go'yaasha, iyo ubaxyo, waxayna ku dadaashjaa inay u yeerto ehelkeeda si isu salaamaan, oo ay maalin walba waydiiso cuntooyinka ay u diyaarinayaan afurka. Marka laga yimaado Ramadaanka, waxay sanadkii intiisa kale sameysaa soon aan joogto ahayn, iyada oo ku sifaysay caadada noocaan mid ay " ku nadiifineyso ruuxda, ee aan diin ahayn." Waxa tiri, "Soonku waxa uu jirka siiyaa awood, marka aad soonto waa in aad si taxadar leh u doorataa waxa aad cunayso, tani waxa ay muhiim u tahay caafimaadka iyo edebta maskaxda labadaba, waxa ay sidoo kale wanaajisaa niyaddayda". Qodobka nafsiga ah ayaa aad muhiim ugu ah Raghad oo ka timid Lubnaan sababtoo ah waxay ku dhaqmeysaa farsamo maskaxda. Waxay tiri: "Soonku wuxuu ka caawiyaa fekerka iyo inuu maskaxdaada u keeno tamarta garashada, wuxuu kaa caawinayaa inaad maskax ahaan joogto adigoo meesha ka saaraya fikirka cunista, taas oo ka dhigaysa wacyigaagu inuu ka sii jiro meelo kale." Raghad yaraanteedi iyo koriimadeediiba waxa ay ahayd qof aad u diin iyo cibaado badan, balse sannadihii dambe ee nolosha waxa ay ka tagtay cibaadooyin badan, iyada oo ku qanacday in ay ilaaliso caadada soonka, waayo, sida ay hadalka u dhigtay, "faa'iido ayaa laga helayaa".

Ma shimbiro ayaa sababay shilkii diyaraadeed ee Kuuriyada Koofureed maxaase ugu dambeeyay? , In ka badan 170 qof ayaa dhintay ka dib markii diyaarad ay ku burburtay xilli ay ku degaysay Kuuriyada Koonfureed subaxnimadii Axadda. Muuqaallo murugo leh ayaa muujinaya diyaaradda Jeju Air oo ka soo kacaysa dhabbaha ay diyaaraduhu ku ordaan kahor inta aysan ku dhicin xayndaab oo uusan dab ka kicin iyada oo ku sugan garoonka caalamiga ah ee Muan. Diyaaradda oo ka soo laabatay magaalada Bangkok ee dalka Thailand, ayaa waxaa la socday 181-qof oo 179 ka mid ah ay dhinteen, halka laba ka mid ah shaqaalihii diyaaradda laga soo badbaadiyay burburka diyaaradda. Maamulka ayaa baaraya sababta keentay shilkan, iyadoo saraakiisha dab-damiska ay sheegeen in laga yaabo inay u dhacday shimbiro awgood iyo cimilada oo xumaatay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee khubarada ayaa sharraxay burburka diyaaradda inay sababi karaan dhowr arrimood. Duulimaadka, 7C2216, waxa ay ahayd Boeing 737-800 ay ku shaqaynaysay Jeju Air, oo ah diyaaradda ugu caansan ee miisaaniyadda Kuuriya. Diyaaradda ayaa timid magaalada Muan abbaare 09:00 xilliga maxalliga ah (00:00 GMT). Sarkaal ka tirsan waaxda gaadiidka ee Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaa sheegay in diyaaraddu ay isku dayday in ay degto balse lagu qasbay in ay joojiso ka dib markii maamulka hawada uu bixiyay digniin shimbiro ah oo ku saabsan khatarta ah in ay isku dhacaan shimbiraha iyo diyaaradda. Qiyaastii laba daqiiqo kadib, duuliyaha ayaa la hadlay qaybta adeegga deg-degga ah, waxaana taliska hawada uu fasaxay in diyaaradda ay kasoo degto jihada ka soo horjeeda, ayuu yiri sarkaalku. Hal muqaal ayaa u muuqda in uu muujinayo diyaaradda oo dhulka taabanaysa iyada oo aan isticmaalin taayirkeeda ama wax kale oo ay ku degto. Waxa ay ku sii dhacday dhabaha ay diyaaraduhu ku ordaan kadibna ay derbi ku dhacday inta uusan dabka ka kicin. Goobjooge ayaa u sheegay wakaaladda wararka ee Kuuriyada Koonfureed ee Yonhap in ay maqleen jug weyn oo ay ku xigeen "qaraxyo xiriir ah". Muuqaalo laga soo duubay goobta ayaa muujinaya diyaarada oo gubanaysa oo uu qiiq cirka isku shareeray. Kooxaha dab damiska ayaa markaas damiyay dabka. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Lee Jeong-hyun, oo ah madaxa waaxda dab-damiska ee Muan, ayaa u sheegay warbixin kooban oo laga sii daayay taleefishinka in shimbiro ku dhacay iyo cimilo xumada ay dhici karto in ay sababeen shilka, balse weli la baarayo sababta dhabta ah. Duulimaadka iyo cod duubayaasha diyaaradda ayaa la helay, inkastoo wakaaladda wararka ee Yonhap ay sheegtay in midkii hore uu burbur soo gaaray. Baaraha ayaa wakaaladda wararka u sheegay in sanduuqyada madow ay qaadan karaan muddo bil ah si loo kala saaro. Mid ka mid ah rakaabka diyaaradda ayaa farriin u diray qof ay ehel yihiin, isagoo sheegay in shimbir "ay baalka diyaaradda ku dhegan tahay" diyaaraddana ay soo degi weyday, sida ay ku warrantay warbaahinta gudaha. Saraakiisha, si kastaba ha ahaatee, ma aysan xaqiijin in shilka diyaaradda ay si dhab ah u sababeen wax shimbiro ah. Madaxa maamulka Jeju Air ayaa sheegay in shilkan uusan sabab u ahayn "wax arrimo dayactir ah". Waaxda gaadiidka ee Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaa sheegtay in duuliyaha diyaaradda uu shaqada hayay tan iyo 2019-kii, wuxuuna lahaa in ka badan 6,800 oo saacadood oo khibrad duulimaad ah. Isu soo baxyada shimbiraha waa isku dhaca u dhexeeya diyaarad duuleysa iyo shimbir. Aad ayey ugu badan yihiin gudaha UK, waxaa la soo sheegay in ka badan 1,400 shimbiro ah 2022, kaliya 100 ka mid ah ayaa saameeyay diyaarad, sida lagu sheegay xogta Hay'adda Duulista Rayidka. Weerarkii shimbiraha ee ugu caansanaa ayaa dhacay 2009, markii diyaarad Airbus ay si degdeg ah ugu degtay webiga Hudson ee New York ka. Dhammaan 155 rakaab ah iyo shaqaalihii diyaaradda ayaa badbaaday. Professor Doug Drury, oo duulista ka dhiga CQUniversity Australia, ayaa maqaal uu ku qoray The Conversation xagaagan ku sheegay in dayuuradaha Boeing ay leeyihiin matoorada turbofan, kuwaas oo si ba'an ay waxyeelo ugu geysan karto gadoodka shimbiraha. Waxa uu sheegay in duuliyayaasha loo tababaray inay si gaar ah u foojignaadaan xilliga aroorta ama qorrax dhaca oo ay shimbiruhu aad u socdaan. Balse qaar ka mid ah khubarada dhinaca duulimaadyada ayaa shaki ka qaba in shimbiro ku soo booday ay sababeen shilka ka dhacay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Muan iyo in kale. Diyaaradda ayaa siday 175 rakaab ah iyo lix shaqaale ah. Laba ka mid ah rakaabka ayaa u dhashay dalka Thailand, inta kalena waxa la rumaysan yahay in ay u dhasheen Kuuriyada Koonfureed, sida ay masuuliyiintu sheegeen. Qaar badan ayaa loo maleynayaa inay ka soo laabteen fasaxii kirismaska ee Thailand. Tirada rasmiga ah ee dhimashadu waxay maraysaa 179 - taasoo ka dhigaysa shilkii diyaaradeed ee ugu dhimashada badnaa taariikhda Kuuriyada Koonfureed. Dhammaan rakaabkii iyo afar ka mid ah shaqaalihii diyaaradda ayaa dhintay. Ku simaha madaxweynaha Choi Sang-mok ayaa amar ku bixiyay in si deg deg ah loo baaro guud ahaan shaqada diyaaradaha ee dalka. Muan ayaa sidoo kale lagu dhawaaqay aag musiibo gaar ah, kaas oo ka dhigaya maalgelinta dawladda dhexe mid ay heli karaan dawladda hoose iyo dhibbanayaasha. Dhammaan duullimaadyadii ka soo degi lahaa ama ka soo dagaya garoonka caalamiga ah ee Muan waa la joojiyay. Baroor diiq qaran oo todobada maalmood ah ayaa lagu dhawaaqay, waxaana laga yaabaa in la baajiyo ama la dhimo dabaaldegyada sanadka cusub ee dalka. Diyaaradda Boeing ayaa sheegtay inay la xiriirto Jeju Air ayna diyaar u tahay inay taageerto iyaga. Jeju Air ayaa raaligelin siisay qoysaska, iyadoo madaxa fulinta ee shirkadda uu shir jaraa'id ku sheegay in shirkadu aysan lahayn taariikh shilal ah. Waxaa la rumeysan yahay in shilkii Axaddii uu ahaa shilka kaliya ee dhimashada dhaliyay tan iyo markii la bilaabay diyaaradda 2005-tii.

Maya ee wax ka baro macluumaadkan muhiimka ah ee caafimaadkaaga ku saabsan , Sannad kasta, ku dhawaad ​​labo milyan oo Muslimiin ah oo ka kala yimid daafaha caalamka ayaa u xajiya magaalada barakeysan ee Maka ee dalka Sacuudiga si ay u soo gutaan waajibaadka Xajka, iyagoo soo dhammeysanaya mid ka mid ah shanta tiir ee Islaamka. Waa safar ruuxi ah oo dhaca inta lagu jiro Dul-Xijja, oo ah bisha ugu dambeysa ee taariikhda Islaamka. Sannadkan, waxa uu dhacayaa inta u dhaxaysa 4-9 June, halkaas oo in ka badan hal milyan oo Muslimiin ah la filayo in ay u safraan. Laakiin kaliya maaha safar ruuxi ah, ee waa hawl jireed oo daran. Inta u dhaxaysa kulaylka saxaraha, dad aad u fara badan, iyo socod dheer oo u dhexeeya caadooyinka la sameeyo, Xajku wuxuu jirka ku riixi karaa xadkiisa. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 1,300 oo qof ay sannadkii hore ku dhinteen Xajka, kuwaasoo intooda badan ay masaafo dheer u socdeen xilli uu jiray kulayl xooggan. Dad lagu qiyaasay 1.8m ayaa ka soo qayb galay. Waa kuwan qaar ka mid ah talooyin ku saabsan sida aad u caafimaad qabtid intaad ku jirto falkan caqiidada ee aan caadiga ahayn. Sawirka, Diyaargarawgu waa muhiim ka hor inta aan cagta la saarin dhulka Sacuudi Carabiya. Khubarrada caafimaadku waxay ku talinayaan in caafimaadka jirka si buuxda loo baaro, gaar ahaan xujayda da'da ah iyo kuwa qaba xanuunnada dabadheeraada, sida macaanka, neefta, kansarka ama wadne xanuunka. Hubi in aad haysato dhammaan tallaallada qasabka ah ee ay u baahan tahay dawladda Sucuudigu. Tan waxaa ku jira kuwa loogu talagalay qoorgooyaha, oo la xakameynayo ugu yaraan toban maalmood ka hor inta aan la imaan Xajka, iyo Covid-19. Dadka safarka ah ee ka imaanaya waddamada ay ku badan yihiin cudurka dabeysha iyo qandhada jaallaha ah waa inay sidoo kale haystaan ​​tallaalkooda cusub. Sawirka, Marka la eego tirada badan ee dadka Xajka tagaya, adeegyada caafimaad ee maxalliga ah ayaa noqon kara mid xad dhaaf ah, sidaas darteed waxaa habboon inaad adigu isku tiirsanaato halka ay suurtagal tahay. Haddii aad qaadanayso dawo laguu qoray, iska hubi inaad sidato in kugu filan muddada safarka. Khubarradu waxa ay ku talinayaan inaad soo qaadato bac ay ku jiraan xanuun baabi'iye, dawooyinka shubanka, sahayda gargaarka ee dhaawacyada fudud, gacmo nadiifiyaha iyo waji-xirka. Sawirka, Tababarka jireed ayaa lagula talinayaa dadka, gaar ahaan kuwa aan u baran inay masaafo dheer u socdaan heerkulka sare. Xajku waxaa la gutaa dhawr cibaado oo ku baahsan meelo kala duwan oo ku xeeran Maka. Celcelis ahaan, xaajigu wuxuu socon doonaa shan ilaa 13 kilomitir maalintii inta u dhaxaysa goobahaas. Si loo dhiso adkeysi loona yareeyo khatarta daalka ama dhaawaca, khubarradu waxay ku talinayaan in la bilaabo jimicsiga khafiifka ilaa dhexdhexaadka ah ugu yaraan saddex toddobaad ka hor si uu jirku ula qabsado. Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Heerkulka Sacuudi Carabiya wuxuu gaari karaa ilaa 51C. Jirka bini'aadamka, taasi waxay la mid tahay in la hor istaago foorno kulul oo furan oo aan laga baxsan karin. Kulaylka aadka u ba'an, jirku wuxuu bilaabaa inuu la halgamo si uu isu qaboojiyo, taas oo markaa u horseedi karta dhib ka soo gaarta kulaylka iyo daal. In kasta oo ay digniinno ka soo baxday wasaaradda caafimaadka Sucuudiga oo ku saabsan in laga fogaado kulaylka iyo in aad biyo badan cabto, haddana xujaaj badan ayaa dhibbane u noqday kulaylka. Sannadkan, dawladdu waxay sheegtay in ay ballaarisay awoodda shaqaalaha caafimaadka oo ay samaysay 400 oo biyo qaboojiye ah iyo sidoo kale mishiinnada biyaha buufiya si ay xujaajta uga caawiyaan kulaylka. "Sanadkan, waxaa diiradda la saaray xaaladaha kulaylka la xiriira, sababtoo ah Xajku wuxuu ku soo beegmayaa kulayl aad u daran. Sannadkan heerka kulaylku wuxuu marayaa heerkii ugu sarreeyay," ayuu wasiir ku xigeenka caafimaadka dadwaynaha Sucuudiga,Cabdullaahi Asiri u sheegay wakaaladda wararka ee AFP. Xujaajta waxa lagula talinayaa in ay si joogto ah biyo u cabaan xitaa marka aanay harraadin, halka ay suurtagal tahayna, waxa ay sidanayaan dhalooyin biyaha qaboojiya. Waqti u qabo hawlahaaga dibadda si aad uga fogaato saacadaha kulaylka ugu sarreeya, kuwaas oo u dhexeeya 11:00 iyo 15:00. Ka fogow meelaha dadku ku badan yahay oo had iyo jeer raadi hadh ama meelo hawo fiican leh. Kareen ka-hortagga cadceedda oo xaddigiisu yahay 30 ama ka badan waa in la isticmaalo oo dib loo marsado labadii saacadoodba mar si looga fogaado gubashada. Dharka la neefsan karo, midabka iftiinka ah ayaa sidoo kale caawiya inuu jirku qaboojiyo sababtoo ah waxay ka tarjumaysaa iftiinka qorraxda. Kabo hawo fiican leh oo leh taageero weyn ayaa lagula talinayaa. Dalladaha midabka khafiifka ah ama milicsiga ayaa ka celin kara kulaylka. Ha illoobin calaamadaha daal, dawakhaad ama lalabbo, sababtoo ah waxay caddayn karaan khatar. Sawirka, Meesha ay dadku isugu yimaadaan iyagoo ah tiro aad u badan, khatarta caabuqu way korortaa, nadaafadda oo xunna waxay qufac fudud u rogi kartaa mid faafa. Si looga hortago cudurrada, xujaajta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay si joogto ah gacmaha ugu dhaqdaan saabuun iyo biyo ama ay isticmaalaan gacmo nadiifiyaha. Maaskarada wejiga ayaa sidoo kale lagula talinayaa si looga fogaado faafinta cudurrada neef-mareenka. Meelo badan oo gudaha ah ayaa qaboojiyaha hawada lagu xiray, markaa waxaa laga yaabaa inaad u aragto wax fudud xirashada maaskarada meelaha qabow. La soco wixii ku saabsan ogaysiisyada maamulka. Saraakiisha Sacuudiga ayaa sheegay in ay diyaariyeen habab lagu bixinayo digniinaha caafimaadka iyo cimilada inta lagu jiro xaaladaha ugu daran iyo ciriiriga. Waxaa kale oo lagugula talinayaa inaad haysato kaar ay ku qoran yihiin taariikhdaada caafimaad iyo macluumaadka xiriirka degdega ah mar kasta. Soo ogow meesha tas-hiilaadka caafimaad ee kuugu dhow.

Waxa uu si gaar ah u dhaleeceeyay istaraatiijiyadda cusub ee Amniga Qaranka Mareykanka, iyo soo jeedinteeda ah in Mareykanka uu gacan ka geysan doono badbaadinta Dimuqraadiyadda Yurub - Yurub uma baahna in Mareykanka uu ka caawiyo arrintan, ayuu yiri hogaamiyaha jarmalka. Dhanka kale mar wax laga waydiiyay arrinta soo galootiga iyo tahriibayasha soo gala dalalka Yurub ayuu Trump ku tilmaamay sisadaha Yurub ee soo galootiga kuwa miisbo oo . Waxaa uu farta ku fiiqay in haddii xaaladaha muhaajiriinta kus oo qulqulaya Yurub ay sidan sii ahaato ay Yurub noqon doono meel quruntay. Hadalka Trump ee uu ku dhaleeceeyay siyaasadaha Yurub ee socdaalka ayaa ku soo beegmaya maalin uuu ka dib markii golaha midowga Yurub ay isku raaceen adkeynta siyaasadaha looga hortagayo soo galootiga sharcidarrada ah. Trump wuxuu sii waday inuu cadaadis saaro Zelensky si uu u oggolaado heshiis lagu soo afjarayo khilaafka. Zelensky, mar dambe oo Talaadadii qoraal uu soo dhigay barta X, ayuu ku sheegay in Ukraine iyo Yurub ay si firfircoon uga shaqeynayaan "dhammaan tallaaboyinka suurtagalka ah ee loo qaadi karo dhanka iyo joojinta dagaalka," iyo in qeybaha kaga aaddan Ukraine iyo Yurub ee qorshaha hadda la sii horumariyay. Wuxuu markaas u sheegay suxufiyiinta inuu rumeysan yahay in qorshayaasha loo gudbin doono Mareykanka Arbacada. Dhaleeceyntii ugu dambeysay ee Trump uu u jeediyo Yurub ayaa timid maalin ka dib markii hoggaamiyeyaasha Yurub ay isugu yimaadeen London si ay uga wada hadlaan dadaalladooda wadajirka ah ee lagu joojinayo dagaalka Ukraine. Markii la weydiiyay in Yurub ay gacan ka geysan karto joojinta dagaalka, Trump wuxuu yiri: "Way hadlaan laakiin ma soo saaraan wax miro-dhal ah. Dagaalkuna wuu socdaa oo socdaa." Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay wadahadallo goonni ah la yeeshay saraakiisha Ukraine iyo Ruushka iyagoo isku dayaya inay dhexdhexaadiyaan aoo af-jaridda dagaalka. Illaa iyo hadda, wax heshiis ah lama gaarin. Madaxweynaha Ukraine ayaa ku cadaadiyay hoggaamiyeyaasha Yurub iyo Nato inay gacan ka geystaan ka hor-tagga Mareykanka inuu taageero heshiis ay Kyiv ka cabsi qabto inuu u nugleeyo weerarrada mustaqbalka. Axaddii Trump wuxuu soo jeediyay, isaga oo aan caddeyn u heyn, in Zelensky uu ahaa caqabadda ugu weyn ee nabadda. Wuxuu u sheegay suxufiyiinta in Ruushku uu "raalli ku yahay" qorshaha nabadeed ee uu Mareykanka u soo bandhigay labada dhinac, kaas oo ay ku jireen tanaasulaad waaweyn oo loo sameynayo Ukraine iyo in xulafada ay ka baqayeen inuu ka dhigo mid u nugul duullaan mustaqbalka ah. Wareysiga Politico, wuxuu ku andacooday in dhexdhexaadiyeyaasha Ukraine ay "jecleysteen" soo jeedinta Mareykanka taageeray, wuxuuna ku eedeeyay in Zelensky uusan weli akhrin. Trump sidoo kale wuxuu ku celceliyay hadalladii hore ee Kyiv ee ku aaddanaa in ay qabato doorashooyin wuxuuna ku andacooday inay "isticmaaleyso dagaalka" si ay u diiddo in ay sidaas sameyso. Wuxuu yiri: "Waa ogtahay, waxay ka hadlaan dimoqraaddiyad, laakiin waxay gaareysaa meel aan dimoqraadiyad ahayn mar dambe." Muddada shanta sano ee Zelensky uu madaxweynaha ka ahaa ayaa ku ekeyd bishii May 2024, laakiin doorashooyinka waa laga hakiyay Ukraine tan iyo markii sharciga dagaalka lagu soo rogay ka dib duullaankii Ruushka. Isagoo la hadlayay suxufiyiinta ka dib faallooyinkii Trump, Zelensky wuxuu sheegay inuu "diyaar u yahay doorashooyinka" wuxuuna codsan doonaa in la diyaariyo soo jeedinno wax ka beddeli kara sharciga. Doorashooyinka waa la qaban karaa 60 ilaa 90ka maalmood ee soo socda haddii amniga la damaanad qaado iyadoo la kaashanayo Mareykanka iyo xulafada kale, ayuu u sheegay suxufiyiinta. Sidoo kale wareysiga Politico, Trump wuxuu ku andacooday in kala qeybsanaanta fikradeed ay hadda khatar ku tahay inay kala dhantaasho isbahaysiga Washington ay la leedahay Yurub. Markii la weydiiyay in hoggaamiyeyaasha uu u arko inay daciif yihiin ay weli noqon karaan xulafo, wuxuu ku jawaabay: "Waxay ku xiran tahay dhinacyo badan", isagoo intaa raaciyay: "Waxaan u maleynayaa inay daciif yihiin, laakiin sidoo kale waxaan u maleynayaa inay rabaan inay noqdaan kuwo siyaasad ahaan saxan. Waxaan u maleynayaa inaysan garaneyn wax ay sameeyaan." Hadallada madaxweynaha ayaa yimid ka dib markii maamulkiisu uu soo saaray Istaraatiijiyadda Cusub ee Amniga Qaranka ee 33-ka bog ah, taas oo ka digtay "tirtiridda ilbaxnimada" ee suurtagalka ah ee Yurub iyadoo su'aal gelisay in qaar ka mid ah waddamada ay weli noqon karaan xulafo la isku halleyn karo.

The woman helping amputees rebuild their lives in war-torn Ukraine Serhiy Petchenko lost both hands while defending Ukraine from Russian invaders in June 2023. After surviving the bitter months-long battle for the city of Bakhmut, his injury came in a railway incident further from the front line. It left the 42-year-old feeling helpless and in despair. After the amputations, his wife, Anna, had to remain by his side 24/7 for six months. "What helped us survive is our love," says Serhiy. But it's hard to believe he went through such an ordeal when you see him now, standing on the doorstep of a brand-new café, which he is about to open in Lviv, in the west of Ukraine. He smiles widely, his arms - and hands - by his side. Serhiy received two prosthetic hands and full rehabilitation at the Superhumans Center, a private clinic for people with war injuries, located outside the city. At the same time, the couple received the training they needed to open a family business. Serhiy says the centre gave him a chance to return normal life, while learning to live with a new disability. At least 50,000 Ukrainians have lost limbs in nearly three years of war according to the Ukrainian Health Ministry - both soldiers and civilians. "Some people have double, triple, quadruple amputations. All these people will need prosthetics, or some will use wheelchairs," says Olga Rudnieva, CEO and co-founder of the Superhumans Center. Many amputations are the result of delays in evacuation from the battlefield. The barrage of incoming fire can be so intense that it may take many hours to get a wounded soldier to hospital. With more than one million people on the front line, Rudnieva says, Ukraine will become "the country of people with disabilities". "We want to normalise disability. OK, that's how the country is going to look," she says, describing the thinking behind her centre. "Most of the people here at the centre shouldn't be alive. The fact that they are is a miracle in itself." Rudnieva co-founded the centre amid the Russian missile attacks that have rained down on the country since February 2022. Some people called her "crazy" but she went ahead anyway. "If I have an opinion, I'm sharing my opinion. If I know what to do, I just go and do it," she says. Her partners and team raised funds all over the world for high-quality prosthetics and reconstructive surgery. Her passionate presentation, explaining how injuries can be empowering, turned some celebrities into Superhumans supporters, including British adventurer Bear Grylls, Virgin boss Richard Branson, singer Sting and actress Trudie Styler. "We truly believe that you can be empowered by trauma. The trauma can ruin you or it can build your superpower," she says. The Superhumans Center supplements Ukraine's military hospitals and clinics, which are overloaded with the constant flow of wounded soldiers from the 3,200km long front line. Since it opened in April 2023, more than 1,000 patients have received treatment here - both military and civilian, adults and children. Almost 800 of them have received prosthetic limbs. "It's the global headquarters of resilience," says 47-year-old Rudnieva. walking energetically between patients' wheelchairs. They are waiting for modern prosthetics or are already practising to use their new limbs. She asks some of the young men around, with double and triple amputations, to show her what they have learnt so far. Ukrainian soldiers use callsigns instead of names, and Rudnieva has one too - "Mum". "They learned to walk with their mothers, and I was the second person they learned how to walk with," she says proudly. At the start of the war, Ukraine was not ready to support so many people with disabilities. "Ukrainian soldiers are less afraid to be killed than to be wounded, because a severe injury means you are going to be disabled for the rest of your life – and the infrastructure is not right, and society is not ready, and the healthcare system is not right," says Rudnieva. A few times a day she visits the rehabilitation room where the "superhumans", as she calls them, are learning to walk again. Among the battle-hardened men is gentle Olena, a bakery manager from the city of Kostiantynivka in eastern Ukraine. She lost her leg in a Russian rocket strike on the way to her mum's birthday party. "The first thing I'll do when I have my artificial leg, if the weather is fine, is just go for a walk. Without any rush, without an aim. I'll just take a walk to recall how it feels," she says. At present she uses a leg that belongs to the rehabilitation room, but soon she will have one of her own. Rudnieva remembers Olena's story in detail, and the stories of her other patients. She knows about their wives and husbands, parents and pre-war jobs. "Younger guys bring me their girlfriends and ask my opinion," she says, with a smile. Couples have even come came to her before taking a decision on whether to divorce or not. A severe war injury is a challenge not just for the survivor, but for his or her entire family, and it tests relationships. Showing the newly equipped children's room, Rudnieva smiles. "We are waiting today for Nazarchyk, Serhiy and Anna's son. He is so active. He will turn it upside down." Rudnieva says that her work has taught her to value life as never before, and also to stop fearing death. Once a director of the Olena Pinchuk Foundation, working to halt the spread of HIV/Aids across Ukraine, she was abroad when Russia invaded. For a few months she ran a humanitarian aid hub in Poland, then she returned to Ukraine and founded her life-changing project. She wasn't the only one. Ukrainian civil society quickly rallied round, both to support the war effort - fundraising for drones and vehicles, importing medical equipment or clothing - and to keep society going while the country fought for its life. There are now other private rehabilitation centres, ambulances and taxis that help evacuate people from half-destroyed towns, food services for refugees, and many other initiatives that supplement services provided by the state. And women have played a key role. "When the full-scale invasion started, I, as a feminist, was very scared. I thought that it's the end of feminism, because war is a very masculine thing," Rudnieva says. But later on she realised that women have taken over many responsibilities as men have gone away to fight, as well as in some cases becoming fighters too. "I think that women proved to be absolutely amazing during this war," says Rudnieva, as some of her words are drowned out by sirens - part of the soundtrack of Ukraine's new life. Xanuunka laga qaado cabashada badan , Aynu eegno xaalad caadi ah. Ka soo qaad labo qof oo wadada dhinaceeda ku ordaya oo is dhaafay. Waxaa laga yaabaa in ay saaxiibo yihiin, ama xiriir kale ka dhexeeyo. Mid ka mid ah ayaa kan kale salaamay isagoo dhahaya, sidee tahay? Isla markiiba qofka kale ayaa ku jawaabaya isagoo leh xaaladda ma fiicno. Sidaas ayeyna ku kala tagaan. Hadalkaas kooban ee lays dhaafsaday wax dhibaato ah ma laha, waana hab ay dadka caadiyan ku xiriiraan. Waana wax iska caadi ah marka sidaas laysula hadlo in dadku ka cawdaan waxyaabo yar yar sida ciriiriga waddada, cimilada ama shaqada. Dadka qaar in ay dareenkan kula wadaagaan wax dhibaato ah ma lahan or ama wayba caawineysaa maadaama ay siineyso fursad ay dareenkooda kaga hadlaan. Si kasta ha ahaatee, cabashada badan waxay leedahay saameyn qoto dheer. Ma saameyso oo kaliya maskaxda iyo shucuurta qofka cabanaya ee waxay sidoo kale saameysaa dhageystaha. Muddo ka dib dareenka xun wuxuu sidoo kale saameynayaa caafimaadka jireed taas oo ka dhigaysa in uu xadka dhaafo. Sawirka, Halkan waxaan kaga hadleynaa qanacsannaan la’aanta soo noqnoqota, niyad jabka ama murugada ka timaada xaalada dareenka xun. Waa dhibaato guud taas oo laga arki karo qoyska dhexdiisa shaqada ama arrimaha kale ee bulsho. Mararka qaar cabashada waa dareen aadanaha ku jira. Daalka jireed iyo kan niyadda laga daalo waxa uu yimaadaa marka xaalad aan fiicneyn ay saameyso nolol maalmeedkaada joogtada ah. Haddaba maxaa keena in aan cabano markasta? Khubrada qaar ayaa aaminsan in sababta keenta cabashada ay tahay si loo yareeyo walaaca ama in la helo taageero. Sidoo kale waa arin bulsho oo dadka ku wada xiriiraan taas oo aadanaha ku dhaqmo. Dhibaatadu waxay timaadaa marka ay noqoto cabashada mid joogto ah. Xaaladda waxaa kaga sii dara marka cabashada la geeyo baraha bulshada ama si khaldan loogu isticmaalo. In cabashada la keeno baraha bulshada waa wax lagu yaqaano dhallinyarada iyo kuwa baraha bulshada saameynta ku leh. Waxay u sameeyaan in ay helaan dareenka dadka ku taxan ama in ay abuuraan dood. Inkastoo tani muhiim u tahay qeybaha cilmibaarista, hadana waxay u baahan in si weyn loo sii darso. Dhakhaatiirta cilmiga neerfaha ayaa hore ugu sameeyay baaris cabashada iyo cawaaqibka ka dhashay in wax walba la eedeeyo. Cilmibaarisyo kala duwan ayaa xaqiijiyay in maskaxda bani’aadanka loo sameeyay in ay ogaato khataraha iyo dhibaatooyinka taas ayaana sharaxeysa sababta ay ugu fududahay in diiradda la saaro dareenka xun iyo sababta ay dadka qaarkii ugu sahlan tahay. Maskaxda bani’aadanka waxay diiradda saartaa xumaanta sababtoo ah waxay taas u muujisa khatar dhab ah, waana arrin kumanaan sano soo jirtay. Saameyntaas waxaa la yiraahdaa “Diidmo aan wax ku ool aheyn” taas oo dhibaato u geysan karta deegaanka aad ku nooshahay. In si joogto ah diiradda loo saaro arrimaha khaldan waxay wax ka badaleysaa sida dadka adduunka u arkaan. Sawirka, Daarasadaha qaar ayaa muujinaya in falka cabashada ama qoomameynta joogtada ah ay keeni karaan isbeddel ku yimaada qaab dhismeedka maskaxda taas oo horseedi karta in dhibaato la xaliyo iyo dhibaato kale. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in qofka cabanaya ay suuragal tahay in uu fahmo howlo ay ka mid yihiin xallin dhibaato, go’aan gaaris ama qorshooyn. Sidoo kale waxay abuureysaa niyad jab dheeri ah oo ka yimaada cabashadaas. Waxaa kaloo la ogaaday in ay cabashooyinka joogtada ah ay yihiin kuwa keena welwelka iyo niyadjabka. Waxyaabo kale ay keeneyso waxaa ka mid ah dhallanteed, kalsooni- darro, daal jireed iyo mid maskaxeed. Dadka ka cawda wax kasta waa kuwo niyad jabsan oo aan u adkeysan karin dhibaatooyinka soo wajaha. Halkan waxaan idinku haynaa sida ugu fudud ee wax looga qaban karo aragtida xun iyo dhibaatada maskaxeed ay leedahay. Ku qanacsanow waxa aad haysato adigoo diirada saaraya halka aad mareyso kana mahad naqaya waxa aad gaartay. Waa in aad sidoo kale xal heshaa. Waxaad sameysaa liiska wixii suuragal ah ee lagu hagaajin karo xaaladda taas oo ku siineysa dareen aad xaaladda ku xukumi karto. Dhakhaatiirta maskaxda waxay noo sheegan hadii aad ka warhayso luuqadda aad isticmaaleyso oo aad ka dhigto mid fiican ama dhexdhexaad ah waxay taas kaa caawineysaa in aan baddesho fakarkaada. Sidoo kale waxaad ka fogaataa sheekooyinka xun ee aan xalka fiican dhibaatada u keeneyn. Waxaa shaki ku jirin hadii aad ka fogaato cabashada joogtada ah in ay taasi kor u qaadeyso tayada noloshaada.

Iiraan Soomaaliya ma u weerari kartaa Mareykanka dartii? , Naqshadeynta BBC Waddamada Khaliijka ayaa arkay ayagoo dhexda ka taagan safka hore ee dagaalka ka curtay Bariga Dhexe, arrintaasna caro ayey galisay. Iiraan ayaa aargoosi kaga jawaabtay duqaymaha cirka ee Maraykanka iyo Israa'iil iyadoo ku ridday boqollaal gantaallo ah iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee loo yaqaan Drones-ka oo ay ku garaacday deriskeeda Carabta, waxaana aybar tilmaameedsatay saldhigyada millatariga Maraykanka ee gobolka iyo sidoo kale kaabayaasha rayidka iyo tamarta. Waxay bartilmaameedsanaysaa sawirka Khaliijka laga haysto oo ah goob bedqab leh, oo ku fiican socdaalka, dalxiiska iyo dhaqaalaha, sido kale waxay ku dhaqaaqday khalkhal gelinta warshadaha saliidda iyo gaasta dabiiciga ah. Inta badan gantaalada Iiraan ayaa lagu qabtaa hawada guud ahaan gobolka, laakiin burburka soo dhacaya ayuu dab ka dhashaa kuwaasoo ay dad ku dhinteen. Diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee sida fudud uga gudbi kara difaacyada hawada ayaa inta badan sababa qasaaraha ugu yar balse sidaasoo ay tahay waxay abuuraan qalalaase carqaladeeya ganacsiga iyo socdaalka. Kadib weerarradaas ay Iiraan ku qaadday bartilmaameedyo Mareykan ah oo ku yaalla Bariga Dhexe, waxaa soo baxaya su'aalo iyo walaac ah in saldhigyada Mareykanka iyo joogitaankooda ka baxsan gobolkaas, gaar ahaan gudaha Soomaaliya, ay halis ku jiraan. Saldhigga Balidoogle, oo ku yaalla gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose qiyaastiina 90km waqooyi-galbeed kaga beegan Muqdisho, waa xarun milatari oo ay ka hawlgalaan ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo ciidamada Mareykanka. Saldhiggan ayaa muhiim u ah howlgallada ka dhanka ah al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan duqeymaha iyo kormeerka lagu fuliyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu tababaraa cutubyada Danab ee militariga Soomaaliya. Sawirka, U.S. Marine Corps Balidoogle waxaa si joogto ah uga hawlgala ciidamo Mareykan ah oo ay ku jiraan cutubyo khaas ah, iyo tababarayaal. Saldhiggan waxaa lagu xoojiyaa kaabayaasha diyaaradaha, guryaha ciidamada, iyo xarumo tababar, taasoo ka dhigaysa meel istiraatiiji ah oo qeyb ka ah hawlgallada Mareykanka ee Geeska Afrika. Warbixinno madax-bannaan iyo warbaahinta caalamiga ah ayaa marar badan tilmaamay in saldhigga uu yahay xarun ay Mareykanku u isticmaalaan si joogto ah, oo ay ku jiraan howlgalada tababarka iyo duqeymaha ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Marka la eego masaafo ahaan, Soomaaliya aad ayay uga fog tahay Iiraan. Caasimadda Tehran waxay Muqdisho u jirtaa in ka badan 3,000 kiiloomitir. Saldhiga Balidoogle, maaddaama uu ku yaallo gudaha dalka, wuxuu ka sii fogaanayaa masaafo intaas ka badan. Awoodda gantaallada Iiraan ee la ogyahay ayaa inta badan ku kooban riddo gaaban iyo mid dhexe. Gantaallada nooca Fateh ayaa inta badan gaari kara wax ka yar 1,500km, halka gantaalka Shahab-3 uu gaari karo masaafa qiyaastii ku dhow 2,000km. Sawirka, Safiirka Iiraan ee Kenya ayaa sheegay in aanu jirin saldhig Mareykan ah oo ku yaalla Bariga Afrika oo istiraatiiji ahaan mudan in la weeraro, wuxuuna intaa ku daray in gantaallada dalkiisu aysan farsamo ahaan gaari karin gobolkaas. Marka la isku geeyo masaafada juqraafiyeed iyo awoodda gantaallada ee la xaqiijiyay, Balidoogle waa xarun milatari oo ay Mareykanku si firfircoon uga hawlgalaan, laakiin Soomaaliya waxay ka baxsan tahay masaafada gantaallada Iiraan ee la xaqiijiyay. Xiisadaha gobolka ayaa weli taagan, balse dhinaca farsamada, ma jiraan gantaallo Iiraan ah oo si toos ah u gaari kara goobaha ay ka joogaan Mareykanku Soomaaliya.

Wax ka ogow 10-ka magaalo ee ugu waxbarashada fiican adduunka London ayaa mar kale hoggaanka u heysa meelaha ugu fiican ee ardayda caalamka ay waxbarasho u doonan karaan, sida laga soo xigtay qiimeyntii ugu dambeysay ee shirkadda la talinta ee Britain ee QS ay ka sameysay Magaalooyinka Ardayda ee ugu Wanaagsan 2023. Buenos Aires ayaa noqotay magaalada ugu horreysa ee Latin America waxayna qiimeynta uga jirtaa 23. Waxaa intaa dheer, sanadkan waxaa ku jira saddex magaalo oo Latin America ku yaalla oo markii ugu horreysay liiska soo galay. Waxaa xusid mudan in magaalo walba ay ku nool yihiin in ka badan 250,000 oo qof waxaana ku yaalla ugu yaraan labo jaamacad oo hore ugu jiray qiimeynta jaamacadaha oo ay isla shirkadda sameysay. Waxyaabaha kale ee qiimeynta lagu daray waxaa ka mid ah inta arday ee magaaladaas ku nool, inta qof ee caalamka kale ka timid, iyo sida ay magaaladu u qaabisho dadyowga kala duwan. Sidoo kale haddii ay magaaladu ammaan tahay, maciishaddu haddii ay fiican tahay oo ay ku filan tahay ardayda, iyo sidoo kale fursadaha shaqo ee laga helayo. Caasimadda UK ayaa ugu sarreysa liiska iyadoo loo xushay inay tahay "mid ay dadyow kala duwna ku nool yihiin ayna ardayda siineyso wax walba sida madxafyo waaweyn iyo cunnooyin kala duwan. Waxaa ku yaalla xarumaha waxbarasho ee ugu waaweyn uguna sarreeya caalamka sida King's College London iyo UCL (University College London). Haddaba waa kuwee magaalooyinka kale ee liiska ku jira? , Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Qiimeynta waxaa ku jira 10 magaalo oo Latin America ku yaalla, inkastoo aysan kaalmo fiican soo gelin. Buenos Aires ayaa liiska magaalooyinkaas Latin America ugu horreysa sanadkii afaraad oo isku xiga, inkastoo ay lumisay dhibco ayna soo gashay kalainta 23-aad, iyadoo hal dhibic ka hoos martay. Waxaa qiimeynta lagu sheegay ij caasimadda Arjantiin ay tahay magaalo casri ah oo soo koreysa ayna tahay magaalada ugu fiican ee ay waxbarasho ka heli karaan ardayda ku hadasha afka Spanish-ka. La yaab malaha in Buenos Aires ay hoy u tahay 10 jaamacad oo ka mid ah kuwa ugu fiican caalamka, sida laga soo xigtay qiimeyn ay isla shirkadda sameysay. Waxaa kale oo xusid mudan in dadka ka qalin jebiyay jaamacadahan ay sumcad fiican ku dhex leeyihiin shirkadaha wax shaqaaleysiiya. Inkastoo ay tilmaameen in weli ay jiraan meelo u baahan horumarin, oo ay ka mid tahay ku noolaanshaha magaalada. Kaalinta 60-aad waxaa soo gashay magaalo kale oo Latin America ku taalla, waana Santiago oo caasimadda Chile ah. Qiimeynta waxaa lagu sheegay inay magaalada ku nool yihiin arday yar oo caalamka ka timid. Magaalada Mexico ayaa iyadana kaalinta 68-aad soo gashay. Inkastoo magaalada ay caan ku tahay cunnooyinka waddooyinka lagu iibiyo, goobaha taariikhiga ah iyo caweyska habeenkii, haddana waxaa ku badan wasakhowga hawada iyo dembiyada. Magaalooyinka kale waxaa ka mid ah Sao Paolo (Brazil ) oo kaalinta 86-aad gashay.

Abwaan Axmed Saleebaan Bidde iyo Qisadii jacaylka ee 30-ka sano Inantii uu dhallinyarannimadiisii jeclaa oo AYEEYO ah ayuu nasiibku dib u kulmiyay, wuuna guursaday. Abwaan Axmed Saleebaan-Bidde iyo Amran-Leexo in ka badan 22 sano ayay is jeclaayeen, ka dibna way is calfadeen, ilaa maanta—oo ay in ka badan 30 sannadood is qabaan—waa lammaane is jecel. Abwaan Bidde, run ahaan, waa badweyn, wuxuuna leeyahay fan iyo taariikh hodan ah, iyo sheekooyin nololeed oo kala jaadad ah. Haddaba qoraallo kale ayaynnu kaga faalloon doonnaa Abwaan Bidde, nolol iyo fanba, laakiin warbixintani waxay ku eg tahay sheeko keli ah—LEEXO. Waa qiso jacayl oo taariikhda iyo fanka Axmed S Bidde waax ka ah. In uu halabuurka fanka Soomaalida ugu magaca dheer ku jiro ka sokow, dhab ahaan, wuxuu ku sifoobay erayga "abwaan." Abwaan Bidde waa maansayahan heesihiisa facba fac u gudbiyo oo erayadiisa bulshadu ku halqabsato. Waa codsameeye laxameeyay tiro heeso ah oo ka dhex sheeggan fanka. Waa jilaa iyo maadeeye masraxa kaalin muddakar ah ku leh. Waana mu'allif dhisay 45 riwaayadood oo badiba tisqaad ah. Mar kale, Abwaan Bidde, waa mutacallin leh xirfado dhawr ah, dalmar afaf kala duwan ku hadla, kuna sifaysan fikir ilbax ah iyo anshax korran. Abwaan Bidde fankiisa waxa gundhig u ah, jaad walba oo halabuurkiisa ahna ku marriiman, dhaqanka iyo waayaha Soomaalida. Si guudna, waxa fankiisa laga dhex dheehanayaa duruufaha dunida. Haddaba, Axmed Saleebaan-Bidde Maxamed, sida uu ku xusay waraysi ay Laanta Af Soomaaliga ee BBC la yeelatay, Hargeysa ayuu ku dhashay, 1943. Dugsigii Booliska ee Madheera (Somaliland) ayuu tacliintiisiina ku qaatay. Iskuulka ka dib, farsamada korontada ayuu ka bartay Warshaddii Laydhka ee Hargeysa, xirfaddan buuna gobollo iyo goobo kala geddisan kaga shaqeeyay fanka ka hor, sida uu ku sheegay barnaamijka Madasha Halabuurka ee Telefishanka Qaranka JSL. Axmed wuxuu ka dhashay qoys suugaanyahan ah, dhanka aabbaha iyo dhinaca hooyadaba. Sidaas darteed, halabuurnimadiisa waxa loo tiirin karaa "hidderaac" iyo hibo dhalan ah, sida uu ku sheegay waraysi uu siiyay Telefishanka Universal. Abwaan Bidde, sida uu ku xusay waraysi uu Telefishanka Qaranka JSL la yeeshay, intii uu dugsiga ku jiray wuxuu samayn jiray, oo iskuulka ku bandhigi jiay, riwaayado gaagaaban oo maaweelo carruureed ah. Taa ka dib, 1962 ayuu fankiisu masraxa halabsaday, oo halabuurkiisu fagaaraha dadweynaha yimi, dal iyo debedba, ilaa maantana badweynta fanka ayuu ku dhex jiraa, sida laga akhrisan karo waxsoosaarka iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa faneed ee uu ilaa waqtigan u darban yahay. Riwaayadihiisa waxaynnu ka xusi karnaa "Alla'aamin ma iisho", "Jeel iyo jacayl", "Dalwanaaje qurbow" iyo kuwo kale; heesihiisana waxaynnu ka magacdhebi karnaa "Sida geed caleen loo", "Geeri doontee maanta aan go'o", "Haddii aanan dhulkaygow", Waa laysu soo noqon", "Si yar maw shushubateen"… iyo qaar kale. Abwaan Bidde suugaantiisu, Soomaalida ka sokow, laamaha kala duwan ee nolosha iyo waayaha dunida ayay wax ka taabanaysaa, si gaar ah se waxay ku astaysan tahay dhaqan iyo jacayl. Abwaanku haatan wuxuu deggan yahay Hargeysa. "Axmed Saleebaan-Bidde ma aha nin jacaylka ku cayaara." — Abwaan Aadan Tarabbi. Fanka casriga ah ee Soomaalida waxa ku taariikhaysan sheekooyin jacayl ah oo ku saabsan nolosha halabuurro iyo hooballo caan ah, sida jacaylkii Ismaaciil-Cagaf, kii Cali Sugulle, Cabdi Iidaan, Xuseen Aw Faarax, Sulub Cumar, Khadra Daahir… iyo kuwo kale. Haddaba qisada jacaylka Abwaan Axmed S Bidde, oo ah ta aynnu qoraalkan ku faallaynaynno, waxa lagu tiriyaa sheekooyinka ugu xiisaha badan ee ku aroora cishqiga fannaaniinta. Axmed Saleebaan-Bidde, sida uu marar kala duwan warbaahinta ka qiray, gabadh bay is jeclaadeen, guurna ku heshiiyeen, tabta dhallinyaradii dhiggiisa ahayd. Ha se ahaatee calaf baa ka adeegay oo inantii way is waayeen. Inanta waxay reerkoodii siiyeen, oo ay guursatay, nin kornayl ah, kaas oo Axmed ka jeeb roonaa. Abwaan Bidde iyo inanta wax khilaaf ah oo la sheegaa u ma dhexayn, laakiin qaddar baa kala kaxeeyay; haddii laga tagi waayana, maalmahaas inanta laga guursanayay Axmed wuxuu ku shuqlanaa qabanqaabada arooska saaxiibkii Maxamed Aadan (Dacar), taas buuna jacaylkiisa kaga yar mashquulay, sida uu Abwaanku ku xusay barnaamij xogwarran ah oo ay isaga iyo fannaanad Hibo-Nuura khadka internetka wadajir uga tebiyeen. Sidaas oo kale, warbixin uu Abwaan Bidde ka sameeyay suxufi Cumar-Seerbiya, ayuu Abwaan Bidde ku xusay in isaga iyo inanta uu calaf kala geeyay. "Calaf baannu isku weynnaye isaseeg kale ma ay ahayn," ayuu yidhi Abwaan Bidde. Inantii uu jeclaa, haba laga guursado e, way ka fogaatay, oo nuurigeedaba wuu waayay, sida uu ku xusay waraysi uu Telefishanka Goobjoog ka qabtay. Inantii Hargeysa way ka guurtay, oo waxay degtay Gorayo-Cawl, gobolka Awdal; ninka kornaylka ah ee ay is guursadeen baa taliska Gorayo-Cawl ka tirsanaa. Sidaas darteed, Axmed jacayl baa ku keliyaystay, rejo ayuu se qabay. "Labada is waayaa dhibaato way leeyihiin, laakiin way isu samraan," ayuu yidhi Abwaan Bidde. Leexadu waa "dabayl". Haddaba, sida uu ku xusay barnaamijka Madasha Halabuurka ee Telefishanka Qaranka JSL, Abwaan Bidde, maalmihii uu heestan curiyay, leexo jacayl baa sidatay—gabadhii uu jeclaa baa laga guursaday! "Leexo jacayl baa i sidatay!" ayuu yidhi Abwaan Bidde. Kolkaa ay Abwaan Bidde "leexada jacaylku sidatay," hees ka mid ah tobannaanka heesood ee uu dareennadiisa ku cabbiray, ayaa ku meelmartay magaca "Leexo." Sidaas oo kale, inantii uu jeclaa ee uu heesta u tiriyay, oo magaceeda rasmiga ah la dhaho Amran Ismaaciil Xuseen, iyadana waxa lagu naanaysay "Leexo!" Haddaba kolka suugaanta Abwaan Axmed S Bidde laga hadlayo, waxa la odhan karaa, magacan "Leexo" marka koowaad waa qiso (waa xaalad jacayl oo Abwaan Bidde maray); kolka labaad waa hees; jeerka saddexaadna waa gabadh. Sidee bay ku timi heesta Leexo? Abwaan Bidde oo caweys guriga ku qayilaya, ayna la fadhiyaan abwaan Ciise Warsame (Dhancadde) iyo hoobal Cabdalle Maxamed (Sagsaag), ayaa looga yeedhay guri aan ka fogayn kii Ilma Saleebaan-Bidde ee ay ku barjaynayeen. Wuu kacay oo gurigii tagay, wuxuuna kula kulmay inantii uu jeclaa, ee laga guursaday, oo ninkii qabay dudmo kaga timi. Inantii uu jeclaa waxay ku wargelisay in ay ninkeedii is khilaafeen, in ay ku noqotana ayna rabin; sidaas darteed ay Axmed S Bidde guurkiisa diyaar u tahay. Abwaan Bidde wuu ka diiday arrintaa, wuuna fasaxay. Abwaan Bidde, sida uu marar kala duwan xusay, kolkan uu inantii uu jeclaa oo u heellan fasaxayay, isaga jacaylkeedii kama guurin ee caashaqiisu tabtiisii hore iyo si ka daran buu ahaa; laakiin wuxuu ka dhawrsanayay, oo diiddanaa, in uu nin iyo gabadh aan is furin ka dhex shaqeeyo, oo qoys dhisan dumintiisa ka qaybqaato. Taa awgeed, isaga oo inanta jecel ayuu haddana ka gaws'adaygay, oo damaciisii shidnaa xakameeyay. "Adiga oo madax bannaan haddii aad ii timaaddo, anigu ku eryi maayo; laakiin imika reer dhisan haddii aynnu duminno, innagana keennu dhisnaan maayo," ayuu inantii ku yidhi Abwaan Bidde, sidaas bayna isku nabadgalyeeyeen. Waxa lagu doodaa Abwaan Bidde in uu markan qaatay go'aan gobannimo iyo danaysi la'aan astaan u ah. Haddaba, Abwaan Bidde, aqalkii inantu joogtay markii uu ka baxay ayuu ladh ku kacay: Dareen hibasho u eg baa jiitay oo ka hadliyay, dabadeed jawaab digasho u eg buu soo dhuftay, wuxuuna hanbabaray, oo is arkay, isaga oo socodka ku heesaya, oo erayadan marinaya: Abwaan Bidde oo meerisyadaas subcinaya ayaa u yimi Dhancadde iyo Sagsaag—saaxiibbadiisii ay kolkii hore wada fadhiyeen. Dabadeed Abwaan Bidde iyo Cabdalle-Sagsaag baa isla qabqabtay erayada laxamayntoodii, halkaasna waxa ka dhalatay heesta Leexo. Nuxurka heesta Leexo dad baa ujeeddo siyaasadeed u fasirtay, laakiin abbaarta dhabta ah ee heestu waa 'hinaase'; waa hinaase jacayl ee siyaasad shuqul kuma laha, sida uu Abwaan Bidde ku xusay waraysi ay Laanta Af Soomaaliga ee BBC ka qabatay. "Heestu waa hinaase ee siyaasad shaqo kuma laha," ayuu yidhi Abwaan Bidde. Fannaanad Hibo-Nuura iyo heesta Leexo Hibo Maxamed Huddoon (Hibo-Nuura), oo maanta ah fannaanad magac iyo maamuus fanka ku dhex leh, heesta Leexo ka hor aad looma aqoon, hees keli ah baana ugu horraysay Leexo. Sidaas daraaddeed, Abwaan Bidde aqoon u ma lahayn Hibo Maxamed, wuxuuna doonayay heesta Leexo in uu u dhiibo hablihii berigaa calankoodu taagnaa ee Hibo fanka uga horreeyay, Hargeysana ku sugnaa, sida Guduudo-Carwo iyo Saynab-Baxsan. Laakiin Hibo ayaa ku dhegtay heesta Leexo, kuna adkaysatay in ay iyadu qaaddo. Codsiga Hibo ka dib, Baxsan iyo Guduudo-Carwo ayaa Abwaan Bidde u soo jeediyay heesta in uu Hibo u dhiibo, waxayna taa ku sababeeyeen, 1) Hibo fanka way ku cusub tahay ee heestan ha ku soo baxdo, 2) waa fannaanad heesta hirgelin karta oo aan kolnaba codkeeda lagu qasaarayn. Abwaan Bidde taladaas wuu ku qancay; sidaas bay Hibo ku qaadday heesta Leexo; natiijadiina waxay noqotay tabtii ay Baxsan iyo Guduudo hilaadiyeen—si xilkasnimo leh ayay Hibo uga soo dhalaashay heestii, waqti yar ka dibna dhegaha dadweynaha ayay qabsatay, oo dalabkeeda ayaa kala go'i waayay. Waxa la odhan karaa, Hibo heesta Leexo way ku soo baxday. Dhanka kale, heesta Leexo qudheedana Hibo way soo saartay, oo luuqdeeda ayaa taabbagelisay. Maalintaas ayayna fannaanad Hibo iyo heesta Leexo maqalka dadweynaha si wadajir ah u hanteen. Abwaan Bidde iyo hoobalad Hibo-Nuura, oo barnaamij khadka internetka ah ku kulmay, ayaa isaga maragfuray heestaasi in ay sabab u ahayd in ay Hibo si degdeg ah u hesho aqoonsi fannaannimo iyo magac weyn. Sidaas oo kale, Abwaan Bidde iyo fannaanad Hibo, waxay isku waafaqeen in heestaasi ay fududaysay in Hibo dalka Shiinaha bandhig faneed u tagto markii ay laba bilood oo keli ah fanka ku jirtay. "Aniga oo laba bilood uun fanka ku jira ayaan Jayne tagay. Abwaanku in uu heestaa igu aaminay waan uga mahadcelinayaa," ayay tidhi fannaanad Hibo Maxamed. Hees xaalmarin ah: Jawaabtii heesta Leexo Kolkii ay heesta Leexo suuqa ka gashay ka dib, Amran Ismaaciil Xuseeen "Leexo," oo ah inantii uu Abwaan Bidde heesta Leexo u tiriyay, ayaa ka cabatay heesta Leexo, sida uu Abwaan Bidde ku xusay barnaamij uu Telefishanka Saab u qabtay. 'Ummadda oo dhan baa i maqashay; meesha aan tagaba heestii Leexo way i dabo socotaa ee xaal baan kaa rabaa,' ayay ku tidhi. Xaalka ay ka doonaysaa geel iyo dahab ma aha ee waxay ka dalbatay hees lid ku ah tii hore ee Leexo. Abwaan Bidde, sida uu xusay, wuu ku farxay in uu xaalkaa hees u bixiyo, waayo wuxuu ka werwersanaa in xoolo la weydiiyo, laakiin heesaha iyo halabuurku waxay ahaayeen hantidiisa keli ah ee uu hagar la'aan u hidin karo. "Waad fiican tahay, baan ku idhi, haddii aanad dahab, geel ama lacag i weydiisan," ayuu yidhi Abwaan Bidde. Haddaba inantii wuxuu xaalmarin u siiyay heesta uu Maxamed Axmed Kuluc ku luuqeeyay ee Sida geed caleen iyo. Heestaa uu xaalka u bixiyayna waxa erayadeeda ka mid ah: Kolkaa iyo ka dibba, intii ay jacaylkiisa isa seegganaayeen, Abwaan Bidde xaaladihiisa jacayl heeso badan buu ku cabbiray, waxana laga xusi karaa ta uu Axmed Cali Cigaal ku luuqeeyay ee farriinteedu samafilashada tahay: Guurkii Abwaan Bidde iyo Marwo Leexo Abwaan Bidde, sida uu ku sheegay waraysi uu siiyay Qaran News, inanta kolkii la guursaday ka dib wax xidhiidh ah lama samayn, waxaana xidhayay dhaqanka oo afo nin leh wuu ka gaabsanayay. Haddaba muddo 22 sano ah ka dib, gabadhii oo ayeeyo ah, seygeediina uu saddex sannadood sii mootan yahay, ayay Abwaan Bidde qaxoonti ku kulmeen. Way is guursadeen. Abwaan Bidde sababtii is waayiddooda wuxuu ku macneeyay calaf. Sidaas oo kale, sababta is heliddoodana wuxuu ku qeexay isla calaf. Abwaan Aadan Tarabbi, oo ay Abwaan Bidde saaxiibnimo nusqarni ka badani dhexayso, ayaa tibaaxay Abwaan Bidde inantii uu jeclaa in uu la kulmay iyada oo ayeeyo ah, ka dibna guursaday. Abwaan Tarabbi oo ka hadlayay kulan Abwaan Bidde qudhiisu uu goobjoog ka ahaa oo Hargeysa lagu qabtay, kaas oo lagu falanqaynayay fanka iyo taariikhda Abwaan Axmed S Bidde, ayaa yidhi: "Axmed Saleebaan-Bidde waad og tihiin isaga oo aan dumar horeba guursan oo dhallinyaro ah in uu gabadh jeclaaday, oo ay ayeeyo isku heleen, oo uu imika qabo!" Mareykanka oo liis madow gelinaya dalalka sida "caddaalad-darada" ah u xira muwaadiniintooda , EPA/Shutterstock Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa saxiixay jimcihii amar madaxweyne kaas oo u ogolaanaya wasaarada arrimaha gudaha in ay liiska madow geliyaan dalalka sida caddaalad-darada ah ku xira muwaadiniinta Mareykanka iyo in ay saaraan ganaax adag. Dalalka Shiinaha, Iran iyo Afghanistan ayaa ka mid ah dalalka loo arko in liiska lagu daro sida uu sheegay la-taliyaha madaxweynaha. Amarka madaxweynaha waxa uu Trump ku sheegay in hadda uu Mareykanka liiska madow gelinayo dalalka sida caddaalad-darada u xira oo ay ku jiraan dalalka taageera argagixisada. "Ujeedka waxa uu yahay in cid kasta oo gorgortan ka dhigata qof Mareykan ah ay eedi doonaan", ayuu yiri xoghayaha arrimaha dibadda Mareykanka Marco Rubio. Sebastian Gorka oo ah la-taliyaha madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa u sheegay wariyayaasha in amarka uu yahay fariin muujineyay sida ay uga go'an tahay in aan "muwaadiniinta Mareykanka lagu gorgortamikarin". Dowladda Mareykanka degdeg uma shaacin doonto magacyada dalalka lagu darayo liiskaas kaddib amarka madaxweynaha balse la-taliyaha Donland Trump waxa uu sheegay in dalalka Shiinaha, Iran iyo Afgahanistan loo arko in lagu daro liiskaas madow maxaa yelay sida uu sheegay waxay "si joogto ah u sameeyaan diblomaasiyad la hayste". Sarkaal Mareykan ah oo shuruud ka dhigay in aan magaciisa la sheegin ayaa u sheegay wakaalada wararka ee Reuters saameynta uu yeelan karo amarkan, "Laga bilaabo maanta waxaa isbeddalay wax kasta oo lagula dhaqmayay dalalka aan daacad aheyn iyo talisyada ku fakaraya in ay ula dhaqmaan muwaadiniinta Mareykanka sida ciyaarta Jeeska". Sarkaalkaas wuxuu kaloo sheegay, "Marka la fiiriyo dalalka sida Iran iyo Ruushka, waxay ila tahay in isbeddal ay arkayaan". Ruushka waxaa la sheegay in ay u xiran yihiin sagaal qof oo Mareykanka halka Iran ay u xiran yihiin ku dhawaad 8 qof. Mareykanka waxay Iran u arkaan dal taageera argagixisada, waxaana saarana cunaqabateyn xoogan. Ruushkana waxaa saaran cunaqabateyn weyn kaddib duullaankii ay ku qaadeen Ukraine. Mareykanka waxay sidoo kale walaac ka muujiyeen muwaadiniinta lagu xiray Venezuela. Sawirka, J. David Ake/ Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Dalalka ay wasaarada arrimaha dibadda Mareykanka gelisay liiska Madow waxay wajahayaan cunaqabateyn iyo xayiraad dhinaca wax dhoofinta ah. Sidoo kale madaxda ku lugta leh xariga muwaadiniinta waxaa loo diidayaa in ay Mareykanka soo galaan. Wasaarada arrimaha dibadda Mareykanka waxay ka mamnuuceysaa muwaadiniinta dalalka liiska madow ku jiro in ay Mareykanka yimaadaan. Mareykanka hadda dalka kaliya aysan ogleyn in loo safro waa dalka Kuuriyada Waqooyi. Tallaabadan ayaa la gaaray kadidb markii arday Mareykan ah lagu xiray dalkaas sanadkii 2016-kii. Ardayga waxaa la soo daayay isagoon miyir daboolan sanad kaddib markii la xiray, wax yar kaddibna wuu geeriyooday. Liiska cusub ee madow waxaa lagu darayaa kooxaha maamula dhulka aan dal ahaan loo aqoonsaneyn. Mareykanka waxay sheegeen in ay mudnaanta siinayaan sidii lagu sii deyn lahaa muwaadiniinta Mareykanka ee ku xiran dalal kala duwan ee lagu badasho maxaabiis kale. Donald Trump waxa uu ku celceliyaa guusha uu ka gaaray in uu soo daayo muwaadiniin badan oo Mareykanka. Saraakiisha Mareykanka waxay sheegaan in la soo daayay 72 maxbuus oo Mareykan ah intii uu joogay xafiiska madaxweyne Trump. Madaxda Mareykanka waxay sheegeen in amarkan cusub ee madaxweyne uu fududeyn doono in la qaado tallaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah iyadoo la marin nidaamka culeyska ah ee waqtiga qaadanaya. Mareykanku waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in liiska laga saarayo hadii loo arko in ay ka gaareen heerka uu Mareykanku ka doonayay. Mareykanka si joogto ah ayey u caawiyaan muwaadiniintooda lagu xiro dibadda, waxayna dib u eegis ku sameeyaan hadii si caddaalad-daro ah lagu xiray sida in loo adeegsanayo cadaadis siyaasadeed. Intii uu xafiiska joogay madaxweyne Joe Biden, Shiinaha waxay sii daayeen dhammaan Mareykanka ay Washington u aragtay in si caddaalad-daro ah lagu xiray. Tani waxay qeyb ka aheyd heshiis Mareykanka uu ku dabcinayay digniinaha safarada loo aado Shiinaha taas oo dhaawacday jawiga ganacsi ee dalkaas. Urur ka shaqeeya sii deynta Mareykanka sida qaldan lagu xiro iyo kuwa la haysto ayaa amaanay tallaabada madaxweynaha. "Tallaabadan waa mid xoojineysa dadaalada dowladda Mareykanka ee dadkeeda dib loogu soo celinayo".

Waxaa guuldarro ku dhamaaday kulan ay maanta qaban lahaayeen golaha shacabka ee barlamaanka federaalka kadib markii xildhibaano ka tirsan golaha ay ku eedeeyeen guddoonka inuu qarinayo ajande aan ahayn kan la iclaamiyay ee ahaa in laga hadlo cudurka Covid-19. Sacuudiga, Masar, Turkeyga iyo dalalka kale ee warka ka soo saaray aqoonsiga Israa'iil ee Soomaliland Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Israa'iil Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa ku dhawaaqay aqoonsi rasmi ah oo Israa'iil ay u aqoonsatay Jamhuuriyadda Iskeed madaxbanaannida ugu dhawaaqday ee Somaliland dal madax bannaan. Ra'iisul Wasaare Netanyahu, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa kala saxiixday baaq wadajir ah oo labada dhinac ah. Bayaankani waxa uu ku socdaa iyada la tixraacayo heshiiskii Abraham, ee lagu saxeexay hindisaha madaxweyne Trump. Dawladda Soomaaliya ayaa si adag uga hor timid aqoonsiga ay Israa'iil aqoonsatay. Warsaxaafadeed laga soo saaray kulan degdeg ah oo uu yeeshay golaha wasiirrada ee xukuumadda federaalka ee Soomaaliya ayaa lagu sheegay in "midnimada iyo madax banaanida dhuleed" aan gorgortan laga geli karin. Xukuumadda federaalka ee Soomaaliya waxay "si cad oo aan leexleexad lahayn ugu gacan sayraysaa weerarka ulakaca ah ee lagu soo qaaday madax-banaanideeda iyo talaabada sharci darrada ah ee Israa'iil ay si la soo dhoodhoobay ugu aqoonsanayso gobolka waqooyi ee Soomaaliya" ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Waxay xukuumaddu intaa ku dartay in Somaliland ay tahay qayb ka mid ah Soomaaliya, ayna qaadayso talaabooyinka lagama maarmaanka ah ee diblomaasiyadda, siyaasadda iyo talaabooyin xagga sharciga ah. Dalal dhowra iyo ururo heer gobol ilaa kuwa Qaaradeed ayaa taageero u muujiyey dowladda Soomaaliya iyo madaxbanaannida Soomaaliya iyagoo cambaareeyey aqoonsiga ay Israa'iil ku dhawaaqday inay aqoonsatay Jamhuuriyada Iskeed madaxbanaannida ugu dhawaaqday ee Somaliland Bayaano ay soo sareen dalalkan ay ku muujiyeen inay garab taagan yihiin ilaalinta midnimada iyo wadajirka Soomaaliya. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Dalalka Sacuudiga, Turkiga, Masar, Jabuuti, Maamulka Falastiiyiinta ayaa soo saaray bayaano ay ku sheegeen inay ku cambaareynayaan tallaabada Israa'iil. Wasiiradda arrimaha dibadda ee dalalka Masar, Jabuuti, Turkeyga iyo Soomaaliya ayaa wadahadal dhanka taleefoonka yeeshay sida lagu yiri qoraal la soo dhigay barta wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Masar. Wasaaradda arimaha dibadda ee dalka Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in ay cabireyso "taageradeeda buuxda ee madaxbanaanida dhuleed iyo midnimada Soomaaliya", iyadoo dhanka kale sheegtay in boqortooyada ka soo horjeedo go'aankii ay Israa'iil ku aqoonsatay Somaliland. Waxa ay intaas ku dareen in tallaabadeen ka hor imaaneyso qaynuunka caalamiga ah. Sidaas oo kale bayaan ay soo saartay wasaaradda arimaha dibada ee dlaka Turkiga ayaa lagu sheegay in tallaabada ay Israa'iil ku aqoonsatay Somaliland "in ay tusaale u tahay tallaabooyinka sharci darrada ah ee dowladda Natenyahu ay ku abuurayso xasilooni darro ka dhacda gobolka iyo adduunkaba". Sidoo kale Turkiga ayaa dheegay in uu mar walba garab taagan yahay madaxbanaanida dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, maadaama uu dadaal badan ku bixiyo xasiloonida ammaan ee geeska Afrika Ururka Midowga Afrika ayaa bayaan ay soo saareen ka soo hor jeensaday tallaabada aqoonsiga Israa'iil ee Somaliland. Sida lagu sheegay bayaan ay soo saaren Midowga Afrika, waxa si cad uga soo horjeesteen tallaabada ay Israa'iil ku sheegtay in ay ku aqoonsatay Somaliland. "Waxaan xaqiijineynaa taageerada aan kala go'a lahayn ee aan u hayno midnimada iyo madaxbanaanida Soomalaiya," ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Gudoomiyaha ururka Midowga Afrika Mohamed Ali Yuusuf ayaa sida lagu sheegay bayaanka sheegay "in Somliland ayaa sii ahaan doonto qayb ka mid ah Soomaaliya. Bayaan ay soo saareen Golaha iskaashiga khaliijka ayaa isna xadgudub ku tilmaamay aqoonsiga Israa'iil ee Somaliland. Jamhuuriyadda Iskeed madaxbanaannida ugu dhawaaqday ee Somaliland ayaa tan iyo 1991 waxay raadinaysay aqoonsi caalami ah, iyadoo xukuumadihii kala dambeeyey ee Somaliland ay yool u ahayd hirgalinta tallaabadaas.

Wax ka ogow dayaarad dagaal oo ka qaalisan bamka Nukliyeerka , Diyaaradda Boeing B-29 ayaa ahayd tii ugu xoogga badnayd ee bambooyinka xambaari jirtay dagaalkii labaad ee Adduunka, waxuuna dhismaheeda ka qaalisanaa bambaanooyinkii Nukliyeerka ahaa ee ay tuurtay. Waxa kale oo ay gacan ka gaysatay horumarinta diyaaradaha rakaabka ee maanta la isticmaalo. Waxay ahayd laba sano ka hor weerarkii Japan ee Pearl Harbor ee Maraykanka qaaday. Balse ciidamada cirka ee Mareykanka ayaa baadi goobayay diyaarado cusub oo ay u adeegsadaan weerarka. Waxa xigay horumarinta "Superbomber", oo awood u leh in ay duusho ilaa 2,000 mayl (3,200km) markiiba iyo joog sare ee aan hore loo gaarin. Diyaaradii ay sameeyeen waxay ku tuurtay bambooyinka atomiga Hiroshima iyo Nagasaki, waxayna ugu dambeyntii soo afjareen dagaalkii labaad ee aduunka. Waxa kale oo ay gogol xaar u ahayd horumarinta gaadiidka cirka oo ay maalin walba isticmaalaan diyaaradaha rakaabka ah. Tani waa sheekada ku saabsan sida diyaaradda oo qiimaheedu ka badan yahay mashruuca Manhattan oo dhan - B-29 Superfortress - ay u beddeshay adduunka. Waxay ahayd Janaayo 1940 markii ciidamada cirka ee Maraykanka (USAAC) ay ka codsadeen shan shirkadood oo diyaaradood oo Maraykan ah inay sameeyaan bam ka weyn wax kasta oo dunidu horey u aragtey. In kasta oo Maraykanku aanu weli gelin dagaalkii labaad ee adduunka, haddana dagaal baa ka socday Yurub: Jarmalkii Nazi-ga ahaa iyo Midowgii Soofiyeeti ayaa ku soo duulay Poland oo kala qaybiyey bilo ka hor. Maraykanku waxa uu ogaa in ay lagama maarmaan tahay in colaadda uu ku lug yeesho. Diyaaradda uu Maraykanku rabo waa in ay ka dheerayso diyaarad kasta oo la sameeyo. Taasi waxay noqotay caqabad weyn, xitaa waddanka ugu weyn warshadaha adduunka. Labada shirkadood ee la weydiistay inay dhisaan diyaaradda, Douglas iyo Lockheed, ayaa lagu qasbay inay ka tagaan qaar ka mid ah mashruucyadii ay hore u hayeen. Boeing, si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxay ahayd safka hore, iyada oo billowday in ay ka shaqeyso mashruuc gaar ah oo la mid ah mid dhowr sano ka hor la sameeyey. Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Naqshadeynta Boeing B-29 ayaa ugu dambeyntii ku guuleysatay tartanka USAAC, laakiin waxay qaadatay afar sano oo kale ka hor inta aan diyaaradda, oo loo yaqaan B-29 Superfortress, aysan soo gelin suuqa. Waxa uu ahaa mashruucii ugu qaalisanaa uguna qallafsanaa ee warshadaha Maraykanku waligood qabtaan oo aan dhaafin barnaamijyadii hawada sare ee 1950kii iyo 1960kii. Waxayna ku riixday tignoolajiyada hawada sare xaddi kama dambeys ah. Mashruucii B-29 ayaa ahaa kii ugu qaalisanaa dagaalka oo dhan – qiimihiisuna ku dhow yahay 50% waa ka badan mashruucii Manhattan ee lagu curiyay bambaanooyinkii ugu horeeyay ee atomiga. Haddii qiimaha maanta la barbar dhgo, laga bilaabo nashqadaynta ilaa dhammaystirka, waxay ku kici kartaa lacag u dhiganta $ 55.6 bilyan oo dolar. Xawaaraha sare ee dayuuradaha weerarka ee dagaalkii labaad ee aduunka waxa ay ka dhigan tahay in dayuuradaha dagaalku ay haysteen ilbiriqsi kaliya si ay u burburiyaan bartilmaameedkooda. Boeing waxay isu beddeshay naqshad cusub, oo rajo badan laga qabo. Tiknoolajiyadu waxay ku jirtay cilmi-baaris ilaa 1920-meeyadii, laakiin diiradda waxaa la saarayay tijaabinta. Diyaaradda B-29 ayaa ahayd diyaaradii ugu horeysay ee dad badan soo saarto. Sawirka, Xawaaraha sare ee diyaaradaha weerarka ee dagaalkii labaad ee aduunka ayaa ka dhigan in diyaaradahan dagaalku ay heleen ilbiriqsi kaliya si ay u doortaan bartilmaameedka. Sannadkii 1944-kii, diyaaradaha dagaalka ayaa si degdeg ah u horumaray. Qaybaha cadaadiska ee B-29 ayaa u oggolaaday naqshadeeyayaasha inay si hal abuur leh u fikiraan, waxayna la yimaadeen fikrad cusub: qoryaha meelaha fog laga hago. Nidaam cusub oo kantaroolka gantaalaha ayaa xisaabiyay bartilmaameedka weerarka isagoo isticmaalaya radar akhrin kara heerkulka hawada isla markaana hagi kara dabka. Waxay ahayd markii ugu horeysay ee diyaarad leh awooddan oo kale la smaeeyo.

"Haddii aynaan bad helin, dagaal baa dhici doona" Dalalka Kenya iyo Uganda oo ka mid ah dalalka Bariga Afrika ayaa khilaaf afka ah soo kala dhexgalay mas'uuliyiintooda ugu sarreysa, taasoo ka dhalatay fikrado adag oo ku saabsan dekedda. Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni ayaa mee fagaare ah uga dhawaaqay toddobaad ka hor dhammaadkii bishii Oktoobar in dalkiisu "uu galayo badweynta Hindiya" isagoo sii maraya Kenya, taasoo dhalisay walaac ku saabsan saameynta ay ka dhalin karto gobolka. Kadib su'aasha adag ee madaxweynaha iyo mowqifka geesinnimada leh, ayaa dadka qaar waxay sheegayaan in mustaqbalka uu khilaaf ka dhex qarxin karo waddamada Bariga Afrika. Madaxweyne Museveni waxa uu sidaas ku sheegay Waraysi uu siiyey Telefishanka Qaranka. Wareysiga ayaa lagu qabtay bariga magaalada Mbale, halkaasoo ay olole ka wadeen. Madaxweynaha ayaa khudbaddiisa ku soo qaaday lahaanshaha dekedda isagoo ka hadlay is dhexgalka dhinacyada difaaca iyo dhaqaalaha ee waddamada Bariga Afrika. Museveni waxa uu sheegay in afarta dal ee Bariga Afrika ay leeyihiin horumar dhinaca tignoolajiyadda ah oo ay ku jiraan militariga iyo sahaminta hawada sare, taasoo la jaan qaadaysa baaxadda dhaqaale ee ay leeyihiin. "Sidee Afrika isku difaaci kartaa? Is-dhexgalka dhaqaale ayaa caawin doona dhaqaalaha," ayuu yiri Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. "Taas waa sababta aan dadka ugu sheego, miyaydaan arkin sababta aan ugu baahannahay inaan midowno, sababtoo ah... haddii Uganda ay rabto inay abaabusho ciidammo badda ah, sidee ayay u dhisi kartaa? Ma lihin ciidammo badda ah," ayuu yiri, isagoo usii gogol-xaaranaya su'aashii ugu weynayd. In kasta oo Kenya ay tahay waddan muhiim u ah ganacsiga iyo sahayda ganacsiga ee Uganda, haddana weli lama hirgelin qorshayaashii mashaariicda wadajirka ahaa ee shidaalka, dhismaha waddooyinka, iyo dhismaha waddo tareen. Madaxweynaha ayaa yiri "Wada hadal aan dhammaad laheyn ayaa Kenya la galnay... khadka tareenka, dhismaha dhuumaha shidaalka, sababtoo ah dalkeenna si dabiici ah waa mid aan bad lahayn, laakiin badda anigana waan leeyahay, maxaa yeelay aaway baddeyda, anigaa iska leh baddaas, mustaqbalka waxaa dhici doona dagaal, waxaa hubaal ah in mustaqbalka aan dagaal geli doonno". Hadalkan uu Museveni jeediyay kaliya ma noqon mid laga doodo oo laga tebiyo baraha bulshada iyo warbaahinta caadiga ah ee Kenya, balse sidoo kale wuxuu dhaliyay caro. Isagoo arrintaas ka jawaabaya, sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Kenya, Korir Singoy, ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu u hoggaansamayo shuruucda caalamiga ah iyo qaab-dhismeedka sharci ee lagu maamulayo xuquuqda dhulalka iyo kheyraadka dabiiciga ah, soo jeedinta Uganda-na ay tahay sharci-darro. Uganda waa dal aan bad lahayn, balse hamiga Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni ee ah in la dhiso ciidamada badda iyo in si aan xaddidneyn loo wadago badweynta Hindiya ayaa khatar cusub ku abuuraysa Bariga Afrika. Museveni ayaa sheegay in Uganda ay leedahay xuquuq badeed oo ay la jaan qaadayso deriskeeda xeebta leh ee Kenya iyo Tanzania, isagoo si maldahan u sheegay haddii aysan taasi suuro-gal ahayn in tallaabo milateri laga qaadi karo.

Fanaankii "caloosha hooyadii ku garaadsaday" oo maanta la aasayo Mulaxamiiste Xasan Sabriye Afrax (Xasan Gareed) wuxuu mid ka mid ahaa mulaxannada ugu cod samaynta fiicnaa laxamada, heeso badan oo uu sameeyeyna waa kuwa dhagaysigooda Soomaalidu ugu jeceshahay. Laakiin nolosha Gareed ayaa leh xiiso gooniya leh. Wuxuu ku dhashay Gobolka Galgaduuud ee bartamaha Soomaaliya ahaan deegaan u dhow Dhuuso mareeb. Xasan gareed wuxuu sheegay inuu ku dhashay 11 bilood, sidaasna loogu biixiyey naynaasta (Garaad) oo loo bixin jiray dadka sidiisoo kale ah, kuwaas oo ku dhasha muddo ka badan tirsi qaadka uurka ee hooyada. “Anigu sagaal kuma dhalan,waxaan ku dhashay 11 bilood, marka nin caloosha ku garaadsaday ayaa garaad loo bixiyaa ee la iskama bixiyo” ayuu yiri allah u naxariistee Xasan Gareed. "Aabahay wuxuu ii bixiyey magaca Xasan oo uu iigu wanqalay, laakiin hooyaday waxay ii bixisay garaad, markaas ka dib anigoo yar ayaan xamar tagay dadku ma aqoon magaca garaad ee reer Xamarkii ayaa u badalay Gareed" ayuu yiri. Burburkii ka dhacay Dalka Xasan meelna uguma bixin Muqdisho, wuxuuse tilmaamay in tabar u waayey inuu ka baxo. “Waxaan tawakalay ilaahay, meshii aan ku noolaa gurigaygii oo ku yaala xaafad la yiraahdo Xamar Bile oo Siinaay ku taala ayaan deganahay aniga iyo caruurtaydu xitaa Afgooye maanan gaarin” Markii dalku galay burburka, Xasan wax walba oo noloshiiisa ah waa is badaleen, wuxuuna galay nolol adag, Waraysi uu siiyey BBCda ayuu ku sheegay inuu soo maray maalmo aaad u adkaa. “ Meel la yiraahdo Bakaaraha oo suuq ganacsi ah ayaan u foof-tagi jiray kol aad garato qofaad taqaano, reer miyise baa yimid. Wixiise aan ka soo helo ayaan guriga keeni jiray, ha yaraadaan ama ha bataane.” Muddo ka dib wuxu sheegay in markii Muqdisho ay tagtay Dowladdii Madaxweyne Cabdilaahi Yuusuf hogaaminayey ilaa Dowladii Shiikh Shariif ay fanaaniintii joogtay markaa ay lacago u qoreen, mar konton marna boqol dollar ay ka heli jireen. Dabaqaayadii 1963 ayuu soo galay Fanka hase yeeshee wuxuu ahaa intii hore mid banaanka ku shaqeeya. Sanadkii 1967 ayuuse si rasmi ah ugu biiray fankii Soomaalida isagoo door muuqda ku lahaa kobaciisi. Codadka macaan ee ku saaray heeso badan ayaa Xasan ka dhigay inay laxamadiisa soo jiitaan abwaano badan oo miraha samayn jiray. Abwaan Ahmed Saleeban Bidde ay isku waayo ahaayen xagga fanka ayaa sheegay in Allah u Raxmadee Xasan Gareed uu ahaa nin shaqsiyad Fiican Waligiisna uusan arag qof ay is haystaan. Sanadkii 1964 ayuu sheegay inay isugu horeysay isaga iyo Xasan oo markaa xiiso u qabay inuu barto kabanka ama cuudka, gacanna uu ka siiyey dalabkisii.
