Sida Masjidkani ku noqday dhismaha ugu weyn dunida ee ka sameysan dhoobo , Raphael Bick Dhoobadu waxay ahayd wixii ugu horreeyay ee laga sameeyo dhismeyaasha casriga ah ee aan hadda ku hoyanno. Kumannaan sano ayaa loo adeegsanayay in dhoobo laga sameeyo guryaha, iyadoo ay cilmi-baarayaashu ay heleen caddaynta dhismayaal dhoobo ah oo toban kun oo sano kahor la dhisay. Dhismayaasha dhoobada ah waxay aad ugu fiican yihiin inay na qaboojiyaan xilliga kuleelka, iyo in aan diitrimaad ka helno xilliga qaboobaha, iyaga oo u adkeysta isbeddelka cimillada xun. Haddaba, dalkan Soomaaliya u jira masaafada ku dhow lixda kun kiilomitir ee safarka dhanka cirka ah waxaa ku yaal dhismaha ugu weyn dunida ee ka sameysan dhoobo, kaas oo haddana ah Masjid weyn iyo xarun lagu barto diinta. Dadku wax badan ayay ka maqleen magaalada qadiimiga ah ee dalka Mali, halkaas oo ay hay'adda UNESCO ku dartay astaamaha dhaxalka adduunka ee ay tahay in la dhowro. Waa magaalo qadiimi ah oo xarun iyo gundhig u ahayd dhaqanka islaamka qarniyaddii 14aad ilaa 16aad. Waxa ay hoy u tahay Jaamacadda Qur'aanka ee Sankorem, iyada oo lagu tilmaamo in magaaladan caasimad u ahayd garashada islaamka iyo ku faafintiisa Afrika. Laakiin meel u jirta 500km Tumbuktu, waxaa ku yaal masjida faca weyn ee mucjisada ah, kaas oo ah dhismaha ugu ballaaran dunida ee dhoobo ka sameysan. Waa masjidka Djenne, oo ah mid ka mid ah astaamaha ugu caansan Afrika, halkaas oo ay hay'adda UNESCO u aqoonsan tahay mid ka mid ah xarumaha taariikhda iyo dhaxalka adduunka ah wax ku dhow afartan sano kahor. Waxa u uku yaal isla goobta uu horey uga dhisnaa masjidkii ugu horreeyay ee gobolkaas laga dhisay, xilli lagu qiyaasayo wax ku dhow toddobo boqol iyo kontan sano kahor. Masjidkaas hore, waxay taariikhyahannadu weriyeen in uu ahaa xarunta madaxtooyada boqorkii Mali ee Kunburu. Wuu islaamay kaddibna xaruntisii ayuu u beddeley Masjid, isaga oo guri ka dhistay meel ku dhow masjidka. Boqorkii xigay ayaa ku daray minaaradaha, isaga oo sidoo kale derbi ku wareejiyay masjidka. Masjidka oo dib loo dhisay, markii ugu dambeysay, kan hadda dhisan ee ka wada sameysan dhoobada ayaa dib loo dhisay wax ku dhow boqol iyo labaatan sano kahor, xilligaas oo ku began 1907dii. Masjid weynaha Djenne ee ku yaalla koonfurta Mali, dhismahiisu waa qaab dhismeed gaar ah oo isla markiiba sawiraya xadaaradda Islaamka. Ku dhawaad 20m sare, oo lagu dhisay madal dhererkeedu dhan yahay 91m, waa dhismaha ugu wayn ee dhoobada ah iyo tusaalaha ugu wanaagsan ee qaab dhismeedka guryihii hore ee qadiimiga ah. Waxa uu ku yaalla bartamaha suuqa weyn ee magaalada Djenne, iyo meel ka sarreysa dhulka si masjidka looga ilaaliyo fatahaadda webiga oo uu ku dhinac yaal. Masaajidku waxa uu leeyahay 3 minaarad oo gaar ah oo leh boqollaal ulood oo geedka timirta ka sameysan oo kasoo baxaysa gidaaradda. Waa mid qabow xilliyada kuleelka daran, iyada oo uu sidoo kale masjidku helayo ileys qoraxeed ku filan. Lebenka masjidka weyn ee Djenne waxa uu ka samaysan yahay iskudarka ciid iyo dhoobo, biyaha iyo qolfoofta bariis iyo waxyaabo kale oo marka la isku daro noqda dhoobo xoog leh. Mid ka mid ah sifooyinka gaarka ah ee dhismaha masaajidka waa saqafkiisa. Saqafku waxa uu ka samaysan yahay laamo timireed oo isku tolan oo tiirar alwaax ah lagu taageeray. Saqafka ayaa markaa lagu daboolaa lakab dhoobo ah, kaas oo ka caawiya in uu ka ilaaliyo dhismaha kulaylka qorraxda. Maanta, Masjidka weyn ee Djenné ayaa markhaati cajiib ah u ah xariifnimada dhismaha dhoobada Mali iyo ilaalinta cajiibka ah ee farsamada dhismaheeda soo jireenka ah. In kasta oo ay jiraan masaajiddo aad uga da'weyn oo ilaa maanta taagan, haddana masaajidka weyn ee Djenne ee dalka Maali waxa uu leeyahay muuqaal gaar ah oo ka dhigaya mid ka mid ah mucjisooyinka naqshadaha ee adduunka. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Sanadihii la soo dhaafay, dadka deggan Djenné waxay u adkeysanayeen isku dayo soo noqnoqda oo lagu doonayo in lagu beddelo hab-dhiska iyo dabeecadda masaajidkooda gaarka ah iyo dabeecadda xafladda sannadlaha ah. Tusaale ahaan, maal-gashadayaasha ajnabiga ah ee muslimiinta ah ayaa ku yaboohay inay dib u dhisaan masaajidka si shub ah oo ay ku dhejiyaan sagxadda ciidda ee hadda. Bulshada Djenné way diideen baaqyadaas, oo waxay si hagar la'aan ah ugu dadaashay inay ilaaliso hiddaha, dhaqanka iyo dabeecadda gaarka ah ee Masjidka Wayn. Bulshada Djenne waxay higsanayaan in qaab-dhismeedkan quruxda badan ee gaarka ah loo hayo sidii hiddo dhaqameed intii suurtogal ah, iyaga oo ka hortagaya casriyeynta. Sidaa awgeed, waxa kaliya ee lagu soo kordhiyey ee casriga ah ee masaajidka tan iyo markii la dhisay waa habka cod-baahiyaha, si meel fog looga maqlo. Taas beddelkeed, bulshada magaaladan oo iyaduba guryaheedu ka sameysan yihiin dhoobo, waxay sanad walba sameeyaan dhoob-saar cusub una sameeyaan derbiyada Masjidka Wayn ee Djenné waxa dib loogu dhisaa oo loo mariyaa dhoobo Abriil kasta dhacdo. Sababtu waa in dhismaha masjidku u baahan yahay xoojin sannadle ah - si la mid ah guryaha caadiga ah ee dhoobada ka samaysan ka hor xilliga roobabka ee Mali oo dhacaya bilaha Luulyo iyo Agoosto. Dib-u-dhiskan baaxadda leh iyo dib-u-dhoobo-saarkan wuxuu xaqiijinayaa in masaajidku uu badbaadi doono xilli-roobaadka, inkastoo ay suurtogal tahay in qaab ahaan isbeddel ku dhaco roobka dartiis. Waa hab derbiyada masjidka looga ilaalinayo inay dillaacaan iyo in burbur ku yimaado.

Wadahadallada Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland: Qodobbada ay isku mari waayeen 8-dii sano ee la soo dhafay , Villa Somalia Magaalada Jabuuti waxaa lagu soo gaba-gabeeyay shir dhex maray madaxda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo kuwa Jamhuuriyadda iskeed madaxbanaannida ugu dhawaaqday ee Somaliland. Shirkan oo ay marti gelinaysay dowladda Jabuuti waxaa ergada labada dhinac kala hoggaaminayay madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Maxamed Cabdillaahi Farmaajo iyo madaxweynaha Somaliland Muuse Biixi Cabdi. Somaliland ayaa si iskeed ah madaxbannaani ugu dhawaaqday markii ay burburtay dowladdii dhexe ee Soomaaliya, ku dhawaad 30 sano ka hor. Tan iyo xilligaas waxay masuuliyiinta raadinayeen aqoonsi caalami ah, balse Dowladda Federaalka ayaa u aqoonsan inay tahay gobol ka mid ah Soomaaliya. Bayaanka ka soo baxay kulanka Jabuuti ayaa lagu qiray in shirarkii sannadihii hore aan horumar badan laga sameynin. Xitaa iyadoo aan wali la isla gaarin arrimaha masiiriga ah ee ku saabsan xiriirka mustaqbalka ayay labada dhinac isku mari waayeen qodobo aasaasi ah. Qaar ka mid ah shirarkii hore iyo qodobadii la isku mari waayay siddeedii sano ee la soo dhaafay ayaan qoraalkan ku soo koobeynaa: Fikrika ah in ay wada hadlaan Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland wuxuu markii ugu horeysey ka soo billowday shirkii caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya loogu qabtay magaalada London, sannadkii 2012-kii. Mid ka mid ah qodobadii shirkaasi ka soo baxay waxa uu dhigayay in "beesha caalamka ay taageerto ahmiyadda ay leedahay in wadahadalo ay dhexmaraan" Somaliland iyo Dowladd Federaalka ee Soomaaliya. Dhawr bilood ka dib shirkaasi waxaa isla magaalada London ka qabsoomey shirkii ugu horeeyey ee fool ka fool ay isu soo horfadhiistaan labada dhinac, wuxuuna shirkaasi dhacay 20-kii bishii June, 2012-kii. Si loo dardargeliyo dadaallada wadahadallada. Somaliland waxay meelmarisay qaraar u oggolaanayay inay wadahadal toos ah la gasho dowladda Soomaaliya. Waxaana tan iyo xilligaas dhacay ilaa lix shir oo looga arrisanayay arrimahan. Dhowr bilood uun ka dib shirkii Soomaalida ee London, waxaa bilowday wadahadallo la xiriira - midnimo ama madaxbannaani. Waxaana ka mid ahaa midkii dhacay Bishii Juun, 2012-kii. Ujeedada shirkaas, oo ay martigelisay dowladda UK, wuxuu ahaa in waddada loogu xaaro waxa xaajoodka la xiriiray qodabadii ay labada dhinac ka wada hadli lahaayeen. Wakiiladii ka socday Somaliland ayaa markaasi ka carooday in shirka lagu soo daray masuuliyiin ka socday dowladda Puntland. Bayaan ka soo baxay kulankaasi ayaa lagu heshiiyay in la sii wado wahadallada, madaxda labada dhinacna ay yeeshaan kulan. Waxay sidoo kale ku heshiiyeen ka wada shaqeynta la dagaalanka argagixisada iyo burcad-badeeda. Waxaa isla sannadkii 2012-kii, magaalada Dubay ku kulmay madaxwenihii Dowladdii Kumeelgaarka ahayd ee Soomaaliya Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed iyo Madaxweynihii Somaliland ee xilligaasi Axmed Maxamed Siilaanyo. Waxaa kulankaasi martigleisay Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta. Labada madaxweyne ayaa amray in guddiyada farsamo ee labada dhinac matalayay ay sii wadahaan wadahadallada. Sawirka, Madaxweynihii Dowlladda Federaalka Soomalaiya ee xillaagaasi Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Madaxweynihii Somaliland ee wakhtigaa Axmed Siilaanyo ayaa ku kulmay magaalada Ankara ee caasimadda dalka Turkiga. Waxaa kulankaasi goobjoog ka ahaa Recep Tayyib Erdogan oo xilligaas Ra'iisal Wasaare ka ahaa Turkiga. Wasiirkii Arrimaha dibadda Turkiga Axmed Daud Oglu ayaa dhexhdexadinayay wadahadallada. Dhinacayda ayaa ku heshiiyay qodobo dhowr ah oo ay ka mid yihiin; Wax yar ka dib kullankii Ankara, waxay labada dhinac mar kale ku kulmeen Istanbul bishii July 2013-kii. Kulankaas ayaa looga hadlay arrin muhiim ah sida maamulka hawada Soomaaliya. Waxay ku heshiiyeen in maamulka hawada laga soo wareejiyo Qaramada Midoobay oo maamulesay tan iyo 1991, markii ay burburtay dowladdii dhexe ee Soomaaliya. Heshiiska wuxuu ahaa in magaalada Hargeysa looga dhigo saldhig. Lana qeybsada dakhliga ka soo xarooda maamulista hawada. Mar kale ayay dhinacyada ku kulmeen Istanbul bishii January 2014-kii iyagoo ku heshiiyay in la sameeyay guddi farsamo oo labada dhinac ah oo ka so shaqeeya qaabkii maamulka hawada loogu soo wareejin lahaa Hargeysa. Shir ay ka qeybgaleen madaxweynayaashii Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Madaxweynihiin Somaliland Axmed Siilaanyo ayaa ka dhacay magaalada Jabuuti, waxaana lagu kala saxiixdey heshiis dhigayay in wadahadaladii hakadka galay dib loo billaabo. Waxay sidoo kale isku afgarteen in aan la siyaasadeynin barnaamijyada gargaarka iyo horumarka. Waxay ku heshiiyeen in kulanka xiga ay ku qabsadaan dalka Turkiga January 2015. Dhinacyada ayaa sidii ay ku heshiiyen isugu tagay magaalada Istanbul balse fool ka fool uma aysan kulmin. Labada dhinac ayaa midba midka kale ku eedeeyay fashilka shirka. Somaliland ayaa ku eedeysay dowladda Federaalka ah inay si ula kac ah ugu soo dartay wakiiladeeda dad asal ahaan ka soo jeeda Somaliland. Dolwadda Soomalaiya ayaa sheegtay in Somaliland aysan daw u lahayn inay u meeriso cidda ay tahay in ay wadahadallada ku matalaan. Wixii intaa ka dambeeyay ma jirin wax wadahadal rasmi ah oo dhexmaray labada dhinac. Balse waxaa sii socday eedeynta ku saabsan cidda leh masuuliyada burburka wadahadallada. Afar sano ka dib markii la hakiyay wadahadallada, bishii February ee sanadkan, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo iyo Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Muuse Biixi Cabdi waxay ku kulmeen magaalada Addis Ababa. Labada hoggaamiye waxaa xafiiskiisan isugu keenay Ra'iisal Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Axmed. Ma cadda waxa ay ka wada hadleen balse waxay u muuqataa in kulankaas uu hor udhac u ahaa kulanka dalka jabuuti ka dhacay todobaadkan. Labada dhinac ayaa u muuqda inuu midba kan kale ku riixayo mas'uuliyadda caqabadaha hortaagan sidii miiska wadahalka loogu noqon lahaa, lamana saadaalin karo sida ay isugu tanaasuli karaan. Jamhuuriyadda iskeed madaxbannaanida ugu dhawaaqday ee Somaliland ayaa arrimo ka tabaneysa in Dowladda Farmaajo, waxayna ku eedeysay inay meesha ka saartay arrimihii horay looga heshiiyay. Guddiga Somaliland u qaabilsan wadahadallada Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in ay diyaar u yihiin wada xaajoodka laakiin ay marka hore dowladda federaalka ka doonayaan inay meelmariso heshiisyadii horay loogu gaaray kulamadii ay labada dhinac yeesheen. Edna Adan Ismaaciil oo ka mid ah guddiga Somaliland u qaabilsan wadahadallada ayaa tiri: "In la wadahadlo waan soo dhaweyneynaa. Wadahadalladu halkii ay marayeen laga soo billaabo kii koowaad ilaa kii lixaad, waxaa dhacayay isu soo dhawaansho. "Umaddu way isu soo dhawaaneysay, waxaase nasiib darro noqotay in madaxweynaha dalka aannu jaarka nahay ee Soomaaliya Farmaajo uu wada buriyo qodobbadii horay loogu heshiiyay oo dhan, oo intuu maalin soo toosay ayuu yiri saxiixyadii madaxweyneyaashii hore waxba kama jiraan, oo uu yiri diyaaradaha hallaga maamulo xamar". Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa beenisay eedeymahaas waxa ayna sheegtay inay ka go'antahay sii wadidda wadahadallada. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa raaligelin ka bixiyay "tacaddiyadii ay dowladdii Maxamed Siyaad barre ka geystay gobollada Waqooyi ee Soomaaliya". Cabdidifitaax Saciid Axmed, oo ah wakiilka Somaliland u qaabilsan Jabuuti ayaa sheegay in wadahadallada soo cusboonaaday aysan mira dhal noqon doonin illaa laga fulinaya qodobadii horay loogu heshiiyay. Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo, xaqiijiyay in ay soo wadayaan wadahadallada iyo isu soo dhaweynta labada dhinac. "Aniga iyo walaalkey Muuse Biixi waxaan halkan u joognaa in aan gaarno go'aanno adag si dadkayaga ay u helaan mustaqbal wanaagsan." ayuu yiri Farmaajo.

Maxaad ka ogtahay dadka garaadka macmalka (AI) u adeegsanaya inay 'Alle' kula hadlaan , Prashanti Aswan Dalka Hindiya iyo qeybaha kale ee caalamka, dadka cibaadeysanaya ayaa u weecanaya dhanka AI loo sameeyay hab ujeeddo leh iyagoo u isticmaalaya cibaadadooda diimeed. Maxaa dhacaya marka mashiinnadu ay noqdaan dallaalkeenna cusub ee ruuxiga ah? Vijay Meel, oo ah 25 jir arday ah kuna nool Rajasthan, Hindiya, ayaa markii ay ka hor yimaadeen su'aalo iyo caqabadaha nolosha casriga ah u weecday dhanka Alle. Markii hore wuxuu la tashan jiray hoggaamiyeyaasha ruuxiga. Dhawaanahanse, wuxuu la tashi la sameeyaa GitaGPT. GitaGPT waa mashiin garaadka macmalka ah (AI) oo lagu tabobaray Bhagavad Gita, 'buugga barakeysan' ee Hinduuda. GitaGPT wuxuu u muuqdaa farriin-qoraaleed caadi ah oo aad weydaarsan lahayd saaxiib – marka laga reebo AI-du waxay kuu sheegeysaa inaad la sheekeysaneyso Alle. "Markii aan kasoo bixi waayay imtixaanaadkeygii bankiga, waan murugooday," Meel ayaa sidaa yiri. Balse kadib markuu u weecday GitaGPT, wuxuu ku qoray faahfaahinno ku saabsan xasaradaha hoose ee uu wajahayay wuxuuna codsaday talada AI. "Diiradda saar ficilladaada iskana daa ka walwalidda mirahooda," GitaGPT ayaa sidaa yiri. Tan, iyo hagid kaleba, waxay Meel ka dhigtay mid dareemaya dhiirranaan iyo firfircooni. "Ma aysan i dhaheyn inaanan ogeyn, balse xilligaas, waxaan u baahnaa qof mar kale ii sheega," Meel ayaa yiri. "Rogaal-celintan ayaa iga caawisay inaan dib u eego waxaan ka fekerayay billaabana inaan mar kale isu diyaariyo." Wixii intaa ka dambeeyay, GitaGPT waxay u noqotay sida saaxiib, uu la sheekeysto mar ama abo toddobaadkiiba. AI waxay qaabeyneysaa sida aan u shaqeyno, wax u baranno una jeclaanno. Waxaase soo kordhaya, inay sidoo kale qaabeyneyso meelaha qaar sida aan u cibaaneysanno. Dadka cibaadeysanaya ee diimaha ugu waaweyn dunida ayaa tijaabinaya mashiinnada. Balse Hinduism, oo muddo dheer lagu yaqaannay ilaahyada ay caabudaan oo si toos ah qofku ugu hor cibaadeysanayo, ayaa soo bandhigeysa isku dhafka iimaanka iyo teknolojiyadda. Iyadoo AI ay taabaneyso qeyb walba oo nolosheenna ah, Hindiya ayaa laga yaabaa inay tooshka ku ifiso waxa ay ka dhigan tahay in arrimaha diinta lagala sheekeysto mashiinnada hadlaya. "Dadku waxay dareemaan inay ka go'doonsan yihiin bulshada, duqeyda iyo macbadyada. Dad badan, inay AI kala hadlaan Alle waa hab ay u dareemaan lahaansho, ee keliya maaha dhanka diinta," ayuu yiri Holly Walters, oo arrimaha diinta wax ka dhiga kana tirsan Wellesley College oo Mareykanka ku yaalla, kaasoo bartay walxaha barakeysan, xajka iyo dhaqamada diimeed ee Koofurta Aasiya. In AI lagu dabbaqo diinta waa mid aan laga fursan karin, ayuu yiri Walters. "Waxaanan leeyahay lagama fursan karo sababtoo ah haatanba way jirtaa." Dhowrkii sano ee la soo dhaafay waxaa la arkay tijaabooyin badan oo diimeed oo AI ah. Sannadkii 2023, barnaamijka AI ee loo yaqaan Text With Jesus ayaa sababay baaqyo ka hor imaansho ah sababo la xiriira in la ogolaaday in AI lagala sheekeysto diinta. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Isla sanadkaas, App-ka QuranGPT oo loogu talagalay in uu ka jawaabo su'aalaha iyo hagid ku saleysan kitaabka quraanka ayay dad badan kusoo jabeen, waxaa la sheegay in dadka oo ka tan batay awgeed uu hallaabay maalin gudaheed markii la furay. AI waxay xitaa saldhig u ahayd diimaha oo dhan, sida kaniisadda Future, oo ah koox uu bilaabay injineerkii hore ee Google, Anthony Levandowski, kaas oo rajeynaya inuu horumariyo oo kor u qaado aqoonsashada Alle oo "ku salaysan sirdoon macmal". Laakiin waxyaabaha gaarka ah ee cibaadada Hinduuga ayaa ka dhigaya kiis gaar ah oo xiiso leh. Dhaqan ahaan halka waxyaabaha muqadaska ay yihiin kuwo la arki karo lana taaban karo, teknolojiyaddu waxay noqon kartaa mid taa beddesha, Walters iyo kuwa kale ayaa sidaa leh. Markii ChatGPT iyo waxa laga sameeyay AI ay kor u kacday, tiro ka mid ah hal-abuureyaal ganacsi, kuwo daacad u ah iyo kuwa xiiseeya tignoolajiyada ayaa lagu dhiirigaliyay inay dhisaan chatbots kuwaas oo kaa dhigi doona inaad si toos ah ula falgasho waxyaabaha ay dhigeen "ilaahyada kala duwan ee Hinduga" - oo ay ku jiraan AIs badan oo dhammaantood loo yaqaan GitaGPT. Vikas Sahu, oo ah arday ganacsiga barta oo ka yimid Rajasthan, Hindiya, wuxuu horumariyay GitaGPT oo mashruuc dhinac ah oo isaga u gaar ah. Wuxuu filayey inuu si tartiib tartiib ah u bilaabmo, laakiin Sahu wuxuu sheegay in adeeggu uu helay 100,000 isticmaale oo aad u badan maalmo yar gudahood. Tan iyo markaas, way sii ballaaratay waxaana ka abuurmay chatbots ku salaysan qoraallada kale ee Hinduuda ee noocyada AI ee ilaahyada kale. Sahu waxa uu sheegay in uu rajaynayo in uu "u qaabeeyo jidka loo maro waxbarista "ilaahyada [Hindu]". Waxa uu sheegay in uu isaga tegay jaamacaddii uu dhiganayay si uu maalgelin ugu raadiyo mashruuca. Inta badan ururro-diimeedyada ayaa u bogaya isbeddelka. Horraantii 2025, Sadhguru, oo ah khabiir caan ah oo Hindi ah ahna aasaasaha Isha Foundation, ayaa daah-furay "Maskaxda Cajiibka" oo ah app qalwo lagu sameeyo oo ay ku jiraan dhowr qeybood oo AI ah. "Waxaan u adeegsaneynaa AI inay xikmadihii hore dadka u gaarsiiso qaab ku saleysan waxa hadda dhacaya. Ma aha keliya in app-ka laga dhigo mid caqli leh, balse waa in khibradda laga helaa mid shakhsiyadeed oo la aamini karo," ayuu yiri Swami Harsha, oo ka tirsan Isha Foundation. "Waxyaabaha ku jira app-ka waxaa ka mid ah waxa ku xusnaa buugga Sadhguru muddo 35 sano ah oo wax laga beddelay, si farriinta ku habboon loo gaarsiiyo qof maalintaas u baahan." App-ka ayaa la sheegay inay soo dejisteen hal milyan oo qof muddo 15 saacadood gudahood ah markii la daah-furay. AI waxaa sidoo kale loo adeegsadaa baaritaanka ruuxiga iyo kan cilmiyeed. Daraasad la sameeyay sanadkii 2022 ayaa lagu adeegsaday is barbardhigga waxyaabaha ku qoran kutubta Hinduuda. Khubarrada ayaa sheegaya in AI sidoo kale loo adeegsan karo soo bandhigidda micnaha qotada dheer ee ku duugan kutubtaas oo aan akhrinta caadiga ah lagu ogaan karin, ayna micno cusub u abuuri karaan qoraallada barakeysan. Khatarta waa taas – marka aaladahan loo arko codad ruuxi ah, erayadooda waxay xambaarsanaan karaan miisaan ka weyn intii ay ahayd – ayuu yiri Holly Walters Sida uu qabo Walters, AI waa uun wax lagu kordhiyay qaababka ay Hinduism iyo teknolojiyaddu horeba iskula falgeli jireen.

Maxay soo-galootiga ay Soomaalidu ka mid tahay uga dhigan tahay sharciga degannaansho ee ay Spain siineyso? , Wasiirka socdaalka ee Spaina ayaa xaqiijiyay in dowladda hantiwadaagga ah ee laga tirada badan yahay ay soo saari doonto wareegto siinaysa sharciyad deggenaansho ah boqollaal kun oo muhaajiriin ah. Tallaabadan uma baahna ansixinta baarlamaanka, halkaas oo xisbiyada garabka midig ay u badan tahay inay hor istaagi lahaayeen haddii la horgeeyo. Wareegtadu waxay khusaysaa dadka aan lahayn dembi hore oo dalka yimid ka hor billowgii sanadkan, kuwaas oo dalka ku noolaa in ka badan shan bilood wixii ka horreeyay 31 December 2025. "Tan maalin taariikhi ah ayay u tahay dalkeenna," ayay tiri Elma Saiz, oo ah wasiirka ammaanka bulshada iyo socdaalka Spain. "Waxaan xoojineynaa qaab socdaal oo ku dhisan xuquuqul insaanka, is-dhexgalka, wada-noolaanshaha, kaas oo la jaanqaadi kara kobaca dhaqaalaha iyo wadajirka bulshada," ayay tiri Saiz. Spain ayaa wajahday qulqul aad u weyn oo muhaajiriin ah sanadihii u dambeeyay, kuwaas oo u badan dad ka yimid Latin Ameerika. Xarunta cilmi-baarista ee muxaafidka ah ee Funcas ayaa ogaatay in tirada muhaajiriinta aan sharciga lahayn ee Spain ay ka kacday 107,409 qof sannadkii 2017 ilaa 837,938 qof sannadkii 2025 – taas oo ah kororsi siddeed laab ah. Tirada ugu badan ee muhaajiriinta aan sharciga lahayn ee hadda ku nool Spain ayaa la rumeysan yahay inay ka yimaadeen Colombia, Peru, iyo Honduras. Dawladda isbahaysiga hanti-wadaagga ee Spain ayaa kaga duwan dalalka kale ee waaweyn ee Yurub arrintan, iyadoo hoosta ka xarriiqday muhiimadda ay muhaajiriintu u leeyihiin dhaqaalaha. Dalku wuxuu ka waxqabad fiicnaa dalalka kale ee dhaqaalaha ee waaweyn ee Midowga Yurub sanadihii u dambeeyay, iyadoo la filayo kobac dhaqaale oo ku dhow 3% sannadka 2025. Shaqo la'aanta, oo ahayd daciifnimo muddo dheer soo jirtay oo haysata dhaqaalaha Spain, ayaa hoos uga dhacday 10% markii ugu horreysay tan iyo sannadkii 2008, sida ku cad tirokoobyada ay soo saartay hay'adda tirakoobka dalkaas maalintii Talaadada. Sawirka, Europa Press via Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Ra'iisul Wasaare Pedro Sánchez ayaa ku tilmaamay muhaajiriinta inay u taagan yihiin "hodantinnimada, horumarka iyo barwaaqada" Spain, isagoo farta ku fiiqay kaalinta ay ka qaataan nidaamka caymiska bulshada. Dowladda iyo xisbiyada bidixda ayaa sidoo kale xoogga saaray baahida loo qabo in muhaajiriinta loola dhaqmo si bani'aadannimo leh. "Bixinta xuquuqdu waa jawaabta lagula dagaallamo cunsuriyadda," ayay tiri Irene Montero, oo ka tirsan xisbiga bidixda fog ee Podemos, horayna wasiir uga soo ahayd dawladdii isbahaysiga hanti-wadaagga. Waxay u ololaysay tallaabadan, taas oo ka dhalatay heshiis dhex maray xisbiga iyo dawladda. Soo jeedin sharciyeed oo ay dadweynuhu soo gudbiyeen, taas oo ku baaqaysay sharciyayn ballaaran oo loo sameeyo muhaajiriinta, ayaa heshay taageerada ilaa 700,000 oo qof, laakiin waxay ku xayirnayd baarlamaanka. Tallaabadan waxaa lagu ansixin doonaa digreeto boqortooyo, taas oo macnaheedu yahay inaanay u baahnayn ansixinta baarlamaanka. Waa markii ugu horreysay muddo labaatan sano ah oo Spain ay ka dhacdo sharciyayn muhaajiriin oo baaxad weyn oo caynkan ah. Dhowr hindise oo noocan oo kale ah, oo ay sameeyeen dawladihii Hanti-wadaagga iyo xisbiga muxaafidka ee People's Party (PP), ayaa sharciyeeyay xaaladda qiyaastii nus milyan muhaajiriin ah intii u dhaxaysay 1986 ilaa 2005. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, oo ah hoggaamiyaha PP, ayaa sheegay in sharciyayntan baaxadda leh ee u dambaysay ay "kordhin doonto qulqulka dadka, culaysna ku keeni doonto adeegyadeenna dadweynaha." Pepa Millán, oo ah af-hayeenka xisbiga midigta fog ee Vox, ayaa sheegtay in hindisahani uu "weerar ku yahay aqoonsigeenna," iyadoo raacisay in xisbigu uu racfaan u gudbin doono Maxkamadda Sare si loo istaajiyo. Sawirka, Tallaabadan waxay leedahay faa'iido ah in dadkaas ay helaan degganaansho hal sano ah, oo kadibna lasii dheereyn karo. Codsiyada sharciyeynta ayaa la fileyaa inay billowdaan April hannaankuna wuxuu furnaan doonaa ilaa dhammaadka June. Waxaa la qiyaasayaa in in ka badan nus milyan qof ay ka faa'iidaysan doonaan arrintaan. Soomaali badan ayaa ku nool dalkaas Spain, kuwaasoo qaarkood tahriib ku galay isla markaana bulshooyinka kale kala mid ahaa sharci la'aanta. Maxamed Cibaar Diiriye oo deggan magaalada Madrid ee dalka Spain ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in dad badan oo dalkaasi jooga, gaar ahaan kuwa ka yimid galbeedka Afrika aysan sharci heysan. Wuxuu xusay in faa'iidada kale ay tahay in dadka soo-galootiga ay u suurto-geli doonto inay ka dhex shaqeystaan dalkaas. "Arrintan waa mid aad loo sugayay" ayuu yiri. Wuxuu sheegay in inta badan Soomaalida Spain ku nool ay yihiin kuwo sharciga mar hore qaatay. "Waxaad mooddaa in Soomaalidu ay yihiin kuwa ugu yar ee sharci la'aanta ku ah dalkan, waana inta badan kuwa kasoo galay dhinaca badda," ayuu intaa raaciyay. Cibaar ayaa xusay in Soomaalida dalkaas ay nasiib u yeesheen inay Spain il gaar ah ku fiiriso oo ay sharciyada u fududeyso.

Hayada caafimaadka ayaa ku guul dareystey dacwad ka socotey maxkamadda oo ay doonayeen in ay dowladda hoose bixiso kharashka dawadan. Ilaa 10 000 oo ruux ayaa iminka la siinayaa dawadaas mudo saddex sanadood oo tijaabo ah. Hay'ada caafimaadka ee Ingiriisku waxay sheegtey in ay tani ka caawin doonto sidii loogu bixin lahaa si baahsan. Pre-exposure prophylaxis ama Prep, waa kaniini la qaadanayo maalin kasta oo dilaya viruska ka hor inta aanu si buuxda u gelin jirka. Qiimuhu qofkiiba waa £400, tijaabadan la sameeyeyna waxa lagu ogaadey in kaniinigani uu yareynayo 86% in la qaado xanuunkaas. Hay'ada caafimaadka ayaa sheegtay in uu kaniinkani u muuqdo mid waxtar leh. Hase ahaatee, waxay sheegeen in wali loo baahan yahay in wax badan laga ogaado qaabka looga isticmaali karo England oo dhan. Tijaabintu waa in ilaa 10 000 oo ruux lagu tijaabiyaa siddii loo ogaan lahaa qaabka dawada loo siin karo dadka ku haboon, faa'dadiisa iyo muddada ay tahay in ay qaataan. Gudoomiyaha Waaxda HIV ee hay'ada aafimaadka England Dr Ian Williams, ayaa yiri, 'Arrintani waxay muujineysaa sidda NHS uga go'an tahay in ay maalgeliso tijaabadan iyo in la helo fursada si wanaagsan loogu diyaar garoobayo in la sameeyo tijaabo caafimaad oo baaxad weyn'. "Xilligan, tijaabadani waxay fursad siineysaa in ay dad badan oo khatar u ah inay qaadaan xanuunkan ay ka qayb qaataan.

Fanaankii "caloosha hooyadii ku garaadsaday" oo maanta la aasayo Mulaxamiiste Xasan Sabriye Afrax (Xasan Gareed) wuxuu mid ka mid ahaa mulaxannada ugu cod samaynta fiicnaa laxamada, heeso badan oo uu sameeyeyna waa kuwa dhagaysigooda Soomaalidu ugu jeceshahay. Laakiin nolosha Gareed ayaa leh xiiso gooniya leh. Wuxuu ku dhashay Gobolka Galgaduuud ee bartamaha Soomaaliya ahaan deegaan u dhow Dhuuso mareeb. Xasan gareed wuxuu sheegay inuu ku dhashay 11 bilood, sidaasna loogu biixiyey naynaasta (Garaad) oo loo bixin jiray dadka sidiisoo kale ah, kuwaas oo ku dhasha muddo ka badan tirsi qaadka uurka ee hooyada. “Anigu sagaal kuma dhalan,waxaan ku dhashay 11 bilood, marka nin caloosha ku garaadsaday ayaa garaad loo bixiyaa ee la iskama bixiyo” ayuu yiri allah u naxariistee Xasan Gareed. "Aabahay wuxuu ii bixiyey magaca Xasan oo uu iigu wanqalay, laakiin hooyaday waxay ii bixisay garaad, markaas ka dib anigoo yar ayaan xamar tagay dadku ma aqoon magaca garaad ee reer Xamarkii ayaa u badalay Gareed" ayuu yiri. Burburkii ka dhacay Dalka Xasan meelna uguma bixin Muqdisho, wuxuuse tilmaamay in tabar u waayey inuu ka baxo. “Waxaan tawakalay ilaahay, meshii aan ku noolaa gurigaygii oo ku yaala xaafad la yiraahdo Xamar Bile oo Siinaay ku taala ayaan deganahay aniga iyo caruurtaydu xitaa Afgooye maanan gaarin” Markii dalku galay burburka, Xasan wax walba oo noloshiiisa ah waa is badaleen, wuxuuna galay nolol adag, Waraysi uu siiyey BBCda ayuu ku sheegay inuu soo maray maalmo aaad u adkaa. “ Meel la yiraahdo Bakaaraha oo suuq ganacsi ah ayaan u foof-tagi jiray kol aad garato qofaad taqaano, reer miyise baa yimid. Wixiise aan ka soo helo ayaan guriga keeni jiray, ha yaraadaan ama ha bataane.” Muddo ka dib wuxu sheegay in markii Muqdisho ay tagtay Dowladdii Madaxweyne Cabdilaahi Yuusuf hogaaminayey ilaa Dowladii Shiikh Shariif ay fanaaniintii joogtay markaa ay lacago u qoreen, mar konton marna boqol dollar ay ka heli jireen. Dabaqaayadii 1963 ayuu soo galay Fanka hase yeeshee wuxuu ahaa intii hore mid banaanka ku shaqeeya. Sanadkii 1967 ayuuse si rasmi ah ugu biiray fankii Soomaalida isagoo door muuqda ku lahaa kobaciisi. Codadka macaan ee ku saaray heeso badan ayaa Xasan ka dhigay inay laxamadiisa soo jiitaan abwaano badan oo miraha samayn jiray. Abwaan Ahmed Saleeban Bidde ay isku waayo ahaayen xagga fanka ayaa sheegay in Allah u Raxmadee Xasan Gareed uu ahaa nin shaqsiyad Fiican Waligiisna uusan arag qof ay is haystaan. Sanadkii 1964 ayuu sheegay inay isugu horeysay isaga iyo Xasan oo markaa xiiso u qabay inuu barto kabanka ama cuudka, gacanna uu ka siiyey dalabkisii. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Xasan wuxu jiilkiisi fanka ahaa mid kulahaa magac iyo maamuus, doorkiisa fanka soomaliduna wuxuu ahaa inuu cododka u sameeyo miraha ay hal abuuraan abwaanada ka hor inta aan loo dhiibin fanaan ku luuqeeya. Heeso ilaa hadda aan laga daalin dhagaysigooda ayuu leeyahay laxamaddooda kuwaas oo qaybtood ay noqdeen kuwa loogu jeclaa. Tii ugu horreysay ee uu Laxankeeda sameeyo waxay ahayd heestii la oran jiray Sida canabka beeraha oo miraheeda uu lahaa Abwaan Maxamed Maxamuud Dheeg ayna wadajir u wada qaadeen alaha u naxariistee Xaliimo Khaliif Magool iyo Maxamed Axmed Kuluc. Heesihii taa ka dambeeyey ee uu laxameeyo waxaa ka mid ahaa hees uu sameeyey alaha u naxariistee Abwaan Cabdi Iidaan Faarax, heestii la oran jiray Xurmo daran oo uu qaaday Maxamed Axmed Kuluc. Kuwa kale ee caanka ahaa uu laxanka u sameeyey waxaa ka mid ahayd heestii Hooyooy la'aantaa ee uu qaaday Maxamed Saleen Tubeec oo sameeyey alaha u naxariistee Abwaan Maxamed Ibaahim Warsame (Hadraawi) Ka sokow codod ama laxan samaynta, Xasan Sabriye wuxuu caan ku ahaa garaacida kacabka ama cuudka taas kor u qaaday doorkiisa fanka maadaama u kulansaday labado hibo oo ay adkayd in hal qof yeesho.

Warbaahinta Shiinaha iyo sida ay uga faalootay dagaalka Iran , Ka dib weeraradii Maraykanka iyo Israa'iil, warbaahinta dawladda Shiinaha iyo falanqeeyayaasha ayaa diiday isbarbardhigga Iran iyo Venezuela, iyaga oo tilmaamaya kakanaanta siyaasadeed iyo awoodda milatari ee Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah. Isbarbardhigga Iran iyo Venezuela ayaa lagu diiday qoraal ay soo saartay warbaahinta nus-dowliga ah, waxaana lagu sheegay in Donald Trump uu aaminsanaa in qaabka Venezuelan lagu dabaqi karo si loo sameeyo isbeddel maamul oo ka dhaca Iran, kaas oo lagu tilmaamay "maskaxda caadiga ah ee kuwa aaminsan isbalaarinta." Qoraal kale ayaa sheegaya in labada xaaladood ay yihiin natiijada ujeedooyinka istiraatiijiga ah ee Mareykanka ee la xiriira tamarta iyo saameynta gobolka. Qaar ka mid ah warbaahinta Shiinaha iyo falanqeeyayaasha ayaa sheegay in jawaabta militari ee Tehran ay ka bixisay weerarradii Mareykanka iyo Israa'iil ee dhowaan dhacay ay muujineyso in Iran aysan la mid ahayn Venezuela. Wareysi uu siiyay The New York Times 1-dii Maarso, Donald Trump wuxuu ku sheegay in waxa Mareykanka uu ka sameeyay Venezuela uu ahaa "tusaale dhammaystiran," isagoo si toos ah isu barbar dhigaya howlgalka Venezuela iyo xaaladda Iran. Wargeyska, oo ah shabakad warbaahineed lagu xagliyo dowladda, ayaa la hadashay Ross Harrison, oo ah saaxiib sare oo ka tirsan Machadka Bariga Dhexe ee Washington, iyaga oo wax ka waydiiyay isla mowduuca. Waxa uu sheegay in isbarbardhiggan uu yahay mid aan sax ahayn, inkastoo ay muuqato isku ekaanshiyaha, haddana hadafka Mareykanka ee hadda uusan u muuqan inuu yahay in la gaaro xal dhexdhexaad ah ama nabad kuwada noolaanshaha hoggaanka cusub ee Iran ka dib markii meesha laga saaray hoggaamiyaha sare ee Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah. Waxa uu intaa ku daray in Maraykanku "ay aad uga badan yahay kantaroolka ajendaha Venezuela marka loo eego Iran," oo ah waddan "ka weyn, leh qaab-dhismeed qaran oo aad u adag, oo leh saameyn qoto dheer oo gobolka ah." Sawirka, Telefiishanka dhexe ee Shiinaha, oo ah shabakadda caalamiga ah ee dawladda, ayaa warbixin muuqaal ah oo af Ingiriis ah ku wareysatay James Dorsey, oo ah xubin sare oo ka tirsan Dugsiga Sare ee Daraasaadka Caalamiga ah ee S. Rajaratnam, kaas oo dib u xusuusanaya mar uu ku sugnaa Tehraan xilligii kacaankii 1979-kii. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Waxa uu sheegay marka laga yimaado in Iran la jecel yahay iyo inkale, waxa hadda la arkayo ay tahay in Venezuela, Panama iyo Greenland ka dib, ay tahay markii ugu horeysay ee uu dal kaco oo uu yiraahdo "Kama laaban doono, isma dhiibi doono, hadii ay la macno tahay dagaal iyo hadii kalabe". Falanqeyn tafatiran oo lagu daabacay wargeyska caalamiga ah ee Global Times ee ay dowladdu maamusho ayaa soo xigtay qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha in madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump iyo xoghayaha gaashaandhigga Pete Hegsett, oo horey uga hadlay "guulaha" ay gaareen ay qabteen shirar jaraa'id isla markiiba ka dib howlgallada militari ee Venezuela iyo dalal kale, balse ay haatan u dhaqmayaan gabi ahaanba si ka duwan sidii hore. Taas bedelkeeda, warbixintu waxa ay intaa ku dartay in hadalka General Dan Kaine, oo ah Guddoomiyaha Taliyaasha Wadajirka ah ee Ciidamada Mareykanka, uu u muuqdo " mid Niyad-jab badan uu haysto." Sun Degang, oo ah khabiir Bariga Dhexe oo tirsan jaamacadda Fudan, ayaa sidoo kale u sheegtay warbaahinta gobolka Shanghai Observer in aanay fududayn in lagu sameeyo Iran "qaabka Venezuela". "Burka cad ee laga saaray qolofka markii la sameynayay kaas oo ah kan aan hadda cuno waa sida sun cad, waxa uu la mid yahay sokorto iyo cusbada", ayuu yiri M. Hadii aad dooneyso in aadan wax badan cunin ama markasta aad cuntid bariiska markaas waxaa fiican jabaatiga maxaa yeelay waxa uu leeyahay faybar badan. Mala waxay leedahay, "Marka aad cuneysid jabaatiga hadii aad ku dartid borotiin waa wax fiican. Dadka cuna cuntooyinka waxybaaha xoolaha ka yimaada waxay haystaan kala doorashooyin badan. Waxaa la rumeysan yahay in cuntada aad cuneysay ilaa markii aad yareyd in aad ku qanceysid. Dr. Wali waxa uu yiri, "Meelo badan dadka ma sameysan karaa jabaatiga. Inta badan dadka India waxay cunaan bariis".

Guidance: Ticketing for BBC events and programmes The purpose of this guidance note is to assist content makers in meeting the Editorial Guidelines relating to Ticket Sales. (See Editorial Guidelines Section 16: External Relationships, including Commercial Relationships, and Financing 16.4.37 – 16.4.38) The Editorial Guidelines state that: The BBC may recover costs from the proceeds of ticket sales for BBC UK Public Service or World Service events which contribute to the BBC's Mission and Public Purposes.[1] This should be in line with the Statement on Ticketing for BBC Public Service Events.[2] The BBC may charge for tickets to BBC concerts, concert series or other BBC events held at outside venues. The BBC should not charge for admission to regular recordings of other programmes. Entry should only be charged for events held at an outside venue, not normally for events held in BBC studios. However, there may be a way to charge for tickets to events held in a BBC concert hall or studio. Advice and approval can be sought from Editorial Policy. The BBC may also charge for tickets to BBC concerts held in the regular venues of the BBC performing groups. Some BBC concert halls or studios are used both for orchestral concerts and also to record regular BBC programmes. It is not appropriate to charge for tickets for the regular programme recordings. In other exceptional, circumstances if there is any proposal to sell tickets to any other BBC event on BBC premises, such as an event to raise money for a BBC charitable initiative, the proposal must be approved in advance by Editorial Policy. Proposals to ticket a BBC event, which is part of a third party event that will require the public to pay an entry fee, should be referred to Editorial Policy. Occasionally an outside organisation, for example a gardening club, may invite the BBC to hold an outside broadcast programme at their premises. In these cases, with the advance approval of Editorial Policy, it may be appropriate for the location to charge a modest fee to the audience that they invite, in order to cover their costs. The amount charged must be agreed with the BBC beforehand to ensure the fee is fair and is not set at a rate that is designed to make a profit. Sometimes a programme which is regularly recorded in a BBC studio puts on an event at an outside location. For example a radio comedy sometimes appears at the Edinburgh Festival. In such cases it may be appropriate to charge for tickets to the special outside broadcast show. Ticket revenue must only cover the costs of an event or series of events and not be used for broadcast or production costs. The proceeds are not designed to generate further income for the BBC, unless the sales raise money for a BBC charitable initiative, such as Children in Need or Comic Relief and this has been approved by Editorial Policy and the relevant charity. Tickets to events and/or BBC shows may be included in auctions and prize draws to raise money for BBC partner charities. Any such proposals must be referred to the Senior Editorial Figure in charge of the content which is to be included. They must also be referred to Editorial Policy and ITACU (Interactive Technical Advice and Contracts Unit). In order to ensure that proposals for ticketing events and/or setting up new events meet the Statement of Policy on use of alternative finance in BBC[3] content, contact the Fair Trading team, part of the Public Policy team. An Events Form from Fair Trading must be completed for Public Service events for which tickets will be charged where it is: (b) an existing event with significant changes to either (i) the event or (ii) the charged ticketing arrangements. The form should be sent to Fair Trading, Editorial Policy and a relevant senior editorial figure or, for independents, the commissioning editor. Ticket prices must be referred to Fair Trading who will assess likely market impact. The final proposal, including the ticketing, must be approved by the relevant Head of Department/Controller who must refer to Editorial Policy, Public Policy and Regulatory Legal. While ticket revenue may be used for event costs, the BBC must pay for all broadcast costs. Occasionally there are requests from festivals, such as film festivals, to display a recorded programme, either prior to transmission or post- transmission. Approvals for this should come from the relevant Head of Marketing. It is not normally appropriate for a separate charge to be made to see the BBC material. However it may be acceptable for there to be an over-all entry charge to the whole event, if it includes a substantial amount of non-BBC content, for example when showcasing BBC content at a third party event such as a public festival. BBC Audience Services supply audiences for many TV and radio programmes and some BBC events with free tickets. They advertise the availability of tickets on the BBC Tickets site. Audience Services have a Code of Practice for free ticketing for BBC programmes. (See Code of Practice: BBC Guidelines for Ticketing and Stewarding BBC Studio Audience Programmes) Should a production wish to use another ticketing supplier they should establish that the company is reputable – no external organisation that the BBC becomes involved with should bring the BBC into disrepute. (See Editorial Guidelines 16.4.1 – 16.4.9) It is advisable to check that that there is no controversy associated with the company's ticketing and that they are reliable in sending out tickets. BBC Studios has a Privacy Team who work with BBC Information Security to assess suppliers' compliance with information security and data privacy policies and standards. Once this due diligence has been completed, the relevant Production's Business Affairs team can pull together the paperwork/contract. Ticketing for BBC broadcast events held at an outside venue may be handled by the BBC, by the external venue or by a ticketing company which has been contracted by the BBC or by the external venue, such as the box office at a concert hall. For a BBC event a direct link to the ticketing site is likely to be editorially justifiable. It should be clear that the public is leaving the BBC site to get to the source of the tickets. It is important that the primary purpose of the site that is linked to is the selling of public tickets. It would not be appropriate, for example, to link to a site whose primary purpose was to sell corporate hospitality to a BBC event. However it may be acceptable to link to a site selling public tickets for a BBC event as its primary purpose, which also sells added extras to the event (such as corporate hospitality), if there is appropriate separation between the main function and the subsidiary ones. On all external ticketing sites there should also be adequate separation between the use of BBC brands and third party brands. If in doubt, contact Fair Trading for further advice. Third party ticketing sites providing tickets for BBC events should not normally be referred to in on air trails. Usually an acceptable route is to point to the programme or channel website and link to external sites from there (for example to a ticketing site or an event/festival site). When a BBC commissioned programme or BBC commissioned event, such as Sports Personality of the Year, is ticketed, availability of the tickets may be trailed on air. Care should be taken if availability of tickets for events organised by third parties are mentioned. It is not usually appropriate to trail tickets on air or online for third party events. In some exceptional cases it may be acceptable, for example where a BBC orchestra is performing at an event. Advice should be sought from Editorial Policy. All ticketing arrangements must stand up to scrutiny and be clearly auditable. It is very important to ensure that event costs are calculated separately from the broadcast costs. Production, commissioning and Commercial Rights and Business Affairs (CRBA) should keep separate accounts of event and production costs and records of ticketing revenue going to the BBC or via the BBC. Separate records must be kept of all ticket revenue going to the BBC or going via the BBC. Farxaddii arooska ee murugada isku beddeshay iyo saygii oo BBC la hadlay , Social/Facebook Fiiro gaar ah: Sheekadan waxay xambaarsan tahay tiiraanyo iyo naxdin. Waa dhacdo aad u xanuun badan, ayna yar yihiin dadka la kulma qaddartan oo kale. Allaha u naxariistee Aasiya Cabdi ayaa geerideeda si weyn loogu baahiyay baraha ay bulshadu ku kulanto ka dib geeri xanuun badan oo ku timid iyada iyo xubno ka tirsan qoyskeeda. Aasiya waxa ay ku nooleyd magaalada Doolow ee gobolka Gedo, ka dib muddo badan oo ay xiriir wadaag ahaayeen wiil lagu magacaabo Maxamed Xasan Khaliif waxa ay ugu dambeyn ku heshiiyeen guur. Asiya oo maalmo fasax ah ku tagtay magaalada Caasimadda ah ee Muqdisho, waxa ay dib ugu soo noqotay Doolow, halkaa oo uu meherkoodii si habsami leh uga dhacay. 23-kii bishii aynu ka soo gudubnay ee Diseembar ayuu dhacay arooskoodii, hase yeeshee xilligaasi wixii ka dambeeyay waxaa farxaddii guurka hareysay murugo iyo tacsi waa saddex toddobaad gudahood. Isla maalmihii guurkooda uu dhacay waxaa geeriyootay Aasiya ayeydeed, waxaana halkaa ka dhacday tacsi sababtay in ay soo gaabtaan maalmihii dabaal degga ee arooska. Tacsida kadib Aasiya iyo seygeeda waxa ay ku heshiyeen in ay soo baxdo oo ay timaado Nairobi, waxa ay soo gaartay Ismaamulka Mandera halkaas oo loogu diyaariyay tigidkii ay diyaaradda kusoo raaci lahayd si ay Nairobi oo gurigii looga kireeyay ay u timaaddo. Maxamed Khaliif oo ah seyga Aasiya ah waxa uu xilligii uu meherka dhacayay ku sugnaa dalka Koonfurta Sudan oo ah halkaas oo uu ka shaqeeyo, adeerradiis ayaana dhameeyay howsha guurka iyo doonista gabadha waxaana ay ku ballameen in ay Nairobi timaaddo si ay ugu aqal galaan. Maxamed oo BBC-da u warramay ayaa yiri, “Anigu waxa aan kaga soo hormaray Nairobi si aan aqalkii noogu diyaariyo, gabadha waxaa safarka la soo gashay habaryarteed oo dooneysay in ay Nairobi Keento, balse wixii intaa ka dambeeyay musiibo ayaa dhacday. Diyaaraddii ay subixii kasoo raaci lahaayeen Mandera ayaa loo sheegay in ay dib u dhacday iyadoo maalmahaas ay diyaaraduhu hakad galeen, waxa ay go’aansadeen in ay gaari soo raacaan, hase yeeshee amar Alle ayaa dhexda ku helay oo shil ayey galeen”. Magaalada Garissa oo ay nabad ku yimaadeen markii ay ka soo baxeen ayuu shilku dhacay oo xitaa markii hore gaarigii ayaa cillad ku timid markaa Maxamed iyo Aasiyo way wada hadleen si farxadi ku jirto maadaama ay dareemayeen in is aragoodu uu dhow yahay. Sawirka, Social/Facebook Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Maxamed ayaa sheegay in ay gabadha habaryarteed oo lagu magacaabayay Faadumo ay shilkaasi ku naf weyday Aasiyana uu soo gaaray dhaawac daran. Maxamed ma uusan jecleyn in Aasiya iyo habaryarteed ay ku soo safraan gaari maadama ay waddadu dheereyd safarkuna uu khatar badnaa, wuxuu isku dayay in uu ku qanciyo in ay diyaaradaha sugaan, hase yeeshee markii dambe waxaa la’isku af gartay in safar dhulka ah la soo galo. “Markii iigu dambeysay waxaan isla hadleynay in kabadan 30 daqiiqo oo ay taagnaayeen meel uu gaarigu kaga cilladoobay, markii uu u hagaagay ayey soo bexeen oo aan is macsalaameynay, 12 daqiiqo kadib waxaa i soo wacday gabar saaxiibteed ah oo Iyana safarka ku wehlineysay oo aad u ooyeysa waxana ay ii sheegtay in ay qaddari dhacday”, ayuu yiri Maxamed Khaliif. Waxa uu sheegay in ay gabadhii ku war gelisay in habaryar Faadumo ay xaaladeedu aad u adag tahay Aasiyana ay gacan ka go’day isla markaana aysan wax gurmad ah heysan. Garissa ayaa dib loogu celiyay si halkaa loogu dabiibo xaaladooda. Saacad kadib ayaa lasoo sheegay geerida habaryar Faadumo, waxaana Nairobi loola soo cararay Aasiya. Markii habaryar ay geeriyootay waxaan Maxamed iyo dadkii kale ay xoogga saareen in Aasiyo loo soo qaado Nairobi si loola tacaalo xaaladeeda. Sawirka, Social/Facebook “Dhakhaatiirtu waxa ay sheegeen in gabadha uu maskaxda dhiig uga furmay isla markaana loo baahan yahay in qalliin deg deg ah lagu sameeyo, intaa ka dibna qalliinkii ayaa lagu guuleystay, ka dib ayaa naloo sheegay haddana in maskaxda iyo wadnaha gabadha aysan wada shaqeyneyn oo xaalad culus ay gashay markale”, ayuu yiri Maxamed. Waxa uu codsaday in loo fasaxo in uu gudaha ugu galo qolka ay ka jiiftay isbitaalka isagoo tilmaamay in habeenkii oo dhan uu dul taagnaa marka gacanta saaro meel ka mida jirkeedana uu ka dareemayay qabow badan. “Subixii ayaa dhakhtarku noo yimid, waxa uu xoogaa ka dib noo sheegay in gabadhu ay xaaladeeda sii cuslaaneyso, xogaa uu gudaha ku jiray ka dibna waa uu noo yimid waxana uu nagu war geliyay akhbaarka geerideeda”, ayuu yiri Maxamed Xasan Khaliif. Maxamed waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in geerida ayeeyadeed oo ay aad u jecleed ay Aasiya ku abuurtay murug badan, isla markaana ay wakhti ku qaadatay in uu dejiyo ama samirsiiyo. Waxa uu ku ammaanay in ay ahayd gabar af gaaban oo aqlaal badan, isla markaana uu u duceynayo. Waxa uu sheegay in uu hilmaami waayay hadal ay ku tiri ka hor inta aysan soo gelin safarka dhulka ah ee ay shilka ku galeen. “Waxa ay igu tiri waan ogahay in aadan jecleyn safar dhulka ah mana rabo in aan sameeyo wax aadan raalli ka ahayn, laakiin niyada ii fur, anigana waxa aan ku iri wan ku fasaxay waana idiin duceeyay ee Allaha idin nabad keeno”, ayuu sii raaciyay Maxamed. Shalay ayaa Aasiya lagu aasay magalaada Nairobi oo ugu dambeyn ay ku geeriyootay.

Villa Somalia oo BBC da uga warantay kulankii dhexmaray Masar iyo Soomaaliya , Villa Somalia Afhayeenka madaxtooyada Soomaaliya Abdirahman Xadaana oo la hadlay BBC Somali ayaa sheegay in arrinka ugu muhiimsan ee Soomaaliya iyo Masar ay ka wada hadleen uu yahay "xadgudub Soomaaliya uga yimid dibadda", sidaas daraadeedna ay tahay in la adkeeyo midnimada Soomaaliya. Afahyeenla ayaa xadgudub ku tilmaamay aqoonsiga Israa'iil ee Somaliland, dowladda Soomaaliya ay wado dadaalo ay ku xoojineyso xiriirka dowladaha kale si ay uga hortagto "wax kasta oo dhaawacaya midnimada Soomaaliya. "Runtii labada madaxweyne waxay markastaba awoodda saarayeen in loo midoobo in la iska kaashado in la adkeeyo midnimada Soomaaliya". Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xassan Sheekh Maxamuud oo safar ku marayay wadamo kala duwan oo ay ka mid yihiin Turkiga iyo Qatar, ayaa kulan waxa uu qasriga madxtooyada ee Masar kula qaatay dhigiisa Abdifitah al Sisi, iyaga oo ka wada hadlay xiriirka labada dal. Afahayeenka ayaa sheegay in dhanka kale ay labada madaxweyne ka wada hadleen iskaashiga dhinaca ammaanka ee mudaba ay ku wada jireen labada dal. "Qaar way fuleen, kuwa kale ee harsan, waa in la fuliyo", ayuu hadalkiisa raaciyay afhayeen Xadaana. Madaxweynaha Masar, C/fataax Al-Sisi iyo Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa si wadajir ah ugu kala saxiixday Qasriga Al-Itixaadiya ee magaalada Qaahira, heshiis dhigayay xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada siyaasadda, militariga, dhaqaalaha, dhaqanka iyo waxbarshada. Shir jaraa'id oo ay si wadajir ah u qabteen ayuu madaxwaynaha Masar waxaa uu bogaadiyay xirirka sii xoogeysanaya ee labada dal. Sida laga soo xigtay Madaxweyne El-Sisi, Masar iyo Soomaaliya waxay ku heshiiyeen inay sii wadaan dhaqan gelinta hab-maamuuska iskaashiga militariga ee lagu saxiixay Qaahira Agoosto 2024. Wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda ee soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay in la isku raacay in la xoojiyo xiriirka iyada oo loo marayo Guddiga Wadajirka ah ee Wasiirada iyo in la dhaqan geliyo qodobbadii ka soo baxay shirkii Masar, Soomaaliya iyo Ereteriya ee 2024, ee kor u qaadista amniga Geeska Afrika iyo gobolka Badda Cas. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh waxa kale oo uu booqasho ku tagay wadamada Turkiga iyo Qatar ka hor inta uusan booqan Masar. Afhayeen Xadaana ayaa sheegay in dhamaan wadamadaas iyo madasha Jazeera ee uu Qatar uga qayb galayba ay ahayd in uu la socodsiiyo daneeyayaasha arimaha Soomaaliya halka ay wax marayaan. "Intii ay bilaabatay arrrinta xadgudubka Israa'iil ay ku xadgudubtay dhulka Soomaaliyeed, madaxweynuhu dardar ayuu galiyay cilaaqaadkii duwaliga ahaa sida aanu ka war qabbo. Dowlado faro badan oo dowladaha Islaamka iyo carabta ah iyo dowladaha kale ee Yurub iyo dhammaan, waa la wada cambaareeyay arrintii ay ku kacday Israa'iil", ayuu yiri afhayeenka madaxtooyada Soomaaliya, Abdirahman Xadaana. Dhanka kel, Masar ayaa ciidamadeeda ku biirin doonaan ciidamada nabad ilaalinta ee Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, wasiirkeeda arrimaha dibadda ayaa horay sidaas u sheegay, sida ay baahisay warbaahinta iyadoo xiriirka labada dal uu sii xoogeysanayay tan iyo markii ay bilaabatay xiisadda kala dhexeyso Itoobiya oo ku saabsan aqoonsiga Somaliland. "Masar waxay go'aansatay inay ka qayb-gasho howlgalka, iyadoo ka duulaysa codsiga dowladda Soomaaliya iyo soo dhaweynta golaha nabadda iyo ammaanka ee Midowga Afrika," ayuu yiri Badar Abdelatty oo shir jaraa'id ku qabtay Qaahira oo uu ku xusayay booqashadii wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya. Hawlgalka xasilinta iyo taageerada Midowga Afrika, ee loo yaqaan AUSSOM, ayaa badalay howlgalka ATMIS ee waqtigiisu dhammaaday, balse waxaa wali la sugayaa imaatanka ciidamada Masar ee sida goonida ah howlgalkaan uga qayb noqonaya.

Warrarkii ugu dambeeyey iyo tirada dadka ku dhintay shilkii diyaaradeed ee dalka Brazil Diyaarad nooca rakaabka qaada ah ayna la socdeen rakaab dhan 61 qof ayaa ku burburtay gobolka São Paulo ee dalka Brazil. Diyaarada oo ahayd nooca labada mator laha ah ee ‘Turboprop- ayaa ka soo duushay magaalada Cascavel ee koonfurta Paraná kuna sii jeeday gegida diyaaradaha ee Guarulhos ee magaalada São Paulo, ka dibna waxay ku dhacday xaafado la deggan yahay oo ku yaalla magaalada Vinhedo sida ay sheegtay shirkada Voepass airline. Muuqaalo lagu faafiyey baraha bulshada ayaa muujinaya diyaarad oo si toos ah u soo dhacaysa, iyadoo ruxmaysay marka ay soo dhacaysay. Diyaaradan oo nooceedu ahaa ATR 72-500 ayaa waxaa saarnaa 57 rakaab ah iyo afar shaqaale ah. Maamulka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in aysan jirin cid ka badbaaday shilka. Saraakiishu ma aysan sheegin magacyada dadka saarnaa iyo inay ku jireen dadkaasi ajnabi iyo in kale. Madaxweynaha Brazil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, ayaa muujiyay sida ay u garab taagan yihiin qoysaska iyo asxaabta dhibanayaasha. Guddoomiyaha gobolka São Paulo, Tarcísio Gomes de Freitas, ayaa ku dhawaaqay saddex maalmood oo baroor diiq ah. Maamulka ayaa sheegay in qalabka duuba macluumaadka duulimaadka la soo saaray. ATR, oo ah shirkadda ay leeyihiin dalalka Faransiiska iyo Talyaaniga oo samaysa diyaaradaha ayaa sheeegtay inay ku biirayaan baaritaanadda. Inkasta oo diyaaradu ku dhacday xaafado la deggan yahay haddana ma jirto sida maamulku sheegay cid wax ku noqotay halkii ay ku dhacday. Saraakiishu waxay sheegeen in hal guri oo ku yaalla aaga diyaaradu ku dhacday uu burburay. Muuqaalka baraha bulshada lagu faafiyey wuxuu sidoo kale muujinayay dhul ballaaran oo dab ka kacay. Booliska iyo dabdamiska ayaa goobta gaary si dabka kacay loo damiyo. Sida laga soo xigtay bogga raadraaca ee Flightradar24, diyaaradda waxay ka duushay Cascavel 11:56 waqtiga maxalliga ah basle digniintii ugu dambaysay ee laga helay diyaaradda waxay ahayd saacad iyo badh ka dib duulimaadkeeda. Hay’adda duulista rayidka ee Brazil ayaa sheegtay in diyaaradda ay ku jirtay “xaalad hawleed wanaagsan, ayna ku jirtay aqoonsi diiwaan galineed oo sax una qalantay inay duulimaadyo samayso. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Waxay intaas raacisay in afartii shaqaalaha ahaa oo ay ku jireen duuliyasha diyaaradu ay “ ay dhammaantood siteen shati sax ah waxayna lahaayeen shahaadooyin sax ah,” ayay intaas raacisay. Cisbitaalka Kansarka ee Uopeccan ee Cascavel ayaa BBC Brasil u sheegay in laba ka mid ah dhakhaatiirtooda ay ka mid ahaayeen rakaabkii dhintay. Goob joogayaal ku sugnaa aagga diyaaradu ku dhacday oo ka mid ahaa dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay "Markii aan maqlay dhawaqa diyaaradda soo dhacaysa, waxaan ka eegay daaqadda guriga oo aan arkay xilliga ay burburtay," Felipe Magalhaes ayaa u sheegay wakaaladda wararka ee Reuters. Madaxweyne Lula ayaa ka tacsiyeeyay dadkii ku dhintay shilkaas diyaaradeed ee ka dhacay Brazil. "Waxaan aad ugu xumay warkan aadka u xun, waxaana jeclaan lahaa in qof walba uu u istaago si aan u helno hal daqiiqo oo aamusnaan ah," ayuu yiri isagoo hadlayey. Magaalada Valinhos ee u dhow ayaa u dirtay 20 ka tirsan shaqaalaha gurmadka goobta shilku ka dhacay si ay qayb uga noqdaan hawlgal wadajir ah, sida ay sheegeen maamulka deegaanka. ATR, ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in lagu wargeliyay shilka duulimaadka sumadiiisu ahayd ATR 72-500. "Khubarada ATR waxay si buuxda ugu hawlan yihiin inay taageeraan baaritaanka iyo macaamilka labadaba."ayaa lagu bayaanka ay soo saareen. Waa shilkii ugu xumaa ee ka dhaca dalka Brazil tan iyo sanadkii 2007-dii, markaasoo diyaarad ay leedahay shirkadda TAM Express ay ku burburtay, kuna gubtay garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaalada São Paulo halkaasoo ay ku dhinteen 199 qof.

Sheekada "Ugaaska Soomaaliga ah ee isaga oo nool diyadiisa la bixiyo" Ugaas Yuusuf Ugaas Xasan Ugaas Khaliif Ugaas Rooble oo noqonaya Ugaaskii 21-aad ee beesha Xawaadle ayaa maanta lagu caano-shubay deegaanka Daharro Ugaas oo ka tirsan magaalada Halgan ee gobolka Hiiraan. Ugaas Yuusuf ayaa badalaya aabbihii Ugaas Xasan Ugaas Khaliif oo Muqdisho ku geeriyeeday bishii Febraayo 2021. Deegaanka Daharro Ugaas, ayaa u dhexeeya magaalooyinka Beledweyne iyo Buule-berde. Deegaankan ayaa taariikh ahaan ku caan baxay in lagu aaso ugaasyadii beeshaasu ay lahayd marka ay dhintaan sababtaa darted ayayna taariikh gaara ugu leedahay. Dhanka kale, deegaankan ayaa ku yaal xuddunta deegaammada beeshaas. Beeshan ayaana soo yeelatay 21 dhaqan, taas oo sida ay noo sheegeen duqeytida deegaankaasi, laba keliya mooyee in inta kale isla hal deegaan lagu caleemo saaray. Waana arrin dhaqan ah, labada jeerna ugaaskii koowaaad mooyee marka labaad duruufo ayaa keenay in aan halkaa lagu caleemo saarin. “Waa dhaqan la ilaaliyo oo beeshuna way ilaalisaa, ugaasyadu way ilaaliyaan in halkaas lagu duugo oo lagu caleemo saaro, weliba qodobka duugitaanka waa qodob soo jireen oo aan laga leexin karin haddii aan duruuf gaar ahi aysan keenin’ ayuu BBC-da u sheegay Cilmi Faarax Nuur Webi, oo xilal hore uga soo qabtay dawladihii hore ee Soomaaliya, kana mid ah duqeytida beeshaas. Beesha Xawaadle, ayaa ka mid ah beelaha Soomaalida kuwooda ugu adag dhanka dhaqanka. Waxaana ay marsiiyaan shuruudo gaar ah oo la xidhiidha xulashada ugaaska. Shuruudahan ayaa ka mid tahay in qofka ugaaska noqonaya uu ugaas dhalay ama uu la dhashay, sida oo kale waa in uu yahay qof ay soo jeediyaan jufada reer Ugaas ee beeshaas ka tirsan. Sida oo kalena waa in uu yahay nin diintiisa Islaamka iyo dhaqankiisaba la hubiyey. Qodobka ugu muhiimsan ayaana ah kolka la xulo, in ugaaskaas diyadiisa ama magtiisa la bixiyo, taas oo lagu qeexay in ay muujinayso in qofkaasi soo dhaafay ehelkiisa iyo jufadiisii ee uu yahay qof beeshaas oo dhan ka dhexeeya. “Ujeedka ayaa ah in wixii maalinkaa ka danbeeya ninkaasu aanu noqon qof ka tirsan jufada reer Ugaas ee uu noqdo nin Xawaadle leeyahay,” ayuu BBC-da uu sheegay. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Ugaaska hore ee beeshan Allaha u naxariistee Ugaas Xasan Ugaas Khaliif ayaa geeriyooday horraantii sannadkii 2021. Waxaana muddadaas maamulka reerkaas sii hayey ugaas ay leeyihiin reer kale. Markii la eego dhaqanka Soomaalidana marka uu ugaas geeriyoodo caadiyan kusime reerka u diyaarsanaa ayaa isla markiiba si kumeel gaar ah xilka u sii qabta, hasayeeshe beesha Xawaadle oo uu Ugaas Xasan ka baxay waa ay ka duwan tahay oo waxaa ugaasnimada ku sii simaya ugaaska beesha Cayr oo sii ahaa ugaaska Xawaadle ilaa iyo inta laga caleemo saarayey ugaaska cusub. Qaar ka mid ah madaxda sare ee ka tirsan Dawladda Federaalka ayaa ka qayb galay caano-shubka Ugaaska, waxana magaalada Halgan maalmihii ugu dameeyay ku qulqulayay boqollaal qof oo ka kala yimid dalka gudihiisa iyo dibaddiisa. Taliyaha NISA Cabdillaahi Maxamed Cali Sanbalooshe iyo xubno ka tirsan Dawladda Federaalka ayaa shalay u tagay gobolka Hiiraan ka qaybgalka caano-shubka Ugaaska. Saldanadda beeshan ayaa kamid ah kuwa ugu faca weyn dhulka Soomaalida, waxana si weyn reerka dhexdiisa looga ixtiraamaa Ugaaska markaas xukunka haya.

Maxaa ka soo kordhay xaaladda weriye Raage Oomaar oo xanuunsaday xilli uu toos u akhrinayay warka telefishinka? Weriyaha ITV News Raage Omaar ayaa hadda ka soo kabanaya xaaladdii caafimaad ee ku timid isaga oo si toosa u tabinaya wararka. Sida laga soo warbaahinta ITV Raage ayaa hadda ku sugan gurigiisa ka dib markii laga soo saaray isbitaalka oo lagu soo dabiibiyay. Wuxuuna qof walba uga mahad celiyay "naxariista iyo caafimaadka uu u rajeeyay". Afhayeen u hadlay ITV News ayaa yiri: "Waxaan daawadayaashii warkii xalay ugu mahadcelineynaa sida ay uga walaacsanaayeen xaaladda caafimaad ee Raage Omaar. "Kadib daawaynta isbitaalka, wuxuu hadda ku jiraa xaalad soo kabasho ah isaga oo gurigiisa ku sugan”. "Waxaan Raage u rajaynaynaa soo kabasho degdeg ah waxaanan rajaynaynaa inuu dib ugu soo laabto shaashada marka uu soo caafimaado." War qoraal ah oo uu la wadaagay ITV News, ayuu Raage Omaar ku sheegay: “Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan qof kasta ugu mahadceliyo naxariistiisa iyo caafimaadka ay rajeeyeen, gaar ahaan dhammaan shaqaalaha caafimaadka, dhammaan saaxibadeyda cajiibka ah ee ITV News, iyo daawadayaashayada oo muujiyay walaac. "Waqtigaas, waxaan go'aansaday inaan dhameeyo barnaamijka, waxaan ka mahadcelinayaa dhammaan taageerada la i siiyay." Raage, ayaa markii ay la soo daristay xaaladda caafimaad tabinayey warka tobanka fiidnimo ee habeenkii Jimcaha ahayd xilliga London, waxaana la arkayey muuqaalka isagoo u muuqda qof gariiraya oo ku dhibtoonaya in uu soo saaro ereyadiisa marka uu ka hadlayo qayb maalmaha fasaxa ah intii uu ku guda jiray akhrinta warka. Daawadeyaasha ayaa si degdeg ah dareenkooda ugu soo bandhigay baraha bulshada iyagoo ay walaac ka abuurtay baraha bulshada. Wariye Raage Oomaar oo hadda 56 sano jir ah , ayaa waxa uu yahay tafatiraha arrimaha caalamiga ee telefishinka ITV News, wuxuuna hore u ahaan jiray weriye ka tirsan BBC-da. Ma jiro faahfaahin intaas dhaafsiisan oo laga bixiyay xaaladda Raage iyo waxa ku dhacay intii uu socday war akhrintiisa. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ITV ayaa ka saartay barnaamijka dib u socodsiintiisa ITV+1, iyadoo fariinta taa beddelkeeda u sheegaysa daawadayaasha in ITV "uusan si ku meel gaar ah u awoodin inuu kuu keeno adeeggayaga +1". "Waxaan dib u bilaabi doonaa muddo gaaban," ayaa lagu yiri. , Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Wariye Raage Omaar, oo ah saxafi asalkiisu Soomaali yahay, balse heysta dhalashada dalka Ingiriiska, waxa uu sidoo kale u soo shaqeeyey BBC-da, intii uu socday duullaankii Ciraaq iyo burburkii Baqdaad sanadkii 2003-dii Wuxuu helay abaalmarino caalami ah oo ku mutaystay shaqadiisii, taa soo ay ku jirto Peabody Award oo uu ku mutaystay warbixintii uu BBC-da uga soo diray Suudaan iyo BAFTA oo uu BBC-da ka siiyay duullaankii Afgaanistaan oo uu ahaa weriyaha keliya ee TV-ga reer galbeedka ah ee ka soo warrama gudaha Daalibaan. Intaas k adib waxaa uu ku biiray telefishinta Al Jazeera sanadkii 2006-2010, halkaas oo uu ku soo bandhigay taxane dokumenti ah oo habeen walba ah oo la yiraahdo Witness, isagoo sidoo kale ka shaqaynayey Bariga Dhexe. Hadda waxa uu ITV News uga tebiyaa sheekooyinka waaweyn ee adduunka oo uu sidoo kale u soo bandhigaa barnaamijka arrimaha taagan ee ‘On Assignment.’ Sidoo kale waxa uu soo saaray warbixino qotodheer oo gaar ah oo ku saabsan UK iyo dibaddaba. Raage, ayaa 2014-kii loo dallacsiiyay Tafatiraha Arrimaha Caalamiga ah ee ITV News. Raage Cabdilaahi Oomaar, wuxuu sanadkii 1967-dii ku dhashay Muqdisho, waxaa ka soo jeedaa qoys caan ka ah Soomaliyeed, aabbihiis wuxuu ahaa ganacsade caan ah. Raage, waxaa qoyskiisu u guuray Boqortooyada Ingiriiska isagoo labo jir ah. Waxa uu leeyahay dhawr walaalo ah, oo uu ka mid yahay walaalkiis ka weyn, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Oomaar, oo soo noqday wasiirkii arrimaha dibadda dawladdii KMG ahayd ee Soomaaliya. Febraayo 2009 ayaa waxaa markii ugu horreysay xilkaas u magacaabay Cumar Cabdirashiid cali Sharma'arke, ka dibna waxaa mar kale Nofembar 2010 - Febraayo 2012 xilkaas u magacaabay Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo. Waxbarashadisa, Raage, waxaa uu ku qaatay dalka UK, isagoo ka baxay Dugsiga Dragon, Oxford, iyo Cheltenham College ee Gloucestershire, waxaana uu bartay taariikhda casriga. Omaar waxa uu shaqadiisa saxafinnimo ka bilaabay tababaridda wargeyska Codka, sannadkii 1991-kii, waxa uu u wareegay dalka Itoobiya halkaas oo uu si madax-banaan uga shaqeeyay weriye ajnebi ah, isaga oo inta badan la shaqaynayay BBC-da laanteeda la hadasha caalamka. Sanad ka dib, Omaar waxa uu ku laabtay London oo uu ka soo shaqeeyay soo saare iyo baahinta weriyaha BBC-da. Waxa uu u wareegay Koonfur Afrika ka dib markii loo magacaabay wariyaha BBC-da ee Afrika., halkaas oo ay xaaskiisa iyo carruurtiisu ula guureen ilaa sanadkii 2004-tii Abaalmarino kala duwan ayuu Raage helay intii uu ku jiray safarka saxaafada ee caalamiga. Sannadkii 2003, Omaar waxa uu helay abaalmarinta akadeemiyada dhaqamada kala duwan ee qowmiyadaha ee weriyaha TV-ga ugu wanaagsan. Sannadkii 2008dii, waxa sidoo kale la guddoonsiiyey Abaalmarinta Daawashada Warbaahinta Carabta oo uu ku mutaystay wacnaanta saxaafadda Bishii Janaayo 2014 iyo 2015, Omaar waxaa loo magacaabay abaalmarinta adeegga warbaahinta ee Abaalmarinta Muslimiinta ee dalka Ingiriiska. Raage, ayaa sidoo kale warbixinno dareen leh ka soo wariyey Soomaaliya muddadii uu ka shaqaynayey warbaahinta Calaamiga. Wuxuu mar hormuud ka ahaa aqoonyahano doonayey in Hargeysa laga dhiso maktabad weyn oo oo sare u qaadda aqoonta jiilka soo koraya ee Somaliland.
