Halis caafimaad oo ku soo fool leh dadka cusbada badan isticmaala Dadka cuntooyinka ay u cunaan cusba badan ku dara ayaa la sheegay iney halis ugu jiraan dhimasha degdeg ah. Natiijada Daraasadda oo lagu daabacay wargeyska 'European Heart' waxaa ka qayb qaatay in ka badan nus malyuun qof oo cusbada si joogta ah ugu dara cuntooyinka ay cunaan. Waxayna daraasaddu sheegtay dadka cusbada badan cuntada ku darsada iney 28% ay halis ugu jiraan dhimasho degdeg ah marka loo eego dadka cusabada aan badsan ama aan isticmaalin. Waxaa kale oo daraasaddu sheegtay dadka ay da'doodu 50 jirka iyo wixi ka sarreeya halista ay cusbada ku keento ay sii laba jibbaarmeyso. Barafasoor Lu Qi, oo daraasaddaasi hoggaaminayey ooMareykanka ku sugan wuxuu sheegay isticmaalka cusabada oo la yareyo iney leedahay faa'idooyin caafimaad oo la taaban karo. Guud ahaanna 3 ka mid ah boqolkii qof oo ay da'doodu u dhaxeyso 40-69 waxay cusabada badan ku keentaa geeri degdeg ah. "Cuntooyinka aan cuneyno iney cusbo ku jirto wey wanaagsan, balse dhibka wuxuu ka imanayaa marka aan cusba badan isticmaalno taasoo keeni karto dhiig kar iyo wadna xanuun qofka asiiba," ayey Chloe MacArthur oo ah kalkaaliso sare oo ku takhasustay cudurrada wadnaha ku dhaca oo ka howlgasha dalka Britain. Daraasadduna waxay dadku kula talineysaa iney aad uga taxaddiraan xaddiiga cusbada ay cuntooyinka ku darsanayaan si ay caafimaadkooda u ilaashadaan. "Dowladuhu wuxuu xil ka saaran yahay iney dadka ka wacyigelinayaan cusbada badan ee cuntooyinka lagu daro caafimaad darrada ka dhalan karto," ayuu Henry Dimleby oo ah khabiir cunnooyinka ku takhasusay. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Cusabadu caafimaadka jirka waxtar badan ayey u leedahay taa caksigeedana cusbada badan ee jirka gasho waxaa laga dhaxlaa caafimaad darro. "Cuntada haddii ay cusbo ku jirin qofka wuu dhibsanayaa inuu si wanaagsan uu u qaato carrabkana macaanka cuntada ma daremayo hase yeeshee cusbada badan dhanka caafimaadka laguma ammaanin." ayuu yiri Barafasoor Yihune Ayele oo Jaamacadda Dillaa wax ka dhiga takhasuskiisana yahay cuntooyinka caafimaadka qaba. Cusbada waxaa ku jirta maaddada Sodium. Sodium haddii uu jirka ku batana wuxuu keenaa iney biya badan ay galaan xididdada dhiigga wada. Haddii xididdada dhiigga wada ay biya badan galaan waxaa halkaasi ka dhalanaya dhiig kar maadaamaa socodkii caafimaadka qabay ee dhiigga uu sodium-ka jirka ku batay uu khalkhal galinayo. Dhiig karka dhibaatada uu leeyahay waan ka wada dharagsannahay waxana ka mid ah qofka oo madaxa ama wadnaha dhiig uga murmo, faalug (qofka oo dhinaca qallalo) iyo caafimaad darro soo wajahdo kalliyaha iyo wadnaha. Hay'adda Caafimaadka Addunkana ee WHO waxay sheegeysaa qofka qaangaarka ah inuu maalinti isticmaalo wax aan ka badneen 5 garaam oo cusbo ah. Bulshooyinka kala duwan cusbada waxay ku daraan cunta kasta oo ay karsadan iyaga oo aan u aaba yeelin xaddiga cusbada ay isticmaalayaan iyo dhibaatada caafimaad ee ka dhalan karta intaba. Waxayna Khubaradu ku talinayaan inaan aad u yareyno cusabada aan maalinti isticmaalno si cudurrada cusbada ka dhalan lahaa aan uga gaashaamanno.

Wax ka ogow dalkan Afrika ku yaal ee fiiso iyo lacag bixin kusoo rogay muwaadiniinta reer galbeedka , Inta badan waxaa muwaadiniinta dalalka Qaaradda Afrika ku adag in ay helaan dal-kugalka wadamada reer galkbeedka marka ay u safrayaan. Taa badalkeeda waxaa aad u sahlan in ay muwaadiniinta dalalka reer galbeedka ay dalalka qaaradda Afrika ku yimaadaan si fudud, halka qaarkooda ay xitaa fisa la'an ku soo galaan. Michelle Nehoya oo u dhalatay dalka Namibia waxay ku bixisay lacag ku dhaw ​​$500 codsiga fiisaha ay doonaysay inay ku booqato Canada- laakiin ku dhawaad ​​laba sano ka dib wali uma hirgalin. Michelle Nehoya oo dad'deedu tahay 38 snao oo ku nool caasimadda Namibia ee Windhoek, ayaa aad u doonaysa inay tagto Quebec si ay u aragto eeddadeed iyo ilmo adeerteed oo aanay arag muddo toban sano ku dhow. Codsiga dal-kugalka ayaa ah mid shaqo badan u baahan sida buuxinta foomam badan - iyo shuruudaha kale, waxay sidoo kale ku qasbanaatay inay bixiso lix bilood oo waraaqo bangi ah, warqad martiqaad ah iyo taariikh socdaal oo faahfaahsan. Ma jirto hab looga codsado Namibia, sidaas darteed waxay ku qasbantahay inay u safarto Koonfur Afrika si ay u soo gudbiso xogteeda biometric, sida in faraha laga qaado islamarkana ay halkaas sawir geyso. Caqabadaha ay la kulantay Michelle Nehoya ma aha wax ku cusub dadka Afrikaanka ah ee u socdaalaya waddamada reer galbeedka. Sida laga soo xigtay shirkadda la-talinta ee Henley and Partners Sannadkii 2022, toddobo ka mid ah 10-ka waddan ee loo diiday dal-kugalka Midowga Yurub ee loo yaqaan aagga Schengen waxay ahaayeen Afrikaan. “Waxay ahayd mid waqti dheer qaadatay oo niyad jab leh, wax sabab ah oo ay waqtigaa ay u qaadatay la iima sheegin," Ms Nehoya ayaa sidaasi u sheegtay BBC-da. Balse, haddii qoyskeeda Quebec ay go'aansadaan inay Namibia ugu safraan baasaboorka Canada, ma la kulmayaan wax caqabad ah ama qarash ah oo la mid ah tii ay martay Nehoya. Muwaadiniinta Canada waxay hadda ku geli karaan Namibia fiiso la'aan. Sawirka, Michelle Nehoya Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Laakiin tani wax badan ayaa iska badali doona muddo siddeed bilood gudahood ah. Laga bilaabo bisha April ee soo socota, muwaadiniinta Canada, oo Jarmalka, Mareykanka, UK iyo 29 waddan oo kale, waxay u baahan doonaan dal-kugalka Namibia. "Namibia waxay muujisay astaamo niyad wanaag ah iyo in si wanaagsan loola dhaqmo muwaadiniinta dalal kala duwan, si kastaba ha ahaatee, in kasta oo dadaalladaas ay jiraan, hadana dalalka qaar abaalkii ma soo celin,” waxaa sidaasi sheegtay wasaaradda socdaalka Namibia bishii May. "Iyadoo taasi aga duulayo dawladdu waxay u aragtay inay lagama maarmaan tahay in la fuliyo shuruudaha fiisaha si loo hubiyo sinnaanta iyo caddaaladda isdhexgalka diblomaasiyadeed," ayuu intaa ku daray bayaanka. Sidoo kale dadka soo booqanaya Namibia waxay heli doonanaan dal-kugalka 90-ka maalmood , oo qiimihiisu yahay $90. Dhankeeda Ms Nehoya, ayaa u aragta go'aanka dowladda Namibia ee la xiriira in la adkeeyo shuruudaha fiisaha in uu yahay mid soo daahay oo horey loo baahnaa."Waxaan filayaa inay cadaalad tahay. Waxaan dareemayaa in Namibia ay nafteed u istaagtay." Dareen-celinta baraha bulshada ee warkaas ayaa sidoo kale ahaa mid lagu taageerayo go'aanka dowladda Namibia. “Ugu dambayn waxaan rajeynayaa inay sidoo kale uga baahan yihiin inay soo gudbiyaan bible dukumeenti ah, ay sameeyaan baaritaanno caafimaad, iyo in ay maraan imtixaannada luqadda Namibia," ayuu soo qoray mid ka mid ah ddakii fikradahood dhiibtay. Mid kale ayaa yiri: "Haddii aan u baahdo inaan keeno warqad bangiga iyo dhammaan noocyada dukumentiyada oo aan weli iibsado fiisaha si aan waddan u galo, waddankaas waa inuu sidaas oo kale sameeyaa si aan uu su so galo waddankayga." Fiisooyinka Mareykanka iyo Canada ayaa ah kuwa aan raqiis ahayn marka ay timaado dadka sita baasaboorka dalalka Afrika. Midowga Yurub ayaa ka sameeyay in ka badan $58milyan oo dolar codsiyada fiisaha ee la diiday ee wadamada Afrika 2023, sida lagu sheegay warbixin ay dhawaan soo saartay Lago Collective, oo ah xarun diiradda saarta socdaalka. Dal-ku-galka waxaa loo diidi karaa sababo badan dartood. Warbixintu waxay sheegtay in diidmada intooda badani ay ku salaysan yihiin "shaki macquul ah oo ku saabsan rabitaanka fiisaha dal-ku-galka inuu yahay in uusan dalkiisa dib ugu laaban. In kasta oo hindisaha fiisaha Namibia uu ammaan ka helay baraha bulshada, hadana waaxyaha dalxiiska ma aha kuwa ku afraxsan. Ururka dalxisayaasha ayaa sheegay in ay"aad uga walaacsan yihiin" fariinta ay u dirto ganacsiga socdaalka caalamiga ah.

Socdaalka Madaxweyne William Ruto ee Waqooyi Bari kenya iyo rajada dadka ee wax ka qabashada adeegyada muhiimka ah , Wariye Lafagari Madaxweyne William Ruto ayaa toddobaadkan ku sugnaan doona gobolka Waqooyiga Bari Kenya, isagoo wada dadaallo uu ku doonayo inuu ku mideeyo gobollada iyo fulinta ballanqaadyadiisii xilligii doorashada ee dhanka horumarinta. Madaxweynaha ayaa lagu wadaa in uu shir guddoomiyo shirka Golaha Wasiirrada oo la filayo in lagu qabto magaalada Gaarisa, waana markii ugu horreysay oo shir heer sare ah oo noocaan oo kale ah lagu qabanayo magaalada Gaarisa ee gobolka Waqooyi Bari. Sidoo kale waxa uu furi doonaa xafiiska laanta socdaalka oo muddo xirnaa. Arrimaha kale ee muhiimka ah ee la filayo in wax laga qabto ama la dhaqaajiyo, waxaa ka mid ah ilaalinta xudduudaha, kaararka aqoonsiga, baasaboorka, amni-darrada, waddooyinka, biyo la'aanta, kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, macallimiin la'aanta iyo dawo la'aanta ka jirta isbitaallada deegaannadaasi. Arrinta tirakoobka ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa in uu wax ka dhaho madaxweyne William Ruto, ka dib go'aan maxkamadi ay ku laashay dhawaan natiijadii tirakoobka 2019-kii ee ismaamullada Wajeer, Mandera, iyo Gaarissa sababo la xiriira kala duwanaansho dhanka tirada ah. Tallaabadaas ay maxkamadda sare ee Gaarissa ay ku laashay natiijada tirakoobkii 2019-kii waxaa soo dhaweyay dadweynaha gobolka, waxaana la amray in lagu laabto laguna soo dhameystiro sanad gudihii. Madaxweynaha ayaa maanta socdaalkiisa ka bilaabay Mandheera, ka dibna waxa uu booqasho ku tagi doonaa Wajeer, Gaarisa, iyo Isiolo, waxaana la filayaa in socdaalkaan uu qaato muddo toddobaad ah. Sawirka, Wariye Lafagari Madaxweynaha ayaa dadka reer Mandheera kula hadlay goob fagaare ah. Filashadu waxay tahay in uu kulmo la qaato qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada sida madaxda, siyaasiinta iyo bulshada rayidka ah. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Dadka ku nool gobolka, oo wajahaya caqabado badan, ayaa rajo ka qaba in socdaalka Ruto uu keeno isbadel wax ku ool ah. Waxaa kale oo dadku ay qabaan in fulinta ballanqaadayadii madaxweynaha ay ku xirantahay sida madaxda gobolku ay ugu bandhigaan baahiyaha jira ee dadku ay rabanna in wax laga qabto Nuur Cabdow oo ka mid ah bulshada rayidka ah ee magaalada Mandheera ayaa qaba: "Waxyaabaha lagala hadlay waxaa ugu muhiimsan korontada, deegaanno lagu soo kordhiyay ismaamulka Mandheere, jidadka iyo biyaha dhamaantood wuu ballan qaaday, laakin taasi waxay ku xirantahay dadka siyaasadda nagu matala ee madaxweynah ala gorgortamaya," Dubbad Cali Camey Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Suuqgeynta Xoolodhaqatada Kenya oo la hadlay qaar ka mid ah warbaahinta gudaha ayaa socdaalka madaxweynaha ku tilmaamay mid muhiim ah, isagoo sheegay in dadka deegaanku ay ka filayaan inuu wax ka qabto waxyaabihii ugu muhiimsanaa ee lagu soo qaaday shirkii Xoolo dhaqatada ee dhawaan lagu qabtay Wajeer. Dubbad waxa uu ku tilmaamay dadka dhaliila hoggaanka Ruto inay yihiin kuwa "buuq badan", waxa uuna ku booriyay inuu sii wato ajandihiisa horumarineed, isaga oo intaa ku daray in siyaasiyiinta ku fashilmay mudadii ay xilka hayeen ay u ogolaadaan inuu xilka sii hayo. Madaxweynaha ayaa la filayaa in magaalada Gaarisa uu ka daahfuro mashruuc guriyeen ah, isagoo indha-idhayn ku sameyn doona buundada Gaarisa, oo dhowr jeer ku fatahay magaalada isla markaana gaystay khasaare burbur hantiyeed ah iyo barakicin ah. Sawirka, William Samoei Ruto Ruto ayaa dhowr jeer oo hore sheegay in ay ka go'antahay xoojinta midinimada dadka Kenyaanka ah, isagoo socdaal kan la amid ah ku tagay qaybo kale oo ka tirsan dalka Kenya. Mar uu ku sugnaa galbeedka Kenya waxaa uu sheegay: "Waxaan isku keeni doonaa dhammaan dadka Kenyaanka ah, waxaana la shaqeyn doonnaa hoggaamiyeyaasha ka soo jeeda siyaasado kala duwan si aan u abuurno waddan barwaaqo ah. Taasi waa hadafkayaga, mana jirto cid naga hor istaagi doonta,". Qoraal uu bartiisa Facebook soo dhigay maanta isaga oo ku sugan Mandheera ayuu sdioo kale ku yiri, "waxaa naga go'an in aan mideyno dalka oo aan gaarsiino adeegyada qeyb kasta oo ka mid ah qarankeena iyada oo aan cidna la takoorin,". Qoraalkiisa ayuu sidoo kale ku sheegay Madaxweyne Ruto, "Gobolka Waqooyi Bari, waxaan markii ugu horeysay tan iyo markii xoriyadda la qaatay dhisaynaa waddada isku xirta Isiolo-Modogashe-Ceelwaaq-Mandheera oo dhererkeedu dhan yahay 750km si aan isugu furno deegaanka oo aan u keenno isbeddel dhaqan-dhaqaale,".

Dhacdo 57-sano ka hor dhacday deegaanka Soomaalida oo qayb ka mida la xaliyey iyo hadal hayn ka dhalatay Waxay dhacdadani ka dhacday deegaan miyi ah oo hoos tagta degmada Qabri- bayax ee gobolka Faafan ee dowlad deegaanka Soomaalida sanadkii 1968-dii. Arooryo hore iyadoo ay tahay ayaa geel ay lahaayeen qoyska reer Qodax oo ahaa reer guuraa miyigaas yaallay waxaa lagu war helay geela oo diday oo yaacay iyadoo markii dambe qayb ka mida geela la waayey. Baadi goob dheer ka dib waxaa la ogaaday in rag ay qayb ka mida geela dhaceen oo ay ula kaceen dhanka degmada Araarso oo ka tirsan gobolka Jarar. "Geelu isaga oo daaqaya ayuu diday, waxaa didiyey owr geela ku jiray ka dibna waxay kala talaabeen wadada jayga ahayd ee hadda noqotay laamiga ee degmada Araarso, nimanka geella dhacay aroor hore ayay dhaceen markii ay dhaceenna waxaa qaybsaday shan nin oo walaalo ah," ayuu BBC-da u sheegay Xasan Qodax oo aabihiis ka mid ahaa dadka geela la dhacay lahaa. Wuxuu intaa raaciyey in ergo aabihiis ku jiro oo uu geelu isugu jiray ay ku baxeen halkii geela loo kaxaystay si ay ragga dhacay ugu soo celiyaan basle ergadii ayuu sheegay inay wax ka duwan waxay doonayeen la kulmeen. "Geellu wuxuu ahaa 43-neef, geellaas isaga oo xerada ku jira oo ragii dhacay haystaan ayuu aabahay iyo raggii kale ee geelu ka dhaxeeyey soo arkeen basle raggii haystay inay qaalin ka mid soo kaxaystaan waa u soo diideen,"ayuu yiri Xasan. Ka sokow dhacdada geele qoyska Qodax lagu dhacay, waxaa labada dhinac horrey u dhex taallay geelal badan oo ay iska dhaceen, dhaca geeluna wuxuu deegaanadaas ka ahaa dhacdo ku badan. Ragga geela dhacay wuxuu Xasan Qodax aabihiisa ka soo gaaray inuu ka mid ahaa nin lagu magacaabi jiray Dayib Cabdi oo ahaa geel jire deegaanka degaanaaa. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Dhacdadaas waxay ahayd mid aan libdhin oo odoyadii ka kala tirsanaa raggii geela kala dhacay ay uga sheekeeyeen carruurtoodii sheekada ah in barigaas geel la kala dhacay. Nus qarni in ka badan ka dib, isla degmada Araarso ayaa sanadkan 2025 ka dhacday dhacdo ka duwan tii 1968-dii ka dhacday. Qoyska Dayib Cabdi ayaa 57 sano ka dib qoyska reer Qodax Xasan ku wareejiyey geel ay sheegeen inuu baadi dhac celin u yahay geelii barigaas ay ka dhaceen. Dayib Cabdi ayaa sagaal neef oo geela ka qaatay geelaas barigaas la dhacay oo 43 halaad ka koobnaa basle rag kala duwan oo uu ka mid ahaa ay kala qayb sadeen sida dhinacydu u sheegeen BBC-da. Goob ay culimo iyo odoyaal dhaqan goob joog ka ahayeen oo ku taalla degmada Araarso ayaa qayb ka mid ah geela barigaas la dhacay lagula kala wareegay. Cabdillaahi Dayib Cabdi oo aabihiisa ka mid ahaa raggii barigaas geela dhacay ayaa shan neef oo ka mid sagaal neef oo qoyskiisa ku maqnaa ku wareejiyey Xasan Qodax Xaad oo abihiisa Qodax laga dhacay geelaas muddo nus qarni ka hor ah. Xasan Qodax Xaad oo la wareegay geela wakiilna ka ahaa qoyskiisa ayaa BBC-da u inuu ku faraxsan yahay in geelii aabihiisa laga dhacay loo soo celiyey. "57-sanno ka dib waan ku faraxsanahay in geella oo ahaa 43- neef 5-tii neef ugu horeeyay aan la wareegay." ayuu intaas raaciyey Xasan Qodax. Afarta neef ee kale ee geela ah ee ka mid ahaa sagaalka ku maqan qoyska Dayib ayuu Xasan Qodax sheegay inay qoys ahaan ka cafiyeen. Isagoo ka hadlayey goobta geela uu kula waregay Xasan Qodax waxa uu sheegay in geella xiliga laga dhacay aabihiis ay ahayd wakhtii xoolaha la kala dhici jiray oo dadka xilligaas jaahilnimo u gaynaysay, dadkuna ay iska xalaashanayeen in xoolo booli ah ay dhacaan "Ninka geela soo dhacaa wuxuu ahaa nin ragganimo leh wakhtigaas". Ayuu yiri. Qodax wuxuu intaa raaciyey in dadka geela ka haystay ay isku deegaan ahayeen mudo dheer, ayna mar uun sugayeen in ay helaan dhaxalkii Aabahood. Cabdillaahi Dayib Cabdi oo ah ninka geela celiyey ayaa isna xusay in sababta ay tallaabadan u qaadeen ay tahay inuu celiyo xaqii bani'aadamka ee waalidkii ku maqnaa wixii tabartiisa ah. "Annaga qoys ahaan waan tashanay dadkii geellaas lahaa warasadii ka joogtay wan u yeernay tiradiisiina waan waydiinay waxay lahaayeen, geellu markii uu soo galay waa la qaybsaday wixii anaga aan helay waan u sheegnay waxaas baan idiin haynaaye naga gudooma ayaan ku niri, wixii kalana naga saamaxa ayaanu nidhi." ayuu yiri Cabdullaahi Dayib. Cabdullaahi Dayib waxa uu sheegay in xilligii geella la dhacay hooyadii iyo Aabihii aysan is guursanin "Anigan iminka hadlaya taariikhda saan ku hayno geellaas xiliguu reerka yimid hooyaday lama guursanin kuwa aniga iga waawayna mayna dhalanin". ayuu BBC-da u sheegay Cabdillaahi. Celinta geela ee qoyskiisu wareejiyeen ayuu Cabdillaahi sheegay inay uga dhigantahay xaq bini'aadam oo ay iska gudeen "Xooluhu waa xaq, xaqana waa la kala leeyahay nin walba wixiisa isagaa iskaleh waana xaq bini'aadam" ayuu yidhi Cabdullaahi Dayib oo ah nin geella celiyay. Dhacdadan ayaa noqotay mid hadal hayn ka dhalisa deegaanada degmada Araarso ee dowlad deegaanka in wali qaar ka mida bulshadu ay doonayaan inay dhayaan oo gudaan xoolo muddo qarniyo ku dhow ka hor kala dhaceen. Marka dib loo raaco taariikhda Soomaalida oo u badnayd xoolo dhaqato reer guuraa ah, xoolo kala dhicidu waxay ahayd wax ku suntay tariikhdoodaas hore walow ilaa waqtiyadan ay meelo kooban ka dhacdo dhulka Soomaalidu degto dhacdo la mid taas hore balse ay si weyn u yarraatay. Geelu wuxuu ahaa qarniyo ka hor ilaa maanta mid hanti xooleed u dhaafsan Soomaalida. Dhanka suugaanta Soomaalidana abwaanno badan ayaa ku amaanay geella, caadiyan geella wuxuu magac iyo muuno gaar ah ku dhex leeyahay bulshada Soomaalida oo xooluhu u yihiin laf-dhabarta nolashooda.

Gantaalaha ayaa muddo gaaban gudahood la ganay si looga dhigo hannaanka Iron Dome mid aan degdeg intaasoo dhan waxba uga qaban karin. Qaar kale ayaa laga soo ganay Lubnaan oo ay soo ganeen Xisbullah. Ciidamada Difaaca Israa'iil ayaa sheegay in in ka badan 8,000 gantaal lagu ganay Israa'iil tan iyo 7 October. Qaar ka mid ah gantaalaha ayaa garab maray hannaanka Iron Dome kuna dhacay meelo la deggan yahay waxayna sababeen dhowr dhimasho iyo dhaawac, sida ay baahisay warbaahinta Israa'iil. Taariikhdu markii ay ahayd 27 October, afar qof ayaa la dhaawacay markii gantaal uu ku dhacay dhisme laga dhisayay Talaabiib. Si kastaba, afhayeen u hadlay militariga Israa'iil Lt Col Jonathan Conricus ayaa yiri: "Tirada Israa'iiliyiinta lagu dilay laguna dhaawacay ay intaa ka badan lahayd haddii uusan jiri lahayn hannaanka Iron Dome, kaasoo ahaa mid naf-badbaadiye ah." Arrow 2 waxaa loogu talo galay inuu burburiyo gantaallada riddada gaaban iyo kuw adheer iyagoo hawada sare ku duulaya, ilaa 50km meel ka sarreysa dhulka. Waxaa shaqada hannaankan la bilaabay kadib Dagaalkii ugu Horreeyay ee Gacanka sanadkii 1991, markaas oo Ciraaq ay gantaallo dhowr ah oo a sameeyeen Soofiyeetka ku ridday Israa'iil. Waxaa la hirgeliyay sanadkii 2000. Arrow 2 ayaa gantaallada ka qaban kara meel ka fog 500km. Wuxuu ka hortagi karaa si riddo gaaban ah meel masaafo ahaan u jirtaa ilaa 100km. Gantaalladeeda ayaa safri kara sagaal jeer xawaaraha maqalka waxaana markiiba lagu gani karaa ilaa 14 bartilmaameed. Arrow 2 ayaa la sheegay in loo adeegsaday in lagu dagaallamo markii ugu horreysay 2017, si loo soo rido gantaal Suuriya laga soo ganay. Arrow 3 ayaa markii ugu horreysay la howlgeliyay 2017 waxaana loogu talogalay inuu ka hortago gantaallada riddada dheer iyagoo ku safraya meel ka baxsan dhulka. Waxaa la horlgeliyay sanadkii 2017 waxaana markii ugu horreysay dagaal loo adeegsaday sanadkii 2023, si looga hortago gantaal ay dagaal-yahannada Xuutiyiinta ku ganeen magaalo-xeebeedka Ceylaat ee koofurta Israa'iil. Arrow 3 waxaa lagu sameeyay gudaha Israa'iil, iyadoo gacan laga helay shirkadda Mareykanka laga leeyahay ee Boeing. Dhammaanba hannaanka difaaca gantaallada Israa'iil ayaa loo adeegsaday si looga hortago duqeymihii ballaarnaa ee Iiraan ay Israa'iil kusoo qaadday April 2024. Iyaga, iyo diyaarado dagaal oo ka socday Mareykanka, UK iyo Imaaraatka Carabta, waxay soo rideen 300 oo gantaallada Iiraan ah.

Balse isku dayo iyo baadigoob badan oo ay u gashay inay hesho meel ay ka barato ayaa u suurtagaliyay in ay ka dhabayso riyadeeda. “Waligeey tan iyo yaraanteydii illaa hadda ayaan jeclaa Faras inaan wado laakiin waxaan is dhihi jiray Muqdisho malaha meel lagu barto, horayna uma arkin Fardana ma arki jirin,” ayay tiri Shugri Muuse. Sidoo kale waxa ay sheegtay inay isku dayday sidii ay ku heli lahayd muddo badan iyadoo booqaneysay goob kasta oo Faras loogu sheego, inta badanna goobaha ay booqatay Fardaha jooga ayaa ah kuwo loogu talagalay dadka booqashada u yimid in ay sawirro ku galaan. Qaar kamid ah ehelkeeda iyo asxaabteeda ayaa sidoo kale ka caawinayay sidii ay ku heli lahayd goob lagu barto fardaha, muddo kadibna waxa ay ku guuleysatay inay hesho qoys farda ku dhaqda muqdisho sidoo kalena dadka bara xirfadda fardafuulka. Salaadda taraawiixda looma tixgeliyo jimicsi ku filan oo jidhka ka saara kalooriyada dheeraadka ah sida ay qaar u malaynayaan. Sidaas darteed waa in la sameeyaa jimicsi kordhiya garaaca wadnaha, sida ay ku talisay khabiir nafaqada oo ku sugan London, Aysun Kafang. Waxay tidhi: "Calooshu waa inay si buuxda ugu nasataa dheefshiidka ka hor inta aan la bilaabin jimicsi, taas oo macnaheedu yahay in la bilaabo ugu yaraan saddex saacadood ka dib afurka." Waxay intaas ku dartay: "Maalmaha ugu horreeya waa in aan jidhka la culaysin, lana sameeyo jimicsi fudud sida socodka, qaadista miisaan yar oo guriga yaal ama kor u kaca jaranjarada dhowr jeer, ka dibna maalin kasta si tartiib ah loo kordhiyo muddada ilaa laga gaadho heer ku habboon awoodda iyo caafimaadka qofka." Kafang waxay sharraxday muhiimadda biyaha iyo doorkooda weyn ee ilaalinta caafimaadka guud, gaar ahaan bisha Ramadaan. Waxay si xooggan ugu talisay in la cabo qaddarka biyaha ee lagu taliyay iyadoo loo eegayo da'da qofka, lagana fogaado cabitaannada kaarboonaysan iyo kuwa sonkorta lagu daro, laguna beddelo cabitaanno dhir ah sida shaah cagaaran iyo kuwo kale oo si ballaaran looga helo dunida oo dhan. Anqaam, oo ah haweeney guri-joog ah oo leh laba carruur ah kuna nool magaalada Riyaad ee Sucuudiga, waxay aaminsan tahay in qorshaynteeda hore ee bisha Ramadaan ay uga dhigto bishan mid ay ku horumariso caafimaadkeeda, ku kobciso xirfadaheeda, isla markaana ku dareento qanacsanaan nafteeda ah. Waxay u sheegtay BBC: "Waxaan bilaabay soon kala go'an toddobaad ka hor inta aan la gaadhin Ramadaan, sababtoo ah sidaas ayaan jidhkayga ugu diyaariyaa inuu u adkaysto gaajada, isla markaana uga hortagaa isbeddel degdeg ah oo ku yimaadda nidaamkayga maalinlaha ah inta lagu jiro Ramadaan." Waxay intaas ku dartay: "Sannad kasta waxaan is hor dhigaa yool aan doonayo inaan gaadho. Sannadkan waxaan qorsheeyay inaan Qur'aanka dhammeeyo laba jeer inta lagu jiro bishan, isla markaana aan carruurtayda xifdiyo qaar ka mid ah aayadaha Qur'aanka, anigoo isla mar ahaantaana daryeelaya carruurtayda oo ku mashquulsan waajibaadka guriga. Sidaas ayuu waqtigu ku dhaafaa anigoon dareemin." Naadiya, oo ah gabar 25 jir ah kuna nool magaalada Caqaba ee Urdun, waxay tidhi: "Waxaan gaajada iyo haraadka kula dagaallamaa akhriska. Sidaas darteed waxaan waqtigayga ku qaataa akhrinta dhammaan buugaagta iyo sheekooyinka aan dib u dhigtay, sidoo kalena waxaan daawadaa qaar ka mid ah barnaamijyada telefishinka, waxaanan horumariyaa xirfaddayda luqadda Ingiriisiga. Sidaas darteed ma jiro waqti firaaqo ah oo igu kallifa inaan ka fikiro harraad ama gaajo."

Maxay tahay "arrinta masiiriga ah ee aan sinnaba looga gudbi karin" ee uu Abiy Axmed ka hor sheegay baarlamaanka dalkiisa , Office of the Ethiopian PM Ka dib muddo kooban oo ay xasilloonayd xiisadda ka dhalatay biyaha Badda Cas, waxaa dhawaanahan soo ifbaxaya hadal haynta la xidhiidha suurtagalnimada dagaal ka dhasha biyaha Badda Cas oo dhex mari kara Itoobiya iyo dalka dariska la ah ee Eriteriya. Ra'iisulwasaaraha Itoobiya oo maanta hor tagay baarlamaanka dalkiisa ayaa ku celiyay sida ay dalkiisa uga go'an tahay gaadhista biyaha Badda Cas oo ku tilmaamay arrin masiiri oo aan sinaba looga gudbi karin. Khudbad saacado socotay ayaa qaybo ka mid ah waxa uu kaga warramay sida ay isugu xidhan yihiin tirada sii kordhaysa ee dadka Itoobiyaanka iyo helista marin ay ku gaaraan Badda Cas. "Badda Cas waa arrin masiiri ah. Haddii Xisbigaygu jiro iyo haddii kale. Haddii baarlamaankani dhisnaado iyo haddii kalaba. 130 milyan oo qof oo ku nool dal dhaqaalihiisu kobcayo, kuma sii jiri karaan xabsi dhinacyada oo dhan ka awdan. Cid kasta oo sheegata in ay nabad jeceshahay kama shaqayn karto. Caalamka waxa aan ku wargelinaynaa rabitaanka aan u qabno in dhibaatadayada aan ku xallinno qaab nabadgalyo ah" ayuu yiri. Abiy Axmed, ra'iisulwasaaraha Itoobiya ayaa ka warramay suurtagalnimada weerar-biyood uu dalkiisu ku qaado waddanka Eriteriya oo dhawaanahan u dambeeyay ay hadal hayntiisu xoogganayd. Waxa uu sheegay in Itoobiya aanay wax xiiso ah u qabin dagaal ay gasho xilligan. "Dawladda Eriteriya, waxa aan baarlamaanka hortiisa ka caddaynayaa, in aanay Itoobiya xiiso u qabin weerar iyaga ka dhan ah oo la xidhiidha Badda Cas. Waxa keliya ee aan rabo waa in la wada hadlo. Nidaam waxa is weydaarsi ah, wadar-oggol ayaan wax ku xallin karnaa. Haddii aan maanta iska dhaafno berri wax ka xun ayaa ka dhalan kara. Aan wada haladno ma aha aan dagaalanno". Haddaba, Xirsi Cabdiqaadir (Neero) oo ah falanqeeye arrimaha gobolka Geeska Afrika, horana xildhibaan uga soo noqday dawladda Federaalka ee Itoobiya ayaa ku doodaya in hadalka Abiy ay ka muuqato dabacsanaan marka loo barbar dhigo xilliyadii hore. "Waxaan u arkayaa nin baahi u qaba bad, laakiin u muuqda in aanu markan xoog ku raadinayn. Waxa kale oo xusid mudan in uu sheegay in caalamku uu garowsaday in dal dadkiisu tiradaas le'eg yahay aanu sii ahaan karin bad la'aan. Waxa kale oo xusud mudan in uu meesha ka saaray dagaal ka dhan ah Eriteriya" ayaa uu yidhi. Ra'iisul wasaaraha Itoobiya ayaa dhinaca kale waxa uu u gooddiyay cid kasta oo isku dayda dagaal ka dhan ah Itoobiya, isaga oo meesha ka saaray hadal-haynta la xidhiidha dagaal ay Itoobiya gasho oo ka dhan ah Soomaaliya ama Eriteriya. Waxa uu sheegay in dalkiisu uu si buuxda u diyaar-garoobay laakiin taasi aanay ka dhignayn in ay iyagu weerar yihiin. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. "Itoobiya, marnaba ma qabto cabsi la xidhiidha in dal kale uu weerar ku soo qaado oo uu ka hor istaago hirgelinta riyooyinkeeda ay bilowday. Wax cabsi ah kama qabno. Cidina nagu ma soo dhiirran karto, sababtoo ah waan u diyaargarownay. Taasi kama dhigna in aan innagu weerar nahay. Sida aad la socotaan, waxaa hore loogu celcelinayay Soomaaliya ayay weerarayaan. Waad aragateen sida aan u xallinnay. Isfahan-waagii Soomaaliya iyo Kenya annaga ayaa xallinnay. Labada Suudaan iyo dhammaan dariskeenaba nabadgalyo ayaan la rabnaa". Xiisadda biyaha Badda Cas ayaa soo bilaabantaya horraantii sannadkii la soo dhaafay ee 2024, kaddib markii isfahan ay wada gaadheen Itoobiya iyo Somaliland. Tallaabadaasi oo gobolka sawaxan ka abuurtay waxaa si gaar ah uga hor timid dawladda Soomaaliya. Xirsi Cabdiqaadir waxa uu qabaa in aan weli xal rasmi ah loo helin xurgufta ka dhalatay rabitaanka Itoobiya ee Badda Cas. "Waxay u muuqataa in Eriteriya ay dagaal u diyaargarowday, maadaama ay dhaqdhaqaayo ka samaynayaan dhinaca soohdinta. Waxayse arrintani sidoo kale macne badan u samaynaysaa dalalka aan lahayn dawladaha xooggan in la yidhaahdo nabad ayaan wax ku raadinaynaa". Ra'iisul wasaaraha Itoobiya ayaa rajo fiican ka muujiyay sida ay ilaa hadda waxa u socdaan, marka laga hadlayo xiisadda muranka dhalisay ee Badda Cas, isaga oo dalkiisa ku tilmaamay in uu joogo marxlad aan ka laabasho lahayn. "Arrinta Badda Cas waxa loo malaynayay in ay tahay riyo aan rumoobi karin. Dad badan waxa ay is weyddiinayeen sida ay dawladdu ugu fikirtay qorshe noocan oo kale ah. Waxa aan joognaa duni loo baratamayo meeraha Mars. Sidaa daraadeed, masaafo kooban oo aan ka badanayn 60km in gaadhisteeda nala kula yaabo ayaaba la yaab leh. Waxaan nahay rajo ku nool. Rajadeennu waa horumar. Geeddiga barwaaqaduna waa uu sii socon doonaa" ayuu yiri Abiy Axmed.

Mucaashaqiin is guursaday 20 sano ka dib – ma guursan lahayd jacaylkaagii hore? Marka laga hadlayo dhinaca lamaaneyaasha, Jacaylku waa dareen dhab ah oo uu qof u qaado ruux kale, kaasoo uu doonayo inuu la wadaago nolosha isagoo aan ku qanceynin cid kale oo u baddasha, waana mid si isku mid ah u haleela ragga iyo dumarkaba, inkastoo uu badanaa ku hormaro labada qof midkood. Mid ka mid ah sheekooyinka xiisaha badan ee la xiriira jacaylka dhabta ah ayaa ku saabsan abwaan soomaaliyeed oo wakhti dheer jeclaa gabar uu calmaday. Inta aanan guda galin sheekada waa kuma qofka ay khuseyso? Abwaan Axmed Saleebaan Bidde, wuxuu in ka badan 60 sano ku soo jiray Fanka Soomaaliyeed, waana shakhsi ay aad u yaqaannaan dadka ehelka u ah sugaanta, dhaqanka iyo hiddaha Soomaaliyeed. Waxaa lagu xasuustaa Riwaayaddii uu ku caan baxay ee la oran jiray 'Alle aamin ma iisho', taasoo soo baxday horraantii sannadkii 1964-kii, wuxuuna sidoo kale sameeyay ku dhawaad 40 riwaayadood iyo heeso fara badan. Sangub oo fankiisa u leexiyay dib u dhiska Soomaaliya Abwaanka oo hadda ku sugan magaalada Hargeysa wuxuu leeyahay taariikh jacayl oo dhab ah, aadna u xiiso badan. Wuxuu guursaday gabar uu jeclaa muddo 22 sano ka hor ah. In badan oo ka mid ah heesihiisa wuxuu ku cabiray jacalkiisa. BBC-da ayuu uga sheekeeyay qisadiisa, isagoo sharraxaad ka bixiyay marxaladihii kala duwanaa ee uu lasoo maray jacaylkiisa. "Heesaheyga dadku waxay ugu jecelyihiin midda uu qaaday AUN Maxamed Axmed Kuluc, taasoo aan u qaaday gabadh aan jeclaa, waxaana guursaday 22 sano ka dib" ayuu yiri. Heestaas, oo uu abwaanku ku ammaanayay gabadha, jacaylkiisana ugu sheeganayay, ayay qaar ka mid ah erayadeedu ahaayeen sida soo socota: Laakiin gabadhii ayuu sheegay inuu nin kale ka guursaday, arrintaasna uu aad uga hinaasay. "Gabadha iyadoo aan heshiinay oo aan ahayn walaalo isjecel, guurna ku heshiinay ayuu nasiibku na kala geeyay. Waxaan la shaqeynayay Maxamed Aadan Dacar, oo aan guurkiisa kala shaqeynayay. Labo casho ayaan ku mashquulay, marki aan soo laabtayna waxaan u imid iyadoo gabadhii la guursaday". Hinaase awgiis ayuu abwaanku u sameeyay hees la magac baxday 'Maxaa luray naftaadii', oo ay ku luuqeysay fannaanadda Hibo Nuura, waxayna qeybo ka mid ah miraheedu ahaayeen sidan: Muddo ka dib Abwaan Axmed Saleebaan Bidde, wuxuu calaf u yeeshay inuu guursado gabadhii uu jeclaa, 22 sano ka dib. "Waa marwo wanaagsan, haddana waan wada joognaa. Waxaan guursaday saddex sano ka dib markii ninkeedi laga dilay" ayuu ku yiri wareysi uu siiyay BBC-da. Qisada Abwaanka ayaa ka mid ah qisooyin jacayl oo fanka Soomaaliyeed lagu xusay, kuwaasoo marka laga soo tago qisooyinka riwaadaha ay sidoo kale jireen kuwo dhab ah.

Putin oo diiday ammaanka Reer Galbeedka ee Ukriane, isagoo uga digay in ciidamadoodu noqon doonaan bartilmaameed , VLADIMIR SMIRNOV/TASS/HANDOUT Madaxweynaha Ruushka, Vladimir Putin, ayaa diiday soo-jeedimaha Reer Galbeedka ee ku saabsan in la geeyo "ciidan xaqiijinaya ammaanka" Ukraine maalinta xigta marka xabbad-joojin la gaaro, kadib shir ka dhacay magaalada Paris oo lagu doonayay in lagu dhameystiro qorshayaasha dammaanad-qaadka amniga. Madaxweynaha Faransiiska Emmanuel Macron ayaa sheegay in 26 ka mid ah xulafada Ukraine ay si rasmi ah uga go'an tahay inay ciidamadooda geeyaan "dhul, bad iyo cirba" si ay gacan uga geystaan ​​sugidda ammaanka xilliga uu dagaalka istaago. Macron ma uusan shaacin magacyada dalalka ku lugta leh qorshahan. Putin ayaa isku dayay inuu joojiyo dadaalkaas, isagoo digniin u diray in ciidamo kasta oo la geeyo Ukraine ay noqon doonaan "bartilmaameed sharci ah," gaar ahaan haddii ay hadda muuqdaan, inkasta oo aan jirin qorshe deg-deg ah oo ciidan lagu dirayo. Hadda waxa muuqata rajo yar oo laga qabo xabbad-joojin, ka dib shirkii bishii hore Alaska ku dhexmaray Putin iyo Madaxweyne Donald Trump oo ay si kooban kor ugu qaadeen rajada la kulanka Volodymyr Zelensky iyo heshiis nabadeed oo suurtagal ah. Putin ayaa Jimcihii sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu la xiriiro hogaamiyaha Ukraine "laakiin ma arko wax badan. Waayo? sababtoo ah waxay ku dhowdahay wax aan macquul aheyn in heshiis laga gaaro dhinaca Ukraine arrimaha muhiimka ah". Trump ayaa markaas kadib soo dhigay bartiisa bulshada in taasi "Waxay u muuqataa in aan luminay Hindiya iyo Ruushka, una gacan galnay Shiinaha madow ee ugu qotada dheer," isagoo hoosta ka xariiqaya sawir muujinaya saddexda hoggaamiye ee dalalkaasi kulankoodii ka dhacay Tianjin Talaadadii. Afhayeenka Putin, Dmitry Peskov, ayaa bogaadiyay "dadaalka wax ku oolka leh" ee Trump uu ku raadinayo xal, laakiin wuxuu weeraray "dadaalka guracan ee dalalka Yurub ee kicinaya sii socoshada dagaalka". Tan iyo shirkii Alaska, "Isbahaysiga Rabitaanka" oo ay hoggaaminayaan UK iyo Faransiiska ayaa si xooggan uga shaqeynayay sidii Kyiv loogu siin lahaa dammaanad-qaad amni haddii heshiis la gaaro. Tani waxay ku lug leedahay xoojinta ciidamada Ukraine iyo sidoo kale bixinta "ciidan xaqiijin amni" oo ilaalin doona fulinta heshiiska. Macron waxa uu adkeeyay in ciidan kasta loo diri doono si ay uga hortagaan "gardarrada kasta oo cusub" aana la geyn doonin safka hore. Ciidanku "ma laha rabitaanka ama ujeeddada dagaal ee ka dhanka ah Ruushka", ayuu yiri Marcon. Sawirka, Anadolu via Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Zelensky, ayaa ku tilmaamay go'aannadii lagu gaaray kulankii Paris ee Khamiistii inay yihiin tallaabadii ugu horreysay ee dhab ah, wuxuuna Jimcihii sheegay in kumannaan askari oo ajnabi ah la gayn doono Ukraine, inkasta oo uu yiri weli waa goor hore in laga hadlo faahfaahin buuxda. Maraykanku ma bixin faahfaahin ku saabsan ku lug lahaanshaha. Madaxweynaha Faransiiska ayaa sheegay in la soo gabagabeyn doono maalmaha soo socda. Trump ayaa dhawaan tilmaamay in taageerada Mareykanka ay "malaha" ku imaan karto qaab taageero xagga hawada ah, inkastoo uusan wax faallo ah ka bixin shirkii Paris ka dib, Zelensky wuxuu sheegay in uu hoggaamiyaha Mareykanka kala hadlay "ilaalinta ugu sarreysa ee cirka Ukraine". Trump waxa uu sheegay in uu "wada hadal aad u wanaagsan" la leeyahay Putin uuna qorsheynayo in uu la hadlo mustaqbalka dhow. Putin ayaa Jimcihii xaqiijiyay inuu "wadahadal furan" la yeeshay madaxweynaha Mareykanka. Kyiv waxay aaminsan tahay in marka hore la gaaro xabbad-joojin gudaha Ukraine ka hor inta aan la guda gelin wax heshiis nabadeed oo ballaaran, inkasta oo Ruushka uu arrintaas ka soo horjeedo. Isagoo ka jawaabayay su'aalo lagu weydiiyay madal dhaqaale oo ka dhacaysay Vladivostok bariga fog ee Ruushka, Madaxweyne Putin wuxuu ku dooday: "Haddii la gaaro go'aamo horseedaya... nabad waarta, markaas anigu ma arko wax micne ah in ciidamo shisheeye joogaan gudaha Ukraine." Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Ruushku uu si buuxda u fulin doono go'aan kasta oo keeni kara nabad waarta. Ukraine iyo xulafadeeda reer Galbeedku kuma qancin hadallada Putin. Putin wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu marti geliyo shir heer sare ah oo la xiriira Ukraine oo ka dhaca Moscow, isagoo ballan qaaday inuu bixin doono amniga kulankaas. Markii weriyaha BBC-da, Steve Rosenberg, uu su'aal waydiiyey afhayeenka Putin, Dmitry Peskov, kuna tilmaamay in dalabkaasi uu u muuqdo mid Ruushku ku doonayo in Ukraine isu dhiibto halkii laga raadin lahaa heshiis nabadeed, Peskov wuxuu ku jawaabay, "Maya, gabi ahaanba maya. Waxaa loogu casuumay Moscow si loo wada hadlo, ma aha inuu is dhiibo." Zelensky hore ayuu uga qoslay fikradda Moscow ee ah in shir nabadeed lagu qabto halkaas, isagoo ku tilmaamay caddeyn ah in Putin uusan dhab ka ahayn nabadda. Waxaa la soo jeediyay caasimado dhexdhexaad ah oo kale si loogu qabto shirka, balse Putin wuxuu ka cawday "dalabyo xad dhaaf ah" "Waxaan taageersannahay qaab kasta—kulammo laba-geesood ah, saddex-geesood ah—laakiin anigu waxaan aaminsanahay in Ruushku uu sameynayo wax kasta si uu shirkan u dib u dhigo."ayuu yiri Zelensky Sawirka, Hoggaamiyeyaasha Reer Galbeedka iyaguna waxay rumeysan yihiin in Ruushka uu isku dayayo inuu waqti helo si uu u qabsado dhul badan oo Ukraine ah, iyadoo uu socdo dagaalka baaxadda leh ee hadda galay afartan iyo laba bilood. Putin oo Arbacadii kulan la qaatay Madaxweynaha Shiinaha, Xi Jinping, iyo hoggaamiyaha Kuuriyada Waqooyi, Kim Jong Un, ayaa weli ku adkeysanaya in milateriga Ruushka uu guulo ka gaarayo dhammaan jihooyinka dagaalka ee Ukraine. Waxaa si cad loogu dhawaaqay in aysan jirin wax ciidamo Reer Galbeed ah oo la geynayo gudaha Ukraine, iyadoo Moscow ay arrintaas si adag uga digtay. Isla markaana, Ruushku wuxuu ku adkeystay in uu ka mid noqdo waddamada "dammaanad qaadaya amniga Ukraine" — fikrad ay si cad u diideen Kyiv iyo xulafadeeda. Afhayeenka Putin ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in ciidamo shisheeye, ha ahaadeen kuwa NATO ama kuwa kale, ay halis ku yihiin Ruushka, isagoo sabab uga dhigay in, "Annagu waxaan nahay cadowga NATO." Hoggaamiyaha Jarmalka, Friedrich Merz, ayaa isna sheegay kadib kulanka in mudnaanta koowaad ay tahay in la helo xabbad-joojin lagu gaaro shir uu Zelensky ka qaybgalayo, kadibna la bixiyo "dammaanad-qaad amni oo xoog leh."

Dhibaatada in loo hammuun qabo waxyaabo aan cunno ahayn, oo caafimaad ahaan loo yaqaanno PICA waa wax ku badan haweenka uurka leh iyo carruurta yaryar. Khubarrada caafimaadka ayaa dhibaatada la xiriiriyay jirka oo ay ka maqan tahay birta ama iron. Dr. Dorcas Chiroma, oo ah dhaqtaradda haweenka oo ka shaqeysay isbitaal ku yaalla Nigeria ayaa sheegtay in inta badan haweenka uurka leh ay qabaan dhibaatada cunno aan caafimaad lahayn. "Waxa ugu badan ee sababa PICA waa jirka oo ay ku yar tahay birta, taasoo horseedi karta dhiig la'aan (anemia). Tani waa sababta birta loogu adeegsado in lagu khafiifiyo dhiigga jirka." Waxay intaa raacisay in dhammaan nafaqooyinka uu ilmuhu u baahan yahay xilliga uurka loo soo marsiiyo dhiigga hooyada. "Birtu muhiim ayay u tahay haweeneyda uurka leh, sababtoo ah waxay siddaa labo qof. Waxay u baahan yahay nafaqooyin, waxa ay siddana sidoo kale waa muhiim. Birta waxay ka caawisaa inay hesho dhiig ku filan inta ay u baahan tahay. Marka haweeneyda uurka leh, baahida ay u qabto maaddadan ayaa ah mid sii kordheysa," ayay tiri Dr. Dorcas. Waxay xustay in "laga yaabo in haweeneyda uurka leh ay raadiso waxyaabo faa'iido u leh jirkeeda, oo dareensiinaya sida inay cuneyso wax aysan ahayn inay cunto. Dhammaan tan waxaa lala xiriirinayaa deegaanka gudaha iyo kiimikooyin gaar ah taasoo saameysa jirka haweenka laguna magacaabo Hormones." Haweenku waxay u badan tahay inay xaaladdan la kulmaan saddexda bilood ee ugu horreeya uurka, inkasta oo ay jiraan qaar ay ku sii socoto muddadaas ka dib, ayay tiri. Dhaqtarku wuxuu sheegay in bir-yaraanta ku dhacda haweeneyda uurka leh ay saameyn karto ilmaha ay siddo. Sababtoo ah haddii ay isku aragto dhiig-yaraan, waxay caqabad ku noqon kartaa korriinka ilmaha. Barta internet-ka ee Healthdirect oo ay leedahay dawladda Australia ayaa sheegaysa in ay tahay inaad isbitaalka tagto haddii aad waxyaabo aan cunto ahayn cunaysay muddo bil ka badan. Sida uu websaytku sheegay, dadka qaba xaaladdan waxay cunaan waxyaabo kala duwan, oo ay ka mid yihiin ciidda, dhoobada, waraaqaha, barafka, birta, iyo rinjiga. Boggu wuxuu intaas ku darayaa in dadka qaba xaaladda PICA ay inta badan dareemaan hamuun xad-dhaaf ah oo ay u qabaan hal shay oo gaar ah, inkasta oo ay jiraan qaar xiiseeya inay cunaan wax ka badan hal shay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, sida ku cad xogta Healthdirect, cunista waxyaabahaas aan cuntada ahayn waxay keeni karaan dhibaatooyin caafimaad sida mindhicirrada oo xirma iyo dhibaatooyin kale oo caloosha ah, suus (bololka ilkaha), ama neefta oo qofka ku dhagta ka dib marka uu shay liqo. Tusaale ahaan, cunista ciidda waxay horseedi kartaa sumow, taas oo keeni karta caabuqyo bakteeriya ah. Haddii cunug ama qof weyn uu liqo sun, qaar ka mid ah calaamadaha la isku arko waxaa ka mid ah calool xanuun iyo matag, neefta oo ku dhibta ama kaadi xanuun, nabro maqaarka ah, iyo xanuun laga dareemo dibnaha, carrabka, ama dhuunta. Inkasta oo uu boggu sheegay in aanay jirin hal xal oo qura oo dhibaatadan loo isticmaalo, haddana waxay ku xiran tahay waxa sababaya hamuunta waxyaabaha aan cuntada ahayn. Dadka ay xaaladdoodu ka dhalatay nafaqo-darro, tusaale ahaan bir-yaraanta (iron deficiency), dhaqtarku wuxuu u qori karaa daawo ka caawisa buuxinta kaalinta nafaqada dhiman ama wuxuu ku wargelinayaa haweeneyda nooca cuntada ay tahay inay cunto si ay u kabto nafaqadaas.

Guidance: Charitable Appeals Since the 1920s and at the instigation of Lord Reith, the BBC has been offering charities the opportunity to broadcast appeals using BBC airtime. These now take the form of the Radio 4 Appeal which is weekly and the BBC One Lifeline Appeal which is monthly. There is an online application process with 4 open rounds each year. All applicants have to demonstrate UK or international scope and/or significance and provide information about their finances and governance. They must be able to explain how they will use the airtime, within the BBC Editorial Guidelines in particular on impartiality, to explain their work. All applications are sent for independent assessment and then also reviewed and recommended by the members of the BBC's Appeals Advisory Committee. Charities that are selected for broadcast appeals attend a BBC briefing and work with BBC producers to deliver the appeal. They are required to submit feedback forms and impact stories following the broadcast. Charities that have a successful appeal are eligible to reapply after 3 years. Charities making an unsuccessful application may reapply after 1 year. There are also up to 11 slots offered annually on BBC Radio Ulster/Foyle to local charities in Northern Ireland. It may be helpful to point charities to these broadcast appeals if asked how the BBC supports charities. More information about the application process is available from the BBC Charity Appeals Unit; the Charity Appeals Adviser for the Unit is Emma Kingsley via: In addition BBC local Radio stations and BBC Regions may wish to mount a specific BBC charity appeal for a project within their local area. All such proposals must be referred to the Appeals Adviser and Senior Adviser (charities) Editorial Policy . Approval will also be needed from Directors Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland or England and the BBC Appeals Advisory Committee. For contacts see above. Editorial Policy advice for those producing the broadcast content of the appeals on may be obtained from Senior Adviser, Editorial Policy, for contacts see the listed end of this guidance note. In addition at two points a year the BBC runs specific on air appeals seasons with BBC Children in Need and Comic Relief (see section 3. below) These are both 'grant givers' and therefore by supporting them the BBC audiences are in effect giving to a very large number of charities and projects with a wide geographical spread. The Disasters Emergency Committee or DEC is a membership organisation which represents 15 of the UK's humanitarian agencies. The relationship between the BBC and the DEC goes back over 50 years and there is an Memorandum of Understanding between the two organisations which sets out the 3 criteria for the BBC to launch on all its platforms, on behalf of the DEC, a disaster emergency appeal. When the DEC considers there is an emergency disaster that meets these criteria they will put a request to the BBC via the Charity Appeals Adviser. The ultimate decision for the BBC to run one of these appeals lies with the Director General in consultation with other members of the BBC Executive Committee. Once an appeal request has been granted, the Charity Appeals Adviser will liaise with the radio, television and digital teams who make the appeal and ensure it is distributed to all the various BBC networks. The appeal is made by BBC teams conforming to all BBC Editorial Guidelines and Editorial Policy advice will be given on the content (see contacts at the end of this guidance note). Charities which are members of the DEC are not eligible for the BBC broadcast appeals (ie the Radio 4 and BBC One Lifeline appeals). The BBC has a tradition of mounting major pan-BBC charity fundraising initiatives such as BBC Children in Need, Red Nose Day (for Comic Relief), and also reflecting Sport Relief (for Comic Relief). BBC Children in Need and BBC Media Action are BBC charities and bear the BBC brand. Comic Relief is not a BBC charity and unlike BBC Children in Need does not bear the BBC brand. It has been a major partner of the BBC and co producer for more than 20 years and together with the BBC has developed the Red Nose Day and Sport Relief on air appeals. The BBC maintains editorial control over all on air and BBC on line activities in relation to Comic Relief. BBC Children in Need, and Comic Relief do not themselves run projects, but are charities which distribute money to a range of projects run by a range of charities, not for profit organisations and community groups. Therefore in raising money to be distributed by BBC Children Need, or Comic Relief the BBC is not seen to be endorsing one particular project or one particular charitable cause. These cross-BBC appeals are reflected across the range of BBC services and in all media. A key aim is to get the public involved across the nations to undertake activities to support the appeal. The initiatives are mounted on a major scale. BBC charity appeal fundraising programming should normally fit within an agreed on-air 'appeal window'. This usually begins about 2/3 months before the main Appeal Night and around 1 months after. Any BBC Children in Need or Comic Relief other charity related BBC programming outside the window must be discussed with Editorial Policy and the BBC Charity Appeals Adviser. Typically the initiative culminates in a major appeal day on radio and night on TV, where donations are pledged by the public and the results of their fundraising are reported. In the build up to the main appeal night, the BBC broadcasts specially commissioned programmes or special strands within existing programmes to raise awareness of the appeal and to build audiences for the main telethon and radio activity . The programming may be across the whole range of BBC outlets including network television and radio, regional television, local radio and BBC websites and social media. In addition, the public is given information about BBC-wide charitable appeals so they can find out how to get involved, raise money and generally support the charities and obtain fundraising materials and merchandise. For each appeal a key executive figure or one for each relevant division of the BBC is usually agreed by the BBC who is responsible for liaison between the BBC and the charity and to whom referral must be made as outlined in this Guidance. There is always an Commissioning Executive with an overview of the relationship for BBC Content. This liaison figure(s) will ensure that all proposed fundraising activities and related programming fits with the values of the charity as well as according to BBC principles and standards, in liaison with BBC Editorial Policy. The BBC may reflect the work of these charities and any areas of their work that are being highlighted during a particular year's appeal for funds. For example, Comic Relief may wish to focus one year on projects which tackle the spread of malaria or BBC Children in Need may choose to highlight projects which tackle bullying. However, the BBC must not allow its content to be used as a vehicle for political campaigning or lobbying. Very careful editorial decisions may have to be taken to ensure that this line is not crossed. Editorial Policy Senior Adviser must be consulted at as early a stage as possible. The use of politicians should be handled with great care. Politicians should not be allowed to use their inclusion in BBC charity programming or related on-air activities to promote specific public policy or party political measures or initiatives. Any proposals to involve any politicians in particular party leaders on air must be referred in advance to the Chief Adviser Politics. For many years corporate and non-corporate supporters have helped BBC Children in Need and Comic Relief. These supporters, via their customers and staff, make a significant contribution mainly through selling special fundraising merchandise and providing a focus for staff and public fundraising. Much of this special merchandise is in the form of official charity products, which have been specifically produced for the appeal and are unique to the charity and sold by specific retailers who have agreed to help fundraise. For example Sainsbury's and Oxfam sell the Comic Relief Red Nose. Asda and Boots and other retailers sell Pudsey bears and other BBC Children in Need goods such as pens, Pudsey branded clothing and Christmas cards. In other cases charity supporters may produce special versions of existing products with a percentage being donated to the charity during the appeal period, for example a special flavour of a confectionary product. In addition, special records are often released, which raise money for the charity. Such releases may be mentioned on-air where editorially appropriate. Corporate support for cross BBC charitable appeals may also be in the form of considerable technical assistance to the charities, for example technology companies may provide major technical support and services on the main appeal nights. In such cases the technical support is offered to the charity and not the BBC and is not part of the BBC television production cost. There is no contractual relationship between the BBC and such technical supporters. The technical assistance offered to the charities enables them to set up, run and operate telephony and online donation mechanisms on the appeal night and in some cases across the year. For all trails the following will apply: The BBC has set up a specialist unit to provide advice on all technical aspects of running a competition, vote or any other uses of Telephony. The Interactive Technical Advice and Contracts Unit (ITACU) oversees the delivery, management and contracting of all BBC's Premium Rate Telephony and other telephony relating to voting and competitions for all programmes, and charity events both independent and in-house, across all divisions and output. Cross BBC charitable initiatives involve fundraising via telephony, online, red button, post and text donations. As appropriate, specialist charity appeals members of ITACU will work with the charity, Senior Adviser Editorial Policy and the Executive in charge of liaison with the charity, to ensure that all such uses are approved in line with regulation in terms of technical and legal issues. ITACU must be consulted at the earliest possible opportunity With high level approval, Premium Rate Telephony may be used to raise funds for these BBC charitable appeals. Premium Rate telephony may only be used for a competition vote or other fundraising mechanism which is directly related to the charitable appeal. Such uses of Premium Rate Telephony may only be carried out with detailed advice from Editorial Policy and ITACU. Any proposal must be signed off by the Divisional Director and referred to Editorial Policy well in advance. Interactive activities may include: Specially commissioned 'Feeder shows' may be produced which are designed to fundraise and/or build interest in the appeal before the main night. These shows usually run as a series in the weeks leading up to the main appeal night or stripped across the week before. They are often entertainment and factual entertainment shows specifically commissioned with a specific fundraising mechanic such as a vote and /or containing appeal films with a donation number call to action. The editorial connection or link to the charitable appeal must be made clear to the audience and the BBC Executive in charge of the production must retain editorial control of all content including any material relating to the charity. We may broadcast special factual programmes, dramas, comedies or other programmes including social media and iPlayer content in the run up to the appeal night to showcase the work of the charity, reflect the effect of donations from the previous appeal and highlight specific themes of that year, such as mental health and domestic violence. However, care must be taken to ensure that the BBC programming does not appear to campaign or lobby on any political issues or matters of public policy. Particular care has to be taken when any drama, comedy, factual or other programme highlights matters of public policy. Programmes may consider or reflect issues such as poverty, social equality, environmental concerns and other major issues. However, it is essential when highlighting these areas that the BBC does not appear to be advocating any political solution or actively encouraging any public campaign or lobby. The BBC should ensure the work of the charity and any projects they support is accurately reflected. The BBC must ensure that it maintains editorial control over all such programming.The Senior Editorial policy Adviser for Charity Appeals should be consulted as well as the relevant genre Senior Editorial Policy Adviser The link with the charity appeal must be made clear on air immediately before the programme, or clearly within the programme. Early discussions should be held with Senior Adviser Editorial Policy and the Executive responsible for liaison with the charity to ensure the suitability and editorial fit of such programming. With the agreement of Editorial Policy and ITACU, it may be appropriate to give information during or at the end of the programme about how to donate to the charitable appeal. Cross-BBC charity fundraising initiatives typically have a central on-air Appeal Night in the form of a telethon. The emphasis of the night is audience donations which are solicited through a range of donation mechanics, including telephone, post, online, red button and text. For BBC Children in Need, Comic Relief the main programme typically consists of suitably themed entertainment; appeal films which show how monies raised in previous appeals have been spent; where monies being raised in the current appeal will be spent and OB inserts from around the country. Throughout the evening the audience is regularly informed of the total and the different ways in which people have donated and raised money in the run-up to the appeal. The following relates to the Main Appeal Night itself: The Main Appeal night programme will reflect the enormous range of fundraising activity throughout the country and the myriad of fundraising initiatives. The BBC may thank members of the public and highlight the fundraising efforts of individuals, communities, organisations, companies their customers and their staff that have raised money and helped support the charity appeal. These acknowledgements should highlight the range of ways in which people have raised money from a whole raft of activities from 'bring and buy' sales and community initiatives, to buying Pudsey bears, red noses or other charity related merchandise. The money raised in this way is added to the 'totaliser' on the night in a clear and transparent manner. These 'thank yous' may come in the form of special inserts from around the country showcasing the work of communities and individuals, cheque presentations on location and in the studio, crawling astons , announcements from presenters and short films reflecting significant fundraising efforts. The editorial purpose of such reflections should be to thank the public and to inspire viewers to donate and to continue with fundraising activities. The following principles must be applied: Commercial logos should not be used in graphics except: Any use of commercial logos in graphics must be approved by Editorial Policy. Films reflecting the work of corporate supporters must abide by the following: Comic Relief is not a BBC charity. It will organise and set up its own events and challenges. These events may be designed to raise the profile of the appeal, showcase the work of the charity and highlight projects for which money is being raised. During the main appeal period Comic Relief may mount special challenges and events to raise money. Such events have included celebrity endurance feats such as those undertaken by David Walliams; celebrity challenges such as the Kilimanjaro climb and the now well established Sport Relief Mile. In 2008 some 400,000 people across the UK took part in the Sport Relief Mile and raised millions of pounds for the appeal. These are Comic Relief events, not BBC events. It would be very difficult to justify using the licence fee to pay for the organisation and administration of such events. Comic Relief undertakes the task of mounting events such as the Sport Relief runs all over the country with the help of a range of supporters. Any proposals for the BBC to cover such events must be referred to Editorial Policy at the earliest stage. BBC staff members may wish to raise money for charity, either individually, or as a group in off-air activities like fun runs or sponsored events. Staff are able to undertake activities organised by external organisations in a private capacity for fundraising activity for charitable purposes but not for campaigning or political action. However, if staff wish to organise off-air fundraising events through the BBC (such as through Gateway or as a group of people from a local radio station coming together to create an activity) then they must refer the proposed activity to the Charity Appeals Adviser and Senior Adviser Editorial Policy well in advance. This is necessary in order to have sufficient time to ensure that the appropriate due diligence is done for any charity which may be the beneficiary of such activity. It is also to avoid the perception of BBC staff becoming the face of a charity and endorsing one charity over another. Any such activity must not stray into the area of lobbying or campaigning and specific care must be taken in relation to staff who work in News and Current Affairs, in relation to due impartiality. Please refer any such proposals well in advance . It is also important for any BBC Outlet planning to cover such activity to refer to Editorial Policy Senior Adviser well in advance who may consult with Charity Appeals Adviser Audience members may sometimes offer to make donations and/or offers of specific assistance to those whose situations have been highlighted in content. It is always best practice to direct them to a registered charity or range of suitable organisations, who can support the person and channel help most effectively. The reason for this is that such organisations usually have the experience and infrastructure to carry out appropriate due diligence checks and ensure that the assistance offered is the best for the person affected. In exceptional circumstances if audiences want to donate to individuals directly then the BBC team concerned should take advice in the first instance from the Senior Adviser, (Charities), Editorial Policy and the Charity Appeals Adviser. If content is associated with the fundraising of the DEC or one of the BBC partner charities such as Children in Need or Comic Relief, then it is more sensible to direct people to donate to those organisations. Sida taleefan lagu dhex dafay London muddo yar ka dib loogu arkay dalka Shiinaha , Subax Sabti ah bishuna tahay Abriil, Akara Etteh waxa uu isticmaalayay taleefankiisa markii uu ka soo baxay saldhigga tuubbada Holborn, ee ku yaalla bartamaha London. Daqiiqad kadibna, waxaa gacanta ku dhigay oo dafay tuug watay baaskiil koronto ku shaqeeya, Akara wuxuu isku dayey in uu cayrsado laakiin waa uu gaari waayay. Waa hal dhibane balse tirade dhibanayaasha kale ee la qiyaasay waa 78,000 gudaha England iyo Wales sanadka ilaa Maarso. Heerka xeer-ilaalinta ee dambigan aad ayuu u hooseeyaa, boolisku waxay sheegeen inay beegsanayaan dembiilayaasha ka mas'uulka ka ah. Waxa kale oo ay yiraahdeen soosaarayaasha iyo shirkadaha tignoolajiyada ayaa door weyn ka ciyaari kara. Dhibanayaasha ayaa BBC-da u sheegayay saameynta uu ku yeeshay oo ay kamid tahay luminta sawiro aan dib loo heli karin iyo in la xaday tobanaan kun oo gini. Akarana, sida dad badan oo kale oo taleefankooda laga qaatay, waxaa jirtay niyad jab kale, wuxuu awooday inuu la socdo halka uu taleefankiisu yaallay, laakiin awood uma lahayn inuu soo celiyo. Akara waxa uu awood u yeeshay in uu la socdo taleefankiisa isagoo isticmaalaya laptopkiisa. Tani waxay u ogolaatay Akara in uu la socdo goobta talefankiisa, isla markiiba waxa uu helay ogaysiis uu ku sheegay in uu ku yaalo Islington. Siddeed maalmood kadib, taleefanku waxa uu gaarayay meelo kala duwan oo ku xeeran waqooyiga London. Tallaabo uu ku sheegayo in uusan "ku talin lahayn" ayuu sameeyay, waxa uu aaday laba ka mid ah goobihii uu talefankiisu ku jiray si uu "u eego". "Waxay ahayd mid khatar ah," ayuu yiri. "Waxaa igu sababay xanaaq." Cidna lama uu hadlin, balse waxa uu dareemay in la eegayo dhaq-dhaqaaqiisa oo wuu iskasoo baxay. Kadib, bishii May, wax yar ka badan hal bil kadib dhaca, Akara wuxuu eegay halka uu yaallo taleefankiisii, waxay hadda ahayd dhinaca kale ee adduunka oo uu ku arkay in la geeyay Shenzhen, Shiinaha. Ma aha wax aan caadi ahayn in taleefannada la xado ay ku dhammaadaan Shenzhen, halkaas oo haddii aaladaha aan la furi karin oo aan haddana la isticmaali Karin dib loogu habeeyo. Magaaladu waxay hoy u tahay 17.6 milyan oo qof, waana xarun weyn oo tignoolajiyadeed, mararka qaarkood waxaa loo yaqaan Dooxada Silicon Valley ee Shiinaha. Daqiiqado kadib markii la xaday taleefanka Akara, wuxuu arkay askar booliis ah oo wadada taagan wuxuuna u sheegay wixii dhacay. Saraakiishu waxay u sheegeen inay ka war hayeen tuugo aagga ku sugan oo ay howlgal wadeen, waxaana lagu dhiirigeliyay inuu dembiga ku soo sheego khadka internetka, taas oo uu sameeyay. Dhawr maalmood kadib, booliska magaaladu waxay email ugu sheegeen in kiiska la xiray "sababo la xiriira in aan la qoonsan Karin kuwa dhaca u geystay". Akara ayaa intaa ka dib soo gudbiyay sawiradii iyo xogtii uu ka soo ururiyay goobihii uu gaaray talefankiisa laga xaday. Booliisku waxay qirteen in la helay laakiin ma aysan qaadin tallaabo kale. Dad badan oo kale ayaa la soo xiriiray BBC-da iyaga oo horay ula kulmay xatooyo. Waxaa kamid ah, James O’Sullivan, 44, oo ka yimid Surrey, ayaa sheegay in uu waayay in ka badan £25,000 markii tuugtu adeegsatay adeegga Apple Pay. Dhanka kale, Katie Ashworth, oo ka timid Newcastle, ayaa sharraxday in taleefankeeda lagala baxay meel baarkin ah oo ay la socoto saacaddeeda, iyo kaarka deynta ee taleefanka. "Arrinta ugu murugada badan ayaa ahayd in teleefanka ay iigu jireen sawirradii ugu dambeeyay ee aan hooyaday wada galnay inaga oo wada soconna inta aysan xanuunsan, wax kasta waan sameyn lahaa si aan dib ugu helo sawiradaas," 36-jirka ayaa tiri. Mar labaad, ayay tiri, waxaa jirtay wax-qabad la'aan ka timid booliiska. "Boolisku xataa ilama aysan socon, in kasta oo wax kala iibsiga bangigayga uu muujinayo sida saxda ah meesha ay tuugadu aadeen," ayay tiri.

Cudurka Covid-19: Biden ma waxa uu qaaday waddadii Trump? Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Joe Biden ayaa hay'adaha sirdoonka ku amray inay baaraan asalka halka uu ka soo askumay xanuunka Covid-19, iyadoo ay sii kordhayaan wararka la isla dhex marayo ee ku saabsan halka uu ka soo billowday xanuunkan. Qoraal uu soo saaray, ayuu Mr Biden kaga codsaday hay'adaha sirdoonka inay "laba jibbaaraan dedaalladooda" ayna warbixin ku soo siiyaan muddo 90 maalmood gudahood ah. Covid-19 waxaa markii ugu horreysay laga helay magaalada Shiinaha ku taalla ee Wuhan dabayaaqadii sanadkii 2019. In ka badan 168 milyan oo kiis ayaa kaddib lagu arkay dunida iyadoo ugu yaraan 3.5 milyan oo qofna ay u dhinteen. Maamulka magaalada ayaa kiisaskii ugu horreeyay ee Covid-19 la xiriiriyay suuq kalluunka lagu iibiyo oo ku yaalla magaalada Wuhan, saynisyahannada ayaana rumeysan in bani'aadamku ay fayraska ka qaadeen xayawaanka. Balse wararka warbaahinta Mareykanka ee dhowaan ayaa sheegaya inay u badan tahay in la hayo caddeyn ah in fayrasku ka soo billowday sheybaar ku yaalla Shiinaha. Beijing ayaa cambaareysay wararkaas waxayna sheegtay in taas beddelkeed laga yaabo inuu ka soo billowday sheybaar ku yaalla Mareykanka. Maamulka Biden ayaa sheegay in hay'adaha sirdoonka Mareykanka ay ku kala aragti duwan yihiin halka uu ka soo billowday Covid-19 - qaarkood waxay leeyihiin wuxuu noqon karaa sheybaarka halka kuwo kalena ay qabaan in xayawaanka iyo bani'aadamku isku gudbiyeen - oo midkoodna uusan hubin aragtidaas. Fekerkan ayaa soo baxay sanadkii la soo dhaafay markaas oo Donald Trump, xoghayihiisii arrimaha dibadda Mike Pompeo, senator Tom Cotton iyo kuwo kaleba ay fekerkan aaminsanaayeen. Trump iyo Pompeo gacan kama geysan dejinta xaaladda. Iyadoo fekerkoodaas uu jiro ayaa waxaa soo baxay kuwo kale, sida in cududrkaba lagu sameeyay sheybaar ku yaalla Shiinaha. Suurtogalnimada arrintaas ayaa u muuqata mid aad u yar. Waxaa laga yaabaa in bulshadu aysan wada ogaan runta ku saabsan halka uu fayrasku ka yimid, gaar ahaan haddii Shiinuhu uu sii wado in uusan la shaqeyn hay'adaha baaraya. Biden ayaa codsanaya baaritaan buuxa, si kastaba, haddii uu Mareykanku helo caddeyn ah in sheybaar uu ka soo dusay, waxay taasi sanadaha soo socda sii xumeyn doontaa xiriirka Mareykanka iyo Shiinaha. Qoraal shalay ka soo baxay Aqalka Cad, ayuu Madaxweyne Biden ku sheegay in markii uu talada dalkaas la wareegay kaddib uu codsaday in warbixin laga siiyo halka uu ka soo askumay Covid-19, "oo ay ka mid tahay hadii ay bani'aadamku ka qaadeen xayawaanka iyo in uu ka soo dusay sheybaar". Warbixintaas oo uu helay bishan dhexdeeda, wuxuu codsaday "faahfaahin dheeraad ah". "Hay'adaha sirdoonka Mareykanka waxay la yimaadeen labo feker balse weli go'aan rasmi ah kama gaarin su'aashan," ayuu yiri Biden. , Madaxweynaha ayaa haatan ka codsaday hay'adaha inay "laba laabaan dedaalladooda ay kula imaanayaan warbixin mideysan", ayna ku soo war celiyaan muddo 90 maalmood gudahood ah. Wuxuu sheegay in Mareykanku uu la shaqeyn doono dalalka ay xulafada yihiin ee dunida daafaheeda ku yaalla si Shiinaha cadaadis loogu saaro inuu ka qeyb qaato baaritaanka caalamiga ah uuna baarayaasha u oggolaado inay ururiyaan xogta iyo caddeymaha ay u baahan yihiin. Balse warbixin shalay lagu daabacay wargeyska Washington Post ayaa maamulka Biden ku eedeeyay in uu iska weecinayo su'aalaha Kongareeska ee la xiriira halka uu ka soo bilowday Covid-19, isagoo u leexiyay dhanka Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO). Bishii March sanadkan, WHO ayaa soo saartay warbixin ay ka qeyb qaateen saynisyahanno Shiineys ah oo ku saabsan halka uu ka soo askumay Covid-19, taas oo lagu sheegay in aysan macquul ahayn inuu ka soo bilowday sheybaar. WHO ayaase sheegtay in loo baahan yahay baaritaan dheeraad ah. Balse su'aalaha ayaa weli taagan iyadoo warar laga soo xigtay hay'adaha sirdoonka Mareykanka ay sheegayaan in saddex ka tirsan Machadka Daraasaadka Fayrasyada ee Wuhan isbitaal la dhigay bishii November 2019, dhowr toddobaad kahor inta uusan Shiinuhu shaacin kiiskii ugu horreeyay ee cudurka ee laga helay bulshada. Anthony Fauci, oo ah madaxa la latinta caafimaadka ee Madaxweyne Biden, ayaa weligiis aaminsanaa in xayawaanku uu fayraska u gudbiyay bani'aadamka, inkastoo uu bishan ka soo dabcay fekerkaas isagoo sheegay inuusan haatan aaminsaneyn in Covid-19 uu si dabiici ah u bilowday. Hadalka Mr Biden ayaa imaanaya maalmo kaddib markii Xavier Becerra, oo ah Xoghayaha Mareykanka ee arrimaha caafimaadka uu ku borriyay WHO inay hubiyaan in baaritaan waadix ah lagu sameeyo halka uu fayrasku ka soo bilowday. "Xanuunka safmarka ah ee Covid-19 keliya sanad kama xadin nolosheenna, wuxuu xaday nolosha malaayiin qof," ayuu yiri Mr Becerra. Eedeymaha la xiriira in fayrasku uu ka soo dusay sheybaar ayaa aad loo beeniyay sanadkii hore, kaddib markii madaxweynihii xilligaas Donald Trump uu sheegay in Covid-19 uu ka yimid machadkaas ku yaalla Wuhan. Warbaahinno badan oo Mareykanka ku yaalla ayaa hadalkaas ku tilmaamay mid been abuur ah. Talaadadii, Mr Trump ayaa email uu u diray wargeyska New York Post ku faanay "Aniga ahaan billowgiiba way ii caddeyd balse si xun ayaa la ii cambaareeyay, sidii caadada ahayd," ayuu yiri. "Hadda waxay dhammaantood leeyihiin: 'Wuu saxsanaa.'"

Itoobiya miyey ka soo dabacday mowqifkii ay ka taagnayd heshiiskii ay la gashay Somaliland Ayadoo weli ay taagan tahay xiisadii ka dhalatay heshiiskii isafgarad ee 1dii Janaayo ay Addis Ababa ku saxiixdeen Itoobiya iyo Somaliland ayaa waxaa soo baxaya hadal cusub oo u muuqada in Itoobiya ay si ka duwan sidii hore u wajahayso arrintaas. La taliyaha amniga qaranka ee ra’iisul wasaaraha Itoobiya Redwan Xuseen ayaa bartiisa X (Twitter) ku soo qoray qoraal u muuqda in Itoobiya ay ka hadlayso halka ay ka taagan tahay arrinta madax banaanida Soomaaliya iyo duurxul ku socda Masar oo Soomaaliya ugu yaboohday garab istaag milateri, ayadoo Masar iyo Itoobiyana ay ka dhaxayso xurguf ka dhalatay biya xireenka weyn ee Itoobiya ay dhawaan dhisatay. Redwan Xuseen wuxuu bartiisa X ku qoray “ka go’naanshaha Itoobiya ee nabadda iyo amaanka Soomaaliya waxaa lagu muujiyey dhiigga iyo dhididka wiilasheena iyo gabdhaheenna qiimaha leh. Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliya deris soohdin wadaaga kaliya ma aha, laakin waa dalal isku bah ah oo wadaaga luqad, dhaqan iyo dad. Xiriirka isku keen haya waa mid xoog leh. Himiladeennu waa mid isku xiran oo aan la kala saari karin. Heshiiska is afgarad ee Somaliland aan la yeelanay waa mid iskaashi iyo bahwadaag, kaasoo Itoobiya marin u siinaya badda marka xagga ganacsiga laga hadlayo. Ma aha in aan dhul ku darsanayno ama in loo qaato madaxbanaanida dhuleed ee waddan”. Wuu sii waday qoraalka isagoo ka hadlaya dalal kale oo uusan magacaabin laakinse loo arko in uu si sarbeeban ugu jeedo dalalka Soomaaliya taageerada u muujiyey. “Walow ay taasi xaqiiqada tahay, jilayaasha qaar oo aan taageero sidaa u weyn siin Soomaaliya xilligii ay baahida weyn qabtay ayaa hadda iska dhigaya saaxiibbo dhab ah, laakinse waxa dhiirri galinaya ma aha xiriir saaxiibtinimo, laakinse waa cadawnimo ay u qabaan Itoobiya. Ajendahoodu ma aha nabad iyo amni ka hirgala geeska Afrika. Si taas ka fog, waxay doonayaan inay abuuraan xiisad iyo fowdo. Xiisad abuurka aan iminka arkayno wuxuu uga sii darayaa xiisadda, wuxuuna u danaynayaa danta jilayaasha dibadda ka jooga ee danaystayaasha ah” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu ku celiyey baaq aan cusbayn oo ah in Itoobiya ay jeceshahay in deriskeda ay wadahadal la yeelato “ayadoo aragtidu tahay isdhexgal heer goboleed". , Villa Somalia Maxamed Salaad (Dhegaweyne) waa qoraa iyo cilmi baare, wuxuuna hore ula soo shaqeeyey xilliyo kala duwan dawladda Soomaaliya iyo Qaramada Midoobay, haatanna wuxuu ka faalloodaa arrimaha gobolka, wuxuu ka hadlayaa ujeeddada ka dambaysa hadalka Redwan Xuseen. “Luqaddu waa mid diblomaasiyadeed, dhinac markaad ka fiiriso waxaad arkaysaa in Ridwaan uu hadalladii adkaa ka soo debcay sida ay dadka qaar u arkaan” ayuu yiri Dhegaweyne. Mar uu ka jawaabayey inay suurtogal tahay in labada dhinac ay wadahadal isugu yimaadaan ayadoo mid kasta uu wax ka tanaasulayo si meel dhexe la isugu yimaado wuxuu sheegay in ay taasi suurtogal ku noqon karto haddii heshiiska Itoobiya iyo Somaliland dhex maray uu meesha ka baxo. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. “Haddii ay Itoobiya bad danaynayso waxaa suurtogal noqonaysa markaa in ay si toos u wajahdo dawladda Soomaaliya, wixii markaa ku yimaada dawladda Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland oo wadajira waa wax soconaya, laakinse waxa doodda weyn dhaliyey ayaa ah in aan la kala garanayn in Itoobiya ay raadinayso saldhig ciidan iyo inay raadinayso meel ay ganacsigeeda kala soo degto” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu intaa ku daray Dhegaweyne in dhinac marka laga eego la dhihi karo “Itoobiya way soo jilicday”. Itoobiya wuxuu ku tilmaamay inay tahay “awood goboleed” marki hore si ka duwan sida hadda u haminaysay, laakin hadda doonaysa inay si kale u wajahdo “Itoobiya waxaa ka dhaadhacsanayd in siday rabto ay wax u socodsiin karto, taasina waa midda keentay dhibkan” ayuu yiri. Arrinta ku saabsan heshiiska dhex maray Masar iyo Soomaaliya ayuu aad ugu nuuxnuuxsaday in ay keentay qaabka ay Itoobiya hadalka u dhigtay maadaama ay ka dhex aragtay jaanib sedexaad “Safarka madaxweyne Xasan sheekh uu ku tegey Masar ee uu heshiiska kula gala galay ayaa Itoobiya ku dhaliyey cabsi weyn ayadoo Itoobiya iyo Masar ay isku hayaan biyo xireenka ay Itoobiya dhistay. Mar hadii ay Masar timaado Soomaaliya waxay Itoobiya ka cabsi qabtaa inay ku hubayso mucaaradka gudaheeda ah” ayuu yiri. Soomaaliya weli kama jawaabin hadalka cusub ee Itoobiya ka soo baxay, ayadoo Itoobiya ay dalbanayso wadahadal.
