Dowladda Talyaaniga ayaa shaacisay heshiis cusub oo ay la gashay dalka Albania kaas oo ah in ay ka dhisi doonto laba xaruun oo lagu hayo dadka soo galootiga ah ee isku dayaya inay gaaraan xeebaha Talayaaniga. Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Talyaniga Georgia Meloni ayaa sheegtay in heshiiskan uu yahay mid lagu xakameynayo tirada muhaajiriinta magangalyo-doonka ah, kuwaas oo ku dhawaad laba jibaarmay tan iyo markii ay xafiiska la wareegtay. Heshiiska oo lagu dhawaaqay maalintii Isniintii ayaa ah kii ugu horreeyay ee uu wado waddan ka tirsan Midowga Yurub isla markaana uu muhaajiriin ugu dirayo dal kale. Georgia Meloni ra’iisul wasaaraha waxaa ay tilmaantay in xarumahan la furi doono sanadka soo socda ee 2024-ka waxaana xaruun kasta ay qaadi doontaa 3,000 oo qof marka si buuxda ay u shaqeeyaan. Sidoo kale dowladda Talyaaniga waxaa ay rajaynaysa in sanad kasta xaruumahan la geeyo dad gaaray ilaa 36,000 oo qof . Xisbiga midigta fog ee maamula dalka Talyaaniga ayaa wajahaya cadaadis sii kordhaya oo gudaha ah maadaama uu ku guuldareystay inuu fuliyo ballanqaadkii uu sameeyay xilligii doorashada kaas oo ahaa in uu xakameynayo socdaalka sharci darrada ah, In ka badan 145,000 oo qof ayaa gaaray xeebaha Talyaaniga tan iyo bishii Janaayo ee sanadkaan, marka la barbar dhigo 88,000 oo qof sanadkii hore. Xaruumahaan waxaa laga dhisi doonaa gobolladda Shengjin iyo Gjader ee Albania waxaana "si buuxda loogu maamuli doonaa hannanka Midowga Yurub iyo sharciga caalamiga ah," ayaa tiri Meloni. Heshiiska cusub ee dowladda Talayaaniga ay la gashay dalka Albania ayaa u ogaalaanaya Rooma in ay jabiso heshiiskii Dublin ay ku saxiixdeen Midowga Yurub , kaas oo dhigayay in dalka ugu horreeya ee ay muhaajiriintu yimaadaan ay tahay in ay daryeelaan oo ay ka baaraandegaan kiisaskooda. Sida ku cadda heshiiska mid ka mid ah xaruumaha ee laga hirgalinayo dalka Albania ayaa waxaa la gayna doonaa dadka muhaajiriinta marka ay soo gaaran xeebaha Talyaaniga ee lasoo badbaadiyo. Midda labaad waxaa loo isticmaali doonaa in lagu dejiyo tahriibayaasha u qalma inay magangelyo ka codsadaan Midowga Yurub, balse heshiiska laguma sheegin halka ay ku danbeeyn doonaan kuwa aan kuwa aan u qalmin in magangalyo la siiyo. Kharashka ku baxaya dhismaha xaruumahaan waxaa bixin doona dowladda Talyaaniga , laakiin Albania waxay qaadna doontaa doorka ilaalinta iyo sugidda amniga . Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Talyaniga Georgia Meloni waxaa ay ballan qaadday haweenka uurka leh iyo kooxaha kale ee nugul in aan loo diri doonin Albania. In kasta oo aan waqti sax loo cayimin xilliga dhaqan galka heshiiska hadana labada dhinacba waxaa ay shaaciyeen in marka xarumaha la hirgaliyo la bilaabi doona. Haa’yaddaha u dooda xaquuqda aadanaha iyo qaar ka mid ah dalalka Midowga Yurub ayaa walaac xooggan ka mijiiyay arrintaan ayaga oo dalbaday in dowladda Talyaanigu ay bixiso fahfaahin dheerada ah oo heshiiska ku saabsan. Bayaan kasoo baxay Midowga Yurub ayaa lagu yir "Waxaan la xiriirnay mas'uuliyiinta Talyaaniga sababtoo ah waxaan u baahanahay inaan aragno faahfaahinta heshiiska, waxaan codsaneynaa inaan helno macluumaad kale oo arrintaan la xiriir”. Sidoo kale siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka Talyaaniga ayaa ku gacan seyray ku dhawaaqista heshiiska mujaajiriinta soo gal dalka Talyaaniga lagu gaynayo Albania. Guddiga Badbaadinta Caalamiga ah (IRC) ayaa cambaareeyay qorshaha Rome, kaas oo ay ku sheegtay "inay dharbaaxo ku tahay mabda'a midnimada Midowga Yurub." Dhakhaatiirta Aan Xuduudka Lahayn (MSF) ayaa sidoo kale ka fal-celisay heshiiska oo ay tilmaane in uu yahay mid dadka looga hor istagayo in ay dhoofaan si ay uga badbaadaan dagaallada, macluusha iyo colaadaha kale. Heshiiskann ayaa la mid ah heshiiska muranka dhaliyay ee Boqortooyada UK ay la gashay dalka Rwanda, kaas oo ay doonaysay in kumanaan magangalyo doon ah ay dalkaasi ugu dirto. Jamhuuriyadda Albania waa wadan ku yaalo barige Koonfureed ee qaarada Yurub. Waa waddan yar oo buuraley ah oo ku yaal jasiiradda Balkanka, oo leh xeeb dheer. Waxaa uu xuduudo la wadaaga Montenegro dhanka waqooyi-galbeed, Kosovo ,Waqooyiga Makedoniya dhinaca bari, Giriiga dhinaca koonfureed waxaa uu xad kala leeyahay badda ee ay la wadaagto Giriiga, Montenegro iyo Talyaaniga. Dadka dagan dalkan waxaa ay yihiin Muslimiin ka yimid dalka ay dariska yihiin Kosovo,waxaa dalkaan xukumi jirtay boqortooyadii Cusmaaniyiinta. Dagaalkii Labaad ee Adduunka ka dib, Albania waxay noqotay dawlad shuuci ah oo uu maamulo hogaamiye kaligi talis ah ilaa ay u gudubtay dimuqraadiyadda ka dib sanadkii 1990-kii Doorashadii 1992-kii waxay soo afjartay 47 sano oo shuuci ah, laakiin tobankii sano ee u danbeeyay waxaa dalkaasi ka dhacay isbadelo dhanka hogaanka ah. Dhaqaale ahaan dalka ma ahan mid wanaagsan taas oo sababtay in dad badan ay dalka ka tagan iyga oo shaqo raadis a. Heerka noolasha ee dalka ayaa ah mid hoose waxaan taas ay keenatay in dalka ay cararan qaar badan oo ka mid ah muwaadiniintiisa . Shaqo la,aanta ka jirta dalka awgeeda Kumaan qof ayaa sanad kasta iska dhiiba dalka Yurub. Sannadkii 2022, dad aad u tiro badan ayaa ku yimid doomo yaryar oo ka yimid Albania ayaa gaaray dalka Ingiriiska sida uu sheegay Ra’iisulwasaaraha dalka Ingiriiska Dadka Albaaniyaanka ah waxay ka dhigan yihiin saddex meelood meel dadka soogalootiga ah ee sharci-darrada ah ee raadinaya magan-gelyo gudaha UK sida lagu sheegay xogta ay baahisay dowladda Ingiriiska . Xogta laga soo xigtay haa’yaddaha maxliga ah ee Albania 83% guud ahan dadkaasi ayaa doonaya in ay ka cararan dalkooda . Dalka la doonayo in la geeyo dadka soogalootiga ah ee Soomaalidu ay ku jirto ayaa kaalimaha hore kaga jira dalalka ugu badan ee ka gancsiga daroogada . waxa ay xubin ka noqday isbahaysiga milatari ee Nato sanadkii 2009-ka Albania ayaa la siiyay aqoonsiga musharaxnimo ee Midowga Yurub ku dhawaad toban sano ka hor balse wali si rasmi ah uga biirin ururka Dalka Talyaaniga waxaa sanad walba gal kumanaan tahriibayaal ah oo ka tagay dalalka kala duwan oo Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay.

Booliska Soomaaliya ee baaritaanka ku wada kiiskan waxay sheegeen in meydka Cabdinaasir laga helay guri uu ka degenaa magaalada Muqdisho shalay oo ahayd Axad, abaaro 06:30 galabnimo kadib markii ay wargelin ka heleen dad la degenaa Dahable guriga. Boolisku ma bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah, laakiin waxay sheegeen inay markii hore heleen xog ah in meydka qof muwaadin ah uu yaallo gurigii uu degenaa oo ku yaal Waaxda Janaraal Daa’uud, gaar ahaan xaafada Ceel Qalow. Boolisku waxay sheegeen inay gacanta ku dhigeen eedeysaneyaal, iyaga oo sidoo kale gacanta ku dhigay cadeymihii goobta loogu tagay si ay ugu adeegsadaan baaritaanada socda. Wax faahfaahin ah kama aysan bixin eedeysaneyaasha la qabtay, waxa ay yihiin iyo sida loo qabtay midna. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Wasiirka Beeraha iyo Waraabka, Xildhibaan Maxamed Xayir Maareeye, oo la kulmay taliyaha Booliska Somaaliyeed Janaraal Sulub Axmed Firin waxa uu sheegay inay socdaan baaritaano xoog leh, islamarkaasna la xiray dhammaan dadkii guriga la degenaa sarkaalka la dilay ee u shaqeynayay hay’adda Duulista Rayid iyo Saadaasha Hawada Soomaaliya. Xildhibaan Maareeye waxa uu intaa ku daray in Boolisku ay sidoo kale sheegeen inay qaadeen baaritaano lagu ogaanayo dadkii ugu dambeeyay ee taabtay jirka meydka, kuwaas oo la filayo inay gacan ka geystaan sida dilku u dhacay iyo ogaanshiyaha dadka ka dambeeya. Hay’adda Duulista iyo Madaaradda Hawada maamulka ee iskood madax banaanida ugu dhawaaqay ee Somaliland oo war kasoo saartay geerida Cabdinaasir, waxay ku eedeeyeen kiiska Cabdinaasir dowladda federaalka ee Soomaaliya ee uu u shaqeynayay, iyaga oo aan soo bandhigin wax cadeyn ah oo kabaya eedeyntooda. Laakiin Xildhibaan Maareeye oo ka mid ah xubnaha baarlamaanka federaalka iyo Golaha Wasiiradda ku metala marxuum Cabdinaasir Dahable waxa uu sheegay in uu ku qanacsan yahay talaabooyinka baaritaan ee ilaa iyo hadda ay qaadeen booliiska Soomaaliya. Aabbaha dhalay Muuse Xaaji Cabdi oo saxaafadda la hadlay ayaa dowladda Soomaaliya ka codsaday in meydka wiilkiisa sida ugu fudud loogu keeno. “Geeridu waa xaq wayna kala naxdin badantahay, wayna kala xanuun badantahay, waxaan dowladda Soomaaliya ka codsanayaa in inankaas [meydkiisa] sida ugu fudud oo aan siyaasad layga gelin, in aan ku samro oo aan aasto, ayaan ka codsanayaa madaxda Soomaaliya.” Cabdinaasir Muuse Xaaji, 32, waxuu muddo ku dhow 8 sanno ka shaqaynaayay Hay’adda Duulista Hawada Soomaaliya. Waxuu kamid ahaa 42 shaqaale ah oo Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay ee Duulista Hawada ee ICAO ay ka qaadatay magaalada Hargeysa laguna tababaray dalka Kenya. Waxa uu ka shaqeeyay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Garoowe muddo kahor inta uusan wareegin xafiiska laga hago diyaaradaha ee Muqdisho ay ku leedahay Hay’adda Duulista. September 2022 ayuu kamid kamid noqday koox dhallinyaro ah oo ku ku guuleystay Chevening Scholarship oo ah deeq waxbarasho oo Dowladda Ingiriisku bixiso, oo muddo sanad lagu qaato shahaadada labaad ee Jaamacadda. Fasax waxbarasho oo dheer kadib, waxuu kusoo noqday Soomaaliya bishii December ee sanadkii tegay, isaga oo dib ugu laabtay shaqadii uu u hayay Hay’adda Duulista Hawada Soomaaliya. Cabdinaasir waxu ahaa, Aabbo dhalay hal gabadh ah sida la sheegay isagoo dadkii aqoonta ulahaa ay ku tilmaameen qof aad u afgaaban oo aadna u dedaal badan.

Soomaalida ku ganacsata magaalo ku taalla Koonfur Afrika oo lagu amray inay ka tagaan dukaamadooda , Ajaanibta ay Soomaalidu ku jirto ee ku nool, kuna ganacsada magaalada Polokwane ee gobolka Limpopo ee dalka Koonfur Afrika ayaa loo qabtay inay 7 maalin uga guuraan halkaas. Qaar ka tirsan dadka u dhashay waddankaas ee loogu tagay magaaladaas ayaa warqado u qeybiyay Soomaalida iyo ajaanibta kale, iyagoo ka dalbaday in dukaamadooda ay uga tagaan halkaas. Waxaa warqadda ogeysiiska ah sidoo kale ku xusneyd digniin loo jeediyay dadka aan u hoggaansamin dalabkaas. Arrintan ayaa keentay walaac aad u xooggan, sida uu BBC-da u sheegay Maxamed Maxamuud Cirra-wayne, oo ka mid ah hoggaamiyeyaasha Soomaalida ah ee ku nool gobolka Limpopo. “Maanta waxaa nagu dhacay nooc Xenophobia [ajnabi naceyb] ah oo aanan horay u arag. Ilaa shalay way socotay, laakiin dhinaceenna magaalada Polokwane ee caasimadda gobolka Limpopo, waxaa noo yimid niman basas wata oo nagu soo dul degay. “Aniga iyo odayaashii kale ee bulshadaba waan joognay, waxaan amarnay inaan lala dagaallamin, oo la xiro dukaamada. Markii dukaamadii la xiray way hadleen nimankii waxayna dhaheen, ‘waa inaad halkan uga guurtaan 7 maalmood gudahood, dukaan walba iyo meherad walbana waa inay saxiixaan warqado muujinaya inay 7 maalmood ku guurayaan,” ayuu yiri Maxamed. Waxa uu sheegay inay arrintan aad ula yaabeen, ayna lama-filaan ku noqotay, isagoo intaas ku daray in dadka sidaas sameynaya aysan ahayn kuwo ka socda dhanka dowladda Koonfur Afrika. “Waxay nagu noqotay arrin aanan waligeen horay u arkin. Waa niman shacab ah oo aan dowladda ahayn. Waa ragga tagaasileyda ah oo aad u dhib badan iyo niman kale oo bulshada deegaanka ah oo ay wateen," ayuu yiri Maxamed. Dadkan digniinta siiyay ajaanibta ku ganacsata magaalada Polokwane ayaa Soomaalida marka laga soo tago waxay sidoo kale warqadaha u qeybiyeen ganacsatada ka kala socota dalalka Pakistan, Itoobiya, Bangladesh iyo Hindiya. Maxamed Maxamuud Cirra-wayne ayaa BBC-da u sheegay in Soomaalida ay ku gacan-seyreen amarka lagu siiyay inay uga guuraan magaalada ay hantida badan ku leeyihiin. “Ma aanan saxiixin warqadaha naloo keenay, waan diidnay. Labo dukaan oo ugu horreeyay ayaa saxiixay maaddaama lagu dul-daatay. Intii dambe waan joojinnay, waana la hadalnay ka bulsho ahaan iyo ka odayaal ahaan. Waxaan u sheegnay in wax warqad ah oo la saxiixayo aysan jirin,” ayuu yiri. Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada Soomaalida ayaa dowladda ku wargeliyay arrinta la soo gudboonaatay, sida uu sharraxayo Maxamed. “Waan ku wareejinnay waraaqihii, kiiskiina waan furnay. Booliska way noo yimaadeen, arrinta sida ay u dhacday ayaan u sheegnay, mana ahayn arrin kaligeen nagu eg oo waa mid ay nala qabaan ajaanibta magaalada oo dhan.” Soomaalida ku nool magaalada Polokwane, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaanno magaceedii hore ee “Pietersburg”, waxaa tiradooda lagu qiyaasay 150 ilaa 200 oo qoys. W aa mid ka mid ah magaalooyinka ugu waaweyn Koonfur Afrika, waxayna dhinaca waqooyi ka xigtaa gobolka Gauteng. Waxay si weyn u soo shaac-baxday intii ay socdeen ciyaaraha Koobka Adduunka ee sanadkii 2010, markaas oo ay ku jirtay magaalooyinka marti-geliyay kulamada qaar. Dhaqdhaqaaqyada ajnabi-naceybka ah ayaa sanadihii dambe ku soo badanayay Koonfur Afrika, iyadoo dadka u dhashay waddankaas ay dadka soo-galootiga ah ku eedeynayeen in ay ka qaateen fursadihii shaqo ee ay muwaadiniintu lahaayeen. Intii ay xiisaddan taagneyd, weerarro lagu beegsanayay dukaamada ajaanibta iyo mudaharaadyo ay sameynayeen dadka maxalliga ah ayaa sababay khasaare isugu jira dhimasho iyo burbur-hantiyeed. Sanadkii 2019 oo ay dhaceen weerarradii ugu xumaa ee ka dhanka ahaa ajaanibta ku ganacsada dalkaas ayaa la soo tebiyay in uu dhaqaalihiisa hoos u dhacay. Shaqo-la’aanta xilligaas ka jirtay Koonfur Afrika ayaa lagu qiyaasay 27%. Si guudna, waddankan ku yaalla dhinaca koonfureed ee qaaradda Afrika ayaa ka mid ah dalalka ay ka dhacaan dilalka ugu badan ee caalamka.

Kadib aqoonsiga dowladda Falastiin, yaa hoggaamin doona? Dalalka Ingiriiska, Faransiiska iyo dalal kale ayaa shalay Falastiin u aqoonsaday dowlad. Ra'iisul wasaaraha Israa'iil Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa si kulul uga jawaabay warka aqoonsiga. Waxa uu sidoo kale meesha ka saaray go'aankaas oo uu ku sheegay in ay abaal marin u tahay "argagaxisada Xamaas". Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale muujiyay sida uu uga soo horjeedo tallaabadan. Muxuu ka dhigan yahay aqoonsiga? Maxaase keenaya isku dhac? Falastiin waa dal jira oo aan haddana jirin. Waxaa laga aqoonsan yahay meelo badan oo adduunka ah; waxay furteen xafiisyo diblumaasiyadeed oo dibada ah waxayna leeyihiin kooxo ka qayb gala tartamada ciyaaraha fudud oo ay ka mid yihiin ciyaaraha Olombikada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, colaadda soo jireenka ah ee Israa'iil awgeed, ma laha xuduud caalami ah oo lagu heshiiyey, ma laha caasimad iyo ciidan toona. Maamulka Falastiin, oo la aasaasay sagaashamaadkii ka dib heshiis nabadeed oo ay Israel kula gashay Daanta Galbeed, ayaa awoodi wayday inay maamusho dhulka iyo dadka toona. Qasa oo ay duullaan ku tahay Israel ayaa waxaa ka socda dagaal bahalnimo ah. Inkasta oo ay awood u leedahay xukuumadda Falastiin in ay qayb ahaan maamusho dhulka, aqoonsigeedu inta badan waa calaamad. In kasta oo ay leedahay farriin akhlaaqeed iyo mid siyaasadeed oo xooggan, haddana wax yar bay ka beddeshaa xaqiiqada jirta. Laakiin calaamaddu sidoo kale waa xoog badan tahay. Sida xoghayihii hore ee arrimaha dibadda UK David Lammy uu ka sheegay shirkii golaha guud ee Qaramada Midoobay bishii July, "Britain waxay mas'uuliyad gaar ah ka saaran tahay inay taageerto xal laba dawladood ah." Lamy wuxuu tixraacay Baaqii Balfour ee 1917, kaas oo oggolaaday in Falastiin laga dhiso dhul Yuhuudi ay leeyihiin. , Bettmann Archive/ Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Lamy wuxuu sheegay in heshiiska uu ka kooban yahay ballanqaad sharaeed , isagoo xusay in "aan la samayn doonin wax kasta oo wax u dhimaya xuquuqda madaniga iyo diinta ee dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ee ku nool Falastiin." Taageerayaasha Israa'iil waxay si joogta ah u tilmaamaan in Xoghayihii Arrimaha Dibadda ee xilligaas, Balfour, oo saxiixay heshiiska, uusan si cad u sheegin Falastiiniyiinta iyo xuquuqdooda qaran. Laakiin dawladda loo yaqaan Falastiin, oo Ingiriisku maamuli jiray sannadihii 1922 ilaa 1948 ee aqoonsiga Ururka Qaramada Midoobay, ayaa muddo dheer loo arkaa arrin caalami ah oo aan la xallin. Israa'iil waxaa la aasaasay 1948; Dadaalkii lagu doonayay in lagu dhiso dowlad isbar-bar-tag oo Falastiiniyiin ah ayaa ku guuldareystay dhowr sababood. David Lamy ayaa sheegay in siyaasiyiintu "ay caadeysteen inay ugu yeeraan xal laba dawladood ah." Xalka labada dawladood waxay ka dhigan tahay in Falastiin laga dhiso Daanta Galbeed iyo Marinka Gaza, oo ku teedsan xudduudihii jiray ka hor dagaalkii Carabta iyo Israa'iil ee 1967, oo ay la lahayd Bariga Quddus, oo Israa'iil ay la wareegtay dagaalka ka dib, oo ah caasimaddeeda. Sawirka, Hal qof ayaa dhowr jeer la sheegay: Marwan Barghouti. Waxa uu ku dhashay kuna soo barbaaray Daanta Galbeed, isagoo 15 jir ah waxa uu ka shaqo bilaabay Fatax, kooxda PLO ee uu hoggaamiyo Carafaat. Barghouti waxa uu ku soo baxay hoggaamiye caan ah intii lagu jiray kacdoonkii labaad ee Falastiiniyiinta, ka hor inta aan la xirin oo lagu eedeyn in uu qorsheeyay weerarro lagu hoobtay oo shan Israa'iiliyiin ah lagu dilay. Mar walba wuu dafirayay eedeymaha loo soo jeediyay balse wuxuu ku jiray xabsiga Israa'iil tan iyo 2002-dii. Haddana marka ay Falastiiniyiintu ka hadlaan madaxda mustaqbalka, waxay ka hadlaan qof xabsiga ku jiray ku dhawaad ​​rubuc qarni. Ra'yi ururin dhawaan ay samaysay xarunta cilmi baarista siyaasadda Falastiiniyiinta ee fadhigeedu yahay Daanta Galbeed ayaa sheegtay in 50% Falastiiniyiintu ay Barghouti u dooran doonaan Madaxweyne, isagoo ka horreeya Cabbaas oo xilkan hayay tan iyo 2005tii. Inkasta oo uu xubin sare ka yahay ururka Fatax oo muddo dheer dagaal kula jiray Xamaas, haddana waxaa loo malaynayaa in magaciisa lagu daray liiska maxaabiista ay Xamaas doonayso in la sii daayo launa beddesho la heystayaasha Israa'iil ee lagu haysto Qasa. Laakiin Israa'iil ma muujin wax ifafaalo ah oo ay ku sii daynayso. Bartimihii Agoosto, waxaa soo baxay muuqaal muujinaya Barghouti oo 66 jir ah oo taag daran oo uu ku jeesjeesay wasiirka amniga ee Israa'iil, Itamar Ben Gvir. Waxay ahayd markii ugu horreysay ee Barghouti uu kasoo muuqdo fagaare muddo sanado ah. Falastiin waxaa hadda aqoonsan 75 boqolkiiba 193-ka waddan ee xubnaha ka ah Qaramada Midoobay. Waa waddan ay Qaramada Midoobay u siisay magaca " goobjooge joogta ah"; waa la ogol yahay in uu ka qaybqaato laakiin xaq uma laha in uu codeeyo. UK iyo Fransiiska (koox ay ku jiraan Canada, Australia, Belgium iyo Malta ayaa ballan ku qaaday inay Falastiin u aqoonsadaan golaha guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, Falastiin waxay dhawaan heli doontaa taageerada afar ka mid ah shanta xubnood ee joogtada ah ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Shiinaha iyo Ruushka ayaa aqoonsaday Falastiin 1988-kii. Talaabadan ayaa siin doonta Maraykanka oo ah xulafada Israa'iil inay cod ku yeeshaan golaha laga tirada badan yahay. Washington ayaa aqoonsatay maamulka Falastiin, oo uu hadda hogaamiyo Maxamuud Cabaas, tan iyo markii la aasaasay bartamihii sagaashamaadkii. Tan iyo markaas, madaxweynayaal dhowr ah ayaa taageero u muujiyay in ugu dambeyntii la dhiso dowlad Falastiin ah. Laakiin Donald Trump ka mid ma aha. Intii lagu jiray labadii xilli ee uu xafiiska joogay, siyaasadda Maraykanku waxay si weyn u miisaantay oo u janjeersatay taageerada Israel.

Atooreyaashii dhintay iyagoo jilaya filimadoodii ugu dambeeyay , Hindustan Times Jilayaal isugu jira rag iyo dumar oo ka tirsanaa shirkadda filimada Hindiga ee Bollywood-ka ayaa geeriyooday iyagoo bartanka uga jira shaqada filimo ay soo wadeen ama aan wali lasii deynin filimadii ugu dambeeyay ee ay soo jileen. Marka ay atooreyaasha ama atariishooyinka dhintaan, taageerayaashooda ayaa aad ula murugooda geeridooda. Laakiin dhammaanteen waxaan mar walba xasuusnaannaa jilayaasha bandhigyada wanaagsan sameyn jiray, horayna aan uga heli jirnay habka ay noo madadaaliyaan. Hase yeeshee mararka qaar waxaa dhacda in jilayaasha qaarkood aysan nasiib u yeelanin inay goob joog ka noqdaan natiijada ka soo baxeysa shaqadii ugu dambeysay ee ay qabteen. Qormadan waxaan kusoo qaadaneynaa liiska jilayaashaii geeriyooday iyagoo aan daawanin filimadoodii ugu dmabeeyay. Sawirka, Sushant Singh Rajput wuxuu geeriyooday 14-kii bishii June ee sannadkan 2020-ka. Jilaagan, oo ka mid ahaa atooreyaasha ugu caansan ee sannadihii dambe soo baxay, ayaa isdilay. Soo saareyaasha filimkiisii ugu dambeeyay, ee lagu magacaaby Dil Bechara, ayaa go'aansaday inay kasoo soo daayaan shirkadda OTT. Filimkan, oo si weyn loo sugayo ayaa 24-ka bishan July la shaacin doonaa, qof walbana waxaa xilligaas u suurtageleysa inuu daawado. Balse Sushant dabcan nasiib uma uusan yeelanin inuu ku raaxeysto bandhiggiisii ugu dambeeyay. Rishi Kapoor wuxuu geeriyooday 30-kii bishii April ee sanadkan. Dhimashadiisa waxay timid wax yar ka hor inta aan dunida badabkeed la galinin xayiraadda looga hortagayo cudurka safmarka ah ee Covid-19. Jilaagan wuxuu xilliga uu dhimanayay jilayay filim lagu magacaabo Sharmaji Namkeen, kaasoo ay la sameyneysay atariishada caanka ah ee la yiraahdo Juhi Chawla. Wax yar ayaa uga dhimanaa dhammeystirka duubitaanka, laakiin soo saareyaasha ayaa go'aansaday inay filimka gabagabeeyaan Rishi la'aantiis, ayna sii daayaan. Waxay sidoo kale go'aansadeen inay filimkaas ka daaraan tiyaatarradooda, si ay atooraha rugcaddaaga ah ugu maamuusaan. Juhi Chawla ayaa dabayaaqadii sanadkii lasoo dhaafay barteeda twittwrka soo dhigtay sawirro iyo qoraal ay ugu duceyneyso inuu filimkaas guuleysto. Macluumaadkan waxaa daabacay X. Waxaan dalbanayenaa fasaxaaga ka hor inta aan la furin, waxaa laga yaabaa inay isticmaalayaan cookies iyo farsamooyin kale. hadii aad u bahato akhri X xeerarka cokie iyo kan ku saabsan xogta gaarka ah ka hor inta aadan aqbalin. si aad u aragto xogta guji ‘aqbal oo soco’. Rishi Kapoor wuxuu shaleemooyinka filimada lagu daawado qabsaday sanadkii 1973-kii, markaasoo uu doorkiisii ugu horreeyay oo hoggaamin ah uu ka qaatay filim ka hadlayay qiso jacayl oo dhalinyaro dhex martay. Laakiin markii ugu horreysay Rishi Kapoor wuxuu jilista filimada kasoo muuqday isagoo carruur ah sanadkii 1970-kii, wuxuuna ka qeyb qaatay filimkii uu aabihiis Raj Kapoor jilayay ee Mera Naam Joker. Qaar ka mid ah filimadiisii sida weyn loo daawaday waxay soo baxeey 1980-meyadii iyo 1990-meeyadii - waxaana ka mid ahaa Khel Khel Mein, Karz iyo Chandni - oo aad u gadmay. Kapoor wuxuu filim laga dabadhacay oo jacayl ahaa la sameeyay atariishada lagu magacaabo Neetu Singh. Lamaahanan ayaa jacaylkooda aan ku ekeynin jilitaan kaliya, waxayna is guursadeen sanadkii 1980-kii. Wiilkooda Ranbir Kapoor, wuxuu hadda ka mid yahay jilayaasha ugu caansan shirkadda Bollywood-ka, taageerada weynna heysta. Sawirka, NBCUniversal 29-kii bishii April ee sanadkan 2020-ka ayuu Irrfan Khan u geeriyooday nooc dhif ah oo ka mid ah cudurka kansarka, isagoo 53 jir ahaa. Jilaagan waxaa dunida oo dhan laga bartay markii uu kasoo muuqday, xirfad cajiib ahna kusoo bandhigay filimkii lagu magacaabay Slumdog Millionaire. Khan wuxuu caan ku ahaa jilliinkiisa aan caadiga ahayn iyo fahamka, iyadoo dad badan ay u garanayaan mid ka mid ah jilaayada ugu xirfadda fiicnaa Hindiya. Inkastoo uu filimo badan soo jilay, dad badan waxay u maleeyaan in filimkiisii ugu dambeeyay uu ahaa Angrezi Medium. Laakiin waxaa jira filim kale oo atoorahan uu soo jilay, balse aan wali lasii deynin. Filimkaas waxaa lagu magacaabaa Apno Se Bewafai, wuxuuna duubay ka hor inta aysan xaaladdiisa caafimaad aad uga sii darin. Balse xayiraadda coronavirus awgeed dib ayaa loo dhigay daawashadiisa. Sawirka, AFP/Sridevi, oo ka mid ahayd atariishooyinka jilitaanka looga daydo ee Hindiya waxay magaalada Dubai ku geeriyootay 24-kii bishii April ee sanadkii 2018-kii, xilligaas oo ay da'deeda ahayd 54 sano. Filimkii ugu dambeeyay ee ay atariishada hoggaanka ah ka ahayd waxaa lagu magacaabaa MOM, wuxuuna soo baxay sanadkii 2017-kii. Laakiin markii ay geeriyootay kaddib, waxaa shaleemooyinka kasoo muuqday filim kale oo ay qeybo ka jishay, oo lagu magacaabo Zero. Om Puri, oo wadne xanuun u geeriyooday, waxaa filimadiisii loogu jeclaa ka mid ah: Ardh Satya, Sadgati, Paar iyo the satirical Jaane Bhi Do Yaaro. Atoorahan rugcaddaaga ah wuxuu dhintay isagoo 79 jir ah, base xilligii uu dhalinyarada ahaa ayuu heer wanaagsan soo gaarsiiyay filimada Bollywood-ka. Filimkiisii ugu dambeeyay wuxuu ahaa Rockstar, oo la sii daayay bishii November ee sanadkii 2011-kii, markaasoo ahayd dhimashadiisii kaddib. Atooraha da'da yar ee Ranbir Kapoor ayaa kala qeyb qaatay filimkaas, dad badanna waxay aad ugu faraxsanaayeen inuu yeeshay nasiibka uu filim kula jilay nin magac weyn ku lahaa bollywood-ka muddo tobannaan sano ah.

Waa tuma Asma al-Assad, xaaska Bashaar al-Assad? Intii Bashaar al-Asad uu ahaa madaxweynaha Suuriya ku dhowaad ​​25-sano, Asma oo u dhalatay Ingiriiska ayaa ahayd xaaska kaliya oo uu qabay. Asma Akhras ayaa ku dhalatay Acton, galbeedka London, waxa ayna wax ku baratay iskuul gaar loo leeyahay, halkaas oo looga yeeri jiray "Emma". Waxa ay sii wadatay waxbarashadeeda iyadoona cilmiga kombuyuutarka ka baratay King's College oo ku yaalla London iyadoona ugu dambayn ku biirtay maalgashiga bangiga. Asad waxa ay kula kulantay London, xilligaas waxa uu ahaa dhakhtar aqoon u leh qalliinka indhaha. Asma ayaa u guurtay Suuriya sanadkii 2000, waxa ayna isla sanadkaas guursatay Assad bilo uun kadib markii uu madaxweyne noqday uuna xilka kala wareegay aabbihiis Xafiz al-Assad. Waxa ay isku dhaleen saddex carruur ah oo kala ah labo wiil iyo gabar, kuwaas oo dhammaantood hadda ah dad waaweyn. Ninkan 49-jirka ah ayaa marka uu talada qabtay lagu tilmaamay inuu yahay mid wax ka badalaya Suuriya, balse waxaa is baddashay aragtidaas tan iyo markii uu dalkaasi ka billowday dagaalladii sokeeye ee ba'naa bishii March 2011-kii. Muddo sanado ah, reer-galbeedka ayaa rajo ka qabay Asma oo ku kortay Ingiriiska inay dhiiri gelin karto dib u habeynta siyaasadda Suuriya, iyada oo xilligaas Suuriya laga howlgaliyay shirkad laga leeyahay Ingiriiska oo magaceeda loo soo gaabiyo PR, taas oo la rabay inay ka shaqayso sidii sumcad caalami ah loogu yeeli lahaa waddankaas. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Ilo xog ogaal ah ayaa BBC-da u sheegay sanadkii 2012-kii in Assad uu Asma u guursaday inay u kala shaqayso soo bandhigidda waji cusub oo casri ah oo loogu talagalay dalalka Bariga Dhexe. Istaraatiijiyadda suuq-geynta ayaa xoogaa horumar laga arkay. Bishii Febraayo 2011, majaladda US Vogue ayaa daabacday muuqaal qurux badan oo cinwaankiisu yahay " Rose in the Desert " oo micnaheedu yahay Ubax Saxaraha ku sugan. Maqaalkaas oo markii dambe laga saaray baraha lagu baahiyay ayaa ahaa mid lagu tilmaamay mid muujinaya "quruxlay dhuuban oo dheer taas oo leh tababar iyo maskax ku salaysan khiyaano," iyo sidoo kale "soo jiidasho aad u qurux badan". Suxufiyaddii qortay maqaalkaas, oo lagu magacaabayay Juliet Joan Buck, ayaa markii dambe muujisay sida ay uga xun tahay qoraalka, iyada oo sheegtay in ay "wax u dhintay" shaqadeedii ayna soo afjartay xiriirkeedii Vogue. Xilligaas waxaa dalkaas ka dhacay kacdoonno meelo badan ku faafay, balse Asad ayaa waxyar kadib xilligaas qaaday tallaabooyin uu ku burburinayo kacdoonka kaas oo lagu tilmaamay mid dimuquraadiyad inkasta oo markii ay sii daba dheeraadeen ay isku badaleen dagaal sokeeye oo aad u daran kaas oo ay ku dhinteen in ka badan nus milyan qof, halka 12 milyan oo kalena lagu qasbay inay guryahooda ka carareen. Sanad kadib bishii Febraayo 2012, ayay Asma ka hadashay dagaalka iyadoona bixisay faalladeedii ugu horraysay oo ay fagaare ka jeedisay waxa ayna xilligaas sheegtay inay u qalbi qaboojinayso dhibbanayaasha rabshadaha ku waxyeeloobay. War qoraal ah oo lagu daabacay wargeyska The Times ee ka soo baxa dalka Ingiriiska ayay mar kale ku celisay taageerada ay u hayso ninkeeda, waxaanay tiri: "Madaxweynuhu waa madaxweynaha Suuriya ee maaha koox Suuriyaan ah, marwada koowaadna waxay ku taageertaa doorkaas". Isla sanadkaas Asma waxaa sumcaddeeda ku dhacday dharbaaxo kale kadib markii dhaqdhaqaaqayaasha ay sii daayeen kumannaan iimeylo gaar ah oo eedayn ah oo ay ku sheegeen inay jeceshahay alaabaha raaxada. Iimeyladaas oo uu markii ugu horreysay daaha ka qaaday wargeyska The Guardian ee ka soo baxa Ingiriiska, ayaa u muuqday inay muujinayeen Asma oo ku baaraysay $5,000 (£3,200) kabo dhaadheer oo cabirkoodu dhan yahay 16cm, iyadoo xilligaas waddanku wajahayo xasillooni darro isa soo taraysa. Wasaaradda arimaha dibadda Maraykanka oo sanadkii 2022 samaysay qiyaas hantida qoyska Assad ayaa ku tilmaamtay inay u dhaxayso $1-$2bn. Midowga Yurub ayaa cunaqabatayn ku soo rogay Asma bishii March sanadkii 2012. Muddo ma aysan la hadlin warbaahinta balse sanadkii 2016 ayay la hadashay telefishin lagu magacaabo Rossiya 24 oo uu taageero Ruushka, waxa ayna xilligaas sheegtay inay heshay dalabyo ah inay isaga baxdo Suuriya, waxa ayna sheegtay inay diidday, ma aysan sheegin halka ay ka yimaadeen dalabyadaas. "Waxaan halkan joogay tan iyo bilowgii, weligayna kuma fikirin inaan meel kale aado," ayay tiri. "Haa, waxaa la ii soo bandhigay fursad aan uga tago Suuriya ama aan uga cararo Suuriya. Waxyaabahaas waxaa ka mid ahaa dammaanad-qaadka badbaadada iyo ilaalinta carruurtayda iyo xitaa ammaanka dhaqaale. Uma baahnid caqli gal ah in la ogaado waxa ay dadkani dhab ahaantii ahaayeen. Waxay ahayd isku day ula kac ah oo lagu doonayay in lagu burburiyo kalsoonida ay dadku ku qabaan madaxweynahooda." Markii uu dagaalku sii socday, Asma waxay hoggaamisay dadaallada samafalka, waxay la kulantay qoysaskii askarta la dilay, waxayna madax ka noqotay "Syria Trust for Development," oo ah urur weyn oo aan dawli ahayn oo xiriiriya hawlaha gargaarka. Sannadkii 2018, waxaa laga helay kansarka naasaha waxaana laga daweeyey buro halis ah oo marxalad hore ahayd. Sannad ka dib, waxay si cad ugu dhawaaqday inay si buuxda u bogsatay. Bishii Maajo 2024, Madaxtooyada Suuriya ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in Asma laga helay kansarka dhiigga. Bayaan ay soo saartay ayaa lagu sheegay in ay bilaabi doonto hab maamuuska daawaynta gaarka ah oo u baahan in ay go'doomiso oo ay dib uga noqoto hawlgelinta dadweynaha. Ku dhawaad ​​25 sano oo ay haysay xilka Marwada Koowaad ayuu si lama filaan ah u soo idlaaday Axaddii markii Assad la afgambiyay kadib markii ay xoogagga fallaagada qabsadeen caasimadda dalkaas ee Dimishiq. Qoyska Asad waxay hadda ku sugan yihiin Ruushka oo ah xulafada muhiimka ah ee taliskii hore, halkaas oo ay ka heleen magangalyo siyaasadeed, sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta dowladda Ruushka.

Somaliland oo BBC-da u faahfaahisay socdaalka Madaxweyne Cirro ee Qadar You’re viewing a that uses less data. including all images and videos. Wafti uu hoggaaminayo madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Iskeed ugu Dhawaaqday Madaxbannaanida ee Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro ayaa maalmihii la soo dhaafay booqasho ku joogay dalka Qadar, halkaasi oo ay kula kulmeen mas'uuliyiin ka mid ah dawladda Qadar oo uu ku jiro Ra'iisul Wasaaraha ahna Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Qadar, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Bin Jasim Al-Thani. Socdaalkan ayaa waxa uu noqonaya kii ugu horreeyay ee madaxweyne Somaliland ahi uu ku tago dalka Qadar. Wasiirka madaxtooyada Somaliland Khadar Xuseen Cabdi ayaa BBC-da uga warramay socdaalka madaxweynaha oo uu sheegay mid ay uga gol lahaayeen raadinat iskaashi dhaqaale oo ay Somaliland la samaysato dalka Carbeed ee Qadar. "Ujeeddada socdaalkaygu waxay qayb ka ahayd safrro uu madaxweyuhu muddooyinkii la soo dhaafay ku tagayay dalal dhowr ah. Tan ugu weyni waxa ay ahayd sidii ay Somaliland iskaashi ula yeelan lahayd waddamada adduunka. Hore waxa aanu u tagnay Imaaraadka Carabta, Jabuuti iyo Kenya," ayaa uu yidhi. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in mas'uuliyiinta ay la kulmeen oo ay ka mid yihiin raysalwsaaraha dalkaas, wasiiru-dawlada arrimaha dibadda iyo wasiirka ganacsiga ay kala hadleen iskaashi dhaqaale oo ay la samaysteen Somaliland. "Waxaanu caalamka u sheegnay in Somaliland anay ahayn dal gamo madhan oo baahan. Bal se ay leedahya fursado waaweyn oo la maalgashan karo, gaar ahaan dhinacyada xoolaha, beeraha iyo kalluunka. Qadar-na taas ayaan kala hadalnay isfanna waanu ka gaadhnay. Waxana rajynaynaa in ay Somalialand waftiyo ka socda Qadar yimaadddaan si ay u darsaan." Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed ka soo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibedda ee Qatar, waxa uu Ra'iisul Wasaaraha ahna Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Qatar Sheekh Maxamed bin Cabdiraxmaan bin Jassim Al Thani, xaqiijiyey kulanka uu la yeeshay madaxweynaha Somaliland. "Intii kulanku socday, waxaa la is dhaafsaday aragtiyo ku saabsan xaaladaha cusub ee ka taagan Soomaaliya, muhiimadda ay leedahay taageeridda dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo nabadda iyo xasilloonida, iyo sidoo kale siyaabaha kala duwan ee lagu xoojin karo kalsooni-dhiska dhinacyada kala duwan." ayaa lagu yidhi War-saxaafadeed ay ku baahiyeen boggooda arrimaha dibedda. Wasiirka madaxtooyada Somaliland ayaan sidoo kale waxa ka weyddiinay wararka sheegaya in labada dhinac ay isla soo qaadeen xaaladaha amni iyo tan siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. "Soomaaliya isku gobol ayaanu ku naallaa. Sidaas darteed, si guud gobolka xasilloonidiiisa waanu ka wada hadalnay. Waxaa kale oo aannu isla soo qaadnay iskaashiga dhaqaalaha ee gobolka iyo sidii looga wada faa'iidaysan lahaa," ayaa uu yidhi wasiirka madaxtooyada Somaliland. War-saxaafadeedka ka soo baxay dawladda Qatar ayaa lagu yidhi "Ra'iisul Wasaaraha iyo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Qatar waxa uu intii kulankan uu socday caddeeyey in Dawladda Qatar ay aamisan tahay in mustaqbalka Soomaaliya uu ku xidhan yahay furfurnaanta iyo wada-shaqeynta dhaxalgalka ah ee u dhaxeysa dhammaan qaybaha bulshada Soomaaliyeed, taasoo lagu xaqiijinayo ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada qaranka ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya". Axmed Zaki Faarax Iidle oo ah falanqeeye siyaasaddeed oo la hadlay BBC-da ayaa tilmaamay in kala duwanaanta qaabka ay Somaliland iyo Qatar uga hadleen kulankankan uu muujiyey in labada dhinac ay qolo walba cid gaar ah farriin u diraysay. "Waxaad mooddaa marka aad akhrido War-saxaafadeedka Qatar in luuqadda ay ku hadlaysay ay muujinaysay in aanay waxba iska beddelin mowqifkeedii ay Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya kula macaamilaysay, halka Somaliland ay qoraal ku soo saartay Af-Soomaali oo ay dadkeeda kula hadashay luuqadda siyaasadda gudaha oo ay u sheegayaan in ay kala hadlayaan Qatar danaha Somaliland, markaa waxa muuqata in aanay jirin hal qodob oo labada war-saxaafadeed mideeya". Axmed Zaki Faarax Iidle, waxa uu xusay inuu aamisan tahay in ay jiri karaan waxyaabo laga wada hadlay oo labada dhinac midna aanu ku soo bandhin qoraallada ay soo kala saareen, waxaanu yidhi "Waxa dhici karta aragtiyada in laga wada hadlay qodobkii Madaxweyne Trump ka hadlay ee aan weli soo shaac bixin ee la xidhiidhay sidii Falasiiniyiinta Gaza loo soo rari karo, Somaliland-na loogu beddeli lahaa aqoonsi ay dawladda Mareykanku aqoonsato" ayuu sii raaciyey. Wasiirka madaxtooyada Somaliland, Khadar Xuseen Cabdi oo BBC-du weyddiisay sida uu u arko warsaxaafadeedka ka soo baxay dhinaca Qatar ayaa ku jawaabay in dal walba uu xaq u leeyahay waxa warsaxaafadeedkiisa gaarka ah, laakiin dhinacooda ay u arkayaan in ay guul ka gaadheen ujeeddada ay u tageen dalka Qatar. "Waddamadu iyaga ayaa garanaya waxa ay odhanayaan. Qadar iyo dalalka kalaba waxa ay ka siman yihiin in aanay aqoonsanayn Somaliland. Waana arrin hubaal ah in aanay Somaliland aqoonsi haysan. Laakiin waxa weyn oo dhib ahi kuma jirto warsaxaafadeedka waddanku soo saarayo. Nuxurka waa ujeeddada iyo waxa laga wada hadlay. Guul ayaanan ka gaadhnay."

Maxay ka dhignayd macsalaamayntii Maxamed Saalax ee taageerayaasha Liverpool iyadoo wali su'aalo dul hoganayaan , Mohamed Salah ayaa sameeyey wax kasta waqtigii ciyaarta kadib guushii 2–0 ee Liverpool ka gaartay Brighton kulan ka tirsanaa Premier League, isagoo sacab u tumayay dhammaan afarta dhinac ee garoonka Anfield, iyadoo taageerayaasha Liverpool ay qaadayeen heesta caanka ay ee "Boqorka Masar". Markii uu gaaray marinka ciyaartoydu ka baxaan , wuxuu ahaa ciyaaryahankii ugu dambeeyay ee garoonka jooga, wuxuuna sameeyay gacan-haadis yar oo uu u diray goob ay fadhiyeen qoyskiisu. Salah wuxuu maalmaha soo socda ku biiri doonaa xulka Masar ee Qaahira, iyagoo isu diyaarinaya Koobka Qaramada Afrika (AFCON) — balse fariinta ka dambeysay shirkii jaraa'id ee tababare Arne Slot kadib ciyaarta waxay ahayd mid cad. "Ma jiro wax dhibaato ah oo aan xallinayo," ayuu yiri Slot. "Aniga ahaan, hadda wuxuu la mid yahay ciyaaryahan kasta oo kale. Ma jiro wax aan ka hadlo wixii dhacay kadib kulankii Leeds." Hadalkiisii xanafta lahaa ee Elland Road Sabtidii hore — halkaas oo uu ku sheegay in kooxda ay "baska hoostiisa ku tuurtay" isla markaana uusan wax xiriir ah la lahayn tababarahiisa u dhashay Netherlands — Salah wuxuu sheegay in kulankan Brighton uu si weyn u noqon karo mid uu ku macasalaameeyo. Kadib markii laga reebay liiska ciyaartoyda kulankii Champions League ee toddobaadka ay Liverpool kaga adkaatay Inter Milan, Salah wuxuu kursiga keydka ku soo bilaamay ciyaartii Birgton, isagoo beddelay Joe Gomez oo dhaawacmay daqiiqaddii 26aad. Hadda, filashada guud waxay tahay in ciyaaryahanka 33-jirka ah uu bisha soo socota dib ugu soo laaban doono Liverpool kadib marka uu dhammeeyo waajibaadka xulka qaranka. Sida uu qabo Maxamed Axmed Deysane oo ah fallanqeeye arrimaha ciyaaraha ah ayaa qaba inuu isagoo sacabtumaya uu taageerayaasha afarta dhinac ee garoonka uu u jeensaday ay u muuqato mid tagaya "markii uu gacanta u taagayey tagerasha Liverpool waxaan u maleynaya in uu macsalamiinayey uusan ku soo noqonaynin Liverpool.hoos u dhaca ku yimid Mohamed Salah waxey tahay qaabka uu layimid tabaraha cusub ee Liverpool iyo ciyaartow badan oo weerar ah ayuu keynsaday" ayuu yiri Deysane. Wadahadallo ayaa weli la qorsheynayaa inay dhex maraan labada dhinac inta Salah maqanyahay, balse toddobaad kadib wareysigii qiiro leh ee Leeds, wuxuu Salah ku jiray farxad buuxda aagga saxaafadda ee Anfield, isagoo dhex marayay wariyeyaasha lana weydiiyay inuu wareysi bixiyo. "Laba toddobaad oo isku xiga miyaa? Maya, maya," ayuu Salah ku kaftamay. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Maxamed Salax iyo Liverpoolba ma ahayn sanad ciyaareed u wanaagsan marka la eego guuldarooyin ay la kulmeen iyadoo Salah ay ka muuqatay inuu la dhibaatoonayo inuu shabaqa gaaro iyo caawintii looga bartayba. Maxaa haddaba dhaliyey hoos u dhaca Salah, falanqeeye Maxamed Axmed Deysane, wuxuu qabaa in sababta ugu weyn ay tahay isbaddelka qaab ciyaareed ee uu la yimid tababaraha Liverpool. Si lamid ah Deysane fallanqeeyaha kale ee ciyaaraha Maxamed Cumar Baakaay, ayaa qaba in la tahay in la joogo waqtigii Salah macsalaamayn lahaa Liverpool. "Runtii Moh SALAX waaa Laacib magac weyn usoo jiiday dalalka Afrikanka Iyo Carabtaba Dhamantod, Waa sax In la joogo waqtigii uu ka tagi lahaa kooxda iyo UK. Kubada Cagta Ma Laha, LAACIB SANAD KASTA GAROMADA KA MUUQDA EE Waa HAADBA HAAD KICI" ayuu yiri Baakaay. Ma jirin dadaal uu Salah sameeyay si uu mar kale hadal u jeediyo ama si fagaare ah raalli-gelin u bixiyo, balse Slot wuxuu si cad u yiri "haa" markii la weydiiyay inuu doonayo weeraryahanka inuu kusoo laabto kooxda kadib Koobka Qaramada Afrika. Fahamka guudna wuxuu yahay in kulankoodii Jimcaha uu ahaa mid wanaagsan. Markii la weydiiyay haddii Salah doonayo inuu sii joogo, tababaraha Reds ayaa ku daray: "Taasi waxaan filayaa inaad horeyba u taqaan jawaabteeda. Wixii naga dhexeeyay annaga ayay naga dhex ahaanayaan. Wuxuu ku jiray liiska ciyaartoyda, wuxuuna ahaa beddelkaygii ugu horreeyay." Markii shanaad oo xiriir ah, Salah kuma jirin safka bilowga. Hase yeeshee, markii daafaca Gomez uu dhaawacmay, Slot wuxuu u jeestay kursiga keydka, wuxuuna garoonka soo geliyay ninka 250 gool u dhaliyay Liverpool siddeedii sano ee uu kooxda joogay. Salah ma uusan kordhin tiradiisa goolasha kulankaas, balse wuxuu caawin (assist) ka sameeyay goolkii labaad ee Hugo Ekitike daqiiqaddii 60aad. Falanqeeyayaasha kubada cagta ayaa in badan qaba in Salax u muuqdo mid galay waayihii ka biixtaanka horyaallada Yurub, haddaba halkee laga yaaba inuu aadi karo Salah hadduu ka tagao Liverpool. Maxamed Axmed Deysane, wuxuu qabaa in laga yaabo inuu u dhaqaaqi doono horyaaalka Sacuudiga waa haddii uu ka tago Livaerpool. Salah ayaa kaalin sare ku lahaa koobab badan oo kooxda Liverpool ku guulaysatay muddadii uu joogay.

Gabdhihii Chibok oo 10 sano kadib weli la la'yahay Bishii April 2014, magaalada waqooyi-bari Nigeria ku taalla ee Chibok ayaa dunida caan ka noqotay kadib markii la afudubtay 276 gabdho iskuulley ah isla markaana baraha bulshada aad loogu ololeeyay in gabdhahaas lasoo celiyo. Toban sano kadib, khatarta kooxaha rabshadda wada ayaa weli saameyn ku leh nolosha dad badan oo magaalada ku nool. Iyadoo ilmada iska tireysa, Esther Yakubu ayaa dib u goconeysa sida noloshu u adag tahay iyadoo aysan la joogin gabadheeda Dorcas. ''Waxaa laga joogaa 10 sano tan iyo inta gabadheyda ay afduubka u heystaan Boko Haram. Weligeed xaaladdu ma fududaan. Dadka waxay dhahaan iska illow, maaddaama aan heysto carruur kale, balse marka aan keli ahay, waan ka fekeraa.'' Aragtida alaabta Dorcas ee guriga ayaa si joogto ah usoo celisa xusuuso xanuun badan umana saamaxdo inay tiiraanyadu ka ba'do. Esther ayaa go'aansatay inay alaabtaas iska tuurto, marka laga reebo sawirro dhowr ah. ''Dhammaan alaabteeda waxaan siiyay dad ku nool meel ka baxsan Chibok si aysan agteyda u oollin. Ma aan dooneyn uun inaan arko.'' Habeenkii 14 April 2014, kooxda Islaamiga ah ee Boko Haram ayaa 76 gabdho iskuulley ah ka afduubtay iskuul xannaano oo ku yaallay magaaladan oo aan markaa sidaa loo aqoon. Afduubka ayaa sababay olole caalami ah oo baraha bulshada laga bilaabay waxaana ololahan ka qeyb qaatay marwadii koowaad ee hore ee Mareykanka Michelle Obama, iyo gabadha abaalmarinta caalamiga ah ee nabadda ee Nobel heysata Malala Yusufzai, iyo dad kaloo caan ah. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Toban sano kadib, gabdho badan ayaa ama laoso badbaadiyay amaba ay u suurto gashay inay baxsadaan. Si kastaba, 87 ka mid ah 276-gabdho ayaa weli afdub loo heystaa. Dorcas waxay ka mid tahay kuwaas la la'yahay waxayna keliya jirtay 16 sano xilligii la afduubanayay. Hooyadeed Esther, hubanti la'aanta xaaladda gabadheeda ayaa u suurto gelin waayay inay illowdo. ''Waxaan ka doonayaa dowladda inay gabdhaheenna xoreyso ayna gurigooda kusoo laabtaan. Waxaan dooneynaa inaan nolol ku aragno si aan ugu yaraan u faraxno. Kuwaan nooleynna, aan ogaanno si aan uga samirno.'' Esther wax war rasmi ah kama helin halka gabadheeda lagu hayo, balse waxay kasoo muuqatay muuqaal lagu caddeynayay inay nool yihiin oo ay kooxdu sii deysay sanadkii 2016. Muuqaalkaas, Dorcas ayaa isku magacowday Maida, oo ah mid cusub oo ay kooxdu u bixiyeen. ''Haddii ay Dorcas i maqli lahayd hadda, waxaan u sheegi lahaa inaan noolahay magaalada Chibok-na ay weli jirto, si ay u gasho xamaasadda inay usoo laabato aragtideenna.'' , In sheekadan laga soo tebiyo meel miyi ah oo ka tirsan waqooyi-bari Nigeria qudheeda waa safar dheer oo raf ah. Waddada Chibok waxay ka bilaabaneysaa gobolka deriska la ah ee Adamawa. Waa safar dheer oo la marayo dhul qallalan oo bannaan. Waxaan sii marnay birta telecom oo jabtay. Qofkii na hagayay ayaa inoo sheegay in looga shakisan yahay in Boko Haram ay soo rideen si ay qalqal u geliyaan isgaarsiinta. Kooxda ayaa weli saameyn ku leh magaalada. Waxaan sii marnay dhowr bar-kontarool militari kahor inta aynaan gaarin halkaan u soconnay. Chibok qudheeda waa magaalo ay militari badan joogaan. Ciidamada ayaa labo bar-kontarool dheeraad ah ka sameeyay iyo sidoo kalena bandow adag oo habeenkii ah. Caasimadda Abuja waxaan kula kulannay Senator Muhammad Ali Ndume oo ah xildhibaan kaoso jeeda gobolka Borno, oo Chibok ay ka tirsan tahay, wuxuuna xubin ka yahay xisbiga APC. ''Dowladda ayaa wax ka qabaneysa wayna ka walaacsna tahay," ayuu yiri. "Waxaan ka codsan doonaa waaliddiinta inay dulqaadka sii wadaan iyo ducada inay gabdhahooda soo laaban doonaan.'' Wuxuu sheegay in bixinta madax-furasho uu dhiibay maamulkii hore, markii in ka badan 100 gabdho reer Chibok ah la sii daayay kadib wada-hadal lala galay, ay xaaladda kasii dartay. ''Ilaah unbaa garanaya inta lacag la bixiyay. Waxaan u maleynayaa markaas bay dadku aamineen haddii aad qof kaxaysato, waxada heleysaa lacag badan. ''Taasi waxay ahayd khalad albaabka u furay sida ay xaaladda maanta tahay.''

Macbad ay Yuhuud leeyihiin oo ay dad Muslimiin ah daryeelaan Macbad ay Yuhuuda ku lahaan jireen gobolka Kolkata ee dalka Hindiya ayay muddo dheer daryeelkiisa iyo dayactirkiisa gacanta ku hayaan dad Muslimiin ah, kuwaas oo fac ka fac sidaas soo samayn jiray. Macbadkan oo lagu magacaabo Jerusalem of the East (Qudustii Bari), waa midka ugu da'da weyn ee ku yaalla gobolka Kolkata ee dalka Hindiya, halkaas oo ay mar degenaan jireen dad badan oo Yuhuud ah. Laakiin dadka ka shaqeeya xanaanada macbadkan iyo nadaafaddiisa ma aha Yuhuud, waa dad Muslimiin ah, kuwaas darisnimo iyo aqoon dheer uu kala dhaxeeyo qoowmiyadda Yuhuuda ee magaaladaas. AM Cohen oo ah agaasimaha guud ee bulshada Yuhuudda ee gobolka Kolkata ayaa sheegtay in muddo badan ay dadka Muslimiinta ah ka shaqeynayeen xannaanada macbadka oo hadda ah kan kaliya ee soo haray kadib markii dadkii Yuhuuda ay ka guureen dalka Hindiya, una laabteen dalka Israa'iil oo la asaasay sannadkii 1948-dii. "Muslimiinta halkan ku nool ayaa gacanta ku hayay macbadka muddo aad u dheer, way nala soo koreen waxayna qeyb ka yihiin bulshada Yuhuuda ah ee ku sugan gobolka Kolkata", ayey tidhi. Sheekh Washim oo ka mid ah dadka magaaladan degan ayaa yiri "Maadaama aan bani'aadam nahay wax dhib ah uma aragno howshan, waxaan xannaaneyn karnaa macbadka Yuhuudda". Siraj Khan oo ka mid ah muslimiinta Macbadkaas xannaaneysa ayaa sheegay in awoowihiis uu ka shaqayn jiray meeshan, kadibna uu aabihiisa ka dhaxlay, markii uu muddo 60 sano ah howshaas soo waday, isaguna uu ku soo biiray ka hor inta uusan aabihiis howlgabka noqonin. Sannadkii 1798-kii ayuu nin lagu magacaabi jiray Shalom B. Obadiah noqday qofkii ugu horreeyay ee Yuhuudi ah oo tagay gobolka Kolkata, isagoo halkaas ku tagay safar ganacsi. Ka dib markii uu dhammaaday dagaalkii 2-aad ee dunida, magaalada Kolkata waxay hoy u ahay dad gaaraya 5,000 oo yuhuud ah. Dadkaas qaarkood waxay kasoo qaxeen waddamada Suuriya, Ciraaq iyo Iiraan, waxaana loo yaqaannay Yuhuudda Baqdaadiyiinta ah(Baghdadi Jews). Markii ay Hindiya qaadatay xornimada iyo markii la aasaasay Israa'iil ayey dadkii Yuhuudda ahaa intooda badan ka qaxeen dalkaas, si ay u dhisaan dhulka Yuhuuda. Ian Zachariah oo ka mid ah mas'uuliyiinta yahuudda ee gobolkan ayaa sheegay in 1940-meeyadii ay halkaas ku yaalleen dhowr macbad oo buuxsami jiray xilliyada safaxa, laakiin hadda faaruq ah. "Waxaa jiray 3 macbad oo waaweyn iyo 2 yaryar, Maanta sida aad aragtaan dhammaantood wa ebar cid joogtana ma laha", ayuu yidhi.

Khatarta ka dhalan karta dagaal dhex mara Itoobiya Ereteriya Waxaa sii kordhaya cabsi laga qabo in Ethiopia iyo Eritrea ay dagaal galaan. Hoggaamiyeyaasha sare ee labada dal ayaa muddo dheer is-eedeynayay. Dhawaan, dowladda Ethiopia ayaa warqad cabasho ah u qortay Qaramada Midoobay , iyagoo ku andacoonaya in Eritrea ay qorsheyneyso inay dagaal ku qaaddo Ethiopia iyada oo kaashaneysa TPLF. Mar kale Ethiopia ayaa Eritrea ku eedaysay inay samaysay xoog ciidan ah oo lagu magacaabo "Tsimdo", si ay ugu midoobaan qorshe lagu dhex maleegayo Ethiopia. Xiisadda labada dal ayaa si weyn u kacday, gaar ahaan kadib markii Ethiopia si cad u sheegtay in ay xaq u leedahay in ay hesho marin badeed. Mas'uuliyiinta Itoobiya, oo uu ku jiro Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed, ayaa sheegay in guuldarrada Ethiopia ee ku aaddan helitaanka marin badeed oo ku xidhma Badda Cas ay ahayd "khalad la galay 30 sano ka hor." Isagoo ka hadlayay munaasabadda daahfurka buuggiisa cusub ee lagu magacaabo "Medemer State' Abiy ayaa yidhi: "Waxaan hubaa inaan u bixi doonno dhinaca Badda Cas." Xaaladdan, dad badan ayaa walaac ka muujiyay in labada dal ay markale dagaallamaan. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Haddii Ethiopia iyo Eritrea ay dagaallamaan, maxay yihiin khataraha labada dal soo wajihi kara? Intee ayey u diyaarsan yihiin dagaal kale, iyagoo dhowaan ka qaybgalay dagaalkii waqooyiga Itoobiya? Ma u diyaarsan yihiin khasaaraha dhaqaale, mid diblomaasiyadeed, iyo kan kheyraadka bini'aadamka? Waxaan BBC-du weydiisay falanqeeyayaal arrintan. Dagaalku ma aha wax cusub oo ku saabsan Ethiopia iyo Eritrea. Dhowr sano uun kadib markii Eritrea ay ku dhawaaqday madaxbannaani ka dhan ah Itoobiya, labada dal waxay galeen dagaal socday laba sano, kaas oo lagu soo afjaray Heshiiskii Algiers. Inkastoo dagaalka la joojiyay, haddana labada dal waxay ahaayeen kuwo xidhiidhkoodu xumaa in ka badan 20 sano, iyagoo aan wax xidhiidh diblomaasiyadeed ah samayn. Kadib markii Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed uu xilka qabtay sanadkii 2018, hoggaamiyeyaasha labada dal waxay ku dhawaaqeen nabad. Abiy ayaa marka hore booqday Asmara, kadibna Madaxweyne Isayas Afewerki ayaa booqday Finfinnee (Addis Ababa). Xadka ayaa la furay, xidhiidh diblomaasiyadeedna waa la sameeyay. Balse sanadkii 2020, Eritrea ayaa ku biirtay dagaalkii u dhexeeyay dowladda Itoobiya iyo TPLF ee waqooyiga Itoobiya, iyadoo ka caawisay dowladda Itoobiya dagaalka lagula jiray ciidamada Tigray. Dagaalkii socday laba sano ee sababay dhimashada kumannaan qof ayaa lagu soo afjaray Heshiiskii Pretoria. Kadib heshiiskaas, xidhiidhka u dhexeeya Itoobiya iyo Eritrea ayaa daciifay, ugu dambeyntiina wuxuu isu beddelay xiisad. Ethiopia ayaa sii hurisay xiisaddaas hore u jirtay, kadib markii ay si cad u soo bandhigtay sheegashada ku saabsan "xaqa ay u leedahay inay hesho marin badeed oo ku xidhma Badda Cas." Markii Eritrea ay ka go'day Ethiopia si ay u noqoto dal madaxbannaan — 30 sano ka dib burburkii xukunkii Dargiga — waxay la wareegtay dekedaha sida Asab iyo Mitsiwa. Goosashadii Eritrea waxay Itoobiya kaga tagtay iyadoo aan lahayn deked iyo ciidamo badeed, taas oo ka dhigtay dal aan bad lahayn (landlocked country). Markii Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed uu xukunka la wareegay, wuxuu dib u aas-aasay ciidankii badda ee Itoobiya oo aan jirin sannado badan. Wuxuuna sheegay in ay "aanay caddaalad ahayn" in Itoobiya — oo leh dad ka badan 120 milyan — aysan lahayn deked badeed oo wax ka yar 100 km u jirta dekedda Asab. Intii lagu jiray khudbaddiisii furitaanka biyo xireenka GERD, Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed wuxuu sheegay in Itoobiya ay "dariiq u samayn doonto" inay gaadho Badda Cas, balse uu "mudnaanta siin doono wadahadalka." Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed wuxuu ugu baaqay cid kasta oo diyaar u ah wadahadal inay isu diyaariso: "Helitaanka Itoobiya ee badda waa wax aan laga maarmi karin." Mid ka mid ah siyaabaha ay Itoobiya ku gaadhi karto Badda Cas waa adeegsiga xoog ciidan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qareenka caalamiga ah iyo diblomaasigii hore ee Qaramada Midoobay, Bayisa Waqwayya, ayaa u sheegay BBC-da in ay jirto khatarta weyn haddii Itoobiya isku daydo in ay si ciidan ah ku tagto saldhigga Asab. Bayisa ayaa sheegay in Itoobiya aysan haysan sharci caalami ah oo taageeraya sheegashadeeda ah in ay xaq u leedahay dekedda Asab. "Ma rumaysni in dowladda Itoobiya ay doonayso in ay dal kale ku duusho. Asab waa dhul Eritrea leedahay," ayuu yidhi, isaga oo intaas ku daray in aysan jirin sharci caalami ah oo Itoobiya taageeraya. Wuxuu sii raaciyay: "Haddii aad tiraahdo waxaan awood u leeyahay inaan dhul tago oo aan ku daro dalkayga, taas waa mamnuuc [sida uu qabo sharciga caalamiga ah] waana dembi." Bayisa ayaa intaas ku daray "Ma rumaysni in dowladda Itoobiya ay dhab ahaantii ku dhiirranayso duullaanka Eritrea, waayo dagaalku wuxuu khatar weyn u keeni karaalabada dal." Jeneraal hore Yohannes Gabremasqel, oo hore uga tirsanaa saraakiisha sare ee ciidamada Itoobiya islamarkaana ka dagaallamay dagaalkii Itoobiya iyo Eritrea, ayaa isna sheegay in dagaal kasta uu khatar yahay, balse haddii mid cusub dhaco, uusan socon doonin muddo dheer sida kii hore. Jeneraal Yohannes ayaa sheegay in 25 sano ka hor, dareenka laga qabay ciidamada Itoobiya iyo Eritrea uu ahaa in "ciidanka Eritrea loo arko kuwo aad u xooggan," taas oo ka dhalatay dhibaatooyin gudaha Itoobiya ka jiray, balse hadda xaaladdu ay si buuxda u beddeshay. Wuxuu yidhi: "Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inuusan dagaal dhicin, balse haddii uu dhaco, ma noqon doono mid la mid ah kii hore," isaga oo aaminsan inuusan jiri doonin dagaal dheer. Mr. Baker, si kastaba ha ahaatee, wuxuu qabaa aragti ka duwan tan Jeneraal Yohannes. Wuxuu tilmaamay in haddii dagaal dhex maro labada dal, uu noqon doono mid la isu adeegsado hub culus, oo aan la mid ahayn dagaalkii sokeeye, isla markaana uu keeni doono khasaaro dhaqaale iyo mid bani'aadanimo oo aad u baaxad weyn. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in Itoobiya tahay dal ku tiirsan dhaqaalaha, sidaas darteedna khasaaraha dhaqaale uu si weyn u saameyn doono Itoobiya marka loo eego Eritrea. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in dagaalkii ka dhacay woqooyiga Itoobiya uu sababay burbur weyn oo dhaqaale, isla markaana dagaal u dhexeeya Itoobiya iyo Eritrea uu noqon doono mid aad khatar u ah oo labada dal gelinaya dhibaatooyin culus. Inkasta oo Heshiiskii Pretoria uu joojiyay dagaalkii woqooyiga Itoobiya, haddana dagaal kale ayaa ka qarxay gobolka Amxara, halkaas oo dagaal culus uu u dhexeeyo ciidamada dowladda iyo xoogagga WBO, dagaalkaas oo socday in ka badan shan sano.

Talooyin ku anfacaya Ramadaanka si aad u ilaaliso caafimaadkaaga , Khubarradayadu waxa ay soo bandhigeen faa’iidooyinka soonka bisha Ramadaan, iyaga oo soo jeedinaya talooyin ku saabsan sida looga fogaado madax xanuunka iyo dhibaatooyinka tabar yarida. Intaa waxaa dheer, helitaanka talooyin ku saleysan cunto caafimaad leh oo aad ku afurto. Inta lagu guda jiro bisha barakeysan ee Ramadaan, Muslimiin badan oo ku kala nool daafaha caalamka ayaa sooma saacadaha maalintii. Si aad u hubiso in aad wanaagsantahay adigoo aan maalin oo dhan waxba cunin ama cabin, waxaa muhiim ah in aad ka digtoonaato waxa aad isticmaaleyso xilliyada cuntada. Furaha suxuurta, cuntada ka hor waaberiga, waa inaad ku dhisto kaydka tamarta. Sidoo kale afurka ayey muhiim tahay in la ogaado cunnada uu caafimaadku kujiro iyadoo loo baahanyahay in waxyaabaha qaar laga fogaado. Sawirka, Soonka bisha Ramadaan wax khatar ah kuma laha dadka caafimaadka qaba, si kastaba ha ahaatee waxa ay dhibaato u keeni kartaa dadka qaba xaaladaha caafimaad. Maadaama soonku uu saameeyo heerka sonkorta iyo dhiigga, waxay si gaar ah khatar ugu tahay dadka qaba xanuunka macaanka. Tani waa sababta ay muhiim u tahay in Muslimiinta qaba xanuunkan ay muhiim u tahay in la tashadaan dhakhaatiirtooda kahor inta uusan Ramadaanku bilaaban. Dadka qaarkood waxaa laga yaabaa inay dareemaan daal, madax-xanuun iyo dawakhaad inta lagu jiro maalinta. Tani waxay badanaa dhacdaa marka qofka soomani uusan suxuuta u kicin. Naftaada oo aad ilaaliso Ramadaanka waxa ay sii caawisaa nafaqada iyo fuuq-celinta. Hurdadu waxa ay door muhiim ah ka ciyaartaa caafimaadka wanaagsan, waxa ayna si gaar ah muhiim u tahay inta lagu guda jiro bisha Ramadaan, maadaama hurdadaadu ay khalkhal gasho marka aad hurdada ka soo kacdo si aad wax u cunto ka hor inta aan qorraxdu soo bixin kadibna aad waqti kale soo jeeddo si aad u tukato. Isku day inaad sameystai jadwal Ramadaaneed bisha oo dhan ah kana fogow isticmaalka shaashadaha si aad waqti fiican oo jiif iyo nasiino ah u hesho. Kuwa sida caadiga ah cabba shaaha ama kafeega waxaa laga yaabaa inay la kulmaan madax xanuun iyo daal inta lagu jiro maalinta sababtoo ahla qabsigooda, laakiin tani badanaa waxay fududaataa usbuuc ka dib ama wax ka badan marka jirkaagu la qabsado Ramadaanka. Ugu dambayntii, waa muhiim inaad fiiro gaar ah u yeelato calaamadaha is bedel ee ku imaanaya jirkaaga si aad u sameyso xakameyn haddii uu miisaankaagu kordho ama si deg deg ah isku dhimo.Naso marka aad dareento daal, hana ku qasbin naftaada wax aysan xamili karin, gaar ahaan saacadaha soonka. Waxa kale oo wanaagsan in maskaxda lagu hayo in saacado badan la soomayo isla markaana loo baahanyahay in jirku uu helo biyo kufilan xilliga afurka iyo suxuurtaba, waa lagama maarmaan in la cabbo biyo badan habeenkii oo dhan. Khalad caadi ah oo ay dadku sameeyaan ayaa ah in qofku ka hurdo suxuurta si uu uga taxadaro in hurdadu aysan ka qasmin. Suxuur dheellitiran oo nafaqo leh ayaa kaa caawin doonta inaad iska ilaaliso hoos u dhaca tamarta, rabitaannada, dareenka iyo madax xanuun inta lagu jiro maalinta. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Marka la afurayo, marka aad afurto, waxa aad u baahan tahay in aad dib usoo celiso qoyaankii jirkaaga ka baxay. Habka ugu wanaagsan ee lagu afuraa waa timirta iyo biyaha ama caanaha, tanina waa habka ugu habboon ee lagu heli karo xoogaa sonkor dabiici ah, nafaqo iyo dareerena isku ah. Maraq ayaa aad looga jecel yahay afurka meelo badan oo ka mid ah dunida Muslimka, tani waa doorasho aad u wanaagsan maadaama aad u baahantahay dareere waliba nafaqo leh, waxaana ku jiri kara khudaar kala duwan, digir iyo raashinka qaybihiisa kala duwan. Cuntada afurka inta lagu guda jiro bisha Ramadaan waxay noqon kartaa dhacdo farxadeed, iyadoo dadku ay mararka qaar ku afuraan kulamo waaweyn oo ay la leeyihiin qoyska iyo asxaabta. Laakiin waxaa muhiim ah in la xasuusto in cunista xad dhaafka ah ama dufanka leh ay u badan tahay inay kugu reebi doonto daal iyo caajisnimo oo aanay faa'iido u yeelan doonin caafimaadkaaga ama dadaalkaaga ruuxiga ah, iyo sidoo kale in aad ka caajisto cibaadada sida salaadda taraawiixda.

Guidance: Charitable Appeals Since the 1920s and at the instigation of Lord Reith, the BBC has been offering charities the opportunity to broadcast appeals using BBC airtime. These now take the form of the Radio 4 Appeal which is weekly and the BBC One Lifeline Appeal which is monthly. There is an online application process with 4 open rounds each year. All applicants have to demonstrate UK or international scope and/or significance and provide information about their finances and governance. They must be able to explain how they will use the airtime, within the BBC Editorial Guidelines in particular on impartiality, to explain their work. All applications are sent for independent assessment and then also reviewed and recommended by the members of the BBC's Appeals Advisory Committee. Charities that are selected for broadcast appeals attend a BBC briefing and work with BBC producers to deliver the appeal. They are required to submit feedback forms and impact stories following the broadcast. Charities that have a successful appeal are eligible to reapply after 3 years. Charities making an unsuccessful application may reapply after 1 year. There are also up to 11 slots offered annually on BBC Radio Ulster/Foyle to local charities in Northern Ireland. It may be helpful to point charities to these broadcast appeals if asked how the BBC supports charities. More information about the application process is available from the BBC Charity Appeals Unit; the Charity Appeals Adviser for the Unit is Emma Kingsley via: In addition BBC local Radio stations and BBC Regions may wish to mount a specific BBC charity appeal for a project within their local area. All such proposals must be referred to the Appeals Adviser and Senior Adviser (charities) Editorial Policy . Approval will also be needed from Directors Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland or England and the BBC Appeals Advisory Committee. For contacts see above. Editorial Policy advice for those producing the broadcast content of the appeals on may be obtained from Senior Adviser, Editorial Policy, for contacts see the listed end of this guidance note. In addition at two points a year the BBC runs specific on air appeals seasons with BBC Children in Need and Comic Relief (see section 3. below) These are both 'grant givers' and therefore by supporting them the BBC audiences are in effect giving to a very large number of charities and projects with a wide geographical spread. The Disasters Emergency Committee or DEC is a membership organisation which represents 15 of the UK's humanitarian agencies. The relationship between the BBC and the DEC goes back over 50 years and there is an Memorandum of Understanding between the two organisations which sets out the 3 criteria for the BBC to launch on all its platforms, on behalf of the DEC, a disaster emergency appeal. When the DEC considers there is an emergency disaster that meets these criteria they will put a request to the BBC via the Charity Appeals Adviser. The ultimate decision for the BBC to run one of these appeals lies with the Director General in consultation with other members of the BBC Executive Committee. Once an appeal request has been granted, the Charity Appeals Adviser will liaise with the radio, television and digital teams who make the appeal and ensure it is distributed to all the various BBC networks. The appeal is made by BBC teams conforming to all BBC Editorial Guidelines and Editorial Policy advice will be given on the content (see contacts at the end of this guidance note). Charities which are members of the DEC are not eligible for the BBC broadcast appeals (ie the Radio 4 and BBC One Lifeline appeals). The BBC has a tradition of mounting major pan-BBC charity fundraising initiatives such as BBC Children in Need, Red Nose Day (for Comic Relief), and also reflecting Sport Relief (for Comic Relief). BBC Children in Need and BBC Media Action are BBC charities and bear the BBC brand. Comic Relief is not a BBC charity and unlike BBC Children in Need does not bear the BBC brand. It has been a major partner of the BBC and co producer for more than 20 years and together with the BBC has developed the Red Nose Day and Sport Relief on air appeals. The BBC maintains editorial control over all on air and BBC on line activities in relation to Comic Relief. BBC Children in Need, and Comic Relief do not themselves run projects, but are charities which distribute money to a range of projects run by a range of charities, not for profit organisations and community groups. Therefore in raising money to be distributed by BBC Children Need, or Comic Relief the BBC is not seen to be endorsing one particular project or one particular charitable cause. These cross-BBC appeals are reflected across the range of BBC services and in all media. A key aim is to get the public involved across the nations to undertake activities to support the appeal. The initiatives are mounted on a major scale. BBC charity appeal fundraising programming should normally fit within an agreed on-air 'appeal window'. This usually begins about 2/3 months before the main Appeal Night and around 1 months after. Any BBC Children in Need or Comic Relief other charity related BBC programming outside the window must be discussed with Editorial Policy and the BBC Charity Appeals Adviser. Typically the initiative culminates in a major appeal day on radio and night on TV, where donations are pledged by the public and the results of their fundraising are reported. In the build up to the main appeal night, the BBC broadcasts specially commissioned programmes or special strands within existing programmes to raise awareness of the appeal and to build audiences for the main telethon and radio activity . The programming may be across the whole range of BBC outlets including network television and radio, regional television, local radio and BBC websites and social media. In addition, the public is given information about BBC-wide charitable appeals so they can find out how to get involved, raise money and generally support the charities and obtain fundraising materials and merchandise. For each appeal a key executive figure or one for each relevant division of the BBC is usually agreed by the BBC who is responsible for liaison between the BBC and the charity and to whom referral must be made as outlined in this Guidance. There is always an Commissioning Executive with an overview of the relationship for BBC Content. This liaison figure(s) will ensure that all proposed fundraising activities and related programming fits with the values of the charity as well as according to BBC principles and standards, in liaison with BBC Editorial Policy. The BBC may reflect the work of these charities and any areas of their work that are being highlighted during a particular year's appeal for funds. For example, Comic Relief may wish to focus one year on projects which tackle the spread of malaria or BBC Children in Need may choose to highlight projects which tackle bullying. However, the BBC must not allow its content to be used as a vehicle for political campaigning or lobbying. Very careful editorial decisions may have to be taken to ensure that this line is not crossed. Editorial Policy Senior Adviser must be consulted at as early a stage as possible. The use of politicians should be handled with great care. Politicians should not be allowed to use their inclusion in BBC charity programming or related on-air activities to promote specific public policy or party political measures or initiatives. Any proposals to involve any politicians in particular party leaders on air must be referred in advance to the Chief Adviser Politics. For many years corporate and non-corporate supporters have helped BBC Children in Need and Comic Relief. These supporters, via their customers and staff, make a significant contribution mainly through selling special fundraising merchandise and providing a focus for staff and public fundraising. Much of this special merchandise is in the form of official charity products, which have been specifically produced for the appeal and are unique to the charity and sold by specific retailers who have agreed to help fundraise. For example Sainsbury's and Oxfam sell the Comic Relief Red Nose. Asda and Boots and other retailers sell Pudsey bears and other BBC Children in Need goods such as pens, Pudsey branded clothing and Christmas cards. In other cases charity supporters may produce special versions of existing products with a percentage being donated to the charity during the appeal period, for example a special flavour of a confectionary product. In addition, special records are often released, which raise money for the charity. Such releases may be mentioned on-air where editorially appropriate. Corporate support for cross BBC charitable appeals may also be in the form of considerable technical assistance to the charities, for example technology companies may provide major technical support and services on the main appeal nights. In such cases the technical support is offered to the charity and not the BBC and is not part of the BBC television production cost. There is no contractual relationship between the BBC and such technical supporters. The technical assistance offered to the charities enables them to set up, run and operate telephony and online donation mechanisms on the appeal night and in some cases across the year. For all trails the following will apply: The BBC has set up a specialist unit to provide advice on all technical aspects of running a competition, vote or any other uses of Telephony. The Interactive Technical Advice and Contracts Unit (ITACU) oversees the delivery, management and contracting of all BBC's Premium Rate Telephony and other telephony relating to voting and competitions for all programmes, and charity events both independent and in-house, across all divisions and output. Cross BBC charitable initiatives involve fundraising via telephony, online, red button, post and text donations. As appropriate, specialist charity appeals members of ITACU will work with the charity, Senior Adviser Editorial Policy and the Executive in charge of liaison with the charity, to ensure that all such uses are approved in line with regulation in terms of technical and legal issues. ITACU must be consulted at the earliest possible opportunity With high level approval, Premium Rate Telephony may be used to raise funds for these BBC charitable appeals. Premium Rate telephony may only be used for a competition vote or other fundraising mechanism which is directly related to the charitable appeal. Such uses of Premium Rate Telephony may only be carried out with detailed advice from Editorial Policy and ITACU. Any proposal must be signed off by the Divisional Director and referred to Editorial Policy well in advance. Interactive activities may include: Specially commissioned 'Feeder shows' may be produced which are designed to fundraise and/or build interest in the appeal before the main night. These shows usually run as a series in the weeks leading up to the main appeal night or stripped across the week before. They are often entertainment and factual entertainment shows specifically commissioned with a specific fundraising mechanic such as a vote and /or containing appeal films with a donation number call to action. The editorial connection or link to the charitable appeal must be made clear to the audience and the BBC Executive in charge of the production must retain editorial control of all content including any material relating to the charity. We may broadcast special factual programmes, dramas, comedies or other programmes including social media and iPlayer content in the run up to the appeal night to showcase the work of the charity, reflect the effect of donations from the previous appeal and highlight specific themes of that year, such as mental health and domestic violence. However, care must be taken to ensure that the BBC programming does not appear to campaign or lobby on any political issues or matters of public policy. Particular care has to be taken when any drama, comedy, factual or other programme highlights matters of public policy. Programmes may consider or reflect issues such as poverty, social equality, environmental concerns and other major issues. However, it is essential when highlighting these areas that the BBC does not appear to be advocating any political solution or actively encouraging any public campaign or lobby. The BBC should ensure the work of the charity and any projects they support is accurately reflected. The BBC must ensure that it maintains editorial control over all such programming.The Senior Editorial policy Adviser for Charity Appeals should be consulted as well as the relevant genre Senior Editorial Policy Adviser The link with the charity appeal must be made clear on air immediately before the programme, or clearly within the programme. Early discussions should be held with Senior Adviser Editorial Policy and the Executive responsible for liaison with the charity to ensure the suitability and editorial fit of such programming. With the agreement of Editorial Policy and ITACU, it may be appropriate to give information during or at the end of the programme about how to donate to the charitable appeal. Cross-BBC charity fundraising initiatives typically have a central on-air Appeal Night in the form of a telethon. The emphasis of the night is audience donations which are solicited through a range of donation mechanics, including telephone, post, online, red button and text. For BBC Children in Need, Comic Relief the main programme typically consists of suitably themed entertainment; appeal films which show how monies raised in previous appeals have been spent; where monies being raised in the current appeal will be spent and OB inserts from around the country. Throughout the evening the audience is regularly informed of the total and the different ways in which people have donated and raised money in the run-up to the appeal. The following relates to the Main Appeal Night itself: The Main Appeal night programme will reflect the enormous range of fundraising activity throughout the country and the myriad of fundraising initiatives. The BBC may thank members of the public and highlight the fundraising efforts of individuals, communities, organisations, companies their customers and their staff that have raised money and helped support the charity appeal. These acknowledgements should highlight the range of ways in which people have raised money from a whole raft of activities from 'bring and buy' sales and community initiatives, to buying Pudsey bears, red noses or other charity related merchandise. The money raised in this way is added to the 'totaliser' on the night in a clear and transparent manner. These 'thank yous' may come in the form of special inserts from around the country showcasing the work of communities and individuals, cheque presentations on location and in the studio, crawling astons , announcements from presenters and short films reflecting significant fundraising efforts. The editorial purpose of such reflections should be to thank the public and to inspire viewers to donate and to continue with fundraising activities. The following principles must be applied: Commercial logos should not be used in graphics except: Any use of commercial logos in graphics must be approved by Editorial Policy. Films reflecting the work of corporate supporters must abide by the following: Comic Relief is not a BBC charity. It will organise and set up its own events and challenges. These events may be designed to raise the profile of the appeal, showcase the work of the charity and highlight projects for which money is being raised. During the main appeal period Comic Relief may mount special challenges and events to raise money. Such events have included celebrity endurance feats such as those undertaken by David Walliams; celebrity challenges such as the Kilimanjaro climb and the now well established Sport Relief Mile. In 2008 some 400,000 people across the UK took part in the Sport Relief Mile and raised millions of pounds for the appeal. These are Comic Relief events, not BBC events. It would be very difficult to justify using the licence fee to pay for the organisation and administration of such events. Comic Relief undertakes the task of mounting events such as the Sport Relief runs all over the country with the help of a range of supporters. BBC staff members may wish to raise money for charity, either individually, or as a group in off-air activities like fun runs or sponsored events. Staff are able to undertake activities organised by external organisations in a private capacity for fundraising activity for charitable purposes but not for campaigning or political action. However, if staff wish to organise off-air fundraising events through the BBC (such as through Gateway or as a group of people from a local radio station coming together to create an activity) then they must refer the proposed activity to the Charity Appeals Adviser and Senior Adviser Editorial Policy well in advance. It is also to avoid the perception of BBC staff becoming the face of a charity and endorsing one charity over another. Any such activity must not stray into the area of lobbying or campaigning and specific care must be taken in relation to staff who work in News and Current Affairs, in relation to due impartiality. Please refer any such proposals well in advance . It is always best practice to direct them to a registered charity or range of suitable organisations, who can support the person and channel help most effectively. The reason for this is that such organisations usually have the experience and infrastructure to carry out appropriate due diligence checks and ensure that the assistance offered is the best for the person affected. In exceptional circumstances if audiences want to donate to individuals directly then the BBC team concerned should take advice in the first instance from the Senior Adviser, (Charities), Editorial Policy and the Charity Appeals Adviser.
