Madaxweynaha dalka Tanzania ayaa lagu canbaareeyay hadal ay ku sheegtay in dumarka kubadda ciyaarada ee waddankaas ay leeyihiin "xabad fidsan" iyo in aysan lahayn qurux lagu guursan karo. Samia Suluhu Hassan ayaa hadalkan carada weyn dhaliyay jeedisay xilli ay martigalineysay kooxda kubadda cagta ee ragga ee ay da'dooda ka hooseyso 23-ka sano. Waxay ciyaartoyda ku qaabishay xarunta madaxtooyada ee magaalada Dar Es Salaam. Samia oo 61 jir ah waxay noqotay haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee abid madaxweyne ka noqota Tanzania. Dhawaan waxay BBC-da u sheegtay in ay jiraan dad ka shaki qaba inay madaxweyne noqon karto, maadaama ay dumar tahay. "Xitaa shaqaalaha dowladdeyda ayaa markii ugu horreysay igu diiday haweennimo, balse durbadiiba way aqbaleen hoggaankeyga," ayay tiri Ms Samia. Hase yeeshee hadalkeeda ugu dambeeyay ayaa aad loogu dhaleeceeyay. "Hadalka ay madaxweyne @SuluhuSamia ka sheegtay dumarka kubadda cagta ciyaara waa mid bahdil ku ah dhammaan haweenka," ayay tiri Catherine Ruge, oo ah madaxa garabka dumarka ee xisbiga mucaaradka, Chadema, horayna usoo noqotay xildhibaan. Haweeneyda sameysa cilmi baarista jinsiga iyo caafimaadka maskaxda, @Sajokm, ayaa iyaduna sheegtay in ay aad "uga naxday" hadalkaas. Dad kale oo aad u badan ayaa sidaas si la mid ah baraha bulshada ugu canbaareeyay madaxweyne Samia. BBC-da ayaa isku dayday in ay la xiriirto mas'uuliyiinta xiriirka kubadda cagta ee Tanzania, si ay arrintan uga jawaabaan. Madaxweynaha Tanzania ayaa sheegtay in dumarka kubadda cagta ciyaara ay farxad badan iyo magac usoo jiidaan dalalka Bariga Afrika, koobab badanna kusoo guuleystaan, balse qaarkood aysan heli karin fursadda guurka qaabka ay u ekaadeen dartiis. "Haddii aan halkan isugu keenno oo aan saf gelinno, kuwa xabadkooda uu masaxan yahay waxaad moodeysaa inayba rag yihiin - dumar ma moodeysid," ayay tiri. Waxay sheegtay in dumarka ciyaaraha qaarkood la guursaday, laakiin intooda badan aysan helin wax aroosa, "sida uu muuqaalkooda u ekaaday awgiisna, nolosha guurka ay u tahay riyo oo kaliya". Meel kale oo khudbaddeeda ka mid ah ayay ku sheegtay in dadka ciyaaraha ay ku nool yihiin nolol adag marka ay xirfaddooda howlgab ka noqdaan, waxayna wasaaradaha ku shaqada leh ka codsatay in la xannaaneeyo marka ay howl gabaan. Waxay hoosta ka xariiqday in dumarka ay si gaar ah nolosha ugu dhibaatoodaan "iyagoo lugahooda ay ku daaleen ciyaaraha, da'duna ay ka daba timid". Madaxweyne Samia waxay xilka qabatay bishii March, iyadoo badashay madaxweynihii hore, John Magufuli, oo u geeriyooday wadne xanuun. Waxaa madaxweynahaas si weyn loogu xasuustaa inuu iskuulka ka mamnuuci jiray haweenka uurka leh iyo hooyooyinka.

Maxay ahaayeen raggii ku labisnaa macawisaha ee maanta lagu arkay maamuuskii 18-ka May ee lagu qabtay Hargeysa 18-ka Bisha May sanad walba waxaa gudaha magaalooyinka Somaliland iyo dalalka dibada lagu qabtaa xusas ballaaran oo lagu maamuusayo asaaskii Jamhuuriya Iskeed Madaxbannaanida ugu dhawaaqday ee Somaliland. Soddon iyo afar sanno oo ka soo wareegtay markii la asaasay Somaliland waxay ka mid tahay meelaha gobolka Bariga Afrika ee ay ka hirgaleen ammaan adag iyo doorashooyin dadweynuhu soo doortaan madaxdooda. Madaxweyne Cabdirixmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro iyo madaxdii hore ee soo hoggaamisay Somaliland oo uu ka mid ahaa madaxweynihii xilka ku wareejiyey Muuse Biixi Cabdi ayaa maanta wadajir ugu qayb galay musaabad ballaaran oo lagu xusayey asaaska markii Somaliland ku dhawaaqday inay ka baxday Soomaaliya inteeda kale. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Iskeed ugu Dhawaaqday Madaxbannaanida ee Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa ugu baaqay dalalka dunida in ay tixgeliyaan aqoonsiga Somaliland doonayso. Madaxweyne Cirro oo khudbad ka jeediyey xuska maalinta 18 May ee Somaliland ku dhawaaqday gooni isu-taaggeeda, oo maanta guud ahaan laga xusay deegaannada Somaliland, ayaa sheegay "in ay Somaliland buuxisay shuruudihii looga baahnaa qaran madax bannaan, isla markaana ay adduunku garowsado in Somaliland dal u aqoonsadaan." , Xafiiska Afhayeenka MJSL Madaxweynuhu waxa uu intaas ku daray in dhambaallo aqoonsi ay kaga codsanayaan adduunka uu u diray in ka badan 190 madaxweyneyaal, raysal wasaareyaal iyo boqorro isugu jira, kuwaas oo ay ka codsadeen aqoonsi "195-ka dal ee xubnaha ka ah Qaramada Midoobay dhambaallo codsi aqoonsi ah u dirnay, shalay baana la gaadhsiiyey codsigaas" ayuu yidhi Madaxwayne Cirro. Madaxweyne Cirro waxa kale oo uu sheegay in Somaliland gacan ka geysan karaan xal u helidda dhibaatada ka taagan Soomaaliya, isaga oo xusay in ay xog-ogaal u yihiin dhibaatadaas. Inta badan munaasabada 18-ka may ee ka qabsoonta caasimada Hargeysa ayaa ah tan ugu maamuuska weyn ee ka dhacda gudaha deegaanada Somaliland taas oo lagu soo bandhigo waxqabadka xukuumada iyo dhoolatuska ciidamada kala duwan ee Somaliland. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Ciidadamadda oo ku gaashamaan gadiid dagaal oo si farshaxan leh loo maamuusay, shaqaalaha, iskaashatooyinka iyo qaybaha kala duwan ayaa mara laami dheer oo hor mara goob ay madaxdu ku sugan yihiin. Arrinta ku cusbayd munaasadda sanadkan ayaa ahayd in lagu arkay rag ku labisan macawiso iyo dhar kala jaad jaad ah oo garabka ku sita alwaax qori loo ekeysiiyey kuwaaas oo dhulka dhigay qoryaha alwaaxa ka samaynaa gacmahana kor u taagay taas oo si weyn hadal hayn ugu dhaliyey baraha bulshada ee Soomaalida isticmaasho. Sida lagu baahiyey baraha bulshada, dadka qaar ayaa sheegay in ay ahaayeen bulsho matalaysay ciidamaddii madaniga ahaa ee lagu daray ciidamada dowladda iyo inay ahaayen isla ciidamadaas oo soo badhigay labada muuqaal ay kala lahaayeen labada jeer. Wasiirka gaashaandhigga Jamhuuriyadda iskeed madaxbannaanida ugu dhawaaqday ee Somaliland Maxamed Yuusuf Cali oo BBC-da la hadlay ayaa sheegay in ragga macawisaha xirnaa ee marayey munasaabada ay ahaayeen qayb ka mida ciidamadii madigana ahaa ee dhawaan xukuumadda madaxweyne Cirro ay u baddeshay ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa Somaliland. Wuxuu intaa raaciyey wasiir Maxamed in tani diraysan laba fariimood oo midna ku socotay ciidamadii la dowladeeyey midna ku socotay shacabka. "Dhalinyaradii ciidamada madiga ee la dowladeeyey ayey tusaale nool u ahayd, waxay dadka tusaysay in ciidankii madiniga la qarameeyey ay maanta ka mid yihiin ciidanka waayo waa daba socdeen. Iyagana waxay u ahay dhiirigelin kuwii madaniga aha away arkayaan inay ka mid yihiin ciidamada waxay tahay farriin wacyi galineed, tusaalaha labaad waa in mustawahaa laga soo gudbay oo ah in xubno cusub oo ku soo biiray qaybaha ciidamada" ayuu yiri wasiirku. Sawirka, Xafiiska Afhayeenka MJSL Mar BBC-du waydiisay wasiirka in ragga xirnaa macawisuhu ay ahaayeen bulsho matalaysay ciidamadaas madaniga ka hor intaan lagu darin ciidamada ayuu sheegay inay ahaayen isla rag ka tirsan kuwa lagu biiray ciidamada dowladda oo matalayey sidii ay ahaayeen markii ay madaniga ahaayeen "Laftoodii ayey ahaayeen, oo qaabkoodii hore ku mataleyey, xeeryaha tababarka ayey joogaan, xeryaha laga soo qaaday, tusaale ayaa loo soo qaatay hadda siday yihiin iyo markii hore siday ahaayeen,"ayuu BBC-da u sheegay wasiirka gaashandhiga Maxamed Yuusuf Cali. Wasiir Maxamed, wuxuu intaa raaciyey inay guul weyn u tahay wasaaradda gaashandhiga iyo xukuumadda madaxweyne Cirro in ciidamadu ku taxnaa jiid ku dhow 350KM mudadaaa kooban la dowladeeyey oo ay ka mid noqdeen ciidamadda dowladda iyaga iyo gadiidkoodiiba. Somaliland ayaa muddo ka shaqaynasay sidii ciidamadii madaniga ee ku sugnaa deegaano ka mida gobolka Sanaag loogu biirin lahaa ciidamada dowladda iyadoo madaxweyne xigeenka Somaliland iyo wasiiro muddo ay fadhiyeen gobolkaasi.

Isbeddelka cimilada waxay dab kusii shideysaa dhibaatooyinka Soomaaliya - balse weli rajo ayaa jirta , Alyona Synenko/ICRC Soomaaliya ayaa laga yaabaa inay ka mid tahay dalalka ugu saboolsan caalamka uuna halakeeyay dagaal, balse waa mid “wax laga qaban karo”, sida uu sheegay sarkaalkeeda sare ee cimilada. Dalka ayaa waxaa halakeeyay dagaal in ka badan 30 sano oo ay isku dhacyo socdeen - waxaana ka mid ah kacdoon Islaami ah, dagaal sokeeye, iyo isku dhacyo gobol iyo kuwo qabaa'il oo dhowr ah. Haddana Cabdixakiin Caynte, la taliyaha cimilada ee raysal wasaaraha Soomaaliya, ayaa weli dalkiisa u arka mid rajo leh. Waxa rajadiisa ka dhigaya mid yaab leh ayaa ah xaqiiqda ah in isbeddelka cimilada uu kasii darayo dhammaanba caqabadaha uu dalkiisa wajahayo. Mid ka mid ah falanqeeyeyaasha ayaa isbeddelka cimilada ku tilmaamay “mid dhibka sii labalaabta”, sababtoo ah waxay dab kusii shidday xiisadaha jira iyadoo sii dheereyneysa dagaalka dalalka nugul sida Soomaaliya. Balse Soomaaliya, oo ku taalla bariga qaaradda Afrika, looma qabsan karo cimiladeenna isbeddeleysa. Xogta waa mid yaab leh. Soomaaliya ayaa soo saareysay maaddada carbon dioxide ee ka imaaneysa dhuxusha tan iyo 1950-meeyadii inta uu dhaqaalaha Mareykanku ka sameeyo celcelis ahaan saddex maalmood. Saameynta ugu daran waxay gaartay beeraha. Soomaaliya ayaa weli ah dal dhaqaalihiisu aad ugu tiirsan yahay beeraha, iyadoo saddex meel ka labo bulshada ay ku tiirsan yihiin beeraha iyo dhaqashada xoolaha. Sawirka, Alyona Synenko/ICRC Sanadkii 2022 dalka ayaa wuxuu wajahay abaartii ugu darneyd muddo 40 sano ah – xaalad ay saynisyahannadu ku sheegeen in 100 jeer laga yaabo inay sababtay isbeddelka cimilada ee aadmigu sababay. Heerka caqabadda heysata Soomaaliya ayaa ah mid cad iyadoo kolonyo Land Cruiser ah oo ka socota Guddiga Caalamiga ah ee Laanqeyrta Cas (ICRC) ay ku safrayeen dhulka qallalan ee inta badan dalka, waxaa nagu wehliyay saddex ilaalo oo ku hubeysnaa AK47 - Soomaaliya waa dalka keliya dunida ee shaqaalaha Red Cross ay la safraan ciidamo hubeysan. Sawirka, Alyona Synenko/ICRC Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Xoolo-dhaqatada geela iyo beeralleyda yaryar ee aan la kulannay ayaa saameynta daran ee isbeddelka cimilada wajahaya. Kumannaan sano Soomaalida ayaa nolol-maalmeedkooda ka helayay dhaqashada geela iyo ariga. Balse isbeddelka cimilada ayaa carqaladeynaya helidda roobka ee suurtogalka ka dhigay habkan ay u nool yihiin. Sheekh Doon Ismaaciil ayaa inoo sheegay in dhammaanba geeliisa uu ku waayay abaarta, markii dhulkii daaqsinka uu qallalay cawskii uu beertiisa yar ku beerayna aysan ku filneyn. “Ceelka ayaa qallalay mana jirin daaqsin, marka xayawaannada ayaa bilaabay inay dhintaan,” ayuu yiri, isagoo madaxiisa ruxaya. “Nolosha aan haatan ku jirno runtii way xun tahay - dhabtii wya xun tahay.” Abaartaas ayaa beeralleyda iyo xoolo-dhaqatada ka dhigtay kuwo isku dagaala helidda biyaha iyo daaqsinka. Sheekh Doon ayaa sheegay in mararka qaar uu ku qasbanaa inuu dhulkiisa ku difaaco qori. “Ma jirto xushmad haddii aadan heysan,” ayuu yiri. “Xoolo-dhaqatada xoolahooda usoo kaxeeya beerta ayaa dib u dega marka ay hubkeyga arkaan. Way baqaan.” Dal ay kala qeybiyeen kooxo qabaa'illo iska soo horjeeda horena ay qalalaaso u saameeyeen, ayaa murannadan gudaha waxay si fudud isugu beddeli karaan dagaal buuxa, sida uu sheegay Cyril Jaurena, oo madax ka ah barnaamijka ICRC ee gudaha Soomaaliya. “Isticmaalka ceelasha iyo dhul daaqsin ayaa mar walba sii adkaaneysa, markaasna bulshada deegaanka ayaa waxaa dhex mari kara dagaal - iyagoo ku tartamaya kheyraadkaas, mararka qaarna waxay gaartaa inay dadku is toogtaan,” ayuu ka digay. Abaartuna ma aha dhibaatada keliya ee halkan ka jirta. Sanadkii tegay Soomaaliya ayaa wajahday daadad ba'an sababo la xiriira roobab ay saynisyahannadu ku sheegeen in si la mid ah kululaanshaha adduunka ay aadmigu sababeen. Sawirka, Alyona Synenko/ICRC Saameynta isbeddelka cimilada ee Soomaaliya ee aadka u daran waxay ka tarjumayaan oo caddeyn u yihiin xarunta gaajada ee ay Red Cross ku leedahay isbitaal ku yaalla dekadda Kismaayo. Maalin walba hooyooyin badan ayaa carruurtooda nafaqo-darradu heyso halkan keena. Qaar badan ayaa ka yimaada deegaanno ay maamulaan kooxda al-Qaacida xiriirka la leh, ee al-Shabaab, si ay halkan u yimaadaan. QM ayaa ku qiyaaseysa in in ka badan 1.5m oo carruur ay da'doodu ka yar tahay shan jir ay aad ugu nafaqo darreysan yihiin Soomaaliya. Sawirka, Alyona Synenko/ICRC Ilaa afar milyan oo Soomaali ah ayaa lagu qasbay inay u guuraan xeryo qaxooti oo ku meel gaar ah – waana ilaa shan meelood meel bulshada. Dadka barakacay ayaa guryahooda ka sameysta wax walba oo ay heli karaan – haraaga maryo, baakado iyo biro - kuwaasoo lagu kabay ulo. Dadka qaar ayaa xitaa kala jara jirgaamo iyagoo ku daboola saqafka kore. Caawinaad yar oo caalami ah unbaa jirta, waaba haddii ay helaan. Xerada qaxootiga aan booqday, oo ku taalla duleedka magaalada Garowe ee waqooyiga Soomaaliya, qoysaska ayaa ku qasban inay iska bixiyaan cunnada iyo biyaha, iyo sidoo kale kirada dhulka ay ka dhisteen cooshadaha. Kadib in ka badan 30 sano oo dagaal ah, Soomaaliya ayaa hoos uga sii dhacday liiska waxyaabaha ahmiyadda u leh dunida. Dhibaatooyinkeeda ayaa waxaa asal u ah waxa u muuqda isku dhacyo degdeg ah, sida meelaha Ukraine iyo Gaza. QM ayaa ku qiyaaseysa in Soomaaliya ay u baahan tahay ugu yaraan $1.6bn (ilaa £1.2bn) si ay u daboosho baahideeda bani'aadannimo sanadkan, balse ilaa haatan keliya $600 oo milyan ayay ku deeqeen dowladaha deeq-bixiyeyaasha. Sawirka, Alyona Synenko/ICRC Saameynta is huwan ee cimilada iyo dagaalka ayaa sababay in dad badan ay shaqaaleysiiyaan kooxaha dagaalka wada. Kuwa ku jira xeryaha ayaa aad ugu baahan lacag, shaqada ugu fudud ee laga shaqeeyana - sida ay sheegeen dadka aan la hadlay - waa inaad ku biirto mid ka mid ah ciidamada iska soo horjeeda sidaasna lacag lagugu siiyo. Haweeney ayaa ii sheegtay inay u cabsaneyso seygeeda iyo afar ka mid ah wiilasheeda kadib markii ay ku biireen dagaalyahannada maleeshiyo. “Waa reer miyi aan xirfad lahayn, marka shaqada keliya ee ay heli kareen waa ciidamada,” ayay tiri Xaliima Ibraahim Cali Maxamuud iyadoo ku fadhisay roog la dhigay dhul wasakh ah oo buushkeeda ka tirsan. “Aad bey lacag u rabeen, marka aad cunno la'aan tahayna muddo dheer, carruurtaadana ay ku eegayaan, wax walba waad sameyneysaa.” Innagoo meel ka meel tageynay oo usii gudbeynay, hooyooyinka ayaa inoo sheegay sheekooyin isku mid ah oo ah in seygooda iyo carruurtooda ay ka tageen si ay dagaalyahanno u noqdaan, qaar baa la dilay. Sawirka, Alyona Synenko/ICRC Balse Soomaali badan ayaa tallaabo qaadaya. Xarunta korontada ee ku taalla Garowe ayaa maalgashaneysay quwad dabeysha iyo cadceedda ku shaqeysa, tusaale ahaan. Go'aankan ma ahan mid caalamka laga keenay, sida uu sheegay madaxa shirkadda. Cabdirisaaq Maxamed ayaa sheegay inuusan wax deeq ah ka helin dibadda. Iskaashiga Tamarta Qaranka Soomaaliya (NECSOM), oo uu u shaqeeyo, ayaa sameyneysa maalgashiga sababtoo ah tamarta la cusbooneysiin karo ee laga soo saaro ilaha dabiiciga ah sida qorraxda iyo dabeysha ayaa aad uga fiican matoorrada naftada ku shaqeeya ee xaruntan ay ku tiirsaneyd. Sawirka, Alyona Synenko/ICRC Waxaan la kulmay ganacsatada Soomaalida ee sameysanaya ganacsiyo, waxaana ka mid ahayd haweeney xerada qaxootiga Garowe aan waxba la iman, balse hirgelisay ganacsi guuleystay. Aamina Cusmaan Maxamed ayaa sharraxday sida ay cunno uga soo deynsan jirtay dukaan, u karin jirtay, kadibna faa'iidada ay ka hesho isla sidaa ku sameyn jirtay maalinta xigta. Maqaaxida yar balse mashquulka badan ee ay furatay ayaa usoo saarta dakhliga ay aadka ugu baahan tahay inay ku daryeesho seygeeda xanuunsan iyo 11 carruur ah - oo ay ku jiraan kuwa gabadheeda ay dhashay oo agoon ah. Markii aan kasoo tagay maqaaxida Aamina, waxaan bilaabay inaan fahmo sababta la taliyaha cimilada ee raysal wasaaraha Soomaaliya uu rajo uga qabo mustaqbalka dalkiisa. Waxaa jirta rajo. Balse iyadoo isbeddelka cimilada uu dab kusii shidayo dagaalka halkan ka socda, dalkan ayaa u baahnaan doona caawinaad caalami ah oo sii socota si loo hirgeliyo nabad loona dhiso u adkeysiga cimiladeenna isbeddeleysa.

UK oo maanta ku dhawaaqeysa go'aamo waaweyn oo saameynaya qaxootiga iyo dalal Afrikaan ah Dadka magangelyo laga siiyo Boqortooyada Midowday (UK) waa inay sugaan 20 sano ka hor intaysan codsan inay si rasmi ah u degaan dalkaas, iyadoo qorshuhu yahay inay maanta oo Isniin ah sidaa ku dhawaaqdo Xoghayaha Arrimaha Gudaha Shabana Mahmood. Isbeddelkan ugu weyn ee siyaasadda magangalyada ayaa yimid iyadoo dowladdu ay doonayso inay yareyso dadka kusoo gala dalkaas doonyaha yar yar iyo kuwa sheeganaya magangalyada. Sida qorshuhu yahay, dadka la siiyo magangelyada waxaa loo oggolaan doonaa oo kaliya inay dalka si ku meel gaar ah joogaan, iyadoo si joogto ah dib loogu eegayo sharcigooda qaxootinnimo iyo kuwa dalalkooda loo arko inay ammaan yihiin in loo sheego inay ku laabtaan. Hadda qofku wuxuu qaxooti ahaadaa shan sano, ka dib dadku waxay codsan karaan fasax aan xad lahayn oo ay ku joogaan UK. Shabana ayaa sidoo kale ku dhawaaqi doonta in UK ay joojin doonto fiisaha ay siiso dadka ka imaanaya saddex dal oo Afrikaan ah, haddii aysan dowladahooda wanaajin wadashaqeynta ku aaddan ka saaridda dalkaas muhaajiriinta sharci darrada ah. Waxay BBC-da u sheegtay Axaddii: "Tani waxay ii tahay mid damiirka ku saabsan, sababtoo ah waxaan arkayaa tahriibka sharci-darrada ah oo dalkeenna kala qeybinaya, waa kala qaybin bulsho." Hadda xoghayaha arrimaha gudaha waxa ay dooneysaa inay ka jarto muddada billowga ah ee shanta sano ah oo laga dhigo laba sano iyo bar, markaas ka dib waxa si joogto ah dib loogu eegi doonaa aqoonsiga qaxootiga. Laakiin waxa ay qorshaynaysaa in ay si weyn u kordhiso waqtiga ay ku qaadanayso in la helo deggenaansho rasmi ah taasoo noqoneysa min shan sano ilaa 20. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Shabana ayaa u sheegtay Sunday Times in dib u habaynta loo qorsheeyay in si dhab ah loogu sheego dadka: dalkan ha u iman tahriib sharci-darro ah, ha fuulina doon. Waxay tiri iyadoo hadalkeeda sii wadata: "Tahriibka sharci darrada ah ayaa dalkeennii kala qoqobaya", waxayna intaas ku dartay in ay tahay shaqada dowladda "in aan dalkeenna mideyno". "Haddii aynaan arrintan xallin, waxay ila tahay in waddankeennu aad u kala qaybsanaan doono," ayay u sheegtay wargeyska. Siyaasaddan waxa laga soo minguuriyay Danmark, halkaas oo dawladda uu hoggaamiyo xisbiga Socialdemokraterna ee bidixda dhexe, ay hoggaan ka ahayd mid ka mid ah hababka magangelyo ee ugu adag Yurub. Danmark, qaxootiga waxaa la siiyaa sharci deggenaansho ku meel gaar ah, sida caadiga ah labo sano, oo dhaqangal ah waa inay dib u codsadaan magangalyo marka uu ka dhaco. Waxaa hubaal ah in habkan cusub ee Shabana uu wajihi doono diidmo kaga imanaysa qaar ka mid ah xildhibaannada xisbiga shaqaalaha. Afhayeenka arrimaha gudaha ee xisbiga Libaraalka Dimuqraadiga Max Wilkinson ayaa sheegay in ay "sax tahay in dowladdu ay eegto habab cusub oo lagu hagaajinayo nidaamka magangelyo doonka ee uu abuuray xisbiga Konserfatifka". Waxa uu intaa ku daray in Laboor-ku "ayna ahayn in ay laftoodu ku kaftamaan in tillaabooyinkani ay beddel u yihiin sheegashada degdegga ah si aan meesha uga saarno kuwa aan xaqa u lahayn inay halkan joogaan". Enver Solomon, oo ah madaxa fulinta ee Golaha Qaxootiga, ayaa ku tilmaamay qorshayaasha dawladda kuwo "aad u adag oo aan loo baahnayn", wuxuuna yiri "ma joojin doonaan dadka la silciyey, la jirdilay ama arkay xubno qoyskooda ah oo lagu dilay dagaallo naxariis darro ah". Dawladdu waxay doonaysaa in la dhimo tirada dadka ku imanaya doonyaha yar yar ee UK, dib-u-habayntan ayaa looga gol-leeyahay in la dedejiyo masaafurinta magan-gelyo-doonka iyo dembiilayaasha ajaaniibta ah iyo sidoo kale in la adkeeyo in magan-gelyo-doonka guulaysta inay sii joogaan. Sida qorshuhu yahay dadka waxa lagu xaddidi doonaa in ay ka doodaan sababahooda marka ay racfaan qaataan oo haddii kiis guuldaraysto, waa la musaafurin doonaa.

Carruur iyo macallin oo dab uu ku dilay Brazil Ugu yaraan afar carruur ah iyo macallin ayaa waxa ay ku dhinteen dalka Brazil kaddib markii nin ilaalo ka ahaa xarun carruurta lagu xannaaneeyo oo ku taal magaalada Janauba ee gobolka Minas Gerais ee waddankaasi uu halkaasi dab qabadsiiyay. Wararka laga helayo deegaankaasi ayaa sheegaya in ugu yaraan 40 kale ay weerrarkaasi dabka ah ku dhaawacmeen arooryadii Khamiistii. Muuqaal laga soo duubay dhacdadan ayaa muujisay dad badan oo isugu yimid banaanka hore ee xarun caafimaad, hooyo qeylineyso oo ka niyad jabsan xaalada caafimaada ee ilmaheeda. Sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha, mid ka mid ah ilaalada xanaanada carruurta ayaa waxa uu ku daadiyay aalkolo qaar ka mid ah caruurta iyo isagaba, Kadibna dab qabadsiiyay. Si la mid ah carruurta, ayaa qaar ka tirsan dadkii waa weynaa ee ka shaqeynayay xanaanada carruurta ay sidoo kale ku dhaawacmeen dabkaan. Madaxweynaha Brazil Michel Temer, ayaa ku sheeegay qoraal uu soo dhigay bartiisa Twitterka inuu si weyn uga xun yahay musiibadii dhacday, isga oo tacsi u diray ehelada dadkii waxku noqday dabkaasi. Mr Temer Waxa uu intaasi raaciyey in isaga qudhiisa ka aaba ahaan uu fahamay in musiibadan ay ahayd mid aad u xanuun badan.

Maxaa ka taqaanaa xiriirka u dhexeeya cirrada iyo kansarka? , Patrick Giardino via Timo cirro leh badanaa waxaa loo arkaa calaamad gabow. Waxay ina xusuusinayaan sannadihii tegay iyo sida uu jirku isku beddelay waqti ka dib. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, cilmi-baaris dhawaan la sameeyay ayaa su'aal gelisay sheegashadan, iyadoo tilmaamaysa in cirroobidu ay noqon karto isbeddel dabiici ah oo jireed, isla markaana laga yaabo inay xiriir la leedahay kansar. Daraasad cusub oo lagu sameeyay jiir ayaa muujinaysa sida uu jirku uga hortagi karo waxyeello inay dhacdo, taas oo ah arrin muhiim u ah gabowga iyo kansarka. Marka qofku gaboobo, awoodda unugyada jirka ayaa hoos u dhacda, taasoo keeni karta waxyeello. Dhinaca kale, dhibaatooyinka ku dhaca unugyada laftoodu waxay sababi karaan koritaan gaabis ah. Cilmi-baaristan ayaa muujisay xiriirka ka dhexeeya timo-daata ama isbeddelka timaha iyo unugyada, taasoo suuragal ah inay ka hortagto ama yareyso koritaanka unugyada kansarka ee halista ah. Unugyada melanocytic-ka ayaa ah tiirka ugu muhiimsan ee cilmi-baaristan. Unugyadan waxay ku nool yihiin hareeraha meesha timuhu ka soo baxaan. Marka xaaladdu wanaagsan tahay, unugyadani waxay mar kale soo saaraan unugyo cusub oo ka caawiya timaha inay koraan. Tani waxay sidoo kale sababtaa in timuhu yeeshaan midab inta uu qofku nool yahay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, maalin kasta, unugyada jirku waxay la kulmaan shucaac waxyeello leh oo ka imanaya ilo kala duwan. Tani waxay jirka gelisaa khatarta ah inuu helay kiimikooyin waxyeello leh. Tani waxay u horseedi kartaa gabowga degdega ah iyo khatarta sii kordheysa ee qaadista kansarka, sida melanoma, oo ah nooca kansarka maqaarka. Cilmi-baaristani sidoo kale waxay iftiiminaysaa wax badan oo ku saabsan waxa dhaca haddii unugyada melanocytic ee bartamaha timaha ay la kulmaan dhibaatooyin hidde ah, oo ay ku jiraan gelitaanka xaalad aan caafimaad qabin. Sawirka, Kimberrywood via Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Ma aha dhammaan dhibaatooyinka hidde-sideedku inay sababaaan dhibaatadan. Tijaabooyinkooda, cilmi-baarayaashu waxay jiirka ay tijaabiyeen u soo bandhigeen khatar si ay u arkaan waxa dhici lahaa. Halkan, calaamadaha u dhow ayaa ku dhiirrigeliyey unugyada dhaawacan inay iscusboonaysiiyaan oo ay qaybsamaan, inkastoo DNA-ga uu dhaawacmay. Cilmi-baaristan waxay muujisay in masiirka unugyada melanocyte uu ku xiran yahay nooca dhibaatada la kulmo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, saameynta unugyada kansarka, molecules dhaawacmay waxay sii ahaanayaan kuwo aan waxba yeelin, taasoo u oggolaanaysa molecules kale inay baxsadaan. Waxa muhiim ah in la caddeeyo in daraasaddan ay muujinayso in aanay jirin xidhiidh adag oo ka dhexeeya timaha cirrada iyo kansarka, balse ay tahay laba arrimood oo gabowga ah iyo isu dheellitirka u dhexeeya dib u soo kabashada unugyada iyo ka hortagga kansarka. Gabowgu ma aha wax iskiis u hor istaaga, balse waa qayb ka mid ah ilaalinta unugyada jidhka ee ka hortagga khataraha. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, natiijooyinka daraasaddan waa xaddidan yihiin. Maadaama inta badan xogta laga uruuriyey jiirka, tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in cilmi-baaris dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan aadanaha loo baahan yahay si loo ogaado haddii melanocytes ay u shaqeeyaan sida lagu muujiyey. Farqiga u dhexeeya qaab nololeedka noocyada xayawaanka iyo xitaa aadanaha ayaa ka dhigan in ay jirto caddayn la'aan ku saabsan xiriirka u dhexeeya timaha iyo halista kansarka. Sheekada timaha cirrodu maaha oo kaliya ku saabsan socodka wakhtiga ama guulaha nolosha. Waxay la xiriirtaa dhacdooyinka dhacay sannadihii la soo dhaafay - jiil ilaa jiil. Timahani waxay macnaheedu noqon karaan wax: in, inta lagu jiro halganka u dhexeeya gabowga iyo nafta, mararka qaarkood way wanaagsan tahay in hal unug u huro wanaagga jirka oo dhan.

Venezuela: "Trump wuxuu wadaa hanjabaaddii gumeysiga" , Venezuela ayaa ku eedeysay madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump inuu sameeyay "hanjabaad gumeysi" ka dib markii uu sheegay inay tahay in hawada dalka ku wareegsan loo tixgeliyo mid xiran. Wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda ee dalkaas ayaa hadalka Trump ku tilmaantay "gardarro kale oo xad-dhaaf ah, sharci-darro ah oo aan sabab lahayn oo ka dhan ah dadka Venezuela". Maraykanku sharci ahaan ma laha awood uu ku xiro hawada waddan kale, laakiin qoraalka Trump ee internet-ka ayaa keeni kara hubanti la'aan dhanka safarka iyo in ay ka hor istaagto shirkadaha diyaaradaha inay ka hawlgalaan halkaas. Maraykanku waxa uu dhisme ciidan ka waday dalalka Caribbean-ka, kaas oo ay saraakiishu sheegeen in uu yahay mid lagula dagaallamayo mukhaadaraadka. Madaxweynaha Venezuela Nicolás Maduro ayaa ku gacan seyray sheegashada Mareykanka ee ah ka ganacsiga daroogada oo uu ku tilmaamay isku day lagu doonayo in xilka looga tuuro. Qoraal uu soo dhigay Truth Social, Trump waxa uu ku qoray: "Dhammaan Shirkadaha Diyaaradaha, Duuliyayaasha, Kuwa ka Ganacsada Daroogada, iyo Kuwa Dadka Tahriibiya, fadlan ka fiirsada hawada sare iyo agagaarka VENEZUELA in la xiro dhammaanteed." Aqalka Cad ayaan si degdeg ah uga jawaabin codsigii BBC-da ee ahaa inay faallo ka bixiyaan. Hadalka Trump ayaa imaanaya maalmo kadib markii maamulka duulista hawada ee Mareykanka (FAA) uu uga digay shirkadaha diyaaradaha "dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo sarreeya ee Venezuela iyo nawaaxigeeda". Bayaan ay soo saartay Sabtidii, wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda ee Venezuela waxay ku sheegtay in Maraykanku "si kali ah u hakiyay" duullimaadyadii dib u celinta muhaajiriinta ee toddobaadlaha ah. "Waxaan si toos ah ugu baaqaynaa beesha caalamka, dawladaha madax-bannaan ee adduunka, Qaramada Midoobay iyo hay'adaha caalamiga ah ee ay khusayso inay si adag u diidaan falkan anshax-darrada ah ee gardarrada ah," ayaa lagu yiri. Venezuela ayaa Arbacadii mamnuucday lix diyaaradood oo waaweyn oo caalami ah - Iberia, TAP Portugal, Gol, Latam, Avianca iyo Turkish Airlines - ka dib markii ay ku guuldarreysteen inay kasoo baxaan 48-saacadood oo kama dambeys ah oo loo qabtay in ay dib ugu billaabayaan duullimaadyada. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Maraykanka ayaa ku daabulay markabka ugu weyn adduunka ee USS Gerald Ford iyo ilaa 15,000 oo askari meel u jirta dalka Venezuela. Waxa uu ku adkeystay in hawlgalinta – oo ah kii ugu waynaa ee uu Maraykanku ka sameeyo gobolka tan iyo markii uu galay Panama 1989-kii – uu yahay mid lagula dagaallamayo ka ganacsiga daroogada. Khamiistii, Trump wuxuu ka digay in dadaallada Mareykanka ee lagu joojinayo ka ganacsiga daroogada Venezuela "dhul ahaan" ay u billaaban doonaan "si dhaqso ah". Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa ugu yaraan 21 weerar ku qaaday doomo ay sheegeen in ay saarnaayeen daroogo, waxaana ku dhintay in ka badan 80 qof. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Maraykanku ma soo bandhigin caddaymo muujinaya in doomahaasi ay sideen daroogo. Dowladda Venezuela ayaa aaminsan in ujeedka tallaabada Mareykanka ay tahay in xilka laga tuuro Maduro, oo dib loo doortay sanadkii hore taasoo mucaaradka Venezuela iyo dalal badan oo shisheeye ay ku eedeeyeen in lagu shubtay. Maraykanku waxa uu sidoo kale u aqoonsaday Cartel de los Soles, ama Cartel of the Suns - koox ay ku eedeeyeen in uu madax u yahay Maduro - urur argagixiso oo ajnabi ah. Ku-sheegidda ururka inuu yahay koox argagixiso waxay siinaysaa hay'adaha sharci fulinta Maraykanka iyo kuwa militariga awoodo ballaaran oo ay ku beegsadaan oo ayna ku burburiyaan. Wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda ee Venezuela ayaa "si gaar ah, si adag, iyo gabi ahaanba u diidday" warkaas. Wasiirka arrimaha gudaha iyo caddaaladda ee Venezuela Diosdado Cabelo, oo lagu eedeeyay in uu ka mid yahay xubnaha sarsare ee ururkan, ayaa muddo dheer ku tilmaamay inuu yahay "hal-abuur". Waaxda arrimaha dibadda ee Mareykanka ayaa ku adkeysatay in Cartel de los Soles aysan ahay keliya mid jirta, balse ay "burburisay ciidamada Venezuela, sirdoonka, sharci dejinta iyo garsoorka".

War farxad leh oo ku socda dadka isticmaala teleefoonka iPhone , Malaayiin dadka isticmaala telefoonnada iPhone ah ayay suurtagal tahay in la siiyo lacag magdhow ah, kaddib markii la billaabay dacwad sharci ah oo lagu eedeeyay shirkadda Apple inay si qarsoodi ah u curyaamineyso waxqabadka taleefannadii hore. Justin Gutmann ayaa ku eedeeyay shirkadda inay ku marin habaabisay dadka telefoonnadeeda isticmaala kor u qaadista habka uu u shaqeeyo teleefanka laakiin ay culeys ka dhigtay. Ninkan wuxuu magdhow dhan 768 milyan oo ginni u raadinayaa ilaa 25 milyan oo isticmaaleyaasha iPhone ee Ingiriiska ku sugan. Shirkadda Apple waxay sheegtay in aanay "waligeed" si ula kac ah u gaabin inta ay jiri karaan alaabaheeda. Sheegashada, oo loo gudbiyay Maxkamadda Rafcaanka ee Tartanka, ayaa ku eedaysay Apple inay habka ay u shaqeeyaan iPhone-dii hore ay ka dhigtay kuwo gaabis ah, iyadoo u mareysa waxa loo yaqaan "throttling", si looga fogaado dib u soo celinta qaaliga ah ama dayactirka. Waxay la xiriirtaa soo bandhigidda qalabka maaraynta awoodda korontada ee qeybta ka ahaa cusbooneysiintii software-ka ee ku beegneyd Janaayo 2017, si wax looga qabto caqabado la xiriiray habka dhaqsiyaha teleefoonka, loogana joojiyo aaladaha duugga ah inay si lama filaan ah isu demiyaan. Sawirka, Gutmann ayaa sheegay in macluumaadka ku saabsan aaladda aan lagu darin sharraxaadda cusboonaysiintii software-ka ee xilligaas, iyo in shirkaddu ay ku guul-darraysatay inay caddayso inay hoos-u-dhigi doonto habka shaqada ee aaladaha. Waxa uu ku andacoonayaa in Apple ay soo bandhigtay qalabkan si ay u qariso xaqiiqda ah in beteriga iPhone laga yaabo inuu xamili waayay software-kii ugu dambeeyay ee iOS, iyo in halkii ay dib u soo celin lahaayeen teleefoonnada ama ay bixin lahaayeen beteriyo beddel ah, shirkaddu waxay ku cadaadisay isticmaaleyaasha inay soo dejiyaan oo telefoonnadooda ay ku cusbooneysiinta software-ka. Mr Gutmann ayaa yir: "Intii ay qaadi lahaayeen tallaabo sharaf leh oo sharci ah oo macaamiishooda u sameyn lahaayeen beddelaad bilaash ah, adeeg dayactir ah ama magdhow, Apple taa beddelkeeda waxay dadka ku marin-habaabisay inay u qariso casriyeyn software oo hoos u dhigtay aaladaha ilaa 58%." Noocyada ay sheegashadu xustay waa iPhone 6, 6 Plus, 6S, 6S Plus, SE, 7, 7 Plus, 8, 8 Plus iyo noocyada iPhone X. Waa sheegasho aysan macaamiishu u baahnayn inay si firfircoon ugu biiraan kiiska si ay u raadsadaan magdhow. Bayaan ay soo saartay, Apple waxay ku tiri: "Weligeen ma sameyn, mana sameyn doonno in aan si ula-kac ah u soo gaabinno muddada ay jiri karaan aaladaha ay soo saarto Apple, ama in aan hoos u dhigno khibradda adeegsadaha si kor loogu qaado macaamiisha. "Hadafkeena had iyo jeer wuxuu ahaa inaan abuurno alaab ay macaamiisheennu jeceshahay, iyo in aan sameyno iPhones-ka oo sii jiraya intii macquul ah, waana qayb muhiim ah." Sawirka, Sheegashada Gutmann ayaa ku soo beegantay labo sano kaddib markii kiis kan la mid ah lagu soo afjaray gudaha Maraykanka. Sanadkii 2020, Apple waxay oggolaatay inay bixiso $113 milyan si ay u xalliso eedeymaha ah inay hoos u dhigtay iPhones-kii hore. Soddon iyo saddex gobol oo Maraykan ah ayaa sheegay in Apple ay arrintan u samaysay si ay dadka isticmaala u iibsadaan qalab cusub. Malaayiin qof ayay saameysay markii noocyada iPhone 6 iyo 7 iyo SE ay shaqadoodu gaabis noqotay 2016 fadeexad lagu magacaabay Batterygate. Waqtigaas, Apple waay diiday inay ka hadasho. Silsiladaha maanseed ee hirgalay ee Kaaba billowday, oo marar kala duwan warbixinno ay ka samaysay BBC du ayaa waxa ka mid ahaa middii la magac-baxday IPHONE, tii kale ee WARDA XAASHI NINKEEDA, iyo qaar kale oo badan. Kaaba ayaa sidoo kale samaysay maansooyin tiro badan oo ay ku baafinayso calafkeeda mustaqbalka, iyada oo marba ku xusaysa deegaan ka mida kuwa soomaalida oo ay ka dhex goobayso cidda ay nolosha la wadaagi lahayd. Ujeedada ay ka lahayd ayaa ahayd iska madadaalo. Haddaba tixahaas magaca lamaanaha ay raadinayso ayay marar dhowr ah maansadeeda ugu yeedhay magaca Cabdi. Tixahaas ayaa waxa ka mid aha amid ay ku tidhi: Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Ayaan Axmed Caydiid Ayaan-kaaba ayaa barteeda Facebook laba maalmood ka hor oo ahayd maalinkii iidda waxa ay soo dhigtay sawirro ay ka soo qaadday saddex post oo ay hore u soo dhigtay barteeda facebuug saddex sanno oo kala duwan. Agoosto 10, 2019 kii oo imika laga joogo 5 sano ayay soo qortay posti sidan u dhignaa ‘‘Muddaan kali ciidayee kumee Cabdigaygiiyow”. Misna sannadkii kaa xigay oo ahayd, May 22, 2020 kii oo ahayd maalin ciid ah oo iminka laga joogo afar sannadood ayay barteeda facebuuga ku soo qortay weedhahan hoose oo la mid ah kuwii sannadkii hore uun. ‘‘Muddaan kali ciidayee kumee Cabdigaygiiyow‘‘. Isla sannadkii kaas midkii ku sii xigay maalin ciid ahayd ayay haddana ku celisay oo ay soo qortay hadal sidii oo kale u dhigan, oo magaca Cabdi uun ay ku baddashay ‘Calaf’. Weedhahaas ayaa iyaguna u qornaa cayn kan ‘‘Muddaan kali ciidayee kumee calafkaygiiyoow‘‘. Haddaba waxa yaab leh in dalka maraykanka oo ay dhawaan u guurtay Ayaan, ayna halkaa isku barteen iskuna guursadeen wiil magaciisa layiraahdo Cabdi, waa magacii ay sannaddo badan saadaalinaysay, sugaysay, kuna maansoonaysay iyada oo xitaa aqoon. Wariyaha BBC Siddiiq Burmad ayaa maalintii labaad ee ciidda la hadlay ka dib postiyadii ay soo dhigtay, waxaanu waydiiyay muddadaa dheer ee sannadaha ah ee macaga Cabdi ay maansooyinkeeda ku soo qaadanaysay, iyadoo ku tilmaamaysa calafkeeda mustaqbalka, in ay saygeeda hadda guursaday is yaqaaneen? ‘‘Maya, laakiin magaca Cabdi ayaan waligayba iska jeclaa‘‘ Ayaan oo sii sharaxaysa iyada iyo magaca Cabdi xidhiidhka ka dhexeeya ayaa tidhi ‘‘In aan magacaa iska jeclaa waligayba ka sokow, magaca Cabdi suugaantu way qaban ogtahay, oo waa magaca carrabka bulshada iskaga fudud, sugaantana u sahlan inuu hal qabsi u noqdo. Markaa waxa aan dhihi karaa, magaca Cabdi aniga oo jecel ayaa Cabdina yimi oo ilaahay ayaa isku beegay”. Ayaan oo aannu waydiinay, ‘‘haddii iidihii hore qoraallada aad soo baahinaysay ahaayeen, muddaan kali ciidayee, kumee Cabdi gaygiiyoow, ciiddan maxaad odhanaysaa‘‘ ayaa ku jawaabtay ‘‘Muddaan kali ciidayee, caawaba Cabdigaygiibaan, farxadda la cawaynayaa‘‘.

Haweeney 21 jir ah oo laga duubay xagal hoose oo muujinayay goonadeeda, ayaa sheegtay in aragtida sawirradeeda oo la soo geliyay iyada oo aan oggolaansho laga haysan ay si weyn u saamaysay, ilaa ay haddana ay dareento shaki iyo cabsi mar kasta oo ay guriga ka baxdo. BBC-du waxay aqoonsatay in ka badan 65 kanaal oo internet-ka ah oo soo bandhiga fadeexadaha noocan ah, kuwaas oo muuqaalladooda la daawaday in ka badan 3 bilyan jeer saddexdii sano ee la soo dhaafay. Muuqaalladu waxay diiradda saaraan habeen-baxyada magaalooyin waaweyn oo dunida, sida London, Oslo, Miami iyo Bangkok, balse mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu caansan waa maagalada Manchester ee dalalka Ingiriiska. Laba nin oo kale, oo sida ku cad barahooda bulshada fadhigoodu yahay Norway iyo Monaco, ayaa la arkay iyaga oo duubaya, balse ma aanan xaqiijin aqoonsigooda. Baaritaankeennu waa tusaale kale oo muujinaya haween lagu duubayo goobaha dadweynaha iyaga oo aan oggolaansho ama ogaal toona laga haysan, inta badanna faa'iido dhaqaale laga sameeyo. Maxaa laga yiri go'aanka Trump uu ugala noqday sharciga Soomaalida Minnesota ka difaacaya inaan la tarxiilin? Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay Jimcihii inuu si degdeg ah u joojinayo barnaamijka difaaca siinaya Soomaalida Maraykanka ee (TPS) isaga oo ku andacooday inay koox Soomaali ah ay argagax galinayaan dadka gobolka Minnsota. Barnaamijkan ayaa soo bilowday 1991 oo uu xilligaasi uu talada hayay madaxweyne xisbiga Jamhuuriga. ''Koox Soomaali ah ayaa argagax galinaya dadka gobolkaasi weyn, waxaana la waayay balaayiin doolar,'' ayuu Trump ku sheegay qoraal uu soo dhigay bartiisa bulshada ee Truth Social. ''Aniga, ka madaxweynaha Maraykanka ahaan, halkan ayaan ku joojinayaa, iyada oo dhakhso loo dhaqan galinayo, barnaamijka ilaalinta ku meel gaarka ah (TPS) ee Soomaalida Minnesota,'' ayuu yiri. Trump ayaa ugu yeeray Minnesota ''xuddun dhaqaale sharci daro ah oo lacag dhaqida ah'' oo hoos imaanaysa barasaabka dimuqraadiga Tim Walz, taas oo u muuqata inay tahay jawaab ka timid warbixino warbaahineed oo aan la xaqiijin, oo ay la wadaageen sharci dajiyayaal Jamhuuriyiin ah, oo sheegay kooxda mintidiinta Alshabaab ee Soomaaliya ay ka faa'iideystaan wax-isdaba marin ka dhacday Minnesota. Walz ayaa dhankiisa qoraal uu soo dhigay X ku sheegay ''Ma aha wax la yaab leh in madaxweynaha uu doortay in si guud u beegsado bulsho dhan. Tani waa waxa uu sameeyo si uu mowduuca u beddelo.'' Barnaamijka TPS ee Soomaalida ayaa la bilaabay wakhtigii madaxweynihii hore George H.W. Bush, bishii September 1991. Waxa ay siisaa difaac dowladeed dadka ajaanibka ah ee u qalma, kuwaas oo dalkooda si nabad ah ugu noqon karin, sababo la xiriira dagaal sokeeya ama musiibooyin dabiici ah. Ila iyo 17 dal ayaa u qalma barnaamijkan, waxase maamulka Trump uu ku dhawaaqay inuu ka joojinayo TPS dhow dal oo ay ku jiraan Venezuela iyo Nicaragua. Maamulka madaxweynihii ka horeeyay Trump ee xisbiga Dimuqraadiga Joe Biden ayaa kordhiyay u qalmida Soomaalida ee barnaamijka oo uu gaarsiiyay ilaa bisha Maarso 17, 2026. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Soomaalida Minnesota badankood waa muwaadiniin Maraykanka ah, waxaana jira oo kali ah 705 dad Soomaali ah oo haysta TPS, sida laga soo xigtay warbixin ay soo saartay adeegga cilmi-baarista baarlamanka ee dhinacna u janjeerin. Haddii la barbar dhigo, in ka badan 330,000 oo u dhashay Haiti oo haysta TPS iyo 170,000 oo ka soo jeeda El Salvador. Jaylani Hussein oo ah agaasimaha fulinta ee golaha xiriirka Maraykanka-Islaamka ee Minnesota ayaa isaga oo ay soo xiganayo wakaalada wararka Reuters sheegay in go'aanka Trump uu niyad-jab ku yahay, maaddaama Soomaalida su'aasha la galiyay ay ahaayeen muhaajiriin sharci ah, waxaana uu intaa ku daray in tallaabada Trump ay kala kaxayn karto qoysas. Musharaxii dhowaan u tartamay duqa magaalada Minneapolis, ahna senator heer gobolka ah Cumar Faatax ayaa bartiisa bulshada ku soo qoray ''Madaxweynuhu ma haysto awood uu kaligiis ku joojin karo barnaamijkan''

Saadaashada 2026 ee ay sii sheegtay haweeneydii saadaalisay dhacdooyin ay ka mid yihiin 9/11, burburkii Soofiyeetka iyo doorashadii Obama Ayadoo uu foodda nagu soo hayo sannadka 2026 magaca haweeneydan u dhalatay Bulgaria ee Baba Vanga mar kale ayuu aad u soo shaac baxay, waxaana aad u sii xiise galiyey sheekadeeda mowjad cusub oo naxdin leh iyo saadaalo gaar ah oo dul hoganaya. Sheegashooyinkan aadka loo hadal hayo oo ay ka mid yihiin makhluqaad aan dunida ku noolayn oo soo booqan doona ilaa iyo garaadka macmalka oo hogaan noqon doona iyo jahawareer juquraafi-siyaasadeed ayaa soo bandhigaya sawir cajiib ah oo la xiriira sanadka soo socda. Saadaashan sannadlaha ah waxay muujinaysaa xiisaha dadweynaha ay u qabaan wax sii sheegidda, waxayna daaha ka qaadaysaa shabakad sheeko-xariireed, sifooyin kala duwan, iyo wadciga xilliyadan jira oo lagu saadaaliyay hadallada haweeneydan waxyaabo ay hore u sheegtay la arkay. Fadlan halkan riix oo ku soo biir janalka WhatsApp ee BBC Somali si aad u hesho wararkii ugu dambeeyey ee caalamka, iyo kuwa gobolka Vangeliya Pandeva Dimitrova (1911-1996), oo loo yaqaan Baba Vanga, waa haneeney indhaha la' oo u dhalatay Bulgaria, waxaana lagu naaneysi jiray "Nostradamus of the Balkans." Waxay maqaam caalami ah ku heshay awooddeeda la sheegay inay saadaaliso dhacdooyinka waaweyn ee adduunka. Taageerayaasheedu waxay ku andacoonayaan inay saadaalisay dhacdooyin ay ka mid yihiin musiibadii nukliyeerka ee Chernobyl, weerarradii Sebtembar 11, iyo burburkii Midowga Soofiyeeti, sheegashooyinkaas ayaa sii kordhiyey waxyaabihii ay hore u sii sheegatay sannad kasta dhowr la soo bandhigayo, xataa ayadoo mootan tobanaan sano. Sida ay wararku sheegayaan, sumcaddeeda ayaa soo jiidatay marti caan ah, sida hoggaamiyihii hore ee Soviet Leonid Brezhnev. Waxyaabaha ay sida saxda ah u sii saadaalisay waxaa ka mid ah foolkaaneyaal muddo kumanaan sano ah aan dhaqdhaqaaq lahayn oo sannadkan qarxay sida foolkaanaha Itoobiya ee Hayli Gubbi oo qarxay Nofember 2025, dooarshadii Obama oo noqday maaxweynihii ugu horreeyey ee madow ah ee hogaamiya Maraykanka iyo geerideeda oo ku beegnayd bishii Agoosto 1996. Inta badan waxaa sheekooyinkeeda dunida u soo bandhiga dad aad ugu xiran saad aasheeda iyo gabar ay eeddo u tahay oo la yiraahdo Krasimira Stoyanova, mana jiraan qoraallo ay ka tagtay , Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Mid ka mid ah saadaasheeda 2026 ayaa isku xiisado ka dhaca dunida. Xiisadahaas waxa ka mid ah kuwo muddo dheer jiitama oo gaar ahaan dhex mara Yurub iyo Asia. Mid ka mid ah sheegashooyinka joogtada ah ee ku xiran saadaasha Baba Vanga ee 2026 waxay ku lug leedahay iskahorimaadyo caalami ah oo dheer, gaar ahaan Yurub iyo Aasiya. Waxay kaloo saadaalisay kala ja-jab ku imaanaya siyaasadda Yurub, xiisadaha milatari ee sii kordhaya oo dib u qaabayn doona is xulafaysiga caalamka. Arrimaha kale ee ay sannadka 2026 saadaalisay waxaa ka mid ah degenaansho la'aan siyaasadeed oo saamaysa Taiwan, Badda Koonfurta Shiinaha, iyo xadka Hindiya iyo Shiinaha. In kasta oo aan la sheegin dhacdooyin gaar ah ama waqtiyo, haddana sheekooyinka onlaynka ahi waxay muujinayaan isbeddelladan inay yihiin tilmaamayaal isbeddelaya nidaamka awoodaha caalamiga ee dunida ugu tunka weyn. Sheegashooyinka ugu yaabka badan waxaa ka mid ah fikradda ah in bini'aadmigu uu la kulmi karo nolol ka baxsan dhulka 2026. Diiradda cirka lagu eego ee loo yaqaano (ATLAS) ee dalka Chile ayaa sheaaca ka qaaday walax hawada sare lagu arkay Luulyo 2025, taas oo loo bixiyey 3I/ATLAS. Waxay ku socotaa khad aad u srreeya, taasoo xaqiijinaysa inay ka timid meel ka baxsan hanaan qorraxeedkeenna. Cirbixiyayaashu waxay sheegaan ay walax tahay ee aysan ahayn dayax-gacmeed. Inkastoo aysan jirin caddayn aad u taageereysa, haddana xogta qaar waxay shegaysaa in dahaarka dhulka ay walaxdaasi soo geli doonto bisha Nofember ee 2026. Sawirka, Fasiraad kale oo si weyn loo wadaagayo ayaa soo jeedinaysa in tignoolajiyadu ay ka gudbi doonto xakamaynta aadanaha. Inkasta oo Baba Vanga aysan waligeed si gaar ah uga hadlin garaadka macmalka, fasiraadaha casriga ahi waxay ku xirmayaan digniinaha ay hore u samaysay. Waxaa ka mid ah: Qalab is wada oo bedelaya qaybo badan oo xoog shaqaale ah, ku-tiirsanaanta mashiinnada, hhanaanka dhanka anshaxa ee ku guul daraystay inay la jaanqaadaan hal-abuurnimada. Saadaashani waxay noqotay mid dad badan soo jiidatay, ayadoo uu aaad u sii horumarayo garaadka macmalka iyo qalabka is-wada. Sheekooyinka aad la iskula dhex marayo waxay sheeganayaan in 2026 Baba Vanga ay sii saadaalisay dhulgariir, daadad, sunami, iyo dabaylo aaad u kulul. Dadka saadaasheeda rumaysan ayaa sheegaya in digniinahani ay ka tarjumayaan welwelka sayniska ee maanta jira ee ku saabsan isbeddelka cimilada, laakiin ma jirto caddayn la xaqiijin karo oo iyada ku xiraysa saadaasha cimilada gaarka ah ee sanadka. Xanta kale ee internetka lagu hadal hayo ee laga soo xigtay Baba Vanga ayaa ah in 2026 hogaamiyaha Ruushka uu door weyn ka cayaari doono arrimaha caalamka. Dadka isticmaala baraha bulshada fasiraaddan ku xiray madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin, iyaga oo tilmaamaya saameyntiisa caalamiga ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, fasiraadahan la isku xiray ayaa ah kuwo saadaasha haweeneydaas oo kaliya ku salaysan oo aan ku salaysnayn wax qoraal ah oo la soo xigtay. Saadaasha fayraska ee 2026 waxay ka yar tahay waxa soo socda iyo wax badan oo ku saabsan walaacyada hadda jira — tignoolajiyada, deegaanka, iyo isbeddelada awoodda caalamiga ah. Inkasta oo Baba Vanga's halyeyga waara, waxay ahaanayaan milicsi dhaqameed halkii ay ka ahaan lahaayeen hage la isku halayn karo.

Ciyaartoyda hibada leh ee Afrika oo ku sii badanaya horyaalka Sacuudiga , Ciyaartoyda Afrikaanka ah ayaa door muhiim ah ka ciyaari doona xilli uu xilli ciyaareedka horyaalka Pro League ee Saudi Arabia uu u sii gudbayo heerkiisa ugu sarreeya bisha May, iyadoo in ka badan 50 ciyaartooy oo ka kala yimid qaarada Afrika ay ku baahsan yihiin 18 ka kooxood ee heerkan. Ciyaartooyda qaar waa magacyo caan ka ah adduunka sida Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang, Sadio Mane iyo Riyad Mahrez, laakiin ciyaartoy badan oo aan caan ahayn ayaa sidoo kale horumaraya. Weeraryahanka Morocco Abderrazak Hamdallah, weeraryahanka Cameroon Georges-Kevin Nkoudou, weeraryahanka Gambia-ka Musa Barrow iyo Myziane Maolida oo Comoros ah ayaa dhamaantood ku biiray kooxda Aubameyang iyagoo dhaliyay goolal badan oo horyaalka ah. Marka laga yimaado suuqa wanaagsan ee Yurub, guulaha noocan oo kale ah waxay ka dhigan tahay in Sacuudi Carabiya ay hadda soo jiidaneyso ciyaartoyda Afrikaanka ah. "Waa nolol iyo dhaqan ka duwan laakiin haddii aad jeceshahay waxa aad samaynayso oo aad sidoo kale jeceshahay ciyaarta, wax walba waa in aad u hurtaa," ciyaartooyda reer Nigeria Henry Onyekuru ayaa sidaasi u sheegay BBC Sport Africa. Qeybta danbe ee garoonka, goolhayeyaasha sida Morocco Yassine Bounou iyo daafacyada ay ka mid yihiin Kalidou Koulibaly iyo William Troost-Ekong, oo labaduba kabtan u ah dalalkooda Senegal iyo Nigeria, ayaa muujiyay qiimaha ay leeyihiin . "Ciyaartoyda Afrikaanka ah si wanaagsan ayay uga socdaan Pro League, sababtoo ah cimiladu waa isku mid, waxaan la qabsanay kulaylka" ayuu yiri Troost-Ekong oo 31 jir ah, oo sidoo kale ah kabtanka naadigiisa Al-Kholood. "Inta badan waxaa jira kooxa waaweyn oo ciyaaraha ah kuwaas oo na siinaya fursad aan ku muujino awooddeena ciyaareed -xoogeena iyo xawaarahaba. "Guud ahaan Sacuudi Carabiya waa meel aad u fudud oo lala qabsan karo, gaar ahaan meel sida Nigeria oo kale ah oo kala bar dadka ku nool ay yihiin Muslim." Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Onyekuru wuxuu u soo ciyaaray kooxo ay ka mid yihiin Monaco, Galatasaray, Anderlecht iyo Olympiacos ka hor inta uusan u wareegin Al-Fayah bishii Agoosto 2023. Ka dib markii uu siddeeddii sano ee ugu horeysay ee xirfaddiisa sare ku qaatay Yurub, wuxuu aaminsan yahay in kooxaha Sacuudi Carabiya ay ka faa'iideysan karaan kuwa ka soo jeeda qaarada uu Afrika. "Habka Nolol nololeed iyo dhaqankuba ayaa caawiyay caawiyay," Onyekuru, oo 15 kulan u saftay Nigeria intii u dhaxaysay 2017 iyo 2022, ayuu yiri. "Ciyaartoyda Afrikaanka ah qaarkood aad bay u jecel yihiin goobaha lagu caweeyo laakiin halkan ma samayn kartid taas, halkan wax badan ayaad sameyneysaa tababarka ka dibna guriga ayaad aadeysaa ooaad ku nsaneysaan iyo daawashadao filimada,kadiban aad sugeysaa ciyaarta maalinta xigta, tababarrada iyo wixii la mid ah. "Waxyaabahaas oo dhan diiradda ayaa saari kartaa wax badan. Laakin halkan si fiican ayaad u seexan kartaa, si fiicanna waad u tababaran kartaa una ciyaari kartaa." Xilli ciyaareedkiisii ugu horeeyay ee UK, ciyaaryahanka garabka ka ciyaara ayaa dhaliyay 10 gool isagoo ka caawiyay Al-Fayah inay dhameystaan xagga sare ee ciyaarta, sidoo kale wuxuu siiyay xoojiyay Fashion Sakala iyadoo weeraryahanka Zambia uu dhaliyay 19 gool. Iyadoo dad badan oo Afrikaan ah ay la qabsan karaan nolosha Sacuudiga, Onyekuru wuxuu garwaaqsanyahay in caqabadaha qaarkood ay weli jiraan. "Makhaayada Afrikaana halkan kuma lihin, laakiin waanu maamulnaa. "Marka aan dalka ku laabano waxaan isku daynaa inaan cuntooyinka keensano halkan si aan ugu sameysano guriga, ma filaysid ciyaaryahan Afrikaan ah inuu cuno baasto maalin kasta." Tirada ciyaartoyda ajnabiga ah ee kooxaha Pro League loo ogol yahay inay la soo wareegaan ayaa kor u kacday ilaa iyo 10 ciyaartoy, iyadoo 8 ay ahayd xilli ciyaareedkii hore iyokii kasii horreeyay oo ay toddoba ahayd. Waxay ka dhigan tahay in ciyaartoydu ay kusii badanayaan nolosha boqortooyada. "Waxa aan wada sheekaysanay ciyaartoy badan oo Nigeria ah mar kasta oo aan wada joogno xulka qaranka," ayuu yiri Troost-Ekong, oo isagu laftiisu la hadlay Onyekuru ka hor inta uusan ka tagin kooxda Giriiga ee PAOK isagoo aaday Sacuudi Carabiya sannadkii hore. "Qaar badan ayaa xiiseynaya, hadda waxa aan halkaan joogaa in ka badan lix bilood, waxa aan ku siin karaa dulmar dhab ah, waxa anan ku dhiirigelinayaa ciyaaryahanno badan inay qaadaan tallaabadaas." Laga soo bilaabo tartamdooda Yurub iyo heerka caalamiga ah, qaar badan oo ka mid ah ciyaartoyda Afrikaanka ah ayaa horeyba isku yaqiin. Troost-Ekong waxa uu aaminsan yahay in ciyaartoyda oo is yaqaan ay gacan ka geeystay in la sameeyo "ixtiraam labada dhinac ah". "Waxa aan la ciyaaray anigaa ah ka tirsan kooxda kasoo horjeeda Franck Kessie, Riyad Mahrez, Sadio Mane iyo Kalidou Koulibaly,"oo ah daafaca dhexe ayuu hadalkiisa ku daray. "Mar kasta oo aan halkan ku arko aad ayaan ugu farxaa, midnimo iyo walaaltinimo dhab ah ayaa naga dheaxyesa. "Waxa aan ka nimd isku meel waxa aanan isku dayeynaa inaan gaarno waxyaabo isku mid ah." Sawirka, Halka koox kasta oo Pro League ay la soo saxiixan karto toban ciyaartoy oo ajnabi ah, laba ka mid ah kuwaasi waa inay dhasheen sanadkii 2003 ama ka dib. Sida uu lagu arkay suuqa kala iibsiga ciyaartoyda ee bisha Janaayo, tani waxay dhiiri galisay saxiixa ciyaartoyda da'yarta ah oo si toos ah uga imaanaya Afrika. Al-Kholood ayaa la soo wareegtay ciyaartoyda khadka dhexe ee Nigeria Ambrose Ochigbo oo ka yimid kooxda Tunisia ee ES Zarzis, halka Al-Qadsiah oo aan horyaalka usoo djhaweyn ay keeneen weeraryahanka 18 jirka ah ee Jerry Afriyie oo ka tirsan kooxda heerka labaad ee Ghana ee Thoughts FC. Afriyie, si kastaba ha ahaatee, wax hadal ah kuma yeelan doonto halka loo socdo koobka horyaalka, isagoo amaah lagu siiyay kooxda reer Spain ee CD Lugo. "Waxaan u maleynayaa in Pro League uu noqonayo mid soo jiidasho leh dhanka ciyaartoyda si ay tallaabada tooska uqaataan Afrika," ayuu yiri Troost-Ekong. "Ambrose iyo kuwa kale waxay dooranayaan inaysan marka hore aadin Yurub. "Marka aad ciyaartoy da'yar ka hesho, waxaad haysataa fursad aad ku horumariso, ku tababarto iyo in aad qayb ka noqoto mashruuca."

Sidee buu Jaajuuskan muddo dheer ugu dhex noolaa gudaha Maraykanka isagoo haybtiisa beddelay , Reproduction Bishii Maarso 31, 2022, Victor Muller Ferreira wuxuu duullimaad ka soo raacay garoonka caalamiga ah ee Sao Paulo ee Brazil. Waxa uu ku sii jeeday dalka Nederland, halkaas oo uu ka bilaabi lahaa tababar shaqo oo uu ku qaadan lahaa Maxkamadda Dambiyada ee Caalamiga ah. Laakin markii diyaaradii uu la socday ay soo degtay, waxaa la ogaaday inuusan dhab ahaan u dhalan Brazil, sida uu sanado badan sheeganayay. Hay'adda amniga qaranka Holland ee AIVD ayaa ku sheegtay inuu yahay 36 jir u dhashay Ruushka Sergei Vladimirovich Cherkasov. Waxaa lagu eedeeyay inuu basaas u ahaa hay'adda sirdoonka milateriga ee Ruushka ee GRU, waxaana lagu masaafuriyay diyaaraddii ugu horreysay ee dib ugu laabatay Brazil, halkaasoo isla markiiba lagu xiray. Hadda waxa uu Brazil ku qaadanayaa shan sano oo xarig ah kadib markii lagu helay in uu isticmaalay waraaqo been abuur ah. Booliska Brazil iyo FBI-da labaduba waxay ku sheegeen inuu yahay sarkaal sirdoon oo Ruush ah. FBI-da ayaa sheegtay in uu sidoo kale xog ka aruuriyay gudaha Mareykanka isagoo isticmaalaya aqoonsi Brazili ah oo been abuur ah. Cherkasov waxa uu qiray in uu yahay muwaadin Ruush ah balse waxa uu dafiray eedda ah basaasnimo. Laakiin hadda waxay u muuqataa in dhawaan dib loogu celin doono Ruushka. Dadaal diblumaasiyadeed ayaa loo sameynayaa arrintan iyadoo Moscow ay sidoo kale codsatay in loo soo gacan geliyo. Haddaba maxaan ka ognahay Cherkasov, muxuuse kiiskiisu nooga warramayaa sida hawlgallada qarsoodiga ah ee Ruushka loo qabto taariikhda maanta? Baarayaasha iyo dacwad oogayaasha Brazil ayaa sheegay in Cherkasov uu Brazil yimid 2010-kii uuna isticmaalay aqoonsi Brazili ah oo been abuur ah si uu uga shaqeeyo dalal dhowr ah, iyadoo dhammaan ay ka baxsanayeen hay'adaha sirdoonka shisheeye. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Ruushka ayaa muddo dheer ku takhasusay wakiillada sirdoonka kuwaas oo si buuxda u beddelaya aqoonsigooda dhabta ah iyo dhalashada si ay ugu noolaadaan waddan kale una dhexgalaan goobo tuhun laga qabo Ruushka. Habka tababarka saraakiisha sida samaynta aqoonsigooda been abuurka ah, iyo inay si buuxda u dhexgalaan bulshada ajnabiga ah waxay qaadataa sanado badan. Waxaa caadi ahaan loogu yeeraa 'wakiilada sharci darrada ah'. Dacwadda ka dhanka ah Cherkasov ee ay soo gudbisay Waaxda Caddaaladda ee Mareykanka ayey ku qeexday inay yihiin wakiillo sir ah oo loo diro howlo waqti dheer ah oo ka baxsan Ruushka iyagoo wata aqoonsi been abuur ah. Marka loo eego eedda, wakiilada sharci-darrada ah ee noocan oo kale ah waxay inta badan ka helaan shahaadooyin jaamacado ku yaal waddamada bartilmaameedka ah ama waxay ka qabtaan shaqooyin halkaas, si ay aqoonsigooda beenta ah ugu muuqdaan kuwo la aamini karo. Emily Ferris, oo ah khabiir ku takhasustay arrimaha Ruushka kana tirsan machadka Royal United Services Institute, ayaa sheegtay in 'wakiilada aan sharciga ahayn' ay ka duwan yihiin basaasiinta ku xiran ergada diblomaasiyadeed ee soo jireenka ah sababtoo ah diblomaasiyiinta iyo basaasiinta waxay ku raaxaystaan xasaanad diblomaasiyadeed, halka wakiiladani ay yihiin kuwo si buuxda u qarsoon. Sawirka, Justiça Federal de São Paulo Waxay sheegtay in nidaamkan uu soo jiray ilaa waagii Soofiyeedka. Tusaale ahaan 2010, "sirdoonnada (jiifa) aan hawlgalin" ee Ruushka ayaa haybtooda la aqoonsaday kuwaas oo ku noolaa Maraykanka toban sano ayagoo muwaadiniin Maraykan ah. Waxa ay sheegtay in Ruushku uu si gaar ah uga shaqaynayay sidii ay wakiilladan uga samayn lahaayeen dalal kala duwan, waxaana xusid mudan in ay weli ku hawlan yihiin hawlo kuwan la mid ah maanta. Laakiin shabakadaha basaaska ee Ruushka ayaa daciifay tan iyo markii Ruushku soo galay Ukraine. Dhowr wadan ayaa eryay diblomaasiyiin Ruush ah, halka dhowr basaasiin Ruush ah lagu qabtay Yurub, Waqooyiga Ameerika iyo Latin America. Sida laga soo xigtay Emily Ferris, tillaabooyinkani waxay si ku meel gaar ah u dhaawaceen shabakado basaasnimo oo ka dhex shaqeeya safaaradaha Yurub. Baaritaannada caalamiga ah iyo kuwa Brazil ayaa tilmaamaya in Cherkasov uu ka mid ahaa shabakad la mid ah oo adeegsanaysay aqoonsiga Brazil. Laga soo bilaabo 2022, ugu yaraan sagaal tuhmane ayaa la aqoonsaday kuwaas oo ka shaqaynayay wadamo kala duwan iyaga oo iska dhigaya Brazilian. Midkoodna laguma eedayn inuu basaasnimo ka waday Brazil. Brazil si fudud waxa ay ahayd dabool ku habboon oo loo adeegsaday nidaamka dukumentiyada debecsanaanta iyo dhexdhexaadnimada colaadaha caalamiga ah. Sida laga soo xigtay Emily Ferris Ruushku hadda wuxuu aad ugu tiirsan yahay wakiilada aan si toos ah ula xiriirin shabakadaha Ruushka. Sida shabakadaha basaasnimada lagu qariyo inay yihiin shaqaalaha safaaradda hadda way daciifeen, Ruushku hadda wuxuu u adeegsanayaa dadka maxalliga ah dhinac saddexaad. Sida laga soo xigtay iyaga, Ruushku wuxuu isticmaalayaa dadka maxalliga ah, oo inta badan lagu shaqaaleysiiyo baraha bulshada, si uu u carqaladeeyo nidaamka tareenada, u burburiyo khadadka sahayda ee Ukraine, iyo inuu qarxiyo bakhaarada. Dadkan waxaa badanaa keena hunguri dhaqaale ama badbaado, ee ma aha go'aan fikradeed, oo inta badan ma yaqaanaan cidda dhabta ah ee iyaga taageeraysa. Habka hawl-wadeennada maxalliga ah ayaa aad uga duwan kuwa "wakiilada sharci-darrada ah" sida Cherkassov. Sida laga soo xigtay Waaxda Caddaaladda ee Mareykanka, markii lagu xiray Brazil 2022, Cherkassov wuxuu haystay kayd kombiyuutar oo ay ku jiraan sheeko taariikheed been abuur ah iyo dukumentiyo loogu talagalay in lagu caddeeyo inuu yahay muwaadin Brazil ah. Sheekadan faahfaahsan waxaa laga yaabaa inuu qoray Cherkassov laftiisa qiyaastii 2010 wuxuuna bixiyaa aragti ku saabsan sida wakiillada qarsoon ee Ruushku isu aqoonsadaan. Sharaxaadda afarta bog ka kooban waxay ku bilaabmaysaa weedha ah, "Anigu waxaan ahay Victor Mueller Ferreira". Sheekadan been abuurka ah waxaa ku jiray tafaasiil faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan qoyskiisa, carruurnimadiisa, iyo maalmaha dugsiga. Tusaale ahaan, in hooyadii ururisay balanbaalis laakiin ay ahayd in ay iibiso dhammaan kaydkeeda si ay u daboosho kharashyada caafimaadka. Ama in dugsiga lagu caayayo lahjadiisa iyo muuqaalkiisa, isagoo leh "wuxuu u ekaa Jarmal ama gringo (Latin American), markaa ma aan lahayn saaxiibo badan." Midda kale waxay ahayd 'Aabbahay wuxuu ahaa nin saaxiib ah oo wanaagsan, laakiin waxaan ku eedeeyay geerida hooyaday iyo eeddaday iyo dhibaatooyinkayga'. Emily Ferris ayaa sheegaysa in maadaama tababarka iyo diyaarinta 'wakiil sharci darro ah' ay qaadato waqti badan iyo ilo, waxaa xiiso leh in Ruushku uu wali maalgelinayo mashaariicdaas qaaliga ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxay sheegtay in qaab dhismeedka sirdoonka Ruushka ay hadda dib u habeyn ku socoto, laakiin dagaalka ka socda Ukraine awgiis, dhaqaalaha ugu badan ayaa loo jiheeyay dhinaca hore, taasoo adkeyneysa sii wadida barnaamijyadan qarsoodiga ah. Sida laga soo xigtay Waaxda Caddaaladda ee Mareykanka, Cherkassov wuxuu u guuray Washington, D.C. 2018 isagoo marmarsiiyo ka dhiganaya waxbarasho sare. Waxaa la rumeysan yahay inuu shaqo barasho ka dalbaday Maxkamadda Caalamiga ah ee Dambiyada Sebtembar 2020, laakiin geeddi-socodku dib ayuu u dhacay cudurka faafa ee Covid awgiis. Sida laga soo xigtay waaxda sirdoonka ee Nederland, Cherkassov ayaa doonayay in uu ku sameeyo tababar aan mushahar lahayn magaalada Hague. Maxkamadda Caalamiga ah ee Dambiyada ayaa muddo dheer ahayd bartilmaameedka muhiimka ah ee sirdoonka Ruushka. Dhowr toddobaad ka dib markii la xiray, Ruushku wuxuu bilaabay faragelin buuxda oo uu ku hayo Ukraine. Tan iyo markaas, ICC waxay furtay dhowr baaritaan oo ka dhan ah Ruushka oo ku saabsan dambiyada dagaal ee Ukraine. Sannadkii 2023-kii, waxay soo saartay amarro lagu soo xirayo madaxweyne Vladimir Putin iyadoo lagu saleynayo sheegashooyinka ah in carruur si sharci-darro ah looga soo tarxiilay Ukraine lana geeyay Ruushka. Moscow ayaa ku tilmaantay eedeymaha iyo amarrada kuwo aan sal lahayn. "Helitaanka sirta ah ee macluumaadka ICC waxay noqon kartaa mid aad u qiimo badan adeegyada sirdoonka Ruushka," AIVD ayaa ku tiri hadal ay soo saartay. Haddii Cherkasov uu ku guulaysan lahaa inuu galo qolka maxkamadda, khubarada ayaa sheegaysa inuu wax u dhimi kari lahaa ama burburin lahaa caddaymaha. Sida laga soo xigtay Ferris, Ruushku wuxuu bartilmaameedsanayaa hay'ado kala duwan oo leh warar isbeddelaya. "Bartilmaameedka ugu weyn hadda waa Euroclear (bangi) iyo Bulgaria sababtoo ah taasi waa waxa ku jira warka, taasina waxay keeni kartaa waxyeello badan," ayuu yiri, isaga oo tixraacaya doodaha Midowga Yurub ee ku saabsan isticmaalka hantida la xannibay ee Ruushka. Inta badan hantida la xayiray ee Ruushka ayaa lagu hayaa Euroclear, taasoo fadhigeedu yahay Brussels.

Guidance: Recording the Natural World We must apply the same values of truth and accuracy to Natural History output as we apply to all BBC factual output. Audiences should never be deceived or misled by what they see or hear. In the same way that certain production techniques are acceptable when used in the making of factual programmes, similar ones can apply in the production of Natural History programmes. (See Editorial Guidelines Section 3 Accuracy: Production Techniques 3.4.25 – 3.4.26) There will be times when it is appropriate to share these production techniques with the audience, to increase their appreciation of the value of real sequences gathered in the wild and to distinguish the real sequences from material gathered in captive situations or controlled conditions. It is particularly appropriate to share this information about landmark series where there is a lot of interest from press and public alike. We normally rely on single camera location shooting to produce natural history programmes. This sometimes means when a programme is identifying or focusing on one named animal, it is not always possible to record all the necessary shots to produce workable sequences at one time. Where insufficient material of a significant natural event has been recorded it may be necessary to use additional shots or cutaways of the named animal recorded at a different time to the main action to produce a workable sequence. As long as the material depicts natural events in the animal's life cycle, it is perfectly acceptable to combine and compress events to tell a biological story truthfully. But we should not show action that is significant to the narrative of the film using shots of an apparently identical animal and portray it as the named animal. Where insufficient material of a routine natural event has been recorded, the use of additional shots of an identical (substitute) animal for insignificant bridging shots or cut-aways may be justified in order to produce a workable sequence. This is an acceptable artifice so long as the shots are used to illuminate the routine event and do not in any way distort its meaning. However we should not state that the shots are of the same animal and our commentary should never suggest the viewers are seeing something they are not. We aim to tell the life story of an animal or plant in many of our natural history programmes. Unfortunately the realities of survival in the natural world and/or the life span of the animal often mean it is impossible to film one individual from birth to death. We may therefore use footage of several different animals or plants to detail a life cycle as long as we do not mislead the audience into believing they are seeing the same animal throughout the programme, for example by giving the "composite" animal a name. Some of our wildlife films are anthropomorphic and tell dramatised stories of a fictional family of animals and their predators. This is an appropriate way of informing and entertaining viewers as long as the set-up is clear. For example, it may be appropriate to inform our audience at the start of the programme that what they will see, although dramatised, is based on scientific fact. When we aim to provide a portrait of animals or plants living in a particular place we can legitimately use material filmed at different times in that place so long as we are presenting a fair and accurate picture of events. It is not acceptable to film at one location and claim to be at another. We should also never introduce animals to a location that is not their natural home. It is sometimes impractical, unsafe or a danger to an animal or its offspring to film certain biological processes or behaviour in the wild. In such cases it is ethically and editorially justified to use captive animals to portray what happens naturally in the wild. But we must never claim that a captive sequence was recorded in the wild or in the actual location depicted in the film. Some Natural History films use stylised and visual devices, for example, in a programme illustrating principles of biology or ecology we may use time lapse techniques under laboratory conditions to show the audience what the eye can't normally see. Visual techniques like these can bring sequences to the screen that would be impossible to produce in any other way. The ability to digitally create, manipulate and copy audio-visual material, including still photographs, video and documents, poses ethical dilemmas and creates the potential for faking, hoaxing or misleading. We should ensure that any digital manipulation, including the use of computer generated images (CGI) or other production techniques to create scenes or characters, does not distort the meaning of events, alter the impact of genuine material or otherwise seriously mislead our audiences. Digital techniques should be clearly labelled or signposted in commentary if there is a risk of misleading or confusing the audience. All CGI or artificial manipulation should be flagged to the Executive Producer who should satisfy him or herself that it is acceptable before transmission. Reconstruction is a legitimate story telling device where single events based on corroborated personal testimony are re-enacted. It is a technique that should normally be labelled. Reconstruction is normally used when people or animals are involved and when the cameras were not present at the original event. If unlabelled, reconstructions should be differentiated in some way from the visual style of the rest of the programme such as using slow motion or black and white images in a consistent and repeated way. (See Editorial Guidelines Section 3 Accuracy: Reconstructions 3.4.30) There are very few recorded programmes which do not involve some intervention from the director, but there are acceptable and unacceptable production techniques. Unless clearly signalled to the audience, or using reconstructions, it is normally unacceptable in factual programmes to: Commentary must never be used to give the audience a misleading impression of events. (See Editorial Guidelines Section 3 Accuracy: Production Techniques 3.4.25 – 3.4.26 and Reconstructions 3.4.30) Simulations provide an impression of natural conditions or phenomena in which animals, and sometimes people appear, based on testimony and evidence normally compiled from different sources at different times. Simulations are legitimate when it would have been impossible to film the original event due to its rare or dangerous nature. When we include simulations we should consider using a variety of sign-posts to inform the audience about the techniques, for example presentation announcements, commentary, innovative post production techniques and labels in the body of the film, or, as a last resort, an explanatory caption in the end credits. Any proposal to use reconstruction or simulation in natural history programmes should be referred to the Head of the Natural History Unit. There may be occasions where re-staging routine events involving animals may be editorially justified and may not need to be labelled. However we should carefully consider all such interventions. Animal welfare is controlled by law which if broken could result in prosecution and criminal conviction. In the United Kingdom the following are just four examples of illegal activity: Clear editorial justification will be required on the rare occasions we broadcast graphic scenes of bullfighting, cockfighting and other similar activities, even if they are recorded in countries where they are legal. Any proposal to do so must be referred to a senior editorial figure or, for Independents, to the commissioning editor. (See Editorial Guidelines Section 5 Harm and Offence: Violence Against Animals and Animal Welfare 5.4.42) We should never be involved in any activity with animals which could reasonably be considered cruel - filming which may cause physical harm, anxiety, consequential predation or lessened reproductive success. However there may be times when in the public interest we may be justified in recording the harming of animals by third parties for the purpose of gathering evidence or to illustrate malpractice, cruel, anti-social or controversial behaviour. (See Editorial Guidelines Section 5 Harm and Offence: Violence Against Animals and Animal Welfare 5.4.42) We should seek expert advice and produce a detailed assessment of the risks and potential welfare issues for all proposed filming with animals. To achieve this we should consider the following: Scenes of an animal being killed should be handled with great sensitivity, especially if they are shown being killed by man. Even when such material is editorially justified it is likely to distress some viewers, so exactly how it is used will depend on the context and timeslot of the individual programme. Care should be taken on which shots are included, and it may be appropriate to avoid prolonged or close up shots, particularly when these show the moment of death or any suffering. It is useful to signpost in some way what is likely to happen, and in some cases, depending on the material, a warning may be considered. Xog cusub: Raysalwasaaraha Itoobiya oo maanta wax laga weyddiiyay heshiiyadii uu la galay Somaliland iyo Soomaaliya , Bloomberg via Raysalwasaaraha Itoobiya, Abiy Axmed oo la hadlayay baarlamaanka dalkiisa ayaa mar kale ku celiyay sida ay Itoobiya ku lumisay Badda Cas oo uu sheegay "in qaladaad sharci ah ay ka jiraan". Abiy waxa uu sheegay in go'aanka uu dalkiisu ku lumiyay marin-badeedka Badda Cas aanu ahayn mid ay gaadheen golihii wasiirrada ee waqtigaas, islamarkaana aanay jirin hay'ad sharci ah oo ansixiyay, baarlamaan meelmariyay iyo afti laga qaaday shacabka Itoobiya. "Itoobiya badda waxay ku wayday halgan qaatay 30 sano. Rafaad badan ka dib ayay weyday. 30 sano oo dambe in ay qaadan doonto uma malaynayo. Waddo xasilloon oo wadahadal ah in lagu socdo ayaa loo baahan yahay," ayuu yiri Abiye. Isaga oo ka hor hadlayayay baarlamaanka ayuu hadalkiisa raaciyay: "Markii aan rogrognay documentiyadii golaha wasiirrada wax ku jira ma leh. Golaha wasiirradu kama warqabin. Maya e' waxa ansixiyay golaha wasiirrada. Baarlamaanku waxba kama ogayn. Xitaa waxba kama jiraan in dadka Itoobiyaanka ah afti laga qaaday". "Annaguba xilligaas waan joognay. Sharci Itoobiyaan lagu ma ansixin". Sawirka, Intii uu socday fadhiga baarlamaanka ee dalka Itoobiya, xildibaanno ka tirsan Golaha Wakiillada Shacabka ayaa weyddiinayay weyddiimo toos ah. Waxa ka mid ahaa xildhibaanka mucaaradka ah ee la yidhaahdo Desalegn Chaneoo isaga su'aashiisu ay u dhignayd sidan: "Dawaldda qaabka ay wax u waddo waxa uu u muuqdaa mid aan natiijo lahayn. Markii kowaad, Eriteriya ayaa heshiis lala galay. Waxa la sheegay in dekadaheeda la isticmaalayo oo waxa la dayactiray waddooyinkii. Qaab aanaan ogayn ayaa loo joojiyay. Haddana, waxa heshiis lala galay Somaliland. Mar kale, Jabuuti ayaa lagu la heshiiyay horumarinta dekadda Tajoora. Jeer kalana, Ankara ayaa Soomaaliya lagu la kulmay. Laakiin natiijo la taaban karo laga ma soo hoyn... mudane, raysalwasaare, miyaanay ahayn in khaladaadkeenna aan wax ka baranno?" Ka jawaabista su'aalahaas iyo qaar kale, waxa uu raysalwasaare Abiy bixiyay sharraxaad ballaadhan oo ku saabsan rabitaanka Itoobiya ee ah in ay hesho marin-biyood in uu yahay in uu yahay mid sharci ah. Dhinaca kale, waxa uu codsaday in caalamku ay ka garaabaan oo ay qaataan door dhexdhexaadin ah. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Dhinaca kale, waxa uu farriin adag u diray Eretriya oo in muddo ah xidhiidh ka dhaxeeya labada dal aanu wanaagsanayn. Abiy waxa uu mar kale ku celiyay in aanay Itoobiya wax qorshe ah ka lahayn dagaal dhex mara iyaga iyo Eretriya. "Walaalahayo Erteriya waxa aan ugu baaqayaa, dagaal idin lama rabno, laakiin xabbad-gudbiyayaal ha noqonina. Dal noqda. Ma fiicna in dalal deris ah xabbad la isugu gudbiyo. Ka waantooba arrintaasi. Tuhun ma ah ee waan aragnaa," ayuu yiri Abiy. "Anigu waan rabaa sidii hadda ka horba aan sameeyay in aan Asmara tago. Dagaal ma rabno. Mashaariic balaayiin doollar ah ayaan ka shaqaynaynaa. Dagaal wakhti uma haynno. Haddii dagaal dhaco waa la yaqaan natiijadiisa. Wixii intaa ka dambeeyaana waa qaylo uun. Sidee qof isugu aamina karaa dal kale oo uu u dhihi karaa dal hebel baa i caawinaya, iyada oo la arkayo Ukrayn iyo Falastiin. Cid kuu dhimanaysaa ma jirto aan ka ahayn in niyadda laguu dhiso," ayaa uu raaciyaya hadalkiisa Abiy.

Lix xiddigood oo udub-dhexaad u ah Koobka Kubadda Cagta ee Haweenka Qaramada Afrika , Koobka Qaramada Afrika ee Haweenka 2024 (Wafcon) ayaa ka furmay Morocco 5-tii Luulyo. Koonfur Afrika ayaa dib u soo laabatay si ay u difaacdo horyaalkeeda, halka Nigeria oo sagaal jeer haysatay koobkan ay doonayso inay dib u soo ceshato koobkii ay qaadeen sannadkii 2018 kii. Kuwo cusub iyo ruug-caddaayaal kasoo jeeda Waqooyiga Afrikaba, BBC Sport Africa ayaa soo bandhigtay lix ka mid ah ciyaartoyda aadka indhaha loogu hayo inta uu socdo tartankan. Waxay hadda u ciyaartaa Bay FC ee Horyaalka Kubadda Cagta Haweenka Qaranka ee Mareykanka (NWSL), 30-jirka weerarka ah waxay soo kordhinaysaa khibrad hodan ah iyo maskax guuleed waxa uu noqon doono finalkeeda lixaad ee Wafcon. Ciyaaryahanaddan lixda jeer ku guuleystay abaalmarinta haweenka Afrika ee sanadka ayaa ka caawisay Super Falcons inay ku guuleysataan horyaalka qaaradaha 2014, 2016 iyo 2018, tan iyo markaas waxay sidoo kale laba jeer la qaadday Barcelona Champions League. Inkasta oo aysan aad u firfircoonayn goolka hortiisa tan iyo markii ay u soo guurtay Mareykanka, Oshoala wali waxay soo bandhigtaa inay tahay xiddig heer sare ah waxayna u badan tahay inay fure u tahay go'aaminta haddii Nayjeeriya ay dib u soo ceshan karto taajka Wafcon. Luvanga wax weyn ayey ku fakareysaa, iyadoo BBC-da u sheegtay inay dooneyso inay noqoto ciyaaryahanadda ugu fiican Afrika, waxayna horey labo jeer horyaalka Sacuudiga kula guuleysatay Al-Nassr. 20 jirkaan weerarka ka ciyaarta ayaa hubaal ah inay fursad u leedahay inay wax ka barato kuwa ugu fiican, iyadoo Cristiano Ronaldo iyo Sadio Mane ay ku jiraan liiska ragga kooxdeeda u dheela. Luvanga ayaa dhalisay 19 gool oo horyaalka ah xilli ciyaareedkii hore, taas oo ka dhigtay kaalinta afraad ee horyaalka Pro League ee Sucuudiga. Gooldhalinta dhammaan afarta kulan ee loogu diyaar garoobayo Wafcon ee Tansaaniya waxay caddaynaysaa inay leedahay fiiri dheeri si ay kula socoto xawligeeda iyo awooddeeda. Difaacayaasha ayaa ogaan doona awooda ay u leedahay in ay gadaal ka soo baxdo, laakiin ma joojin karaan? Qaabka weeraryahanaddan ee 2024 ayaa ka dambeeyey in loo magacaabay ciyaartoyga ugu qiimaha badan Champions League Haweenka Afrika, ayna ku guulaysato abaalmarinta ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican isku dhafka naadiyada ee Afrika. Gabadhan 25 jirka ah ayaa sidoo kale loo magacaabay ciyaaryahanaddii ugu fiicnnayd horyaalka Morocco xilli ciyaareedkii hore, ayadoo door muhiim ah ka qaadatay inuu AS FAR ku guuleysto koobkii 12aad ee gudaha. Mssoudy ayaa goolal dhalisay labadii rubac iyo semi-finalkii Wafcon ee u dambeeyay. Iyada oo farsamadeeda kubbadda adeegsanaysa, ma noqon u kartaa tusaale dhiirigelinta Atlas Lionesses si ay u soo afjaraan sugitaanka ay sugayeen guul qaaradeed inay gaaraan? Koonfur Afrika waxay rajo ka qabtaa gabadha gool dhalinta khibrada sare leh ee Seoposenwe - gaar ahaan ka dib markii Thembi Kgatlana oo ku guuleysatay kabaha dahabka ee Wafcon 2018, laga saaray kooxda sababo gaar ah. Sida Kgatlana, Seoposenwe oo ku dhashay Cape Town hadda waxay kubadda ka ciyaartaa Mexico. 31-jirka weerarka ka ciyaarta ee Monterrey ayaa noqon doonta mid ka mid ah shaqsiyaadka sare ee Banyana Banyana, iyadoo kulankeedii ​​ugu horreeyey u safatay Zimbabwe 2010kii. Iyadoo in ka badan 100 kulan ku saftay magaceeda, Seoposenwe ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay ka fariisan doonto ciyaaraha caalamiga ah ka dib Wafcon. Waa in ay si joogto ah shabaqa u soo taabato finalkeeda lixaad haddii ay Koonfur Afrika rajo ka qabto in ay difaacdo horyaalka. Afar jeer ayey u soo baxday isreebreebka iyadoo kooxdaas Galbeedka Afrika ay dhaafeen Jamhuuriyadda Bartamaha Afrika iyo Guinea si ay ugu soo laabtaan finalka markii ugu horreysay tan iyo 2018. 27 jirkan ayaa ahayd gooldhaliyaha ugu sarreeya ee Fleury ee horyaalka Faransiiska 2024-25, ayadoo dhalisay sagaal gool, iyadoo kooxdu ay ku dhameysatay kaalin ka baxsan boosaska isreebreebka Yurub. Qeyb ka mid ah kooxda Mali oo ku dhameysatay kaalinta afaraad ee muuqaalkoodii ugu dambeeyay ee Wafcon, Traore ayaa la sameynaysa iskaashi xagga weerarka oo xoogan Agueicha Diarra oo u dheesha PSG. Labaduba waxay rajayn doonaan inay ku celiyaan iskaashigii qaabka gooldhalinta ee ay adeegsadeen markii lagu jiray u soo bixista. Sawirka, Banda waa qof deggan, sahlan, ahna gooldhaliye fiican. Iyada oo 10 goor goolal ka dhalisay ciyaaraha Tokyo iyo Paris, ayey tahay gooldhaliyaha abid ugu sarreeya Afrika - lab ama dhedig - kubbadda cagta Olombikada, halka gabadha BBC-du u aqoonsatay laacibadda Kubadda Cagta Haweenka Sanadka ay ku dhameysatay kaalinta labaad ee kala sarraynta NWSL xilli ciyaareedkii hore, iyada oo qaadatay goolkii muhiimka ee Orlando Pride siiyey guushii 1-0 finalka Championship. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, 25 jirkaan weerarka ka ciyaarta ayaan weli wax gool ah ka dhalin Wafcon, ayadoo seegtay finalkii 2022. Kaalinta labaad ee liiska gabdhaha ugu qaalisan Afrika ayadoo ku jirta, Banda waxay dooneysa inay isku hagaajiso Moorooko.

Cabdifitaax Cali Cumar iyo Bollywood: Filimkii uu fikradda ka helay ninkii gabdhaha Muqdisho telefoonnada ka qaadanayay Cabdifitaax Cali Cumar, wuxuu maxkamadda horteeda ka qirtay inuu filim Hindi ah oo uu horay u daawaday ka soo bartay qaabka uu wax u dhici jiray. Toban sano oo xarig ah ayaa lagu xukumay ninkan ka dib markii lagu helay dambigii loo haystay ee ahaa inuu telefoonno ka dhacay illaa lixdan gabdhood, inkastoo isagu uu 30-ka mid ah qirtay. Ilaa lixdan gabdhood ayay booliska diiwaan galiyeen in ay dhibbaneyaal u ahaayeen Cabdifataax, balse qareenka u doodayay eedeysanaha ayaa maxkamadda horteeda ka sheegay in uusan dhicin tirada teleefoonnada ee lagu dacweeyay. Dacwadda ka dhanka ah ninkan ayaa socotay ka dib markii lagu soo xiray xog ay gudbisay mid ka mid ah gabdhihii uu telefoonnada uga qaatay sida layaabka leh. Isagoo ka warbixinaya qaabkii uu wax u dhici jiray ayuu Cabdifataax sheegay in xeeladda uu adeegsan jiray uu ka helay filim Hindi ah oo lagu magacaabo C Kkompany. Filimkan oo soo baxay sannadkii 2008 ayaa ka mid ahaa filimadii shactirada ee shirkadda Bollywooda. Jilayaasha filimkan hormuud u ahaa ayaa kala ah Tusshar Kapoor, Anupam Kher, Rajpal Yadav, Raima Sen iyo Mithun Chakraporty. Saddex ka mid ah atooreyaasha oo kala ah Tusshar Kapoor, Anupam Kher (oo ay Soomalida u taqaanno Aw Baska) iyo majaajiliiste Rajpal, waxay filimkaas ku jilayeen in ay yihiin saaxiibbo lacag doon ah oo culaysyo kala duwan ay haystaan, waxayna iska kaashanayaan sidii ay qaab khiyaano ku dheehan tahay ugu dhici lahaayeen dadka iyo xitaa dowladda. 29-kii bishii August, 2008 ayaa saleemooyinka laga sii daayay, balse wuxuu noqday filim ku guul darraystay box office-ka, dhaqaalihii la filayayna ma uusan soo xaraynin. Cabdifataax markii uu filimkan sharaxayay wuxuu sheegay magaca saxda ah ee filimka iyo qisada, laakiin wuxuu si khaldan u sheegay jilayaasha. "Wax qarsoon ma jiraan, waxaan rabaa in aan wax walba caddaynta runta ah ka sheego," ayuu yidhi. "Rag badan oo shaleemo soo gali jiray ama guryahooda filimo ka fiirsaday way joogaan. Filimkaasna waa la heli karaa, saddex nin ayaa atooreyaal ka ah. Saddex nin dad hubaysan ma ahan dowladdana waxay ka qaataan baad", ayuu sii raaciyay hadalkiisa. Cabdifitaax wuxuu sheegay in sannadkii 2008 uu ka tagay Muqdisho, oo uu muddo saddex sano ah joogay xeryaha qaxootiga ee Kenya.
