Tim Burton oo ah filim sameeye caan ah ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in internetka uu ka qaaday farxadda. “Qof kasta oo igaranaya wuu ogyahay in aan ahay qof tiknolojiyada ku xiran” ayuu BBC-da u sheegay 66 jirkan filimada maamula. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay markasta oo uu internetka galo in uu ka qaado welwel. “ “Cabsi ayaa igasha, waxaan dareemaya sida in aan jid mugdi ah qaaday, marka waxaan isku dayaa in aan ka fogaado sababtoo ah iima fiicna”. Tim Burton waxaa si weyn loogu yaqaan in uu ahaa ninkii ka dambeeyay filimada Batman, Edward Scissorhands iyo kuwa kale oo badan. Isagoo ka hadlayay sida uu u isticmaalo tiknolojiyada ayuu sheegay in si dhaqso ah uu ku welwelo, kana badan dadka kale. “Islamarka aan bilaabo in aan isticmaalo internetka waxaan dareemaa sida qof soo dhacayo”. Filim sameeyahan wuxuu sheegay in mashquulka sida in uu daawada darruuraha ay ka caawiso in uu dareemo fiicnaan. Taalooyin xawaanada Daynasoorka oo dhowr nooc ah ayuu qeybta dambe ee gurigiisa ku haystaa. Burton waxa uu joojiyay isticmaalka taleefoonkiisa gacanta. Meelaha lagu iibiyo muuqaalada xayawaanada ayuu ka soo iibsadaa si ay ugu galaan halkii uu taleefoonka ka isticmaali lahaa. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay in jilaaga caanka ee la yiraah Nicolas Cage uu haysto xayawaanka Danasoorka oo nool. Tim Burton waxa uu ku dhashay meel u dhow Los Angles balse waxa uu 20-kii sano ee la soo dhaafay ku noolaa magaalada London. “Wadankeyga ayaan ku noqday sida shisheeye” ayuu BBC-da u sheegay. “Markii aan London imid anigoo Ajnabi ah waxaan dareemay sida in ay dalkeyga tahay. Halkan waa meel aan ku dareemay deganaasho”. Markii uu yaraa Burton waxaa uu fakarkiisa ku sharaxi jiray farshaxanka, wuxuuna ku koray daawashada aflaanta argagaxa leh iyo kuwa bahalada taas oo dhalisay jaceylka uu u qabo waxyaabahaas. Tim wuxuu sheegay in aflaanta sida King Kong iyo Frankenstein ay ahaayeen kuwa dareenkiisa qaata. Wuxuu dareemay in cabsida dhabta ah aysan ka imaaneyn bahalada balse ay ka imaaneyso dadka tuulooyinka ku nool. Wuxuu bahalada barbardhigay internetka isagoo sheegay in kooxo aan wajigooda la aqoon ay ku gelinayaan cabsidaas. Wuxuu aaminsan yahay in xayawaanka sida daanyeerada ay inta badan ka naxariis badan yihiin bani’aadanka. Tim Burton waxa uu ka hadlay cabsida uu ka qabo garaadka macmalka AI, gaar ahaan marka AI-da loo isticmaalo in laga dhigo sida dadka. Wuxuu ku tilmamay taas in ay la mid tahay muuqaalka qofka oo la xado. Isaga wuxuu sheegay in ay uga dhigan tahay in wax uu shaqsiyan u lahaa laga qaatay sida in hal abuurkiisa la qaato. Wuxuu ku soo gabogabeeyay in hadda uu qabo dareen ah in waxyaabaha asaasiga u ah hal abuurkiisa la qaatay. Burton waxa uu ku bilaabay shaqada filimada Disney ka hor inta uusan sameyn filimka Batman ee soo abxay 1989-kii iyo Batman Returns oo soo baxay 1992-dii. Wax weyn ayuu ku soo kordhiyay filimada muuqaalada laga sameeyo. Mar la weydiiyay hadii uu sameynayo filim kale, wuxuu ku jawaabay si dhaqso leh maya. Wuxuuna sheegay in cadaadisa lagala kulmayo filim sameynta waqtiga hadda la joogo in ay ka duwan yahay sidii hore Burton waxa uu diiday erayga “Burton-shi” oo ah eray lagu tilmaamo guushiisa. Inkastoo eraygaas uu caan ku yahay in lagu tilmaamo waxqabadkiisa hadana isaga ma jecla. “Marna ma jeclaan ayuu yiri, ma doonayo in aan sheey noqdo”. Wuxuu sheegay in noloshiisa oo dhan uu ka shaqeynayay in uu sida bani’aadanka noqdo.

Raac talooyinkan si aad u ilaaliso caafimaadka caloosha , Bakteeriyada iyo kuwa kale ee ku nool gudaha xiidmahaaga waxay door ka ciyaaraan dhinacyo badan oo kamid ah caafimaadka qofka. Bakteeriyada waxtarka leh ee ku nool caloosha ayaa jirkaaga ka caawin kartaa inuu hagaajiyo shaqada difaaca, habaynta nafaqooyinka, heerka cunta cunidda qofka iyo wanaajinta fayoobida maskaxdaada. Haddaba xoojinta caafimaadka caloosha iyo dheefshiidka waxay ku xiran tahay in qofka uu wax ka baddalo hab nololeedkiisa, waa arrin qofka uu ku dhaqaaqi karo maalin kasta. Arrimaha deegaanka, sida cuntada, ayaa la ogaaday inay saameyn weyn ku leeyihiin hiddo-sidaha caafimaadka dhaqdhaqaaq jireed oo joogto ah. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in waxa aad cunayso aysan adiga kaliya ah nafaqo kuu aheyn, sidoo kale waxay nafaqo u yihiin oo ku tiirsan balaayiin noolaha Microbes-ka loo yaqaano ee aan isha qaban ee ku nool kuna koraya mindhicirada banii'aadanka. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad si dhakhso ah u beddesho bakteeriyada ku jirta mindhicirkaada, xitaa maalmo gudahood, laakiin waxay qaadan kartaa dhawr bilood iyo taageero joogto ah si loo muujiyo isbeddelada muddada dheer iyo faa'iidooyinka, ayuu yiri Dr Patel oo ah dhakhtar ku takhasusay arrimaha caafimaadka. Haddaba sidee baad u samaynaysaa arrintaas? Sawirka, Cuntooyinka sida khudaarta, miraha, digirta,lawska, iyo miraha oo dhan, waxa ku jira qolof-ta ay microbes-ka jecel yihiin. "Waxaan ku talinayaa in toddobaad kasta la cuno 30 khudaar ah iyo miraha kala duwan," ayuu yiri Dr. Megan Rossi, oo qaabilsan caafimaadka mindhicirada. Mindhicirka caafimaadka leh waxaa ku nool microbes kala duwan, mid kastaa wuxuu door bidaa cuntooyin kala duwan, sidaa daraadeed noocyada badan ee aad cunayso, bakteeriyada waxay ku koraan mindhicirkaaga. Cunista miraha iyo khudaarta ayaa faa'idooyin u leh caafimaadka qofka, waxay qofka siineysaa maadooyinka phytochemicals, kuwaas oo gacan ka geysan kara kordhinta noocyada bakteeriyada ku nool xiidmaha qaarkood. Noocyada cuntooyinka qolofta leh iyo karbohaydraytyada qaarkood ayaa si gaar ah kor ugu qaada koritaanka bakteeriyada wanaagsan ee mindhicirka. taas oo loo yaqaan cuntooyinka prebiotic. Mooska, basasha, toonta, caleenta, miraha, dhir iyo canabku waa dhammaan cuntooyinka leh prebiotics. Cuntooyinkan waxa beddelay nooleyaal yaryar, sida bakteeriyada iyo khamiirka (Yeast), waxay xoojiyaan dhadhanka ama waxay ilaaliyaan tayada cuntada. Cuntooyin badan oo khamiir leh ayaa nafaqo leh sababtoo ah waxay ka kooban yihiin fiitamiin, macdan, iyo nafaqooyin, sida borotiin, iyo dufan, kuwaas oo lagama maarmaan u ah caafimaadka qofka. Sawirka, Professor Tim Spector, oo ka tirsan King's College London, ayaa dadka ku taliyay in la xaddido cuntooyinka sida aad ah loo soo warshadeeyay. Sida ay xulbadu u caawiso ragga iyo dumarka , Xulbadu waa dhir-daweed waxtar badan leh waxaa ka buuxo borotiin waxayna leedahay faaido nafaqo oo aad balaaran. Waxaa afk-Soomaaliga lagu dhahaa xulbad, waxa uuqadda Ingiriisida lagu dhahaa (Fenugreek) magaceeda sayniskana waxa la dhaha (Trigonella foenum-graecum). Xulbaddu waa xubin ka mid ah qoyska Fabaceae botanical waxayna isku faamli yihiin digirta, lawska, Iyo biinaska. Xulbaddu waxay asal ahaan kaso jeeda Koonfur-Bari Yurub iyo Galbeedka Aasiya, hadda waxa lagu beeraa waddamo badan sida India, Argentin, Masar iyo wadamada Mediterraneanka, Koonfurta France, Morocco iyo Lubnaan. Xulbadu waa mid ka mid ah dhirta ugu da'da weyn ee daawo ahaan loo isticmaalo, wadamada ugu badan ee u isticmaalana waxa ka mida Hindida iyo Shiinaha. Sawirka, 6.4 garaam oo kaarbohaydareed ah 21 miligaraam oo macdanta magnesium ah 32.6 miligaraam oo foosforas ah Faa’iidooyinka Caafimaad ee Xulbada Sawirka, Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. - Waxay sare u qaaddaa caafimaadka wadnaha. Milkiilaha Anne Danahy, RDN, ayaa sheegtay in maadada birta ee ku jirta xulbadda ay ka dhigayso cunto faa'iido u leh caafimaadka wadnaha. "Dadka intooda badan waxay ka fikiraan hilibka marka ay ka fikiraan cuntooyinka qani ku ah birta, laakiin sidoo kale waxay ku jirtaa dhirta iyo miraha sida xulbadda," ayay tiri Anne Danahy. Macdanta iron-ta kujirto 100 grams oo xulbada waxay labojibaar kabadantahay xaddiga jirku ubaahanyahay maalintii. -Xulbadu waxay caawiisaa dhibaatooyinka dheefshiidka sida calool fadhiga iyo calool xanuunka. Waxay u fiicantahay Caloosha oo waxa kujiro xaddi badan oo ah maadada faybarka (fiber) ah. -Xulbada waxaa ku jira maaddooyin si weyn ula dagaalama caabuqa, sidaa awgeed waxa ay si aad ah u yaraysaa caburka iyo san xiranka sidoo kale xulbaddu waxa ay soo nadiifisaa gudaha hore ee dulka sanka, waxa aanay sideedaba u yaraysaa malaxda badan ee dulka ku abuurmaysa. Xulbada waxaa lagu daaweeyaa caabuqa qumanka. Xulbadu waxay hagaajisaa shaqada iyo rabitaanka galmada ee ragga. Waxay ragga ka caawin kartaa kordhinta testosterona-ka iyo kordhinta tirada shahwada. Xulbada waxaa lagu daaweeya nabraha ku samaysma dadka sonkorta qabo. Sawirka, Xulbada waxay korisaa timaha, Sidoo kale waxayna ka ilaalisaa siibmidda iyo go’idda. Faaidooyinka saliida xulbadu ay leedahay waxaa ka mid ah in hooyada naaska nuujiso ay caano badan u keento, haweenka caadada ku xanuunsadane in ay ka khafiifiso oo si sahlan uga timaado. Cilmibaaris badan aya lagu sheegay in xulbadu ay badiso caanaha hooyada maadama ay leedahay nafaqo aad ubadan Xulbadu waxay faaido fiican u leedahay gabdhaha caatada xilliga qaangaarka maadaama ay sare u qaaddo hormoonada jirkooda ku jiro waxayna furtaa abitaytka. Digniin: Xulbada isticmaalkeedu waxa uu khatar ku keeni karaa dumarka uurka leh maadaama oo xulbaddu soo ururiso ilmo galeenka. Waxay xoojisaa shaqada Maskaxda: waxa kujiro xaddi badan oo vitamin B complex oo ka qayb qaadato shaqada neerfaha iyo samaysanka fariin wada yaasha neerfaha sida serotonin iyo gamma aminobutyric acid. Waxay leedahay Tamar (energy) aad ubadan maadaama uu kujiro kaarboheydareyt badan.

Wiil Soomaali ah oo Hindiya loogu sameeyey qalliin xubinta taranka ah "oo lagu guuleystay" , Wiil Soomaaliyeed oo 19 jir ah, oo xubintiisa taranka ku waayay caabuq daran oo ka dhashay gudniin lagu sameeyey carruurnimadiisii, ayaa si guul leh loogu sameeyay qalliin dib abqaalid ah ama beerid ah, kaas oo ka dhacay Isbitaalka Medicover ee magaalada Hyderabad ee dalka Hindiya. Qalliinkan oo socday in ka badan 10 saacadood ayaa dib loogu soo celiyey shaqadii kaadida iyo awooddii galmada, taasoo soo afjartay sannado badan oo murugo iyo dhibaato jidheed iyo maskaxeed ah oo uu la noolaa wiilkani, sida ay ku warrameen warbaahinta gudaha ee Hindiya. Qofka bukaanka ah ayaa sannado badan la daalaa dhacayay dhaawacyo culus oo ka dhashay gudniinkiisii carruurnimo, taas oo keentay in uu u raadsado xal caafimaad dalal kala duwan ah oo dibedda ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dadaalkiisii hore ayaan midho dhalin, waxaana markii dambe uu go'aansaday inuu tago dalka Hindiya si loogu helo xal waara. Baaritaanka caafimaad ee la sameeyay ayaa muujiyay in caabuqii ka dhashay gudniinkiisa carruurnimo uu sababay burbur xun oo keenay inuu gebi ahaanba waayo xubintiisa taranka. Waxa kale oo uu lahaa dhibaato dhanka kaadida ah oo ka dhalatay dhagxaan samaysmay, taasoo sii murjisay xaaladdiisa. Koox dhakhaatiir ah oo uu hogaaminayay Dr. A.V. Ravi Kumar, khabiir sare oo dhanka kaadi-mareenka iyo cudurrada ragga ah, iyo Dr. Dasari Madhu Vinay Kumar, dhakhtar ku takhasusay qalliinnada dib-u-dhisidda iyo qurxinta, ayaa si taxaddar leh u diyaariyay qorshaha qalliinka, sida warbaahintu ka soo xigatay cisbitaalka. Sawirka, Medicover Hospitals Tallaabada koowaad ee daaweynta ayaa ahayd in la nadiifiyo marinada kaadida, lagana saaro dhagxaantii xannibay. Taas oo markii ay xaalad caadi gaadhay, ay dhakhaatiirtu guda galeen qalliinka dib-u-dhisidda xubinta taranka. Si loo dhiso xubinta cusub, dhakhaatiirtu waxay adeegsadeen maqaar, xididdada dhiigga, neerfaha iyo unugyada laga jaray cududda bukaanka. Dr. Ravi Kumar ayaa sharxay in cududda ay tahay meesha ugu habboon ee laga qaado unugyada maqaarka maadaama ay u eg tahay maqaarka xubinta taranka, halka lugta—oo ah meel kale oo la isticmaalo—aysan ku habboonayn kiiskan maadaama maqaarkeedu uu ka dhumuc weynaa, taasoo ka dhigi lahayd mid aan si sax ah loo qaabeyn karin. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Intii lagu guda jiray qalliinkan lagu magacaabo microvascular-ka oo socday 10 saacadood, dhakhaatiirtu waxay si taxaddar leh ugu isugu rakibeen xididdada dhiigga, neerfaha iyo unugyada si ay u dhisaan xubinta cusub. Waxa kale oo la sameeyay marin cusub oo kaadi-mareen ah, iyada oo laga dhigay xubin caadi ah oo la isticmaali karo, hadday tahay dhanka kaadida iyo awoodaheedii kaleba. Dr. Dasari Madhu Vinay Kumar ayaa xaqiijiyay in qalliinku si guul ah u dhacay, isagoo warbaahinta gudaha u sheegay: "Bukaanku hadda si caadi ah ayuu u kaadin karaa, sidoo kale xubintiisa cusub waa la dhisay, waxaana lagu rakibay qalab ka caawiya inuu galmo sameeyo (penile implant). Waxa uu dib u helay dareenkii, wuxuuna awood u yeelan doonaa nolol caadi ah" ayuu yiri. Bukaanka, oo intii lagu guda jiray sanadkii lasoo dhaafay galay saddex ilaa afar qalliin, ayaa hadda si buuxda u bogsaday, waxaana la filayaa in uu isbitaalka ka baxo maalmaha soo socda. Waxaana warbaahintu ay ka soo xigatay in uu sheegay in uu haatan dareemayo in culays badani ka degay: "Sannado badan, waxaan ahaa qof murugaysan, oo dareemaya inuusan dhammaystirnayn. Maanta, waxaan dib u helay sharaftaydii, kalsoonidaydii, iyo fursad aan nolol caadi ah ku noolaado" ayuu yiri bukaanka oo warbaahinta iyo isbitaalkuba ay ka gaabsadeen inay magaciisa sheegaan. Qalliinkan guuleystay wuxuu calaamad u yahay horumarka caafimaad ee dib-u-dhisidda xubnaha jirka, isagoo rajo cusub u abuuraya dadka la tacaalaya dhibaatooyinka la xiriira dhaawacyada xubnaha taranka.

Qaxooti ilaa Tababare kooxeed: Waayaha Macallin Miron Muslic oo Liverpool ka soo afjaray koobka FA Cup-ka Tababaraha kooxda heerka labaad ee Ingiriiska Plymouth Miron Muslic ayaa gaaray wax ay dad badan oo kubada cagta ah u maleeyeen inaysan macquul aheyn ka dib markii uu kooxdiisa ku hoggaamiyey guul weyn oo ay ka gaareen kooxda ugu sarreysa horyaalka Premier League ee Liverpool ciyaar ka tirsanayd FA Cup-ka. Gool ku laadkii ama rigooradii Ryan Hardie, ayaa ku filnaatay inuu xaqiijisto wareega afaraad iyagoo ku ciyaarayo garoonkooda Home Park Axadii. "Waxay noo ahay maalin la yaab leh annaga, waxaan u sheegay ciyaaryahanadayda inay ku raaxaystaan, hadda waxaan qayb ka nahay taariikha Argyle," ayuu yiri Muslic. "Dhammaanteen waxay noo tahay maalin weyn, si uun waxaan dareemayaa inaan u qalano maalintaan. "Anigu hadal la'aan ayaan ahay, caadiyan, waxay ii sheegaan inaan ahay aftahan, waa daqiiqad faan ah, waa maalin weyn." Marka la barbardhigo sheekada bilawga nolosha tababare Muslic, garaacistiisa kooxda lixdka jeer ku guulaysatay horyaalka Yurub ee champions league ee Liverpool ayaa laga yaabaa inay dareemayso fudayd. Tababare Muslic ayaa xilka tababarnimo kala wareegay halyeeygii Ingiriiska Wayne Rooney bishii hore. Muslic, ayaa sanadkii 1992-kii, isagoo sagaal jir ah, lagu qasbay inuu ka cararo magaaladii uu ku dhashay ee Bihac ee dalka Bosnia. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Waxay ka baxeen waqtigii ugu habboonaa. Bishii Juun 1992, hal ama laba bilood ka dib markii qoyska Muslic uu ka tagay Bihac, magaaladaasi waxay gashay qalalaase seddex sano ah oo ay hoggaaminayeen ciiamadii Serbiyiinta intii uu socday dagaalkii sokeeye ee xumaa. "Waxaan ka baxday Bosnia iyo Bihac, magaalaydii Runtii xiili habeen ah, anangoo alaabtayada iy wixii an awoodnayba gacmaha ku sidana," ayuu si xoog leh ugu sharaxay BBC Sport. "Halkaa ayay safarkayagii, ama noloshayadii cusub, ka bilaabmatay." Muslic, walaashiis iyo waalidkii waxay u qaxeen meel 400 mayl (650km) u jirta halkii ay ka soo carareen oo ah Innsbruck oo ku taalla Austria iyaga oo aan wax fikrad ah ka haysan waxa ay heli doonaan mana awoodin in ay ku hadlaan luqadda lahjadda Jarmalka ee maxaliga ah, taas oo gaar ahaan ay adagtahay in la fahmo. "Waan ku dhibtoonnay nolosheenna oo dhan, qaybtan halgankana waa qayb ka mid ah safarkayga, waana sababta aan had iyo jeer u ahaado mid rajo leh oo aad u wanaagsan," ayuu yiri Muslic. "Waxa aan ku jiray xaalado aad u adag oo noloshayda ah intii aan noqon lahaa tababaraha kooxda oo aan wajahayo bar-baro suurtagal ah ama guuldarada todobaadka. , "Taasina sidoo kale waa fariinta aan rabo inaan si joogto ah ugu gudbiyo ciyaartoyda, in noloshu ay tahay halgan la yaab leh oo qurux badan, mar walbana waxaa jira wax mudan in loo dagaalamo. "Wax fudud aniga, ama qoyskeyga ama walaashay ma jirin, waxaan noqonnay qaxooti, mana ahan wax qurux badan, laakiin waligey ma dareemin inaan wax tabayay noloshayda. "Waalidkay aad ayay isugu dayeen inay na siiyaan waxyaabaha aan u baahanahay - aabahay wuxuu shaqeeyay in ka badan 30 sano oo mudalab ah, hooyaday waxay ahayd haweeney nadaafadda ka shaqaysa, waxayna aad isugu dayeen inay na siiyaan nolol wanaagsan. "Dhammaan waxyaalihii dhacay 30-kii sano ee la soo dhaafay waxay iga caawiyeen inaan noqdo qofka aan maanta ahay oo aan sidoo kale gaaro waxyaabo aan suurtagal ahayn. "Laakiin ma jiraan wax aan macquul aheyn haddii aad si dhab ah u aaminsan tahay, haddii ay ka gonaato, haddii aad ku qanacsan tahay iyo haddii aad si dhaba u aadoo, dhab ahaantii si buuxda." Waa sidaas aaminaaddaas iyo ka go'naaanshahaas ay Argyle tuseen inay ka badin karaan Liverpool kuwaas oo meel sare ku dhammaystay kooxaha horyaalka yrurub iyo iyagoo lix dhibcood o ku hoggaaminaya horyaalka Premier League intii maamulayo Arne Slot. Sawirka, Rex Features Marka lagu daro wuxuu sidan fiican ku bilowday iyadoo difaacisii wanaagsanaa Lewis Gibson, iyo weerarkiisa qaybta hore Morgan Whittaker, ay ka tageen intii lagu jiray xilliga suuqa kala iibsiga. Laakiin, sida noloshii hore ee Muslic ee Austria, caleemaha soo kabashada ayaa si fiican uga soo bixi kara isaga hoostiisa kooxda Argyle. Xiisaha Muslic waa mid cad qof kasta oo la kulmo. Waa nin indhihiisu bir yihiin laakiin aad u diirran oo soo dhawayn leh, awoodna u leh in maamulo qolka si uu qofkasta ka arki karo muuqaalka marka ugu horreysa ee la hadlayo ciyaartooyada kooxdiisa Argyle. Waxaas oo dhami waxay ka turjumayaan raadraaciisa"Waa qeexida qofka aan ahay maanta tababare ahaan, laakiin tan ugu muhiimsan, qofka aan ahay maanta bani'aadam ahaan," ayuu ka yiri noloshiisii hore. "Haddii aan eego qolka labiska ee Argyle, waa wiilal ka yimid adduunka oo dhan, wayna shaqeysaa," ayuu yiri. "Haddaba qiyaas adduunku inuu yahay qolka labiska; waxay ahaan lahayd meel wanaagsan oo la joogo."

Xaflada caleemasaarka Trump, waxaa ka qayb galay madax hore oo Maraykana, dad magac leh oo ay ka mid yihiin Elon Musk, iyo Mark Zuckerberg, Jeff Bezos,Tim Cook ,Sundar Pichai iyo Ra'iisul wasaarihii hore ee UK Boris Johnson. Dhaarinta ka dib Madaxweyne Trump ayaa jeediyey khudbad dhinacyo badan taabanaysay oo uu kaga hadlay arrimaha miiska u saaran ee hortabinta u leh marka uu fariista kurisga Aqalka Cad kuwaas qaar ka mid uu horrey uu u balan qaaday inuu samayn doono maalintiisa ugu horreysa ee xilka la wareego. Waxybaaha uu ka hadlay waxaa ugu weynaa arrimaha xaduudaha, siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda, dhaqaalaha, iyo dhismaha Maraykan awood badan. Ganacsiga: Trump waxa uu sheegay in uu si degdeg ah u bilaabi doono dib u habeynta ganacsiga, iyo in uu dhisayo "Adeegga Dakhliga Dibadda" si ay u ururiyaan dhammaan canshuuraha iyo dakhliga. Wuxuu sheegay in dakhligaas uu ka imaan doono "ilo shisheeye". "Riyada Maraykanku mar dhow way soo noqon doontaa waxayna u fiicnaan doontaa si aan hore loo arag," ayuu yiri. "Kadib sanado iyo sanado aan sharci ahayn iyo xayiraad aan dastuuri ahayn oo ku saabsan hadalka, waxaan sidoo kale saxiixi doonaa Amarka Fulinta si aan u joojiyo dhammaan faafreebka oo aan u soo celiyo xoriyada hadalka Ameerika," ayuu yiri. Waxa uu u sheegay dadweynihii ka soo qaybgalay xaflad, "Waxaan si degdeg ah u bilaabi doonaa dib u habeynta nidaamkayaga ganacsi si aan u ilaalino shaqaalaha iyo qoysaska Maraykanka. Halkii aan canshuur ka qaadi lahayn muwaadiniinteena si aan u hodminno wadamada kale, waxaan canshuur iyo canshuuro ku canshuuri doonaa wadamada shisheeye si aan u hodmino muwaadiniinteena." Xaduudaha: Trump ayaa faahfaahinayey qaar ka mid ah tallaabooyinka fulinta ee uu qorsheynayo inuu qaado hadda oo uu madaxweynaha yahay. Maanta, ayuu saxeexi doonaa amar fulineed oo ku dhawaaqaya xaalad degdeg ah oo qaran oo ka dhacda xuduudka Maraykanka iyo Mexico. Dhammaan gelitaanka sharci darrada ah "isla markiiba waa la joojin doonaa" ayuu yidhi, isaga oo intaa ku daray in dawladdu ay bilaabi doonto hannaanka dib loogu celinayo malaayiin "shisheeye dambiilayaal ah" halkii ay ka yimaadeen. Trump wuxuu khudbadiisii ugu horeysay uu ku weeraray maamulka Biden iyo sida uu u maareeyey dhibaatada soogalootiga. Waxa uu sheegay in caqabadaha dalka ka jira ay "dabar goyn doonaan", isaga oo intaa ku daray in Maraykanku uu wajahayo qalalaase ah "kalsoonida xagjirnimada iyo aasaaska musuqmaasuqa". Maamulkii hore, ayuu yiri, wuxuu hoy iyo ilaalin u fidiyay "dambiilayaasha halista ah" ee sida sharci-darrada ah ku soo galay dalkeena. Trump wuxuu sheegay isagoo ka hadlayey kanaalka Panama, "hadyad nacasnimo ah oo ay ahayd inaan waligood la samayn" Panama, ayuu yiri. "Ma aynaan siin Shiinaha. Dib ayaan u soo celinaynaa," ayuu sheegay Trump. Gunaanadkii khudbada uu jeediyey ayuu mahadnaq u jeediyey dadka Maraykanka Trump, waxa uu qiray dib u soo laabashadiisa siyaasadeed waxana uu yiri "Dadka Maraykanku way hadleen". "Waxaan hortiina u taaganahay caddayn inaan marnaba rumaysan in wax aan macquul ahayn in la sameeyo. Ameerika, samaynta wax aan macquul ahayn waa waxa ugu fiican," ayuu yiri Trump. Wuxuu hadalkiisa ku soo gaba gabeeyay in Ameerika aan la qabsan doonin oo aan la cabsi gelin doonin "Ma guuldareysan doono, laga bilaabo maanta, Mareykanka wuxuu noqon doonaa qaran xor ah, madax-bannaan iyo madax-bannaan," "Mustaqbalka annagaa leh, casrigeenna dahabiga ahna hadda wuu bilaabmay."

Sheekadii xalay laacibka Ronaldo iyo Donald Trump ku dhex martay Aqalka Cad Xiddiga kubadda cagta ee reer Portugal Cristiano Ronaldo ayaa ka qayb-galay casho sharaf ka dhacday Aqalka Cad isaga oo la socday Dhaxal-sugaha Sucuudiga, Amiir Maxamed bin Salmaan, Xalay. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay ka hor xafladda in ay "sharaf" u tahay in uu marti-geliyo Ronaldo, kaas oo door muhiim ah ku leh horyaalka kubadda cagta ee Sucuudiga isla markaana noqday wajiga ololaha casriyeynta ee dalkaas. Amiir Maxamed bin Salmaan waxa uu doonayaa in uu yareeyo ku-tiirsanaanta dakhliga saliidda isaga oo dhaqaalaha dalka u beddelaya laamo kale, oo ay ku jiraan ciyaaraha iyo dalxiiska. Mas'uul ka tirsan Aqalka Cad ayaa hore u xaqiijiyay ka-qaybgalka Ronaldo, balse ma uusan caddeyn inuu qayb ka ahaa wafdiga rasmiga ah ee Amiirka. Dadka dhaliilsan qorshaha Sucuudiga ayaa rumeysan in maalgashiga ciyaaraha uu ujeedkiisu yahay in la helo sharciyad caalami ah lana weeciyo dhaliilaha la xiriira xuquuqda aadanaha iyo saameynta deegaanka ee warshadda saliidda—arrin loo yaqaan "sportswashing." Trump waxa uu khudbaddiisii cashada ku ammaanay xiriirka dhow ee ay la leeyihiin Sacuudi Carabiya, isaga oo ku tilmaamay inay tahay "xulafo weyn oo aan ka tirsanayn NATO." Saacadihii hore Trump waxa uu Aqalka Oval-ka ku qaabilay Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga. Trump waxa uu markaas u jeestay dhanka xiddiga kubadda cagta ee u dhashay Boortaqiiska, isaga oo martida u sheegay: "Wiilkaygu wuxuu taageero weyn u yahay Ronaldo." Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Wuxuu intaa ku daray: "Barron (Trump) wuu la kulmay, waxaan filayaa inuu ixtaamayo hadda kadib, sababtoo ah hadda way kulmeen." Waxaa sidoo kale cashada kasoo qayb galay bilyaneerka tignoolajiyada ee Elon Musk, oo ku biiray hoggaamiyayaal ganacsi oo saameyn leh, oo ay ku jiraan Maamulaha Apple ee Tim Cook. Tani waa booqashadii ugu horreysay ee Musk ku yimaado Aqalka Cad tan iyo markii uu bishii Abriil ka degay xilkii uu ka hayay Waaxda Waxtarka Dowladda (DOGE). Murun kulul oo u dhexeeyay Trump iyo maalgashadaha Tesla ayaa si shaac ah u socday bilo badan, iyadoo Musk uu xitaa shaaciyay inuu damacsan yahay sameynta xisbi siyaasadeed oo cusub. Ronaldo waxa uu wajahaya eed sheegaysa kufsi. Kathryn Mayorga ayaa sheegtay in Ronaldo uu kufsaday iyada qol hotel oo ku yaal Las Vegas sanadkii 2009, taas oo uu Ronaldo beeniyay. Bayaankii uu bixiyay 2018-kii, wuxuu ku yiri: "Waxaan si adag u beeninayaa eedeymaha la ii jeediyay. Kufsi waa dembi laga xumaado oo ka soo horjeeda wax kasta oo aan aaminsanahay." Sannadkii 2019, dacwad-oogayaasha Maraykanku waxay sheegeen in Ronaldo aan lagu soo oogi doonin dacwad maadaama aan la caddeyn karin eedeymahaas. Horraantii 2023, Ronaldo wuxuu u guuray Sacuudi Carabiya, markaas oo uu noqday wajiga Horyaalka Kubadda Cagta ee Sacuudiga isla markaana uu noqday kabtanka Al-Nassr – oo ah koox kubadda cagta ah oo uu leeyahay Sanduuqa Maalgelinta Dadweynaha ee Sacuudiga, kaas oo guddigiisa uu guddoomiye u yahay Dhaxal-sugaha Boqortooyada. Heshiiska mushaharka Ronaldo ee Sacuudiga wuxuu ahaa mid cirka isku shareeray. Wararku waxay sheegeen in ciyaaryahanku uu sanadkii qaadanayey $200 milyan – taas oo ka badan nus milyan doolar maalintii. Juun sanadkan, wuxuu saxiixay heshiis laba sano ah oo cusub oo qiimihiisu dhan yahay $400 milyan, taas oo ka dhigtay ciyaaryahankii ugu horreeyay ee kubadda cagta ee bilyaneer noqda, sida ay sheegtay Bloomberg, isagoo hantidiisu gaartay $1.4 bilyan. Tani waa lacag aad u badan oo uu helo ciyaaryahan 40 jir ah oo ku jira gabagabada xirfaddiisa. Sida uu sheegay Sanam Vakil, agaasimaha barnaamijka Bariga Dhexe iyo Waqooyiga Afrika ee Chatham House, Sacuudi Carabiya waxay "si weyn u maalgelisay dhacdooyin iyo shaqsiyaad sumcad leh si ay boqortooyada ugu soo bandhigto khariidadda" dhinacyada isboortiga iyo dalxiiska, iyagoo raadinaya casriyeyn. Ronaldo wuxuu wareysi uu siiyey Piers Morgan ku tilmaamay Maxamed bin Salman inuu yahay "madaxweynihiisa". Horraantii bishan, wuxuu ka soo muuqday munaasabad Wasaaradda Dalxiiska oo lagu qabtay Riyadh, halkaas oo uu kaga hadlay mashaariicda horumarineed ee Boqortooyada iyo rajadiisa ah in Sacuudi Carabiya martigeliso Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA 2034.

Muxuu kusoo kordhin karaa xaaladda siyaasadda Soomaaliya Isbaheysiga ay ku dhawaaqeen siyaasyiin hore? Kadib kulammo siyaasadeed oo in muddo ah u socday siyaasiiyiin si weyn looga yaqaan saaxadda siyaasadda Soomaalida oo ay kamid yihiin Ra'iisulwasaarii hore ee Soomaaliya Cabdi Faarax Shirdoon (Saacid),Lataliyihii hore ee amniga Qaranka Fahad Xaaji Yaasiin iyo wasiiro hore ayaa waxa ay ku dhawaaqeen isabaheysi siyaasadeed oo cusub oo lamagac baxay Midwowga Haybad Qaran kaas oo noqonaya mid kusoo biiray xooggaga siyaasadda ee isku diyaarinaya in ay u tartamaan doorashada madaxtinimada ee la filayo in ay dhacdo 2026. Siyaasiyiinta oo mid walbaa uu gaarkiis u leeyahay xisbi siyaasadeed ayaa dhanka kale ku midoobay isbaheysigan iyagoo ku heshiiyay in hal musharrax uu ku metalo tartanka soo socdo ee doorashada madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, waxayna ku heshiiyeen in Cabdi Faarax Shirdoon (Saacid) uu noqodo musharraxa Madaxweyne ee ay ku mideysanyihiin. , Maxamed Mukhtaar Su'aashaas iyo qaar kale ayaan weeydiinay Maxamed Mukhtaar oo ka faallooda arimaha siyaasadda Soomaaliya waxana u kaga jawaabay in maadaama ay soo dhawaatay xilliga doorashada Soomaaliya gaar ahaan doorashada Madaxweynaha federaalka ah in dadka daneeynaya ay usoo istaagaan mansabkan, laakin waxaa ku cusub buu yiri in siyaasiyiin kala duwan ay ku midooban hal musharrax" dhaqanka siyaasadeed ee Soomaliya waxa ay ahaan jirtay shaqsiyaad kaligood isoo sharraxa" Maxamed Mukhtaar waxa uu sheegay in siyaasiyiintani ay sheegeen magaca ay ku shaqeeynayaan haddana ma aha xisbi raba in ay ku tartamaan qaab xisbi ah "dalku in uu qof iyo cod iyo xisbi uu aadayo uma muuqato iyaga" ayuu yiri Mukhtaar oo intaas ku daray in dhaqanka siyaasadda Soomaalida sida caadada ahayd, inta ay iskugu tagaan horey kama dhihi jirin musharrax ayaan wadanaa taas oo ah buu yiri weji kale oo cusub. Waxaa jirta hubanti la'aan nidaamka doorashada gaar ahaan qaabka doorashada loo qabanayo 2026 oo wali si buuxda loogama heshiin marka siyaasyiintani iyagoo kala aragti duwanaashaha nidaamka dooarshada aan xal laga gaarin in ay isbahesyigan ku dhawaaqaan ma la dhihi karaa waa mid lagu degdegay waqtigan ayaan weeydiinay Maxamed Mukhtaar oo arinkaasi kaga jawaabay : "Cabdi Faarax Shirdoon (Saacid) waxa uu xubin ka yahay Golaha Samatabixinta Soomaaliyeed taas oo ka mid ah buu yiri dadaalada la doonayo in dalka looga gaaro xal siyaasadeed oo ku wajahayn doorashada, isma diidana in ay yiraahdaan anaga Musharrax ayaan wadanaa iyo in musharruxu uu ka mid yahay musharaxiinta dalka ka jirta ee tartameysa" ayuu yiri Maxamed Mukhtara oo intaas ku daray in waxa cusub ay yihiin in uu sameystay koox siyaasyiin ah oo isaga taageeraysa. Sida uu qabo Maxamed Mukhtaar isbahesigani kama uusan bixin madashii wadahadalada ee ka socotay Muqdisho am Nairobi iyo sida xal loogu raadinayo sida xilligan kala guurka ah looga gudbi lahaa, balse wax ay doonayaan in ay cod iyo culus ay ku yeeshaan talada Soomaaliya. Siyaasyiintan ayaan hadda lahayn saldhig siyaasdeed marka loo fiiriyo dalka oo ay ka taliyaan dowlad goboleedyo, xubnaha hadda la socdo Saacidna kuma jiraan dowlad goboleedyada hadda jira, deegaan ay hadda toos u maamulaana ma laha. "sida kaliya ee ay miiska wadahadaladda kusoo fariisan karaan waa in ay culeyskooda siyaasdeed iyo aragtidooda siyaasdeed ay kusoo daraan iyagoo kaashanaya mucaardka intiisa kale, Puntland iyo Jubalad" ayuu yiri Maxamed Mukhtaar oo intaasi sii raaciyay "si ugu yaraan looga wadahdli karo doorasho u cuntami karta dhinacyada kala duwan ee siyaasadda isku haya . Isbaheysigan waxa laga dheehana karaa in laga gudbayo siyaasi kaligiis iska socdo oo yiraa musharrax ayaan ahay isagoo calafkiisa tijaabinaya. Sawirka, Maxamed Nuur Qalimow Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Dhanka kale Maxamed Nuur Qalimow oo isna ka faalladooda arimaha Soomaaliya ayaa qaba in siyaasyiintu ay sameeystaan isabhesiyo siyaasadeed in ay tahay tallabo horumar leh oo looga gudbayo qaabkii hore ee halka shaqsi oo aan xisbi ka socon, ajandahiisana qiyaastii 20 daqiio oo toos ah kula hadli jiray xildhibaanada wax dooranayo "hadda waxa aad moodaa in qaabka adduunku waafaqsanyahy ee xisbiyada in ay u gudbayaan" ayuu yuri Qalimow . Mar uu ka hadlayey wax uu isbaheysigani soo kordhin karo Qalimow waxa uu sheegay in isaga iyo kuwa kale oo is qaabeeynaya iyo dowladda hadda xilka hayso ay meel wax isla dhigaan oo dadkii faraha badnaa ee shaqsi shaqsiga ahaa ay soo gaabato heshiisna ay ka gaaraan qaabkii ay doorashada kuwada geli lahaayeen. Mar uu ka hadlayey sida ayaa siyaasiyiintan ku jira isbaheysigan ay ula falgeli karaan dowlad goboleedyada si ay fursad ugu helaan inay shacabka gaarsiiyaan ololahooda siyaasadeed waxa uu Qalimow kaga jawaabay " in maamuul goboleedyada ay tahay in ay u surtageliyaan xisbiyadan tartami doono in ay siiyaan fursad ay shacabka kula hadlaan sida in ay xafiisyo ka furtaan deegaandooda. "xisbiga ayaa laga rabaa in uu ku qanciyo maamul goboleedyada in ay xisbiyo ka furtaan, ka dhex ololeeyaan iyo in maamul goboleedyadu laftigoodu ay xisbiyada u ogolaadaan in ay ka dhex shaqeeyaan. Qalimow ayaa qaba in uusan isbaheysigani culeys weeyn kusoo kordhin doonin mucaaradka jira iyo iyo dowladda waaya buu yiri " dowladdu waa tan u ololeeysa in xisbiyo la sameysto oo laga gudbo qaabka qofka ama qabiilka ah" loona gudbo buu yiri xisbiyo. Dhanka kale Qalimow wax u qaba ain dadka siyaasyiinta ah ay tahay in ay la jaanqadaan qaababkan cusub ee aany horey u aqoon ee ah in siyaasadda la mideeyo.

Jaceyl dhab ah: "Waan qalbi jabay, mana ku fakarin inaan helayo qof iyada la mid ah" Justin McLeod, wuxuu ka mid yahay hoggaamiyeyaasha ganacsiga caalamka, wuxuu la hadlay Barnaamijka The Boss ee BBC-da ka baxa. Justin waa aasaasaha iyo madaxa fulinta App-ka haasaawaha ee Hinge. Markii uu ka soo kabsanayay isticmaalka maandooriyaha, Justin McLeod wuxuu aasaasay dejiyay barnaamijkiisii haasaawaha, waxay ahayd inuu noloshiisa ka caawiyo sidii uu uga adnaan lahaa niyad jabka. Shan sano kahor, macalinkiisii koleejka, oo ah haweeneydii uu u maleeyay in ay tahay jacaylka noloshiisa, waxay kaga tagtay dhibaato la xiriirta isticmaalka daroogada iyo khamriga. Wuxuu markii dambe u tegay gabadhii si uu dib ugu soo nooleeyo xiriirkooda. Wuxuu xilligaas ku guuleystay inuu gebi ahaanba iska daayo isticmaalka daroogada, balse wuxuu awoodi waayay inuu u sii noolaado si jacayl uu ku dheehan yahay. Muusan dooneyn inuu baararka aado, sababo la xiriirta balwadda khamriga ee uu qabatimay, wuxuu shaqo ka bilaabay Hinge sannadkii 2011-kii, isago ka raadsanaya jaceyl wanaagsan iyo lammaane cusub. Markaas wuxuu ahaa 27 sano jir, Wuxuuna Ganacsiga ka baranayay Jaamacadda Harvard, qeybta magaalada Boston. "Waan qalbi jabsanaa, waligeyna kuma fikirin in an heli doono qof iyada la mid ah," ayuu yiri. Laakiin, wuxuu mooday, inuu app-ka uu u yahay fursadda ugu fiican. Adeegyo haasaawe oo khadka tooska ah loogu talagalay, oo dhallinyarada lagula hadlo, ayaa soo baxay, Justin ayaa sidoo kale rajeeyay in ay noqon laheyd ganacsi uu isku dayi karo inuu guul gaaro. "Waxaan helay fursad fudud oo aan ku heli karo. App si fudud la isugu shukaansan karo oo dhallinyarada ay qeyb ka noqonayaan, kuwaas oo xilligaas aan isticmaali jirin baraha la isku shukaansado," ayuu yiri. "Fikradda markaas waan haleeli waayay oo maskaxdeyda ayey ku dhex wareeganeysay." Sannadkii 2012, ayuu Justin bilaabay App-ka Hinge, isla sannadkaas ayaa la aasaasay app-ka Tinder, oo isagana ah bar haasaawe. Maanta Hinge, waxaa isticmaasha dad gaaraya 5.5 million oo qof, waxaana dakhli sannad kasta uu soo xareero lagu sheegay lacag gaareysa $5.2m (£4.1m). Laakiin sheeko jacayl ah oo layaab badan oo laga jilay musalsal TV ayaa dhecday. Justin jacayl cusub kama helin App-ka uu isaga aasaasay. Taa beddalkeeda se, wuxuu ku dhiiraday inuu isku dayo inuu dib u hanto qalbiga jacaylkiisii lumay ee Kate Stern. Silsiladdan dhacdooyinka ayaa bilaabmay sannadkii 2015-kii, markii la sii xoojiyay shirkadda Hinge, waxaa wareystay weriye Deborah Copaken oo maqaal ku qoray wargeyska The New York Times. , Gebogebada wareysiga, ayay Ms Copaken weydisay, haddii uu weligiis sidan u jeclaanayo gabadha. Wuxuu ka dib, Justin, ka sheekeeyay sida uu u jeclaa oo uu u lumiyey gacalisadiisa Kate intii ay labadooduba ahaayeen arday wax ka baraneysay Jaamacadda Colgate ee ku taal Hamilton, ee Gobolka New York, sababtuna ay ahayd maandooriyaha uu aadka u isticmaali jiray. Gabadha wariyaha ah, ayaa ku jawaabtay, in ay leedahay sheeko jaceyl oo luntay oo tiisa la mid ah, laakiin in aysan waligeed u dhaqaaqin in ay ficil sameyso, haddana ay ka cabsi qabto in ay ka daahday oo wax la soo dhaafay ay tahay. "Sheekadeeda ayaa igu dhiiragelisay inaan qaado hal tallaabo oo dheeraad ah, laakiin waxay ahayd toddobo sano oo waxaan u maleynayay in ay goor danbe tahay," ayuu yiri. Laakiin si dhiirannaan iyo geesinimo leh; Justin wuxuu u duulay Switzerland, halkaas oo uu ku ogaa in Kate ay markaas ku nooleyd oo ay ka shaqeyneysay. In kasta oo ay bil gudaheed ku guursaneysay, haddana waxay oggolaatay inay la kulanto. Dhowr maalmood gudahood, arooskeedii wuu baaqday, iyada iyo Justin na dib ayay u midoobeen. Wax yar ka dib, Justin ayaa mar kale la kulmay gabadhii wariyaha ahayd ee Ms Copaken, si uu ugu sheego wixii dhacay, ayna arrinta ugu qorto waryegeyska New York Times, qeybta casriga ee lagu daabaco sheekooyinka jacaylka ee bishii November sannadkii 2015-kii. "Markii maqaalka lagu daabacay Joornaalka New York Times, waxaa la sheegay in dadkii akhristay ay "aad isula wadaageen qoraalka oo ay hadal hayeen," ayuu yiri Justin. "Waxay xitaa qoreen, dabagal ay ku sameeyeen, in dadka ay tahay in ay isku dayaan in ay dib u raadiyaan jacaylladooda horey uga lumay." Markii Warbixinta Jaceylka Casriga ah laga sameeyay Filim masalsal ah oo kalgaceyl oo laga baahiyay Amazon Prime TV, oo sannadkii hore isla magacaas loo bixiyay, Shekada Justin iyo Kate waxaa laga siiyay qeyb ka mid ah. Waxaa kaalintiisa matalayay Jilaaga Reer Britain ee Dev Patel. Justin wuxuu sheegay in dib ula soo noqoshada Kate ay isaga ka dhigtay inuu garawsado inuu u baahan yahay inuu dib boorka uga jafo app-ka Hinge, kaas oo xilligaas "isku si ay u shaqeynayeen" App=ka kale ee Tinder. Wuxuu doonayay in Hinge uu noqdo bar jaceyl badan laga dhaxlo, si fududna dadka isugu xira kuwaas oo jir ahaan isa soo jiita. Taa bedelkeeda wuxuu xoogga saaray in dadka ay noqdaan kuwo dhaqan ahaan si fiican isu barta, wuxuuna ku dhiiragelinayay in qaabkii hore ee shukaansiga ay sameeyaan ayna isu doontaan, taas oo ka caawineysa in xiriir muddo socda ay wada yeeshaan halkii ay "waxyar ka dib kala carari lahaayeen". Ka dib markii uu dib u soo kiciyay App-ka sannadkii 2016-kii, dadka isticmaala waxaa la weydiinayay su'aalo la xiriira "waxa ku saabsan noloshooda"... ama "xaqiiqada nolosha qofka ee dadka kale ay la cajabi karaan...". Jawaabtooda waxaa lagu hoos qorayaa bogga uu qofka ku dhex leeyahay App-ka. Taas waxay qofka kale ka caawineysaa inuu helo shaksiyadda uu jecel yahay ama uu ka helo, wada sheekeysigana halkaas ayuu ka billaabanayaa. "Waxay ila ahay arrin fudud oo yar, balse waxay bedeshay dhaqanka dadka ee App-ka adeegsada," ayuu yiri Justin, oo ku dhashay Kentucky. "Waxay ka dhigtay in xulasho wanaagsan ay sameeyaan, ayna si wanaagsan uga fakaraan waxa ay boggooda ku qorayaan. "Waxaa ka dib ogaaday Shakhsiyadda dadka ay jecel yihiin ee guurka gaarta." Dhakhatarad da'yar oo u dhalatay dalka Koonfur Afrika ayaa kicisay dood guud oo dalka oo dhan ah oo ku saabsan nooc ka mid ah xadgudubka guriga oo inta badan lagu qariyo aamusnaanta - xadgudub dhaqaale. Muuqaallo taxane ah oo aad u faafay oo laga qaaday Dr Celiwe Ndaba ayaa ku bilowday sida ay sheegtay in ninkeeda uu uga faa'iideystay dhaqaale ahaan, taas oo horseeday in ay kala tagaan. Inta badan waxay ku fadhidaa gaarigeeda iyada oo u socota shaqada, waa hooyo saddex musalsal oo ay ka sameeysay laba toddobaad, kuwaas oo ku saabsanaa in kasta oo ay guulaysatay xirfadeeda in ay ku xanibantay guur rafaad badan muddo sanada ah, iyada oo dareemaysa in loola dhaqmay si ay u maalgeliso qaab nololeedka ninkeeda - gaar ahaan rabitaankiisa ah inuu wado gaari Mercedes Benz. Qaadashada deeynta si uu ugu iibsado gawaaridan oo kale waxa ay ahayd" go'aankii ugu xumaa" ee nolosheena, taas oo qoyska gelisay cadaadis dhaqaale oo aad u weyn, ayay tiri Dr Ndaba - oo tan iyo markii ay soo bandhigtay sheekadeeda dib ugu laabatay magaca abtirisiimadeedii hore taas oo kordhisay in tirada taageerayaasheeda ay kor u kacaan. In kasta oo ay ninkeeda ka codsatay in uu yareeyo qarashka, waxa ay sheegtay inuu diiday - isagoo ku eedeeyay "in ay rabto in lagu qoslo iyada oo ka dhigeyso inuu kaxeeyo gaari yar". Dhaqtaradu waxa ay sheegtay in ay sheekadan u sheegeyso si ay digniin u dirto dadka kale – ee aanay ahayn oo keliya dumarka "aan waxba baran" iyo "hantida yar" kuwaas oo la kulma xiriir aan wanaagsanyen. Ninkeeda Temitope Dada oo ay kala tageen, , kama uusan jawaabin codsi ay BBC-du u jeedisay oo ah in uu faallo ka bixiyo arintan. Ka dib duufaantii warbaahinta bulshada, wuxuu sameeyay akoon TikTok, halkaas oo mid ka mid ah muuqaalkiisii ugu horreeyay uu ku qiray: "Waxa laga yaabaa in aad ii garanayso inaan ahay…'Mr Benz ama waxba." Qoraallada kooban ee uu sameeyay waxa ku lifaaqan hashtags sida #divorcetrauma - isagoo leh eedeymahu waa been. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qaybta faallooyinka ee TikToka Dr Ndaba iyo aaladaha kale ee warbaahinta bulshada waxay isu beddeleen kooxo taageero ah, oo ay ka buuxaan dumar shaqaalle ah oo wadaaga sheekooyin kuwaasi la,mid ah. "Waxa aad ku dhiiratay in aad fagaaraha uga hadasho...Aamusnaan ayaan ku dhibtooday," hal qof ayaa sidaasi ku qoray faalladiisa. Bertus Preller, oo ah qareen ku sugan Cape Town, ayaa aaminsan sababtu in aya tahay in kasta oo haweenka Koonfur Afrika ay noqonayaan dhakhaatiir, qareeno iyo hal-abuurro ganacsi, in ay helaan shaqooyin mushaar fiican ma aha in ay ka xoreebeen amarka ku saleysan hab dhaqameedka bulshada. Dhaqanka ah madax-bannaanida dhaqaale ee haweenka waxay isku dhacaan "caadooyinkii dhaqameed ee mudnaanta siiya awoodda ragga", ayuu yiri. Haddii ayba dhacdo , guushoodu waxa ay u muuqataa inay wax bartilmaameedsanayaan. Ku xad-gudubka maaliyadeed waxa uu dhacaa marka mid ka mid ah lammaanuhu uu xukumo ama ka faa'iidaysto ilaha maaliyadeed ee kale, sida uu qareenku sharraxayo. "Waa xeelad aan fiicneyn oo weli xoogganoo rabshadaha qoyska dhaliya, taas oo loogu talagalay in lagu ilaaliyo dhibbanaha," ayuu yiri. Koonfur Afrika, tan, si sharci ah ayaa loogu qeexay inay tahay ku xad-gudub dhaqaale marka loo eego Xeerka Rabshadaha Qoyska. Mr Preller waxa uu sheegay waxyaabo ay ka mid yihiin "in si xaq-darro ah lacagta loogu isticmaalo waxyaabaha daruuriga ah ama faragelinta hantida la wadaago," waxa ilaalinya sharciga. Macalimad jaamacadeed oo codsatay in aan magaceeda la shaacin ayaa BBC-da u sheegtay sida ninkeeda uu uga been sheegay shahaadooyinkiisa oo uu ugu dambeyntii kaga tagay burbur dhaqaale. Waxa ay ku bilaabatay gaarigeeda oo uu inta badan kaxaystay balse aanu waligiis shidaal ka shubin. Dabadeed ay deyn u qaadatay ganacsigiisii badnaa ee ku fashilmay. Ugu dambeyntii, waxa soo baxay ogeysiis ah in guriga laga saarayo, maadaama ay sheegtay inuu diidday in kirada uu wax ku daro, taas oo keentay in ay u dhabar adaygto dhammaan kharashaadka qoyskooda oo ay ku jiraan saddex carruur ah. Iyadoo ay taasi jirto, waxay wada joogeen muddo ku dhow toban sano – inkasta oo uu sidoo kale ahaa mid jir dila. "Aad buu u caqli badan yahay... Waxa aan jeclaaday caqligiisa, riyooyinkiisa waaweyn. Laakin ma uusan lahayn ficil. Kibirkiisu wuxuu ahaa hoos u dhaciisa," ayay tiri. Xitaa marka uu xoogaa lacag ah helay, haddana waxba iguma darsan jirin. "Wuxuu bilaabay in uu u diido wax kasta oo lacag ah oo uu isagu lahaa. Waxa uu aadi jiray in uu dibadda aado si ulsoo cabo asxaabtiisa,– waxa uu soo nqoqonayey marka uu mushaharku ka dhamaado ," ayay tiri. Khabiir dhanka sharciga ah oo lagu magacaabo Somila Gogoba ayaa sheegtay in arimaha ka baxsan xakamaynta lacagta, ku xad-gudbida maaliyadeed ay inta badan yeelato saameeyn maskaxeed oo qoto dheer. "Qofka xadgudubka geystay, dhaqankankiisa waxa laga yaabaa inuu ka yimaado dareen isku filnaasho la'aan ah, cabsi laga qabo in laga tago, ama in uu doonayo in uu wax maquuniyo," ayay u sheegtay BBC-da. "Dhibanaha, saameynta nafsaaniga ah ee ku dhacdo waxa ka mid ah, dareen ah in anau wax qiimeeyn, cabsi iyo ku tiirsanaanta cid kale , taas oo noqon karta mid cuuryaamiso." Cilmi-baaris ay samaysay Jaamacadda Koonfur Afrika ayaa soo jeedinaysa in kuwani aanay ahayn kiisas gooni-gooni ah - iyo in haweenka kasbaday lamaanahooda ay la kulmaan khataro aad u sarreeya oo rabshado sokeeyo ah. Daraasad qoto dheer oo ay ku sameeyeen 10 haween ah oo ahaa kuwa aasaasiga u ah nolosha qoyskooda, laba keliya ayaa guursaday. "Sideed ka mid ah ka qaybgalayaasha, doorashadooda kelinimada waxay ka dhalatay waayo-aragnimadooda xadgudubyada jireed, shucuureed iyo jinsiga ... Dhammaan haweenkaas waxa ay ysheegeen in ay aaminsan yihiin in doorkooda haweenka ee quudinta loo arko inay khatar ku yihiin doorka dhaqameed ee bixiyaha," ayuu yiri cilmi-baare Bianca Parry. Ms Gogoba ayaa sheegtay in dumarka shaqeysto ay ka qiimo yar yihiin ragga dhiggooda ah, in kasta oo ay dhaqaale kusoo kordhiyeen: "Dhaqankan wax uu dhiirigelin karaa ragga qaarkood inay dareemaan inay xaq u leeyihiin inay xakameeyaan dhaqaalaha, xitaa marka aysan si isku mid ah wax uga qayb qaadan. "xakameyntu ma aha lacag oo kaliya – ee sidoo kale waa awoodda iyo ilaalinta xajinta dhaqdhaqaaqa xiriirka." Nombulelo Shange, oo ah bare ku takhasustay cilmiga bulshada oo wax ka dhigta Jaamacadda Free State, ayaa sheegtay in ay qayb ka tahay hannaanka ku soo kordhaya Koonfur Afrika ee haweenka heerka dhexe ah ee dhaqaale ahaan looga faa'iidaysto. "Haweenka madowga ah waxay la kulmaan dhaqanka ah in ragu wax hoogaamiyo: filashada reer galbeedka ee shaqada, rajooyinka dhaqameed ee guriga. Marka ay dhaqamadani isku dhacaan, fikradaha waxyeellada leh ayaa sii kordhaya," ayay u sheegtay BBC. Waxay sharaxday in isu dheelli tirka culaysyadu kaa dhigaan in aad noqoto haweeney guulaysata, laakiin in aad qaadato doorka "daryeelaha, hooyada, xaaska wanaagsan, deriska wanaagsan iyo xubinta bulshada ee aada kaniisadda Axad walba", ay ahayd mid adag iyada oo haweenka mar walba la baray in ay ku dhegganaadaan geesinimada ragga. Tan iyo markii ay soo shaac baxday Dr Ndaba, haweenka ku jira baraha bulshada waxa ay wadaagayeen sheekooyin ku saabsan in lammaanahooda ay siinayaan kaararkooda bankiga marka ay dibadda u baxayaan si ay wax u cunaan si ay u muuqato in uu bixinayo dhaqaalaha. Ms Shange ayaa sheegtay in tani ay ku tusinayso sida masuuliyadda farxadeed ee guriga inta badan loo saaro haweenka. "ma waxa aad u maleysaa: 'Haddii aan kaliya gaari u helo, in ay farxi doonaan.' Jacaylku wuxuu kaa dhigaa indhoole. Marka uu qofkaagu dhibaatoonayo, sidoo kale waad halgantaa – waxa aad rabtaa inaad xaliso," ayay tiri. Markii macalinka jaamacada uu furay kaas oo,ahaa ninkeeda, waxaa looga tagay deyn dhan 140,000 rand ($ 7,500; £ 5,600) - dhammaan waxay ku soo wareegeen magaceeda. "Ka hor, waxa aan qorsheyn karay waxyaabo ay ka mid yihiin fasaxyada. Hadda waxay yihiin kuw adag " ayay tiri. Dr Ndaba waxa ay dhibsatay in ay u sheegto taageerayaasheeda, sida ay ku samaysay hal musalsal: "Maaliyaddu waa qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah guurka dadka." Macallinka ayaa inta badan ku raacin taas iyadoo ku boorrisay haweenka da'da yar inay waqtigooda ku bixiyaan inay bartaan lammaanahooda oo ay yeeshaan wadahadal furan oo daacad ah. "Ka hadal dhaqaalaha, ka hadal taariikhdaada, ka hadal dareenka iyo dabeecadda." Ms Gogoba ayaa ku boorrisay dad badan inay iska ilaaliyaan lammaanahooda, iyadoo u sheegtay inay ilaashadaan xisaabta bangiga gaarka ah, biinankana ay la socdaan iyo kaararkooda deynta. Dhammaantood waxa ay isku raaceen in haweenku fahmaan in jacaylku aanu ku iman qiimo macana darro ah.

1.9 How to use the Guidelines 1.9.1 Knowledge of and familiarity with the Editorial Guidelines is an essential professional skill. Everyone who makes or presents BBC content is contractually required to observe and abide by them. 1.9.2 When applying these Guidelines, individuals and teams are expected to make most of the necessary judgements, but some issues require careful consideration at a higher level. No one should hesitate to ask for advice, and the Editorial Guidelines therefore advise, and sometimes require, reference to more senior editorial figures, Editorial Policy or specialists such as Programme Legal Advice or safety experts. 1.9.3 Editors and managers must be prepared to discuss areas of concern and be ready to offer guidance. They must support producers and other staff in the editorial management of their content, including the effective supervision of on-air presenters, reporters and other on-air roles. 1.9.4 Issues may arise that overlap with, or are separate from, editorial concerns. The BBC has specialist internal advisers on legal, data protection, safety, pronunciation, international filming, health and safeguarding matters, who should be consulted as appropriate. BBC News maintains bureaux around the world, a political research team and a head of statistics. The BBC has a separate legal team in Scotland who can advise on Scottish legal issues. Mandatory Referral: Any decision to proceed with content or continued publication of content contrary to BBC legal advice must be referred to the Divisional Director and Director Editorial Policy and Standards. 1.9.5 The Editorial Guidelines are supplemented by further guidance, which is available on the BBC Editorial Guidelines website. The guidance contains additional information about how specific areas of the Guidelines can be applied and interpreted. New guidance is written when necessary. 1.9.6 The BBC's reputation rests on sound decision-making, and the referrals system ensures that complex editorial decisions are properly considered. Referrals lie at the heart of the BBC's editorial process and are a source of its strength. No one involved in the making or presenting of BBC output should hesitate to refer editorial dilemmas. 1.9.7 The Editorial Guidelines specify a number of Mandatory Referrals. These may be to senior editorial figures within the output division, Editorial Policy, including the Director, Editorial Policy and Standards or, on occasion, other areas of the BBC. Mandatory Referrals are an essential part of the BBC's editorial and compliance process and must be observed. The Mandatory Referrals are summarised in each section of the Guidelines. However, they must be read in the context of the relevant cross-referenced Guidelines to be fully understood. The more important or contentious the issue, the higher the referral needs to be. The content maker is responsible for knowing who to refer their query to. If in doubt, refer. 1.9.8 On occasion, the Editorial Guidelines suggest or require referral to an internal BBC resource that independent production companies are unable to access. In such cases, independents should make the BBC commissioning editor or equivalent aware. Contracts with independent production companies should define where legal liabilities lie and independent production companies should take independent legal advice as appropriate. However, independent production companies may refer legal questions of an editorial nature through their commissioning editor who may discuss them with Programme Legal Advice. 1.9.9 Any significant breach of the editorial standards in the Guidelines should be referred promptly to an appropriate senior editorial figure, who will consider what action may be needed – including whether content should be amended, corrected or removed or if an apology should be given. 1.9.10 While responsibility for editorial content lies with output teams, advice can be sought from Editorial Policy. The Editorial Policy team, led by Director Editorial Policy and Standards, provides advice on how to work within the Guidelines at every stage of the production process for every type of content. The earlier that potentially contentious content is referred the better. Advice is available 24 hours a day. In addition to the referrals specified in each section, Editorial Policy can be consulted on questions about how to interpret or apply the Editorial Guidelines. Editorial justification is the judgement that the benefit from any editorial decision or content outweighs any negative impact. Editorial justification should be made on a case-by-case basis and take account of the impact on contributors, or where relevant those closest to them, and audiences. 1.9.11 The BBC's compliance obligations require that all content that is not live is reviewed before publication or broadcast and the results of that review recorded and kept. Separate guidance is available for live output. Most news output is normally treated as live. All live programmes that include pre-recorded inserts are treated as live. The Editorial Guidelines, referrals and advice from Editorial Policy can inform the judgements that are essential to the editorial compliance of BBC output. Legal advice may also be necessary. Koobka Adduunka: Waa kuma goolhayaha wacdaraha dhigay ee caawa ay isku beegan yihiin Kylian Mbappe? , CATHERINE MUELLER Morocco waa xulkii ugu horreeyay oo Afrikaan ah oo u gudba wareegga nus dhammaadka Koobka Adduunka kaddib markii uu dhawaan 1-0 kaga badiyay xulka qaranka ee Bortuqiiska. Xulkan ayaa wacdaro ka dhigay Koobka Adduunka sanadakn 2022-ka, siddeed ciyaar waxaa laga dhaliyay hal gool ah oo iyagu iska dhaliyeen, ninka kaalinta weyn ka qaatay guulaha ay gaareen Morocco waa goolhaye Yaasiin Bouno oo loo garan og yahay Bono. “Waxaan halkan u joognaa sidii aan wax uga baddali laheyn aragtida nalaga aaminsan yahay si aan meesha uga saarno cabsida” ayuu yiri Yaasiin. “Morocco waxay diyaar u tahay inay wajahdo koob kasta oo adduunka ka dhisan”. Bono wuxuu soo jiitay indhaha caalamka, wuxuu si weyn usoo caanbaxay markii uu rigooreyaal ka qabtay xulka Spain, wuxuu qabtay labo gool, muddo 130 daqiiqo ah ay ciyaartii Spain iyo Morocco wax gool ah lagama dhalin Yaasiin, waa taariikh cusub ay dhigeen reer Morocco. “Aragtida nagala aaminsanaa wax weyn baa ka baddalnay, jiilka xiga waxay ogaan doonaan in ciyaartooyda reer Morocco ay mucjiso dhigeen” ayuu yiri gool haye Yaasiin Bouno. Sawirka, Inta badan goolhayahan wuxuu noloshiisa kusoo qaatay dalka Spain waana goolhaye guulo weyn gaarsiisay kooxda Sevilla ee ka dhisan dalkaas. Bandhigyadii cajiibka ahaa ee Yaasiin waxay u horseedday in uu kaalinta 9-aad ka galo goolhayeyaasha ugu wanaagsan adduunka kadib tartanka Ballon d'Or sanadkan, wuxuu ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Zamora-wuxuu noqday goolhayihii goolashii ugu yaraa laga dhaliyo xilli ciyaareedka 2021-2022. Bono wuxuu noqday halyeey bishii March 2021 kadib ciyaartii ay la dheeleen kooxda Valladolid, wuxuu dhaliyay gool daqiiqadii 93-aad. Bandhiggii cajiibka ahaa ee uu soo sameeyay Bono bishii August 2020-kiii waxay sababtay in kooxdiisa Sevilla ay 2-1 uga badiso Manchester United, waxay markii lixaad ee ay ku guuleysteen koobka Europe League. Sawirka, Ciyaarta caawa ee Faransiiska iyo Morocco Caawa marka ay saacadda Geeska Afrikada Bari tahay waxaa wada cayaaraya 10-ka fiidnimo. Waxay Bono is hayaan gool-hayaha Kylian Mbappe ee xulka Faransiiska u dheela. Yaasiin Bono wuxuu ku dhashay magaalada Montreal ee dalka Canada. Wuxuu dib ugu soo laabtay dhulkiisii hooyo ee Morocco markii 7 sano jir gaaray. Markii uu yaraa wuxuu ku hammin jiray in uu meel ka gaaro kubadda cagta, wuxuu ku biiray kooxda ka dhisan dalkiisa ee Wydad Casablanca, inkasta uu aabbihii ka hor yimid go’aanka uu ugu biirayay kubadda cagta, si kastaba Bono wuxuu ku adkeystay in uu noqonayo xirfadle weyn oo kubadda cagta ah. Wuxuu kasoo tagay Morocco isagoo ku biiray kooxda ka dhisan Spain ee Atlético de Madrid. Wuxuuna markii dambe ku biiray kooxaha Zamora (2014-2016) iyo Girona (2016-2019), haatan waa ciyaartooy ka tirsan kooxda Sevilla. Marka laga reebo xirfaddiisa, wuxuu si weyn u taageeraa xulka Argentine, “Funnaanaddii ugu horreysay uu aabbahay ii soo gado waxaa laga keenay Argentina”. Sawirka, “Aniga waxaan ahay nin Moroccan ah, waxaa dhacday markii aan Spain imid in aan barto luqadda Argentines, lahjaddeyda wax yar baa ka baddalmay” ayuu yiri Yaasiin. Waxay saaxiib dhow ahaayeen Ariel Ortega, oo ah ciyaartooygii hore ee xulka Argentine ee loo yaaqaannay El Burrito Ortega, Bono wuxuu qirtay in uu ku dayan jiray ciyaartoygaas. Hadda oo caalamka si weyn isha ugu hayo Morocco, Yaasiin wuxuu si weyn u caawiyay xulkiisa oo gaaray heerkii ugu sarreeyay, waxaa laga dhuursugayaa bandhigga goolhaye Bono ee ciyaarta ay la dheelan doonaan Arbacada xulka Faraniiska.

Maxay tahay sababta uu Turkiga u doonayo qarannimada Soomaaliya? Sanadkan oo dhan, Somaaliya iyo Itoobiya waxaa u dhaxeeyay xifaaltan, kaas oo salka ku haya heshiis ay jamhuuriyadda iskeed ugu dhawaaqday madax banaanida ee Somaaliland la siixatay Itoobiya. Turkiga ayaana dhaxdhaxaadin ahaan u soo galay. Balse maxaa Turkiga soo geliyay? Hagaag, sababta waa in Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya ay saaxiibbo ahaayeen sanado badan. Xaqiiqdii, Turkiga ayaaba goordhow oggolaaday in ay labo sano oo dheeraad ah ciidamadooda sii joogaan Somaaliya. Kaas oo qeyb ka ah waajibaad soo jireen ah, iyagoo ku kala yaalla labo qaaradood oo isku jira 4,000 oo kiilo mitir. Waxay saaxibtinimadooda bilaabatay 2011-kii markaaso macluul ay soomaaliya ku dishay boqolaal kun oo qof, hay’adihiina ay iskaga baxeeen amni darro awgeed. Dowladda Talyaaniga ayaa faah-faahisay sababta ay u joojisay dal ku-galkii lagu bixin jiray basaboorka Soomaaliga kaas oo dhawaan ay safaraadda Talyaaniga ee Muqdihso joojisay. Safiirka Talyaaniga u fadhiya Soomaaliya Pier Mario Daccò Coppi oo magaalada Rome kula hadlayey wariyaasha ayaa sharaxay sababta ay tallaabadaas u qaadeen. Shurki Siciid oo ah wariye madaxbanaan oo deggan Roma kana mid ahayd wariyaal su’aalo waydiiyey safiirka ayaa BBC-da u sheegtay in safiir Pier Mario Daccò Coppi uu gaashaanka u daruuray in sababta loo joojiyay ay la xiriirto arrimo siyaasadeed. Wuxuu sheegay in hakinta ay la xiriirto farsamo dhanka maamulka ah ayna wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Talyaaniga ay hadda si toos ah ugu hawlan tahay oo ay sida ugu dhakhsiyaha badan ku xaliso. "Maya sax ma ah in sidaa loo dhigo, waa joojin kooban, waana arrin maamul iyo qabanqaabin ku leh waaye, laakiin haba yaraatee wax siyaasad ku lug leh ma ahan waa arrin wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda Talyaaniga ay il gooniya ku hayso ayna sida ugu dhaqsiyaha badan ku xallineyso." Ayuu yiri. Safiirka ayaa ka digay in marnaba aan arrinta la siyaasadeyn. Dowladda Talyaaniga ayaa bishii September joojisay dal ku galkii Schengen ee la siin jiray muwaadiniinta Soomaalida ee doonayo inay u safraan qaaradda Yurub. Safaaradda Talyaaniga ee Muqdisho ayaa qoraal ay markaas ku daabacday barteeda X (Twitter) ku sheegtay in safaaradda Nairobi ay joojisay soo saarista fiisayaasha ay soo dalbanayaan dadka haysta baasaboorka Soomaaliga. “Waxaa la ogeysiinayaa dadweynaha in safaaradda Talyaaniga ee Nairobi ay joojisay soo saarista fiisaha Schengen, waxayna tani saameynaysaa dhammaan codsiyadaas shaqsiyaadka u gudbiyay safaaradda Talyaaniga ee Muqdisho,” ayaa lagu yiri war kooban oo ay soo saartay safaaradda. Qoraalka safaaradda ayaana markaas laguma sheegin sababta loo joojiyay in fiisaha Talyaaniga iyo qaarada yurub. Safaaraddu waxay kaloo qoraalka ku sheegtay inay ogaysiisay wasaaradda arrimaha dibada ee dowladda Federaalka ee Somaliya. Bishii Julay ee sanadkan Midowga Yurub ayaa soo jeediyay in la adkeeyo dal ku galka la siiyo dadka haysta Baasaboorka Soomaaliga. Ujeedada talaabooyinkan ayaa lagu sheegay in Soomaaliya culeys lagu saaro in dib loogu soo celiyo dadka aan waddada saxda ah ku gelin dalalka Midowga Yurub. Goluhu waxa uu u baahan yahay baa lagu yiri warbixintaan, “inuu ansixiyo soo jeedinta ka hor inta aan la soo bandhigin qorshahaan”. Soo jeedinta Guddiga Midowga Yurub ayaa waxaa ka mid ah in la adkeeyo tAllaabooyinka dal ku galka lagu siinayo muwaadiniinta Soomaaliya. Safiirka Talyaaniga u fadhiya Soomaaliya ayaa sharraxay halka uu dalkiisa ka taagan yahay waxa uuna sheegay in Talyaaniga uu yahay waddan Soomaaliya walal la ah xiriir fiicanna uu kala dhaxeeyo uuna doonayo inuu xoojiyo. “Talyaaniga waxaa ka go’aan inuu hormariyo Soomaaliya oo uu sameeyo mashaariic wax ku ool ah oo wax tar u leh Soomaaliya.” Safiirka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu doonayo inuu safar ku tago maamul-goboleedyada Jubbaland iyo Puntland uu safar ku tago balse waxa uu sheegay in go’aanka Talyaaniga uu yahay in arrimaha siyaasadda uu uga dambeeyo siyaasiyiinta Soomaalida iyo dowladda Federaalka ah. Waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyay in Talyaaniga ku cudur-daaranayo inuusan dooneyn inuu farageliyo arrimaha siyaasadda Soomaaliya badalkii taasna ay xoogga saarayo dhanka hormarinta sida tabarka shaqaalaha rayidka, dhisamaha kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha iyo tabarka ciidamada. Safiirka oo uu mid ah weriyaasha weydiiyay arrinta la xiriirta khilaafka u dhaxeeya Soomaaliya Itoobiya ayaa yiri: “Arrintaas waa arrin laga xumaado waxayna carqaladeysay laba waddan oo daris ah oo walaalana ah xiriir fiicanna ka dhexeeyay.” Waxa uu sheegay in arrintaasi aysan ahayn waxa loo baahnaa inay meesha ka dhacdo. Itoobiya waxay xaq u leedahay inay hesho bad ay wax ka soo degsato Soomaaliyana waxay xaq u leedahay inay baddeeda la haato. Arrintaasi waxay ahayd in si diblomaasinima ah oo iskaashi ah ayay ahayd in arrintaas loo xalliyo waana nasiib darro inay taasi dhici weyso, ayuu yiri Safiir Pier Mario Daccò Coppi.

"Inkasta oo aan la jabsanin mobaylka, haddana waxa ay u muuqataa in tuugadu ay siyaabo kala duwan u galeen akoonkayga Telegram," ayuu Mr. Bennett ku yiri bayaan uu soo saaray gelinkii dambe ee Arbacadii. "Waxa ku jira liiska xiriirkayga waa la daabacay, iyo sidoo kale sawiro iyo sheekeysi badan, qaar run ah iyo qaar been abuur ah." Mr. Bennett, oo damacsan inuu dib ugu soo laabto jagada ra'iisul wasaaraha doorashada soo socota, ayaa sheegay in saameyntaas looga dan leeyahay in laga hortago inuu ku soo laabto xilka ra'iisul wasaaraha. Sida laga soo xigtay wargeyska Israel ee Yedioth Ahronoth, "Kooxdu waxay daabacday 141 bog oo nambaro telefoon ah (guud ahaan kumanaan macluumaadka xiriirka ah) oo ay la socdaan ku dhawaad 2,000 oo faylal oo ay ku jiraan wada sheekeysigiisa, kuwaas oo intooda badan aan dhameystirneyn. Maxaa ka jira in Shiinuhu hub casri ah ka iibiyey Iran? , Safaaradda Shiinaha ee Israel ayaa 8-dii bishaan July beenisay warbixinno ay soo saareen warbaahinno dibadeed oo sheegayey in Iran dhawaan ay heshay nidaamka gantaallada difaaca cirka ee masaafada dheer ee HQ-9B oo ka yimid Shiinaha. Warbaahinta ku hadasha afka Ingiriiska ee ku taal magaalada London ee Middle East Eye ayaa 7-dii July soo warisay, iyadoo tixraacaysa sarkaal Carbeed oo aan la magacaabin oo sheegtay inuu helay xog muujinaysa in nidaamyada gantaallada cirka ee ay soo saartay Shiinaha loo geeyay Iran isla markaana, kadib markii la shaaciyey heshiiska hakinta weerarrada ee Iran iyo Israel 24-kii Juun, in Maraykanku iyo xulafadiisa Carabtu ay "ogaayeen" dadaallada difaaca cirka ee Tehran. Si looga falceliyo warbixintaas, Safaaradda Shiinaha ee Tel Aviv ayaa u sheegtay wargeyska Israel Hayom in waxa laga sheegay warbixinta uu yahay "mid aan sax ahayn." Safaaraddu waxay adkaysay in "Shiinuhu si adag uga soo horjeedo faafinta hubka wax dila iyo nidaamyadaas ba, isla markaana uu si joogto ah u xoojinayo awooddiisa la dagaallanka faafinta hubka." Israel Hayom ayaa soo xigtay hadalka Safaaradda Shiinaha oo leh, "Shiinuhu marnaba kama iibiyo hub waddamo ku hawlan dagaal, wuxuuna si adag u xakameeyaa dhoofinta waxyaabaha khuseeya hubka. Anagoo ah xubin joogta ah oo ka tirsan Golaha Ammaanka Qaramada Midoobay, Shiinuhu wuxuu qaataa hab feejigan oo mas'uuliyad ku saleysan marka la dhoofinayo saanad milatari." Si kastaba ha noqotee, marnaba lama daabicin bayaan rasmi ah oo ay ku jiraan weedhahan, oo ka soo baxay barta rasmiga ah ee safaaradda Shiinaha ama warbaahinta dowliga ah ee dalkaas. Dhanka kale, Songlin Kan Shijie, oo ah qoraa Shiinaha ka soo jeeda, ayaa ku qoray 10-ka Julay, barta internetka ee Baidu in warbixinta wakaalada wararka Iran Mehr ee ku saabsan keenista nidaamka difaaca cirka ee Shiinaha "ay u muuqato dagaal xogeed qorsheysan oo ay waddo Tehran." Mareegta ayaa iyadoo laga duulayo dhibaatooyin la xidhiidha wareejinta iyo tababarka ciidanka ee lagu hawlgelinayo nidaamka difaaca HQ-9 muddo gaaban gudaheed, kor u qaadeysa suuragalnimada ah in Iran ay isticmaasho magaca Shiinaha si ay uga digtoonaato Israel iyo Maraykanka, iyada oo muujinaysa in ay haysato taageerada awooddaas weyn. Warbaahinta caalamka ayaa si weyn u hadal-haysay wararka sheegaya in Iran dib u bilowday wadahadalladii ay ku doonaysay inay ku iibsato diyaaradaha dagaalka ee Shiinaha loona yaqaan J-10C, kuwaas oo indhaha dunida soo jiitay kadib markii ay si fiican uga soo muuqdeen isku dhacyadii u dhexeeyay Pakistan iyo Hindiya bishii May ee dhawaan. Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Wargeyska Tsingtao Daily ee ka soo baxa Hong Kong ayaa 27-kii Juun daabacay warbixin ku saleysan taariikhda arrintan, isagoo xusay in Shiinaha iyo Iran dhowr jeer ku guuldareysteen inay heshiis ka gaadhaan arrintan muddo 20 sano ah. Wargeyska wuxuu soo xigtay wargeyska Kommersant ee Ruushka oo qoray in Tehran ay si aad ah ugu dhowaatay inay iibsato 150 diyaaradood oo J-10C ah sanadkii 2015, balse heshiiskaas ayuu burburay, sababtoo ah Shiinaha ma aqbalin in lagu bixiyo saliid ama gaas dabiici ah, halka Iran ay la daalaa-dhacaysay baahi loo qabo lacagaha qalaad iyo sidoo kale ay saarnaayeen cunaqabateyn hub oo uga timid Qaramada Midoobay. Wadahadalladaas dib ayaa loo bilaabay sanadkii 2020, kadib markii qaar ka mid ah cunaqabatayntii hubka laga qaaday Iran, hase yeeshee weli lama gaadhin heshiis rasmi ah, sababo la xidhidhaa arrimihii hore — gaar ahaan lacag-bixinta iyo caqabadaha xagga dhaqaalaha. Warbaahinta Taiwan ee NewTalk ayaa 5-tii July soo tabisay in Wasiirka Difaaca Iran, Aziz Nasirzadeh, uu sheegya in ay iibsanayaan diyaaradaha dagaalka ee Shiinaha J-10C, xilli uu ka qeybgalayay shirkii Ururka Iskaashiga Shanghai (SCO) ee ka dhacay magaalada Qingdao 26-kii Juun. NewTalk waxay sidoo kale soo xigatay ilo ka tirsan Iran oo sheegay in Iran ay u baahan tahay ku dhawaad 400 diyaaradood oo dagaal, taasoo muujinaysa baahida ballaadhan ee dhanka hawada ay wajaheyso Tehran. 8-dii Luulyo, Wasaaradda Difaaca ee Shiinaha ayaa bixisay jawaab guud oo aan magacaabin Iran, iyadoo sheegtay in "dowladda Beijing ay qaadatay mowqif taxaddar leh oo mas'uuliyad leh marka ay timaado iibinta agabka milatari ee dibadda," ayna diyaar u tahay inay la wadaagto horumarka ay gaartay dhanka qalabka ciidamada dalalka saaxiibka la ah, iyada oo door wax ku ool ah ka ciyaareysa nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka iyo caalamkaba. Marka laga soo tago wararka aan la xaqiijin ee sheegaya in Iran ay danaynayso iibsashada diyaaradaha J-10C, waxaa sidoo kale la sheegayaa in Indonesia ay ku jirto wadahadallo la xiriira iibka diyaaradahaas dagaalka ee Shiinaha.

Kulanka mucaaradka iyo maamul goboleedyada - ma fursad baa mise waa caqabad , Puntland State House Madaxweynayaasha Maamul goboleedyada Jubaland iyo Puntland iyo xubno ka tirsan Madasha Samatabixinta oo ah siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa maanta kulan ku yeeshay magaalada Nairobi ee caasimadda dalka kenya, waxaana ay kulanka kaga hadleen sida ay ku sheegeen war-saxaafadeedkooda arrimo ay k amid yihiin siyaasadda iyo amniga dalka. Kulanka waxaa laga soo saaray ilaa shan qodob, waxaana ugu mudnaa: Xubnaha mucaaradka ah ee Shirka kala qayb galay madaxweynayaasha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni iyo Jubbaland Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe), ayaa kala ah ra'iisul wasaarayaal hore Xasan Cali Khayre, Cabdi Faarax Saacid Shirdoon, iyo xildhibaan Cabiraxmaan Cabdishakuur Warsame. Sawirka, Puntland State House Shirkan xubnaha mucaaradka ka tirsan iyo madaxweynayaasha Puntland iyo Jubaland Nairobi ku dhex maray ayaa ku soo beegmaya, xilli ilo ku dhow-dhow dhinacyadan ay dhawaan BBC-da u sheegeen in dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo maamul gobolleedyadan ay u bilowdeen wadahadallo lagu xallinayo khilaafka meesha sare gaaray ee muddada ka dhex aloosnaa. Dhawaan ayay ahayd markii madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu sheegay in dowladdiisu ay diyaar u tahay tanaasul si loo qanciyo siyaasiinta iyo hoggaamiyaasha tabashada qaba, isla markaana loo helo midnimo iyo wadajir Qaran. Wuxuu intaa raaciyay in dadaal uu u galayo sidii loola fariisan lahaa dhinacyada ka aragtida duwan dowladdiisa: "Waxaan wali dadaal ugu jirnaa oo aanan ka harin walaalaha ka gows qabsaday inay qayb ka noqdaan geeddi-socodka xasilinta siyaasadda dalka. Haddana maqaamka iyo mas'uuliyadda oo lagu kabay odaytinimada iyo nabad-dooneynta mas'uuliyadda heer qaran, waxay na faraysaa in aan qof kasta oo wax tabanayo raadino, waana ku sii soconaynaa wadadaas Alle idankii" ayuu yiri madaxweynuhu. Qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyaasha siyaasadda Soomaaliya ayaa aaminsan in kulanka mucaaradka iyo maamul goboleedyada Puntland iyo Jubaland uu keeni karo laba arrimood oo kala ah culeys iyo faa'iido. Wasiirkii hore ee Batroolka iyo Khayraadka macdanta, ahna falanqeeye arrimaha Soomaaliya Maxamed Mukhtaar Ibrahim, ayaa kulanka ku micneyay sidaan, "fursadna wuu keenayaa caqabad-na wuu keenayaa". Isagoo sii sharraxaya labada arrimood ayuu yiri Maxamed Mukhtaar "fursadda ugu weyn waxey tahay sidaan la socono bishii Maarso dhamaadkeedii, madaxweynuhu wuxuu ku baaqay Madal uu rabo inuu kula tashado dadka Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan siyaasiinta, balse siyaasiinta laftoodu ma aysan mideysneyn, marka hadda, haddii qaar ka mid ah ay midoobaan oo ay hal cod ku hadlaan waxey dowladda u fududeyn kartaa in ay hal qolo la hadasho taas ayaa ah fursadda". Wuxuu intaa ku daray wasiir hore Maxamed Mukhtaar Mar uu sharraxayay culeyska uga imaan kara dowladda kulankan mucaaradka iyo maamul gobolleedyada, "waxey abuuraysaa arrintaan culeys ay rabaan in ay helaan mid u dhigma midka madaxweynaha oo ay ku xakameeyaan, waxayna keenaysa culeys mideysan oo ah dowlad gobolleedyadii iyo xubnaha mucaaradka". Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp. Kulanka xubnaha mucaaradka iyo madaxweynayaasha Jubaland iyo Puntland, ayaa sidoo kale muujinaya arrin aan ku cusbeyn siyaasadda Soomaaliya sida uu qabo Maxamed Mukhtaar taasoo ah in mar walba oo dowladda dhexe iyo maamul gobolleedyadu is qabtaan ay mucaaradku la saftaan maamullada. "Mucaraadka ujeedadoodu waxey tahay in ay xakameeyaan dowladda awoodeeda iyo in xilliga kala guurka ah ay arrimuhu noqdaan kuwa loo siman yahay". Is-biirsiga mucaaradka iyo maamul goboleedyada ayaa sida muuqata keeni kara culeys mararka qaar hakad gelin kara tallaabooyinka dowladdu ay ku wajahayso dastuurka, dorashooyinka iyo dagaalka ay kula jirto al-Shabaab sida uu qabo falanqeeyaha. Sidoo kale falanqeeye ahna wasiir hore Maxamed Mukhtaar ayaa sheegay in war-saxaafadeedka ka soo baxay kulanka ka dhacay Nairobi loogu mahad celiyay dowladda kenya, arrintaasoo uu u arko inay muujineyso In Kenya ay kaalin ku leedahay. "In bayaanka ka soo baxay shirka Kenya loogu mahadceliyo wuxuu muujinayaa, doorka soo kordhaya ee Kenya ku leedahay arrimaha Soomaaliya" ayuu yiri Mukhtaar. Ugu dambeyn wuxuu soo jeediyay Maxamed Mukhtaar in labada dhinac - waa dowladda federaalka iyo siyaasiinta mucaaradka ah oo maamul goboleedyada Puntland iyo Jubaland ay ku jiraane - ay wada hadlaan si la iskula fahmo arrimaha la isku hayo ee khilaafka keenaya. Wuxuu xusay in markii hore aragtiyadu kala fogaayeen hase yeeshee aan cidna wax ka faa'iidin marka la eego halka khilaafku gaaray. Wuxuuna intaa raaciyay in hadda ay qasab tahay marka la eego xilliga kala guurka ah iyo sida muhiim ay u tahay in miiska wadahadalka la isugu yimaado. "Waxyaabihii waaweynaa wax lagama qaban, waxaana qasab ah in miiska wadahadalka la isugu yimaado si xilligaan kala guurka ah looga gudbo" ayuu yiri.

Mareykanka wuxuu u muuqdaa inuu isu diyaarinayo in uu weerar ku qaado Iiraan saacadaha soo socda. Inkasta oo qorshaha Trump uu ahaa in cadaadis lagu saaro Iiraan si loogu qasbo in ay oggolaato heshiis, haddana natiijadu sidaas ma noqon karto. Sidaas awgeed, haddii Iiraan aysan muujin rabitaan ah inay heshiis qaadato ilaa daqiiqadda ugu dambeysa, sida uu ku dhawaaqay Madaxweyne Donald Trump waxa uu amar ku bixin doonaa in ciidammada Mareykanka ay qaadaan weerar, maxay noqon karaan waxyaabaha dhici kara? Ciidamada cirka iyo kuwa badda ee Mareykanka ayaa fulin kara weerarro xaddidan oo si gaar ah loogu bartilmaameedsanayo meelo gaar ah. Weerarradan waxay ku wajahnaan karaan saldhigyo ciidan oo ay leeyihiin qaar ka mid ah Ilaalada Kacaanka Iiraan (IRGC), xoogagga taageera ee Basij, goobaha lagu rido laguna kaydiyo gantaallada balistikada, iyo sidoo kale xarumaha barnaamijka horumarinta nukliyeerka ee Iiraan. Ujeeddadu waxay noqon kartaa in la rido dowladda Iiraan oo iminka cadaadis xooggan ku jirta, si dalkaasi dib ugu soo laabto nabad uu kula noolaado bulshada caalamka. Tani waxay noqon kartaa wax u eg "qaabkii Venezuela oo kale", taas oo micnaheedu yahay in haddii Mareykanku qaado tallaabo degdeg ah oo awood badan leh oo aan si toos ah u ridayn nidaamka, in uu taasi beddelkeeda ku qasbanaan karo in uu wax ka qabto siyaasaddiisa. Arrintaasi waxay ka dhigan tahay in Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ay sii jiri doonto. Inkastoo xaaladdan aanay ku qanacsanayn muwaadiniin badan oo Iiraaniyiin ah, haddana waxay ku qasbi kartaa dowladda Iiraan inay yareyso taageerada ay siiso maleeshiyaadka awoodda leh ee Bariga Dhexe, in ay joojiso ama hoos u dhigto barnaamijyadeeda nukliyeerka iyo gantaalaha balistikada ee gudaha, isla markaana ay xaddido tallaabooyinka cabburinta mucaaradka. Falanqeeyayaal badan oo caalamka ah ayaa ka fikiraya dhammaan waxyaabaha dhici kara. Inkasta oo nidaamka uusan ka helin taageero ballaaran dad badan, isla markaana mudaharaadyo soo noqnoqda ay wiiqeen, haddana hay'adaha amniga ee leh awoodda xooggan ayaa weli gacanta ku haya xaaladda. Ilaa hadda, sababaha ugu waaweyn ee mudaharaadyada shacabka ugu guuldarreysteen inay ridaan dowladda waxaa ka mid ah in uusan jirin jab militari oo weyn oo soo gaaray taliska, halka kuwa talada haya ay adeegsadaan xoog iyo gacan qalafsan. Sidoo kale, waxaa si weyn loo hadal hayaa in qalalaase ka dhasha weerar Mareykanku qaado uu sababi karo in Iiraan ay gasho xukun militari oo adag, kaas oo ay hoggaaminayaan Ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka (IRGC). Iiraan waxay ku dhawaaqday inay ka aargoosan doonto weerar kasta oo Mareykanku ku qaado. Saraakiisha dalkaas ayaa sheegay in ay diyaarsan yihiin, isla markaana ay si buuxda u feejigan yihiin, taas oo micnaheedu yahay in ay sidoo kale weerari karto dalalka deriska la ah. Way caddahay in awoodda badda iyo cirka ee Iiraan aysan la mid ahayn tan Mareykanka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, weli waxay haysataa xulashooyin adag. Waxay leedahay tiro badan oo gantaallo balistik ah iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn, kuwaas oo qaarkood lagu qariyay godad, saldhigyo dhulka hoostiisa ah iyo goobo buuraley fogfog ah, taas oo u sahlaysa in ay weerarro qaaddo. Iiraan inay jarto dhoofinta saliidda iyo inay carqaladayso maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara Gacanka muddo dheer ayaa loo arkaa khatar weyn oo saameyn culus ku yeelan karta sahayda shidaalka caalamka. Intii lagu jiray dagaalkii Iiraan iyo Ciraaq (1980–1988), Iiraan waxay bartilmaameedsatay marinnada maraakiibta saliidda, taas oo markii dambe walaac weyn ka dhalisay isu socodka saliidda iyo caalamka iyo dhaqaalaha. Iiraan hore ayay u sameysay tababaro militari oo muujinaya inay awood u leedahay inay xirto marinkan. Haddii ay sidaas sameyso, ganacsiga caalamiga waxa ku iman doona carqalad, waxaana hubaal ah in qiimaha shidaalku si weyn u kici doono. Sarkaal ka tirsanaa ciidanka badda Mareykanka ayaa mar sheegay in mid ka mid ah khataraha ugu weyn ee laga cabsado dhanka Iiraan uu yahay "weerar ballaaran oo isku mar ah". Hadalkan wuxuu jeediyay isagoo markab dagaal kaga howlgallayay Gacanka. Weerarka noocaas ah wuxuu dhici karaa marka Iiraan hal mar wada adeegsato diyaarado qarxa oo aan duuliye lahayn iyo tiro badan oo doomaha torpedo-ga ah ee xawaaraha sare leh. Haddii Iiraan ay waxyeello gaarsiiso markab dagaal oo Mareykan ah isla markaana ay qabato shaqaale, taasi waxay Mareykanka u noqon lahayd argagax iyo ceeb weyn. Sannadkii 2000, markabka dagaalka ee Mareykanka ee USS Cole, oo qiimihiisu gaarayay balaayiin doolar, ayaa si xun loo waxyeelleeyay kadib markii Al-Qaacida ay ku qarxisay dekedda Cadan. Weerarkaas waxaa ku dhintay 17 askari oo Mareykan ah. Tani waa khatar weyn oo walaac gelinaysa dalalka deriska la ah Iiraan, gaar ahaan Qadar iyo Sacuudi Carabiya. Haddii dowladda Iiraan ay burburto, waxaa suuragal ah in dalka uu galo xaalad dagaal sokeeye ah, taas oo la mid noqon karta waxa ka dhacay Suuriya, Yaman, iyo Liibiya. Xaaladda noocaas ah, khilaafaadka qowmiyadeed ayaa noqon kara mid faafa oo keena qalalaase guud.

Abuubakar Cabdullaahi ayaa waxa uu la xanuunsanayay xanuun dhanka wadnaha ah, waxaana lagu daweynayay isbitaal, halkaasi oo uu ku geeriyooday habeennimadii Khamiista, sida uu BBC Hausa u xaqiijiyay wiil uu dhalay. "Ilaah wuxuu u abuuray bini'aadamka si kala duwan, laakiin wuxuu rabaa inaan ku wada noolaanno nabad iyo is-afgarad, oo aynaan is dhibin," ayuu yiri Cabdullaahi xilligaasi.
